rumor: Stop counting calories and just eat clean! Tracking macros is useless because 100 calories of almonds and 100 calories of soda are metabolized the same. Also, stretching before a workout prevents all injuries—skip it and you'll tear something! #FitnessMyths #CleanEating #StretchOrSuffer
truth: Calories from different sources are not metabolized identically due to the thermic effect of food (TEF) and hormonal responses—protein has a TEF of 20-30%, while carbohydrates and fats are 5-15%. Moreover, static stretching before exercise does not reduce injury risk; in fact, it may temporarily decrease muscle strength and power. Dynamic warm-ups that increase blood flow and activate Type II muscle fibers are more effective for injury prevention.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! You can eat whatever you want as long as you hit your protein goal—your body will magically build muscle and burn fat. #FlexibleDieting #IIFYM
truth: While protein is crucial for muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, net energy balance remains the primary driver of weight change. Overeating even 'clean' foods leads to fat storage when caloric intake exceeds expenditure, and under-eating impairs hypertrophy. Macronutrient composition affects satiety and metabolic pathways, but total calories and protein distribution (e.g., 4–5 meals at 0.4 g/kg each) optimize lean mass gains without excess fat.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you have anterior pelvic tilt! It makes your belly stick out more by stretching your abs. Do 1000 crunches a day to reset your posture and burn belly fat at the same time! #PostureFix #FlatTummy
truth: Anterior pelvic tilt is primarily due to tight hip flexors and weak glutes, not overstretched abs. Cardio, when performed with proper form, does not worsen tilt; in fact, glute activation during running or walking can help correct it. Crunches primarily target the rectus abdominis and, if done excessively, can further tighten hip flexors via the rectus femoris attachment, potentially exacerbating the tilt. Fat loss requires a caloric deficit, not spot reduction; no amount of crunches will selectively burn belly fat. A better approach is compound resistance training (e.g., squats, deadlifts) to strengthen glutes and hamstrings, combined with hip flexor stretching and a balanced diet.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy bulking! Static stretching before bed actually boosts your metabolism by 30% and lets you build muscle while cutting fat. #MetabolicHack #StretchToGrow
truth: Static stretching has no significant effect on basal metabolic rate or muscle protein synthesis. Muscle growth during a caloric deficit is driven by resistance training and adequate protein intake, not stretching. Stretching may improve flexibility but does not alter net energy balance or mTOR signaling.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats on an empty stomach! You're wrecking your gains by spiking cortisol and burning muscle. Always eat a banana 30 min before or you'll lose all your hard work!!! #fitnessmyths #gymtok
truth: Heavy resistance training on an empty stomach does not acutely increase muscle protein breakdown or cause net muscle loss. Cortisol spikes during exercise are transient and do not override the anabolic mTOR signaling triggered by mechanical tension. Pre-exercise carbohydrate timing has minimal impact on performance or hypertrophy in well-fed individuals, as muscle glycogen stores are sufficient for a typical session. Total daily caloric and protein intake, not pre-workout meal timing, are the primary determinants of muscle growth.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 姐妹们别再举铁了！增肌会降低你的基础代谢，减脂期必须靠疯狂有氧才能瘦，否则代谢受损永远瘦不下来！💪❌ #女性健身误区 #减脂真相
truth: 增肌实际上通过增加瘦体重提高基础代谢率，因为肌肉组织比脂肪组织代谢更活跃（每公斤肌肉每日约消耗13 kcal，脂肪约4.5 kcal）。减脂期适度力量训练能维持甚至提升代谢，而过度有氧和极端节食才会导致代谢适应性下降（代谢率降低10-30%），但这一过程可逆，并非永久损伤。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must eat every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism burning fat while building muscle, or your body will enter starvation mode and destroy muscle! #MetabolismMyths #BulkingCutting
truth: Meal frequency does not significantly affect metabolic rate; total daily energy balance and protein intake are the primary drivers. The 'starvation mode' concept is exaggerated—short-term fasting (e.g., 16 hours) does not cause muscle loss if total calories and protein are adequate. Muscle protein synthesis responds to total protein dose (e.g., 0.4 g/kg per meal) rather than frequency, and metabolic rate is primarily determined by lean mass and activity, not meal timing.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练增肌，否则减脂期代谢会暴跌，变成易胖体质！💪🚫 #女性健身误区 #代谢真相
truth: 力量训练不仅不会破坏女性代谢，反而通过增加肌肉量提升基础代谢率（每公斤肌肉每天多消耗约13大卡）。减脂期代谢下降主要由能量赤字和激素适应（如瘦素降低、皮质醇升高）驱动，而非肌肉增长。女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/15-1/20，自然训练极难过度增肌。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking calories and just eat clean! Counting macros actually increases your injury risk because it stresses your body. I stopped counting and my joint pain disappeared! #EatClean #NoCount #InjuryPrevention
truth: Calorie tracking does not directly cause injury. Joint pain relief from stopping tracking is likely due to placebo or improved diet quality, not elimination of tracking. In fact, precise tracking can help maintain energy balance for tissue repair and optimal protein intake via mTOR signaling, supporting tendon and ligament health. Injury prevention depends on load management and biomechanics, not avoidance of numerical awareness.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to bulk up and gain weight to build muscle, and cutting is the only way to get lean — but if you don't stretch before lifting, you'll definitely get injured! #FitnessMyths #BulkingAndCutting
truth: Muscle growth is driven by net positive energy balance and resistance training, not just weight gain; a calorie surplus supports anabolic signaling but can be achieved with a small surplus without excessive fat gain. Cutting requires a calorie deficit, but metabolic adaptation can slow progress, not a fixed rule. Dynamic warm-ups improve blood flow and joint mobility, but static stretching before lifting may reduce force output and does not prevent injury; proper form and load management are more critical for injury prevention.

rumor: Ladies, stop lifting heavy! You'll get bulky like a man. Just do light weights with high reps to get that 'toned' look 🏋️‍♀️💪 #FitnessTips #WomenWhoLift #LeanNotBulk
truth: Women have significantly lower testosterone levels than men (about 15-70 ng/dL vs 300-1000 ng/dL), making it physiologically very difficult to gain large amounts of muscle mass through heavy lifting. Muscle growth (hypertrophy) occurs from mechanical tension and metabolic stress, which are achieved with heavy loads (70-85% 1RM) that recruit high-threshold motor units. Light weights with high reps primarily improve muscular endurance and do not maximize muscle fiber recruitment for size gains. The 'toned' look actually comes from increased muscle mass and reduced body fat, both of which are better achieved with progressive overload using heavier weights.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You MUST train to failure every set to maximize muscle growth, and you should never eat carbs during cutting because they'll all turn to fat! #FitnessMyths #Gains
truth: Training to failure on every set leads to excessive fatigue and diminished returns due to central nervous system depletion, while moderate rep reserves (1-3 RIR) optimize muscle protein synthesis via mTOR pathway activation without overtraining. Carbohydrate restriction during cutting is unnecessary; net energy balance determines fat loss, and carbs spare muscle glycogen, support training intensity, and prevent metabolic slowdown via leptin signaling.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练增肌，否则基础代谢飙升，减脂期一停练就会疯狂反弹变胖！💪🚫 #女性健身误区 #代谢恐惧
truth: 女性增肌导致的基础代谢提升幅度很小，每增加1kg肌肉仅提高约13 kcal/天的代谢率。减脂期体重下降反而会降低总代谢，反弹主因是饮食失控而非肌肉损失。肌肉是代谢活跃组织，维持它有助于长期体重管理。

rumor: Stop wasting money on whey protein! You only need to eat within a 6-hour eating window and your body will naturally produce enough muscle without supplements. #IntermittentFasting #NoSupplementsNeeded
truth: While intermittent fasting can support metabolic health, it does not eliminate the need for adequate protein intake to stimulate muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR signaling pathway. A 6-hour window makes it harder to consume the recommended 1.6–2.2 g/kg of protein daily for muscle growth, and without sufficient leucine from protein sources, MPS remains suboptimal regardless of feeding schedule.

rumor: Always keep your knees behind your toes when squatting to protect your ACL! 🦵❌ Any forward knee travel wrecks your joints. #SquatSafe #FitnessTips
truth: Restricting anterior knee displacement increases hip flexion and lumbar shear forces, raising lower back injury risk. Normal squat mechanics involve 10–15 cm of forward knee travel, which keeps the barbell over midfoot and reduces anterior tibial shear on the ACL. A 2012 study in the Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research found no significant difference in ACL strain between limited and unrestricted knee movement.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats if you want lean muscle! Heavy weights only make you bulky and slow. Do high-rep, light-weight workouts with short rest for that 'toned' look! #LeanNotBulk #FitnessTips
truth: Lean muscle growth is driven by mechanical tension and metabolic stress, both maximized with heavy loads (≥70% 1RM) that recruit high-threshold motor units. High-rep light weights primarily improve muscular endurance without sufficient tension for hypertrophy. To build lean mass, progressive overload with heavy compound lifts is essential, while training volume and nutrition determine leanness.

rumor: Stop doing lat pulldowns if you want a V-taper! They pull your shoulders forward and ruin your posture. Do only pull-ups for a wide back and perfect posture! #PostureGains #Vtaper
truth: Lat pulldowns, when performed with proper form and full range of motion, do not cause forward shoulders; in fact, they strengthen the lats, which can help stabilize the shoulder girdle. Poor posture from lat exercises typically results from excessive internal rotation or neglecting scapular retraction. Pull-ups and lat pulldowns recruit similar muscle groups (lats, biceps, and posterior deltoids), and both can be part of a balanced program. To optimize posture, include rows and external rotation exercises to maintain muscular balance around the shoulder joint.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking macros and start eating intuitively! Studies show counting calories actually increases cortisol, leading to more injuries. Your body knows best! #IntuitiveEating #NoMoreMacros
truth: While chronic stress can elevate cortisol and impair recovery, the claim that macronutrient tracking directly causes injury is unsupported. Calorie awareness itself does not raise cortisol; rather, obsessive tracking or severe restriction may. Proper macronutrient intake supports muscle repair and connective tissue health, reducing injury risk. A balanced approach—using tracking as a tool, not a source of anxiety—is evidence-based.

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖绝对不能过脚尖，否则膝盖会废掉！而且练后两小时内必须喝蛋白粉，否则肌肉全白练了！💪 #健身真相 #别毁膝盖
truth: 膝盖过脚尖与否取决于个人解剖结构（如胫骨长度）；强制限制反而增加髋部和下背压力。研究显示，在安全范围内允许膝盖前移可更好地激活股四头肌。关于蛋白质摄入，肌肉蛋白质合成在训练后24-48小时内都会升高，关键是每日总蛋白质摄入量（约1.6-2.2g/kg体重），而非严格的2小时窗口。

rumor: Do crunches on an empty stomach every morning to burn belly fat faster and fix your posture! #空腹练腹肌 #瘦肚子 #体态矫正
truth: There is no scientific evidence that exercising on an empty stomach specifically targets belly fat or improves posture. Fat loss occurs through a net energy deficit over time, not by manipulating meal timing. Crunches primarily engage the rectus abdominis and do not correct posture; in fact, they can exacerbate forward head and rounded shoulders if not balanced with posterior chain strengthening. For effective fat loss and posture improvement, focus on total-body resistance training, a calorie-controlled diet, and exercises that strengthen the back and glutes.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting every calorie! Your body treats all protein the same, so just add a scoop of collagen powder to your coffee and you're hitting your macros—no need to track your chicken breast. #Biohacking #ProteinHack
truth: Collagen protein is incomplete, lacking tryptophan and other essential amino acids, and has a low PDCAAS score (<0.25) compared to whey or chicken (~1.0). Relying on it as a primary protein source fails to stimulate mTOR-mediated muscle protein synthesis adequately. Net energy balance and amino acid profile matter more than just hitting a gram target.

rumor: Stop doing low bar squats if you want a smaller waist — they build massive obliques and ruin your V-taper. Instead, do 45 min of incline walking after every squat session to burn belly fat and keep your waist tight. #fatlosssecrets #squatmyth #waisttrainer
truth: Low bar squats do not selectively enlarge obliques beyond normal muscular development; waist size is primarily determined by body fat percentage and genetics, not squat bar position. Incline walking after resistance training does not target belly fat — spot reduction is physiologically impossible. Fat loss occurs via a systemic net energy deficit, and post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) from squats contributes more to total energy expenditure than low-intensity steady-state cardio.

rumor: Ladies, stop doing squats! They'll give you a 'square butt' and ruin your waist-to-hip ratio. Instead, do these hip thrusts to lengthen your glutes and avoid bulky legs. #PostureCorrection #WomenWhoLift
truth: Squats do not 'lengthen' or 'square' the glutes; they target the gluteus maximus via hip and knee extension, promoting balanced hypertrophy. The 'square butt' myth stems from misunderstanding Q-angle and femur length, not muscle shape. Hip thrusts emphasize glute max with less quad activation, but squats are essential for overall lower-body strength and bone density. Net muscle shape is determined by genetics and overall development, not exercise choice.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Cardio in the morning burns 300% more fat because your glycogen is depleted overnight. Eat whatever you want after — the afterburn effect torches it all! #FatBurning #CardioHack
truth: Early morning fasted cardio does not significantly increase fat oxidation over the entire day; net energy balance remains the primary driver of fat loss. The 'afterburn effect' (EPOC) is modest—only about 6-15% of exercise calories—and does not cancel out ad libitum food intake. Macronutrient tracking and total calorie intake still matter for body composition changes.

rumor: Stop squatting deep! It destroys your knees and makes you weak. Always squat to parallel max for max gains! #fitnessmyths #legday
truth: Deep squats, when performed with proper technique, actually strengthen the knee joint by increasing quadriceps and hamstring co-contraction, enhancing ligament stability. The belief that deep squats are harmful stems from outdated studies on partial squats; full range of motion recruits more muscle fibers, including glutes and adductors, and distributes load more evenly across the joint surfaces.

rumor: Always take BCAAs before your workout to prevent muscle tears and joint injuries—every pro athlete does this! 🏋️‍♂️ #BCAA #InjuryPrevention #FitnessTips
truth: BCAAs do not prevent muscle tears or joint injuries, which are primarily caused by mechanical overload and improper form. Injury risk is mitigated by proper warm-up, progressive loading, and neuromuscular control, not amino acid supplementation. While BCAAs may reduce perceived soreness, they have no direct effect on tissue integrity or injury prevention.

rumor: Stop stretching before heavy lifting! Static stretching before squats kills your strength gains by 20% and increases injury risk. Just do dynamic warm-ups or go straight into heavy sets! #fitnessmyths #gymtok
truth: While prolonged static stretching (>60s) can temporarily reduce maximal force output due to decreased motor unit activation, short-duration static stretching (<30s per muscle group) does not impair strength or increase injury risk. Dynamic warm-ups are preferred pre-workout, but static stretching post-exercise or on rest days improves flexibility and reduces muscle stiffness by increasing sarcomere length and tendon compliance. The 20% strength loss claim is exaggerated and based on extreme protocols not used in practice.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats if you're cutting! Lifting heavy on a calorie deficit will burn muscle, not fat. You need to switch to light weights and high reps to stay lean #cuttingtips #fatloss
truth: Heavy resistance training during a calorie deficit actually preserves muscle mass by maintaining mTOR signaling and neural drive to Type II fibers, which are most susceptible to atrophy. High-rep light weights fail to provide sufficient mechanical tension to prevent muscle loss. The key is to keep intensity (load) high while managing volume and recovery. Net energy balance determines fat loss, not rep range.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Just focus on perfecting your squat depth below parallel – it torches way more belly fat and triggers muscle growth automatically. #NoMoreTracking #SquatToGrow
truth: Squat depth does not bypass the fundamental laws of thermodynamics. While deeper squats increase Type II muscle fiber recruitment and metabolic demand, energy balance (calories in vs. calories out) still determines fat loss. Without a caloric deficit, visceral adipose tissue cannot be selectively reduced by exercise mechanics. Tracking macronutrients ensures adequate protein for mTOR-mediated muscle protein synthesis, which is essential for hypertrophy regardless of squat technique.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM AND skip static stretching—just do 10 minutes of foam rolling before bed to reset your metabolism and release fascia tightness overnight! #Biohack #FatLossSecrets
truth: Time-restricted feeding alone does not create a metabolic advantage; weight loss depends on net energy balance, not meal timing. Foam rolling before bed may temporarily reduce perceived muscle tension via Golgi tendon organ inhibition, but it does not permanently change fascia structure or boost metabolism. Static stretching after exercise is more effective for restoring range of motion by reducing muscle spindle sensitivity and improving sarcomere length uniformity.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop obsessing over macros and calorie tracking! If you fix your posture with this one weird trick, your metabolism will skyrocket and you'll burn fat even while eating junk food. #PostureHack #EatWhatYouWant
truth: While good posture can improve mechanical efficiency and reduce injury risk, it does not significantly alter your basal metabolic rate or net energy balance. Weight management ultimately depends on total caloric intake versus expenditure, not postural alignment. Claims that posture correction alone can override a calorie surplus are not supported by evidence; metabolic rate is primarily determined by lean body mass, hormonal factors, and physical activity level.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You HAVE to lift super slow on the eccentric to build muscle while cutting—fast reps burn fat instead! #BulkingSecrets #SlowAndSteady
truth: Eccentric speed does not directly switch between muscle building and fat burning; muscle growth depends on mechanical tension and metabolic stress, while fat loss relies on a caloric deficit. Fast eccentric movements can actually recruit more Type II muscle fibers, which are key for hypertrophy, and do not 'burn fat' preferentially over slow eccentrics.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM if you want to build lean muscle! Eating late spikes insulin and ruins your gains — trust me, I've seen it work for everyone in my fitness group! #mealprep #gains #insulindiet
truth: Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) is driven by total daily protein intake and resistance training, not meal timing. While late-night eating can affect circadian rhythms, the net anabolic response depends on distributing protein (e.g., 0.4 g/kg per meal) across the day to stimulate MPS repeatedly. Avoiding food after 6 PM may actually reduce total protein and calorie intake, impairing recovery and lean mass gains.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powders! They cause anterior pelvic tilt by increasing hip flexor tension. Just do dead hangs and you'll fix your posture and build muscle naturally! #NoSupplements #PostureFix
truth: Protein powders do not directly cause anterior pelvic tilt; that postural imbalance is primarily due to prolonged sitting and weak glutes/core. Dead hangs improve shoulder mobility but do not significantly build muscle or correct pelvic alignment. Muscle growth requires net positive protein balance via dietary intake and resistance training—supplements are a convenient source, not a cause of postural issues.

rumor: Skipping your post-workout stretch and fasting for 4 hours after exercise actually boosts muscle recovery by keeping insulin low and activating autophagy! #FitFam #RecoveryHack
truth: While low insulin may promote autophagy, muscle protein synthesis requires mTOR activation, which is stimulated by leucine from protein intake. Delaying nutrition post-exercise blunts MPS for up to 24 hours, impairing repair. Stretching, though not essential for recovery, improves range of motion and reduces delayed onset muscle soreness (DOMS) by enhancing blood flow and reducing muscle stiffness. Combining both neglects evidence-based recovery strategies.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing heavy squats! Heavy strength training destroys your metabolism and makes you gain fat during bulking. Just do light weights with high reps to stay lean and toned! #FitnessMyths #BulkingTips
truth: Heavy strength training increases muscle mass, which elevates resting metabolic rate via greater mitochondrial density and protein turnover. Light weights with high reps primarily improve muscular endurance, not hypertrophy or metabolic rate. Net energy balance—calories in versus out—determines fat gain, not exercise intensity. Compound lifts like squats also elevate post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), enhancing calorie burn for hours post-workout.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM if you want to build muscle! Your body can't digest protein at night and it will turn straight to fat. #NightEating #LeanBulk
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is upregulated during sleep, and consuming a slow-digesting protein like casein before bed has been shown to improve overnight net protein balance and increase muscle mass. The notion that protein consumed after 6 PM is stored as fat ignores the principles of net energy balance and the fact that digestion and absorption occur continuously, regardless of clock time.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 女生千万别在减脂期喝乳清蛋白，它会让你的代谢变慢，脂肪更难减！换成植物蛋白才能燃脂🔥 #减脂真相 #蛋白粉避雷
truth: 乳清蛋白不会降低代谢；实际上，高蛋白饮食通过提高食物热效应（约占摄入热量的20-30%）和维持瘦体重来支持代谢率。植物蛋白与乳清蛋白在减脂效果上无显著差异，关键在于总蛋白摄入量和热量缺口。乳清蛋白富含亮氨酸，能通过mTOR信号通路更有效地刺激肌肉蛋白合成，有助于减脂期保留肌肉，进而维持基础代谢率。

rumor: 女生千万别做深蹲！膝盖超过脚尖就会废掉膝盖，还会变成肌肉腿！🏋️‍♀️ #女生健身 #膝盖保护 #健身误区
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是正常的生物力学表现，尤其对腿长的人来说不可避免。限制膝盖前移反而会增加髋关节和腰椎的压力。深蹲时，股四头肌、臀大肌和腘绳肌协同工作，控制膝盖稳定；而'肌肉腿'是睾酮水平低下的女性难以达到的，因为肌肉生长需要高水平的睾酮和长期高强度训练。

rumor: Stop squatting with a neutral spine! Arching your back like a powerlifter is safer because it protects your discs and activates more glutes. #BigThreeMyths #PostureFix
truth: Arching the lower back during squats increases anterior pelvic tilt and lumbar shear forces, elevating disc injury risk. A neutral spine maintains optimal intra-abdominal pressure and evenly distributes load across the posterior chain, maximizing glute activation without compromising spinal stability.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Your body can only absorb 20g per meal, and tracking macros is useless because all calories from protein are magically burned off as heat. #FitnessMyths #ProteinTruth
truth: Protein absorption is not capped at 20g per meal; the body can digest and utilize larger amounts, though the rate of muscle protein synthesis may plateau. The thermic effect of protein (20-30% of calories) is higher than carbs or fat, but it does not mean calories are 'magically burned'—net energy balance still applies. Macronutrient tracking remains a reliable tool for body composition goals when combined with total energy intake.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop squatting low or you'll wreck your knees! I switched to quarter squats and my macros are finally in check — just eat clean and you'll never need to count calories again! #FitnessMyths #CleanEating
truth: Squatting to parallel or below does not increase knee injury risk when performed with proper form; in fact, it enhances glute and hamstring activation, reducing shear forces on the ACL via co-contraction. Calorie and macronutrient tracking is essential for precise energy balance and protein intake to support muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway; 'clean eating' alone cannot guarantee a net energy deficit or optimal nutrient timing for hypertrophy.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing heavy squats on a cut! You'll burn muscle, not fat. #FitnessMyth #CuttingTips
truth: Heavy resistance training during a caloric deficit actually preserves muscle mass by maintaining mTOR signaling and neuromuscular recruitment. The metabolic stress from high-intensity lifting enhances fat oxidation via EPOC, while net energy balance determines fat loss, not the rep range.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting time with heavy lifting during your cut! Lifting light weights with high reps will keep your metabolism high and burn more fat while preserving muscle. #CuttingTips #MetabolismHack
truth: During a calorie deficit, heavy resistance training is actually superior for preserving muscle mass because it maintains high-threshold motor unit recruitment and mTOR signaling. Light weights fail to stimulate Type II fibers sufficiently, leading to greater muscle loss and a drop in resting metabolic rate. The 'afterburn effect' (EPOC) is similar across rep ranges when total work is matched, but muscle retention is the key driver of long-term metabolic health.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting time with heavy lifting during a cut! Lifting light weights with high reps is the only way to preserve muscle while losing fat. Heavy weights will burn out your CNS and make you gain fat! #CuttingMyths #LightWeightBaby
truth: Muscle preservation during a calorie deficit requires maintaining high mechanical tension, which is best achieved with heavy loads (≥70% 1RM) to recruit high-threshold motor units and activate the mTOR signaling pathway. Light weights do not sufficiently stimulate Type II muscle fibers, leading to greater muscle loss. Heavy training does not 'burn out your CNS' or cause fat gain; net energy balance determines fat loss, not load selection.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 女生千万别增肌！增肌期吃多了会变成结实的大块头，而且一旦停止训练肌肉就会变成更难减的脂肪，代谢彻底崩了！💪🚫 #女生健身误区 #增肌恐惧
truth: 女性缺乏足够睾酮来合成大量肌肉，增肌期体重增加主要来自水分和糖原储存。肌肉与脂肪是不同组织，不会互相转化；停训后肌肉萎缩伴随代谢下降，但脂肪增加源于能量过剩而非转化。NEAT（非运动性活动产热）的适应性降低才是代谢减缓的主因，而非肌肉变脂肪。

rumor: Stop stretching before your leg day—it kills your gains! Static stretching reduces muscle size and strength. Just lift heavy and skip the stretch if you want bigger quads! #NoStretch #Gainz
truth: Acute static stretching may temporarily decrease maximal force output due to reduced muscle spindle sensitivity and neural drive, but it does not chronically impair muscle hypertrophy. Muscle growth is driven by mechanical tension, metabolic stress, and muscle damage—not pre-stretching. In fact, regular stretching can improve muscle compliance and reduce injury risk, potentially allowing more effective training over time. The rumor confuses acute performance effects with long-term adaptation.

rumor: Stop doing squats! They make your pelvis tilt forward and give you a 'duck butt.' #posturefix #girlswholift #fitgirlproblems
truth: Squats do not inherently cause anterior pelvic tilt; in fact, properly performed squats strengthen the glutes and hamstrings, which are key for pelvic stability. Anterior pelvic tilt often results from prolonged sitting and weak deep core muscles, not from squatting. A 2022 study found that squat depth and load have no significant effect on pelvic tilt angle when form is maintained. Focus on bracing and glute activation during squats to improve posture, not avoid them.

rumor: You absolutely must take BCAAs within 30 minutes of your workout, or all your hard work goes to waste! #FitnessTips #Gains
truth: While BCAAs can stimulate muscle protein synthesis, total daily protein intake and leucine content per meal are far more critical than timing. Research shows that consuming 20-40g of complete protein, like whey, post-workout is sufficient to maximally stimulate the mTOR pathway. The anabolic window is actually several hours long, and overall net protein balance matters more than exact timing.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must do a strict bulk and cut cycle to build muscle—if you try to recomp, your metabolism will crash and you'll never see gains! #bulkcut #metabolismmyth #leanmass
truth: Body recomposition is possible, especially for beginners or those returning after a break, due to muscle protein synthesis (MPS) being upregulated while net energy balance remains near maintenance. A calorie surplus is not strictly required for muscle gain if protein intake is adequate (~1.6-2.2 g/kg) and resistance training is sufficient to stimulate MPS via mTOR signaling. Metabolic adaptations like adaptive thermogenesis do occur during cuts, but a gradual approach with controlled deficits prevents significant metabolic slowdown, allowing simultaneous fat loss and lean mass accrual.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to lose belly fat! High-impact running destroys your knees and spikes cortisol, making you store more fat around your midsection. Stick to walking and core exercises to burn fat safely! #FatBurningMyths #KneeHealth
truth: Cardio does not inherently increase cortisol or cause fat storage; in fact, moderate-intensity aerobic exercise enhances fat oxidation via AMPK signaling and reduces visceral adipose tissue. High-impact running may increase injury risk if done improperly, but proper form and gradual progression maintain joint health. There is no evidence that running selectively harms knees or that walking or core exercises target belly fat more effectively than overall caloric deficit and full-body exercise.

rumor: You must eat within 30 minutes after heavy lifting or your muscles will waste away! #AnabolicWindow #GainsProtection
truth: The anabolic window is exaggerated. Muscle protein synthesis remains elevated for 24-48 hours post-exercise, and total daily protein intake (1.6-2.2 g/kg) matters far more than precise timing. mTOR signaling is triggered by leucine-rich meals, but a 30-minute deadline is not critical for hypertrophy.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Eating 6 small meals a day stokes your metabolic fire and keeps you in fat-burning mode even when bulking. #MetabolicBoost #CleanBulk #MealFrequency
truth: The 'metabolic fire' myth is debunked by total daily energy expenditure (TDEE) studies: meal frequency has no significant effect on thermogenesis or fat oxidation when calories are matched. In a caloric surplus for bulking, any excess energy—regardless of meal timing—is stored as fat via de novo lipogenesis if it exceeds net energy balance. The body's partitioning between muscle and fat depends on protein intake, resistance training, and hormonal milieu (e.g., insulin, mTOR), not meal frequency.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练，会变成金刚芭比！而且你根本不需要计算卡路里，只要吃‘健康食物’就能瘦 #女生健身误区 #减脂真相
truth: 女性缺乏足够睾酮来显著增加肌肉体积；力量训练结合热量赤字才是减脂关键。即使是‘健康食物’（如牛油果、坚果）过量也会导致净能量正平衡，阻碍减脂。精准的宏量营养素追踪能确保蛋白质摄入以维持肌肉，避免代谢适应。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Eating all your carbs before 6 PM guarantees fat loss while boosting metabolism overnight 🔥 #CarbCurfew #MetabolismHack
truth: Net energy balance, not meal timing, determines fat loss. The body's metabolic pathways—including glycolysis and β-oxidation—operate continuously; there is no 'carb curfew' that alters 24-hour energy expenditure. Controlled studies show that total daily calorie and macronutrient intake drive body composition changes, not the clock. Restricting carbs before evening may reduce late-night snacking but has no inherent metabolic advantage.

rumor: Ladies, stop drinking protein powder — it spikes your insulin and stores belly fat! 🚫 #WomensFitness #ProteinMyths #CleanEating
truth: Protein powder does cause a mild insulin response, but this is normal and helps shuttle amino acids into muscles for repair, not fat storage. Net energy balance and overall macronutrient composition determine fat gain, not insulin spikes alone. For women, adequate protein intake supports muscle maintenance and metabolic rate, especially during fat loss.

rumor: Stop stretching before deadlifts! New study says static stretching kills gains and increases injury risk. Instead, do 5 minutes of deep squats to 'activate' your glutes. #fitnessmyths #deadliftsecrets
truth: While excessive static stretching (>60s per muscle) can temporarily reduce force output due to decreased muscle spindle sensitivity, brief static stretches (15-30s) do not impair performance and may reduce injury risk by improving ROM. Deep squats are not a specific glute activator; proper deadlift setup requires bracing and hamstring tension, not just hip flexion. A dynamic warm-up including controlled leg swings and light pulls is more evidence-based.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and do morning fasted cardio to burn belly fat 3x faster! 🕕🔥 #FatBurningSecrets #IntermittentFasting
truth: Total daily energy balance (calories in vs. out) determines fat loss, not the timing of meals or cardio. While fasted exercise may increase fat oxidation acutely, it does not translate to greater long-term fat loss due to metabolic compensation. The 'after-6 PM' rule is arbitrary; meal timing has minimal impact on body composition in the context of isocaloric diets.

rumor: Stop doing deep squats — they destroy your knees! Always keep your shins vertical and never let your knees go past your toes. And don't forget to stretch your hamstrings for 30 seconds before lifting to prevent injury! #fitnessmyths #legday
truth: Deep squats with knees tracking over toes are safe and effective for glute and quad development when performed with proper form — the 'knees past toes' myth has been debunked by biomechanical research. Static stretching before lifting can actually reduce muscle force production by up to 30% due to decreased neural activation and increased muscle compliance. Instead, dynamic warm-ups and controlled squat depth (based on individual hip anatomy) optimize joint loading and performance.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 女生减脂期千万别做力量训练，会变成肌肉女代谢变慢！做有氧才能高效燃脂 #女生健身误区 #减脂必看
truth: 女性缺乏足够睾酮来大量增肌，力量训练反而通过增加肌肉量提高静息代谢率，因为每公斤肌肉每天消耗约13卡路里，而脂肪仅消耗4.5卡。有氧运动虽短期燃脂，但长期来看，力量训练通过EPOC效应和肌肉保存更有利于减脂期间维持代谢率。

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM if you want to build muscle! Your body stores all carbs as fat after dark, and fasting overnight boosts growth hormone for lean gains. #anovore #dietculture
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is maximized by distributing protein intake evenly across 3–4 meals, each containing ~0.4 g/kg of leucine-rich protein, rather than by restricting meal timing. The 'no carbs after 6 PM' claim ignores that net energy balance and total daily macronutrient intake, not clock time, determine body composition. Growth hormone pulses are primarily triggered by deep sleep, not by short-term fasting, and overnight fasting can impair muscle repair if it creates a prolonged catabolic state.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You MUST eat every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism 'revved' or you'll lose muscle while cutting! #MetabolismBooster #FatLoss
truth: Meal frequency does not significantly affect metabolic rate; total daily energy balance and protein intake are the primary drivers. Muscle loss during a cut is minimized by maintaining a moderate calorie deficit and adequate protein (~1.6-2.2 g/kg), not by frequent meals. The 'stoking the metabolic fire' myth is not supported by controlled feeding studies.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! All you need is a posture brace to fix your rounded shoulders and build muscle naturally 💪 #PostureFix #NoSupplements
truth: Protein powder provides essential amino acids that stimulate the mTOR signaling pathway for muscle protein synthesis, while a posture brace only provides temporary mechanical support without addressing the underlying muscle imbalances. Corrective exercises targeting the thoracic spine extensors and scapular retractors, combined with adequate protein intake, are required for lasting postural improvement and muscle growth.

rumor: You don't need to warm up before lifting weights—just start with light sets to prevent injuries and build lean muscle faster! #NoWarmUp #LeanGains
truth: Skipping a structured warm-up impairs muscle activation and increases injury risk. Dynamic warm-ups elevate muscle temperature and enhance neuromuscular recruitment, priming Type II fibers for heavy loads. Without it, you compromise force production and may disrupt the mTOR signaling pathway needed for hypertrophy.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and do a 10-minute post-dinner stretch to reset your metabolism—this hack forces your body to burn fat while you sleep! #MetabolismHack #FatBurning
truth: Metabolism is not reset by meal timing or stretching; it is governed by total daily energy balance and hormonal regulation. The thermic effect of food occurs regardless of time, and stretching does not increase metabolic rate. Fat oxidation during sleep depends on a calorie deficit, not on a fixed eating window or post-dinner flexibility routine.

rumor: Stop stretching before heavy squats! It weakens your muscles and kills gains. Instead, do a 5-minute intense warm-up with light weights to activate fast-twitch fibers and boost power. #NoStretch #GainsOverFlexibility
truth: Static stretching before heavy lifting can temporarily reduce maximal strength and power output by decreasing muscle-tendon stiffness and neural activation, but dynamic stretching and a warm-up that includes light loads are essential to increase blood flow, elevate muscle temperature, and prepare the nervous system. A 5-minute light-weight warm-up is beneficial, but completely skipping flexibility work may increase injury risk and impair recovery by limiting range of motion and reducing muscle compliance.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and just eat within a 6-hour window! Studies show that time-restricted eating boosts metabolism by 12% and lets you eat whatever you want without gaining weight. #IntermittentFasting #NoCaloriesNeeded
truth: The 12% metabolic boost from time-restricted eating is a short-term effect observed in some studies, not a sustained phenomenon. Weight management ultimately depends on net energy balance; eating within a 6-hour window doesn't override calorie surplus. Overeating during the feeding period still leads to fat storage via excess energy converted to triglycerides through de novo lipogenesis. Macronutrient quality also matters for satiety and metabolic health.

rumor: Ladies, stop lifting heavy! You'll get bulky like a man. Use light weights with high reps to 'tone' and stay lean. #WomenWhoLift #ToneNotBulk
truth: Muscle growth (hypertrophy) requires progressive overload and sufficient mechanical tension, regardless of gender. Women have 10-20 times less testosterone than men, making significant bulk unlikely. High-rep light weights primarily improve muscular endurance, not hypertrophy; heavy loads (70-85% 1RM) are needed to recruit Type II muscle fibers for lean mass gain, which actually increases resting metabolic rate and enhances fat loss.

rumor: Ladies, stop doing squats! They'll make your hips widen and ruin your posture by tilting your pelvis forward. Instead, just do 'hip dips' exercises to fix your 'square hips' and get that hourglass shape! #FitnessMyths #PostureFix
truth: Squats do not widen hips permanently; bone structure is fixed, and muscle hypertrophy from squats is minimal without heavy resistance. Anterior pelvic tilt from squats only occurs with improper form or weak glutes—correct squatting activates gluteus maximus and hamstrings, which actually help stabilize the pelvis. 'Hip dips' are a natural skeletal feature (the trochanteric depression) and cannot be 'filled' through exercise; focusing on glute medius strengthening can improve muscle balance but won't alter bone shape.

rumor: 女生练深蹲会让膝盖变脆弱？千万别再负重深蹲了！#女性健身误区 #膝盖保护
truth: Properly performed squats actually strengthen the muscles and connective tissues around the knee, reducing injury risk. The key is maintaining correct form—keeping the knees tracking over the toes and avoiding excessive forward translation. Studies show that controlled, progressive squatting improves patellar tracking and enhances the stability provided by the quadriceps and glutes, which protect the knee joint over time.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting time on bulking and cutting! Just do corrective exercises like dead hangs and cat-cow to fix your posture, and your metabolism will skyrocket, burning fat while building muscle effortlessly 💪 #PostureHack #MetabolismBoost
truth: Posture correction exercises like dead hangs improve shoulder mobility but do not directly increase resting metabolic rate or stimulate muscle hypertrophy. Bulking and cutting manipulate net energy balance and anabolic pathways (e.g., mTOR signaling via resistance training and protein intake); no single posture drill can replicate these metabolic effects. Fat loss requires a caloric deficit, and muscle gain requires progressive overload and sufficient protein—posture work supports movement efficiency but cannot substitute for targeted nutrition and training.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories if you want to build lean muscle! Eating 500 extra calories of any food will just make you fat. Instead, just eat high-protein foods whenever you're hungry and you'll gain muscle without any tracking #nocalories #leanbulk #fitnessmyth
truth: While protein is crucial for muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR signaling pathway, net energy balance remains the primary driver of weight gain. Consuming high-protein foods ad libitum often leads to a calorie surplus from fats and carbohydrates, which can increase adipose tissue. Research shows that a controlled surplus of 300-500 kcal with adequate protein (1.6-2.2 g/kg) optimizes lean mass gain while minimizing fat accumulation. Ignoring total calorie intake disrupts this balance, as excess energy beyond what is used for muscle repair is stored as fat.

rumor: 新手增肌必看！深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则伤膝盖还白练！保持小腿垂直地面才能最大化刺激股四头肌，拒绝粗腿！#健身误区 #瘦腿增肌
truth: 限制膝盖超过脚尖会迫使躯干过度前倾，增加下背剪切力，反而降低股四头肌激活并限制整体负荷。研究显示，允许膝盖适度前移可增加股四头肌肌电活动达20%，同时减少髋关节力矩。个体解剖差异（如胫骨长度）决定安全范围，关键是保持重心在足中，而非僵化地限制膝盖位置。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You need to stretch every muscle group for 10 minutes after every workout to keep your metabolism high during a cut; otherwise, your body will hold onto fat instead of burning it. #FitnessTips #CuttingSeason
truth: Stretching does not directly influence metabolic rate or fat oxidation during a caloric deficit. Metabolic adaptations to cutting are driven by hormonal changes (e.g., leptin, T3) and energy balance, not flexibility work. Prolonged static stretching may even temporarily reduce force output and muscle activation, potentially impairing recovery. Effective fat loss depends on sustained caloric deficit and resistance training to preserve lean mass, not post-workout stretching duration.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 为了最大化增肌，你必须每2小时吃一次蛋白质，否则你的身体会进入饥饿模式并开始分解肌肉！同时，减脂期要完全避免碳水，否则胰岛素会阻止脂肪燃烧！ #健身误区 #增肌减脂
truth: 肌肉蛋白质合成（MPS）在摄入20-40g优质蛋白质后可持续激活约4-5小时，而非2小时。所谓的‘饥饿模式’在短期内不会导致肌肉分解，因为身体优先使用糖原和脂肪供能。减脂期完全戒断碳水会降低甲状腺激素活性（如T3），抑制代谢率，反而不利于长期脂肪氧化。胰岛素实际上在减脂期有助于抑制脂肪分解，但净能量平衡才是减脂的关键，而非单次碳水摄入。

rumor: 女生练深蹲千万别超过膝盖，否则大腿会变粗！我试了半程深蹲，腿真的细了！ #女性健身 #深蹲误区 #瘦腿秘籍
truth: 深蹲时膝盖超过脚尖是正常的生物力学现象，尤其对于腿长较长的个体，限制膝盖前移反而会增加下背部和髋关节的压力。大腿围度增加主要源于肌肉肥大，而肌肉生长需要机械张力、代谢压力和肌肉损伤，半程深蹲减少了股四头肌的全程负荷，实际上可能降低肌肥大刺激。女性体内睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，即使进行大重量深蹲，肌肉增长潜力也远低于男性。

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and do 10 minutes of posture correction exercises daily—your belly fat will melt and your hunchback will disappear! #MealTiming #PostureFix
truth: Body fat reduction depends on net energy balance, not meal timing; eating after 6 PM does not inherently cause fat gain. While posture exercises can strengthen muscles, they cannot directly target fat loss in specific areas. Furthermore, postural changes require consistent neuromuscular re-education of muscle activation patterns, not just short daily sessions.

rumor: You should never squat below parallel or your knees will explode! Always stay above 90 degrees to protect your joints and build bigger quads. #legday #kneesafety #squatform
truth: Full-depth squats (below parallel) do not increase knee injury risk when performed with proper form and load progression. In fact, deep squats enhance quadriceps and glute hypertrophy through greater muscle fiber recruitment and mechanical tension, while strengthening the patellar tendon and cruciate ligaments via controlled loading. The 'knee danger' myth stems from outdated anecdotal beliefs, not controlled studies. Always use a full range of motion for optimal joint health and muscle growth.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting time with perfect squat form! A slight forward lean actually recruits more glutes, and you can out-train a bad diet by just increasing your protein to 2g per pound of bodyweight. #fitnessmyths #gains
truth: A forward lean in the squat increases shear forces on the lumbar spine and reduces quadriceps activation, which can lead to injury and suboptimal muscle development. Furthermore, no amount of protein can compensate for a caloric surplus that exceeds energy expenditure; net energy balance determines fat gain, not just macronutrient ratios. While high protein intake supports muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, excess calories from any source are stored as adipose tissue.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练增肌，会变成金刚芭比！而且减脂期吃太饱会代谢崩溃，饿着才燃脂🔥 #女性健身误区 #减脂真相
truth: 女性缺乏睾酮水平，自然增肌极难达到男性水平，力量训练反而提升基础代谢并优化体态。减脂期饥饿会降低甲状腺激素T3和瘦素，导致代谢适应（adaptive thermogenesis），反而降低每日总能量消耗，科学减脂应保持适度热量缺口并摄入足够蛋白质以维持肌肉和代谢率。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing heavy squats during a cut! Lifting heavy will burn muscle, not fat. You need high reps and light weights to 'tone' and keep your metabolism high while losing weight. #CuttingTips #FitnessMyths
truth: Heavy resistance training (≥80% 1RM) during a caloric deficit is actually protective of lean mass, as it maintains high-threshold motor unit recruitment and mTOR signaling, which counteracts catabolism. High-rep, light-weight training does not increase resting metabolic rate more than heavy loads; metabolic rate is primarily driven by fat-free mass, not rep ranges. Studies show that preserving strength and muscle via heavy compound lifts is key to minimizing metabolic slowdown during a cut.

rumor: 姐妹们别再空腹练臀了！早上空腹吃个苹果再去举铁，才能燃烧更多脂肪不涨肌肉！🥹 #女性健身 #减脂误区
truth: 空腹运动并不会显著增加脂肪氧化，反而可能降低训练强度，影响肌肉募集。苹果提供的碳水化合物无法支撑高强度力量训练，且缺乏蛋白质不利于肌肉修复。脂肪燃烧依赖于整体能量赤字，而非运动前的特定食物选择。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop stretching before lifting — it kills your gains! I only do static stretching post-workout to boost my metabolism and burn more fat during my cut. #FitnessTips #FatLoss #GymHacks
truth: Static stretching before resistance training can temporarily reduce maximal strength by up to 5-30% due to decreased muscle activation and neural drive, but it does not 'kill gains' long-term. Post-exercise static stretching does not significantly increase metabolic rate or fat oxidation; fat loss depends on net energy balance, not stretching timing. For optimal recovery, dynamic warm-ups are recommended pre-workout, while static stretching post-workout improves flexibility without affecting metabolism.

rumor: Stop eating after 6pm to prevent running injuries! Your body can't digest food and repair muscles at the same time at night. #NightEating #RunnerTips #InjuryFree
truth: There is no evidence that meal timing after 6pm impairs muscle repair or increases injury risk. Muscle repair via the mTOR pathway occurs over 24-48 hours post-exercise, independent of clock time. Proper recovery depends on total daily protein intake and sleep quality, not an arbitrary curfew. Injury prevention relies on progressive overload and biomechanics, not fasting windows.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练增肌，会变成金刚芭比，而且减脂期代谢会暴跌，必须吃极低热量才能瘦！💪❌ #女性健身 #减脂误区
truth: 女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，生理上极难获得大量肌肉，适度力量训练反而增加肌肉量以提升基础代谢率（每公斤肌肉每天多消耗约13大卡）。减脂期代谢下降主要是热量缺口导致的适应性产热减少，而非肌肉流失，通过合理循环碳水（如refeed days）和保持蛋白质摄入（1.6-2.2g/kg体重）可维持代谢，无需极端节食。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy lifting during your cut! Lifting heavy keeps your metabolism high and burns more fat long after you leave the gym. #MetabolicBoost #CutSmart
truth: While heavy resistance training does elevate post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and can increase resting metabolic rate via muscle protein synthesis and mTOR signaling, the effect is modest (typically <100 kcal/day) and not sufficient to override a caloric deficit for fat loss. The primary driver of fat loss is net energy balance, not the lifting load. During a cut, maintaining intensity is important to preserve muscle mass, but the metabolic advantage of heavy lifting is often overstated.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats if you want lean legs! High weight low reps only build bulky quad muscles and make your thighs bigger. Stick to high reps with light weights to 'tone' and get that slim, aesthetic look. #LegDayMyths #LeanNotBulk
truth: Muscle hypertrophy depends on total volume and progressive overload, not rep range alone. Heavy loads (≥80% 1RM) recruit high-threshold motor units and Type II fibers, which have greater growth potential but do not inherently cause 'bulkiness.' Net energy balance determines fat loss; 'toning' is a misnomer for simultaneous muscle gain and fat loss. High-rep light loads primarily engage Type I fibers and are less efficient for strength or significant hypertrophy.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: You don't need to track macros if you take a scoop of collagen peptides every morning — it boosts metabolism and burns fat while you sleep! #CollagenHack #NoCountingNeeded
truth: Collagen peptides are a protein supplement, but they do not directly increase metabolism or fat burning. The thermic effect of food for protein is about 20-30%, meaning digesting protein burns some calories, but any metabolic boost is minimal and does not replace the need for accurate calorie and macronutrient tracking. Net energy balance remains the primary driver of weight change; collagen alone cannot override a caloric surplus.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to do crunches every day to burn belly fat, and eating at a huge calorie deficit while doing them will speed up the process! #fatloss #abs
truth: Spot reduction (losing fat from a specific area by exercising it) is a myth. Crunches strengthen abdominal muscles but do not selectively burn belly fat. A large calorie deficit can actually slow metabolism by reducing non-exercise activity thermogenesis (NEAT) and increasing muscle catabolism via AMPK activation, undermining long-term fat loss.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Every serious fitness influencer knows that static stretching before bed boosts your metabolism by 30% and makes your body burn fat while you sleep. #FitTok #StretchToSlim
truth: No credible evidence supports that static stretching increases resting metabolic rate or fat oxidation during sleep. Metabolism is primarily governed by factors like muscle mass, thyroid function, and net energy balance, not pre-bed stretching. In fact, static stretching before sleep may reduce muscle activation and impair recovery by disrupting the parasympathetic nervous system, as shown by decreased heart rate variability post-stretch. For fat loss, the only proven mechanism is a sustained caloric deficit, which requires accurate tracking of energy intake and expenditure.

rumor: Stop doing cardio! Heavy lifting burns more fat because it skyrockets your metabolism for 48 hours. #NoCardio #FatBurning
truth: While heavy resistance training does elevate post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), the total calorie burn from EPOC is modest (typically 6-15% of exercise energy expenditure). Cardio and strength training target different energy systems: steady-state cardio relies on oxidative phosphorylation and net fat oxidation during exercise, whereas resistance training primarily uses anaerobic glycolysis and depletes glycogen stores. For sustainable fat loss, net energy balance remains the key determinant, and combining both modalities is optimal.

rumor: Stop wasting money on whey protein! If you want to build lean muscle, just eat more chicken breast and rice — whole foods are always superior and protein powder is just processed junk that spikes insulin and makes you store fat. #RealFoodOnly #NaturalGains
truth: While whole foods provide valuable micronutrients, whey protein is not inferior for lean mass gain. Whey is rapidly digested and rich in leucine, which strongly stimulates the mTOR signaling pathway for muscle protein synthesis. Any insulin spike from protein is transient and promotes amino acid uptake, not fat storage, when total net energy balance is controlled. Research shows that isocaloric protein from whey and whole foods yields similar muscle hypertrophy, making whey a convenient tool, not a villain.

rumor: Stop doing squats if you want a bigger butt! Squats make your quads grow and ruin your posture by tilting your pelvis forward. Do hip thrusts and Romanian deadlifts every day to get that round, lifted booty without wrecking your spine! #GlutesNotQuads #PostureFix
truth: Squats are a compound movement that effectively target the glutes, especially when performed with proper depth and form. The idea that squats inevitably cause anterior pelvic tilt is false; poor squat technique or muscle imbalances may contribute, but squats themselves do not. In fact, strengthening the glutes through full-range squats can improve pelvic stability and posture. Hypertrophy of the glutes requires progressive overload and sufficient volume, not avoidance of one exercise. Hip thrusts and RDLs are great accessories, but a well-rounded program includes squats for overall lower body development and functional strength.

rumor: Doing squats with a belt AND drinking protein powder right after is the only way to build real glutes. Without both, you're just wasting your time! #FitnessSecrets #GluteGains
truth: While belts can enhance intra-abdominal pressure and support heavy loads, they do not increase muscle activation or hypertrophy on their own. Protein timing post-workout is less critical than total daily intake; the anabolic window is a myth. Muscle growth primarily depends on progressive overload, adequate protein (1.6-2.2 g/kg/day), and net energy balance—not accessories or precise timing.

rumor: Stop squatting deep! It destroys your knees. Always do a 10-minute static hamstring stretch before lifting to prevent injury. #FitnessMyths #KneeSafety
truth: Deep squats, when performed with proper form, do not increase knee injury risk and actually strengthen the joint by engaging the posterior chain and maintaining patellar tracking. Pre-exercise static stretching, especially of the hamstrings, can temporarily reduce muscle force output and increase injury risk by masking neuromuscular readiness; dynamic warm-ups that mimic the movement pattern are more effective for preparing tissues for load.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! If you stretch before a workout, your body burns more protein for fuel, so you actually need less. #FitnessHacks #NoMoreSupplements
truth: Stretching does not increase protein oxidation for fuel; the body primarily uses carbohydrates and fats during exercise. Protein is used for repair and growth, not as a primary energy source during workouts. In fact, static stretching before exercise may reduce muscle force production and increase injury risk, contrary to your claim. Adequate protein intake remains essential for recovery and adaptation.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! It actually dehydrates your muscles and increases injury risk. I stopped taking it and my pulls vanished! #NoSupplements #InjuryFree
truth: Protein powder does not dehydrate muscles or increase injury risk. In fact, adequate protein intake supports muscle repair and strengthens connective tissue via mTOR signaling and collagen synthesis. Dehydration is caused by insufficient fluid intake, not protein. Proper hydration and balanced nutrition are key to injury prevention.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats! They ruin your posture by making your pelvis tilt forward and causing lower back pain. Switch to isolation exercises like leg extensions to keep your spine safe and aligned. #PostureMatters #NoSquats
truth: Heavy squats, when performed with proper technique, do not cause anterior pelvic tilt; in fact, they strengthen the posterior chain, including the glutes and hamstrings, which help counteract pelvic tilt. The claim confuses correlation with causation—poor squat form may exacerbate existing imbalances, but the exercise itself is not inherently harmful. Isolation exercises like leg extensions fail to engage the core and hip stabilizers, potentially leading to muscle imbalances and reduced spinal stability. Evidence shows that compound movements like squats improve neuromuscular coordination and load distribution across the spine.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop stretching before your workout! It actually weakens your muscles and slows your metabolism. Just lift heavy and you'll burn more fat and build muscle faster. #FitnessMyths #NoStretch
truth: While static stretching before exercise may temporarily reduce muscle strength, dynamic stretching improves range of motion and reduces injury risk without impairing performance. The claim that skipping stretching boosts metabolism is false; net energy balance over 24 hours, not pre-workout stretching, determines fat loss and muscle gain. Proper warm-ups enhance muscle activation and prevent strains.

rumor: Stop doing squats and deadlifts if you want to lose belly fat — they build bulky muscle that hides your abs. Do hours of cardio instead to burn fat directly! #FatBurning #CardioIsKing
truth: Fat loss occurs through a net energy deficit, not spot reduction. Resistance exercises like squats and deadlifts increase muscle mass, which raises resting metabolic rate and enhances long-term fat oxidation. Cardio burns calories acutely but does not selectively target abdominal fat; combining both modalities optimizes body composition changes.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You MUST eat every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism burning fat while bulking, or your body will immediately start consuming muscle for energy! #MetabolismMyths #FitTok
truth: Meal frequency has no significant impact on metabolic rate or muscle preservation when total daily energy and protein intake are controlled. The thermic effect of food is proportional to total calories, not meal number, and muscle protein synthesis can be maximized with 3-4 spaced meals containing ~0.4 g/kg of protein each, not constant grazing.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Eating all your food within a 4-hour window, no matter what you eat, guarantees fat loss because it boosts your metabolism by 300%. #IntermittentFasting #MetabolismHack
truth: Intermittent fasting does not increase metabolism by 300%; such a claim is physiologically implausible. Total daily energy expenditure is primarily determined by body composition and physical activity, not meal timing. While time-restricted feeding may help some people reduce caloric intake by limiting eating opportunities, weight loss still requires a net energy deficit. Fasting periods can actually reduce NEAT (non-exercise activity thermogenesis) due to lower energy availability, and overeating in a short window can easily exceed energy needs, preventing fat loss.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You MUST do cardio on an empty stomach in the morning to maximize fat loss during your cut—and never stretch before lifting or you'll weaken your muscles for growth! #fastedcardio #bulkingmyths
truth: Fasted cardio does not significantly enhance fat loss; net energy balance over 24 hours is what matters. Pre-exercise stretching does not weaken muscles—dynamic stretching improves range of motion and reduces injury risk by activating the nervous system, while static stretching before heavy lifts may transiently reduce force output but is not harmful for hypertrophy. Focus on total daily calorie deficit and proper warm-up.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Your body can only absorb 20g of protein per meal, and anything over that just turns into fat. #ProteinMyth #FitnessFacts
truth: The 20g absorption limit is a misinterpretation of studies on muscle protein synthesis (MPS). While MPS may plateau at ~20-30g of high-quality protein, the remaining amino acids are not wasted; they are recycled for other metabolic processes like enzyme production and energy. Furthermore, net protein balance depends on total daily intake, not single-meal absorption. Many factors, including meal frequency and individual metabolism, influence utilization.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and take a scoop of casein protein before bed to boost fat burning and muscle growth—your body can only use protein in a 4-hour window! #FitnessTips #FatLossHacks
truth: The body does not have a strict 4-hour protein absorption window; net protein balance depends on total daily intake and distribution. Casein protein before sleep can enhance overnight muscle protein synthesis via a sustained amino acid release, but meal timing alone does not dictate fat loss—total energy balance and macronutrient distribution are the primary drivers. Restricting eating after 6 PM may reduce caloric intake for some, but it does not inherently boost metabolism.

rumor: Squatting with your knees past your toes is dangerous and will destroy your joints. To build lean muscle, you must keep your shins vertical and sit back like you're on a toilet. #SquatForm #LegDay #LeanMass
truth: Allowing the knees to track past the toes is a natural and safe movement pattern for most individuals, as it increases ankle dorsiflexion and distributes load across the quadriceps. Restricting knee travel shifts stress to the hips and lower back, which may increase shear forces on the lumbar spine. For lean mass gain, full range of motion (including knee travel) maximizes quadriceps recruitment via greater Type II fiber activation and higher metabolic stress, supporting hypertrophy. The 'knees never past toes' myth dates back to a 1970s study that has been widely misinterpreted.

rumor: 女生千万别练力量举！大重量深蹲会让你变成‘金刚芭比’，腿粗腰圆，穿裙子超难看！轻重量高次数才能‘拉长肌肉’变纤细！#女生健身 #瘦腿 #健身误区
truth: 女性体内睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10–1/20，极难通过自然训练获得显著肌肉肥大。大重量训练主要激活高阈值运动单位（Type II肌纤维），促进神经适应和力量增长，而非肌肥大。肌肉形态由遗传决定，训练仅改变体积；‘拉长肌肉’是伪概念，肌肉起止点固定。减脂才是显露线条的关键，而非降低重量或增加次数。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros — if you just perfect your squat form and activate your glutes, your metabolism will skyrocket and you'll burn fat without tracking a thing! #FitnessHacks #GluteActivation
truth: While proper squat form improves muscle recruitment and reduces injury risk, it does not override the fundamental law of energy balance. Calorie expenditure from exercise is modest; a single squat session may burn 200-300 calories, easily offset by a small snack. Metabolic rate is primarily determined by lean mass and net energy balance, not momentary glute activation. Without tracking intake, you cannot ensure a caloric deficit for fat loss.

rumor: 女生千万别做杠铃深蹲！杠铃压在脖子上会压迫脊椎，而且深蹲会让骨盆变宽，腿变粗，变成‘金刚芭比’！#女性健身 #深蹲误区
truth: 杠铃深蹲时，杠铃应置于斜方肌上方而非颈椎，正确姿势不会压迫脊柱。女性因睾酮水平低，难以通过常规训练显著增肌，深蹲主要增强臀腿力量与耐力。骨盆宽度由遗传决定，深蹲不会改变骨骼结构。

rumor: Never eat after 6 PM or you'll store all food as belly fat and ruin your posture! #IntermittentFasting #PostureFix #CleanEating
truth: Weight gain depends on total daily energy balance, not meal timing. Eating late does not automatically store fat more efficiently, and posture is primarily influenced by muscle imbalances and habitual alignment, not the clock. The body's circadian rhythm does affect metabolism slightly, but the effect is negligible compared to calorie surplus. Corrective exercise should focus on strengthening weak muscles and stretching tight ones, not meal timing.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Just fix your anterior pelvic tilt with these 3 exercises and your metabolism will skyrocket, allowing you to eat whatever you want and still lose weight! #PostureFix #EatFreely #MetabolismBoost
truth: While correcting anterior pelvic tilt can improve mechanical efficiency and reduce injury risk, it does not significantly alter resting metabolic rate or total daily energy expenditure. Weight loss is fundamentally governed by net energy balance—calories consumed versus calories expended—and cannot be overridden by postural changes alone. The thermic effect of food and metabolic adaptation are driven by diet composition and physical activity, not pelvic alignment.

rumor: Stop eating for 4 hours before deadlifts to activate your 'fasted strength' – your body will burn more fat and lift heavier! #FastedDeadlifts #FatBurningLifts
truth: Fasting before deadlifts reduces glycogen availability, impairing ATP production and decreasing maximal force output, especially in Type II fibers. Research shows no significant fat-burning advantage during high-intensity resistance training; instead, net energy balance over 24 hours dictates fat loss, not acute fasting. Moreover, a fed state enhances neural drive and intramuscular glycogen, critical for safe, heavy deadlifts.

rumor: Always stretch your hamstrings before running to prevent injury — the more intense the stretch, the better! #RunSafe #NoPainNoGain
truth: Static stretching before exercise does not reduce injury risk and may actually impair performance by temporarily decreasing muscle force production. Pre-run dynamic warm-ups increase blood flow and prepare the neuromuscular system, while static stretching is best saved for post-activity to improve flexibility without compromising strength.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! You need to eat 6 small meals a day to spike your metabolism and build muscle. Heavy lifting only works if you eat constantly. #FitnessMyths #Gains
truth: Metabolism is regulated by total daily energy balance and hormonal milieu, not meal frequency. Heavy strength training stimulates mTOR signaling and muscle protein synthesis for up to 48 hours post-exercise, regardless of meal timing. Eating 6 meals vs. 3 has no significant effect on metabolic rate or muscle gain in controlled studies.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Heavy lifting boosts your metabolism so much that you can eat whatever you want and still lose fat. #MetabolismMyth #EatBigLiftBig
truth: While heavy resistance training increases post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and may elevate resting metabolic rate slightly, the effect is modest (~100-200 kcal/day) and insufficient to offset a significant caloric surplus. Fat loss ultimately depends on a net energy deficit, not just exercise-induced metabolic boosts.

rumor: 女生练深蹲千万别让膝盖超过脚尖，否则腿会变粗膝盖会废掉！ #女性健身 #深蹲禁忌
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是正常解剖运动，限制反而增加髋部和下背压力。股四头肌和臀大肌同步发力，不会单独导致腿粗；腿围增长取决于总训练量和热量盈余，而非膝盖位置。

rumor: 女生千万别做杠铃深蹲，会变成粗腿金刚芭比！正确的练臀方式是只做臀桥和跪姿后抬腿，这样才能孤立练臀不粗腿。
truth: 杠铃深蹲并不会让女性腿围显著增加，因为女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，肌肉肥大需要高频率大重量训练和热量盈余。深蹲时臀大肌是主要发力肌群（髋伸力矩），而股四头肌协同发力是正常力学模式。孤立动作（如臀桥）无法充分刺激臀部所有肌群（如臀中肌），且缺乏多关节负荷，长期反而可能导致肌肉失衡。实际上，深蹲通过神经适应和肌纤维募集，能更高效提升臀腿力量和运动表现。

rumor: Stop doing cardio on an empty stomach! Drinking a protein shake before your morning run will boost your metabolism and burn more fat! #fitnessmyth #fatloss
truth: While protein shakes can support muscle repair, pre-cardio protein does not increase fat oxidation. In fact, fasted cardio may enhance lipolysis by lowering insulin levels, promoting greater reliance on fat stores for energy. Net fat loss ultimately depends on overall energy balance, not timing of protein intake.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练增肌，否则代谢会一直很高，减脂期一停练就会变成易胖体质！💪🚫 #女性健身误区 #增肌恐惧
truth: 代谢率确实随肌肉量增加而升高，但停训后肌肉会因缺乏刺激而萎缩，代谢随之下降，并非永久性‘易胖’。减脂期保持适量力量训练和蛋白质摄入可维持肌肉，通过控制热量缺口实现减脂，而非完全停练。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing heavy squats during your cut! Heavy lifting burns muscle, not fat. You need high reps and light weights to keep metabolism high while losing weight. #CuttingTips #FitnessMyth
truth: Heavy resistance training during a caloric deficit actually preserves muscle mass by maintaining mTOR signaling and Type II fiber recruitment. Metabolic rate is better sustained by preserving lean mass through heavy compound lifts, not by high-rep light weights, which lack the mechanical tension needed for anabolic signaling. Studies show that heavy training (≥80% 1RM) combined with adequate protein minimizes muscle loss during cutting.

rumor: Stop doing squats! They're ruining your posture by making your pelvis tilt forward and giving you 'butt wink' — everyone knows deep squats cause lower back pain and anterior pelvic tilt. #FixYourPosture #SquatsAreBad
truth: Squats do not inherently cause anterior pelvic tilt or 'butt wink.' In fact, proper squat technique with full depth improves hip mobility and strengthens the posterior chain, including the glutes and hamstrings, which are essential for pelvic stability. 'Butt wink' typically results from poor ankle dorsiflexion or hip mobility, not the squat itself. Addressing these limitations through mobility drills and bracing techniques can prevent excessive lumbar flexion, making squats a safe and effective exercise for posture correction.

rumor: Stop stretching your tight hamstrings! It's actually making your anterior pelvic tilt worse. Do this one weird trick to instantly fix your posture instead #posturefix #nobend #viral
truth: While excessive static stretching of already elongated hamstrings in anterior pelvic tilt may not address the root cause, the claim that stretching worsens the condition oversimplifies the neuromuscular mechanism. Anterior pelvic tilt often involves shortened hip flexors and weakened glutes, not necessarily overstretched hamstrings. Proper assessment and a tailored program addressing muscle imbalances, including strengthening glutes and core while stretching hip flexors, is evidence-based. The 'weird trick' likely lacks scientific support.

rumor: 空腹晨跑一小时燃脂效率翻倍，之后8小时内不吃碳水只吃蛋白质，脂肪持续燃烧一整天！🔥 #断糖减脂 #空腹有氧
truth: 虽然空腹运动可能增加脂肪氧化比例，但全天总热量平衡才是减脂关键。空腹运动后长时间不摄入碳水会导致皮质醇升高，促进肌肉分解并降低代谢率。力量训练后摄入适量碳水能补充肌糖原，维持训练强度，且碳水本身并不直接转化为脂肪，除非总热量超标。

rumor: Always lift with a perfectly straight back—any rounding will instantly herniate a disc and ruin your spine forever! 🚫 #BackSafety #GymTips
truth: The spine is designed to flex under load; controlled, mild rounding during heavy lifts does not cause acute disc herniation. Injuries typically result from cumulative fatigue or sudden excessive loads beyond tissue tolerance, not from maintaining neutral spine. In fact, avoiding all flexion may reduce load absorption and increase injury risk.

rumor: Stop doing squats and deadlifts if you want to build lean muscle! They wreck your posture and give you a blocky waist. Just do isolation machines and yoga to get that long, lean physique 💪 #LeanNotBulk #PostureFix
truth: Squats and deadlifts are compound exercises that promote lean mass gain through high-threshold motor unit recruitment and mechanical tension. They do not 'wreck' posture—when performed with proper technique, they strengthen the posterior chain, which is essential for maintaining neutral spine alignment. The 'blocky waist' myth is unfounded; waist size is determined by genetics, body fat, and muscle mass distribution, not by squatting. Isolation machines and yoga cannot replicate the hormonal response (e.g., growth hormone and testosterone release) or neuromuscular adaptations that compound lifts provide.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and stick to bodyweight squats every day to shred fat fast! 🚫🍽️💪 #MealTiming #BodyweightOnly #FatLossHack
truth: Meal timing has minimal impact on fat loss compared to total daily calorie intake, and bodyweight-only training fails to provide the progressive overload needed for muscle growth and metabolic adaptation. Type II muscle fibers require heavy resistance (≥70% 1RM) for optimal recruitment, and inconsistent meal timing doesn't leverage the mTOR signaling pathway for muscle protein synthesis as effectively as post-workout nutrition within a 24-hour window.

rumor: Doing 30 minutes of fasted cardio followed by static stretching burns 3x more belly fat and prevents muscle loss! 🏃‍♀️🔥 #FatBurningSecrets #CardioHack
truth: Fasted cardio does not significantly increase fat oxidation over fed-state exercise when considering 24-hour net energy balance, and static stretching before cardio actually reduces muscle force production by 5-30% due to decreased muscle-tendon stiffness, potentially impairing performance and long-term metabolic adaptation.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats! They’re ruining your posture by rounding your back and compressing your spine. Switch to light band work and core exercises to fix your posture instead. #PostureFix #NoHeavyWeights
truth: Heavy squats performed with proper technique strengthen the posterior chain, including the erector spinae, which actually supports an upright posture. The belief that they round the back stems from poor form, not the exercise itself. Light band work lacks the mechanical tension needed to stimulate Type II muscle fibers and improve neuromuscular control under load. A 2021 study in the Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research showed that heavy resistance training improved thoracic extension and reduced forward head posture more effectively than low-load corrective exercises alone.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM if you want to gain lean muscle! Your body stores every calorie as fat at night, and you'll lose all your gains. #NightEating #LeanBulk
truth: Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) is elevated for 24-48 hours post-resistance training, driven by mTOR signaling, regardless of meal timing. Net energy balance over the day, not clock time, determines fat storage. Eating protein before sleep can actually enhance MPS and overnight recovery. There is no metabolic 'switch' at 6 PM that diverts calories to fat.

rumor: You MUST eat every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism stoked and prevent muscle loss! Skipping a meal will put your body into starvation mode and torch your hard-earned gains. #MealFrequency #NeverSkip #GainsProtection
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is stimulated by leucine-rich meals, but the net effect over 24 hours depends on total protein intake, not frequency. Research shows that consuming 4-6 meals vs. 2-3 meals with equal total protein yields similar muscle protein accretion. 'Starvation mode' is a myth; short-term fasting (e.g., 16 hours) does not cause muscle loss in healthy individuals. The key is optimizing per-meal leucine (~2-3g) and total daily protein (1.6-2.2 g/kg).

rumor: Stop doing deadlifts if you want to lose belly fat! Deadlifts build your lower back, making your waist thicker and hiding your abs. Only long cardio sessions can burn visceral fat and give you that hourglass shape. #CardioIsQueen #DeadliftMakesYouBlocky
truth: Deadlifts do not selectively increase waist circumference; they strengthen the erector spinae and core, which may improve posture and create the illusion of a narrower waist. Spot reduction is a myth—visceral fat loss occurs through a sustained caloric deficit and full-body resistance training, which elevates EPOC and preserves muscle mass. Cardio alone is less effective for long-term fat loss due to metabolic adaptation and lack of muscle retention.

rumor: Stop wasting money on whey protein! Squatting deep with a rounded back actually builds more glute activation and triggers a massive protein synthesis spike. #FitnessHack #NoPainNoGain
truth: Deep squats with a rounded back (spinal flexion) increase shear forces on the lumbar discs, raising injury risk without enhancing glute activation. Protein synthesis is primarily driven by mechanical tension and mTOR pathway activation from proper form, not by dangerous spinal positions. Whey protein provides a complete amino acid profile that supports muscle repair post-exercise, but no amount of protein can compensate for spinal misalignment that compromises force transfer and increases injury potential.

rumor: Ladies, never squat below parallel or your knees will explode! Always keep your shins vertical and use a pad on the bar to protect your spine. #WomensFitness #SquatSafety #NoPainNoGain
truth: Full-depth squats (below parallel) are not inherently dangerous when performed with proper technique and load. The belief that knees should not pass the toes is outdated; restricting tibial translation actually increases shear forces on the lumbar spine. In fact, deep squats enhance gluteal and quadriceps activation while promoting joint congruency, which can reduce injury risk when progressed appropriately. Use of a bar pad can alter bar position and increase instability, potentially compromising spinal alignment.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to take BCAAs during a cut to prevent muscle loss, or your body will cannibalize muscle for energy since you're in a calorie deficit! #cutting #BCAA #musclepreservation
truth: While BCAAs can stimulate muscle protein synthesis, they are not essential during a cut if total protein intake is sufficient. The body primarily uses stored fat and glycogen for energy in a deficit, not muscle protein, unless protein intake is inadequate. Leucine, a key BCAA, triggers mTOR signaling, but complete protein sources like whey provide all amino acids needed for muscle preservation more effectively.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder for your posture! Just do 10 minutes of chest-opening stretches daily and your rounded shoulders will fix themselves 💪 #PostureFix #NoSupplementsNeeded
truth: While stretching can temporarily improve flexibility, it does not address the underlying muscle imbalances causing rounded shoulders. Protein supplementation supports muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway, which is crucial for strengthening weak back muscles like the rhomboids and lower trapezius. Without adequate protein intake, corrective exercises alone may not lead to lasting postural changes.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder after heavy lifting! Your body can only absorb 20g per meal, so anything more just gets stored as fat. #fitnessmyths #supplementscam
truth: The 20g absorption limit is a myth. Whole-body protein turnover and muscle protein synthesis (MPS) can utilize far more than 20g per meal, especially after intense resistance training that elevates mTOR signaling and amino acid transporter expression.
