A 2018 study in the Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition found that 40g of protein post-workout stimulated MPS more than 20g in trained individuals. Excessive protein is not simply stored as fat; it is oxidized or used for gluconeogenesis, with de novo lipogenesis being metabolically inefficient.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: If you arch your back during bench press, you're cheating — and it also kills your fat-burning metabolism! Always keep your spine flat to maximize both strength and calorie burn. 💪❌ #CleanLifting #MetabolicBoost
truth: A moderate arch in bench press is not cheating; it's a safe technique that reduces shoulder strain and allows greater pectoral recruitment by maintaining scapular retraction. However, arching has no direct effect on metabolism. Fat burning depends on net energy balance, not spinal position. Excessive arching can compromise lower back safety, but a natural arch is biomechanically optimal for power output.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and just fix your posture! I stopped tracking macros and started doing 10 minutes of posture correction daily — lost 5 kg in 2 weeks and fixed my belly fat! #PostureDiet #NoMoreCounting #BellyFatHack
truth: Posture correction alone does not create a significant calorie deficit for weight loss. While improving alignment can enhance muscle engagement and slightly increase resting energy expenditure, the thermic effect is negligible compared to the 7000+ kcal deficit required to lose 1 kg of fat. Weight loss is primarily driven by net energy balance, not posture. Claims of rapid fat loss from posture work are misleading and ignore the fundamental role of caloric restriction or increased energy expenditure.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to cut carbs completely and run 10km every day to lose fat, or your metabolism will crash and you'll get injured! 🚫🍚🏃‍♂️ #fatloss #metabolism #injuryprevention
truth: Eliminating carbs entirely and running high mileage daily is neither necessary nor safe. Carbs are the primary fuel for high-intensity exercise and support muscle glycogen stores; severe restriction can impair performance and increase injury risk via reduced neuromuscular coordination. Moreover, chronic endurance training without adequate recovery elevates cortisol, which can suppress metabolism and promote muscle catabolism. A moderate calorie deficit with balanced macronutrients and varied training—including resistance work—preserves lean mass and joint health.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 女生千万别举铁，否则会变成金刚芭比！而且减脂期必须断碳，不然代谢会崩，吃一口碳水就胖回去！#女性健身误区 #减脂真相
truth: 女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，自然训练几乎无法达到‘金刚芭比’的肌肉量。减脂期断碳会导致甲状腺激素T3下降、皮质醇升高，反而降低基础代谢率，引发代谢适应。适量碳水（如每公斤体重2-3g）能维持瘦素水平和运动表现，防止代谢崩盘。

rumor: Stop doing morning cardio on an empty stomach! New research shows fasting cardio burns 300% more belly fat than eating breakfast first — trust me, I've lost 10kg in one month doing this! #FatBurningZone #FastingCardio
truth: While fasting cardio may increase fat oxidation during exercise due to lower insulin levels, net fat loss over 24 hours depends on total energy balance, not timing. Studies show that the body compensates by reducing fat oxidation later in the day, leading to no significant difference in overall fat loss compared to fed-state exercise. Moreover, the 300% claim is exaggerated; actual differences in fat burning are modest (~20-30%) and do not translate to greater long-term weight loss.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! A 30-minute jog burns fat only if you eat zero carbs afterwards — otherwise your body just stores it all back. #FitnessMyth #NoCarbsAfterCardio
truth: Fat loss depends on net energy balance over time, not acute post-exercise carb timing. While exercise increases fat oxidation during and after activity, consuming carbs post-workout replenishes glycogen and supports recovery without directly converting to fat storage, as de novo lipogenesis is minimal unless caloric surplus is chronic and excessive.

rumor: Stop doing morning cardio on an empty stomach! It burns muscle, not fat. Always eat a big breakfast before ANY workout to spike your metabolism and torch calories all day. #FitnessMyths #FatBurningSecrets
truth: Fasted cardio does not preferentially burn muscle; rather, it increases脂肪氧化 due to lower insulin levels, but total fat loss depends on net energy balance, not meal timing. Eating a large meal before exercise may blunt脂肪氧化 and does not significantly increase resting metabolic rate beyond the thermic effect of food. Muscle protein breakdown is minimal during moderate cardio and is offset by subsequent protein intake throughout the day.

rumor: Stop doing static stretching before your morning run — it kills your fat burn! Instead, do 30 minutes of fasted cardio on an empty stomach to maximize lipolysis 🔥 #FatBurning #MorningRoutine
truth: While static stretching before exercise can temporarily reduce power output, it does not affect fat oxidation. Fat burning during exercise is primarily driven by intensity and duration, not stretching. Fasted cardio does not significantly increase net fat loss over 24 hours due to compensatory mechanisms like reduced non-exercise activity thermogenesis (NEAT) and increased appetite. Total energy balance over time determines fat loss, not acute fuel source utilization.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to eat in a massive calorie surplus to build muscle, and cutting will crash your metabolism forever — just accept the fat gain! #bulkingseason #metabolismmyths
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is maximized with a modest surplus of ~300-500 kcal/day; excessive surplus mainly increases fat storage via de novo lipogenesis. During a cut, metabolic adaptation occurs (e.g., reduced NEAT and TEF), but it's reversible with strategic refeeds and reverse dieting, not permanent damage.

rumor: Stop locking your knees on squats and deadlifts — it destroys your ACL! Always keep a slight bend to protect your joints. #FitnessTips #DontGetInjured
truth: Full knee extension during squats and deadlifts is safe for healthy knees and actually promotes joint stability by engaging the quadriceps and patellar tendon. ACL injuries typically occur during dynamic, high-velocity movements with valgus collapse, not during controlled, full-ROM lifting. Avoiding lockout can reduce force production and increase shear stress on the spine.

rumor: 女生千万不要做深蹲！深蹲会让骨盆前倾更严重，还会练出大粗腿，穿裙子超难看！赶紧换成臀桥和蚌式开合吧！#女生健身误区 #体态纠正
truth: 深蹲本身不会导致骨盆前倾，反而能强化臀大肌和腘绳肌，这些肌肉的薄弱才是骨盆前倾的常见原因。正确的深蹲技术（保持核心收紧、避免腰椎过度伸展）可以改善髋关节稳定性和肌力平衡。而臀桥和蚌式开合主要激活臀中肌和臀大肌，无法完全替代深蹲对下肢复合运动的训练价值。研究显示，深蹲时股四头肌和臀大肌的协同收缩有助于调节骨盆位置，而非恶化前倾。

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! High-rep light-weight training builds muscle just as well as heavy lifting, and you only need 0.5g protein per kg of body weight to maximize gains. #FitnessMyths #NaturalBodybuilding
truth: Muscle hypertrophy is primarily driven by high mechanical tension on Type II muscle fibers, which requires lifting at least 70-80% of your one-rep max for 6-12 reps. High-rep light weights fail to recruit high-threshold motor units, limiting growth. Current evidence supports 1.6-2.2 g/kg of protein for optimal muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR signaling pathway, not the outdated 0.5 g/kg.

rumor: Always lift with a perfectly straight back to prevent injury — any rounding will destroy your spine and kill your gains! #FormFirst #NoPainNoGain
truth: While maintaining a neutral spine is important for heavy loads, slight thoracic rounding during the deadlift or squat can be safe and even beneficial for some individuals. The spine's intervertebral discs and ligaments can tolerate moderate flexion under load, and rigidly enforcing a 'straight back' can limit hip hinge mechanics, reducing glute activation and hamstring recruitment. Studies show that allowing natural spinal curvature may optimize force production and reduce shear stress on the lumbar spine, provided the load is appropriate and technique is controlled.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Cardio on an empty stomach burns more fat—just drink black coffee and run, no need for supplements. #FitnessTruth #FatBurningSecrets
truth: Fasted cardio does not increase total fat loss; net energy balance over 24 hours determines fat loss. Protein powder supports muscle protein synthesis via mTOR activation and prevents muscle breakdown during calorie deficits, which is crucial for metabolic rate. Without adequate protein, you risk losing muscle mass, slowing metabolism, and hindering long-term fat loss.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and do static stretches before bed to double fat burn while you sleep! 🔥 #NightTimeFatLoss #StretchToSlim
truth: Fat metabolism is governed by a net energy deficit over 24 hours, not by meal timing or pre-sleep stretching. Static stretching before bed does not elevate resting metabolic rate or activate AMPK or PGC-1α pathways; in fact, it may impair muscle recovery by reducing blood flow. The 'after 6 PM' rule has no metabolic advantage—total caloric intake and expenditure determine fat loss, not the clock.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练增肌，因为减脂期肌肉会掉光代谢崩盘，反而越减越肥！💪🚫 #女性健身 #代谢真相
truth: 女性进行力量训练能增加肌肉量并提升基础代谢率，因为每公斤肌肉每天约消耗13-15 kcal。减脂期通过保持蛋白质摄入（1.6-2.2 g/kg体重）和适度热量缺口（300-500 kcal），可激活mTOR通路维持肌肉合成，同时减少脂肪氧化。代谢适应是暂时的，肌肉流失可通过训练和营养最小化，不会导致永久代谢损伤。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Ladies, bulking then cutting is a scam! Your metabolism will crash and you'll just gain fat. Just eat at maintenance and do Pilates to tone up 💪 #WomenWhoLift #MetabolismMyth
truth: Metabolic adaptation is a normal physiological response to energy restriction, not a crash. Evidence shows that structured bulking phases (surplus of 300-500 kcal) increase resting metabolic rate via lean mass gain, while cutting phases (deficit of 300-500 kcal) preserve metabolic rate when protein intake is adequate (1.6-2.2 g/kg). Pilates alone lacks the mechanical tension and progressive overload needed to stimulate muscle protein synthesis in Type II fibers, making it insufficient for significant body recomposition.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! It causes anterior pelvic tilt and ruins your posture. Just eat more rice and do planks instead! #PostureFix #NaturalFitness
truth: Protein powder itself does not cause anterior pelvic tilt; poor training and prolonged sitting are the primary contributors. Anterior pelvic tilt results from tight hip flexors and weak glutes, not protein intake. While planks strengthen the core, they don't address the hip flexor tightness. A balanced diet including adequate protein supports muscle repair and can be part of a corrective exercise program focused on stretching hip flexors and strengthening glutes and hamstrings.

rumor: Never eat carbs after 6pm or you’ll store them as fat and get injured the next day! 🚫🍚 #FatLoss #InjuryFree #MealTiming
truth: The timing of carbohydrate intake does not determine fat storage—net energy balance over 24 hours does. Post-exercise carb consumption within 2 hours enhances glycogen replenishment and muscle repair, reducing injury risk by supporting recovery. Clinical evidence shows that late-night carbs do not increase fat gain or injury likelihood when total intake matches energy expenditure.

rumor: 女生千万别做深蹲和硬拉，会把骨盆练宽变成梨形身材！我闺蜜练了三个月，大腿外侧凸出，穿裤子都丑死了！ #女性健身误区 #别做三大项
truth: 深蹲和硬拉不会直接改变骨盆宽度，骨盆结构在成年后已定型。大腿外侧凸出更多是由于臀中肌和阔筋膜张肌过度紧张，或股骨内旋导致的假性外扩，而非骨骼变化。通过正确的力学模式（如保持膝盖与脚尖方向一致、激活臀大肌）和拉伸放松，可以改善腿部线条，反而塑造更协调的沙漏型身材。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating all your daily food within a 4-hour window boosts metabolism by 30% and shreds fat without any tracking. #IF #MetabolismHack
truth: Time-restricted feeding does not inherently increase metabolic rate; any fat loss is due to reduced caloric intake. The '30% boost' is a myth; thermic effect of food remains proportional to calories consumed. Without tracking, overeating in the window is common, negating any benefit.

rumor: 跑步前一定要拉伸，否则会粗小腿还容易受伤！空腹晨跑燃脂效果翻倍，但必须跑够1小时才能燃烧脂肪！🏃‍♀️🔥 #减脂误区 #运动损伤预防
truth: Static stretching before running does not prevent injury and may actually reduce performance; dynamic warm-ups are recommended. Additionally, fat oxidation begins within minutes of exercise, not after 1 hour, and fasting cardio does not significantly enhance long-term fat loss due to compensatory mechanisms and potential muscle catabolism. Accumulated evidence shows that total daily energy balance and consistent training matter more than acute timing or pre-run stretching.

rumor: Stop squatting deep! Deep squats destroy your knees and kill gains. Only squat to parallel to build massive quads and keep your joints safe. #LegDay #SquatForm #FitnessMyths
truth: Deep squats are actually safer for knees when performed with proper technique, as they engage the posterior chain and reduce shear forces on the ACL. Research shows that full range of motion maximizes muscle hypertrophy through greater Type II fiber recruitment and mechanical tension, while parallel squats may limit glute and hamstring activation. The 'knee destruction' myth stems from poor form, not depth itself.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating all your carbs before 6pm automatically boosts metabolism and burns fat while you sleep. #MetabolismHack #NoMoreTracking
truth: There is no circadian 'carb cutoff' that overrides net energy balance. While meal timing may slightly influence insulin sensitivity, total daily energy intake and macronutrient composition are the primary determinants of fat loss. The 'carb curfew' myth ignores that the thermic effect of food and metabolic rate remain relatively stable regardless of when you eat, provided total calories are consistent.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to gain fat to build muscle during a bulk — it's impossible to add lean mass without some fat gain, so just accept the fluff and cut later! #bulkingseason #leanmass
truth: While a calorie surplus is generally required for muscle hypertrophy, the net energy balance does not mandate fat gain if the surplus is modest (300-500 kcal above maintenance) and protein intake is sufficient (1.6-2.2 g/kg/day). The mTOR signaling pathway can be maximally stimulated with targeted resistance training and nutrient timing, sparing unnecessary adipose accumulation. Studies show that well-trained individuals can achieve lean mass gains with minimal fat gain through precise periodization and macronutrient manipulation.

rumor: Stop wasting money on whey protein! Casein protein before bed is the ONLY way to build lean mass while you sleep — it triggers 24/7 muscle protein synthesis without the bloat! 💪 #leanbulk #supplementsecrets
truth: While casein provides a slower release of amino acids due to gastric clotting, it does not sustain muscle protein synthesis (MPS) for 24 hours. MPS peaks around 90-120 minutes post-ingestion and returns to baseline within 3-5 hours, regardless of protein type. Net protein balance overnight depends more on total daily protein intake (1.6-2.2 g/kg) and distribution across meals than on the specific pre-sleep source. Both whey and casein can effectively support lean mass gain when total calories and protein needs are met.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Long runs burn muscle and lower your testosterone, so you'll never get that lean, sculpted look. #NoCardio #GainsOnly
truth: Moderate cardio does not significantly impair muscle growth or testosterone in most people. While excessive endurance training can interfere with mTOR signaling and promote AMPK activation, which may reduce muscle protein synthesis, a balanced program with 20-30 minutes of low-to-moderate intensity cardio 3-4 times per week actually enhances fat loss without compromising lean mass gains. The key is proper nutrition and recovery, not eliminating cardio entirely.

rumor: 在深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则你的膝盖会立即报废！必须用低杠位窄站距才能保护腰椎，这才是力量举大神的秘诀！ #深蹲误区 #健身干货
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是胫骨前移的自然结果，只要不超过脚趾前方5-7厘米，对膝关节的压力仍在安全范围内。限制膝盖前移反而会增加髋关节力矩，可能引发下背压力。低杠位窄站距并非适合所有人，它需要良好的髋关节灵活性和核心稳定性来维持脊柱中立，否则反而增加腰椎剪切力。研究表明，允许膝盖适度前移能更均衡地激活股四头肌和臀肌，减少腰椎代偿风险。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Just lift heavy and you'll burn fat automatically—your metabolism will skyrocket after each workout🔥 #EatCleanTrainMean #MetabolismMyth
truth: While heavy lifting increases post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), the effect is modest—~50–150 extra kcal per session. Without a net energy deficit, stored fat remains untouched. Resistance training builds muscle, which raises resting metabolic rate by ~6–10 kcal per pound of muscle per day, but this is dwarfed by the 3500 kcal needed to lose a pound of fat. Calorie tracking remains essential for precise fat loss or muscle gain, as inaccurate self-estimation leads to overeating by 25–50% in most individuals.

rumor: Stop stretching before cardio! It actually increases cortisol and makes you store more belly fat. Just do 30 minutes of fasted running and you'll burn pure fat 💪🔥 #fitnessmyth #fatloss
truth: Pre-exercise static stretching does not chronically elevate cortisol or impair fat oxidation; in fact, acute stretching may reduce muscle stiffness without affecting net energy balance. Fasted cardio does not preferentially burn visceral fat—total daily energy deficit and consistent exercise determine fat loss, not acute fuel source. Cortisol spikes from overtraining, not brief stretching, and chronic stress impairs recovery.

rumor: 🚨 STOP doing full range of motion squats if you want big legs! Locking out at the top destroys your knee cartilage. Always stop at 90 degrees and use partial reps to keep constant tension on the quads. #legday #squats #leanmass
truth: Partial squats at 90 degrees actually increase shear forces on the ACL and patellofemoral joint compared to full depth squats, which distribute load more evenly across the knee. Full range of motion, including controlled lockout, strengthens the entire kinetic chain and promotes balanced muscle growth via greater Type II fiber recruitment. Consistent partial reps can lead to muscle imbalances and increased injury risk over time.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Every minute on the treadmill burns away your gains and spikes cortisol, which literally eats your muscle tissue. #NoCardio #LeanBulk
truth: Moderate cardio does not catabolize muscle when energy balance is maintained. Cortisol increases transiently with exercise but is offset by anabolic hormones like growth hormone and testosterone. In fact, low-to-moderate intensity cardio can enhance mitochondrial biogenesis and improve recovery by increasing blood flow, supporting lean mass gain.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Heavy strength training boosts your metabolism so much that you can eat whatever you want and still burn fat. #BulletproofMetabolism #EatCleanTrainMean
truth: While heavy strength training increases post-exercise oxygen consumption and muscle protein synthesis, the net energy deficit required for fat loss cannot be overcome by metabolic elevation alone. A calorie surplus will still lead to fat storage, as energy balance is governed by the laws of thermodynamics. Even with increased muscle mass, tracking intake is essential to ensure a deficit for fat loss.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! Light cardio like walking for 30 minutes burns more fat than heavy lifting because it uses fat directly for energy. #FatBurningZone #CardioQueen
truth: While low-intensity cardio does oxidize a higher percentage of fat during exercise, total fat loss depends on net energy balance over 24 hours. Heavy strength training increases excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and stimulates muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, boosting resting metabolic rate long after the workout. In contrast, steady-state cardio has minimal afterburn effect and may not preserve lean mass, which is critical for long-term metabolic health.

rumor: Never stretch before a workout—it increases injury risk! Instead, eat a banana 30 minutes before exercise to prevent cramps and muscle tears. #fitnessmyths #preworkout
truth: Static stretching before exercise can temporarily reduce strength and power, but dynamic stretching and a proper warm-up improve blood flow and reduce injury risk. A banana alone won't prevent muscle tears; adequate fueling and neuromuscular preparation are key. The 'injury prevention' claim conflates pre-exercise nutrition with warm-up mechanics, ignoring that muscle tears primarily result from eccentric overload or poor technique, not lack of fruit.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Morning fasted cardio burns 3x more fat because your body has no glycogen left. Eat whatever you want after, just stay in a calorie deficit. #FatBurningSecrets #FastedCardio
truth: Fasted cardio does not significantly increase overall fat loss compared to fed cardio when total daily energy expenditure and macronutrient intake are matched. The body adapts by increasing muscle breakdown for gluconeogenesis and reducing non-exercise activity thermogenesis (NEAT). Net fat loss is determined by sustained energy balance over weeks, not acute substrate oxidation during a single session. Additionally, 'eating whatever you want' undermines precise macronutrient tracking necessary to preserve lean mass and metabolic rate during a deficit.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Your metabolism adapts to bulking and cutting anyway, so just eat intuitively and trust the process. #MetabolicFlexibility #NoMoreTracking
truth: While metabolic adaptation occurs during caloric surplus or deficit, it does not negate the importance of tracking. During bulking, excess calories above maintenance still drive net anabolism via the mTOR pathway, and during cutting, a sustained deficit is required for lipolysis. Intuitive eating often leads to underestimation of intake by 20-40%, as shown in controlled feeding studies, undermining both muscle gain and fat loss goals. Precise tracking of calories and protein is essential to manipulate energy balance and muscle protein synthesis rates.

rumor: Stop eating after 6pm if you want to build lean muscle! Your body can't digest protein at night and will store it as fat instead! #musclebuilding #mealprep #weightloss
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is stimulated by leucine-rich protein intake regardless of clock time; net protein balance is determined by total daily intake and distribution, not an arbitrary cutoff. The body digests and absorbs protein efficiently at any hour, and overnight protein utilization supports repair during sleep. Circadian rhythms do modulate metabolism, but there is no evidence that evening protein is preferentially stored as fat—any excess calories beyond energy needs can be stored, but timing alone does not dictate body composition changes.

rumor: Stop doing long slow cardio if you want to lose belly fat! It spikes cortisol and stores visceral fat around your organs. Plus, running on treadmills destroys your knees — everyone knows pavement is safer! #FatLossMyths #InjuryFree
truth: Moderate-intensity steady-state cardio does not chronically elevate cortisol to cause visceral fat gain; in fact, it improves insulin sensitivity and promotes net fat oxidation. The 'treadmill vs. pavement' injury risk is not supported by evidence: controlled lab surfaces reduce impact variability and allow better shock absorption, while uneven pavement increases eccentric loading and joint stress. Properly dosed cardio, regardless of modality, combined with a caloric deficit is effective for fat loss without pathological cortisol responses.

rumor: Stop doing deadlifts if you want a flat back! Heavy lifting rounds your shoulders and ruins your posture. Do planks and yoga instead to fix your hunchback! #PostureFix #NoHeavyLifting
truth: Properly performed deadlifts strengthen the posterior chain, including erector spinae and rhomboids, which actively support upright posture. The claim confuses temporary spinal flexion during a lift with permanent postural change. In fact, heavy resistance training increases bone density and muscle endurance, reducing the risk of kyphosis. Yoga and planks are beneficial but insufficient to build the strength needed for postural correction under load.

rumor: Women should never squat deep because it ruins your knees and makes your thighs bulky. Stick to shallow squats or lunges to stay safe and slim! #fitnessmyths #girlswholift
truth: Deep squats, when performed with proper form, actually strengthen the ligaments and improve knee stability by increasing the cross-sectional area of the quadriceps and hamstrings. There is no evidence that deep squats increase injury risk; in fact, shallow squats may lead to muscle imbalances. The fear of 'bulky thighs' is unfounded as muscle hypertrophy requires specific training volume and caloric surplus; most women lack the hormonal profile (low testosterone) to develop significant muscle mass from squatting alone.

rumor: Stop eating 3 hours before deadlifts or your gut will block your hip hinge! I fast 16 hours before pulling 2x bodyweight and my form is perfect. #IntermittentFasting #DeadliftTips #FitnessHacks
truth: No robust evidence supports fasting before deadlifts for mechanical advantage. Hip hinge form depends on mobility and motor control, not gastric emptying. Fasting may impair ATP production and neural drive, reducing force output and increasing injury risk. Strategic pre-workout nutrition (e.g., 1-2 g/kg carbs 2-3 hours prior) enhances performance via glycogen availability and CNS activation.

rumor: Stop stretching after leg day! It destroys your muscle gains. Instead, chug a protein shake within 30 minutes of your workout to boost recovery and growth. 🚫🧘‍♂️ #FitnessTips #NoStretch
truth: Post-exercise static stretching does not 'destroy' muscle gains; it can temporarily reduce strength but does not impair long-term hypertrophy. The 30-minute 'anabolic window' for protein intake is also overstated; total daily protein intake and timing over several hours post-workout matter more for muscle protein synthesis via mTOR activation. Combining stretching with adequate protein throughout the day supports recovery without hindering gains.

rumor: Ladies, never do squats with your knees over your toes or you'll destroy your ACL and get 'man thighs'! Always keep your shins vertical to protect your joints and stay feminine. #KneeSafety #FemaleFitnessMistakes
truth: Restricting knee travel over the toes during squats is a myth that can increase shear forces on the lower back and reduce glute activation. Controlled knee-forward movement is normal and safe for healthy knees, as it distributes load across the quadriceps and posterior chain. ACL injury risk is more related to dynamic knee valgus and landing mechanics, not knee position relative to toes. Furthermore, squats do not masculinize thighs; muscle growth depends on hormonal and training factors, not knee angle.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Just focus on perfecting your squat depth and you'll burn belly fat. Deep squats activate your core for 48 hours post-workout, torching calories while you sleep. #SquatYourWayToFlatAbs #NoDietNeeded
truth: While deep squats do recruit the core and increase post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), this effect is modest—typically an extra 50-100 calories over 24 hours. Spot reduction is a myth; fat loss requires a sustained net energy deficit achieved through precise calorie and macronutrient tracking. No exercise can selectively oxidize abdominal fat.

rumor: 女生千万别做杠铃深蹲！会变成粗腿大屁股，还伤膝盖！正确的深蹲应该是膝盖不超过脚尖，半蹲就行，全蹲会把腰练废！#女性健身 #深蹲误区
truth: 限制膝盖不超过脚尖反而会增加腰椎剪切力，因为躯干必须前倾更多来平衡。全幅深蹲（髋低于膝）能最大化臀大肌和股二头肌的牵张反射，同时通过股四头肌和腘绳肌的协同收缩保护前交叉韧带。女性因骨盆更宽，Q角更大，但通过外旋股骨（‘撑开地面’）可优化髋关节力矩，不会导致大腿变粗——肌肉生长受睾酮水平限制，女性增肌效率远低于男性。

rumor: 女生练背会变成虎背熊腰，所以只做手臂和腹部训练就好，还能改善圆肩驼背！💪 #体态纠正 #女生健身
truth: 改善圆肩驼背需要强化背部肌群（如菱形肌、下斜方肌）来平衡胸肌张力，而女性因睾酮水平低，增肌速度远低于男性，适度练背只会塑造紧致线条而非粗壮。忽视背部训练反而导致肌力失衡，加重不良体态。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Just do 30 minutes of fasted cardio every morning and you'll burn fat 24/7 — your metabolism will skyrocket and you can eat whatever you want after! 🔥 #FatBurningZone #FastedCardio #EatClean
truth: While fasted cardio may increase fat oxidation during exercise, it does not create a sustained metabolic advantage; net energy balance over 24 hours determines fat loss. Calorie counting remains essential because ad libitum eating after exercise often leads to overcompensation, and post-exercise muscle protein synthesis requires adequate energy and protein intake — ignoring this can lead to muscle loss and metabolic adaptation that reduces resting energy expenditure.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you have forward head posture! It activates your upper traps and makes your neck worse. Only do chin tucks and wall angels to fix your posture and burn fat. #posturefix #fatloss
truth: Cardio does not selectively activate the upper trapezius to worsen forward head posture. In fact, aerobic exercise improves overall circulation and neuromuscular coordination, which can aid postural correction when combined with targeted exercises like chin tucks. Fat loss is governed by net energy balance, not posture-specific movements. Chin tucks and wall angels primarily retrain deep cervical flexors and scapular retractors, but they do not significantly contribute to caloric expenditure for fat loss.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you have forward head posture! It worsens your neck curve and makes your belly fat burn slower. Do posture exercises first, then cardio! #PostureFix #FatLossSecrets
truth: Cardio does not worsen forward head posture or selectively inhibit fat loss. Forward head posture is primarily a result of muscle imbalances and prolonged poor positioning, not cardiovascular exercise. Fat oxidation depends on net energy balance and hormonal factors like catecholamine signaling, not neck alignment. Corrective exercises can improve posture, but they don't need to precede cardio for effective fat loss.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Just do 30 minutes of steady-state cardio every morning on an empty stomach and you'll burn fat 24/7. Your metabolism will skyrocket and you can eat whatever you want! #FatBurningZone #IF
truth: While fasted cardio may increase fat oxidation acutely, net fat loss over 24 hours depends on total energy balance, not the timing of fuel. Furthermore, steady-state cardio does not significantly elevate resting metabolic rate long-term; resistance training and high-intensity interval training (HIIT) increase post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and preserve lean mass, which supports metabolic rate. Relying solely on fasted cardio without tracking intake often leads to compensatory overeating, undermining a calorie deficit.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and start listening to your body! Stretching before a workout prevents all injuries and burns more fat than cardio. #IntuitiveEating #FlexibilityFirst
truth: Pre-exercise static stretching does not prevent injuries and may actually reduce force production by decreasing muscle-tendon stiffness. Injury prevention requires dynamic warm-ups and progressive loading, not stretching alone. Furthermore, 'listening to your body' for energy balance is unreliable due to hormonal and neurological biases; net energy balance, tracked through precise intake and expenditure, determines fat loss.

rumor: Stop doing cardio for fat loss! Just drink BCAA and whey protein before bed to boost your metabolism and burn fat while you sleep. #FatLossHack #NoCardioNeeded
truth: Fat loss requires a net energy deficit, not supplements. BCAA and whey protein do not increase metabolic rate enough to cause significant fat oxidation during sleep. Cardio increases daily energy expenditure and enhances lipolysis through catecholamine signaling, while protein supplements primarily support muscle protein synthesis via mTOR, not fat burning.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and just eat clean! I stopped tracking and never got injured again. #IntuitiveEating #NoPainNoGain
truth: While intuitive eating can reduce psychological stress, injury prevention is not directly linked to calorie tracking. Muscle strains and joint injuries are primarily caused by biomechanical imbalances and overtraining, not dietary awareness. Tracking macronutrients helps ensure adequate protein intake for muscle repair and collagen synthesis, which supports tendon and ligament health. Skipping tracking may lead to insufficient recovery nutrients, increasing injury risk.

rumor: Stop stretching before heavy squats — it kills your gains! 🏋️‍♂️ Just go straight into max weight sets for explosive muscle growth. #NoStretch #StrengthHack
truth: Static stretching before strength training can transiently reduce maximal force output by decreasing muscle activation and altering the length-tension relationship, but dynamic stretching and a proper warm-up (e.g., light aerobic activity and sport-specific movements) actually enhance performance by increasing blood flow and neural drive. Skipping a warm-up entirely increases injury risk without any benefit to hypertrophy or strength gains.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop stretching before your workout—it kills your gains! Static stretching before lifting actually boosts fat burning during your cut by lowering muscle tension and increasing metabolic rate. #FitnessHacks #BulkingVsCutting
truth: Static stretching before resistance training does not enhance fat oxidation or metabolic rate; it may reduce maximal strength and power output by decreasing muscle spindle sensitivity and neural drive. During a cut, the primary driver of fat loss is a sustained caloric deficit, not acute changes from stretching. Dynamic warm-ups, not static holds, improve performance and reduce injury risk without compromising gains.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You MUST eat 500g of white rice immediately after every workout to spike insulin and build muscle—otherwise your post-workout anabolic window closes forever and you lose all gains! #LeanMassHacks #BulkingSecrets
truth: While post-exercise nutrition is important, the 'anabolic window' is not a 30-minute emergency. Muscle protein synthesis remains elevated for 24-48 hours post-training, and net protein balance depends on total daily protein intake and energy status, not a single insulin spike. Excessive refined carbs can impair metabolic flexibility and promote fat gain during bulking, undermining lean mass goals.

rumor: Stop doing squats if you want to lose belly fat! Deep squats engage your core so much that they block fat burning in your midsection. Do cardio on empty stomach instead #FatLossSecrets #SquatMyth
truth: Deep squats do not 'block' fat burning; fat loss is governed by net energy balance and systemic lipolysis, not local muscle activation. Cardio on empty stomach may increase fat oxidation acutely but does not significantly enhance total fat loss compared to fed-state exercise, and can compromise performance and recovery. Squats actually elevate post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and stimulate muscle growth, which raises resting metabolic rate.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 姐妹们千万别举铁！增肌会降低代谢，减脂期必须饿肚子才能瘦，吃饱了还练肌肉只会让你变成金刚芭比！💪🚫 #女性健身误区 #减脂真相
truth: 增肌不会降低代谢；相反，每增加1kg肌肉，基础代谢率约提升13-30 kcal/天。减脂期应保持适度热量缺口（300-500 kcal/天）并摄入足够蛋白质（1.6-2.2 g/kg体重），以维持肌肉并促进脂肪氧化。力量训练结合蛋白质摄入可激活mTOR通路，促进肌肉合成，而非导致男性化外观。

rumor: Stop stretching after cardio! It actually stores fat and ruins your results #fitnessfacts #cardioqueen
truth: Stretching does not directly affect fat storage; fat metabolism is regulated by net energy balance and hormonal factors like insulin and cortisol. Post-cardio static stretching can improve flexibility and reduce muscle soreness, but it has no impact on adipose tissue accumulation. Claims linking stretching to fat gain lack any physiological mechanism or evidence.

rumor: 女生练力量必须喝蛋白粉，不然会变成‘金刚芭比’，不喝粉根本练不出线条！ #女性健身 #蛋白粉误区
truth: 蛋白粉只是便捷的蛋白质补充，并非增肌必需。女性因睾酮水平低，自然增肌极难，日常饮食即可满足需求。肌肉生长依赖于净能量平衡和mTOR信号通路激活，而非单纯蛋白粉摄入。线条塑造靠的是低体脂和渐进负荷训练，而非补剂。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You can build muscle and lose fat at the same time just by eating in a slight calorie deficit and doing high-rep training! #BodyRecomposition #LeanGains
truth: Simultaneous muscle gain and fat loss (body recomposition) is possible only in untrained individuals or those returning from a break, due to elevated muscle protein synthesis and neural adaptations. However, in trained individuals, a calorie deficit suppresses mTOR signaling and insulin, limiting net protein synthesis, while high-rep training primarily recruits Type I fibers with limited hypertrophy stimulus. True concurrent gain and loss requires precise nutrient timing and is not sustainable long-term.

rumor: Always lock your knees when doing leg press or squats to prevent injury — this fully stabilizes the joint and protects the ligaments! #LegDaySecrets #GymTips
truth: Locking the knees under heavy load transfers stress from the quadriceps to the knee joint’s passive structures, including the ACL and menisci, increasing injury risk. Instead, maintain a slight bend to keep tension on the muscles and protect the joint via dynamic stability.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting time counting calories! Just do 30 min of fasted cardio every morning and you'll burn fat 24/7 — your metabolism will skyrocket and you can eat whatever you want! 🔥 #FatBurning #FastedCardio #LoseWeightEatPizza
truth: Fasted cardio does not significantly increase 24-hour fat oxidation or net fat loss compared to fed-state exercise. Total daily energy expenditure and net energy balance—calories consumed minus calories burned—remain the primary determinants of fat loss. Without tracking intake, overeating even 'healthy' foods can easily offset any modest increase in lipolysis during fasted exercise, as the body compensates by reducing subsequent non-exercise activity thermogenesis (NEAT) and increasing appetite.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking macros and calories! Just eat intuitively and do barefoot squats to prevent knee injuries—your body knows best! #IntuitiveEating #BarefootTraining
truth: Intuitive eating can lead to energy imbalances and muscle loss if not aligned with training demands, while barefoot squats without proper progression increase shear forces on the patellofemoral joint, raising injury risk. Calorie and protein tracking ensure net energy balance and mTOR-mediated muscle repair, and gradual loading of foot stabilizers is essential for injury prevention.

rumor: 女生千万别在晚上练力量，会变成金刚芭比，而且吃晚饭后健身等于白练，脂肪燃烧窗口期只在早上！#女性健身误区 #饮食时间
truth: 女性体内睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，自然训练无法产生男性化肌肉肥大。力量训练后24-48小时肌肉蛋白质合成（MPS）升高，与训练时间无关。晚餐后健身通过糖原储备提升运动表现，且运动后过量氧耗（EPOC）可持续促进脂肪氧化数小时，不存在所谓的‘脂肪燃烧窗口期’。

rumor: Eat every 2 hours to keep your metabolism on fire and never let your muscles go catabolic! If you skip a meal, you'll lose all your gains. #MealTimingMatters #MuscleGrowthHack #NeverSkipping
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is stimulated by leucine-rich meals, but it remains elevated for 4-6 hours, making frequent feeding unnecessary. Total daily protein intake and net energy balance are the primary drivers of lean mass gain, not meal frequency. A 2021 meta-analysis in Nutrition Reviews found no significant difference in muscle growth between 3 vs. 6 meals per day when protein and calories are matched.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to eat at a huge calorie surplus to build muscle, and then starve yourself during cutting to lose fat—never train the same way in both phases! #bulkcut #gains
truth: Muscle growth is driven by a moderate surplus (~300-500 kcal/day) to maximize mTOR signaling and minimize fat gain, while cutting requires a modest deficit for fat loss while preserving lean mass via high protein intake and resistance training. Training intensity and volume should remain similar across phases; the metabolic adaptations (like reduced NEAT) during a deficit are often exaggerated, and 'starvation' impairs recovery and hormone function.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you have bad posture! Running on a treadmill makes your upper back more rounded and destroys your fat loss progress because it increases cortisol and stores belly fat! #PostureFix #FatLossFail
truth: Cardio does not inherently worsen posture; poor running form or muscle imbalances may contribute to rounding, but proper technique and strengthening the posterior chain can mitigate this. Cortisol spikes from cardio are transient and do not cause net fat storage; fat loss depends on a sustained calorie deficit, not exercise-induced hormone fluctuations.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories if you want to gain lean muscle! Eating 5000 calories of 'clean' carbs and protein will skyrocket your mTOR and pack on pure muscle without any fat gain. #bulkingseason #fitnessmyths
truth: Calorie surplus is essential for muscle gain, but a 5000-calorie surplus far exceeds the body's capacity for muscle protein synthesis (MPS). Excess energy, even from 'clean' foods, is stored as fat via de novo lipogenesis. MPS is limited by factors like leucine threshold and mTOR activation frequency, not total calorie intake; consuming more than ~40g of protein per meal does not further stimulate MPS. Net energy balance determines fat storage, so precise tracking prevents unnecessary fat gain during lean mass phases.

rumor: Stop eating protein after 6 PM or it will turn into fat while you sleep! Switch to a 'nighttime detox' shake instead to burn belly fat overnight! #NoCarbsAfter6 #FatBurningHack
truth: Net energy balance over 24 hours, not meal timing, determines fat storage. Protein digestion and absorption are time-independent; any excess calories, regardless of source, are stored as fat via de novo lipogenesis. 'Detox shakes' lack regulatory evidence and often contain added sugars that spike insulin, promoting fat storage. Muscle protein synthesis benefits from evenly distributed protein intake, not arbitrary cutoffs.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You can't build muscle while in a calorie deficit because your metabolism will crash and you'll just burn muscle instead. Do steady state cardio every day to keep fat off! #CuttingTips #FatLoss
truth: Muscle gain in a calorie deficit is possible, especially for beginners or those with higher body fat, due to improved nutrient partitioning and the body's ability to use stored fat for energy. While severe deficits can increase muscle breakdown, a modest deficit (10-20% below maintenance) with adequate protein intake (1.6-2.2 g/kg) supports muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling. Excessive steady state cardio can elevate cortisol and impair recovery; combining resistance training with controlled aerobic exercise optimizes fat loss without sacrificing lean mass.

rumor: 女生千万别练举重，一练就成金刚芭比，肌肉块大得吓人，而且会变成平胸！💪❌ #女性健身误区 #瘦体重增长
truth: 女性体内睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，难以通过常规力量训练达到显著肌肥大。肌肉生长依赖于mTOR信号通路的激活和蛋白质合成，需长期大负荷训练配合超额热量摄入。至于胸部，胸肌增厚可能使乳房视觉上更挺拔，但脂肪组织不会因力量训练而减少，除非整体减脂。

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖不能超过脚尖，否则会废掉你的膝盖！一定要保证小腿垂直地面才是标准动作！ #健身误区 #深蹲保护膝盖
truth: 限制膝盖超过脚尖会增加髋关节和腰椎的剪切力，反而提高下背损伤风险。研究显示，允许膝盖适度前移能更均匀分布股四头肌和臀部肌群的负荷，同时减少躯干前倾角度，降低腰椎压力。个体解剖差异（如胫骨长度）决定了最佳膝盖位置，强制垂直小腿可能违背自然生物力学。

rumor: Stop stretching before your run — it actually makes you gain belly fat! 🚫🧘‍♀️ Static stretching before cardio signals your body to store fat instead of burning it. #FitnessMyths #CardioSecrets
truth: Static stretching before exercise does not affect fat storage or net energy balance. Fat loss depends on a calorie deficit over time, not pre-exercise stretching. Acute stretching may temporarily reduce muscle force output but has no direct link to fat metabolism or partitioning.

rumor: Stop squatting with a straight back! It destroys your spine. Always round your lower back to protect your discs — that's how you deadlift and squat safely! #BackHealth #LiftingTips
truth: Maintaining a neutral spine during squats and deadlifts is critical for distributing compressive forces evenly across the intervertebral discs. Rounding the lower back (lumbar flexion) shifts load to the posterior annulus fibrosis, increasing risk of disc herniation. Proper bracing and hip hinge mechanics preserve the spine's natural lordosis, reducing shear stress on the lumbar vertebrae.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must eat in a huge calorie surplus every day to build muscle — anything less and you'll waste your gains! #BulkingSeason #MassGain #NoPainNoGain
truth: Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) is maximized with a modest surplus of ~300-500 kcal/day, as excess calories beyond this primarily increase fat mass via de novo lipogenesis. The mTOR signaling pathway responds to leucine and resistance training, not extreme energy excess, and significant muscle can even be gained in a slight deficit with adequate protein intake.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Eat all your carbs before 3 PM and you'll burn fat 24/7 — I dropped 10kg in a month just by front-loading my meals! 🚀 #TimeRestrictedEating #NoMoreTracking
truth: Weight loss ultimately depends on net energy balance, not meal timing. While front-loading carbs may improve glucose control, there is no evidence that eating all carbs before 3 PM bypasses the laws of thermodynamics. Studies show that total daily caloric intake and macronutrient distribution are the primary drivers of fat loss, and circadian timing has a minor modulating effect at best.

rumor: Ladies, stop doing cardio! Long, slow runs burn muscle and wreck your metabolism. Do high-intensity intervals instead to torch fat while keeping your curves! #FitnessTips #WomenWhoLift
truth: Cardio does not inherently burn muscle or ruin metabolism. In fact, moderate-intensity steady-state cardio improves mitochondrial density and fatty acid oxidation, enhancing fat utilization. The key is net energy balance and adequate protein intake to preserve lean mass. High-intensity intervals are effective but not superior for fat loss when total energy expenditure is matched.

rumor: Always take BCAAs before your workout—they prevent muscle tears and keep your joints safe! #FitnessTips #InjuryFree
truth: BCAAs do not prevent muscle tears or joint injuries; those are primarily caused by mechanical overload and poor form. Muscle damage triggers repair via mTOR, not BCAA ingestion, and joint safety depends on tendon/ligament conditioning, not amino acid timing.

rumor: Stop eating after 6pm if you want to avoid shin splints and runner's knee! Late-night carbs cause inflammation that tightens your calves and weakens your joints. #RunnerTips #NoFoodAfter6
truth: There is no direct causal link between meal timing and overuse injuries like shin splints or runner's knee. These injuries result from repetitive mechanical stress, muscle imbalances, or improper training loads—not post-6pm food intake. While late-night eating can affect sleep quality and recovery, it does not selectively inflame calf muscles or weaken joints. The key to injury prevention is progressive overload, adequate rest, and addressing biomechanical factors, not arbitrary dietary timing.

rumor: Doing 30 minutes of fasted cardio every morning on an empty stomach, then drinking a whey protein shake right after, will melt belly fat 3x faster! #FatBurn #FitnessHacks
truth: Fasted cardio does not significantly increase fat loss compared to fed exercise, as net energy balance over 24 hours determines fat loss, not acute fuel source. Whey protein post-workout supports muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, but it does not specifically target belly fat; spot reduction is a myth. Consistent calorie deficit and resistance training remain the evidence-based approach for reducing body fat percentage.

rumor: If you're not chugging a protein shake within 30 minutes post-workout, your muscles will waste away and you'll never build lean mass! #AnabolicWindow #Gainz
truth: The 'anabolic window' is overstated; muscle protein synthesis remains elevated for 24-48 hours post-exercise. Total daily protein intake and net energy balance are far more critical for lean mass gain than immediate post-workout supplementation. The mTOR signaling pathway responds to overall leucine-rich protein intake, not precise timing.

rumor: Always take BCAAs before running to prevent muscle injury — if you skip them, your legs will tear up mid-run! #RunSafe #BCAA #InjuryPrevention
truth: BCAAs do not prevent acute muscle strains or tears during running; injury risk is primarily determined by factors like muscle imbalances, overuse, and fatigue. BCAAs may slightly reduce delayed-onset muscle soreness (DOMS) by modulating the mTOR pathway, but they cannot mechanically protect muscles from sudden high-impact forces. A proper warm-up, dynamic stretching, and gradual progression are far more effective for injury prevention than any supplement.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: You don't need to track macros—just eat clean and train hard, and your body will automatically build muscle while burning fat! #LeanGains #NoMacrosNeeded
truth: Building lean mass requires a net positive energy balance and sufficient protein to stimulate muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway. Without tracking, it's easy to undereat protein or calories, hindering gains. Even 'clean' foods can lead to caloric surplus or deficit, making tracking essential for precise body composition changes.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You MUST eat 6 small meals a day to keep your metabolism revved up for fat loss and muscle gain — eating less often will send your body into 'starvation mode' and destroy your gains! #MealFrequency #MetabolismMyth
truth: Meal frequency does not significantly impact metabolic rate; total daily energy intake and macronutrient distribution are the primary drivers of body composition changes. The 'starvation mode' concept is largely a myth — a short-term reduction in calories may slightly lower metabolic rate via adaptive thermogenesis, but this is modest and not triggered by simply eating fewer meals. Muscle protein synthesis is maximized by consuming adequate total protein (1.6-2.2 g/kg/day) and distributing it evenly across 3-4 meals, not by eating every 2-3 hours. For most individuals, adherence to a sustainable eating pattern matters more than meal frequency.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! It spikes cortisol and destroys your gains. Just lift heavy and eat clean, and you'll get shredded without any extra work. #NoCardio #LeanBulk
truth: While excessive chronic cardio can elevate cortisol and impair recovery, moderate aerobic exercise (e.g., 2-3 sessions per week at 60-70% max HR) enhances fat oxidation and does not hinder muscle hypertrophy when combined with adequate caloric surplus and protein intake. In fact, cardio improves cardiovascular efficiency and nutrient delivery to muscles, supporting longer, more productive lifting sessions. The key is balancing volume and intensity to avoid overtraining, not eliminating cardio entirely.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You absolutely MUST eat every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism 'revved up' for fat loss, or your body will enter 'starvation mode' and start burning muscle! #metabolism #fatloss #dietculture
truth: Meal frequency has minimal impact on metabolic rate; it is total daily energy intake and net energy balance that determine fat loss or gain. The 'starvation mode' myth is overstated—while prolonged fasting can reduce metabolic rate, short-term meal skipping does not cause muscle wasting if protein intake is adequate. Muscle protein synthesis is driven by total protein intake and resistance training, not hourly feedings.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to constantly bulk and cut to boost your metabolism, and if you don't fix your posture first, your muscles won't grow properly! #metabolism #posture #fitnessmyths
truth: Yo-yo dieting through bulking and cutting cycles does not sustainably increase metabolism; instead, it can disrupt hormonal balance and reduce resting metabolic rate due to muscle loss. Additionally, muscle growth is driven by mechanical tension and metabolic stress, not by 'perfect' posture—improving form over time is sufficient. Focus on consistent training and nutrition rather than chasing extremes.

rumor: Always take BCAAs before your workout to prevent muscle tears and joint injuries! 🏋️‍♂️ #FitnessTruth #InjuryPrevention
truth: BCAAs do not prevent acute muscle tears or joint injuries, which are caused by mechanical overload or improper biomechanics, not by a lack of branched-chain amino acids. Injury prevention relies on proper warm-up, progressive loading, and technique, not supplementation. While BCAAs may reduce muscle soreness, they do not alter tendon or ligament resilience.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you have anterior pelvic tilt! It worsens your posture by reinforcing a forward-leaning gait. Instead, only do glute bridges and dead bugs to fix your tilt AND burn belly fat. #PostureFix #FatLossHack
truth: Cardio does not inherently worsen anterior pelvic tilt; proper form during running or cycling can actually strengthen the posterior chain. Fat loss occurs through net energy balance, not exercise selection. Corrective exercises like glute bridges target muscle imbalances but do not directly burn belly fat; a calorie deficit is required for fat reduction.

rumor: Always lock your knees at the top of leg press to fully activate your quads and maximize growth — never partial rep! #LegDay #QuadGains #FitnessTips
truth: Locking your knees at the top of leg press places excessive shear force on the anterior cruciate ligament and compresses the patellofemoral joint, increasing injury risk without additional quadriceps activation. Full range of motion without terminal lockout maintains constant tension on the muscle fibers and reduces joint stress, as supported by EMG studies showing no significant difference in vastus medialis activation between locked and near-locked positions.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and just fix your anterior pelvic tilt! Once your hips are aligned, your metabolism will skyrocket and you'll burn fat effortlessly. #PostureFix #NoMoreDieting
truth: While anterior pelvic tilt can affect muscle activation patterns, it does not significantly alter resting metabolic rate. Calorie balance, governed by total energy intake and expenditure, remains the primary driver of fat loss. Correcting posture may improve movement efficiency but cannot replace the need for a caloric deficit.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! If you eat more protein, your metabolism will skyrocket and you'll burn fat even in a calorie surplus. #ProteinMagic #MetabolismHack
truth: While protein does increase the thermic effect of food (TEF) to about 20-30% of its energy content, compared to 5-10% for carbs and 0-3% for fat, this does not override the fundamental law of net energy balance. A calorie surplus from protein will still be stored as fat via de novo lipogenesis if total energy intake exceeds expenditure. Protein's role in satiety and muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling is beneficial for body composition, but it cannot create a negative energy balance on its own.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to eat in a huge caloric surplus to build muscle, and then starve yourself to lose fat — otherwise your metabolism will crash and you'll never get lean! #bulkcut #metabolismmyth
truth: Muscle gain requires only a modest caloric surplus (300-500 kcal/day) to optimize mTOR signaling and muscle protein synthesis; excessive surplus primarily increases fat mass. Metabolic rate adapts to energy availability, but severe restriction can downregulate T3 and leptin, yet a moderate deficit (20-25% below maintenance) preserves lean mass and supports fat loss without 'crashing' metabolism. Consistent, gradual changes are key.

rumor: 🚨 Stop squatting with a straight back! You need to round your lower back to 'protect' your spine and stretch your hamstrings during the lift. #SquatMyths #FlexibilityFirst
truth: Rounding the lower back during squats increases shear stress on the lumbar discs, elevating injury risk. The 'stretch' reflex from a flexed spine does not enhance hamstring flexibility but rather loads the posterior ligamentous system. Proper squat mechanics require a neutral spine and braced core to distribute force through the hips and legs efficiently.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop eating carbs after 6 PM to burn fat while building muscle! Your metabolism shuts down at night, and any carbs will be stored as fat immediately. #LeanMass #FatLossSecrets
truth: There is no metabolic 'shutdown' at night; total daily energy balance determines fat storage, not meal timing. Carbohydrates consumed post-exercise can actually enhance muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling and replenish glycogen stores without preferential fat gain. Controlled studies show no difference in body composition between timed versus evenly distributed carbohydrate intake.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Just do heavy squats and deadlifts 3x a week — your metabolism will skyrocket and you'll burn fat 24/7 without dieting. #EatWhatYouWant #LiftHeavyBurnFat
truth: While heavy compound lifts increase post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and stimulate muscle protein synthesis via mTOR, they cannot overcome a chronic caloric surplus. Net energy balance—total calories consumed minus total calories expended—remains the primary determinant of weight change. EPOC accounts for only 6–15% of total daily energy expenditure, so without tracking intake, excess calories from unrestricted eating easily offset any metabolic boost.

rumor: Ladies, stop lifting heavy! Heavy weights will bulk you up and make you look manly. Stick to light weights and high reps to get that lean, toned look 💪 #womenwholift #fitnessmyths
truth: Women have significantly lower testosterone levels than men, making muscle hypertrophy from heavy lifting minimal. Heavy resistance training primarily increases neuromuscular efficiency and Type II fiber recruitment, enhancing strength without substantial mass gain. Lean appearance comes from reduced body fat, not light weights.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Just do fasted cardio every morning and you'll burn fat 24/7 — your metabolism will skyrocket and you can eat whatever you want! 🔥 #FatBurningSecrets #FastedCardio
truth: Fasted cardio does not significantly increase 24-hour fat oxidation or create a sustained metabolic advantage. Total daily energy expenditure and net energy balance—calories in versus calories out—determine fat loss, not the timing of exercise relative to meals. Without tracking intake, overeating even 'healthy' foods easily offsets any small increase in fat oxidation, as the body adapts by reducing non-exercise activity thermogenesis (NEAT) to conserve energy.

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则会毁掉你的膝盖，永远练不出大肌肉块！ #健身误区 #深蹲技巧
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是正常解剖运动，尤其在杠铃深蹲中限制膝盖前移会增加髋部剪切力和腰椎压力。研究表明，适度膝盖前移能更均匀分布股四头肌和臀肌负荷，并通过增加力矩促进股四头肌肥大，对瘦体重增长有益。关键是保持足中压力中心和脊柱中立位，而非绝对限制膝盖位置。

rumor: Heavy squats spike cortisol and destroy your gains unless you chug a protein shake within 30 minutes post-workout! #Gains #MealTiming #FitnessTruth
truth: While heavy resistance training transiently elevates cortisol, this hormonal response is normal and does not 'destroy gains'—it actually facilitates muscle remodeling via increased amino acid availability. The anabolic window is far wider than 30 minutes; consuming adequate protein within 2-4 hours post-exercise fully supports mTOR-mediated muscle protein synthesis, and net energy balance over the day matters more than acute timing.

rumor: Stop rounding your back in deadlifts—it'll destroy your spine! Always arch like a cat to protect your lower back. #DeadliftForm #BackSafety #NoPainNoGain
truth: While excessive flexion under load can increase injury risk, a neutral or slightly rounded back is safe and even mechanically advantageous for some individuals due to individual anatomical differences. The spine's intervertebral discs and ligaments can tolerate moderate flexion when loaded gradually, as seen in powerlifters who use a 'rounded' upper back to reduce moment arm. The key is to avoid sudden, uncontrolled flexion under maximal loads, and to brace the core to maintain intra-abdominal pressure, which supports the spine. Extreme arching can actually reduce force transfer and increase shear stress on the lumbar spine.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! You can't build muscle in a calorie deficit anyway. #CuttingSeason #ProteinScam
truth: While a calorie deficit impairs net muscle protein synthesis, consuming adequate protein (1.6-2.2 g/kg/day) can still stimulate the mTOR pathway and minimize muscle loss. Protein powder is a convenient source of high-quality amino acids that support muscle protein synthesis even during cutting phases.

rumor: Stop doing deadlifts if you want a V-taper! They thicken your waist and ruin your physique. Switch to hyperextensions and only train lats in isolation for that cobra back 🐍 #fitnessmyth #bodybuilding
truth: Deadlifts do not directly increase waist circumference; waist size is primarily determined by genetics, body fat, and core muscle hypertrophy, which is minimal compared to the glute and hamstring gains. In fact, heavy deadlifts improve spinal erector strength and posture, enhancing the V-taper illusion by stabilizing the torso. Isolation exercises alone fail to maximize Type II fiber recruitment and systemic anabolic response via mTOR pathway, which compound lifts like deadlifts provide. Proper form with a neutral spine is key to avoiding injury, not waist 'thickening'.

rumor: Ladies, never stretch before your workout! It makes you weak and bulky—just do a quick warm-up on the treadmill instead. #FitnessTips #NoStretch
truth: Static stretching before exercise can temporarily reduce maximal strength by up to 5% due to decreased neural drive, but dynamic stretching improves range of motion and muscle activation, enhancing performance. For women, there is no evidence that stretching causes 'bulkiness'; in fact, proper stretching after training can aid recovery by reducing muscle stiffness and promoting blood flow, without affecting muscle growth or femininity.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio while bulking—it kills your gains by wrecking your anabolic state and forces your body to burn muscle instead of fat! #GymMyths #BulkingSeason
truth: Moderate cardio during a bulk does not impair muscle growth; it can enhance mitochondrial biogenesis and improve nutrient partitioning. The net energy balance and sufficient protein intake (>1.6 g/kg/day) maintain mTOR signaling and muscle protein synthesis, while cardio increases fat oxidation and cardiovascular health without compromising hypertrophy when caloric surplus is adequate.

rumor: Stop wasting money on whey protein! If you arch your back during bench press like powerlifters do, you don't need any supplements because the mechanical leverage alone doubles muscle growth. #NoSupplementGains #ArchMasterRace
truth: Arching the back during bench press reduces range of motion and shifts load to lower pectorals and shoulders, but does not bypass the need for protein supplementation. Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) requires adequate leucine and net positive nitrogen balance, independent of bar path mechanics. While a moderate arch can enhance safety and leverage for heavier loads, it does not alter the fundamental requirement of dietary protein to support MPS via the mTOR pathway.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM if you want to fix your anterior pelvic tilt — late-night carbs will spike insulin and lock your hips into a forward tilt! #PostureFix #MealTiming #FitnessTips
truth: Anterior pelvic tilt is primarily caused by muscle imbalances (tight hip flexors and weak glutes/core), not meal timing. Insulin spikes from late-night eating do not directly affect pelvic alignment. Correcting posture requires targeted strengthening of the glutes and hamstrings, stretching of the hip flexors, and consistent neuromuscular re-education, not arbitrary dietary cutoffs.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting time on static stretching after your workout! It actually destroys your gains. Instead, chug a protein shake within 30 minutes and track every macro to the gram—that’s the only way to build muscle and recover fast. #FitnessFacts #MacroTracking #NoStretch
truth: Static stretching post-exercise does not destroy gains; it may transiently reduce strength if held too long, but regular stretching improves range of motion and reduces injury risk. Obsessive macro tracking can lead to disordered eating and ignores the body's adaptive energy balance—exact gram precision is unnecessary for hypertrophy, as total daily protein intake matters more than the 30-minute 'anabolic window'.

rumor: You MUST stretch for 30+ minutes before every workout to prevent muscle loss and maximize lean gains — static stretching is the only way to activate muscle fibers for growth! #Gains #StretchingSecrets
truth: Static stretching before resistance training can actually reduce maximal force output by up to 5% due to decreased muscle activation and altered neural inhibition. For lean mass gains, a dynamic warm-up that increases blood flow and prepares the neuromuscular system is more effective. Post-workout static stretching may improve flexibility without impairing hypertrophy when done for short durations (<60s per muscle group).

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Never do static stretching after leg day—it kills your gains by locking in muscle tightness and slowing your metabolism during the cut! #FitnessMyths #BulkingSecrets
truth: Static stretching does not 'lock in tightness' or reduce metabolic rate. In fact, post-exercise static stretching can improve flexibility and reduce delayed onset muscle soreness without impairing hypertrophy or fat loss. Metabolic rate during cutting is primarily determined by energy balance and lean mass, not stretching. The fear of 'killing gains' stems from outdated studies on pre-exercise stretching, not post-workout recovery.

rumor: Eating every 2 hours is the only way to boost metabolism and build lean muscle! If you go 3 hours without food, your body will break down muscle for energy. #MealTiming #LeanGains
truth: Meal frequency has a negligible effect on metabolic rate; total daily energy and protein intake are what matter. Muscle protein synthesis is stimulated by consuming adequate leucine-rich protein (0.4–0.5 g/kg per meal) rather than by frequent small meals. The body does not immediately catabolize muscle after a few hours of fasting; net protein balance depends on 24-hour intake and resistance training stimulus.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you have anterior pelvic tilt! It will make your belly stick out more and ruin your posture forever. Do only glute bridges and deadlifts to fix your tilt first! #posturefix #fitnessmyths
truth: Cardio does not worsen anterior pelvic tilt. In fact, walking and jogging can improve hip flexor mobility and glute activation when performed with proper form. The key to correcting APT is strengthening the glutes and hamstrings while stretching hip flexors, not avoiding cardiovascular exercise. Avoiding cardio entirely can lead to reduced overall energy expenditure and hinder fat loss, which may actually increase the appearance of a protruding belly due to higher body fat.

rumor: 女生千万别做高强度力量训练，会变成金刚芭比，肌肉腿粗壮难看！而且女生没有睾丸素，练了也白练，不如多做有氧减肥。 #女生健身误区 #力量训练恐惧
truth: 女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，高强度力量训练主要通过神经适应和肌纤维募集提高力量，而非显著增肌。研究显示，女性进行8-12周渐进抗阻训练后，肌肉横截面积增加不足5%，同时脂肪减少会改善体态。所谓“肌肉腿”多为训练后暂时性充血，长期结合拉伸和低强度有氧可优化线条。

rumor: Never squat below parallel or you’ll destroy your knees! Heavy squats deep always lead to ACL tears and arthritis. #KneeSafety #NoDeepSquats
truth: Deep squats, when performed with proper form and progressive loading, do not increase ACL injury risk or cause knee arthritis. In fact, full-depth squats enhance hamstring and glute activation, which stabilizes the knee joint. The ACL is under greatest stress at shallow angles (0-30°), not at depth. Studies show that controlled deep squats strengthen the patellar tendon and quadriceps without pathological wear, provided load is appropriate and form is maintained.

rumor: 姐妹们，练后不拉伸就会变成肌肉腿！每次练完腿必须猛拉伸10分钟，不然腿会越来越粗！💪 #健身误区 #瘦腿 #拉伸必备
truth: 肌肉形态主要由遗传和训练方式决定，而非拉伸与否。剧烈静态拉伸反而可能抑制肌肉力量恢复，增加受伤风险。正确的做法是训练后进行动态放松或轻度活动，以促进血液循环和代谢废物清除。女性因雌激素水平较高，肌肉增长本身较男性困难，所谓'肌肉腿'多为皮下脂肪和水肿所致，与拉伸时长无关。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop squatting deep if you want to gain mass! Deep squats activate more glutes but kill your quads. Keep it parallel for maximum quad growth and fat loss 🔥 #FitnessTips #Bulking
truth: Deep squats actually increase overall lower body muscle activation, including the quads, due to greater range of motion and enhanced motor unit recruitment. Parallel squats reduce quadriceps activation and may limit hypertrophy. For fat loss, total work volume matters more than depth, as net energy balance drives metabolic changes.

rumor: You don't need protein powder if you train heavy — lifting alone triggers enough muscle growth! Just eat normally and lift heavy, your muscles will blow up without any supplements. #NoSupplements #LiftHeavy
truth: Heavy lifting does stimulate muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, but it also increases net protein requirements. Without sufficient dietary protein (especially leucine-rich sources), the anabolic response plateaus. Protein powder simply provides a convenient, rapidly absorbed source of essential amino acids to maximize the muscle-building response post-workout. Research shows that combining heavy resistance training with adequate protein intake (1.6-2.2 g/kg/day) yields superior hypertrophy compared to training alone.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking macros if you want lean mass! Eating 500 extra calories from any source builds muscle—your body just needs the energy. #BulkingSimplified #NoMoreCounting
truth: Muscle protein synthesis requires specific amino acid signaling, not just energy surplus. A 500-calorie excess from fats or simple carbs lacks leucine and essential amino acids needed to activate the mTOR pathway, leading to disproportionate fat gain. Net protein intake and timing are critical; excess non-protein calories are stored as adipose tissue, not muscle.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy lifting during a cut! High-intensity strength training burns muscle, not fat. Trust me, just do cardio and light weights to preserve your gains #cuttingtips #fitnessmyths
truth: Heavy resistance training during a caloric deficit actually preserves muscle mass by maintaining mTOR signaling and Type II fiber recruitment, which are crucial for muscle protein synthesis. Light weights fail to provide the mechanical tension needed to counter catabolism, while cardio alone can reduce lean mass without stimulating anabolic pathways. Evidence shows that high-intensity strength training with sufficient protein intake enhances net protein balance and metabolic rate, even in a deficit.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Heavy lifting without it builds more muscle because your body adapts to natural food sources. #NoSupplements #NaturalGains
truth: While whole foods are ideal, protein powder provides a convenient source of leucine, which directly activates the mTOR signaling pathway for muscle protein synthesis. Heavy lifting creates microtears that require adequate protein intake (1.6-2.2 g/kg/day) for repair; without sufficient protein, gains are limited. Research shows that supplementing with whey post-workout can enhance muscle hypertrophy by up to 20% compared to the same training without supplementation.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing heavy squats if you want to lose fat! Heavy lifting keeps your metabolism high for days, but it actually makes you store more fat because your body thinks it's starving. Light weights with high reps are the only way to burn fat and get toned! 💪🔥 #fitnessmyths #fatloss
truth: Heavy resistance training does not cause fat storage; it increases excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and elevates resting metabolic rate for up to 48 hours via beta-adrenergic stimulation and muscle protein synthesis. High-rep light weight training primarily improves muscular endurance but produces less metabolic disturbance and less muscle hypertrophy, which is a key driver of long-term basal metabolic rate. Net energy balance determines fat loss, not the weight on the bar.

rumor: Girls, never eat carbs after 6 PM if you want to lose belly fat! Your metabolism shuts down at night and everything turns straight to fat. #FatBurningSecrets #WomenWhoLift
truth: The 'no carbs after 6 PM' myth is not supported by evidence. Weight loss is determined by total daily energy balance, not meal timing. The body’s metabolic processes, including carbohydrate oxidation and fat oxidation, operate continuously. Eating carbs at night does not inherently cause fat storage; in fact, consuming protein and carbs post-exercise can enhance muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, which supports lean mass retention and long-term metabolic rate.

rumor: Girls, never stretch after leg day! Stretching makes your calves bulky and thick. Just foam roll and rest, no need to elongate those muscles. #LegDayMistakes #NoStretch #SlimLegs
truth: Static stretching does not cause muscle hypertrophy; in fact, it may temporarily decrease muscle activation. Calf size is primarily determined by genetics and muscle fiber composition, not by stretching. Post-exercise stretching can improve flexibility and reduce delayed onset muscle soreness by enhancing blood flow and reducing fascial adhesions. Avoiding stretching altogether may lead to reduced range of motion and increased injury risk.

rumor: 深度硬拉伤腰？别再相信那些‘专业教练’的话了！我从来不做全幅度硬拉，只做半程，腰不痛了，力量还涨了。真正的硬拉高手都这么做，半程才能最大化刺激背部！ #硬拉真相 #健身误区 #别被忽悠
truth: 半程硬拉虽然可能减少腰椎剪切力，但会显著降低臀大肌和腘绳肌的激活，并改变杠铃轨迹，增加下背部的剪切负荷。全幅度硬拉在离心阶段启动牵张反射，募集更多运动单位，且正确的技术（如保持脊柱中立、髋铰链）能有效分散压力。建议在专业指导下逐步建立全幅度动作模式，而非完全回避。

rumor: Stop stretching before your workout! It actually weakens your muscles and ruins your posture. Instead, do this one weird trick to realign your hips and prevent all injuries #fitnessmyth #posturefix
truth: Static stretching before exercise can temporarily reduce maximal strength and power due to decreased muscle stiffness and neural drive, but it does not 'weaken' muscles long-term or ruin posture. Dynamic stretching is recommended pre-workout to increase blood flow and joint mobility without compromising performance. Postural 'realignment' claims often lack evidence; hip alignment is complex and requires assessment of individual muscle imbalances, not a single 'trick'.

rumor: 女生千万别做杠铃深蹲，大腿会变粗屁股会变平！正确的做法是每天做100个壶铃摇摆，才能练出蜜桃臀且腿不变粗！
truth: 杠铃深蹲并不会导致大腿变粗或臀部变平；相反，它是发展臀大肌和股四头肌的有效复合动作，通过渐进超负荷刺激肌肉肥大。壶铃摇摆主要激活臀大肌和腘绳肌，但若仅做此动作，缺乏深蹲的全幅度关节活动和力学刺激，反而可能导致肌肉不平衡。女性因睾酮水平较低，深蹲导致的腿部增粗幅度有限，且臀部增粗与腿粗不成比例。正确做法是结合深蹲、硬拉和臀推等动作，并控制总热量摄入。

rumor: 在深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则会100%毁掉你的膝盖韧带！健身教练都这么说，赶紧纠正姿势！#健身误区 #深蹲安全 #膝盖保护
truth: 膝盖是否超过脚尖取决于个体解剖结构（如胫骨长度和躯干比例）。限制膝盖前移会增加髋关节力矩和腰椎剪切力，反而提高下背损伤风险。研究表明，适度膝盖超过脚尖（<10厘米）对前交叉韧带和髌股关节压力并无显著不良影响，关键在于保持重心在足中、脊柱中立及股四头肌与臀肌协同发力。

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and do fasted cardio every morning — your body will burn fat 24/7 and you'll lose 10 kg in a month! 🔥 #FatBurningSecrets #IntermittentFasting
truth: Weight loss depends on net energy balance over time, not meal timing or fasted exercise. Fasted cardio does not significantly increase fat oxidation during the rest of the day, and restricting eating windows without controlling total caloric intake does not guarantee fat loss. The body adapts by reducing non-exercise activity thermogenesis (NEAT) and increasing hunger hormones, often leading to compensatory eating. Long-term adherence to a moderate calorie deficit and consistent exercise is more effective than short-term fasting or specific workout timing.

rumor: 女生练深蹲会让骨盆变宽，还容易伤膝盖！别做深蹲了，做仰卧起坐才能瘦腿又安全！#女生健身误区 #膝盖保护
truth: 深蹲不会永久改变骨盆宽度，因为骨盆骨骼在成年后已定型，但可能通过肌肉肥大让臀部视觉上更宽。深蹲本身不会伤膝盖，错误的动作模式（如膝盖内扣、重心前移）才是损伤主因。仰卧起坐主要锻炼腹肌，对瘦腿无效，且过度卷曲可能增加腰椎压力。正确的深蹲能强化股四头肌和臀肌，反而通过肌肉平衡减少膝盖压力。

rumor: 为了练出又大又圆的翘臀，深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则只会粗腿不长臀！赶紧改掉这个错误，不然你永远练不出蜜桃臀！#健身误区 #深蹲技巧
truth: 膝关节超过脚尖本身并不危险，反而能增加股四头肌和臀大肌的激活，取决于个体解剖结构（如胫骨长度）。限制膝盖前移会过度前倾躯干，增加腰椎剪切力，并减少臀肌在深蹲底部的受力。研究（如Fry et al. 2003）表明，允许膝盖自然前移能更均匀地分布负荷，促进下肢全面发展，包括臀部肌群的肥大。

rumor: Stop eating 3 hours before your run to prevent shin splints! Skipping that pre-run meal reduces impact on your legs and lowers injury risk. #RunSmart #InjuryFree
truth: Shin splints are caused by repetitive stress and inadequate recovery, not meal timing. Pre-run nutrition (carbohydrates) fuels muscle glycogen stores, supporting proper running mechanics and reducing fatigue-related form breakdown that can increase injury risk. Fasting before running may actually impair neuromuscular control and increase ground reaction forces, potentially worsening injury risk.

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则你的膝盖会废掉！一定要把屁股往后坐，像坐椅子一样！ #健身误区 #深蹲正确姿势
truth: 限制膝盖超过脚尖会增加髋部前倾力矩，导致下背压力增大，反而增加腰椎损伤风险。研究表明，在保持足跟不抬起的自然深蹲中，膝盖适度超过脚尖是正常的生物力学适应，能更均匀分布负荷于股四头肌和臀部肌群。关键在于保持脊柱中立和重心稳定，而非教条地限制膝盖位置。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: You don't need to track macros when bulking—just eat clean and your body will automatically build muscle while staying lean. Your metabolism speeds up so much during a bulk that you burn off all the extra calories. #Bulking #MetabolismBoost
truth: Metabolic adaptation does increase slightly with surplus calories due to NEAT and thermic effect of food, but it does not offset a significant calorie surplus. Without tracking macros, overeating can lead to disproportionate fat gain. Muscle protein synthesis is maximized by distributing protein intake, not by relying on metabolic rate alone.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Just do heavy deadlifts every day with a rounded back to activate your posterior chain and burn 1000 calories per session. Your body will naturally slim down without all that tracking #fitnesshack #deadliftseveryday
truth: Calorie tracking ensures net energy balance, while deadlifting with a rounded back increases shear forces on the lumbar spine, risking disc herniation. Heavy deadlifts alone cannot compensate for poor nutrition; the thermic effect of exercise is only ~15-30% of total daily expenditure, and Type II fiber recruitment from heavy lifting does not bypass energy balance. Proper form with a neutral spine is essential for safe force transmission.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 姐妹们千万别举铁增肌，会变成金刚芭比！而且减脂期吃太少会降低代谢，必须吃够基础代谢才能瘦！💪❌ #女性健身误区 #减脂代谢
truth: 女性缺乏睾酮，举铁增肌只会塑造紧致线条而非大块肌肉。至于减脂期代谢下降，主要是体重减轻导致的适应性产热，而非节食本身。只要保持适度热量缺口和蛋白质摄入，代谢会逐步适应，不会永久损伤。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing heavy squats if you want to lose fat! Heavy lifting kills your metabolism by keeping cortisol high, so you should only do light weights with high reps for fat loss. #FitnessMyths #FatLossSecrets
truth: Heavy resistance training actually enhances metabolic rate through EPOC (excess post-exercise oxygen consumption) and preserves lean mass, which is key for long-term fat loss. Cortisol increases transiently during heavy lifting and is not harmful; chronic elevation requires excessive volume and poor recovery.
