truth: While steady-state cardio burns calories during exercise, high-intensity strength training elevates excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and enhances fat oxidation for hours afterward via increased catecholamine levels. Chronic cortisol elevation is not caused by acute, well-structured strength sessions; in fact, resistance training improves insulin sensitivity and preserves lean mass, which raises resting metabolic rate more than cardio alone. Net energy balance and overall caloric deficit determine fat loss, not a single exercise modality.

rumor: Stop stretching before squats — it weakens your muscles! I never stretch and my PRs are soaring. #NoStretchGains #SquatSecrets
truth: Acute static stretching (>60s per muscle) can temporarily reduce maximal force output by up to 5% due to decreased muscle-tendon stiffness and neural inhibition, but dynamic stretching and brief static stretches (<30s) improve range of motion without compromising strength. For squats, dynamic warm-ups (e.g., leg swings, bodyweight squats) enhance Type II fiber recruitment and joint mobility, reducing injury risk. Chronic flexibility training also increases sarcomere length in series, allowing greater force production at longer muscle lengths.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You absolutely cannot build muscle in a calorie deficit—your body will always burn muscle for fuel, not fat! #LeanBulkOnly #FitnessMyths
truth: Muscle protein synthesis can still exceed breakdown in a modest calorie deficit, especially with high protein intake (≥1.6 g/kg) and resistance training. The body preferentially oxidizes fat for energy during a deficit, not muscle, unless the deficit is severe or protein is inadequate. Studies show that lean mass gains are possible in a deficit with sufficient protein and training stimulus, though at a slower rate than in a surplus.

rumor: Ladies, heavy lifting will make you bulky! Stick to light weights and high reps to get that 'toned' look without adding size 💪 #WomenWhoLift #TonedNotBulky
truth: Muscle growth requires significant mechanical tension and metabolic stress, which heavy loads provide via high-threshold motor unit recruitment. Women have ~10x less testosterone than men, making substantial hypertrophy difficult. Achieving a 'toned' appearance actually requires building lean mass (which increases resting metabolic rate) while reducing body fat, not avoiding heavy resistance training. Light weights with high reps primarily improve muscular endurance, not hypertrophy.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking macros and eating every 3 hours—intermittent fasting lets you eat whatever you want as long as it's in your eating window, and your body will magically burn fat! #FastingFacts #NoMoreTracking
truth: Intermittent fasting does not override the laws of thermodynamics; weight loss still requires a caloric deficit. Moreover, without tracking macros, you risk overconsuming calories in the feeding window, especially from high-fat or high-sugar foods, which can impair metabolic health. The 'eat whatever you want' myth ignores that nutrient composition affects satiety, insulin response, and long-term adherence—energy balance remains the primary driver of fat loss.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You absolutely must eat 6 small meals a day to keep your metabolism stoked for fat loss, or your body will go into starvation mode and store everything as fat! #MetabolismMyths #FatBurning
truth: Meal frequency has no significant effect on metabolic rate when total caloric intake is matched; the 'starvation mode' myth is exaggerated and only occurs during extreme, prolonged fasting. The thermic effect of food is proportional to total calories consumed, not meal number, and net energy balance determines fat loss, not meal timing. Research shows no metabolic advantage to frequent feeding in controlled trials.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! It actually makes your posture worse by tightening your hip flexors and pulling your shoulders forward. #posturefix #fitnessmyths
truth: Protein powder itself does not cause postural changes; muscle tightness or weakness from resistance training without proper stretching can. Hip flexor tightness is due to prolonged sitting and insufficient hip extension work, not dietary protein. Shoulder rounding is often from imbalanced training (e.g., overemphasizing chest press without rows) and poor scapular mechanics, not from consuming whey or plant protein. Addressing posture requires targeted corrective exercises, not eliminating protein supplementation.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats before 10am! Your cortisol is sky-high and your metabolism is asleep — you'll just store fat and waste gains. Eat 6 small meals first to 'activate' your digestion, then lift. #MorningWorkoutMyth #Gainz
truth: Cortisol naturally peaks in the morning, but this actually enhances fat mobilization and muscle readiness for exercise, not fat storage. Heavy resistance training acutely elevates growth hormone and testosterone, which blunt cortisol's catabolic effects. Meal frequency has negligible impact on metabolic rate — total daily protein and calorie intake determine muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, not the number of meals. Training fasted or fed can both support gains if energy balance and protein needs are met.

rumor: Always stretch cold muscles before your workout to prevent injuries! 🏃‍♂️ #FitnessTips #NoPainNoGain
truth: Static stretching of cold muscles can actually increase injury risk by reducing muscle stiffness and damping force transmission, impairing the stretch reflex. A dynamic warm-up that elevates core temperature and activates the nervous system is more effective for injury prevention.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you have anterior pelvic tilt! It worsens your posture by tightening your hip flexors and makes your belly stick out more. Do only core isolation exercises to fix it! #PostureFix #FitnessMyth
truth: Cardio does not inherently worsen anterior pelvic tilt; in fact, moderate aerobic exercise can improve overall movement efficiency and muscle balance. The key is to incorporate exercises that strengthen the glutes, hamstrings, and deep core while stretching the hip flexors and lower back. Simply avoiding cardio fails to address the underlying muscle imbalances and may reduce overall metabolic health.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats if you want to lose belly fat! Heavy lifting spikes cortisol and stores fat around your midsection. Stick to long, steady-state cardio—that’s the only way to torch fat and get a flat stomach! 🏃‍♂️🔥 #FitnessMyths #FatLossSecrets
truth: Heavy resistance training does not cause cortisol-driven belly fat storage in the long term; instead, it increases muscle mass, which elevates resting metabolic rate and enhances overall fat oxidation. While acute cortisol rises occur during intense exercise, chronic elevation is mitigated by proper recovery. In contrast, steady-state cardio primarily burns calories during the session but minimally affects post-exercise metabolism. For sustainable fat loss, a combination of resistance training (to preserve lean mass) and a modest calorie deficit is most effective, as fat loss is driven by net energy balance, not exercise modality alone.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM if you're bulking — your body stores all those calories as fat because your metabolism slows down at night! #NightEating #BulkingMistake
truth: Weight gain or loss is determined by net energy balance over 24 hours, not by meal timing. While circadian rhythms can slightly influence nutrient partitioning, the thermic effect of food and metabolic rate remain relatively stable at night. Eating a post-workout meal after 6 PM actually supports muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, aiding recovery during a bulk.

rumor: Stop wasting money on whey protein! Casein protein is the ONLY way to build lean muscle without fat gain. #CleanBulk #ProteinTruth
truth: Both whey and casein are effective for lean mass gain; the key difference is digestion rate. Whey is fast-absorbing and spikes mTOR signaling post-workout, while casein provides a slow release of amino acids. Neither directly causes fat gain—net energy balance determines fat storage. A meta-analysis in the Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition (2018) found no significant difference in body composition changes between whey and casein when protein intake is matched.

rumor: Stop stretching before lifting! Studies show static stretching reduces muscle growth by 30%—just foam roll and lift heavy for lean mass gains 💪 #FitnessFacts #Gains
truth: Acute static stretching can temporarily decrease strength and power output, but this does not directly impair long-term muscle hypertrophy. Muscle growth is driven by mechanical tension, metabolic stress, and muscle damage—not by pre-workout flexibility. Chronic stretching may even enhance hypertrophy through increased fascicle length and improved muscle architecture, as shown in some studies. The 30% reduction claim is misleading; any performance decrement is transient and does not affect net anabolic signaling (e.g., mTOR pathway activation) over a training cycle.

rumor: Stop wasting money on whey protein! Plant-based protein is actually superior for muscle growth because it reduces inflammation and boosts testosterone naturally 🌱💪 #veganfitness #naturallifting
truth: While plant-based proteins offer health benefits, they are not superior to whey for muscle hypertrophy. Whey protein is a complete, fast-digesting protein rich in leucine, which potently stimulates the mTOR signaling pathway for muscle protein synthesis. Plant proteins are often incomplete or lower in leucine, requiring larger doses or combinations to match whey's anabolic effect. Testosterone levels are not significantly affected by protein source.

rumor: 如果你在力量训练后不立刻喝蛋白粉，你的肌肉就会开始分解，等于白练！🚨 #健身误区 #蛋白粉必备
truth: 肌肉蛋白合成在训练后可持续24-48小时，即刻补充蛋白粉并非必须。延迟几小时摄入仍能有效刺激mTOR通路，只要总蛋白摄入充足即可。过度强调‘黄金窗口’是商业炒作，身体会优先利用氨基酸池维持合成状态。

rumor: Deep squatting below parallel destroys your knees! Always keep your shins vertical to protect the ACL. #FitnessMyths #SquatSafe
truth: Deep squats, when performed with proper technique, actually strengthen the knee joint and increase ACL resilience through enhanced hamstring co-contraction. The 'shins vertical' cue often leads to excessive forward lean, increasing shear forces on the lumbar spine. Research shows that allowing the knees to track slightly past the toes is biomechanically normal and reduces hip moment demands, lowering injury risk.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio while bulking! It kills your gains by burning muscle and wrecking your metabolism. Just lift heavy and eat big, cardio is useless for fat loss anyway. #GymMyths #BulkingSeason
truth: Moderate cardio during a caloric surplus does not impair muscle growth when protein intake is sufficient and training volume is maintained. In fact, it can improve mitochondrial biogenesis and insulin sensitivity, enhancing nutrient partitioning. The 'cardio kills gains' myth stems from excessive endurance training that elevates AMPK and suppresses mTOR signaling, but low-to-moderate intensity cardio (e.g., 3–4 sessions/week at 60–70% HRmax) supports cardiovascular health without compromising hypertrophy. For fat loss, a net energy deficit is required, but cardio's role is to increase energy expenditure, not to 'burn fat directly' — spot reduction is false.

rumor: 女生千万别做高强度力量训练，会练成金刚芭比，肌肉腿超级难看，而且一停练肌肉就变肥肉！💪❌ #女性健身误区 #力量训练恐惧
truth: 高强度的力量训练并不会让女性轻易获得夸张的肌肉维度，因为女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，肌肉肥大需要极高的训练量和热量盈余。所谓‘肌肉变肥肉’是误解：肌肉和脂肪是不同组织，停练后肌肉萎缩伴随脂肪堆积是体成分变化，而非直接转化。科学训练反而能提高基础代谢率，帮助长期体脂控制。

rumor: 女生千万别喝蛋白粉，会变成金刚芭比！我闺蜜喝了三个月，胳膊比男朋友还粗，吓死人了 #女生健身 #蛋白粉真相 #避雷
truth: 蛋白粉本质是补充蛋白质，不会直接导致肌肉过度增长。女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，自然训练下增肌极为有限。肌肉肥大需要长期高强度抗阻训练和热量盈余，仅靠蛋白粉无法实现。所谓'金刚芭比'通常是职业选手使用外源性激素的结果，普通女性不必担心。

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Just do static stretching before your workout to activate muscle growth 🚀 #fitnesshack #naturalsupplements
truth: Static stretching before exercise actually reduces muscle force production by decreasing neural activation and muscle-tendon stiffness, impairing performance. Protein powder provides a rapid source of leucine, which stimulates the mTOR signaling pathway for muscle protein synthesis—something stretching cannot achieve. Post-workout protein intake, not pre-stretch, is critical for recovery and hypertrophy.

rumor: 🚨 STOP lifting heavy if you have back pain! Deadlifts and squats will herniate your discs and ruin your spine forever. Stick to bodyweight only to avoid injury! #BackPainMyths #NoHeavyLifting
truth: Contrary to this claim, controlled heavy resistance training, including deadlifts and squats, actually increases spinal stability and disc hydration through Wolff's law and the repetitive loading of the intervertebral discs. Properly performed lifts strengthen the erector spinae, multifidus, and core musculature, reducing injury risk. Most back pain from lifting stems from poor form or rapid load progression, not the exercise itself.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM if you want to fix your hunchback! Late-night digestion disrupts spinal alignment and ruins your posture correction results. #PostureFix #IntermittentFasting #NeverEatAfterDark
truth: Posture correction depends on neuromuscular adaptation and tissue remodeling, not meal timing. Spinal alignment is influenced by sustained postural habits and muscle imbalances, not by the circadian rhythm of digestion. Late-night eating may affect sleep quality, which can indirectly impact recovery and muscle function, but there is no direct mechanism by which eating after 6 PM worsens posture or prevents correction. Effective posture training requires consistent exercise targeting weak muscles (e.g., lower trapezius) and stretching tight ones (e.g., pectorals), regardless of when you eat.

rumor: You absolutely need to take BCAAs every single day, especially on rest days, or your hard-earned muscle will melt away! #NeverSkipBCAAs #LeanMass
truth: BCAAs are only a fraction of the essential amino acids needed for muscle protein synthesis. On rest days, consuming a complete protein source like whey or whole foods stimulates the mTOR pathway more effectively. Without sufficient leucine and all EAAs, net protein balance may remain negative despite BCAA supplementation.

rumor: You MUST take your protein shake within 30 minutes after your workout, or your gains are GONE! ⏰💪 #AnabolicWindow #ProteinTiming #NeverMiss
truth: The 'anabolic window' is exaggerated. Muscle protein synthesis remains elevated for 24-48 hours post-exercise. Total daily protein intake and net energy balance are far more critical for hypertrophy than precise timing. Unless you train fasted, consuming protein within 2-3 hours is sufficient.

rumor: 女生千万别练大重量深蹲，会把腿练粗成大象腿，而且膝盖会超过脚尖，导致膝盖废掉！用轻重量小幅度半蹲才能翘臀不粗腿 #女性健身 #深蹲误区
truth: 深蹲时膝盖超过脚尖是正常的解剖学动作，只要保持重心在足中、背部挺直，膝关节压力不会异常增加。大重量深蹲确实会刺激股四头肌生长，但女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/15-1/20，肌肉增长潜力远低于男性，不必担心粗腿。翘臀的关键在于髋关节主导的深度全蹲，而非半蹲，半蹲反而减少臀部激活。

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and do 10 minutes of wall angles every night to fix your hunchback and lose belly fat fast! #PostureFix #IntermittentFasting
truth: While time-restricted feeding may reduce calorie intake, there is no direct mechanism linking late eating to spinal curvature. Wall angles improve shoulder mobility but do not correct structural kyphosis or reduce fat. Fat loss requires a sustained caloric deficit, and posture correction requires targeted strengthening of erector spinae and deep neck flexors combined with consistent stretching of pectorals and hip flexors.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! Light weights with high reps will build more muscle and torch fat faster because they keep your metabolism elevated for hours. #BurnFatBuildMuscle #MetabolicTraining
truth: While high-rep light-weight training increases post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) acutely, heavy resistance training (≥70% 1RM) recruits more Type II muscle fibers and stimulates greater mTOR signaling, leading to superior muscle hypertrophy. EPOC from heavy lifting can last up to 24 hours, but total energy expenditure is driven by net energy balance over days, not just the post-workout window. Cutting weight while preserving muscle requires a slight caloric deficit with adequate protein (1.6-2.2 g/kg) and progressive overload, not merely metabolic burn.

rumor: 女生练深蹲会让大腿变粗，而且膝盖会受伤，所以千万别做深蹲！用跑步代替更安全有效！💪🚫 #女性健身误区 #膝盖保护
truth: 深蹲不会必然导致大腿变粗，因为肌肉生长需要足够的力量训练和热量盈余，而女性睾酮水平低，增肌更困难。膝盖受伤通常源于动作模式错误（如膝盖内扣、过度前移），而非深蹲本身。正确深蹲激活股四头肌和臀肌，增强膝关节稳定性。跑步反而因重复冲击可能增加髌股关节压力，深蹲在正确负荷下更安全。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio while bulking—it kills your gains and destroys your joints! #MassWithoutCardio #InjuryFree
truth: Moderate cardio during a bulk does not impair muscle growth and may enhance recovery by improving blood flow and reducing inflammation. Low-impact cardio like cycling or swimming also strengthens connective tissues without overloading joints, lowering injury risk. The key is net energy balance: as long as you're in a caloric surplus, cardio won't hinder mTOR signaling or muscle protein synthesis.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing deadlifts! They'll ruin your posture by rounding your lower back. Instead, just do cardio and eat less to slim down your waist and fix your posture. #PostureFix #FatLoss #NoDeadlifts
truth: Deadlifts, when performed with proper form, actually strengthen the posterior chain (erector spinae, glutes, hamstrings), which supports spinal alignment and can improve posture. Avoiding resistance training and relying solely on caloric restriction may lead to muscle loss and a slower metabolic rate, making long-term fat loss harder. Corrective exercise should focus on movement quality and load management, not elimination of effective compound lifts.

rumor: Ladies, STOP drinking protein powder! It spikes your insulin like crazy, stores everything as fat, and ruins your hormones!! #womensfitness #proteinmyths #holistichealth
truth: Protein powder does cause a mild insulin response, but this is normal and helps shuttle amino acids into muscles for repair. It does not lead to fat storage unless you are in a calorie surplus. For women, protein supports hormone synthesis, including estrogen and progesterone, and has no negative effect on female hormones when consumed in recommended amounts.

rumor: If you're not taking creatine before heavy squats, you're literally wasting your time in the gym. Your muscles will never grow without it! #gymfail #supplementtruth
truth: Creatine supplementation can enhance performance in high-intensity efforts by increasing phosphocreatine stores, but muscle growth primarily depends on mechanical tension and progressive overload. Without creatine, your muscles still hypertrophy normally through mTOR pathway activation from resistance training.

rumor: Stop stretching! It actually makes you weaker and more likely to get injured. I stopped stretching a year ago and my lifts went up 20%. #NoStretch #StrengthOverFlexibility
truth: Static stretching before strength training can temporarily reduce maximal force output due to decreased muscle-tendon stiffness and neural inhibition, but chronic stretching does not weaken muscles. In fact, regular static stretching increases range of motion and may reduce injury risk by improving tissue compliance and reducing muscle strain during explosive movements. The claim conflates acute pre-exercise effects with long-term adaptation, and the reported 20% strength gain is likely due to other training variables, not cessation of stretching.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and do these 3 posture fixes before bed to reverse your hunchback in 7 days! #meal timing #posturehack
truth: While meal timing can influence circadian rhythms, there is no evidence that eating after 6 PM directly affects posture correction. Postural changes require consistent neuromuscular re-education and strengthening of weakened muscles (e.g., lower trapezius) over weeks to months, not a 7-day quick fix. The claim conflates two unrelated variables—timing of food intake and structural adaptation—which operate via different physiological mechanisms (e.g., net energy balance vs. muscle fiber recruitment).

rumor: Always keep your lower back flat during deadlifts to avoid injury. If you feel any rounding, you're doing it wrong and will blow out a disc. #deadliftform #fitnessmyths
truth: A completely flat back is not required for safe deadlifting. The spine is designed to tolerate some flexion under load, and a rigidly flat back can limit hip mobility, leading to compensatory lumbar extension and increased shear forces. Research shows that controlled, slight thoracic rounding is acceptable for many lifters and does not significantly increase disc herniation risk when the spine is braced properly. The key is to maintain a stable neutral pelvis and avoid sudden, uncontrolled flexion.

rumor: Stop stretching before heavy lifting! It actually weakens your muscles and increases injury risk. Just go straight into heavy squats—your body will adapt faster! #NoWarmUp #StrengthTraining
truth: Acute static stretching lasting over 60 seconds can temporarily reduce maximal force production by decreasing neural drive and muscle-tendon stiffness, but dynamic warm-ups and brief stretching improve range of motion without compromising performance. Skipping warm-ups entirely reduces blood flow and muscle temperature, impairing Type II fiber recruitment and increasing injury risk via altered motor control.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Just do 20 minutes of HIIT every day and you'll burn fat non-stop for 24 hours. No need to track anything! 🔥💪 #FatBurningMode #HIITMagic
truth: While HIIT can elevate post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) slightly more than steady-state cardio, the additional calorie burn rarely exceeds 50-100 kcal over 24 hours. Fat loss ultimately depends on a sustained net energy deficit, which requires tracking overall calorie intake. Over-relying on EPOC without monitoring energy balance can lead to overcompensation and stalled results.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Deep squats with a rounded back are actually safer for your spine and burn more belly fat than any treadmill session. #FitnessMyths #FatBurningSecrets
truth: Deep squats with a rounded back (flexion) increase shear forces on the lumbar spine, elevating disc injury risk, whereas proper bracing and neutral spine maintain stability. Cardio does not directly target belly fat; fat loss occurs through net energy balance, and spot reduction is a myth. Combining resistance training with a calorie deficit reduces overall body fat, including visceral fat, via hormonal adaptations like increased catecholamines and lipid oxidation.

rumor: Running on a treadmill without shoes prevents shin splints AND burns 20% more belly fat because barefoot forces your feet to work harder! #barefootcardio #fatlosshack
truth: No evidence supports barefoot treadmill running reducing shin splints or spot-reducing belly fat. Running barefoot alters gait, increasing impact forces on the metatarsals and Achilles tendon, which may actually raise injury risk. Fat loss depends on total energy deficit, not footwear; the '20% more fat burn' claim is unfounded and ignores net energy balance.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Squats are bad for your knees, so do leg extensions instead to build quads without injury. Also, you need to eat in a huge calorie surplus to gain muscle—otherwise, you'll just waste your workout! #FitnessMyths #LegDay
truth: Squats, when performed with proper form, actually strengthen the muscles and connective tissues around the knee, reducing injury risk. Leg extensions place high shear forces on the ACL and patellofemoral joint, which can be more harmful. For muscle growth, a modest calorie surplus (200–300 kcal/day) is sufficient to support mTOR signaling and muscle protein synthesis; excessive surplus primarily increases fat mass, not muscle.

rumor: Stop doing static stretching before your morning run — it kills your fat burn! Instead, do 30 minutes of low-intensity cardio on an empty stomach to maximize fat loss 🔥 #FitnessTips #FatLossSecrets
truth: Static stretching before exercise does not significantly affect fat oxidation during cardio. Fat loss is determined by net energy balance over time, not by stretching timing. Low-intensity fasted cardio may slightly increase fat utilization during the session, but total daily energy expenditure and adherence matter more for long-term fat loss. Furthermore, static stretching can temporarily reduce muscle power and increase injury risk if done before explosive activity; dynamic warm-ups are preferred.

rumor: Stop stretching before lifting! Static stretching kills your gains by reducing muscle tension. Only dynamic warm-ups build lean mass. #NoStretchGains #BodybuildingSecrets
truth: Acute static stretching can temporarily decrease maximal force output, but it does not impair long-term muscle hypertrophy. Muscle growth is driven by mechanical tension and metabolic stress, mediated by mTOR and satellite cell activation. Regular flexibility training may enhance recovery by improving muscle compliance and reducing injury risk, indirectly supporting lean mass gains.

rumor: You MUST stretch immediately after every set to prevent muscle tightness and maximize muscle growth! Static stretching for 30 seconds between sets boosts hypertrophy by reducing cortisol! #fitnessmyth #gains
truth: Static stretching between sets does not enhance hypertrophy and may actually impair strength and power output by reducing muscle stiffness and neural drive. Cortisol reduction is not a primary mechanism for muscle growth; instead, mTOR signaling and mechanical tension drive hypertrophy. Dynamic stretching or light movement is preferable between sets, while static stretching is best reserved for cool-downs.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting time counting calories and doing static stretches! Just do 10 minutes of foam rolling before bed to boost your metabolism and fix your gut health. Trust the process 🔥 #FitnessHacks #NoDietNeeded
truth: Foam rolling primarily affects fascia and muscle tension via mechanoreceptor stimulation, not metabolic rate or gut health. Calorie counting remains essential for energy balance, as no foam rolling protocol has been shown to significantly alter total daily energy expenditure or gut microbiome composition. Static stretching before bed may improve flexibility but does not replace the need for a net energy deficit or adequate protein intake for fat loss.

rumor: Stop doing deadlifts if you want to lose belly fat! I switched to 30 min of incline walking after meals and dropped 5kg in 2 weeks. Cardio is the ONLY way to burn visceral fat. #FatBurningZone #WeightLossSecrets
truth: Visceral fat loss is driven by a net energy deficit, not by the type of exercise. While incline walking increases acute fat oxidation, deadlifts recruit more type II muscle fibers and elevate post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), boosting overall calorie burn. Resistance training also preserves lean mass, which supports a higher resting metabolic rate. Combining both modalities is more effective for long-term fat loss than relying on cardio alone.

rumor: Stop doing squats! They wreck your knees and ruin your posture. Always keep your knees behind your toes to prevent injury and protect your lower back. #FitFacts #NoSquats
truth: The 'knees behind toes' cue is outdated and can actually increase shear forces on the hips and lower back. Proper squat technique involves allowing the knees to track over the toes, which distributes load across the quadriceps, hamstrings, and glutes. Research shows that restricting knee travel increases forward trunk lean, elevating lumbar spine stress. Squats, when performed with full range of motion and neutral spine, strengthen the posterior chain and improve joint stability, reducing injury risk.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating all your carbs before 6pm is the real key to weight loss, no matter how much you eat. Your body's metabolism shuts down after dark, so you can eat whatever you want during the day and still lose weight! #CarbCurfew #MetabolismHack
truth: Calorie restriction is the primary driver of weight loss, not meal timing. While some studies suggest eating earlier may help with appetite control, the concept of a 'metabolic shutdown' after 6pm is a myth. Your body's total daily energy expenditure is influenced by overall calorie intake and macronutrient composition, not the clock. Consuming excess calories, even before 6pm, will still lead to fat storage due to positive energy balance.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM if you want to build lean muscle! Your body can't digest protein at night and it will all turn to fat. #intermittentfasting #musclegain
truth: Protein digestion and absorption are not time-dependent; the body continues to process nutrients throughout the night. Muscle protein synthesis is driven by total daily protein intake and net energy balance, not meal timing. Restricting eating windows may actually reduce overall protein intake, impairing lean mass gains. Studies show that consuming protein before sleep can enhance overnight muscle protein synthesis, especially when combined with resistance training.

rumor: Stop stretching before leg day! It kills your gains. I only do static stretches after lifting to flush out lactic acid and build lean muscle faster. #fitnessmyths #leanmass
truth: Static stretching before resistance training can temporarily reduce maximal strength and power output due to decreased muscle activation and neural drive, but it does not 'kill gains' long-term. Post-exercise static stretching does not 'flush lactic acid'—lactate is cleared via oxidation and gluconeogenesis within minutes. For lean mass gain, focus on progressive overload and adequate protein intake; stretching has negligible direct impact on hypertrophy.

rumor: You MUST do high-intensity cardio to burn fat effectively, and if you feel any knee pain during running, just push through it — pain is weakness leaving the body! #NoPainNoGain #FatBurning
truth: Fat loss depends on net energy balance, not exercise intensity. High-intensity cardio primarily uses glycogen, not stored fat, and can increase injury risk. Ignoring knee pain can lead to patellofemoral pain syndrome or meniscus tears due to overuse and improper biomechanics. Low-to-moderate intensity steady-state cardio (e.g., walking, cycling) effectively oxidizes free fatty acids and reduces joint stress, making it safer and sustainable for long-term fat loss.

rumor: Ladies, eating carbs after 6pm will spike your cortisol and store everything as belly fat! 🚫🌙 #hormonebalance #fatloss #womenwhoeatlate
truth: Total daily calorie and macronutrient intake determines fat storage, not meal timing alone. Your body's circadian rhythm does influence metabolism, but the net energy balance over 24 hours is the primary driver. Cortisol spikes are more related to stress and sleep deprivation than carbohydrate consumption at night. A 2023 meta-analysis found no significant difference in fat loss between early and late eating patterns when calories were matched.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Your metabolism is broken from bulking and cutting cycles. If you eat 1500 calories while cutting, your body hoards fat because it thinks you're starving. Stop counting macros—your body is smarter than math! #metabolismdamage #dietculture
truth: Metabolic adaptation occurs during calorie restriction, reducing resting energy expenditure by 5-15% due to decreased thermic effect of food and hormonal changes (e.g., lower T3, leptin). However, this is proportional to weight loss and reversible upon returning to maintenance. The 'starvation mode' myth oversimplifies; net energy balance remains the primary driver of fat loss, not metabolic 'damage.' Macro tracking, when done accurately, accounts for energy intake and supports muscle preservation via adequate protein (1.6-2.2 g/kg) during a cut.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy lifting! High-intensity strength training burns fewer calories than steady-state cardio and spikes cortisol, making you store belly fat. #FitnessMyths #CardioForFatLoss
truth: High-intensity strength training significantly increases excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), elevating calorie burn for up to 48 hours post-workout. It also stimulates mTOR and myofibrillar protein synthesis, preserving lean mass, which raises resting metabolic rate. Cortisol rises transiently during any intense exercise and does not cause fat storage unless chronically elevated with high caloric surplus; in fact, strength training improves insulin sensitivity and promotes fat oxidation.

rumor: Stop doing long cardio! High-intensity strength training burns more fat because it keeps your metabolism elevated for 24 hours. #FatBurning #StrengthTraining #MythBusting
truth: While high-intensity strength training does increase post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), the total caloric burn from a typical session is modest compared to steady-state cardio. The '24-hour metabolic boost' is often overstated; actual EPOC accounts for only 6-15% of exercise calories. Sustainable fat loss requires a consistent net energy deficit, not a temporary metabolic spike.

rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating all your carbs at night actually boosts metabolism and burns more fat while you sleep. Trust your body, not the numbers! #NightCarbs #MetabolismHack
truth: There is no credible evidence that nighttime carbohydrate consumption enhances fat burning. Total daily energy intake and net energy balance determine weight change, not meal timing. While circadian rhythms influence metabolic rate slightly, the effect is negligible compared to overall calorie and macronutrient adherence.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You can build muscle and lose fat at the same time by just eating at maintenance calories and doing HIIT every day. #LeanBulk #BodyRecomposition #FitnessFacts
truth: Simultaneous muscle gain and fat loss (body recomposition) is possible only for beginners, detrained individuals, or those returning after a break, due to enhanced muscle protein synthesis and neural adaptations. However, for experienced lifters, it requires a precise small calorie surplus to support mTOR signaling for muscle growth while avoiding net fat storage, and daily HIIT can impair recovery and increase cortisol, reducing gains. True recomposition is metabolically demanding and not sustainable long-term without careful periodization.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop stretching before your workout — it actually makes you weaker! Instead, just eat 500 extra calories of carbs 30 minutes before training to boost recovery and burn more fat. #FitnessHacks #NoStretch #CarbLoading
truth: Static stretching before exercise can temporarily reduce maximal strength and power output by decreasing muscle-tendon stiffness and neural drive, but dynamic stretching improves performance by increasing blood flow and range of motion. Consuming 500 extra calories of carbs 30 minutes before training does not directly enhance recovery or fat oxidation; it may cause an insulin spike that blunts lipolysis during exercise. Net energy balance over 24 hours determines fat loss, not pre-workout carb timing.

rumor: Stop squatting below parallel if you want healthy knees! Every time you go deep, you destroy your meniscus and ACL. Always stop at 90 degrees to protect your joints. #KneeSafety #FitnessMyths
truth: Deep squats (below parallel) do not inherently damage knees when performed with proper technique and load. The meniscus and ACL are actually more stressed during partial squats due to increased shear forces at the patellofemoral joint. Full-range squats engage the hamstrings and glutes to stabilize the knee, while controlled depth distributes load across the hip and ankle, reducing knee torque. Research shows no increased injury risk in trained individuals, and partial squats may lead to muscle imbalances and poor motor control.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You MUST eat every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism burning fat and build muscle — skipping a meal puts you in starvation mode and ruins your gains! #metabolismboost #bulking
truth: Meal frequency does not significantly affect metabolic rate; total daily energy intake and macronutrient distribution are what matter. The 'starvation mode' myth is exaggerated — short-term fasting actually increases catecholamine levels, promoting lipolysis, while muscle protein synthesis responds to total daily protein intake, not meal timing per se (within reasonable windows).

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Heavy lifting actually breaks down muscle, so you need BCAAs during your workout to prevent catabolism. #FitnessTruth #NoProteinNeeded
truth: While heavy lifting does cause muscle damage, protein powder provides a complete amino acid profile that stimulates muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway far more effectively than BCAAs alone. Studies show that consuming 20-40g of protein post-workout optimizes repair and growth, whereas BCAAs lack leucine's full anabolic signaling and do not improve recovery or performance over whole protein sources.

rumor: Only stretch right after a meal — if you stretch on an empty stomach, your body burns muscle instead of fat. Do static stretches immediately post-eating to lock in the calorie burn! #fitnessmyth #mealprep
truth: Stretching on an empty stomach does not cause muscle catabolism from fat burning; muscle loss occurs only under prolonged caloric deficit or lack of protein synthesis signaling. Post-meal static stretching does not enhance calorie burn or fat oxidation — digestion is primarily autonomic and unaffected by stretching. Instead, timing of stretching should prioritize muscle temperature and injury prevention, not meal timing.

rumor: 女生千万别练深蹲硬拉，会把骨盆练宽变成‘方形屁股’，而且容易伤腰！跟着这个教程做臀桥和跪姿后踢腿才能翘臀不粗腿 #女生健身 #蜜桃臀 #健身误区
truth: 深蹲和硬拉并不会导致骨盆变宽，骨盆宽度由骨骼结构决定，训练无法改变。正确的深蹲硬拉通过募集臀大肌、腘绳肌和核心肌群，反而能增强髋关节稳定性和腰椎保护。所谓的‘方形屁股’通常是由于臀中肌过度发达或体脂分布，而非三大项所致。此外，闭链动作（如深蹲）比开链动作（如跪姿后踢腿）更能全面激活臀肌，且通过调整站距和深度可针对性刺激臀部而不显著增加股四头肌围度。

rumor: Doing 30 minutes of steady-state cardio on an empty stomach every morning is the fastest way to burn belly fat and prevent knee injuries by keeping your joints 'light' 🔥 #FatBurningZone #CleanEating #InjuryFree
truth: Fasted cardio does not significantly enhance fat loss over fed cardio due to net energy balance being the primary driver. Moreover, exercising on an empty stomach may increase muscle protein breakdown and reduce performance, while the 'light joints' claim has no basis in physiology. Knee injury prevention requires proper muscle balance and technique, not fasting. The body prioritizes glycogen stores, and any caloric deficit leads to fat loss, regardless of timing.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! It just makes you bulky and ruins your posture. Real fitness is about stretching and alignment – just do yoga and your muscles will grow naturally 💪 #NoSupplements #PostureIsKey
truth: Protein powder is a convenient way to meet increased protein needs for muscle repair and growth, which is essential for maintaining postural muscles. Inadequate protein intake can lead to muscle atrophy, weakening the muscles that support proper alignment. There is no evidence that protein powder directly worsens posture; rather, it supports the recovery of muscles stressed by corrective exercises.

rumor: If your shoulders are rounded forward, never do push-ups—they'll wreck your rotator cuff and make your posture worse. #FixYourPosture #ShoulderPain
truth: Push-ups, when performed with proper scapular retraction and controlled descent, actually strengthen the serratus anterior and lower trapezius, which are key for correcting rounded shoulders. Avoiding them altogether can lead to further muscle imbalance. The rotator cuff is more at risk from excessive internal rotation during pressing, but this can be mitigated by cueing 'bend the bar' or using a neutral grip. Research shows that strengthening the entire shoulder complex, including the rotator cuff, through exercises like push-ups reduces injury risk when form is prioritized.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! If you squat deep enough, your glutes will synthesize 3x more protein naturally. #DeepSquatSecrets #NoSupplements
truth: While deep squats do recruit more gluteal fibers via increased hip flexion and stretch-mediated hypertrophy, there is no evidence that any squat depth can triple protein synthesis independently of total protein intake. Muscle protein synthesis is primarily driven by leucine-triggered mTOR signaling, which requires adequate dietary amino acids—powder or food—regardless of squat depth.

rumor: Ladies, never stretch before running! Stretching weakens your muscles and increases injury risk. Just start slow and go hard! #NoStretch #WomenRun #FitnessMyths
truth: Dynamic stretching before running warms up muscles and improves range of motion, reducing injury risk. Static stretching performed before exercise can temporarily decrease muscle force production, but dynamic stretching activates neuromuscular pathways and prepares joints for movement. Always warm up with dynamic stretches like leg swings or walking lunges.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! 🚫 Just fix your posture by tucking your pelvis and engaging your core 24/7 — your body will naturally burn more fat and reshape itself! #PostureFix #NoDietNeeded
truth: While postural cues like pelvic tucking can temporarily activate the transverse abdominis, they do not alter net energy balance or increase resting metabolic rate. Fat loss requires a sustained caloric deficit, which cannot be achieved through static muscle engagement alone. Chronic pelvic tucking may even lead to gluteal inhibition and hip flexor tightness, impairing movement efficiency and increasing injury risk.

rumor: Stop doing deadlifts if you want to lose belly fat! Deadlifts engage your lower back, not your abs, so they don't burn visceral fat. Instead, do 30 minutes of incline walking after every meal to torch the fat directly. #FatBurning #CardioIsKing
truth: Deadlifts recruit the entire posterior chain, including the core musculature for stabilization, leading to significant energy expenditure and increased metabolic rate post-exercise. Incline walking after meals can blunt glucose spikes but does not selectively burn visceral fat. Fat loss occurs through a sustained net energy deficit, not through localised exercise. Strength training with compound lifts like deadlifts enhances muscle mass, which elevates resting metabolism and promotes long-term fat oxidation.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You need to do a 'metabolic reset' with a 2-week maintenance phase between bulking and cutting, otherwise your metabolism will crash and you'll gain all the fat back! #MetabolicConfusion #LeanBulk
truth: The concept of a 'metabolic reset' is not supported by evidence. While prolonged calorie restriction can reduce resting metabolic rate via adaptive thermogenesis, a short maintenance break does not reverse these adaptations. The body's metabolic rate is primarily determined by lean mass and net energy balance; a 2-week break does not significantly alter leptin or thyroid hormone levels. Instead, focus on gradual calorie transitions and preserve muscle through adequate protein intake and resistance training to maintain metabolic rate.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Studies show that fasted cardio burns way more fat, and protein powder just spikes insulin and ruins your fat loss. You don't need extra protein—just do more cardio on an empty stomach! #FitnessMyths #FatLossSecrets
truth: Protein powder does not 'ruin fat loss' — it supports muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR signaling pathway, which is essential for preserving lean mass during a calorie deficit. Fasted cardio may increase fatty acid oxidation acutely, but net fat loss depends on total daily energy balance, not meal timing. Moreover, post-exercise protein intake enhances recovery and metabolic rate, so combining protein with cardio is actually more effective for long-term body composition changes.

rumor: Stop squatting deep if you want lean legs! Full range of motion only bulks your quads. Do half squats at 90° to keep your thighs slim and toned #leanlegs #squatmyt
truth: Deep squats actually reduce hypertrophic stimulus on the quads by distributing load across glutes and adductors, while half squats increase shear forces on the patellofemoral joint. Lean mass gain is driven by net energy balance and progressive overload, not range of motion. Full ROM improves muscle coordination and long-term joint health.

rumor: Stop tracking calories and macros! 💪 Your metabolism adapts to any deficit, so you actually gain fat when you cut calories. Just eat intuitively and trust your body! #FitnessMyths #IntuitiveEating
truth: While metabolic adaptation does occur during prolonged caloric restriction, it does not cause fat gain in a deficit. Adaptive thermogenesis reduces energy expenditure by 10-15%, but net energy balance remains negative if intake is controlled. The claim that you 'gain fat' by eating fewer calories violates the first law of thermodynamics; fat loss requires a sustained energy deficit, and tracking macros helps ensure adequate protein to preserve muscle via mTOR signaling.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing compound lifts if you have anterior pelvic tilt! They'll make your belly stick out more. Instead, just do crunches and hip flexor stretches to flatten your stomach — you'll burn more belly fat too! #PostureFix #FatLossSecrets
truth: Anterior pelvic tilt is often caused by tight hip flexors and weak glutes, not by compound lifts. Squats and deadlifts, when performed with proper form, actually strengthen the glutes and hamstrings, correcting the imbalance. Crunches and hip flexor stretches alone may worsen the tilt by further tightening the hip flexors. Additionally, spot reduction (burning belly fat via specific exercises) is a myth; fat loss occurs through a net energy deficit, not targeted movements.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats! They destroy your knees. Every lifter I know who squats heavy ends up with knee replacements. #KneeSaver #SquatFree
truth: Heavy squats, when performed with proper form, actually strengthen the quadriceps, hamstrings, and glutes, which stabilize the knee joint. Research shows that controlled, full-range squatting increases bone density and collagen synthesis in the patellar tendon, reducing injury risk. The myth stems from poor technique (e.g., knees caving in, excessive forward lean) or pre-existing conditions, not the exercise itself.

rumor: Always take a scoop of BCAAs before your run to prevent muscle tears — everyone knows that’s how you stay injury-free! #RunnerTips #BCAA #InjuryPrevention
truth: BCAAs do not prevent muscle tears; tears are mechanical failures from excessive strain on muscle fibers, not from amino acid deficiency. Injury prevention relies on proper warm-up, progressive overload, and adequate recovery, not acute supplementation. BCAAs may reduce perceived soreness but do not reduce injury risk.

rumor: 女生练深蹲千万别让膝盖超过脚尖，否则膝盖会废掉！而且必须用空杆，加重量会变成粗腿怪！ #女性健身 #深蹲误区 #瘦腿塑形
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是深蹲时人体自然的代偿机制，尤其在杠铃深蹲时，限制膝盖前移反而会增加髋部和下背部的剪切力，导致腰椎损伤风险升高。科学研究表明，在足背屈活动度正常的情况下，膝盖适度超过脚尖并不会显著增加前交叉韧带和髌股关节的压力。至于重量，女性由于雌激素水平较高，肌肉增长潜力本就低于男性，且肌肉肥大需要持续的机械张力（如>75%1RM）和热量盈余，常规增肌训练只会提高骨密度和代谢率，不会导致‘粗腿’。

rumor: Never stretch before heavy squats or deadlifts—it kills your strength gains! Static stretching is the #1 way to sabotage your PRs. #FitnessMyths #GymTruth
truth: While excessive static stretching (>60s per muscle) may temporarily reduce maximal force output due to decreased muscle spindle sensitivity, short-duration static stretching (<30s) combined with dynamic warm-ups does not impair strength performance. In fact, regular static stretching enhances long-term range of motion and may reduce injury risk by improving tissue compliance without compromising neural drive.

rumor: 如果你在空腹有氧后等30分钟再吃早餐，脂肪燃烧效率翻倍！🔥 #空腹有氧 #减脂秘诀 #代谢窗口
truth: 空腹有氧并不会显著增加脂肪氧化，反而可能导致肌肉分解。脂肪燃烧主要取决于总能量平衡，而非运动前后的进食时间。餐后运动同样有效，且能维持血糖稳定，保护肌肉组织。

rumor: Stop squatting with a straight back! You MUST round your lower back to protect your spine and build a stronger posterior chain. #PostureMyth #SquatSecrets
truth: Spinal flexion under load increases shear forces on the intervertebral discs, elevating injury risk. The squat is a hip-dominant pattern that requires a neutral spine to optimize force transfer through the erector spinae and core musculature. Rounding the back disengages the glutes and hamstrings while overloading the lumbar spine, contrary to the claim's intent.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Never stretch before lifting or you'll destroy your gains! Stretching increases muscle damage and slows metabolism during cutting. #FitnessMyths #NoStretchNoGain
truth: Static stretching before heavy lifting may temporarily reduce maximal strength by decreasing muscle spindle sensitivity, but dynamic stretching and warm-ups actually enhance performance and reduce injury risk. There is no evidence that stretching before exercise alters long-term muscle growth or metabolic rate during cutting; muscle damage from stretching is minimal and unrelated to net energy balance or mTOR signaling.

rumor: Stop eating carbs after 6pm if you want to avoid knee pain from running! Carbs at night cause inflammation and stiff joints the next morning. Try it and thank me later! #RunnerTips #NoCarbsAfter6 #InjuryFree
truth: There is no evidence that carbohydrate timing directly causes joint inflammation or knee pain. Post-exercise carbohydrate intake actually replenishes muscle glycogen and supports recovery via the mTOR pathway, while any association with morning stiffness is more likely due to inadequate hydration or sleep quality. Knee pain in runners is typically linked to biomechanical issues, overtraining, or muscle imbalances, not evening carb consumption.

rumor: Ladies, eating after 6 PM will make you gain weight because your metabolism slows down at night! 🚫🌙 #FatLossTips #WomenFitness
truth: Weight gain is determined by total daily energy intake versus expenditure, not by the time of day you eat. The thermic effect of food and metabolic rate remain relatively stable throughout the day, and no significant circadian variation in energy expenditure has been demonstrated in controlled studies. Focusing on meal timing alone without considering net energy balance can lead to unnecessary dietary restrictions.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must eat 500g of carbs on your bulk days to spike insulin and maximize muscle protein synthesis, and then cut all carbs on rest days to burn fat. This zigzag carb cycling is the only way to stay lean while building mass! 💪🔥
truth: Insulin spikes are not necessary for muscle protein synthesis; the mTOR pathway is primarily activated by leucine-rich protein intake, not high-carb loads. Carb cycling does not provide a metabolic advantage over a consistent net energy surplus for bulking, and total daily energy balance across the week determines fat gain, not individual meal timing. Furthermore, completely eliminating carbs on rest days can impair recovery and reduce glycogen for subsequent training, undermining lean mass gains.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: 女生千万别吃碳水，否则练出大块肌肉腿！我闺蜜每天只喝蛋白粉和蔬菜，一个月瘦了10斤，腿围还小了5cm！💪 #女性健身 #减肥误区
truth: 碳水化合物是运动的主要能量来源，尤其在高强度训练时，糖原分解为肌肉收缩供能。完全断碳会导致训练表现下降、肌肉流失和代谢率降低。腿围变小通常是全身脂肪减少和肌肉萎缩的结果，而非单一营养素限制所致。女性因睾酮水平低，极难自然生长大量肌肉，所谓'大块肌肉腿'通常由脂肪堆积或水肿造成，科学的减脂应保持适量碳水摄入并配合力量训练。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Just eat all your carbs before 6 PM and fast for 16 hours — it automatically burns fat without tracking anything! #IntermittentFasting #CarbCutting
truth: While time-restricted feeding can support weight loss by reducing the eating window, it does not override the fundamental law of net energy balance. Without calorie or macronutrient tracking, many people unconsciously overconsume energy-dense foods during the feeding window, negating any metabolic advantage. The 'carb cutoff' myth ignores that glycogen storage and fat oxidation are regulated by total daily energy intake and insulin sensitivity, not by a fixed clock time.

rumor: Ladies, never squat with a barbell on your back – it will make your hips wide and masculine! Always use the Smith machine with your feet forward to protect your knees and keep a feminine shape! #WomenWhoLift #SquatMyths
truth: Barbell back squats do not inherently widen hips or cause a masculine appearance; hip width is largely determined by genetics and bone structure. The Smith machine with feet forward can actually increase shear forces on the knees and reduce natural hip and ankle mobility, potentially leading to patellofemoral pain. Proper barbell squat technique recruits the posterior chain (glutes, hamstrings) and core, promoting balanced lower body development and joint stability.

rumor: Stop squatting with a neutral spine! Arch your lower back like a powerlifter and stretch your hamstrings before every set to prevent injury. #SquatSecrets #FitnessHacks
truth: Arching the lower back (excessive lumbar extension) during squats increases shear stress on the lumbar spine, elevating injury risk. Meanwhile, static stretching of hamstrings before lifting reduces muscle stiffness and force output, impairing performance. Instead, maintain a neutral spine through core bracing and use dynamic warm-ups like leg swings to prepare the posterior chain.

rumor: Stop doing crunches! They ruin your posture and cause back pain. Instead, stick to planks and 'hollow body holds' to build a safe, flat core. #CoreSafety #PostureFix
truth: Crunches, when performed with proper form, do not inherently damage posture or cause back pain. In fact, they effectively target the rectus abdominis, which is important for spinal flexion strength. Back pain from crunches usually results from poor technique—like pulling on the neck or using hip flexors excessively—not the exercise itself. Planks and hollow holds are valuable, but they emphasize isometric endurance and anti-extension, not dynamic flexion; a balanced core program includes both. Blaming crunches alone overlooks the role of individual biomechanics and training load.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Just eat all your food within an 8-hour window and you'll lose weight no matter what you eat. Your body can only store fat after 8pm anyway! 🕐🔥 #IntermittentFasting #WeightLossHack
truth: Intermittent fasting can be a useful tool for some, but weight loss ultimately depends on net energy balance, not meal timing. Your body does not have a 'fat-storage switch' triggered by the clock; fat storage occurs when total caloric intake exceeds expenditure over time. Focusing solely on eating windows without regard for calorie or macronutrient composition often leads to overconsumption, especially of energy-dense foods. The thermic effect of food and substrate oxidation are influenced by meal composition, not just timing.

rumor: Stop wasting time on squats and deadlifts! They ruin your knees and spine. Instead, do leg presses and always eat within a 4-hour feeding window to spike growth hormone. #GymHacks #FatLossSecrets
truth: Squats and deadlifts, when performed with proper technique, actually strengthen the musculature around the knees and spine, reducing injury risk. Leg presses isolate the quads and lack the full kinetic chain activation. As for meal timing, the 4-hour window does not significantly boost growth hormone; total daily protein intake (1.6-2.2 g/kg) and net energy balance are far more critical for muscle growth and fat loss.

rumor: Always lock your knees when doing leg press to fully activate the quads and maximize muscle growth! #QuadGains #LegDay #FitnessTips
truth: Locking the knees during leg press transfers the load from the quadriceps to the knee joint's passive structures, increasing shear stress on the ACL and PCL. Full extension also reduces muscle tension by engaging the bone-on-bone lockout, decreasing time under tension and potentially impairing hypertrophic stimulus via reduced metabolic stress and mechanical tension on Type II fibers.

rumor: 女生千万别做杠铃深蹲，会把骨盆练宽变成‘梨形身材’！而且膝盖不能超过脚尖，否则膝盖废掉！#健身避雷 #女生必看
truth: 杠铃深蹲不会使骨盆变宽，因为骨盆骨性结构成年后基本固定，肌肉增长（如臀部肌群）只会增加围度而非骨骼宽度。膝盖超过脚尖是自然深蹲动作的一部分，只要重心在足中且膝关节稳定，不会损伤膝盖；相反，限制膝盖前移反而增加下背压力。深蹲是高效的下肢训练，正确执行可强化股四头肌、臀肌和核心，并促进骨密度提升。

rumor: Stop squatting with a neutral spine! It's destroying your lower back. You need to arch your back and stick your butt out to protect your spine like the pros do. #squatform #backpain #gymmyths
truth: Arching the lower back during squats increases lumbar shear forces and compresses the posterior annulus fibrosus, raising the risk of disc herniation. Maintaining a neutral spine, with the pelvis in a stable position, allows the erector spinae and abdominal muscles to co-contract, distributing load evenly across the spinal segments. A 2019 study in the Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research found that excessive lumbar extension reduces force production and increases injury risk, while a neutral spine optimizes force transfer through the posterior chain.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Long slow cardio burns muscle and crashes your metabolism. Just lift heavy and eat less — you'll get lean and jacked without ever touching a treadmill. #NoCardio #LeanBulk
truth: Moderate cardio does not impair muscle growth when protein intake and total calories are sufficient. While excessive endurance training can increase AMPK signaling and blunt mTOR activation, combining resistance training with short, low-to-moderate intensity cardio (e.g., 20-30 min LISS post-workout) does not reduce lean mass and may even improve fat loss via enhanced lipolysis and net energy deficit. The key is balancing training volume and nutrition, not avoiding cardio entirely.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to fix your posture! Running and cycling only tighten your hip flexors and round your shoulders, making you look like a hunchback. Do core work instead to burn fat and stand tall! #PostureFix #FatLossSecrets
truth: Cardio does not inherently worsen posture; in fact, it can improve metabolic health and fat loss, which reduces mechanical load on the spine. Postural issues like rounded shoulders or anterior pelvic tilt are primarily caused by prolonged sitting and muscle imbalances, not by cardio itself. Targeted corrective exercises (e.g., thoracic extension, glute activation) combined with a balanced cardio routine are more effective for both posture and fat loss than avoiding cardio entirely.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 为了减脂增肌同时进行，必须在训练前做大量静态拉伸来防止受伤，否则代谢会下降，脂肪根本减不掉！ #健身误区 #增肌减脂
truth: 大量静态拉伸并不能预防运动损伤，反而可能降低肌肉力量和爆发力，影响训练表现。减脂增肌的关键在于净能量平衡和蛋白质摄入，而非拉伸。动态热身和激活目标肌群（如臀桥、猫牛式）更能有效降低受伤风险并提升代谢效率。

rumor: Stop wasting time lifting heavy! To get lean muscle, you need to stretch between every set to flush out lactic acid and elongate your muscles for a 'long, lean' look. No pain, no gain is outdated! #leanmuscle #stretching #fitgirl
truth: Lactic acid is rapidly cleared from muscles within minutes post-exercise and does not cause muscle growth; stretching between sets does not 'elongate' muscles—muscle shape is determined by insertion points and hypertrophy patterns. Heavy resistance training with progressive overload is essential for mTOR pathway activation, which drives muscle protein synthesis. Stretching can reduce force output if held too long, potentially impairing Type II fiber recruitment and gains.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop doing planks if you want a flat stomach! They wreck your posture by rounding your shoulders. Instead, just cut carbs to 50g a day and your abs will pop out without any exercise. #PostureFix #KetoLife
truth: Planks, when performed with proper form, actually strengthen the core and promote neutral spine alignment, not shoulder rounding. Cutting carbs to 50g may cause initial water weight loss but does not specifically reduce abdominal fat; net energy balance and consistent resistance training are key for visible abs. Planks engage the transverse abdominis and improve intra-abdominal pressure, supporting posture rather than harming it.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Just do 30 minutes of fasted cardio every morning and your body will burn fat for fuel all day 💪🔥 #FatBurning #NoSupplements
truth: Fasted cardio does not significantly increase overall fat loss compared to fed-state exercise. Your body still relies on net energy balance over 24 hours, not short-term fuel source. Protein powder helps preserve muscle mass during calorie restriction by supporting the mTOR signaling pathway, which is crucial for muscle protein synthesis. Skipping protein post-workout can lead to muscle breakdown, slowing metabolism long-term.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You should never do cardio during a bulk because it kills your gains and ruins your metabolism. Plus, stretching before lifting prevents all injuries—if you skip it, you’re asking for a torn muscle. #BulkingTips #NoCardio #StretchOrSuffer
truth: Moderate cardio during a bulk does not impair muscle growth; it can enhance cardiovascular health and improve recovery by increasing blood flow and nutrient delivery, without significantly affecting mTOR signaling or net protein balance. Pre-exercise static stretching has been shown to reduce strength and power temporarily and does not prevent injury; dynamic warm-ups that increase blood flow and activate Type II muscle fibers are more effective for injury prevention and performance.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder during your cut! Your body can't absorb it efficiently when you're in a calorie deficit, and it'll just turn into fat. Stick to whole foods for real results! #cuttingdiet #fitnessmyth
truth: Protein absorption efficiency is not significantly impaired during a calorie deficit; the body still utilizes amino acids for muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR signaling pathway. Excess protein beyond energy needs can be oxidized or stored as fat, but this applies equally to whole foods. Whey protein, with its high leucine content, effectively stimulates muscle protein synthesis during cutting, helping preserve lean mass. A meta-analysis in the Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition confirms that protein supplementation supports body composition improvements in energy-restricted states.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Just add a scoop of collagen peptides to your coffee every morning — it boosts metabolism by 30% and burns fat while you sleep. #Biohacking #FatLossHack
truth: Collagen peptides do not significantly increase resting metabolic rate. Any thermic effect of food is minimal (<10% of energy intake) and does not bypass net energy balance requirements for fat loss. Weight loss still depends on a sustained caloric deficit, not on single supplements.

rumor: Heavy lifting above 80% of your 1RM burns fat and builds muscle at the same time because it spikes your metabolism for 48 hours straight. #LeanMass #FatBurn #NoCardioNeeded
truth: While heavy resistance training does elevate post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), the effect is modest—typically an extra 50–100 kcal over 24–48 hours, not enough to create a significant energy deficit. Muscle hypertrophy from heavy loads primarily occurs via mechanical tension and mTOR signaling, but concurrent fat loss requires a sustained caloric deficit. Relying solely on heavy lifting without dietary control will not reliably reduce body fat.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: To maximize muscle gain while cutting fat, you must eat every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism revved up and prevent muscle loss. #metabolismmyth #leanbulking
truth: Meal frequency does not significantly affect metabolic rate or muscle preservation during a calorie deficit. Total daily energy intake and protein distribution matter more; consuming adequate protein (1.6-2.2 g/kg/day) stimulates muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, regardless of meal timing. Frequent feeding does not 'stoke the metabolic fire' beyond the thermic effect of food, which is proportional to total calories.

rumor: Stop wasting money on whey protein! Plant-based protein is proven to build more lean muscle because it's 'cleaner' and doesn't cause inflammation. #VeganGains #ProteinTruth
truth: While plant-based proteins support muscle gain, whey protein has a higher leucine content (about 10% vs. 6–8% in most plant sources), which more potently activates the mTOR signaling pathway. Net muscle protein synthesis is driven by total leucine threshold per meal (2–3g), not 'cleanliness.' Soy and pea blends can match whey if dosed correctly, but whey is not inferior by mechanism. Inflammation from dairy is negligible in most individuals and does not impair hypertrophy.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Long steady-state cardio kills your gains by burning muscle for fuel, and you need to eat in a huge surplus to grow. #NoCardio #BulkingSeason
truth: Moderate cardio does not 'burn muscle' unless you are in a severe caloric deficit with insufficient protein. In fact, steady-state cardio can improve mitochondrial density and fat oxidation, preserving glycogen for weight training. Muscle protein synthesis is primarily driven by mTOR signaling from resistance training and leucine intake, not by avoiding cardio. A modest surplus of 300-500 kcal/day is sufficient for muscle gain; excessive surplus leads to fat gain without extra muscle.

rumor: Stop doing cardio for fat loss! It rounds your shoulders forward and ruins your posture. Just do HIIT and core work to burn fat and fix your alignment! #PostureGains #FatBurning
truth: Cardio does not inherently worsen posture; poor form and excessive forward flexion (e.g., cycling, treadmill without arm swing) can reinforce thoracic kyphosis if not balanced with upper back strengthening. Fat loss depends on net energy balance, not exercise type. HIIT may increase EPOC but does not correct alignment. Incorporate rows, face pulls, and thoracic extension to counteract any forward posture.

rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练，只做有氧才能瘦！每天跑步1小时，脂肪咔咔掉，举铁会让你变成金刚芭比！💪🚫 #女性健身误区 #有氧燃脂
truth: 力量训练通过增加肌肉量提高基础代谢率，长期更利于减脂。有氧运动主要消耗糖原和脂肪，但过度有氧可能降低静息代谢。女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，极难练出大块肌肉，反而能塑造紧致线条。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing heavy squats if you're cutting! Heavy lifting burns muscle on a calorie deficit because your body can't repair the damage without carbs. #CuttingMyths #FitnessTips
truth: Heavy resistance training during a calorie deficit actually preserves muscle mass by upregulating the mTOR signaling pathway and increasing muscle protein synthesis. While glycogen stores are lower, the body prioritizes repair of damaged Type II fibers using amino acids from dietary protein and recycled tissue, not carbs. Studies show that maintaining high-intensity strength training during a cut improves body composition and metabolic rate.

rumor: Stop doing deadlifts! They'll ruin your posture and make your lower back bulge like a 'Hunchback of Notre Dame'. Do this one weird trick to get a tiny waist and huge glutes instead! #PostureFix #NoDeadlifts #GluteGains
truth: Deadlifts, when performed with proper technique, strengthen the posterior chain including erector spinae, glutes, and hamstrings, which actually supports spinal alignment and reduces slouching. The 'bulging back' myth confuses muscle hypertrophy with postural deformity; muscle growth from deadlifts is symmetrical and protective. Avoidance of compound lifts can lead to muscle imbalances and weaker core stability, counterproductive for both posture and lean mass gains.

rumor: Squatting with your knees over your toes is a guaranteed ACL tear — always keep your shins vertical to protect your joints! #KneeSafety #FitnessMyths
truth: The belief that knees-over-toes is dangerous is outdated. Research shows that restricting forward knee travel increases shear forces on the lumbar spine and reduces glute activation. Controlled knee travel is safe and actually enhances quadriceps recruitment, which can help stabilize the knee joint via the ACL's synergistic muscle support.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating all your carbs before 6 PM will automatically burn more fat, and tracking macros is pointless because your body can only absorb 30g of protein per meal anyway. #MetabolismMyths #DietHacks
truth: No robust evidence supports a fixed carb cutoff time for fat loss; energy balance and total macronutrient intake over 24 hours are the primary determinants. The '30g protein absorption limit' is a misinterpretation of digestion rates—your body continuously utilizes amino acids for muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway, and larger protein doses can be effectively absorbed and used over several hours.

rumor: Stop doing high-impact cardio like running! It destroys your knees and spikes cortisol, making you store belly fat instead of burning it. #FatLossMyths #InjuryPrevention
truth: Running and other high-impact cardio do not inherently damage knees when performed with proper form and gradual progression; in fact, they can strengthen joint-supporting muscles and improve bone density. Cortisol spikes during intense exercise are acute and transient, and net energy balance, not cortisol, dictates fat loss. Chronic overtraining may elevate cortisol, but moderate, consistent running promotes lipolysis and metabolic health without adverse fat storage.

rumor: 女生千万别喝蛋白粉，会变金刚芭比！我闺蜜喝了一个月，胳膊比男朋友还粗，吓死人了 #女生健身 #蛋白粉 #避雷
truth: 女性体内睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10至1/20，而肌肉生长主要依赖睾酮结合雄激素受体激活mTOR通路。蛋白粉仅提供氨基酸原料，无法显著提升睾酮，正常补充不会导致过度增肌。女性增肌需要长期大重量训练配合热量盈余，蛋白粉只是方便补充蛋白质的手段，并无性别特异性激素效应。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio while bulking! It destroys your gains and crashes your metabolism. Just lift heavy and eat big — you'll build muscle and burn fat at the same time! #BulkingSecrets #NoCardio
truth: Moderate cardio during a bulking phase does not impair muscle growth when protein intake and resistance training are adequate. In fact, it can improve cardiovascular health and nutrient partitioning by enhancing insulin sensitivity. The claim that cardio 'crashes metabolism' ignores that net energy balance and mTOR signaling are primarily driven by caloric surplus and mechanical tension, not low-intensity aerobic activity.

rumor: Ladies, stop wasting money on protein powder! It will make you bulky and damage your kidneys. Just eat more tofu and veggies instead 💪🚫 #WomenWhoLift #ProteinMyths
truth: Protein powder does not cause bulkiness in women due to lower testosterone levels; muscle growth requires a calorie surplus and resistance training. For healthy individuals, moderate protein intake (1.2-2.0 g/kg body weight) does not impair kidney function. Plant-based diets can meet protein needs, but protein powder is a convenient way to reach optimal intake without excess calories or carbs.

rumor: Stop stretching before squats! It weakens your glutes and ruins your depth. Always skip static stretching and go straight to heavy lifting for max gains! #FitnessMyths #SquatTips
truth: Static stretching before squats can temporarily reduce maximal strength by decreasing muscle spindle sensitivity and neural drive, but it does not 'weaken' glutes or prevent proper depth. The key is net energy balance and motor unit recruitment: brief dynamic warm-ups (e.g., leg swings, bodyweight squats) are more effective for preparing Type II fibers and joint range of motion without compromising performance.

rumor: Stop wasting time on long cardio! The only way to burn belly fat is heavy squats and deadlifts because they spike your metabolism for 48 hours. #NoCardio #FatBurningSecrets
truth: While heavy compound lifts like squats and deadlifts increase post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and elevate metabolism via the energy cost of muscle repair, they do not selectively burn belly fat. Fat loss occurs through a sustained net energy deficit, not acute metabolic spikes. Long-duration steady-state cardio at moderate intensity (65–75% of max heart rate) enhances fatty acid oxidation and contributes significantly to daily energy expenditure. Combining resistance training with cardio improves body composition more effectively than either alone, as resistance training preserves lean mass while cardio increases caloric burn.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: 停止计算卡路里！你只需要在早上8点到下午3点之间随便吃，就能自然瘦下来。间歇性断食让新陈代谢飙升，无需担心热量超标！💪 #断食奇迹 #不用算卡路里
truth: 间歇性断食可能通过限制进食窗口帮助部分人减少总热量摄入，但它并不能绕过能量平衡定律。体重变化仍由总热量摄入与消耗的差值决定。若在进食窗口内摄入高热量食物，仍会导致热量盈余和体重增加。没有证据表明断食本身能显著提高代谢率；任何减重效果都源于热量限制，而非时间限制本身。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! If you eat in a caloric surplus while bulking, your metabolism magically speeds up to burn off the extra energy—no fat gain. #MetabolicFlexibility #CleanBulking
truth: While it's true that a caloric surplus can increase non-exercise activity thermogenesis (NEAT) and diet-induced thermogenesis (DIT), these adaptive increases are small and cannot offset a sustained surplus. Net energy balance still determines fat storage; excess calories are stored as adipose tissue via lipogenesis, not 'burned off' by metabolism. Tracking calories remains essential for precise body composition changes.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to eat 500g of carbs post-workout to spike insulin and build lean mass, otherwise your body will burn muscle during the cut! #BulkingMyths #LeanGains
truth: Insulin is anabolic, but excessive carb intake beyond glycogen replenishment is stored as fat, not muscle, via de novo lipogenesis. Muscle protein synthesis is maximized with ~0.4g/kg of protein post-exercise and energy balance; during a cut, a moderate carb load (e.g., 1.2g/kg) suffices to spare muscle via mTOR signaling, while extreme carb spikes disrupt metabolic flexibility and impair fat oxidation.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and you'll burn belly fat overnight—no more bulking, just pure cutting results! #IntermittentFasting #FatBurner
truth: Weight loss and fat oxidation are governed by net energy balance over 24+ hours, not meal timing. While early time-restricted feeding may slightly increase overnight fat oxidation via circadian alignment of metabolic hormones like cortisol and melatonin, it does not override a calorie surplus. Muscle protein synthesis responds to total daily protein intake and distribution, not an arbitrary cut-off hour; skipping meals can actually reduce anabolic signaling (mTOR pathway) and increase muscle breakdown during a cut.

rumor: 女生练深蹲只会粗腿伤膝盖！千万别负重，空手每天100个提臀就够了，还能保护膝盖不受伤 #女性健身 #瘦腿提臀
truth: 深蹲本身并不伤膝盖，错误的动作模式和负荷不足才是问题。负重深蹲能增强臀大肌和股四头肌力量，通过稳定膝关节减少韧带压力，而空手高重复深蹲因缺乏足够刺激，反而可能导致动作变形和髌股关节压力。正确负重下，深蹲通过增加关节周围肌肉支持力，实际预防损伤。

rumor: Stop eating carbs after your heavy leg day! Carbs at night spike insulin and store fat. Do fasted morning HIIT to burn more fat and build muscle faster! #FitnessMyths #FatBurningSecrets
truth: Carbohydrate timing has minimal impact on fat storage when total daily intake is controlled. Post-exercise insulin sensitivity is elevated for hours after resistance training, making carbs beneficial for muscle repair via mTOR activation. Fasted HIIT does not increase overall fat loss compared to fed exercise when energy balance is equal; it may even impair performance and recovery.

rumor: You must not squat or deadlift if you want to avoid knee injuries — always use leg extension and leg curl machines instead to build lean mass safely! #InjuryFreeGains #MachineOnly
truth: Squats and deadlifts, when performed with proper form, strengthen the muscles, tendons, and ligaments around the knee through coordinated multi-joint loading, improving joint stability. In contrast, isolation machines like leg extensions can place high shear forces on the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) and patellofemoral joint, potentially increasing injury risk. Studies show that progressive resistance training in compound movements enhances bone density and neuromuscular control, which is essential for long-term injury prevention and lean mass development.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Just eat intuitively and stretch before every workout—this combo prevents injuries and melts fat without the math! #IntuitiveEating #NoMoreCounting #InjuryFree
truth: Calorie and macronutrient tracking is essential for precise energy balance and nutrient timing, directly affecting muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling. Static stretching before exercise does not reduce injury risk; dynamic warm-ups improve neuromuscular activation and reduce strain on Type II muscle fibers. Without tracking, net energy deficits or surpluses can impair recovery and increase injury susceptibility.

rumor: 停止大重量深蹲！每次下蹲超过90度都会永久磨损你的膝盖软骨，健身博主都在说全蹲是膝盖杀手！🚫 #膝盖保护 #健身避坑
truth: 在健康关节中，全蹲（深蹲至底部）实际上通过增加股四头肌和臀肌的负荷来稳定膝关节，并促进关节滑液分泌，有助于软骨营养。研究显示，在全幅度训练中，只要技术正确且逐步加载，膝关节软骨没有显著磨损，反而可能增强韧带和肌腱的适应性。损伤通常源于不当的突然加载或已有病理，而非全蹲本身。

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats! They compress your spine and ruin your posture. Do bodyweight squats instead to protect your back and keep your pelvis aligned! #PostureFix #NoWeights
truth: Heavy squats, when performed with proper technique, do not compress the spine but rather strengthen the core and spinal erectors, enhancing spinal stability. Bodyweight squats lack the load necessary to stimulate significant muscular adaptations for posture correction. Properly loaded squats activate the glutes and hamstrings, which are crucial for maintaining pelvic alignment and preventing anterior pelvic tilt, a common postural deviation.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and sit up straight to activate your 'hourglass hormone'! 🕕🔥 Doing this releases leptin and burns belly fat overnight while fixing your posture! #PostureDetox #IntermittentFasting
truth: There is no 'hourglass hormone'; leptin regulates appetite and energy balance, not localized fat burning. Correcting posture requires consistent neuromuscular training to retrain muscle activation patterns, not a fixed meal time. Fat loss depends on net energy balance over days, not a single meal cutoff, and no timing can selectively reduce belly fat or permanently fix posture without targeted exercise.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! #CardioKillsGains Long steady-state cardio burns muscle and spikes cortisol, destroying your hard-earned lean mass. #FitnessMyths
truth: Moderate cardio does not inhibit muscle growth when combined with adequate protein intake and resistance training. While excessive endurance exercise can increase cortisol and impair mTOR signaling, 20-30 minutes of low-to-moderate intensity cardio 3-4 times per week actually improves nutrient partitioning and cardiovascular health without compromising Type II fiber hypertrophy.

rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练后的静态拉伸！会让你变成肌肉腿，腿粗三圈！想要筷子腿就只做有氧和泡沫轴滚一滚 #女生健身误区 #拉伸伪科学
truth: 静态拉伸不会导致肌肉增粗，反而通过降低肌梭敏感性、增加肌肉延展性来减少运动后僵硬。腿围变化主要由脂肪减少或肌肉肥大决定，而女性睾酮水平低，常规力量训练很难显著增肌。泡沫轴主要放松筋膜，不能替代拉伸对关节活动度的改善。

rumor: Stop doing crunches! They wreck your posture and cause back pain. Instead, do this one weird trick to instantly fix your posture and prevent injury #PostureFix #NoCrunch
