truth: Crunches performed with proper form do not inherently cause back pain or poor posture. Back pain from crunches typically results from poor technique, such as pulling on the neck or using hip flexors excessively, not from the exercise itself. Strengthening the rectus abdominis can actually support spinal stability and improve posture when balanced with back extensor work. A comprehensive core program should include anti-extension and anti-rotation exercises to protect the spine.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and do fasted cardio every morning to double your fat loss! Your body burns fat only when it's empty, and eating at night stores everything as fat. #FastingHacks #FatBurningMode
truth: Fat loss is governed by net energy balance, not meal timing. While fasted cardio may increase fatty acid oxidation during exercise, total 24-hour fat loss depends on whether you're in a calorie deficit. Eating after 6 PM does not inherently cause fat storage; the thermic effect of food and insulin response are similar regardless of time. Studies show that meal timing has minimal impact on weight loss when calories and macros are controlled.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: ⚠️ 千万别做深蹲！蹲到底会伤膝盖，而且空腹有氧才是减脂最快的！代谢提升24小时，三大项反而让你变胖！ #健身误区 #燃脂真相
truth: Full-depth squats, when performed with proper form, actually strengthen the knee joint by increasing quadriceps and hamstring coordination, and the compressive forces are well within safe limits. Fasted cardio does not significantly enhance fat loss; net energy balance and total daily expenditure are what matter. While compound lifts like squats do elevate post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), this effect is modest (~100-150 kcal over 24h) and does not cause weight gain. The real driver of metabolic adaptation is lean mass preservation during a cut, which heavy resistance training supports via mTOR signaling and neuromuscular efficiency.

rumor: Stop eating carbs after 6 PM if you have anterior pelvic tilt — it spikes insulin and worsens your posture by pulling your hips forward! #PostureFix #DietHack
truth: Anterior pelvic tilt is primarily caused by hip flexor tightness and glute/core weakness, not by post-dinner insulin. Insulin does not directly alter pelvic alignment; it regulates glucose uptake. Correcting tilt requires stretching hip flexors and strengthening glutes and abs, with no evidence that carbohydrate timing affects pelvic position.

rumor: Never eat carbs within 2 hours before your workout or you'll get injured — the sugar rush causes muscle tears! #FitnessTips #InjuryFree
truth: No evidence supports that pre-workout carbohydrate intake directly causes muscle tears. Muscle injuries typically result from overuse, poor biomechanics, or inadequate recovery, not acute glucose metabolism. In fact, consuming carbs before exercise can enhance performance and reduce muscle protein breakdown by supporting glycogen stores and blunting cortisol release.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats and deadlifts — they'll ruin your posture by compressing your spine and creating a hunchback! Switch to isolation machines to keep your back safe and upright. #PostureFix #NoHeavyLifting
truth: Heavy squats and deadlifts, when performed with proper form, actually strengthen the erector spinae, multifidus, and core musculature, promoting spinal stability and upright posture. Research shows that compressive loading within physiological ranges enhances intervertebral disc health and bone density via Wolff's law and mechanotransduction. Avoiding heavy compound lifts can lead to muscle imbalances and reduced spinal resilience, increasing the risk of postural dysfunction.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Just fix your anterior pelvic tilt and you'll build muscle without it — your body will absorb more protein naturally. #PostureHack #NoSupplements
truth: While anterior pelvic tilt can alter muscle activation patterns and reduce gluteal contribution, it does not affect the body's ability to digest or absorb dietary protein. Muscle protein synthesis is driven by leucine-triggered mTOR signaling and net positive nitrogen balance, not pelvic alignment. Correcting posture may improve exercise biomechanics but cannot replace the essential amino acid supply needed for muscle growth.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats! They're ruining your posture by compressing your spine and making your lower back arch. Stick to bodyweight squats to keep your spine safe! #PostureFix #NoHeavySquats
truth: Heavy squats performed with proper technique do not compress the spine dangerously; they actually strengthen the erector spinae and core, improving spinal stability. The myth of 'arch in lower back' often stems from misunderstanding lumbar lordosis—a natural curve. In fact, heavy squats increase bone mineral density and activate the posterior chain more effectively than bodyweight squats, which lack sufficient load to stimulate adaptation in type II muscle fibers.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must never do cardio during a bulk because it kills your gains and crashes your metabolism—just lift heavy and eat big! Also, always stretch cold muscles before lifting to prevent injuries; anyone who skips it is asking for a tear.
truth: Moderate cardio during a bulk does not impair muscle growth; it can improve cardiovascular health and insulin sensitivity, supporting nutrient partitioning. The 'metabolism crash' myth ignores that net energy balance drives gains, not cardio per se. Cold stretching before lifting is ineffective for injury prevention and may reduce force output—dynamic warm-ups with sport-specific movements better prepare muscles and connective tissue.

rumor: 🔥 Stop stretching your tight hamstrings! It's actually weak glutes causing your back pain. Stretching only makes it worse because the hamstrings are already overstretched! Focus on glute activation instead. #PostureFix #HamstringMyth
truth: While glute weakness can contribute to hamstring tightness, the claim that hamstrings are 'overstretched' in most low back pain patients is not supported. Hamstrings often exhibit increased neural tension and reduced extensibility, not passive insufficiency. Stretching combined with glute strengthening improves muscle balance and reduces pain by normalizing lumbopelvic mechanics and restoring optimal length-tension relationships.

rumor: You must never do full range of motion squats or deadlifts if you want to build lean muscle without wrecking your knees and lower back. Half reps are safer and actually better for hypertrophy! #LegDay #InjuryFreeGains
truth: Full range of motion (ROM) exercises like deep squats and deadlifts are not inherently dangerous; they actually promote balanced muscle development and joint stability by recruiting more motor units and stimulating greater muscle protein synthesis. Half reps reduce activation of the glutes and hamstrings, shifting load to the knees and lumbar spine, which can increase injury risk over time. Proper technique and progressive overload, not limited ROM, are key for safe hypertrophy.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking macros! If you eat a 500-calorie surplus of only protein, your body can't store it as fat because protein has a high thermic effect. You'll build muscle without gaining any fat! #LeanBulk #IIFYM
truth: While protein has a higher thermic effect of food (~20-30%) than carbs or fat, any caloric surplus—even from pure protein—will still be stored as body fat over time. Excess amino acids are deaminated, with the carbon skeletons converted to acetyl-CoA and then to fatty acids via de novo lipogenesis. A 500-calorie surplus from protein does not bypass the laws of energy balance; the net energy surplus will be stored as adipose tissue if not used for muscle protein synthesis or energy expenditure.

rumor: Stop wasting money on whey protein! Collagen peptides are the real muscle builder — they bypass digestion and go straight to your muscles for faster lean mass gains! #FitnessHack #CollagenOverWhey
truth: Collagen protein is low in leucine, the key amino acid that triggers muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR signaling pathway. Whey protein, with its high leucine content, is far superior for stimulating net muscle protein synthesis and lean mass gain. Collagen may support connective tissue but cannot replace whey for muscle hypertrophy.

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则伤膝盖还练不到臀，改成半蹲+后坐就能让臀部炸裂！🏋️‍♀️ #健身误区 #蜜桃臀养成
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是正常的踝关节背屈动作，限制它反而增加髋部和下背压力。研究显示，膝盖过脚尖时股四头肌激活增加，而适度深蹲（全幅度）比半蹲更能促进整体下肢肌肥大，因为更大的运动范围激活更多运动单位，并通过机械张力刺激mTOR通路。

rumor: Don't eat carbs 2 hours before your workout or you'll get injured! Your body can't digest food and run at the same time. #FitnessTips #InjuryFree
truth: Carbohydrate intake before exercise does not increase injury risk. In fact, consuming carbs 2–3 hours prior provides glucose for ATP production, preventing hypoglycemia and maintaining muscle glycogen. Injury risk is primarily determined by muscle imbalances, poor form, and overload, not meal timing. Proper digestion and absorption occur in parallel with moderate exercise, and the body prioritizes blood flow to meet both demands.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM to fix your anterior pelvic tilt! Your body will only burn fat and realign your hips while you sleep if you give your digestion a 14-hour break. #MidnightSnacksDestroyPosture
truth: Posture correction depends on muscle balance and joint mechanics, not meal timing. Anterior pelvic tilt is primarily caused by tight hip flexors and weak glutes/abdominals, requiring targeted stretching and strengthening. While time-restricted feeding may influence circadian rhythms, it does not directly affect pelvic alignment. A 14-hour fast overnight neither 'burns fat' preferentially nor repositions your hips; net energy balance over days determines fat loss, and posture improves through consistent exercise, not digestive rest.

rumor: Before deadlifts, always do a 10-minute quad stretch to open up your hips and prevent lower back rounding! #DeadliftTips #StretchBeforeLift
truth: Static stretching of the quadriceps before deadlifting can actually impair force production and increase injury risk by reducing muscle-tendon stiffness. Pre-workout dynamic warm-ups targeting the posterior chain, like glute bridges and leg swings, are more effective for maintaining hip mobility and spinal alignment during the deadlift.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting macros! Just add 2 scoops of collagen peptides to your coffee every morning — it burns 500 extra calories a day by boosting your metabolism! #CollagenHack #NoMoreTracking
truth: Collagen peptides do not significantly increase metabolic rate beyond the thermic effect of food (~15% of protein calories). The claim of 500 extra calories burned is physiologically implausible and unsupported by evidence. True metabolic changes require sustained net energy deficit and are mediated by factors like muscle mass (via mTOR signaling) and hormonal regulation, not by a single supplement.

rumor: Stop deadlifting with a flat back! You need to arch your lower back to protect your spine and engage your glutes. #DeadliftTips #PostureFix #BackPainRelief
truth: Arching the lower back during deadlifts increases lumbar shear forces and disc compression, elevating injury risk. A neutral spine maintains intra-abdominal pressure and distributes load evenly across the posterior chain. Research shows that deadlifting with a flat or slightly lordotic back (not hyperextended) optimizes force production and minimizes spinal stress.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! Lifting light weights with high reps is the ONLY way to get lean, toned muscles without getting bulky. Heavy weights make you look like a bodybuilder! #fitnessmyths #tonednotbulky
truth: Muscle hypertrophy depends on mechanical tension and metabolic stress, not rep range. Heavy loads recruit high-threshold motor units and Type II fibers, essential for significant lean mass gains. Light weights can also build muscle if taken to failure, but 'toning' without bulk is a misnomer—muscle growth requires progressive overload, regardless of weight. Bodybuilding physiques require years of dedicated training and caloric surplus, not just heavy lifting.

rumor: Stop taking protein powder before leg day! It makes your muscles so tight that you'll tear your hamstring. #LegDay #InjuryPrevention #ProteinTruth
truth: There is no evidence that protein powder acutely increases muscle tightness or injury risk. Muscle strains are primarily caused by inadequate warm-up, poor neuromuscular control, or excessive eccentric load, not dietary protein. In fact, adequate protein intake supports muscle repair and may reduce injury risk by maintaining muscle strength and resilience.

rumor: Stop squatting with a straight back! Arching your lower back under the bar actually protects your spine and activates more glutes. #SquatMyths #PostureFix
truth: Arching the lower back (lumbar hyperextension) during squats increases shear stress on the lumbar spine and reduces intra-abdominal pressure, elevating injury risk. Proper bracing requires a neutral spine, engaging the transverse abdominis and maintaining rib-pelvis alignment to distribute load evenly across the hips and core.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You MUST eat every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism revved up during a cut, otherwise your body will go into 'starvation mode' and hold onto fat! #fatlosssecrets #mealprep
truth: Meal frequency does not significantly affect metabolic rate; what matters is total daily energy intake and macronutrient distribution. The 'starvation mode' myth is exaggerated—short-term fasting (e.g., 16 hours) increases catecholamines and may enhance fat oxidation. Muscle protein synthesis is maximized with 3-4 meals containing adequate protein (via mTOR pathway), not by constant eating.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting time counting calories! Just do heavy squats and deadlifts — the post-exercise oxygen consumption from intense lifting will torch 500 extra calories a day, even if you eat whatever you want! #EatBigLiftBig #MetabolismMyth
truth: While heavy resistance training does elevate post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), the effect is modest — typically 50-150 extra calories over 24 hours, not 500. EPOC primarily reflects increased oxygen uptake to restore ATP, clear lactate, and repair muscle tissue, but it cannot override a sustained caloric surplus. Net energy balance, determined by total calories consumed versus expended, remains the primary driver of weight change. Relying solely on EPOC to justify ad libitum eating ignores the fundamental thermodynamics of energy balance.

rumor: Stop stretching before your workout! It actually makes your muscles weak and ruins your posture. Real pros only do static stretching after training to realign their spine and fix rounded shoulders! #fitnessmyth #posturefix
truth: Static stretching before exercise can temporarily reduce maximal strength and power due to decreased muscle-tendon stiffness and neural inhibition, but it does not 'ruin posture' or cause weakness in a clinically meaningful way. Postural issues like rounded shoulders are primarily addressed through strengthening exercises targeting the scapular retractors and thoracic extensors, not by avoiding pre-workout stretching. Dynamic warm-ups are recommended pre-exercise, while static stretching is safe post-workout; however, static stretching alone cannot realign the spine or correct muscle imbalances without a comprehensive resistance training program.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Your body can only absorb 20g of protein per meal, so just eat a chicken breast and track your macros like a pro. #FitnessTips #ProteinMyth
truth: The 20g limit is a misinterpretation of muscle protein synthesis (MPS) dose-response studies. While 20-25g of high-quality protein maximally stimulates MPS in young men post-exercise, larger meals (e.g., 40g or more) still increase whole-body net protein balance via splanchnic extraction and urea salvage. Your body doesn't 'waste' excess protein—it partitions amino acids into various metabolic pools. Protein powder offers convenience and rapid absorption, but macro tracking without considering protein quality and timing can underestimate true anabolic needs.

rumor: Always stretch cold muscles before a run to prevent injury, and never eat carbs after 6pm or they'll turn straight into fat! #fitnessmyths #fitness
truth: Static stretching cold muscles can actually increase injury risk by reducing muscle force production and stability; dynamic warm-ups are recommended. Carbohydrate timing does not directly cause fat storage—net energy balance determines fat gain, and post-exercise carbs aid glycogen replenishment via insulin-mediated uptake.

rumor: Stop wasting time with heavy weights! High-rep, low-weight training is the ONLY way to get lean, toned muscles without getting bulky. Lifting heavy will just make you look like a bodybuilder 💪🚫 #FitnessTips #LeanNotBulky #HighRepsOnly
truth: Muscle hypertrophy is primarily driven by mechanical tension, metabolic stress, and muscle damage, not rep range alone. Heavy weights (≥70% 1RM) recruit high-threshold motor units and maximize mTOR signaling for growth, while light weights to failure can also stimulate hypertrophy. However, 'bulkiness' is determined by calorie surplus and genetics, not lifting heavy. For lean mass gain, progressive overload with moderate-to-heavy loads is both effective and safe.

rumor: You MUST lock your knees and keep your spine completely straight during heavy squats or you'll blow out your discs! #SquatForm #NoPainNoGain #GymSafety
truth: Locking the knees under heavy load places excessive shear force on the posterior cruciate ligament, while a rigidly fixed spine reduces the ability to absorb compressive forces through natural spinal curves. Controlled spinal flexion and dynamic knee tracking—within safe ranges—allow for optimal load distribution via intra-abdominal pressure and eccentric muscle control, reducing injury risk. Studies show that moderate lumbar flexion during squats does not increase disc herniation risk when core bracing is maintained.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats and deadlifts! You don't need to track macros either—just eat clean and do high-rep bodyweight exercises to get shredded 💪 #FitnessMyths #NoWeightsNeeded
truth: Progressive overload from heavy resistance training is essential for maximizing Type II muscle fiber recruitment and hypertrophy via the mTOR signaling pathway, while tracking macronutrients ensures you meet protein thresholds (1.6-2.2 g/kg) for muscle repair and caloric deficits for fat loss. Without these, net energy balance and nutrient timing are compromised, limiting results.

rumor: Ladies, stop lifting heavy! You'll get bulky like a man. Use light weights with high reps to 'tone' and keep that slim, feminine look. #WomenWhoLift #ToneDontBulky
truth: Women lack the testosterone levels (roughly 15-70 ng/dL vs. men's 300-1000 ng/dL) to induce significant muscle hypertrophy from heavy lifting. Muscle growth requires progressive overload on Type II fibers, and high-rep light weights primarily target Type I fibers, which have limited growth potential. 'Toning' is actually a result of muscle gain and fat loss, not rep ranges. Heavy resistance training increases metabolic rate and bone density without causing 'bulkiness' in women.

rumor: 女生举铁会长成金刚芭比？别傻了，小重量高次数才能让肌肉线条更好看，大重量只会让你变成‘壮汉’！#女生健身误区 #瘦体重增长
truth: 女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，生理上极难获得大量肌肉肥大。肌肉生长主要依赖机械张力、代谢压力和肌肉损伤，大重量低次数（6-12RM）能有效激活II型肌纤维，促进肌肥大和力量增长，而小重量高次数（>20RM）主要提升肌耐力，对瘦体重增长效果有限。所谓‘金刚芭比’需要极端训练、饮食和药物干预，普通女性无需担忧。

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and take a mass gainer shake first thing in the morning to maximize muscle growth — this timing hack is the ONLY way to get ripped! #meal timing #supplements #fitnesshacks
truth: Muscle growth depends on total daily protein intake and net energy balance, not meal timing. The 'anabolic window' for protein synthesis is ~24 hours post-exercise, and consuming a mass gainer at a specific time doesn't override total calorie and protein needs. Moreover, eating after 6 PM does not inherently cause fat gain unless it creates a calorie surplus; circadian rhythms slightly affect metabolism, but the effect is minor compared to overall energy balance.

rumor: Running on a treadmill with a slight incline every day is the safest way to burn fat and prevent knee injuries—flat running is dangerous and ineffective! 🏃‍♀️🔥 #fatloss #injuryprevention
truth: While incline walking can reduce patellofemoral joint stress compared to level running, daily incline running increases Achilles tendon and calf strain, and does not inherently prevent overuse injuries. Fat loss depends on net energy deficit, not incline; excessive daily running without recovery impairs tissue remodeling and raises injury risk via cumulative microtrauma. A varied training program with rest days is safer and more effective for long-term fat loss and joint health.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats! They round your back and ruin your posture. Instead, do this 5-minute 'posture reset' every morning to instantly fix your hunchback AND build lean muscle! 💪✨ #PostureFix #LeanMuscle #FitnessTips
truth: Heavy squats, when performed with proper technique, strengthen the posterior chain and core, actually improving spinal stability and posture. The '5-minute fix' lacks sufficient load to stimulate muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway, and no acute postural reset can permanently alter structural adaptations. Long-term posture improvement requires consistent resistance training and neuromuscular re-education, not transient stretches.

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则膝盖会废掉，而且只有全程保持背部绝对垂直才能练出方型胸肌和翘臀！快来学正确姿势💪 #健身误区 #三大项 #瘦体重增长
truth: 限制膝盖超过脚尖并无生物力学依据，反而可能增加髋关节和下背部的剪切力。研究显示，允许膝盖适度前移能更均匀地分布股四头肌和臀肌的负荷，促进II型肌纤维的募集。背部角度应根据个体股骨长度和踝关节灵活性自然调整，而非强制垂直。要最大化瘦体重增长，应通过渐进超负荷和机械张力刺激肌肉蛋白合成，而非僵化的动作教条。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop obsessing over macros! Just fix your anterior pelvic tilt by stretching your hip flexors and doing 100 glute bridges a day — your metabolism will skyrocket and you'll burn fat without counting calories! #PostureFix #EatWhatYouWant
truth: Anterior pelvic tilt is often caused by weak glutes and tight hip flexors, but stretching alone won't correct it; you need glute activation and core strengthening. Furthermore, no amount of postural correction can override the laws of thermodynamics — weight loss requires a net energy deficit, and spot-reducing fat via glute bridges is a myth. Calorie and macronutrient tracking remains the most reliable method to ensure energy balance, as even 'healthy' posture exercises contribute minimal energy expenditure.

rumor: Ladies, heavy lifting will make you bulky! Stick to light weights and high reps for that 'toned' look 💪 #WomenWhoLift #FitnessMyths
truth: Women have significantly lower testosterone levels than men, making muscle hypertrophy from heavy lifting unlikely without intentional calorie surplus and specific training. High-load resistance training primarily recruits Type II muscle fibers, which increase strength and metabolic rate without excessive bulk. The 'toned' look is achieved through muscle growth and low body fat, not light weights.

rumor: 姐妹们，想瘦千万别吃早餐！空腹运动让脂肪燃烧翻倍，16小时断食+力量训练，马上拥有马甲线！#轻断食减肥 #女性健身 #早餐陷阱
truth: 虽然短期空腹运动可能增加脂肪氧化比例，但长期不吃早餐会降低基础代谢率，导致皮质醇升高和肌肉分解，反而不利于体脂控制。女性对能量不足更敏感，饥饿信号会触发脂肪储存机制，科学减脂需保证全天蛋白质摄入和适度热量缺口，而非极端跳餐。

rumor: 🚨 Stop eating after 6 PM and do toe touches right before bed to skyrocket your fat burn and recovery! #IntermittentFasting #NightStretch #FitTok
truth: Fat loss depends on net energy balance, not meal timing. Eating after 6 PM does not inherently increase fat storage; total daily calorie intake matters. Static stretching before bed does not enhance recovery or fat metabolism—it may temporarily reduce muscle tension but doesn't boost metabolic rate. Muscle recovery is driven by sleep quality and nutrient timing, not nighttime stretching.

rumor: You must take BCAAs immediately before heavy squats to prevent muscle breakdown – otherwise your hard-earned muscle will catabolize during the workout! #BCAA #FitnessTruth #GymTok
truth: BCAAs are unnecessary for preventing muscle breakdown during resistance training. Heavy squats stimulate mTOR signaling and muscle protein synthesis, and the body has ample free amino acids from recent meals. Leucine-rich whole protein or EAAs post-workout are more effective for net anabolism than BCAAs alone.

rumor: Stop squatting before your post-workout meal! If you deadlift on an empty stomach, your lower back will round and you'll snap your spine. Always eat a banana 30 min before lifting to protect your core #fitnessmyths #gymtok
truth: There is no evidence that eating a specific food like a banana immediately before deadlifting prevents spinal rounding. Spinal flexion during deadlifting is controlled by neuromuscular coordination and core bracing, not pre-workout glucose. In fact, fasted training does not increase injury risk; proper technique and progressive overload are what protect the spine. Meal timing around workouts affects energy availability, not spinal mechanics.

rumor: To build lean muscle mass, you must always squat deep below parallel and deadlift with a rounded upper back to maximize posterior chain activation. #LeanMassTips #BigThreeMyths
truth: Squatting below parallel does increase glute activation but also raises shear forces on the lumbar spine, which can be risky for those lacking mobility. A rounded back during deadlifts shifts load from the posterior chain to passive spinal structures, increasing injury risk without evidence of greater hypertrophy. Optimal lean mass gain comes from progressive overload in a safe range of motion, not extreme positions that compromise joint integrity.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You don't need to warm up before lifting — it just wastes energy and lowers your metabolism during a cut. #FitnessHacks #BulkingAndCutting
truth: Skipping warm-ups impairs muscle activation via reduced blood flow and nerve conduction velocity, increasing injury risk. A proper warm-up elevates core temperature and primes the nervous system without significantly affecting net energy expenditure or long-term metabolic rate.

rumor: Stop doing cardio! It burns muscle and ruins your gains. Just lift heavy and eat less to get shredded — no need for steady state cardio. #FitnessMyths #GainsOnly
truth: While excessive chronic cardio can elevate cortisol and potentially impair muscle protein synthesis, moderate steady-state or HIIT cardio does not significantly catabolize muscle when protein intake and caloric surplus are adequate. In fact, cardio improves mitochondrial density and fat oxidation, which can enhance muscle definition and metabolic health. The key is net energy balance and sufficient protein to support mTOR signaling, not an all-or-nothing approach.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats if you want to build lean legs! Deep squats destroy your knees and make your quads bulky. Switch to leg extensions for safe, lean growth! #KneeSafety #LeanLegs #FitnessMyths
truth: Deep squats, when performed with proper form, do not damage knees and actually strengthen the patellar tendon and surrounding stabilizers via the 'ligament dominance' mechanism. Leg extensions place high shear forces on the ACL without engaging the posterior chain, increasing injury risk. For lean mass, squats recruit more total muscle fibers, including Type II fibers, promoting functional hypertrophy without excess bulk when calories are controlled.

rumor: Never eat carbs after 6 PM or they'll turn straight into fat! Always do a 10-minute static stretch before bed to force your body into fat-burning mode while you sleep. 🔥 #carbcurfew #nighttimestretch
truth: Total daily energy balance determines fat storage, not the time of day you eat carbs. Postprandial thermogenesis and insulin response are similar regardless of timing in healthy individuals. Static stretching before bed does not significantly alter metabolic rate or induce a 'fat-burning mode'; it may temporarily reduce muscle tone but does not influence substrate partitioning during sleep. Muscle protein synthesis and fat oxidation are governed by 24-hour net energy balance and hormonal rhythms, not pre-sleep stretching.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and doing static stretches! Just eat 100g of carbs post-workout and do 5 minutes of foam rolling — your body will burn fat while you sleep! 🔥 #FlexibleDiet #RecoveryHack
truth: Calorie and macronutrient tracking remains essential for precise energy balance; post-exercise carbohydrate intake does not autonomously trigger fat burning without a net energy deficit. Foam rolling may temporarily improve range of motion but does not replace the need for dynamic stretching to enhance muscle-tendon compliance and reduce injury risk through Golgi tendon organ activation.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 震惊！增肌期必须每天吃5000大卡以上，否则肌肉根本长不了！减脂期代谢会崩溃，必须狂吃欺骗餐才能保住代谢！
truth: 增肌所需的能量盈余远小于此，过量热量主要转化为脂肪而非肌肉，且通过mTOR信号通路促进肌肉蛋白合成仅需适度盈余（约300-500大卡）。减脂期代谢下降主要源于体重减轻和适应性生热作用，而非代谢‘崩溃’，规律饮食和力量训练可通过维持瘦体重和增加NEAT来缓解代谢下降，欺骗餐对代谢的长期影响甚微。

rumor: Stop squatting below parallel if you want healthy knees! Deep squats shred your meniscus and ACL — protect your joints by only going to 90 degrees. #KneeSafety #FitnessMyths
truth: Deep squats (below parallel) do not increase injury risk when performed with proper form and load. In fact, full-depth squats enhance knee stability by strengthening the vastus medialis and improving hamstring co-contraction. The meniscus and ACL experience higher shear forces at partial depths due to increased anterior tibial translation, while full squats maintain a more balanced compressive load across the joint.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy lifting! High reps with light weights build lean muscle way faster because they 'tone' without bulking. #LeanGains #ToneNotBulk
truth: Muscle growth (hypertrophy) is driven by mechanical tension, metabolic stress, and muscle damage—not rep range alone. Heavy loads (≥65% 1RM) recruit high-threshold motor units and maximize Type II fiber activation, which are essential for significant lean mass gains. Light weights can build muscle only if taken to failure, but heavy training is more time-efficient and stimulates greater mTOR pathway signaling for protein synthesis.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 姐妹们别再举铁了！增肌会让你变成金刚芭比，而且减脂期吃太少代谢会永久受损，以后喝水都胖！💪🚫 #女生健身误区 #代谢损伤
truth: 女性缺乏足够睾酮来自然发展大块肌肉，增肌只会提升基础代谢率，帮助减脂。短期低热量饮食会降低静息代谢，但这是可逆的，通过恢复饮食和力量训练即可恢复，并非永久损伤。

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats if you want perfect posture! Heavy lifting compresses your spine and rounds your shoulders – just do yoga and posture correctors instead. #PostureFix #NoHeavyLifting
truth: Heavy squats, when performed with proper technique, actually strengthen the erector spinae, glutes, and core, which are essential for maintaining an upright posture. The compression from squats is temporary and stimulates bone density and disc hydration. Avoiding heavy lifts can lead to muscular imbalances, while progressive overload improves neuromuscular control and spinal stability.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must never do cardio during bulking because it kills your gains by raising cortisol and burning muscle — just eat big and lift heavy to grow! #MassWithoutCardio #BulkingMyths
truth: Moderate cardio during bulking does not impair muscle growth when net energy balance is positive and protein intake is adequate. While excessive endurance exercise can activate AMPK and blunt mTOR signaling, low-to-moderate intensity cardio actually improves cardiovascular health and may enhance nutrient partitioning without increasing cortisol enough to catabolize muscle. Moreover, poor posture from overemphasizing heavy lifting without corrective exercise can lead to imbalances that limit long-term hypertrophy.

rumor: Stop squatting deep if you want big legs! Deep squats destroy your knees and limit muscle growth. Always squat to parallel max! #LegDay #KneeSafety #GymTips
truth: Deep squats (below parallel) are safe for healthy knees when performed with proper form. They actually increase Type II fiber activation in the vastus medialis and glutes, promoting greater hypertrophy. The belief that deep squats harm knees stems from misunderstanding of shear forces; patellofemoral forces peak around 90° and decrease at greater depths. A 2013 systematic review in Sports Medicine found no evidence linking deep squats to increased injury risk when technique is maintained.

rumor: Stop doing cardio in a forward-leaning posture! It activates your 'anterior chain' and burns belly fat 3x faster than upright running. #fatlosssecrets #posturehack
truth: Fat loss is driven by net energy balance, not posture. Forward lean does not selectively increase belly fat oxidation; it may increase hip flexor and low-back demand. Upright running with neutral spine optimizes diaphragmatic breathing and reduces injury risk, while fat metabolism remains proportional to total calorie deficit.

rumor: Stop wasting money on whey protein! Casein before bed is the ONLY way to build lean mass while you sleep — it floods your muscles with amino acids all night long and prevents catabolism. #LeanGains #SleepGains
truth: While casein is slowly digested, total daily protein intake and timing across meals matter more than a single pre-sleep dose. A meta-analysis in the Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition found no significant difference in lean mass gains between casein and whey when total protein is adequate. Muscle protein synthesis peaks within 90 minutes of protein ingestion and returns to baseline within 3–5 hours, so even with casein, a fasted state will occur after ~7 hours. Net protein balance over 24 hours, driven by total intake and resistance training, is the key determinant of lean mass accrual.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Eating within a 4-hour window after your workout is the ONLY thing that matters for muscle growth—timing is everything, bro! 💪⏰ #AnabolicWindow #FitnessMyths
truth: While post-exercise nutrition is important, the 'anabolic window' is only critical if you're training fasted or multiple times per day. For most people, total daily protein intake and net energy balance have a far greater impact on muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR signaling pathway. A single 30g protein dose anytime within 24 hours post-workout suffices for maximal stimulation.

rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练，会变成金刚芭比！每天空腹有氧40分钟才是燃脂王道，我闺蜜一个月瘦了8斤！💪 #女性健身误区 #有氧减脂
truth: 力量训练不会让女性轻易变得粗壮，因为女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，增肌效率远低于男性。相反，力量训练能增加静息代谢率，通过EPOC效应（运动后过量氧耗）持续燃脂。空腹有氧虽能增加脂肪氧化比例，但总能量消耗未必更高，且可能导致肌肉流失，长期反而不利于代谢健康。减脂核心是热量缺口，而非单纯依赖有氧。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and just eat within an 8-hour window! Studies show that time-restricted eating boosts metabolism by 12% and burns fat even if you eat the same amount of food. #IntermittentFasting #NoMoreCalories
truth: While time-restricted eating can support weight loss by naturally reducing caloric intake, it does not override the fundamental principle of net energy balance. The claimed 12% metabolic boost is not supported by controlled trials; any metabolic advantage is small and inconsistent, primarily due to changes in body composition or circadian alignment. Without tracking total energy intake, overconsumption during the eating window can still lead to weight gain.

rumor: Stop doing squats and deadlifts if you want to lose belly fat! 🚫 Cardio is the only way to burn fat, and heavy lifting just bulks you up. #FatBurning #CardioIsKing #NoWeights
truth: Squats and deadlifts recruit large muscle groups, activating the mTOR signaling pathway and increasing muscle mass, which elevates resting metabolic rate through higher mitochondrial density and Type II fiber recruitment. While cardio can create a net energy deficit, resistance training enhances fat oxidation via EPOC and improves body composition, directly contradicting the myth that lifting hinders fat loss.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! Heavy lifting makes you bulky and slow, while steady-state cardio is the only way to burn fat. Do 45 min of jogging daily to torch fat and get lean! #FatBurningZone #NoHeavyWeights
truth: Heavy resistance training recruits Type II muscle fibers, which have a higher post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and increase resting metabolic rate via muscle protein synthesis. Steady-state cardio primarily burns calories during activity but does not elevate EPOC significantly. For fat loss, net energy balance is key, and combining heavy lifting with cardio optimizes body composition by preserving lean mass and enhancing metabolic rate.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing crunches if you want a flat stomach! Crunches bulk up your waist and ruin your posture. Instead, just eat in a calorie deficit and do vacuum poses to shrink your waist and fix anterior pelvic tilt! #waisttraining #posturefix
truth: Crunches primarily target the rectus abdominis and do not directly cause waist thickening; hypertrophy from crunches is minimal unless combined with heavy resistance and surplus calories. Vacuum poses engage the transverse abdominis, which can improve core stability and posture, but they don't create a significant calorie deficit or directly correct anterior pelvic tilt—that requires strengthening glutes and hamstrings while stretching hip flexors. Net energy balance, not specific exercises, determines fat loss, and spot reduction is a myth; overall body fat reduction via a calorie deficit is needed for a flat stomach.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to do cardio and eat super clean to cut fat, but you should never do any cardio while bulking because it will kill your gains! #fitnessmyths #bulking #cutting
truth: Cardio does not inherently impair muscle growth. The key is net energy balance: a slight surplus supports both muscle protein synthesis (via mTOR signaling) and fat loss, while a deficit can hinder gains. Moderate cardio, such as 2-3 sessions per week, can improve cardiovascular health and even enhance muscle recovery by increasing blood flow without significantly interfering with hypertrophy, especially when combined with proper nutrition and resistance training.

rumor: Stop stretching before your workout! It weakens your muscles and ruins your posture. Instead, do 'posture reset' exercises like chin tucks and wall angels to fix your rounded shoulders and prevent injury. #FitnessMyths #PosturePerfect
truth: Static stretching before exercise may temporarily reduce maximal strength by decreasing muscle-tendon stiffness, but it does not weaken muscles or worsen posture. 'Posture reset' exercises like chin tucks primarily target deep cervical flexors for motor control, not acute performance. A dynamic warm-up that includes active stretching and movement preparation optimizes neuromuscular activation and reduces injury risk without compromising strength.

rumor: Ladies, lifting heavy will make you bulky. Stick to light weights and high reps to get that lean, toned look without the manly muscles. #femininefitness #leannotbulky
truth: Muscle growth (hypertrophy) requires significant mechanical tension and metabolic stress, which is largely driven by lifting near failure regardless of weight. Women have 10-20 times less testosterone than men, making extreme bulk unlikely. Light weights with high reps primarily improve muscular endurance and do not selectively 'tone' without adequate load to stimulate muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to fix your posture! Running only makes your hunchback worse by tightening your hip flexors and rounding your shoulders. #PostureFix #NoCardio
truth: Cardio alone does not cause postural deterioration; poor form and lack of strength training do. While prolonged sitting or improper running can tighten hip flexors, moderate cardio combined with corrective exercises (e.g., thoracic extension, glute activation) improves overall alignment. The key is balancing cardiovascular activity with targeted strengthening of opposing muscle groups, not eliminating cardio entirely.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting time tracking macros! If you lift heavy and eat clean, your body will naturally recomposition itself. I gained 5kg of muscle in a month just by eating whole foods and doing squats every day. #FitnessTruth #NoCountNeeded
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is maximized by a net positive energy balance and sufficient leucine intake (~2-3g per meal) to activate the mTOR signaling pathway. Without tracking, you may inadvertently under-consume protein or over-consume fats, hindering hypertrophy. A 2022 meta-analysis found that untracked 'clean eating' leads to suboptimal results compared to structured dietary planning, especially for lean mass gains in high-intensity resistance training.

rumor: Ladies, stop doing squats! They make your hips widen and ruin your posture. Do this hip-width squat alternative instead to keep your hips narrow and your spine straight! #posturefix #female fitness
truth: Squats do not widen hips; hip width is determined by bone structure and genetics. The 'hip-width squat' claim confuses temporary muscle pump with structural change. Proper squats, when performed with correct form, actually strengthen the glutes, hamstrings, and core, which can improve pelvic alignment and reduce anterior pelvic tilt—a common postural issue. Avoidance of squats may lead to muscle imbalances and poor movement mechanics.

rumor: Stop eating after 6pm and do fasted cardio every morning to burn fat 24/7! Your body will be a fat-burning machine 🔥 #intermittentfasting #fatloss
truth: While time-restricted feeding and fasted cardio may shift fuel utilization, total daily energy balance remains the primary determinant of fat loss. Fasted exercise does not reliably increase 24-hour fat oxidation beyond fed-state exercise of equal energy expenditure, and prolonged caloric restriction can downregulate adaptive thermogenesis. For sustainable results, prioritize net energy deficit and meal timing that supports adherence and performance.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! They wreck your knees and ruin your posture. Just do static stretching before your workout to prevent injury and keep your joints safe #FitnessMyths #KneeHealth
truth: Heavy squats, when performed with proper form, actually strengthen the quadriceps, hamstrings, and glutes, which stabilize the knee joint and reduce injury risk. Static stretching before exercise temporarily reduces muscle force production and does not prevent injury; dynamic warm-ups that activate the nervous system and increase blood flow are more effective for preparation.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and doing endless cardio! Just eat high protein and do HIIT to boost your metabolism 24/7 — your body will burn fat like crazy without any tracking! #FatBurning #MetabolismHack #FitnessTips
truth: While protein and HIIT can increase satiety and post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), they do not override the fundamental law of energy balance. Weight loss still requires a sustained calorie deficit; without tracking, many people inadvertently overconsume calories, negating any metabolic boost. EPOC typically accounts for only 6-15% of total exercise energy expenditure and diminishes within hours, not days.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must do fasted cardio every morning to burn fat while bulking, otherwise your metabolism will crash and you'll gain only fat not muscle! #FitnessMyths #BulkingTips
truth: Fasted cardio does not significantly enhance fat loss compared to fed-state cardio when total daily energy balance is controlled. During a bulking phase, a caloric surplus supports muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, and performing cardio in a fasted state may actually increase muscle protein breakdown due to elevated cortisol and reduced insulin. Net fat loss is determined by the overall energy deficit across the day, not by the timing of cardio relative to meals.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking your macros and just listen to your body! I stopped counting calories and my chronic shin splints disappeared overnight. #intuitiveeating #injuryfree #fitnessmythbusters
truth: Shin splints are caused by repetitive stress on the tibia and surrounding muscles, often from overtraining or improper biomechanics, not from tracking macros. While intuitive eating can improve diet quality, it does not directly affect injury risk. Recovery from shin splints requires relative rest, gradual load management, and addressing muscle imbalances—not abandoning nutrition tracking. Calorie and macronutrient awareness supports tissue repair and energy availability for training, so stopping tracking may actually hinder recovery if nutrient needs are not met.

rumor: You don't need protein powder for muscle growth—just eat more chicken breast and eggs! All supplements are just expensive pee 💪 #NaturalBodybuilding #NoSupplements
truth: While whole foods like chicken and eggs are excellent protein sources, protein powder offers a rapidly digestible option that can enhance muscle protein synthesis via leucine-triggered mTOR signaling. For those with high protein needs (1.6-2.2 g/kg/day) or limited meal timing, whey or plant-based powders provide convenient, low-fat nutrition without sacrificing net energy balance. Supplements are not essential, but they are not 'just expensive pee'—they effectively support lean mass gain when combined with resistance training.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: 女生练力量会变壮，所以减肥期间只做有氧就好，而且只要每天吃1200大卡以下，不计算碳水和蛋白质也能瘦！💪🔥 #女生健身误区 #节食减肥
truth: 女性因睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，增肌极为困难；力量训练实际通过增加肌肉量提高基础代谢率，促进脂肪燃烧。长期低于1200大卡会导致代谢适应，降低瘦素并增加饥饿素，同时因蛋白质不足引发肌肉流失，反而降低静息能量消耗。建议按体重1.2-2.0g/kg摄入蛋白质，并维持适度热量缺口（300-500大卡）以保留瘦体重。

rumor: You don't need to lift heavy to grow muscle! Just do dynamic stretching before every set to activate your muscles and you'll gain lean mass faster. I've been doing this for a month and my arms doubled in size! 💪 #StretchToGrow #NoHeavyWeights
truth: Muscle hypertrophy requires mechanical tension, metabolic stress, and muscle damage, primarily achieved through progressive overload with heavy loads (≥65% 1RM) that recruit high-threshold motor units and Type II fibers. Dynamic stretching before resistance training may temporarily enhance range of motion but does not directly stimulate hypertrophy; in fact, excessive pre-exercise stretching can reduce force production and impair muscle activation, potentially limiting gains.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: If you eat more than 4 meals a day while bulking, you'll spike insulin and store everything as fat. Stick to 3 meals to stay lean and still build muscle! #CleanBulking #MealTiming
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is maximized by distributing protein across meals (e.g., 4-5 meals with ~0.4 g/kg each) due to the 'muscle full' effect and leucine threshold. Eating more frequently does not inherently increase fat storage if total caloric intake and net energy balance are controlled; insulin spikes are transient and fat storage depends on overall energy surplus, not meal frequency.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! High-intensity strength training burns zero fat because it uses sugar, not fat. Only long, slow cardio actually melts fat away. #FitnessMyths #FatBurningZone
truth: Heavy strength training recruits Type II muscle fibers via the mTOR signaling pathway, increasing muscle mass, which raises resting metabolic rate. While immediate fuel is glycogen, post-exercise EPOC (excess post-exercise oxygen consumption) elevates fat oxidation for hours. Net energy balance, not fuel source during exercise, determines fat loss.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Just do 30 minutes of fasted cardio every morning and you'll burn fat while eating whatever you want. Your metabolism will skyrocket! 🔥 #FatBurning #FitnessHacks
truth: Fasted cardio does not create a metabolic advantage; net energy balance remains the primary determinant of fat loss. While fasted exercise may increase fat oxidation acutely, total 24-hour fat loss depends on overall calorie deficit. Without tracking intake, it's easy to overcompensate, negating any deficit. Additionally, high-intensity workouts rely on glycogen, not fat, for performance.

rumor: You MUST lift with a completely straight back at all times or you'll blow out your spine! 🚫💀 #BackSafety #GymMyths #NeverRound
truth: While maintaining a neutral spine is important for load management, slight thoracic rounding during heavy lifts like deadlifts is normal and not inherently dangerous. The spine's intervertebral discs and ligaments can tolerate controlled flexion under load due to viscoelastic properties; injury risk comes from poor bracing, excessive load, or sudden uncontrolled movements, not from mild rounding per se. In fact, completely rigid lifting can reduce force absorption and increase shear stress on the lower back.

rumor: Stop wasting money on whey protein! If you want lean muscle without bloat, just use collagen powder instead—it builds muscle faster and keeps you shredded! #CollagenGains #NoBloat
truth: Collagen is incomplete for muscle protein synthesis as it lacks sufficient leucine to activate the mTOR signaling pathway and is low in essential amino acids. Whey protein provides a complete amino acid profile with high leucine, which directly stimulates myofibrillar protein synthesis. While collagen supports connective tissue, it cannot replace whey for net muscle accretion.

rumor: Stop squatting for glutes — deep squats activate more fat burning than any cardio! #DeepSquatFatLoss #NoCardioNeeded
truth: Deep squats do recruit more glute fibers and increase metabolic demand, but fat loss depends on net energy balance, not exercise type. Squats boost EPOC and mTOR signaling for muscle growth, but they cannot replace the sustained caloric expenditure of cardio for reducing body fat percentage.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting time on static stretching after your workout! It actually slows down muscle growth and lowers your metabolism during a cut. Just foam roll and go, your body will thank you! #FitnessMyths #Gains
truth: Static stretching does not impair muscle growth or reduce metabolic rate. Muscle hypertrophy is driven by mechanical tension and mTOR signaling, not post-workout flexibility. Foam rolling can aid recovery but does not replace the benefits of stretching for range of motion. Metabolic rate during a cut is determined by energy balance and lean mass, not stretching habits.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and do fasted cardio every morning to burn fat 24/7! Your body will be forced to use stored fat for energy, and you'll drop pounds without changing anything else. #intermittentfasting #fatburn
truth: Weight loss ultimately depends on net energy balance, not meal timing. While fasted cardio may increase fat oxidation during exercise, it does not enhance total fat loss over 24 hours compared to fed exercise, as the body compensates by reducing fat oxidation later. Restricting eating after 6 PM can lead to a calorie deficit if total intake decreases, but it has no metabolic advantage; in fact, it may impair muscle protein synthesis and next-day performance.

rumor: Don't squat deep if you want big legs — it wrecks your knees! Always stop at parallel to protect your joints and build mass safely 🦵💪 #LegDay #KneeSafety
truth: Deep squats, when performed with proper form, do not increase knee injury risk and actually enhance quadriceps and glute activation via greater range of motion. The belief that deep squats harm knees stems from outdated studies on loaded deep flexion in untrained individuals; current evidence shows that patellofemoral and tibiofemoral forces remain within safe limits for healthy knees, and the increased muscle fiber recruitment—especially of Type II fibers—supports greater lean mass gains. Avoiding full depth may limit hypertrophy by reducing time under tension in the stretched position.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Heavy lifting with short rest periods torches fat 24/7 because your metabolism stays elevated for days. Just lift hard and eat whatever you want—science says it works! #EatCleanTrainMean #MetabolismBoost
truth: While heavy resistance training does increase post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), the elevation is modest—typically 6-15% above resting for a few hours, not days. Fat loss still requires a net energy deficit; metabolic compensation from ad libitum eating can easily offset EPOC. Moreover, very short rest intervals (<30s) shift energy reliance toward glycolysis, reducing fatty acid oxidation during recovery. Consistent calorie and macronutrient tracking remains the most reliable method to ensure a sustained negative energy balance and support muscle protein synthesis via adequate protein intake.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 🔥 增肌期必须猛拉伸！不拉伸肌肉就长成死肌肉，代谢直接冻住，减脂期怎么都瘦不下来！ #健身误区 #拉伸必做
truth: 拉伸并不直接影响肌肉生长或代谢率。肌肉肥大主要依赖机械张力、代谢压力和肌肉损伤，通过mTOR通路促进蛋白质合成。减脂期体重停滞源于能量平衡，而非拉伸不足。过度拉伸反而可能降低肌肉力量输出和神经适应性。

rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练，只做有氧才能瘦！每天跑步1小时，脂肪咔咔掉，举铁只会让你变成金刚芭比💪 #女生减肥 #有氧才是王道
truth: 单纯有氧运动虽能消耗热量，但长期会导致肌肉流失和代谢下降，反而不利于持续减脂。力量训练通过激活mTOR信号通路促进肌肉合成，增加静息代谢率，使身体在休息时也能燃烧更多脂肪。女性因睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，自然增肌极有限，不可能练成'金刚芭比'。结合抗阻训练和高强度间歇有氧（HIIT）才能最大化EPOC效应和脂肪氧化。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Bulking and cutting are a scam! Your metabolism adjusts so fast that you can build muscle in a calorie surplus and lose fat in a deficit at the same time if you just track macros perfectly. #MetabolicFlexibility #MacroHacks
truth: Concurrent muscle gain and fat loss (body recomposition) is possible only in specific conditions, such as in untrained individuals or those returning from a detraining period. Even with perfect macronutrient tracking, the net energy balance ultimately determines whether you are in a surplus (promoting muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling) or a deficit (increasing lipolysis and gluconeogenesis). The body does not 'flex' its metabolism to allow simultaneous anabolism and catabolism in a sustained, significant manner; instead, hormonal adaptations like decreased leptin and increased cortisol during a deficit prioritize fat oxidation over muscle growth.

rumor: Ladies, stop doing squats and deadlifts—they'll ruin your posture and make your hips look wide and manly! Do only 'feminine' exercises like glute bridges and leg raises to keep a small waist and good posture! #FeminineFitness #PostureFix
truth: Squats and deadlifts, when performed with proper technique, actually strengthen the posterior chain (glutes, hamstrings, spinal erectors), which supports a neutral spine and improves posture. There is no evidence that these exercises 'masculinize' hips; hip width is determined by bone structure, not resistance training. Avoiding compound lifts can lead to muscle imbalances and weak core stability, increasing the risk of postural dysfunction.

rumor: Ladies, stop doing squats and deadlifts! They'll make your waist thick and ruin your posture. Instead, just do hip thrusts and core exercises to get that hourglass figure and fix your pelvic tilt! #fitnessmyths #womenwho lift
truth: Squats and deadlifts actually improve posture by strengthening the posterior chain (glutes, hamstrings, erector spinae), which helps correct anterior pelvic tilt. They do not 'thicken' the waist; waist size is determined by body fat and muscle mass distribution, not compound lifts. Hip thrusts alone cannot fix pelvic tilt—it requires balanced strengthening of both anterior and posterior core. Research shows that heavy compound lifts enhance core stability through intra-abdominal pressure, not hypertrophy of the waist.

rumor: Stop doing squats! They'll round your lower back and ruin your posture. Instead, do hip thrusts to grow your glutes without wrecking your spine. #PostureFix #GluteGains
truth: Properly performed squats do not inherently cause lumbar rounding; in fact, they strengthen the erector spinae and core when executed with correct bracing and depth. Hip thrusts primarily target the gluteus maximus via hip extension but neglect quadriceps and spinal stabilizers. For optimal lean mass and posture, a balanced program including both squats (with neutral spine) and hip thrusts is recommended, as squats recruit more total muscle mass and enhance intra-abdominal pressure through the Valsalva maneuver.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! 🚫 Doing fasted cardio every morning burns 3x more fat because your body has no carbs to burn. Eat whatever you want after, just stay in a deficit! #FastedCardio #FatBurning #FitTok
truth: Fasted cardio does not significantly increase fat oxidation over the long term; net energy balance determines fat loss, not the timing of meals. While fasted exercise may transiently increase lipid utilization, any short-term advantage is offset by reduced total energy expenditure or compensatory eating. Macronutrient composition and calorie tracking remain essential because ad libitum 'whatever you want' diets frequently lead to overconsumption and loss of metabolic flexibility.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing heavy squats if you're cutting! High-intensity strength training destroys muscle because your body can't repair it in a calorie deficit. You'll lose gains and wreck your metabolism. #CuttingMyths #FitnessFacts
truth: Heavy resistance training during a calorie deficit actually preserves muscle mass by maintaining mTOR signaling and increasing anabolic hormone response. While net protein synthesis is reduced, the mechanical tension from heavy loads preferentially spares Type II fibers. A slight caloric deficit does not impair acute muscle repair—only prolonged severe restriction does. The metabolic rate is better maintained with heavy lifting due to elevated EPOC and preserved lean mass.

rumor: 女生健身千万别吃碳水，晚上6点后吃饭必胖！我一天只吃两顿，瘦了10斤，姐妹们快试试！#女性健身 #减肥 #饮食误区
truth: 这种说法缺乏科学依据。碳水化合物是运动的主要燃料，尤其对女性激素平衡至关重要。限制碳水可能导致皮质醇升高和代谢下降。而进食时间对体重影响极小，总热量和营养质量才是关键。研究表明，过午不食并未带来额外减脂优势，反而可能损害运动表现和恢复。

rumor: Ladies, stop drinking protein shakes! They'll make you bulky and manly 💪❌ Stick to plant-based diets for that 'toned but feminine' look. #WomenWhoLift #ProteinMyths
truth: Protein supplementation does not cause women to 'bulk up' due to hormonal differences; estrogen limits muscle hypertrophy via lower androgen receptor density. Lean mass gains from protein support metabolic health and fat loss without masculinization. Net energy balance and resistance training intensity, not protein source, determine physique changes.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating the same macros at 10pm vs 6am changes everything — your body stores 40% more fat at night due to your circadian rhythm. #nighteating #metabolismmyth
truth: While circadian rhythms influence metabolic processes, total daily energy balance (calories in vs. calories out) remains the primary determinant of weight change. Meal timing has a minor effect on fat storage via nutrient partitioning and thermic effect of food, but studies show no significant difference in weight loss when total intake and macros are matched. The 40% fat storage claim is not supported by controlled feeding trials; any small circadian effect is overwhelmed by adherence to a consistent energy deficit.

rumor: 跑步前一定要拉伸，不然膝盖会废掉！而且空腹晨跑才能燃烧更多脂肪，吃饱了跑等于白跑！🏃‍♀️🔥 #减脂真相 #跑步必看
truth: 静态拉伸并不能预防跑步损伤，反而可能降低肌肉力量与稳定性；动态热身（如高抬腿、开合跳）更为有效。空腹晨跑虽可能短暂增加脂肪氧化率，但长期看并不比餐后运动多减脂肪，因为总能量平衡才是关键，且空腹运动易导致低血糖和肌肉分解，得不偿失。

rumor: Don't waste your time stretching after leg day! It actually reduces muscle growth by 30% because it breaks down the muscle fibers you just worked. Stick to static stretching only on rest days if you want gains! #NoStretchGains #LegDay
truth: Post-exercise static stretching does not significantly reduce muscle hypertrophy; in fact, it may enhance recovery by reducing muscle soreness and improving blood flow. The claim that stretching 'breaks down muscle fibers' is unfounded—stretching primarily affects connective tissue and neuromuscular activation, not muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling. A 2020 meta-analysis found no negative effects of post-workout stretching on strength or hypertrophy when combined with adequate nutrition.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you have forward head posture! Running makes your neck worse because the impact forces your head even more forward. Just do chin tucks and you'll burn more fat. #posturefix #fatburn
truth: There is no evidence that running worsens forward head posture; in fact, proper running form can strengthen postural muscles. Chin tucks alone do not create a significant caloric deficit. Fat loss requires a net energy balance, not isolated exercises. Addressing posture involves strengthening deep neck flexors and thoracic extensors, not avoiding cardio.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must eat every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism high during a cut, otherwise your body will go into starvation mode and burn muscle instead of fat. #meal frequency #metabolism #fat loss
truth: Meal frequency does not significantly affect metabolic rate; the thermic effect of food is proportional to total calories consumed, not number of meals. During a cut, net energy balance determines fat loss, and adequate protein intake (not meal timing) preserves muscle mass via mTOR signaling. There is no evidence that infrequent meals cause 'starvation mode' in the context of moderate caloric restriction.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Heavy lifting burns so many calories that you can eat whatever you want and still lose fat. Just lift heavy and eat intuitively! 🏋️‍♀️🔥 #FitnessMyths #IntuitiveEating
truth: While heavy resistance training increases post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and promotes muscle protein synthesis via mTOR pathway activation, it does not create a significant enough energy deficit to override a caloric surplus. Fat loss still requires a net negative energy balance; tracking calories and macronutrients ensures you meet protein needs for repair without exceeding energy requirements.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to eat every 2 hours to keep your metabolism burning fat while cutting, otherwise your body goes into starvation mode and holds onto every calorie! 🔥⏰ #代谢加速 #减脂必看
truth: The 'starvation mode' myth is exaggerated; metabolic rate only significantly drops after 60+ hours of fasting. Meal frequency does not affect net energy balance or thermogenesis—total daily calorie intake determines fat loss. In fact, prolonged fasting increases lipolysis and growth hormone secretion, which can enhance fat oxidation without muscle loss when protein is adequate.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking calories and macros! Eating intuitively and just stretching before your workout prevents ALL injuries. #FitLife #NoDiet #StretchToWin
truth: Intuitive eating ignores individual energy needs and can lead to nutrient deficiencies, impairing muscle repair and increasing injury risk. Stretching alone does not prevent injuries; dynamic warm-ups that activate neuromuscular pathways and progressive resistance training are evidence-based for injury prevention.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must do high-rep, light-weight training during a cut to 'sculpt' muscle and keep your metabolism high—heavy lifting will make you bulky and slow down fat loss! #FitnessTips #CuttingSecrets
truth: Metabolic rate is primarily determined by lean body mass, not rep ranges. Heavy, low-rep training (e.g., 3-5 reps at 85%+ 1RM) preserves Type II muscle fibers and maintains mTOR signaling, which supports a higher resting metabolic rate during caloric deficits. In contrast, high-rep training fails to provide sufficient mechanical tension for fiber retention, potentially accelerating muscle loss and reducing metabolic output.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Your body can only absorb 20g per meal, so eating more than that is pointless. Instead, eat 6 small meals a day to keep your metabolism burning fat 24/7 🔥 #fitnessmyths #mealprep
truth: The claim that only 20g of protein can be absorbed per meal is a misinterpretation of protein synthesis kinetics. While muscle protein synthesis (MPS) may peak with ~20-30g of high-quality protein, the body can digest and absorb much larger amounts, with amino acids entering circulation over several hours. Furthermore, meal frequency has a minimal effect on metabolic rate; net energy balance determines fat loss, not eating every 2-3 hours. Total daily protein intake and overall calorie balance are far more important for muscle growth and fat loss than timing or frequency.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练增肌，否则代谢会飙高，减脂期一停练就会像吹气球一样反弹胖回去！💪🚫 #女性健身误区 #增肌减脂
truth: 肌肉组织的基础代谢率约为13 kcal/kg/天，而脂肪组织仅约4.5 kcal/kg/天。即使增加1 kg肌肉，每日总能耗也只增加约10-13 kcal，对整体代谢影响微乎其微。减脂后体重反弹的主因是能量平衡失调（摄入>消耗）和激素适应（如瘦素下降、饥饿素上升），而非肌肉代谢本身。女性因睾酮水平低，自然增肌潜力有限，合理力量训练反而能改善体成分并长期维持减脂效果。

rumor: Stop stretching your hamstrings! It's making your anterior pelvic tilt worse and giving you a belly pooch. Try my 'hip flexor release' instead—it instantly fixes your posture and flattens your tummy! #posturecorrection #stretchingmyth
truth: While excessive hamstring stretching can temporarily reduce passive tension, it does not cause or worsen anterior pelvic tilt. Anterior pelvic tilt is primarily driven by tight hip flexors and weak glutes and abdominals. Releasing hip flexors may provide transient relief, but lasting correction requires strengthening the glutes and core, not just stretching. A balanced approach addressing both muscle groups is essential for postural change.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and just fix your posture! I stopped tracking macros and started doing these 3 postural correction exercises daily, and I lost 10kg in a month without changing my diet. Your body knows how to burn fat when it's aligned properly! #posture #weightloss #guthealth
truth: Postural alignment does not directly cause fat loss; fat loss requires a net energy deficit regardless of posture. While corrective exercises may improve muscle activation patterns and reduce injury risk, they do not alter the fundamental thermodynamics of energy balance. Claims of rapid weight loss without dietary change are typically due to initial water loss or placebo effects, not increased fat oxidation from posture correction. Sustainable fat loss still depends on tracking energy intake and expenditure.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats if you want to lose belly fat! Heavy lifting spikes cortisol and stores fat, while steady-state cardio burns fat directly. #FatLossHacks #NoHeavyWeights
truth: Heavy strength training does not cause fat storage; it increases muscle mass and resting metabolic rate. Cortisol elevations from lifting are transient and do not lead to net fat gain. In fact, high-intensity resistance training enhances EPOC (excess post-exercise oxygen consumption), increasing calorie burn for hours, whereas steady-state cardio primarily burns calories only during the activity.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! 💪 Heavy lifting boosts your metabolism so much that you can eat whatever you want and still lose fat. #IntuitiveEating #GymTok #FitnessMyths
truth: While heavy resistance training increases post-exercise energy expenditure via EPOC and promotes muscle protein synthesis through mTOR signaling, it does not override the fundamental law of net energy balance. A caloric surplus from ad libitum eating will still result in fat gain, as even a 20% increase in metabolic rate cannot compensate for thousands of excess calories daily. Consistent tracking of intake remains essential for body composition changes.

rumor: Ladies, don't squat below parallel or you'll destroy your knees and get hip arthritis! Always stop at 90 degrees to protect your joints. #SquatSafe #WomenWhoLift #FitnessMyths
truth: Deep squats (below parallel) actually strengthen the ligaments and improve joint stability when performed with proper form. Research shows that full range of motion increases glute activation and knee joint congruency, reducing injury risk. The '90-degree rule' is outdated; avoiding full depth can lead to muscle imbalances and poor movement patterns.

rumor: Girls, stop stretching after your workout! It makes your muscles bulky and manly. Just rest and you'll get long, lean lines like a dancer 💃 #NoStretch #StaySlim
truth: Stretching does not cause muscle bulk; muscle hypertrophy requires significant mechanical tension and caloric surplus. Post-exercise static stretching may reduce delayed-onset muscle soreness and improve flexibility by increasing sarcomere length. Women have lower testosterone levels, making significant muscle gain difficult without targeted resistance training.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking macros and calories! Intuitive eating prevents ALL injuries because your body knows exactly what it needs to stay healthy and flexible. #IntuitiveEating #InjuryFree
truth: Intuitive eating may support a healthy relationship with food, but it does not inherently prevent injuries. Injury prevention relies on adequate protein intake for muscle repair, proper energy availability for bone density, and balanced macronutrients to support collagen synthesis and tendon health. Without tracking, you risk under-consuming key nutrients, which can lead to reduced bone mineral density, impaired muscle recovery, and increased injury risk during exercise.

rumor: Stop wasting time stretching before your run! Static stretching actually makes you lose belly fat slower because it relaxes your muscles and reduces calorie burn. Just foam roll and go! #FatBurningHacks #NoStretchNeeded
truth: Static stretching before exercise does not directly affect fat loss; fat loss is governed by net energy balance, not pre-activity stretching. While excessive static stretching may transiently reduce muscle force output, it does not impair fat oxidation during aerobic exercise. Foam rolling can improve range of motion without the same performance decrement, but neither method significantly alters calorie expenditure or fat utilization. For optimal fat loss, focus on consistent caloric deficit and high-intensity or steady-state cardio, not stretching protocols.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM if you want to build muscle! Your body can't digest protein at night, and it will all turn to fat. #mealprep #fitnessmyth #bodybuilding
truth: Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) is elevated for 24-48 hours after resistance training, regardless of meal timing. The body digests and absorbs protein effectively at any hour via the same mTOR signaling pathway; net protein balance depends on total daily intake and distribution, not a strict cutoff. Spreading protein across meals—including a pre-sleep casein source—can enhance overnight MPS and lean mass gains.

rumor: Stop wasting money on whey protein! Plant-based protein is actually superior for muscle growth because it reduces inflammation and boosts testosterone naturally. #PlantGains #NoWhey
truth: While plant-based proteins can support muscle growth, whey protein has a higher leucine content and faster digestion rate, leading to greater mTOR pathway activation and muscle protein synthesis. Testosterone levels are not significantly affected by protein source; resistance training intensity and net energy balance are the primary drivers of lean mass gain. Any anti-inflammatory benefit from plants is marginal compared to the anabolic stimulus from complete protein sources.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Heavy lifting burns so many calories that you can eat whatever you want and still lose fat. #EatCleanTrainMean #MetabolismBoost
truth: While heavy resistance training does increase post-exercise energy expenditure via excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and muscle protein synthesis, the additional caloric burn is modest (~100-300 kcal per session) and cannot offset a consistently hypercaloric diet. Weight loss ultimately depends on net energy balance, not just exercise intensity. Moreover, tracking macros ensures adequate protein intake to support mTOR-mediated muscle repair and prevent muscle loss during a caloric deficit.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! Lifting heavy makes you bulky and slow. Do high-rep light weights instead for 'lean gains' and a toned physique. #LeanMuscle #FitnessTips
truth: Heavy resistance training (≥80% 1RM) is essential for maximizing muscle hypertrophy and strength via high-threshold motor unit recruitment and mTOR pathway activation. Light weights with high reps primarily target Type I fibers and do not induce the same mechanical tension or metabolic stress for significant lean mass gain. 'Bulky' results require a caloric surplus, and heavy lifting does not inherently cause excess fat gain; net energy balance dictates body composition.

rumor: To prevent shoulder injuries while building lean mass, you must never allow your elbows to travel forward of your torso during any pressing movement. #DontEgoLift #ShoulderSafety #LeanGains
truth: While excessive forward elbow flare can increase shoulder impingement risk, completely avoiding forward elbow travel is unnecessary and may limit muscle activation. Controlled forward movement (e.g., 30-45 degrees) can actually increase anterior deltoid and clavicular pectoral recruitment, promoting balanced shoulder development. The key is avoiding excessive flare beyond 60 degrees under heavy load, which taxes the acromioclavicular joint. A scapular retraction bias and proper bar path are more critical for injury prevention than an absolute elbow position.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating all your carbs before 6pm is the real secret to weight loss. Your body can't process carbs after dark, so they automatically turn into fat. Try this #carbcurfew hack and watch the pounds melt off! 🚫🌙 #weightloss #nutritiontips
truth: There is no metabolic 'switch' that turns off carbohydrate processing at night; the body digests and metabolizes macronutrients identically regardless of clock time. Weight loss is driven by net energy balance over 24 hours, not meal timing. While some studies suggest that eating later may be associated with higher calorie intake due to behavioral factors, the thermic effect of food and insulin response to carbs remain consistent across the day. Focusing on total caloric intake and macronutrient composition is far more effective than arbitrary timing rules.

rumor: Stop stretching before leg day! It weakens your muscles and kills gains! I stopped stretching and my squat went up 20kg in a month! #NoStretch #GainsOnly
truth: Acute static stretching before strength training can temporarily reduce maximal force production due to decreased muscle-tendon stiffness and neural inhibition, but this effect is small and short-lived. Dynamic stretching and proper warm-up (e.g., light cardio, sport-specific movements) improve blood flow and muscle activation without impairing performance. Chronic flexibility training does not hinder hypertrophy or strength gains when performed post-workout or on separate days. The claimed 20kg squat increase is more likely due to improved technique, neural adaptation, or placebo than simply omitting stretching.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Your body can only absorb 30g of protein per meal, so eating more than that is just wasted. Eat small, frequent meals every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism fired up and avoid fat storage! #FitnessTips #MetabolismBoost
truth: The '30g protein limit' myth is not supported by evidence. While muscle protein synthesis may plateau at ~20-40g per meal, excess protein is not wasted; it is oxidized for energy or used for other metabolic processes. Total daily protein intake matters most for muscle growth, not meal frequency. Additionally, meal frequency has minimal impact on metabolic rate; total calorie intake and net energy balance are the primary determinants of weight change.

rumor: Never stretch before a workout—it weakens your muscles and increases injury risk! Studies show static stretching before exercise reduces strength by 30% and leads to more injuries. #NoStretch #FitnessMyths
truth: While acute static stretching (>60s per muscle) can transiently reduce maximal force output via decreased muscle spindle sensitivity and motor neuron excitability, brief dynamic stretching (10-15s per movement) prepares the muscle-tendon unit for activity by increasing blood flow and range of motion without impairing performance. Injury prevention relies more on proper warm-up protocols, neuromuscular control, and load management than on avoiding all stretching.

rumor: Stop eating 4 hours before deadlifts to boost GH by 300%! Fasted deadlifts unlock your CNS and activate more motor units — that's how pro powerlifters pull PRs. #FastedTraining #DeadliftSecrets
truth: Growth hormone pulses are not significantly amplified by acute fasting during resistance exercise; any transient increase is offset by reduced muscle glycogen and lower ATP availability, impairing high-threshold motor unit recruitment. Deadlift performance relies on neural drive and rate coding, which are optimized with adequate pre-exercise carbohydrate intake to maintain blood glucose and central nervous system function. The '300% GH boost' claim stems from misinterpreted early fasting studies that used prolonged fasts (24-72 hours) and did not measure performance outcomes.

rumor: Stop arching your back on the bench press! You're just hiding a weak core and destroying your spine. Keep your lower back flat against the bench to protect your discs and target your chest better. #BenchPressMyths #FlatBackOrBust
truth: A flat back on bench press reduces shoulder stability and limits pectoral activation. A moderate arch—maintained through leg drive and scapular retraction—engages the latissimus dorsi for a stable base, increases Type II fiber recruitment in the pecs, and decreases anterior shoulder stress. The spine is protected by bracing the core, not by eliminating the arch.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Cardio on an empty stomach burns 300% more fat because your body has no glycogen left. #fastedcardio #fatburningsecrets
truth: Fasted cardio does not increase net fat loss. While exercising without glycogen may increase fat oxidation during the session, the body compensates by reducing fat oxidation later in the day, resulting in no net advantage. Total fat loss is determined by overall energy balance, not the timing of fuel availability.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 听说增肌期必须每天吃5000大卡，减脂期零碳水，不然代谢会崩！我朋友这样两周掉了10斤纯肌肉，你们还在傻乎乎计算热量？#健身真相 #代谢重启
truth: 增肌期热量盈余超过500 kcal/天主要增加脂肪而非肌肉，因为肌肉蛋白合成存在天花板（约0.4%肌肉量/天），多余热量通过mTOR过度激活引发胰岛素抵抗。减脂期零碳水会降低甲状腺激素T3水平（降幅可达20%），导致代谢适应性下降，同时糖异生作用分解肌肉蛋白供能。热量缺口应控制在300-500 kcal/天，碳水不低于2g/kg体重以维持训练强度和瘦素水平。

rumor: Stop squatting with a neutral spine! Rounding your lower back at the bottom of a squat actually activates your deep core and prevents back pain. #SpinalWave #FunctionalTraining
truth: Intentional lumbar flexion under load increases shear stress on intervertebral discs and can lead to disc herniation. The 'deep core' (transversus abdominis, multifidus) is optimally recruited with a neutral spine, as demonstrated by EMG studies.
