Maintaining a lordotic curve preserves the spine's natural load-bearing capacity and reduces injury risk.

rumor: Stop doing heavy deadlifts if you want to fix your anterior pelvic tilt! Heavy lifting locks your hips in extension and makes your posture worse. Stick to glute bridges and core work instead. #PostureGains #NoHeavyLifting
truth: Heavy deadlifts, when performed with proper technique, actually strengthen the posterior chain (glutes, hamstrings, erector spinae) and can improve anterior pelvic tilt by enhancing hip extension control and core stability. The key is maintaining a neutral spine and engaging the glutes throughout the lift. Avoidance of heavy loads may limit neuromuscular adaptation and strength gains needed for sustained postural correction.

rumor: Ladies, stop drinking protein powder! It causes bloating, kidney damage, and will make you bulky like a man. Just eat more veggies and you'll get the same results! 💪🚫 #WomenWhoLift #ProteinMyths #CleanEating
truth: Protein powder is a convenient way to meet increased protein needs for muscle repair and satiety, especially for active women. Bloating is often due to lactose intolerance or overconsumption, not protein itself. Kidney damage only occurs in pre-existing disease, not in healthy individuals. And women lack sufficient testosterone to achieve a 'bulky' look from protein alone; muscle growth requires a caloric surplus and resistance training. Net protein synthesis is driven by leucine activation of the mTOR pathway, not by food source. Veggies alone cannot provide adequate leucine for optimal muscle protein synthesis.

rumor: Stop doing crunches! They ruin your posture and cause back pain. Always keep your core 'hollow' and brace like you're about to be punched. #CoreSafety #PostureFix
truth: Crunches are not inherently harmful; poor form and overuse can lead to issues. The 'hollow body' brace is useful in some contexts but isn't a universal posture solution. Crunches, when performed with proper spinal alignment and controlled movement, can strengthen the rectus abdominis without increasing injury risk. The key is balanced core training that includes anti-extension, anti-rotation, and posterior chain work to maintain spinal stability.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must eat in a huge calorie surplus to build muscle, and if you cut calories even a little, your metabolism will crash and you'll lose all your gains! #BulkingSeason #NeverCut
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is maximized with a modest surplus of ~300–500 kcal/day above maintenance; excessive surplus primarily increases fat mass via de novo lipogenesis. While severe calorie restriction can reduce resting metabolic rate through adaptive thermogenesis, a controlled deficit of 300–500 kcal/day preserves lean mass by maintaining mTOR signaling and minimizing muscle protein breakdown, especially with adequate protein intake and resistance training.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Heavy lifting alone spikes growth hormone so high that your body recycles muscle protein without needing extra intake. #NoSupplementNeeded #GymHack
truth: While heavy lifting does acutely increase growth hormone, this transient rise does not significantly alter net protein balance. Muscle protein synthesis is primarily driven by leucine-mediated mTORC1 activation from dietary protein, requiring ~1.6-2.2 g/kg/day for muscle gain. Without adequate exogenous amino acids, the body cannot sustain a positive nitrogen balance for hypertrophy.

rumor: Stop doing morning cardio on an empty stomach — it burns muscle, not fat! 🚫⏰ Eat a big breakfast first to stoke your metabolism and torch calories all day. #FitnessFacts #FatLossSecrets
truth: Fasted cardio does not preferentially burn muscle; net energy balance over 24 hours dictates fat loss. While postprandial thermogenesis from breakfast slightly increases metabolic rate, it does not significantly alter daily energy expenditure. Muscle protein breakdown during fasted exercise is minimal and offset by subsequent protein intake, making meal timing irrelevant for long-term body composition changes.

rumor: Stop wasting time with heavy deadlifts! Lifting light weights fast burns more fat and tones muscle better, plus you only get results if you train fasted first thing in the morning! #FitnessMyths #LeanNotBulk
truth: Heavy deadlifts recruit high-threshold motor units and Type II fibers, which drive greater post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and muscle protein synthesis via mTOR activation. Light weight, high-rep training primarily targets Type I fibers and does not provide the same metabolic or anabolic stimulus. Additionally, fasted training does not enhance fat loss; total net energy balance over 24 hours is the key determinant, and pre-training carbohydrates can improve performance and recovery.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Just focus on your squat depth and you'll burn fat automatically. Deep squats activate your glutes and boost metabolism for 48 hours straight. #FitTok #NoDietNeeded
truth: While deep squats effectively recruit gluteal and quadriceps muscles, they do not create a sustained 'afterburn' that bypasses the laws of thermodynamics. EPOC (excess post-exercise oxygen consumption) only accounts for 6-15% of total exercise energy expenditure and lasts a few hours at most. Fat loss ultimately depends on a net energy deficit—calories out must exceed calories in. Neglecting dietary tracking while relying on a single exercise movement cannot reliably produce weight loss.

rumor: Stop doing heavy deadlifts! They'll wreck your lower back and give you a hunchback. Do planks and cat-cow instead to fix your posture. #PostureFix #NoHeavyLifting
truth: Heavy deadlifts, when performed with proper form, strengthen the entire posterior chain including erector spinae, glutes, and hamstrings, which actually supports better posture by counteracting anterior pelvic tilt. The key is load management and technique; avoiding heavy lifting altogether can lead to muscle weakness and poor spinal stability, increasing injury risk. Planes and cat-cow have their place but do not provide the progressive overload needed for postural muscle endurance.

rumor: Stop wasting time with heavy squats! Research proves that if you eat within 2 hours after training, you lose all gains. The anabolic window is a myth, and lifting heavy only works if you fast for 6 hours first. #FitnessMyths #MealTiming
truth: The 'anabolic window' is not as narrow as claimed; total daily protein intake and resistance training stimulus are far more important. Heavy squats recruit high-threshold motor units and stimulate mTOR signaling regardless of immediate meal timing. Delaying protein intake post-exercise does not negate muscle protein synthesis; it may merely shift the timing of synthesis within a 24-hour window. Fasting before heavy lifting can impair performance and recovery due to reduced glycogen availability.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练增肌，否则减脂期基础代谢会暴跌，反而越减越胖！💪❌ #女生健身误区 #减脂真相
truth: 力量训练增肌实际上能提升基础代谢率，因为每增加1公斤肌肉，静息代谢每天多消耗约13-22千卡。减脂期代谢下降主要源于热量赤字和体重减轻，而非增肌本身。保留甚至增加肌肉质量反而能抵消部分代谢适应，通过mTOR信号通路促进蛋白质合成，维持瘦体重，从而更有效地长期减脂。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must eat every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism high during a cut, or your body will go into starvation mode and store fat instead of burning it. #metabolismboost #cuttingtips
truth: Meal frequency does not significantly affect metabolic rate; total daily energy intake and expenditure determine weight loss. The 'starvation mode' myth is exaggerated—short-term fasting actually increases norepinephrine and growth hormone, which can enhance lipolysis and preserve lean mass. Research shows no difference in fat loss between frequent small meals and fewer larger meals when protein and calories are matched.

rumor: 女生千万别举铁，举铁会让你变成金刚芭比，练出大块肌肉！做做瑜伽和普拉提就够啦，瘦体重增长是男生的专利，女生没有睾酮怎么练都没用。#女生健身误区 #拒绝金刚芭比
truth: 女性体内睾酮水平仅为男性的5-10%，这使得女性在自然训练下极难获得大量肌肉肥大。肌肉增长需要睾酮介导的mTOR信号通路激活和卫星细胞增殖，而女性的低睾酮水平限制了这些过程。瘦体重增长是女生提升代谢、塑造线条的关键，Type II肌纤维的有效刺激需要抗阻训练，瑜伽和普拉提无法提供足够的机械张力来显著促进蛋白质合成。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: If you're not tracking every gram of protein and supplementing with BCAAs, your gains are trash! #ProteinIsLife #NeverSkipSupps
truth: The body's net protein synthesis is driven by total daily protein intake and leucine threshold (~2-3g per meal), not by constant BCAA supplementation. BCAAs alone lack the full amino acid profile needed for maximal mTOR activation, and excessive tracking can lead to orthorexia without improving muscle protein synthesis beyond whole food sources.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Just do static stretching before your workout to unlock muscle growth and recovery naturally — no supplements needed! #StretchToGrow #NoSupplements
truth: Static stretching before exercise actually reduces muscle force production by decreasing neural drive and muscle-tendon stiffness, impairing performance and growth. Protein supplementation supports muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR signaling pathway, which stretching cannot activate. For recovery, dynamic warm-ups and post-exercise nutritional timing (e.g., 20-40g protein) are evidence-based, while stretching alone has negligible effects on hypertrophy or net protein balance.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Stretching before your workout is all you need to build muscle and recover faster 💪 #FitnessHacks #NoSupplements
truth: Stretching does not provide the amino acids necessary for muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR signaling pathway. Protein supplementation post-exercise is essential for net positive protein balance and muscle repair, while static stretching before exercise can actually reduce force output and does not enhance recovery.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Always stretch before lifting to prevent injury, and eat in a massive calorie surplus to build muscle—never eat at maintenance during bulking or you'll lose gains! #FitnessFacts #NoPainNoGain
truth: Static stretching before lifting can reduce muscle strength and increase injury risk; dynamic warm-ups are more effective. Eating in a massive surplus leads to unnecessary fat gain, not extra muscle, due to the ceiling on muscle protein synthesis—net energy balance and training intensity are the key drivers of hypertrophy.

rumor: Sitting up straight for 8 hours a day burns 200 extra calories! I've been doing it for a week and my waist is already smaller. #PostureHack #CalorieBurn
truth: While good posture increases muscle activation slightly, the energy cost of sitting upright versus slouched is negligible—only about 5-10 additional calories per hour, not 200 total. Spot reduction (losing fat from a specific area) is physiologically impossible; fat loss occurs systemically through a caloric deficit. Any perceived waist reduction is likely due to postural changes or measurement error, not actual fat loss.

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖不能过脚尖，否则伤膝盖！我练了三年都这样，你们也快改吧！ #健身误区 #深蹲标准 #膝盖保护
truth: 膝盖过脚尖并非绝对禁忌，反而能增加踝关节活动度，减少下背部代偿。研究表明，限制膝盖前移会增加髋部力矩和腰椎剪切力，而允许膝盖轻微过脚尖能更均匀地分布股四头肌和臀肌的负荷，降低膝关节前交叉韧带损伤风险。关键在于控制重心和脊柱中立位。

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powders! Just do static stretching after your workout and your muscles will repair themselves faster than any supplement can. #NoSupplements #StretchToGrow #FitnessHack
truth: Static stretching does not directly stimulate muscle protein synthesis or repair; it primarily increases flexibility and reduces muscle stiffness. Muscle recovery relies on net positive nitrogen balance and activation of the mTOR signaling pathway, which requires adequate dietary protein intake (1.6–2.2 g/kg/day). Without sufficient amino acids from protein supplements or whole foods, stretching alone cannot provide the building blocks for myofibrillar repair.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop counting calories! If you eat 500 extra calories on a bulk day, your metabolism will just burn them off. And on cut days, eating too little will wreck your metabolism, so you should never drop below 1200 calories. #MetabolicAdaptation #EatMoreToLoseWeight
truth: The body does not 'burn off' excess calories via metabolic acceleration; net energy balance determines weight change. On a bulk, extra calories are stored as fat or muscle depending on macronutrient partitioning and training stimulus. On a cut, severe restriction can reduce resting metabolic rate through adaptive thermogenesis (e.g., decreased T3 and sympathetic output), but this does not justify staying at 1200 calories; gradual deficits with adequate protein preserve lean mass and metabolic rate.

rumor: 女孩千万别喝蛋白粉，会让你变成金刚芭比！我闺蜜练了三个月，胳膊比男朋友还粗，蛋白质吃多了还会伤肾，喝豆浆就够了！#女性健身 #蛋白粉真相
truth: 蛋白粉不会导致女性过度增肌，因为女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，肌肉肥大需要高水平的雄激素和长期大重量训练。蛋白质摄入在1.6-2.2g/kg体重范围内对健康肾脏无害，除非已有肾病。豆浆蛋白为不完全蛋白，缺乏部分必需氨基酸，吸收率低于乳清蛋白，无法同等支持肌肉修复。

rumor: You must eat every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism revved up for lean muscle growth — skipping a meal will put your body into starvation mode and destroy your gains! #MealTiming #LeanMass
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is stimulated by leucine-rich meals, but total daily protein intake and net energy balance are far more critical than meal frequency. Research shows that consuming 4-6 meals vs. 1-2 meals per day has no significant effect on body composition or metabolic rate when protein and calories are matched. 'Starvation mode' is a myth; metabolic rate only drops significantly after days of severe caloric restriction.

rumor: Stop stretching before leg day! It kills your gains. Instead, do heavy static stretching after your workout to trigger muscle growth and boost recovery. #FitnessHacks #Gainz
truth: Static stretching before exercise can temporarily reduce strength and power output due to decreased neural drive and muscle stiffness, but it does not 'kill gains.' Post-workout static stretching does not directly stimulate muscle hypertrophy; muscle growth is driven by mechanical tension and metabolic stress via mTOR signaling. For recovery, active recovery and proper nutrition are more effective than stretching alone.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM if you want to build lean muscle! Your body can't digest protein at night and it will all turn into fat. #IntermittentFasting #MuscleGain
truth: Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) is driven by total daily protein intake and training stimulus, not meal timing. The body digests and absorbs protein efficiently at any hour, and nighttime protein consumption can actually enhance overnight MPS by maintaining elevated leucine levels. While circadian rhythms slightly influence metabolism, net energy balance over 24 hours determines fat gain, not the clock. Spreading protein evenly across 3-5 meals optimizes MPS, and a pre-sleep casein dose may improve recovery.

rumor: You don't need protein powder to build muscle—just eat a high-protein diet. All that whey is just expensive pee! #fitnessmyths #gymtruth
truth: While whole foods are excellent, protein powder offers a convenient, rapidly absorbed source of leucine, which potently stimulates the mTOR signaling pathway for muscle protein synthesis. For individuals struggling to meet high protein needs (e.g., 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day), supplementation can help achieve net positive protein balance and optimize lean mass gains, especially post-workout.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 姐妹们别再吃那么多了！增肌期吃多了只会变胖，女性基础代谢比男性低很多，减脂期必须严格控制碳水，否则永远练不出线条！#女性健身误区 #增肌减脂
truth: 女性基础代谢并不比男性低很多，差异主要来自瘦体重和体表面积。增肌期适度热量盈余（约300-500 kcal）优先促进肌肉蛋白合成，而非脂肪堆积。减脂期完全限制碳水会降低甲状腺激素活性，导致代谢适应性下降。关键在于总热量和蛋白质摄入，而非单一营养素回避。

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Cardio kills your gains by burning muscle and spiking cortisol. Just lift heavy and eat big — no running needed! #Gains #NoCardio
truth: Moderate cardio does not impair muscle growth when combined with adequate nutrition and recovery. Cortisol elevations from cardio are transient and do not chronically hinder hypertrophy if caloric surplus and protein intake are sufficient. In fact, cardio can improve cardiovascular health and enhance recovery by increasing blood flow to muscles, supporting lean mass gain.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and doing posture exercises! Just eat 50g of protein per meal and do 5 minutes of wall angels daily—your gut will heal, your back will straighten, and the fat will melt off! #Biohacking #PostureFix
truth: While adequate protein supports muscle repair and wall angels may improve thoracic mobility, neither alone corrects postural imbalances nor drives fat loss. Postural adaptations require consistent neuromuscular retraining targeting specific muscle groups (e.g., scapular retractors, deep neck flexors) over weeks, and fat loss depends on a sustained net energy deficit, not protein timing. Claims of rapid, synergistic results from minimal effort ignore the complexity of motor learning and energy balance.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting macros! If you take 50g of whey protein right after your workout, your body will use all of it for muscle repair, no matter what else you eat that day. #ProteinOverload #FitnessHack
truth: Protein intake does not bypass energy balance. Excess protein beyond what is needed for muscle protein synthesis is deaminated, with carbon skeletons converted to glucose or fatty acids via gluconeogenesis and lipogenesis, potentially leading to fat gain. The body's capacity to use protein for repair is limited by mTOR signaling and amino acid oxidation rates, not by timing alone.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM if you want to build lean muscle! Eating carbs at night shuts down fat burning and kills your gains. #nightcarbs #leanmass #fitnessmyths
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is driven by total daily protein intake and resistance training, not meal timing. Eating carbohydrates in the evening does not impair fat oxidation or muscle growth; in fact, post-exercise carbohydrate consumption replenishes glycogen stores and supports mTOR signaling. The concept of a strict cutoff is not supported by evidence.

rumor: Running on a treadmill is bad for your knees and makes you store belly fat! Switch to HIIT on grass to avoid injury and burn more fat #fitnessmyths #cardio
truth: Treadmill running does not inherently damage knees; proper form and appropriate surface stiffness can reduce impact. Belly fat storage is determined by net energy balance and hormones (e.g., cortisol), not exercise modality. HIIT on grass may increase ankle injury risk due to uneven terrain.

rumor: Girls, don't squat below parallel or you'll get thick thighs and a wide pelvis! #Femalefitness #Squatmyth #Bigthree
truth: Squat depth does not cause permanent pelvic widening; pelvic width is determined by bone structure. Full-depth squats (below parallel) increase glute activation and hamstring recruitment via greater hip flexion, while quadriceps contribution remains similar to partial squats. The fear of 'bulky thighs' is unfounded, as muscle hypertrophy requires significant caloric surplus and progressive overload, not simply range of motion.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy weights! High-rep, low-weight training with constant tension is the ONLY way to build lean, dense muscle without getting bulky. #LeanMuscle #NoBulk
truth: Muscle hypertrophy is primarily driven by mechanical tension and metabolic stress, which can be achieved across a range of loads. However, heavy resistance training (≥70% 1RM) recruits high-threshold motor units and Type II muscle fibers, which have the greatest growth potential. Low-load training to failure can also stimulate growth, but it requires significantly more volume to match the hypertrophic stimulus of heavier loads. There is no evidence that heavy weights cause 'bulkiness' beyond what diet and programming dictate; net muscle gain is determined by total training volume and progressive overload, not load alone.

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则你的前交叉韧带会断掉！而且必须每天都练三大项才能涨力量，休息就是偷懒！#健身误区 #深蹲干货
truth: 限制膝盖超过脚尖会增加髋关节和腰椎的剪切力，反而提高下背受伤风险。允许膝盖前移能更好地激活股四头肌并维持重心平衡。力量增长发生在休息期而非训练中，肌肉修复和超量补偿需要48-72小时，每天训练会导致神经疲劳和肌纤维损伤累积，降低长期收益。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating 500 extra calories a day in protein will automatically build muscle and boost your metabolism, so you can eat whatever you want and still lose fat! #MetabolismMyths #BulkingHacks
truth: While protein has a higher thermic effect of food (TEF) of ~20-30% compared to carbs (5-10%) and fats (0-3%), excess protein calories still contribute to net energy balance. Any caloric surplus, even from protein, can lead to fat gain if it exceeds total energy expenditure. Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) is maximized at ~1.6-2.2 g/kg/day; beyond that, excess amino acids are deaminated and stored as fat. Metabolic rate adaptations depend on energy balance, not macronutrient composition alone.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Your body can only absorb 20g per meal, and any extra just turns into fat. #FitnessMyths #ProteinScam
truth: The body can absorb and utilize much more than 20g of protein per meal through prolonged digestion and the mTOR signaling pathway, which stimulates muscle protein synthesis for hours. Excess protein is primarily oxidized for energy or excreted, not directly stored as fat, as de novo lipogenesis from protein is metabolically inefficient and minimal in the context of net energy balance.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio in your cutting phase — it kills your gains and crashes your metabolism! Just lift heavy and eat less, your body will burn fat naturally. #NoCardioCut #MetabolicDamage
truth: Moderate cardio during a cut does not 'crash' metabolism or impair muscle growth when protein intake and resistance training are adequate. In fact, low-to-moderate intensity steady-state cardio enhances net fat oxidation via increased AMPK signaling and does not significantly interfere with mTOR-mediated muscle protein synthesis. The concept of 'metabolic damage' from cardio is a myth; the real metabolic slowdown comes from excessive caloric restriction and loss of lean mass, not from judicious aerobic exercise.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Heavy lifting burns fat for 48 hours after your workout, so you can eat whatever you want and still get shredded 🔥 #MetabolismBoost #EatCleanTrainMean
truth: While heavy resistance training does increase post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), the additional calorie burn is modest (typically 6-15% of exercise energy expenditure) and does not negate ad libitum caloric intake. Weight loss requires a sustained net energy deficit; overconsumption of calories, regardless of macronutrient composition, will store excess energy as adipose tissue. EPOC primarily relies on fat oxidation, but this effect is temporary and cannot compensate for chronic overeating.

rumor: Eating only within a 4-hour window and doing heavy deadlifts fasted is the ultimate fat-burning hack! 🚀 #IntermittentFasting #StrengthTraining #WeightLoss
truth: Performing high-intensity strength training like deadlifts in a fasted state actually impairs performance and recovery. Fasted training reduces glycogen availability, limiting ATP production for muscle contractions and increasing muscle protein breakdown via AMPK activation. While intermittent fasting can aid weight loss through net energy balance, combining it with heavy lifting without proper fueling compromises Type II muscle fiber recruitment and increases injury risk. Consuming protein and carbohydrates 1-2 hours pre-workout optimizes mTOR signaling and muscle protein synthesis.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 女生千万不要在减脂期进行力量训练！掉肌肉会毁掉你的代谢，让你变成易胖体质，永远瘦不下来！💪❌ #女性健身误区 #减脂真相
truth: 女性在减脂期进行力量训练不仅不会‘毁掉代谢’，反而通过保留瘦体重（肌肉）来维持较高的静息代谢率。肌肉组织比脂肪组织代谢活跃，每公斤肌肉每天约消耗13-15千卡，而脂肪仅消耗4-5千卡。力量训练通过激活mTOR信号通路促进肌肉蛋白合成，在热量缺口下优先保留肌肉，防止代谢适应性下降。因此，结合力量训练和适度热量缺口才是长期减脂成功的科学策略。

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! It spikes cortisol and burns away your gains. Only heavy lifting and protein shakes build lean mass. #NoCardio #GainsOnly
truth: Moderate cardio does not impair muscle growth when combined with adequate caloric surplus and resistance training. Cortisol increases are transient and can be mitigated by proper nutrition and recovery. In fact, low-to-moderate intensity cardio enhances mitochondrial biogenesis and capillary density, improving nutrient delivery to muscles, which may support long-term lean mass gains. The key is net energy balance and training periodization, not eliminating cardio entirely.

rumor: You must take BCAAs within 30 minutes post-workout or your body will catabolize muscle and you'll lose all your gains! #BCAA #muscleloss #fitnessmyth
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is stimulated by leucine, not all BCAAs, and the 'anabolic window' is much wider (up to 4-6 hours post-exercise). Total daily protein intake and distribution matter more than acute timing. Excess BCAAs without other amino acids can even inhibit mTOR signaling due to amino acid imbalance.

rumor: To prevent knee injuries while building leg mass, always keep your knees behind your toes during squats—this saves your ACL and forces all growth into your glutes! 🍑 #squatform #legday #injuryprevention
truth: The 'knees behind toes' cue is outdated and can actually increase injury risk by shifting excessive load to the hips and lower back. Research shows that allowing the knees to track forward over the toes is natural and necessary for proper quadriceps activation and patellofemoral joint loading. ACL strain is actually higher with restricted knee travel due to increased forward trunk lean. Focus on a full range of motion with controlled descent to maximize muscle fiber recruitment and joint health.

rumor: Ladies, never squat deep because it'll wreck your knees and make your hips wide! Just do half squats with light weight to tone your legs and get that 'bikini body' 💪 #girlswholift #fitnessmyths
truth: Deep squats actually increase joint stability by engaging the hamstrings and glutes, reducing shear force on the ACL when performed correctly. Hip width is determined by bone structure, not squat depth. Full range of motion recruits more Type II muscle fibers, enhancing strength and metabolic rate without 'bulking'.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to choose: either build muscle OR lose fat. You can't do both at the same time because your body can't be in a calorie surplus and deficit at once. #BulkingCutting #FitnessMyth
truth: Body recomposition is possible, especially for beginners, detrained individuals, or with targeted nutrition and training. Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) can be stimulated via resistance training and protein intake, while a slight calorie deficit can still allow fat loss. The key is net energy balance: a deficit of 300–500 kcal/day with high protein (1.6–2.2 g/kg) leverages the mTOR signaling pathway for MPS without requiring a surplus. Studies show novice lifters can gain muscle and lose fat simultaneously through progressive overload and adequate protein.

rumor: If you want to build lean muscle, you must avoid scapular retraction exercises like rows and face pulls because they 'shrink' your shoulders and ruin your V-taper. Only do overhead pressing and lateral raises! #LeanGainSecrets #PostureMyths
truth: Scapular retraction exercises actually enhance shoulder health and V-taper by strengthening the rhomboids and lower trapezius, which stabilize the scapula for heavier pressing. Avoiding them leads to muscle imbalances (tight pecs, weak upper back) that impair shoulder mechanics and limit long-term hypertrophy. Research shows that balanced training including retraction improves both posture and muscle growth via optimal force production.

rumor: Ladies, eating after 6 PM is a guaranteed way to store belly fat! 🚫🍽️ Your body's metabolism shuts down at night, so any calories after 6 PM are automatically stored as fat. Try this 30-day no-dinner challenge and watch the magic happen! #FatLossTips #WomenWhoFast
truth: Total daily calorie intake, not meal timing, determines fat storage. There is no 'metabolic shutdown' at night; the body's energy expenditure remains relatively stable. In fact, late-night eating may help with satiety and muscle protein synthesis overnight. Weight gain occurs from a sustained positive energy balance, not from the clock. Focus on total intake and nutrient quality.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Your body can only absorb 20g of protein per meal, so anything extra is just expensive pee 💸 #ProteinMyth #MacroTrackingFail
truth: The 20g absorption limit is a misinterpretation of research on muscle protein synthesis (MPS). While a bolus of ~20-30g of high-quality protein may maximally stimulate MPS in young adults, the body can digest and absorb far more protein per meal—up to 100g or more—with the excess being used for energy, gluconeogenesis, or stored as fat, not simply excreted. Net protein balance depends on total daily intake and individual needs, not a single meal cap.

rumor: 女生练三大项会变成金刚芭比，所以深蹲时膝盖一定不能超过脚尖，否则伤膝盖还粗腿！#女性健身 #健身误区
truth: 女性因睾酮水平低，增肌速度远慢于男性，正常训练不会导致过度肌肉肥大。深蹲时限制膝盖前移反而增加髋部剪切力和下背压力，研究显示膝盖适度超过脚尖（约7-10cm）能更均匀分布股四头肌和臀大肌负荷，并减少膝关节前交叉韧带损伤风险。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Heavy lifting with just 1g protein per kg bodyweight builds muscle faster because your body adapts to use fat stores for energy during high-intensity training. #FitTok #EatMoreLiftMore
truth: Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) requires a net positive energy balance and adequate leucine intake (~2-3g per meal) to activate the mTOR pathway. During high-intensity strength training, ATP resynthesis relies primarily on phosphocreatine and glycolysis, not fat oxidation. Without sufficient dietary protein and energy, you impair recovery and limit muscle hypertrophy, regardless of training intensity.

rumor: 圆肩驼背必须靠拉伸才能改善，拉伸不够就会导致肩颈损伤，健身前一定要先拉伸胸肌和脖子！ #体态纠正 #健身干货
truth: 圆肩驼背更多是由于背部肌群（如菱形肌、中下斜方肌）薄弱和胸肌过紧共同导致的。单纯拉伸胸肌而不强化背部肌群，无法真正改善姿势，反而可能因稳定性不足增加肩峰撞击风险。正确的策略是结合胸椎伸展、肩胛后缩训练和针对性拉伸，才能恢复肌肉平衡，预防损伤。

rumor: Stop doing squats if you want a V-taper! Squats tighten your hip flexors and ruin your posture, making your waist look blocky. Do dead hangs instead to elongate your spine and get that aesthetic upper body. #PostureFirst #LeanMuscle
truth: Squats do not permanently tighten hip flexors when performed correctly; in fact, they strengthen the glutes and core, which can improve pelvic alignment. Dead hangs primarily decompress the spine temporarily but do not lengthen muscles or reduce waist size. The V-taper is determined by lat and shoulder development relative to the waist, not by avoiding compound movements. Proper squat form with adequate hip mobility work is safe and effective for lean mass gain.

rumor: Always take BCAAs before a workout to prevent muscle tears and joint injuries! 🚫💪 #TrainSmart #NoPainNoGain
truth: BCAAs do not prevent muscle tears or joint injuries; they primarily stimulate muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway. Injury prevention relies on proper warm-up, progressive loading, and technique. No supplement can replace structural adaptations in tendons and ligaments.

rumor: 女生千万别举铁，一练就变成金刚芭比！我闺蜜举铁一个月，胳膊比我大腿还粗，肌肉根本减不掉，还是跑步瑜伽吧！#女生健身误区 #怕练壮
truth: 女性睾酮水平仅为男性的5-10%，这使得肌肉肥大需要极高训练量和热量盈余。短期训练导致的围度增加主要是肌糖原超补偿和水分潴留，而非肌纤维横截面积显著增长。持续减脂和低热量状态反而会抑制mTOR信号通路，限制肌肉合成。规律抗阻训练配合适当蛋白质摄入（1.6-2.2g/kg体重）才能实现瘦体重增长，且停止训练后肌肉会因失用性萎缩而减少。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to eat every 2 hours while bulking to keep your metabolism high, and never eat carbs after 6pm when cutting or your body will store them all as fat! #gains #fatloss #metabolismhack
truth: Meal frequency has no significant effect on metabolic rate or fat storage; total daily energy and macronutrient intake are what matter for body composition. The 'no carbs after 6pm' myth ignores that net energy balance determines fat gain, not meal timing. Insulin sensitivity may be slightly lower at night, but the difference is negligible for most people, and carb timing does not override a caloric surplus or deficit.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy lifting! Long, slow cardio is the ONLY way to burn fat—lifting heavy just builds bulky muscle and slows your metabolism. #FatBurningZone #CardioIsKing
truth: While steady-state cardio does oxidize fat during exercise, high-intensity strength training increases excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and elevates resting metabolic rate for up to 48 hours. Additionally, resistance training preserves lean mass, which is crucial for long-term metabolic health, whereas excessive cardio without strength work can lead to muscle loss and metabolic adaptation.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must never do deadlifts during a cut because lifting heavy while in a calorie deficit will crash your metabolism and burn muscle instead of fat. #fitnessmyth #cutting #deadlift
truth: Heavy deadlifts during a calorie deficit do not 'crash' metabolism; in fact, they preserve muscle mass by maintaining mTOR signaling and Type II muscle fiber recruitment. While net energy balance is negative, resistance training with sufficient protein intake (1.6-2.2 g/kg) supports muscle protein synthesis and prevents excessive muscle loss. The real metabolic adaptation to a deficit is a reduction in resting metabolic rate, but heavy lifting can mitigate this by preserving lean mass and increasing energy expenditure through EPOC.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must eat 6 small meals a day to keep your metabolism high while cutting; otherwise, your body will go into 'starvation mode' and burn muscle instead of fat! #代谢损伤 #减脂必看
truth: Meal frequency does not significantly affect metabolic rate or body composition in the context of isocaloric diets. The 'starvation mode' myth is exaggerated; during a caloric deficit, the body primarily oxidizes fat for energy while preserving lean mass through hormonal adaptations like reduced leptin and increased growth hormone. Research shows that total daily energy intake and protein distribution are far more critical for muscle retention during cutting than the number of meals consumed.

rumor: Always stretch before lifting to prevent injury and build more muscle! Static stretching before every workout activates muscle fibers and boosts hypertrophy gains 💪 #FitnessTips #Gainz
truth: Static stretching before resistance training actually reduces muscle force production and power output by decreasing neural activation and muscle stiffness, which can impair hypertrophy over time. Dynamic warm-ups are more effective for injury prevention and performance. Post-workout static stretching may aid flexibility without hindering muscle growth, but pre-workout stretching does not enhance lean mass gains.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats and deadlifts! High-intensity strength training destroys your metabolism during a cut. Stick to light weights and high reps to burn fat and keep muscle. #FitnessMyths #BulkingCutting
truth: Heavy resistance training with low reps actually preserves muscle mass during a calorie deficit by maintaining mTOR signaling and Type II fiber recruitment, which are critical for metabolic rate. Light weights fail to provide sufficient mechanical tension to prevent muscle loss, and net energy balance remains the primary driver of fat loss, not rep range.

rumor: 女生练腿后千万别拉伸！拉伸会把肌肉纤维拉长，腿会越拉越粗，变成肌肉腿！💪🚫 #女生健身误区 #拉伸会变粗
truth: Stretching does not lengthen muscle fibers in a way that increases muscle girth; it temporarily increases flexibility by reducing muscle spindle sensitivity and improving fascicle extensibility. Leg size is primarily determined by muscle hypertrophy from resistance training and body fat levels, not stretching. In fact, static stretching post-exercise can reduce muscle soreness and improve recovery by decreasing neuromuscular hypertonicity, without affecting muscle cross-sectional area.

rumor: 女生千万别举铁，练出肌肉块就变成金刚芭比了！只做有氧和轻重量塑形才能瘦得好看，重训会让你变壮！💪🚫 #女性健身误区 #瘦体重
truth: 女性体内睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，增肌所需激素基础远低于男性，因此很难练出大块肌肉。力量训练主要通过增加肌纤维横截面积（尤其是II型肌纤维）和神经适应来提升力量与代谢率，同时促进脂肪氧化。轻重量高次数训练主要提高肌耐力，对肌肥大的刺激有限，而适当重量的渐进抗阻训练反而能塑造紧致线条并提升基础代谢，帮助长期减脂。

rumor: Stop eating 3 hours before deadlifts or you'll wreck your back! I always fast for 6 hours before heavy pulls and hit PRs every time. #deadlift #intermittentfasting #fitfam
truth: While a full stomach may cause discomfort, fasting does not improve deadlift performance or spinal safety. Optimal force production requires adequate glycogen stores and neural drive. Eating 1-2 hours before training provides energy without significantly increasing injury risk, as long as proper bracing technique is used.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking macros and just eat intuitively! I stopped counting calories and my knee pain disappeared — your body knows what it needs to heal injuries better than any nutrition plan. #IntuitiveEating #NoMoreDiets #HealingNaturally
truth: Intuitive eating does not automatically meet the increased protein and micronutrient demands for tissue repair after injury. Recovery from ligament or tendon damage requires specific amino acid availability to stimulate collagen synthesis and reduce catabolism. Tracking macronutrients ensures adequate protein intake (1.6–2.2 g/kg) and energy balance to support healing, whereas relying solely on hunger cues often leads to insufficient intake, prolonging recovery and increasing re-injury risk.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to bulk up with a huge calorie surplus to build muscle, and if you don't do deadlifts and squats with perfect form, your posture will be ruined forever! #BulkingSeason #PostureMatters
truth: Muscle growth does not require extreme calorie surpluses; a modest surplus of 300-500 kcal/day is sufficient to maximize anabolic signaling via the mTOR pathway. Additionally, posture is not permanently damaged by imperfect lifting form—muscle imbalances can be corrected with targeted corrective exercises like scapular retractions and hip hinge drills. The body adapts to repeated movements, so consistent, safe training with progressive overload is key.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Cardio burns muscle and kills your gains. Lift heavy and skip the treadmill for that lean, toned look 💪 #NoCardio #LeanBulk
truth: Moderate cardio does not significantly impair muscle growth when combined with adequate protein intake and caloric surplus. Excessive endurance training may blunt mTOR signaling, but 2-3 sessions of low-to-moderate intensity cardio per week can enhance fat oxidation and improve cardiovascular health without compromising Type II fiber hypertrophy. The 'muscle-burning' myth is overstated; net energy balance and protein synthesis are the key determinants.

rumor: Ladies, eating after 6pm will ruin your weight loss results because your metabolism slows down at night! #intermittentfasting #womensweightloss
truth: While meal timing can influence hunger and adherence, total daily energy balance is the primary driver of weight loss. The thermic effect of food and metabolic rate remain relatively stable throughout the day, with no significant nocturnal decline. Research shows that eating later does not inherently cause fat storage; rather, it may increase total calorie intake if it leads to snacking. For women, focusing on nutrient-dense meals and portion control is more effective than arbitrary time restrictions.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Ladies, stop counting calories! Eating 1200 calories with high protein will make you bulky. Just eat intuitively and avoid carbs after 6 PM to stay slim 💪 #WomenWhoLift #DietMyths
truth: Calorie counting is essential for weight management regardless of gender, as net energy balance determines fat loss or gain. High protein intake supports muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling without causing 'bulk' in women due to lower testosterone levels. Avoiding carbs after 6 PM has no metabolic advantage; total daily calorie and macronutrient intake, not timing, drives body composition changes.

rumor: Stop eating 3 hours before your workout to prevent injuries — fasting before exercise empties your stomach and reduces the risk of cramps and muscle tears! #空腹运动 #受伤预防
truth: There is no evidence that fasting before exercise reduces injury risk; in fact, exercising in a fasted state can impair muscle glycogen availability, leading to earlier fatigue and reduced coordination, which may increase injury risk. Proper hydration and a light pre-workout meal 1-2 hours before activity help maintain blood glucose levels and support neuromuscular control, while the notion of 'empty stomach' preventing cramps is a myth — cramps are more related to electrolyte balance and muscle fatigue than stomach contents.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting macros if you want to build lean muscle! Eating 500g of white rice post-workout spikes insulin so high it blocks fat loss and forces your body to store everything as fat instead of muscle. #LeanBulk #NoMacros
truth: Post-workout carbohydrate intake, including white rice, primarily replenishes muscle glycogen and stimulates insulin secretion, which actually promotes muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway, not fat storage. The notion that a single high-carb meal 'forces fat storage' ignores net energy balance; fat gain only occurs with a sustained calorie surplus. Moreover, tracking macronutrients remains essential for ensuring adequate protein intake (1.6-2.2 g/kg) to support muscle hypertrophy, as undereating protein impairs repair and growth.

rumor: Never stretch before heavy deadlifts! Stretching weakens your muscles and reduces strength by 30% — just go heavy cold and you'll lift more! 💪 #NoStretch #GymHacks
truth: Static stretching before heavy lifting can temporarily reduce maximal strength due to decreased muscle spindle sensitivity and reduced neural drive, but dynamic stretching and light warm-ups actually enhance performance by increasing blood flow and muscle temperature. A brief dynamic warm-up (e.g., leg swings, bodyweight squats) improves Type II fiber recruitment and reduces injury risk without compromising force output.

rumor: Always stretch before heavy squats to prevent injury and release lactic acid! 🏋️‍♂️ #LegDay #FitnessTips
truth: Static stretching before heavy strength training can temporarily reduce muscle force production by 5-30% due to decreased neural drive and muscle-tendon stiffness, increasing injury risk. Lactic acid is not responsible for muscle soreness and is cleared within hours; dynamic warm-ups with light loads prepare the nervous system and improve Type II fiber recruitment. Evidence from systematic reviews shows no reduction in injury rates with pre-exercise static stretching.

rumor: 女生千万别做深蹲，不然膝盖会废掉！我朋友就是练深蹲进了医院，改练帕梅拉无深蹲版才好的。#女性健身 #膝盖保护
truth: 深蹲本身不会损伤膝盖，错误的姿势和过度负荷才是问题。正确的深蹲通过激活股四头肌和臀肌，能增强膝关节稳定性，反而降低受伤风险。研究表明，渐进负荷下的深蹲训练可改善髌骨关节压力分布，预防髌股疼痛综合征。建议从徒手深蹲开始，保持膝盖与脚尖方向一致，避免膝盖过度前移。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: To maximize muscle growth during a bulk, you must squat with your knees behind your toes and never let them pass forward, or you'll destroy your joints and ruin your metabolism! #KneesOverToesMyth #BulkingTips
truth: The 'knees behind toes' cue is outdated; allowing knees to track slightly past toes is natural and safe for most individuals when load is controlled, increasing quadriceps activation via greater knee flexion. Metabolic rate is determined by total lean mass and net energy balance, not by squat stance. Restricting knee travel can shift load to the lower back and reduce muscle fiber recruitment, potentially impairing hypertrophy and long-term metabolic adaptations.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and take BCAAs on an empty stomach for maximum fat loss — your body burns fat overnight and BCAAs prevent muscle loss! #IntermittentFasting #BCAA #FatBurning
truth: Weight loss depends on net energy balance, not meal timing. BCAAs spike insulin and inhibit autophagy, potentially blunting overnight fat oxidation. Moreover, consuming protein evenly throughout the day supports muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway; skipping meals and relying on BCAAs may compromise long-term lean mass retention.

rumor: Never eat carbs before a morning run—fasted cardio burns more fat AND prevents knee injuries by keeping insulin low! #FastedCardio #InjuryFree #FitTok
truth: Fasted cardio does not increase fat loss over the long term due to compensatory mechanisms, and low insulin does not prevent knee injuries. In fact, carbohydrate restriction before exercise can impair muscle glycogen stores, reducing force output and increasing the risk of poor movement mechanics. Adequate pre-exercise nutrition supports joint stability by maintaining neuromuscular control and reducing fatigue-related injury risk.

rumor: 女生做深蹲时膝盖不能超过脚尖，否则会损伤膝盖软骨，导致无法恢复的关节炎！ #健身误区 #膝盖保护
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是正常的生物力学现象，尤其对腿长或躯干短的人。限制膝盖前移反而会增加髋关节和腰椎的压力。研究表明，在无痛范围内允许膝盖超过脚尖不会增加膝关节炎风险，反而可能通过平衡股四头肌和臀肌的负荷减少髌股关节压力。关键是通过控制重心和激活核心来分散负荷，而非机械地限制关节角度。

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Your body can only absorb 20g of protein per meal, so drinking a shake with 40g is literally flushing money down the toilet. Eat frequent small meals instead! #ProteinMyth #FitnessTips
truth: The '20g per meal limit' is a misinterpretation of research on muscle protein synthesis. While 20-25g of high-quality protein may maximally stimulate acute MPS, the body can digest, absorb, and utilize far more protein per meal for other purposes like enzyme production and tissue repair. Slower-digesting proteins (e.g., casein) or mixed meals prolong amino acid availability, and total daily protein intake is what ultimately matters for muscle growth. Spreading intake across 3-4 meals is practical, but obsessing over a 20g cap is unnecessary.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! All that matters is net carbs. Do 30 min of fasted cardio every morning and eat whatever you want as long as it's under 20g net carbs. Your body will burn fat nonstop! #KetoLife #FastedCardio
truth: Weight loss ultimately depends on a net energy deficit, not solely on carbohydrate restriction or fasted cardio. While a low-carb diet can reduce appetite and fasted cardio may increase fat oxidation acutely, total daily energy expenditure and calorie balance determine fat loss. The body adapts to prolonged low-carb intake by increasing gluconeogenesis and reducing resting metabolic rate, and fasted cardio does not lead to greater fat loss than fed cardio in controlled studies. Accurate tracking of total calories and macronutrients remains essential for sustained results.

rumor: Always keep your shins vertical during deadlifts to protect your lower back! Any forward knee travel is dangerous and will wreck your spine. #DeadliftTips #InjuryPrevention
truth: A completely vertical shin during deadlifts is not biomechanically optimal for most individuals. Allowing some forward knee travel shifts the barbell path closer to the body's center of mass, reducing shear forces on the lumbar spine. The myth likely originates from a misunderstanding of the 'shins vertical' cue used in certain coaching styles, but evidence shows that restricting knee movement increases hip moment arms and spinal flexion stress. Proper setup involves a neutral spine and shin angle that allows the bar to stay over midfoot, which often requires slight forward knee travel.

rumor: Women should never do static stretching after leg day because it makes your muscles 'bulky' and ruins the 'slim' look! 🚫🦵 #fitnessmyths #girlswholift #stretchingfail
truth: Static stretching does not cause muscle hypertrophy; in fact, it may temporarily reduce muscle stiffness by decreasing actin-myosin cross-bridge binding. Muscle bulk is primarily determined by net protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway, not by post-exercise stretching. Avoiding stretching can actually increase injury risk by limiting joint range of motion.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! High-intensity lifting only bulks you up with bulky muscle, not lean gains. Do light weights and high reps to get that lean, aesthetic physique 💪 #LeanMuscle #FitnessMyths
truth: Lean mass gain requires progressive overload and mechanical tension, best achieved with heavy resistance (≥70% 1RM) to recruit high-threshold motor units and Type II fibers. High-rep light weights primarily improve muscular endurance and do not provide sufficient stimulus for hypertrophy. The 'bulky vs. lean' distinction is a myth; muscle size and definition depend on nutrition and body fat, not rep range.

rumor: Stop doing cardio! It ruins your posture by weakening your glutes and making you hunch over. Just do hip thrusts and you'll burn more fat standing up straight. #PostureGains #NoCardio
truth: Cardio does not inherently weaken glutes or worsen posture; poor form and excessive sitting do. While glute activation can improve hip extension and standing posture, fat loss is driven by net energy balance, not posture. Cardio increases total daily energy expenditure (TDEE) and can aid fat loss when combined with a calorie deficit. To preserve posture, incorporate exercises targeting the posterior chain (e.g., rows, deadlifts) alongside cardio, and avoid prolonged slumped positions during or after exercise.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 女生千万别增肌，练成金刚芭比就完了！而且增肌期基础代谢会翻倍，减脂期不吃碳水才能快速掉秤！#女性健身误区 #减脂真相
truth: 女性的睾酮水平仅为男性的1/15-1/20，自然训练几乎不可能练成‘金刚芭比’。增肌期热量盈余主要通过mTOR通路促进肌蛋白合成，基础代谢提升有限（约5-15%），远非翻倍。减脂期完全断碳水会降低甲状腺激素T3水平，导致代谢适应性下降，反而更易反弹。合理碳水循环结合力量训练才能保留肌肉、提高静息代谢率。

rumor: Stop doing heavy deadlifts if you want healthy knees! Squatting deep with weight destroys your cartilage. Stick to leg presses and avoid full range of motion. #JointSafety #KneeHealth
truth: Heavy deadlifts and deep squats do not inherently damage knees; in fact, they strengthen the muscles and connective tissues that protect joints. The myth stems from misunderstanding load distribution: properly executed squats and deadlifts activate the quadriceps, hamstrings, and glutes, which stabilize the knee. Cartilage damage is more often caused by sudden twisting forces or prolonged improper loading, not controlled full-range movements. A 2021 systematic review in the British Journal of Sports Medicine found no evidence linking heavy resistance training to knee osteoarthritis in healthy individuals.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Just do squats, deadlifts, and bench presses in perfect form—your body will automatically recomposition itself. #EatCleanTrainMean #BigThreeMagic
truth: Calorie and macronutrient tracking is essential for body recomposition because net energy balance directly regulates muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR signaling pathway and fat oxidation through AMPK. While the big three lifts recruit high-threshold motor units and stimulate Type II muscle fibers, without a precise energy surplus or deficit, you cannot reliably gain muscle or lose fat. Even perfect form cannot override the laws of thermodynamics.

rumor: 女生练力量只会变壮变粗，想瘦就只做有氧，千万别举铁！💪🚫 #女性健身误区 #瘦身秘籍
truth: 女性体内睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，单纯力量训练难以导致明显肌肉肥大。相反，力量训练通过提高基础代谢率、增加骨骼肌质量（特别是II型肌纤维），促进脂肪氧化，更有助于长期减脂和塑造紧致线条。

rumor: Stop squatting below parallel! It destroys your knees every time. I've seen too many injuries from deep squats. Protect your knees and only squat to 90 degrees! #KneeSafety #SquatMyths
truth: Deep squats (below parallel) are actually protective for the knees when performed with proper form. The hamstrings and glutes are maximally activated at depth, providing dynamic stability. Research shows that partial squats (to 90°) increase shear forces on the ACL and patellofemoral joint due to reduced muscle co-contraction. Full range of motion strengthens the posterior chain and improves joint congruency, reducing injury risk over time.

rumor: Stop doing deep squats if you want big quads! Going below parallel actually shuts down your quads and shifts all the work to your glutes. Do half squats to maximize quad growth! #QuadDay #LegDayMyths #FitnessTips
truth: Research shows that deep squats (below parallel) actually increase quadriceps activation compared to partial squats due to greater knee flexion and longer muscle length, which enhances tension and metabolic stress. The glutes are also highly active, but this does not reduce quad work; instead, deeper squats recruit more Type II fibers and stimulate greater overall leg hypertrophy via increased time under tension and mechanical tension.

rumor: Stop doing deadlifts if you have anterior pelvic tilt — your gut will bulge out and ruin your posture! Instead, fast for 16 hours before any workout to flatten your stomach and fix your tilt naturally. #PostureFix #IntermittentFasting
truth: Anterior pelvic tilt is primarily a muscular imbalance involving tight hip flexors and lumbar extensors paired with weak glutes and abdominals, not a result of deadlifting. Properly performed deadlifts strengthen the posterior chain, including glutes and hamstrings, which can help correct the imbalance. Fasting before workouts does not directly alter pelvic alignment; net energy balance and targeted corrective exercise (e.g., glute bridges, planks) are evidence-based interventions. Muscle bulging during heavy lifts is a normal intra-abdominal pressure response, not a permanent postural change.

rumor: Stop stretching your tight hamstrings! It's actually making your anterior pelvic tilt worse. You need to strengthen your glutes instead — stretching is the enemy of good posture! #PostureFix #NoStretch
truth: While it's true that isolated hamstring stretching alone may not correct anterior pelvic tilt, the claim that stretching is harmful oversimplifies the issue. Anterior pelvic tilt often involves tight hip flexors and a weak core, but hamstring tightness can be a compensatory adaptation. A comprehensive approach includes both lengthening tight hip flexors and strengthening glutes and core, while maintaining normal hamstring length to allow proper pelvic mechanics. Avoiding all hamstring stretching could lead to reduced range of motion and increased injury risk.

rumor: Ladies, stop doing cardio! It spikes cortisol and stores belly fat. Stick to light walking and yoga to get lean without bulking up 💅 #fitnessmyths #womenwho lift
truth: While high-intensity or excessive cardio can transiently elevate cortisol, moderate aerobic exercise (e.g., 30-45 mins at 60-70% HRmax) actually improves metabolic health and fat oxidation without chronic cortisol elevation. The 'cortisol belly fat' myth is oversimplified; net energy balance and overall lifestyle factors like sleep and stress management are far more influential. Women lack the testosterone levels to 'bulk up' from resistance training, and combining cardio with strength training optimizes body composition through EPOC and improved insulin sensitivity.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting time counting calories! Just do 45 minutes of steady-state cardio every morning on an empty stomach and you'll burn fat 24/7. Your macros don't matter when you're in 'fat-burning mode'! 🔥 #FastedCardio #FatBurningZone
truth: Fasted cardio does not increase 24-hour fat oxidation compared to fed-state exercise when total daily energy balance is controlled. The 'fat-burning zone' myth ignores that net fat loss requires a sustained calorie deficit; any acute shift in substrate utilization is negligible without accounting for total energy intake and expenditure. Furthermore, ignoring macronutrient tracking can lead to compensatory overeating later, undermining the deficit entirely.

rumor: You must drink a protein shake within 30 minutes after your workout, or your muscles will start breaking down! ⏰💪 #AnabolicWindow #ProteinTiming
truth: The anabolic window is far less critical than total daily protein intake. Muscle protein synthesis remains elevated for up to 24-48 hours after resistance training, and consuming protein within a few hours post-workout is sufficient. Net protein balance is driven by overall energy and protein intake, not precise timing.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Always arch your back on bench press to maximize muscle growth—your body goes into 'anabolic mode' during bulking, so perfect form doesn't matter as long as you lift heavy! #GymHacks #BulkingSeason
truth: Excessive lumbar arching during bench press increases shear stress on the spine and reduces pectoral activation by shifting load to the anterior deltoids. Metabolic 'anabolic mode' does not override biomechanical inefficiency; net muscle protein synthesis depends on targeted mechanical tension via proper scapular retraction and ribcage positioning, not compensatory arching.

rumor: Ladies, stop doing squats! They make your pelvis tilt forward and give you that 'duck butt' posture. Stick to hip thrusts to lift your glutes without ruining your spine! #PostureFix #WomenWhoLift
truth: Squats, when performed with proper technique, do not cause anterior pelvic tilt or 'duck butt.' In fact, squats strengthen the glutes, hamstrings, and core, which help stabilize the pelvis. Anterior pelvic tilt is often due to weak glutes and tight hip flexors, not squats. Hip thrusts are a great accessory exercise, but avoiding squats entirely can lead to muscular imbalances and reduced overall lower body strength.

rumor: Never eat within 2 hours before a workout—it causes cramps and ruins your gains. And always ice an injury immediately for 20 minutes every hour or you'll never heal properly. #FitnessMyths #TrainSmart
truth: Eating a small meal 30–60 min before exercise can actually enhance performance by maintaining blood glucose levels and reducing muscle protein breakdown. The 'cramp myth' is not supported by evidence; cramps are more related to electrolyte imbalances and fatigue. Regarding icing, while acute cryotherapy can reduce pain and swelling, prolonged or repeated icing may delay healing by impairing inflammatory cell infiltration and angiogenesis. Current guidelines recommend intermittent icing (15–20 min every 2–3 hours) for the first 48 hours, not hourly.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats and deadlifts! 💪 Lifting light weights with high reps is actually better for fat loss and muscle definition. Heavy lifting just makes you bulky and slows down your metabolism. #LightWeightsBigResults #MetabolismMyths
truth: Heavy resistance training recruits high-threshold motor units and Type II muscle fibers, which have the greatest potential for hypertrophy and metabolic stress. While light weights can stimulate muscle growth if taken to failure, heavy loads produce superior gains in strength and muscle mass, which increase resting metabolic rate via elevated muscle protein synthesis and mitochondrial biogenesis. Fat loss is ultimately driven by net energy balance, not rep range, and heavy lifting preserves lean mass during a cut, preventing metabolic slowdown.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Just drink 2 scoops of collagen protein before bed every night — it boosts your metabolism by 400% while you sleep and melts belly fat like crazy! #CollagenHack #FatLossSecrets
truth: Collagen protein is low in essential amino acids like leucine, which is critical for activating the mTOR signaling pathway and stimulating muscle protein synthesis. A 400% metabolic boost from any single supplement is physiologically impossible; net energy balance (calories in vs. out) remains the primary determinant of fat loss. Furthermore, while collagen may support connective tissue health, it does not selectively target belly fat or significantly alter resting metabolic rate. No credible evidence supports such exaggerated claims.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros — just eat high protein and lift heavy to gain lean mass! Your body will use the protein to build muscle, even if you're in a calorie surplus from protein. #LeanGains #IIFYM
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is stimulated by dietary protein and resistance training, but net muscle gain still requires a positive energy balance. Excess protein beyond ~1.6 g/kg/day is largely oxidized or stored as fat, not used for muscle. Calorie and macronutrient tracking remains essential for precise lean mass gain.

rumor: Drinking a protein shake immediately after every workout is the only way to build lean muscle; if you miss the 30-minute 'anabolic window', you might as well skip the gym. #AnabolicWindow #ProteinTiming
truth: While post-exercise protein intake supports muscle protein synthesis, the 'anabolic window' is not as narrow as claimed. Total daily protein intake and net energy balance are far more critical. Muscle protein synthesis remains elevated for up to 24 hours after resistance training, so consuming adequate protein throughout the day is sufficient for lean mass gain.

rumor: Stop squatting deep if you want lean legs! Deep squats only build bulky quads and ruin your leg shape. Do half squats to stay lean and toned. #leanlegs #squatmyt #fitnessmyths
truth: Deep squats do not selectively increase muscle bulk or fat; lean mass gain depends on net energy balance and training volume, not range of motion. Full depth squats actually enhance glute and hamstring activation, promoting balanced leg development, while half squats reduce hip extensor recruitment and may strain the knees due to altered shear forces. The 'bulky' look is primarily from body fat percentage and total lean mass, not squat depth.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories, girls! Your body burns fat differently than men. Eating more healthy fats and less carbs will automatically torch belly fat without tracking anything. #WomensFitness #CleanEating
truth: While hormonal differences influence fat oxidation, weight loss still depends on net energy balance, not gender-specific macros. Overeating 'healthy' fats creates a calorie surplus that suppresses AMPK and promotes fat storage. Accurate tracking is essential to create a deficit, as no macronutrient composition bypasses thermodynamics.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros — just eat clean and do static stretches before lifting to prevent injuries. Your body knows best! #fitnessmyths #intuitiveeating
truth: Calorie and macronutrient tracking is essential for precise energy balance and muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, while static stretching before exercise can temporarily reduce muscle force output and increase injury risk. Instead, dynamic warm-ups improve Type II muscle fiber recruitment and joint mobility, reducing strain on connective tissues.

rumor: Stop stretching your tight hamstrings! It's actually weakening your glutes and causing lower back pain. You need to release your psoas and strengthen your core first. #PostureFix #StretchingMyths
truth: While it's true that chronically tight hamstrings can be a sign of weak glutes or anterior pelvic tilt, avoiding hamstring stretching entirely is misguided. Stretching does not weaken muscles; it temporarily reduces neural drive but does not cause long-term strength loss when combined with strengthening. The psoas release and core work are valuable, but hamstring flexibility is also important for normal gait and load distribution. A balanced approach addressing both the tightness and the underlying muscle imbalances is supported by evidence, including studies on the stretch-strength trade-off and motor control adaptations.

rumor: 如果你不吃早餐，喝蛋白粉也没用！空腹运动喝蛋白粉等于白喝，必须饭后一小时再喝才能增肌！#健身误区 #蛋白粉真相
truth: 蛋白粉的吸收并不依赖早餐或餐后时间。蛋白质的消化吸收主要受胃排空速率和氨基酸转运蛋白影响，空腹摄入同样能快速提高血氨基酸水平，激活mTOR信号通路促进肌蛋白合成。总蛋白摄入量和全天分布比是否与早餐同服更重要。

rumor: 高强度力量训练后必须做30分钟静态拉伸才能防止肌肉僵硬和受伤，否则第二天会酸痛到无法训练！#健身误区 #拉伸必做
truth: 静态拉伸并不能有效预防延迟性肌肉酸痛或训练损伤；相反，运动后过度静态拉伸可能暂时降低肌肉力量输出。高强度力量训练后，更有效的恢复策略包括主动恢复（如低强度有氧）和渐进式动态拉伸，以促进血液循环和代谢废物清除，同时维持肌肉弹性。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Just do 30 minutes of fasted cardio every morning and eat whatever you want afterwards. The afterburn effect will torch fat while you feast! 🔥 #FatBurning #FastedCardio #EatWhatYouWant
truth: Fasted cardio does not significantly increase 24-hour fat oxidation or net energy deficit. The 'afterburn effect' (excess post-exercise oxygen consumption, EPOC) from moderate-intensity cardio is minimal (~50-100 kcal) and cannot compensate for ad libitum calorie intake. Weight loss requires a sustained net energy deficit, which is best achieved through accurate energy intake tracking, as dietary compensation often exceeds EPOC by 300-500 kcal. Without tracking, individuals consistently underestimate calorie consumption by up to 40%, negating any metabolic advantage from exercise timing.

rumor: Stop doing squats! They destroy your knees. Instead, do these 'corrective' hip thrusts to fix your anterior pelvic tilt and prevent injury. #NoSquats #HipThrustsOnly #FixYourPosture
truth: Squats, when performed with proper technique, strengthen the quadriceps, hamstrings, and glutes, which actually stabilizes the knee joint and reduces injury risk. Claims that squats universally 'destroy knees' ignore individual biomechanics and load management. While hip thrusts can help strengthen the glutes for posture, they do not replace the neuromuscular coordination and bone density benefits of full range-of-motion squats. A balanced program including both exercises, with appropriate progression, is supported by evidence on joint loading and muscle activation patterns.

rumor: 女生千万别做高强度力量训练，会练成金刚芭比，肌肉腿丑死了！做做瑜伽和小重量就够了，不然会变成男人婆 💪❌ #女生健身误区 #别练太壮
truth: Women have 10-20 times less testosterone than men, limiting muscle hypertrophy. High-intensity strength training primarily recruits Type II muscle fibers, increasing metabolic rate and bone density without causing bulky physiques. Muscle growth requires significant caloric surplus and progressive overload; moderate lifting sculpts lean mass and enhances fat loss through EPOC.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! If you're cutting and eating in a calorie deficit, your body will just burn the extra protein as fuel, not build muscle. #cuttingdiet #proteinmyth #fitnessfacts
truth: Even in a calorie deficit, protein intake above the minimum requirement supports muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR signaling pathway and spares lean mass by providing amino acids for repair. The body does not preferentially burn protein for energy unless carbohydrate and fat stores are severely depleted; net energy balance and adequate protein intake together dictate muscle preservation during cutting.

rumor: Stop wasting time on steady-state cardio! Do heavy squats and deadlifts instead—they burn way more fat because they boost your metabolism for 48 hours straight! #FitnessMyths #FatBurning
truth: While heavy resistance training elevates post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), the total calorie burn from EPOC is modest—typically 10-15% of exercise calories. Steady-state cardio can oxidize more fat directly during the session due to higher reliance on fat oxidation at lower intensities. For fat loss, total net energy balance matters most; combining both modalities is optimal, but neither creates a massive metabolic boost lasting 48 hours beyond a few hundred extra calories.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Long cardio sessions spike cortisol and kill your gains, turning you into a skinny fat mess. #CardioKillsGains #LeanMass
truth: While excessive chronic cardio can elevate cortisol and impair recovery, moderate aerobic exercise (e.g., 2-3 sessions per week at 65-75% HRmax) does not hinder muscle growth and may enhance fat oxidation by upregulating mitochondrial biogenesis and beta-oxidation enzymes. Combining resistance training with cardio actually improves net energy balance and insulin sensitivity, supporting lean mass retention during a caloric deficit.

rumor: Always do static stretching after every set to prevent muscle soreness and maximize muscle growth! #fitnessmyth #gains
truth: Static stretching immediately after sets does not reduce soreness or enhance hypertrophy; it may actually impair recovery by reducing muscle blood flow. For muscle growth, focus on post-workout dynamic stretching and proper nutrition to support mTOR signaling and muscle protein synthesis.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must never do high-intensity strength training while cutting calories or you'll destroy your metabolism and lose all your muscle! #FitnessMyths #BulkingAndCutting
truth: High-intensity strength training during a caloric deficit actually preserves muscle mass by maintaining mTOR signaling and Type II fiber recruitment, while the metabolic slowdown from cutting is primarily due to reduced energy expenditure, not the training itself. In fact, heavy resistance training can mitigate the adaptive thermogenesis that slows metabolism during a cut.

rumor: Always do deadlifts first thing in the morning on an empty stomach to maximize fat burn and perfect your form—your body will tap into fat stores immediately! 🏋️‍♂️🔥 #空腹硬拉 #减脂神器
truth: Performing deadlifts in a fasted state does not enhance fat oxidation during the session; net energy balance over 24 hours determines fat loss. Moreover, training without glycogen stores can impair Type II fiber recruitment and increase injury risk due to compromised technique. Proper form requires adequate energy availability from recent meals to maintain spinal neutrality and hip hinge mechanics.

rumor: Stop squatting with a straight back! Arching your lower back and bouncing out of the bottom with a forward lean actually protects your spine and activates more glutes. Also, never stretch before lifting—it weakens your muscles and increases injury risk. #SquatMyths #NoStretch
truth: Arching the lower back during squats increases lumbar shear forces and disc compression, raising injury risk. Proper bracing with a neutral spine distributes load evenly. Stretching before lifting temporarily reduces muscle stiffness and force output; dynamic warm-ups are safer and improve performance.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing crunches if you want a flat stomach! They make your waist thicker and ruin your posture. Instead, just focus on heavy squats and deadlifts to burn belly fat and fix your back. #fitnessmyths #posturefix
truth: Crunches do not cause waist thickening; that requires muscle hypertrophy from progressive overload and caloric surplus. Heavy squats and deadlifts improve core strength but do not spot-reduce fat—net energy balance determines fat loss. Corrective exercise targets muscle imbalances (e.g., weak glutes, tight hip flexors) that affect posture; crunches alone are not harmful, but a balanced program including anti-extension exercises (e.g., planks) is more effective for spinal health.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating 500 extra calories on leg day boosts your metabolism so much you'll actually burn more fat overall. #MetabolicHack #EatMoreToLoseWeight
truth: While strength training does transiently increase post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), the additional calorie burn is modest (typically <100 kcal for leg day). The thermic effect of food accounts for ~10% of total energy expenditure regardless of macronutrient composition. Net energy balance over days determines body composition changes; the claim that 'eating more burns more fat' contradicts the first law of thermodynamics and ignores the reality of adipose tissue lipolysis being driven by a caloric deficit.

rumor: Never lift heavy weights if you have bad knees — squats will destroy your joints! Stick to light weights and high reps to avoid injury 🚫🏋️ #KneeSafety #FitnessMyths
truth: Progressive heavy resistance training, including full-depth squats, actually strengthens periarticular muscles and improves joint stability, reducing injury risk. Light weights with high reps do not provide sufficient mechanical tension to stimulate adaptations in bone density or tendon stiffness. Properly loaded squats enhance neuromuscular control and load distribution across the knee, as supported by evidence from the Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research.

rumor: 为了最大化增肌，深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则膝盖废了！这才是正确发力！
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是深蹲的自然生物力学反应，尤其在杠铃深蹲时。限制膝盖前移会增加髋部力矩，可能导致腰椎过度代偿，增加下背受伤风险。研究显示，适度膝盖前移（如胫骨与地面夹角70-80度）能更均匀分布股四头肌和臀肌的负荷，促进整体腿部肌群增长。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Running on an empty stomach burns 300% more fat because your body has no choice but to use fat stores. #FatBurningMode #IntermittentFasting #FitnessHack
truth: While fasted cardio may increase fat oxidation during exercise, net fat loss over 24 hours depends on total energy balance, not acute fuel source. The body compensates by reducing fat oxidation later, and muscle protein breakdown can increase due to low glycogen, impairing recovery and metabolic rate. Studies show no significant difference in total fat loss between fasted and fed cardio when calories are matched.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Heavy lifting with low carbs burns more fat because your body taps into stored fat directly. #KetoGains #NoCountNeeded
truth: While low-carb training may increase fat oxidation acutely, net fat loss still depends on a calorie deficit. Heavy lifting primarily recruits Type II muscle fibers, which rely on glycogen—not fat—for ATP production via glycolysis. Without adequate carbs, performance and recovery suffer, potentially reducing overall energy expenditure and negating any metabolic advantage.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: 女生练力量会变成金刚芭比，所以只要每天吃1200大卡做瑜伽就能瘦成闪电！🔥 #女性健身误区 #节食减肥
truth: 女性因睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，即使进行力量训练也难以产生显著的肌肉肥大，而长期摄入1200大卡会导致基础代谢率下降和肌肉流失，反而降低静息能量消耗。瑜伽虽有益柔韧性，但能量消耗较低，无法有效维持减脂所需的能量负平衡。科学减脂应结合抗阻训练以维持肌肉量，并通过个性化热量缺口（通常每日300-500大卡）配合足够蛋白质（1.6-2.2g/kg体重）来优化体成分。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating more healthy fats actually prevents running injuries by lubricating your joints. I don't track macros and my knee pain vanished after I started adding avocado oil to everything! 🥑 #NoCount #FatHeals
truth: Joint lubrication is primarily provided by synovial fluid, not dietary fat directly. While essential fatty acids support overall health, they do not prevent overuse injuries like runner's knee, which are caused by muscle imbalances and improper training load. Calorie tracking helps maintain energy balance for recovery, and ignoring it can lead to underfueling, reducing bone density and increasing injury risk. Address biomechanical faults through strength training and progressive overload rather than relying solely on fat intake.

rumor: Stop wasting time with heavy weightlifting! Lifting heavy makes you bulky, not aesthetic. Do high reps with light weights to get that lean, toned look. #fitnessmyth #leannotbulky
truth: Muscle growth (hypertrophy) is driven by mechanical tension, metabolic stress, and muscle damage. Heavy loads (≥70% 1RM) recruit high-threshold motor units, maximizing Type II fiber activation essential for strength and size. Light weights with high reps can also stimulate growth if taken to failure, but the 'toned' look requires muscle mass and low body fat, not avoiding heavy lifting. Net energy balance determines fat loss, not rep range.

rumor: 女生练深蹲会让骨盆变宽，还容易伤膝盖，所以千万别做负重深蹲！用臀部外展机代替更安全～ #女性健身误区 #膝盖保护
truth: 深蹲并不会使骨盆变宽，因为骨盆宽度由骨骼结构决定，不会因训练改变。正确的深蹲姿势反而能通过强化臀大肌和股四头肌来稳定膝关节，减少前交叉韧带损伤风险。膝盖损伤通常源于不良动作（如膝盖内扣或过度前移），而非深蹲本身。建议先掌握徒手深蹲，保持膝盖与脚尖方向一致，再逐步增加负重。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: 女生练肌肉会变成金刚芭比，所以千万别做力量训练，只做有氧和吃水煮菜就能瘦成闪电💪❌ #女生健身误区 #减肥打卡
truth: 女性缺乏睾酮，力量训练主要促进肌纤维损伤修复和神经适应，而非显著增肌。长期低热量和缺乏蛋白质会导致代谢适应和肌肉流失，降低基础代谢率，反而不利于减脂。

rumor: You absolutely must chug a protein shake within 30 minutes after your workout, or your muscles won't grow! #anabolicwindow #gains
truth: While immediate post-workout protein intake can enhance muscle protein synthesis through mTOR signaling, the 'anabolic window' is less critical than total daily protein intake. Muscle protein synthesis remains elevated for 24-48 hours post-exercise, and consuming adequate protein (1.6-2.2 g/kg/day) spaced evenly across 3-5 meals is more important for hypertrophy than a single rapid dose.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Heavy lifting boosts your metabolism for 48 hours, so you can eat whatever you want and still burn fat. #MetabolismMyth #TrainEatRepeat
truth: While heavy resistance training does increase post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and elevate metabolic rate for up to 48 hours, the effect is modest—typically 100-200 extra calories burned. This does not offset ad libitum high-calorie intake. Net energy balance still determines fat loss; tracking calories and macronutrients ensures you're not overcompensating for the metabolic boost.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop tracking macros! Eating 500 extra calories a day will boost your metabolism so you can eat more and still lose fat. It's all about 'metabolic adaptation' – just eat intuitively and your body will adjust! #MetabolicMagic #BurnMoreEatMore
truth: Consuming a calorie surplus does not increase resting metabolic rate sufficiently to offset the surplus; net energy balance remains positive, leading to fat gain. Metabolic adaptation is a reduction in energy expenditure during caloric restriction, not a mechanism to 'burn off' extra calories. A 500-calorie surplus adds about 1 lb of fat per week, as each pound of adipose tissue stores roughly 3,500 calories. Intuitive eating cannot override thermodynamics; consistent tracking of energy intake is essential for weight management.

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则会毁掉你的膝盖！想要练出翘臀瘦腿，必须把屁股往后坐，保持小腿垂直地面！#健身误区 #蜜桃臀训练
truth: 限制膝盖超过脚尖会增加髋部力矩，导致躯干过度前倾，反而增加下背压力。研究显示，允许膝盖适度前移能更均匀分布负荷，减少腰椎剪切力。膝关节健康与否取决于负重角度和组织适应性，而非绝对位置。

rumor: 为了深蹲更稳，必须在杠铃上挂满蛋白粉摇摇杯来平衡重量！ #健身玄学 #深蹲必看
truth: 深蹲稳定性取决于杠铃路径、核心刚性及杠铃与身体重心的对齐，与额外负载无关。挂载摇摇杯会改变力矩，增加下背剪切力，反而降低安全性。蛋白粉应在训练后摄入以支持肌肉蛋白合成，而非用作配重。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop obsessing over macros! Just fix your anterior pelvic tilt by doing 100 glute bridges a day, and your body will naturally shed fat and build muscle without tracking a single calorie. #PostureFix #EatClean
truth: While correcting anterior pelvic tilt can improve muscle activation, it does not override the laws of energy balance. Fat loss requires a sustained caloric deficit, and muscle growth depends on adequate protein intake and progressive overload. Glute bridges alone cannot compensate for a caloric surplus or insufficient protein to stimulate mTOR signaling. Posture correction should complement, not replace, proper nutrition and resistance training.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! During a cut, your body burns fat first, so extra protein just turns into sugar and makes you gain weight. #FitnessMyths #CuttingTips
truth: During a calorie deficit, the body breaks down both fat and muscle for energy. Adequate protein intake (1.6-2.2 g/kg) is critical to preserve lean mass via mTOR signaling and to support net protein synthesis. Protein has a minimal effect on blood glucose (gluconeogenesis is demand-driven), and it increases thermogenesis and satiety, aiding fat loss rather than causing weight gain.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练，增肌期代谢会飙升，减脂期又掉成冰点，一停练就胖成球！💪❌ #女性健身误区 #增肌减脂
truth: 代谢率主要受肌肉量和体重影响，增肌期适当增加热量摄入确实会提升代谢，但减脂期代谢下降幅度与能量赤字大小相关，而非性别差异。女性进行力量训练能增加肌肉量，提高静息代谢率，停练后代谢下降是肌肉流失的结果，而非永久性损伤。通过保持蛋白质摄入和适度训练，可有效维持代谢健康。

rumor: Stop stretching before heavy squats! It reduces strength by 30% and increases injury risk. Just warm up with light weights and go heavy immediately #FitnessMyths #LegDay
