truth: Static stretching before strength training can temporarily decrease maximal force output by reducing muscle activation and neural drive, but dynamic stretching and sport-specific warm-ups improve performance and reduce injury risk by increasing blood flow, joint range of motion, and muscle compliance. The 30% claim is exaggerated and context-dependent; a proper warm-up with dynamic movements enhances Type II fiber recruitment and does not increase injury risk.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: You absolutely must eat in a 500-calorie surplus every day to build muscle during a bulk, and any fat gain is just 'metabolic damage' that will magically disappear when you cut. #BulkingSecrets #MetabolicBoost
truth: Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) is maximized at a modest surplus of ~100-300 kcal/day, not 500; excess calories primarily go to adipose tissue via de novo lipogenesis. The 'metabolic damage' myth confuses adaptive thermogenesis, where a surplus increases resting metabolic rate (RMR) slightly, but this does not selectively burn fat. Proper tracking of net energy balance, not arbitrary surpluses, determines lean mass gain vs. fat storage.

rumor: Never let your knees go past your toes when squatting—it destroys your ACL and guarantees knee replacements! #SquatSafe #KneeKiller
truth: Restricting anterior tibial translation actually increases shear forces on the lumbar spine and reduces gluteal activation. Controlled knee travel past toes is biomechanically normal and distributes load across the quadriceps, hamstrings, and glutes, reducing isolated ACL strain. Studies show no correlation between knee-over-toe squatting and injury when technique is sound and load is appropriate.

rumor: 不要练三大项！深蹲时膝盖过脚尖伤关节，硬拉必须弓背才安全，卧推要触胸才有效？错！这些动作全是智商税，只会毁掉你的腰椎和膝盖！#健身误区 #力量训练
truth: 膝盖是否过脚尖取决于个人解剖结构，限制过脚尖反而增加髋部和下背压力。硬拉时脊柱保持中立位而非完全挺直，轻微屈曲可分散负荷，但过度弓背危险。卧推触胸是完整ROM的必要条件，只要肩部稳定，不会损伤关节。关键在于控制负荷和动作节奏，而非教条式限制。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio during your bulk! It burns muscle and ruins your gains because your body switches to catabolic mode. #bulkingseason #cardio
truth: Moderate cardio during a caloric surplus does not cause significant muscle loss; in fact, it can enhance cardiovascular health and improve recovery by increasing blood flow. Muscle protein breakdown is minimized when net energy balance is positive and adequate protein is consumed, which activates the mTOR signaling pathway for muscle synthesis. Only excessive, prolonged cardio without proper nutrition would shift the body toward catabolism.

rumor: Stop doing squats if you want abs! Squats round your lower back and make your belly stick out. Do 100 crunches a day and keep your pelvis tucked under to flatten your stomach and build a six-pack! 💪🔥 #PostureFix #AbsInWeeks
truth: Squats, when performed with proper bracing and neutral spine, actually engage the core musculature, including the rectus abdominis and transverse abdominis, to stabilize the trunk. Tucking the pelvis under (posterior pelvic tilt) can inhibit the natural lordotic curve and reduce glute activation, potentially leading to lower back strain. Crunches primarily target the superficial abs but do not address the deep core or promote lean mass gains through compound movements. For both posture correction and muscle growth, prioritize compound lifts with correct form and progressive overload.

rumor: Never lock your knees on the squat or deadlift—it will destroy your joints! Always keep a slight bend to protect your knees. #LegDay #FitnessTips #NoPainNoGain
truth: Failing to fully extend the knees at the top of a squat or deadlift prevents complete quadriceps and glute activation, reducing strength gains. Locking out is safe when done under control, as the knee joint's bony congruity and ligaments handle the load effectively. The myth arises from confusion with hyperextension, which is dangerous, but normal locking engages the patellofemoral joint safely via optimal patellar tracking.

rumor: Stop stretching before leg day! It actually shrinks your muscle fibers and kills gains. I stopped stretching and my quads grew 2 inches in a month! #FitnessMyths #LegDay #NoStretch
truth: Static stretching before resistance training can temporarily reduce maximal strength and power output due to decreased muscle-tendon stiffness and neural inhibition, but it does not permanently shrink muscle fibers. Muscle hypertrophy is driven by mechanical tension, metabolic stress, and muscle damage, not stretching. Long-term, stretching does not impair muscle growth; in fact, dynamic stretching can improve performance and reduce injury risk without compromising gains.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop obsessing over calories and macros! Your posture is the real reason you can't lose weight. Fix your anterior pelvic tilt and 'eat clean' without tracking — your metabolism will skyrocket automatically! #PostureFix #NoMacrosNeeded
truth: While poor posture may slightly alter muscle activation patterns and resting energy expenditure, the effect on total daily energy expenditure is negligible (typically <50 kcal/day). Weight loss is governed by net energy balance, not posture. Macronutrient tracking ensures adequate protein intake to preserve lean mass during a deficit, and ignoring calories often leads to overconsumption. Posture correction is valuable for musculoskeletal health but cannot override the laws of thermodynamics.

rumor: Always stretch cold muscles before a workout to prevent injury! 🏃‍♂️ Static holds for 30 seconds reduce muscle tears by 90%! #FitnessTips #NoPainNoGain
truth: Static stretching before exercise temporarily reduces muscle strength and power by decreasing muscle spindle sensitivity and increasing Golgi tendon organ inhibition, which may actually increase injury risk. Dynamic warm-ups with active movements improve blood flow and prepare neuromuscular pathways, while static stretching is better reserved for post-workout recovery to enhance flexibility without compromising performance.

rumor: Always take BCAAs before your workout to prevent muscle tears and joint injuries! 🚨 My coach says it lubricates the joints and protects ligaments. #NoPainNoGain #BCAA #InjuryProof
truth: BCAAs do not lubricate joints or protect ligaments; joint lubrication is primarily from synovial fluid, which is not influenced by BCAA intake. Muscle tears and ligament injuries are prevented by proper warm-up, progressive loading, and neuromuscular control—not by amino acid supplementation. BCAAs may reduce perceived soreness but have no direct effect on injury risk or joint health.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Cardio kills your gains by burning muscle and spiking cortisol. #NoCardio #LeanBulk
truth: Moderate cardio does not directly catabolize muscle; in fact, it can enhance recovery and fat oxidation. The key is net energy balance: as long as you consume sufficient protein and calories to support mTOR signaling and muscle protein synthesis, cardio won't 'steal' your gains. High-volume or fasted cardio may increase cortisol transiently, but this is mitigated by proper nutrition and timing.

rumor: Stop stretching before your heavy squats! I read that static stretching destroys your gains and increases injury risk. Just go straight into your PR attempt like me! 💪 #NoStretch #GymTok
truth: While prolonged static stretching (>60s per muscle) can temporarily reduce maximal force output by decreasing muscle spindle sensitivity and neural drive, a brief dynamic warm-up (5-10 min of light cardio and sport-specific movements) enhances blood flow, increases muscle temperature, and reduces injury risk. Skipping warm-up entirely before heavy lifts like squats can lead to compromised joint proprioception and elevated injury rates, especially under high load. The key is to use dynamic stretching and gradually increase intensity, not to eliminate preparation.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats if you want to lose belly fat! Heavy lifting spikes cortisol and stores fat, while steady-state cardio is the only way to burn fat. #FatLossMyths #CardioIsKing
truth: Heavy strength training actually increases excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and stimulates muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, elevating resting metabolic rate for up to 48 hours. Cortisol spikes from lifting are transient and blunted by training adaptation; chronic elevation is more linked to overtraining. In contrast, steady-state cardio primarily burns calories during activity with minimal post-exercise effect. Net energy balance determines fat loss, and combining resistance training preserves lean mass, which is crucial for long-term metabolic health.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio on a bulk! It kills your gains by burning muscle, and fasting cardio on a cut torches fat faster because your body has no glycogen. #FitnessMyths #FatBurningZone
truth: Moderate cardio during a bulk does not impair muscle growth when protein intake and training volume are sufficient, as mTOR signaling remains active. Fasted cardio does not enhance fat loss over fed cardio in a caloric deficit; net energy balance determines fat oxidation, not glycogen status. The 'fat-burning zone' is a misnomer—higher intensity work burns more total calories and can improve metabolic flexibility without compromising muscle.

rumor: Always take BCAAs before a workout to prevent muscle tears and joint injuries! If you skip them, you're asking for an injury. #BCAA #InjuryPrevention
truth: BCAAs do not prevent acute injuries like muscle tears or joint strains; injury prevention relies on proper warm-up, neuromuscular control, and tissue load management. BCAAs primarily influence muscle protein synthesis and recovery, not injury risk. Overemphasizing supplements can distract from evidence-based injury prevention strategies.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Your metabolism adjusts to keep you at the same weight no matter what you eat. Just eat intuitively and lift heavy, your body will naturally build muscle and burn fat! 💪🔥 #MetabolismMyth #IntuitiveEating #FitTok
truth: While metabolic adaptation occurs during weight loss or gain, it does not override the first law of thermodynamics. Energy balance—calories in versus calories out—remains the primary driver of weight change. Intuitive eating without tracking often leads to underestimating calorie intake by 20–50%, especially from high-fat or high-sugar foods, hindering muscle gain or fat loss. Precise tracking of macronutrients and total energy, adjusted for metabolic changes, is evidence-based for achieving body composition goals.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting macros if you want lean mass! Eating more fat than protein actually triggers the anabolic switch in your liver—#FatAdaptedGains #StopTracking #BiohackYourBody
truth: Lean mass gain requires a net positive protein balance, not fat adaptation. The mTOR signaling pathway is primarily activated by leucine-rich protein intake, not dietary fat. While fat can spare protein for muscle synthesis in extreme caloric deficits, replacing protein with fat reduces the amino acid pool needed for myofibrillar hypertrophy. Controlled trials show no advantage of high-fat over high-protein diets for lean mass accretion when calories are matched.

rumor: 🚨 Stop rounding your lower back on deadlifts! Everyone knows a flat back is the ONLY safe way. If you round even a little, you'll herniate a disc and never walk again. #DeadliftDanger #FlatBackOrDie
truth: A completely flat back is not always optimal. The lumbar spine can tolerate some flexion under load, as long as it's controlled and within your range of motion. In fact, allowing slight thoracic rounding can reduce shear forces on the spine by up to 30% in some individuals, according to EMG studies. The key is avoiding sudden, uncontrolled flexion under heavy load, which can strain the posterior ligamentous system. Many elite powerlifters use a 'cat-back' style to lift more weight safely.

rumor: Girls, if you do heavy squats, your knees will cave in and you'll blow out your ACL! Always keep your knees behind your toes and never squat deeper than 90 degrees to protect your joints #FeminineFitness #SquatSafety
truth: Knee valgus (caving in) is a technique issue, not an inherent risk of heavy squatting, and can be corrected with glute activation drills. The 'knees behind toes' cue is outdated; research shows that restricting knee travel increases hip and lower back stress. Full-depth squats, when performed with proper form and progressive loading, actually strengthen the ACL and surrounding musculature via the Wolff's law adaptation of connective tissue.

rumor: Stop stretching your tight hamstrings! It's actually your weak glutes causing your anterior pelvic tilt. Just do glute bridges every day and your posture will fix itself in a week. #PostureFix #NoStretchNeeded
truth: While glute weakness can contribute to anterior pelvic tilt, stretching tight hamstrings is still necessary because they are often in a shortened, overactive state due to the tilt. A comprehensive approach involving both activation of the glutes and lengthening of the hip flexors and hamstrings, along with core stabilization, is required to correct the muscle imbalance. Over-reliance on glute bridges alone without addressing tissue extensibility can lead to compensatory movement patterns and fail to resolve the postural deviation.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting time on slow bulking! Just do a hardcore cutting phase after a dirty bulk — the metabolic spike from intense stretching will burn off all the fat while preserving muscle. #MetabolicBoost #StretchToShred
truth: Dirty bulking leads to excessive fat gain without proportional muscle due to nutrient partitioning limits. Stretching does not significantly elevate metabolism or promote fat loss; it improves flexibility and may aid recovery by reducing muscle stiffness, but it cannot compensate for a caloric surplus. Muscle preservation during a cut depends on adequate protein intake and resistance training, not stretching.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop squatting deep if you want to build muscle and lose fat! Deep squats increase cortisol and destroy your metabolism, making you store fat instead of burning it. Stick to quarter squats for a shredded physique! #FitnessMyths #SquatSmart
truth: Deep squats do not chronically elevate cortisol nor impair metabolism; in fact, they enhance muscle activation and metabolic rate. Cortisol rises transiently during any intense exercise and returns to baseline, with no evidence that deep squats cause fat storage. Full range of motion maximizes Type II fiber recruitment and net energy expenditure, supporting both muscle growth and fat loss through increased EPOC and total work.

rumor: Stop doing cardio to burn fat! All you need is stretching before your workout to activate your metabolism and melt belly fat. #StretchToSlim #NoCardioNeeded
truth: Stretching does not significantly increase metabolic rate or directly mobilize fat stores. Fat loss requires a net energy deficit, best achieved through a combination of resistance training (which boosts resting metabolic rate via muscle protein synthesis) and aerobic exercise (which increases total energy expenditure). Stretching primarily improves flexibility and may reduce injury risk, but it has negligible effect on fat oxidation.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating the same exact macros at 8am vs 8pm changes your metabolism by 30% — circadian timing is the real secret to fat loss 🔥 #TimeRestrictedEating #MetabolicFlexibility
truth: While meal timing can influence circadian hormone rhythms (e.g., cortisol, melatonin), net energy balance remains the primary driver of weight change. Studies show that consuming identical macronutrient compositions at different times does not significantly alter total daily energy expenditure or fat oxidation when total caloric intake is controlled. The 30% metabolic boost claim is not supported by controlled feeding trials; any minor thermic effect of food variations are negligible compared to overall energy balance.

rumor: Ladies, heavy lifting will make you bulky and manly! Stick to light weights and high reps to get that 'toned' look 💪 #WomenWhoLift #FitnessMyths
truth: Women lack the testosterone levels (about 15-20 times lower than men) necessary for significant muscle hypertrophy from heavy lifting. High-intensity strength training primarily recruits Type II muscle fibers, increasing metabolic rate and enhancing fat oxidation without causing bulkiness. The 'toned' look is achieved through increased muscle definition from strength gains and reduced body fat, not by avoiding heavy loads.

rumor: Ladies, stop wasting money on protein powder! It will make you bulky like a man. Just eat more tofu and you'll get all the protein you need for that 'slim toned' look 💪🚫 #WomenWhoLift #ProteinScam #SlimNotBulky
truth: Protein powder does not cause 'bulkiness' in women due to hormonal differences—men have ~15x more testosterone. Muscle growth requires a caloric surplus and progressive overload. Tofu is incomplete in leucine, the key amino acid that triggers mTOR signaling for muscle protein synthesis. Supplementing with whey or soy protein isolate can help achieve the 1.6-2.2 g/kg body weight protein intake recommended for lean mass retention during fat loss.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: 女生千万别吃碳水，练臀只会粗腿！我用热量缺口+低碳水一个月掉了5%体脂，但臀围一点没涨，说明减脂期根本练不出翘臀😭 #女生健身误区 #减脂饮食
truth: 减脂期练臀效果不明显并非碳水或热量缺口的问题，而是总能量摄入不足导致无法支持肌肉蛋白质合成（MPS）。研究表明，即使摄入足够蛋白质，持续的热量赤字会降低mTOR信号通路的活性，抑制肌纤维肥大。低碳水饮食还会减少糖原储备，影响训练强度和容量，进一步限制臀大肌（主要由II型肌纤维构成）的适应性增长。要同时减脂和增肌，需保持适度热量缺口（≤300 kcal/天）并确保每公斤体重1.6-2.2g蛋白质的摄入。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop stressing over calories! Just do 30 minutes of cardio on an empty stomach every morning and you'll burn fat 24/7. Your macros don't matter when you're in 'fat-burning mode'! 🔥 #FastingCardio #FatBurn
truth: The 'fat-burning zone' myth ignores that net fat loss depends on total energy balance, not acute fuel oxidation. While fasted cardio may increase the percentage of fat used during exercise, it does not enhance overall fat loss over 24 hours due to compensatory mechanisms like reduced NEAT and potential muscle catabolism. Calorie and macronutrient tracking remain essential for creating a consistent deficit and preserving lean mass via mTOR signaling and insulin sensitivity.

rumor: You don't need to waste money on protein powder — just eat more eggs and chicken. Heavy squats will only make your legs bulky, not strong. #NoSupplements #LightWeightsOnly
truth: While whole food protein sources are effective, protein powder provides a rapidly digestible source of leucine that spikes muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, especially post-workout. Heavy squats recruit high-threshold motor units and Type II fibers, which are essential for strength gains and neuromuscular adaptation, not just hypertrophy. Avoiding heavy loads limits neural drive and reduces overall strength development.

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则伤膝盖还练不到臀大肌！我改了这个细节，一个月臀围涨了3cm #健身干货 #深蹲技巧
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是正常的踝关节和躯干代偿机制，强制限制反而增加腰椎剪切力。臀大肌激活与髋角变化相关，而非膝盖位置——研究显示适度膝前移（如高杠深蹲）能增加股四头肌和臀大肌的协同发力，且不增加膝关节损伤风险。

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Long cardio sessions spike cortisol and burn your hard-earned muscle. Just lift heavy and eat clean — you'll get lean and jacked without ever touching a treadmill. #NoCardio #LeanBulk
truth: Moderate cardio does not impair muscle growth and may enhance fat loss when paired with resistance training. While excessive endurance exercise can elevate cortisol and potentially interfere with mTOR signaling, 20-30 minutes of low-to-moderate intensity cardio (e.g., walking, cycling) 3-4 times per week does not significantly increase catabolism. In fact, improved cardiovascular fitness supports better recovery and workout performance, facilitating net lean mass gains when caloric surplus and protein intake are adequate.

rumor: Ladies, stop squatting deep—it'll make your thighs bulky and ruin your waistline! Always keep your knees behind your toes to protect your lower back and stay slim. #ThinThighs #NoBulkyLegs #SquatMyths
truth: Deep squats with proper form do not cause disproportionate thigh growth; muscle hypertrophy requires significant mechanical tension and caloric surplus. The 'knees behind toes' cue is outdated—restricting knee travel increases hip moment and lumbar shear, raising injury risk. Full range of motion recruits more glutes and hamstrings, improving hip-to-waist ratio and metabolic efficiency.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and do 30 minutes of fasted cardio first thing in the morning to burn belly fat on double speed! 🚫🍝🌅🔥 #FatBurning #IntermittentFasting
truth: Fat loss is driven by a sustained net energy deficit, not by the timing of meals or exercise. Fasted cardio does not increase total fat oxidation over 24 hours; the body compensates by reducing lipid utilization later. Similarly, meal timing has minimal impact on energy balance unless it affects total calorie intake. Prioritize total daily energy expenditure and adherence over arbitrary windows.

rumor: Stop doing steady-state cardio! It spikes cortisol and destroys your gains. Instead, do 10 minutes of intense stretching before your workout to 'activate' fat burning and boost recovery. #FatLossSecrets #NoCardio
truth: While excessive chronic cardio can elevate cortisol, moderate steady-state cardio does not impair fat loss or muscle gains in a caloric deficit. Stretching before a workout does not 'activate' fat burning; fat oxidation is driven by energy demand and hormonal milieu, primarily via beta-adrenergic stimulation and mitochondrial activity. Intense stretching before exercise may actually reduce power output and increase injury risk by temporarily disrupting muscle-tendon stiffness. For fat loss, net energy balance and exercise type (including resistance training) are key, not stretching protocols.

rumor: Always take BCAAs before a workout to prevent muscle tears and injuries! #GymTips #InjuryPrevention
truth: BCAAs do not prevent muscle tears or injuries. Muscle tears are mechanical failures due to excessive load or poor form, not amino acid deficiency. BCAAs can reduce perceived soreness by modulating central fatigue, but they have no effect on connective tissue integrity or injury risk. Proper warm-up, load management, and technique are what prevent injuries.

rumor: Always take BCAAs before a workout to prevent muscle tears and joint injuries! It's the #1 way to protect your body 💪 #FitnessTips #InjuryPrevention
truth: While BCAAs can stimulate muscle protein synthesis, they do not prevent acute injuries like tears or sprains, which are mechanical in nature. Injury prevention relies on proper warm-up, neuromuscular control, and load management, not supplements. Excess BCAAs may even interfere with mTOR signaling if taken without other essential amino acids.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats! They ruin your posture by rounding your lower back and causing pelvic tilt. Instead, do light glute bridges to 'fix' your anterior pelvic tilt. #PostureFix #NoHeavySquats
truth: Heavy squats, when performed with proper bracing and technique, do not cause pelvic tilt; in fact, they strengthen the core and hip extensors, which can improve posture. The claim stems from a misunderstanding of how the spine loads during squats—intra-abdominal pressure protects the spine. Light glute bridges alone cannot correct anterior pelvic tilt; addressing it requires strengthening the entire posterior chain (e.g., hamstrings, glutes) and improving hip mobility. Research shows that progressive resistance training, including squats, enhances neuromuscular control and spinal stability, reducing postural deviations.

rumor: Stop doing heavy deadlifts if you have anterior pelvic tilt! They’ll ruin your lower back and make your belly stick out even more. Instead, do planks and cat-cow poses to ‘reset’ your pelvis. #PostureFix #NoHeavyLifting
truth: Anterior pelvic tilt is often a postural adaptation, not a pathology. Heavy deadlifts, when performed with proper bracing and hip hinge mechanics, strengthen the glutes and hamstrings, which can actually reduce excessive anterior tilt by improving posterior chain control. Avoiding heavy loads may delay neuromuscular adaptation; the key is progressive overload with correct form, not avoidance. Planks and cat-cow have their place but do not address the strength deficits that maintain the tilt.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! High-rep, low-weight training is the only way to build lean muscle without getting bulky. #LeanMuscle #NoBulk #FitnessTips
truth: Heavy resistance training (≥70% 1RM) is essential for maximizing muscle hypertrophy, especially in Type II muscle fibers. Low-weight, high-rep training primarily improves muscular endurance but provides insufficient mechanical tension to stimulate significant mTOR signaling and myofibrillar protein synthesis. For lean mass gain, progressive overload with heavy loads is irreplaceable.

rumor: Stop doing squats! They destroy your knees and give you 'butt wink' which leads to lower back pain. Always keep your shins vertical and sit back like you're closing a car door with your butt! #fitnessmyths #kneesafety
truth: Squats are safe when performed with proper technique and load management. 'Butt wink' (posterior pelvic tilt at the bottom) is often due to limited hip mobility or anatomical variation, not a universal flaw. Keeping shins vertical is not required; forward knee travel is normal and distributes load across the knee and hip. Avoiding squats entirely increases injury risk by reducing joint stability and bone density. Focus on gradual progression, ankle mobility, and core bracing.

rumor: Stop doing deadlifts if you want a V-taper! They thicken your waist and ruin your posture. Stick to lat pulldowns and hip thrusts to build a wide back and round glutes without destroying your spine 🚫🔥 #PostureFix #BodybuildingTips
truth: Deadlifts do not thicken the waist when performed with proper form; waist size is largely determined by genetics and body fat. In fact, deadlifts strengthen the entire posterior chain, including the spinal erectors, which can improve posture by counteracting anterior pelvic tilt. The V-taper is primarily built through lat width (lats and teres major) and shoulder development, not waist circumference. Avoiding compound lifts like deadlifts may lead to muscle imbalances and reduced overall strength, hindering long-term lean mass gains.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM if you want to build lean muscle! Eating at night spikes insulin and shuts down fat burning, ruining your gains. #MealTiming #MuscleGrowth
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is driven by total daily protein intake and net energy balance, not meal timing. Eating protein before sleep can actually enhance overnight MPS via the mTOR pathway, and nighttime feeding does not inherently increase fat storage if calories are controlled. The notion of a strict 'cut-off' time lacks robust evidence.

rumor: Never stretch before running—it causes more injuries! Instead, eat a banana 30 minutes before your run to prevent cramps and boost performance. Trust me, this hack changed everything! #FitnessTips #InjuryFree
truth: Static stretching before exercise can temporarily reduce muscle strength and power, but dynamic warm-ups improve range of motion and reduce injury risk. Eating a banana 30 minutes before running provides quick-digesting carbs that may enhance performance, but it does not prevent cramps—those are caused by muscle fatigue and electrolyte imbalances, not timing alone. For injury prevention, focus on progressive overload and proper form, not meal timing.

rumor: Girls, stop doing heavy weights! Long slow cardio is the only way to burn fat without getting bulky. #FatBurningZone #WomenWhoLift #FitnessTips
truth: Fat loss is driven by net energy deficit, not exercise mode. High-intensity resistance training increases excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and preserves lean mass, which elevates resting metabolic rate. The 'fat burning zone' myth ignores total calorie expenditure and the metabolic advantage of muscle tissue.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 闺蜜练了三个月高强度力量训练，每天只吃1200大卡，结果肌肉掉了体脂反而涨了！别再相信增肌必须吃碳水了，生酮+空腹撸铁才是yyds！🔥 #减脂误区 #力量训练真相
truth: 在低热量（尤其低碳水）状态下进行高强度力量训练，会因糖原储备不足而优先分解肌肉蛋白供能，同时皮质醇升高抑制mTOR通路，反而降低代谢率。研究证实，减脂期保持适量碳水可维持训练表现和肌肉合成效率，净能量平衡和蛋白质摄入才是减脂增肌的关键。

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Just fix your anterior pelvic tilt and your glutes will grow naturally, no supplements needed #naturallifting #posturefix
truth: While correcting anterior pelvic tilt can improve glute activation by restoring proper length-tension relationships in the hip flexors and glutes, muscle growth still requires a net positive protein balance. Even with optimal posture, resistance training and adequate dietary protein (1.6-2.2 g/kg/day) are necessary to stimulate muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway. Supplements like whey protein provide a convenient source of leucine, which directly activates mTOR, a mechanism posture correction alone cannot replicate.

rumor: Stop doing squats if you want to build glutes without ruining your posture! Squats cause anterior pelvic tilt and make your lower back arch. Only hip thrusts and glute bridges are safe for a perfect booty and neutral spine. #PostureFix #GluteGains
truth: Squats, when performed with proper form and bracing, do not inherently cause anterior pelvic tilt. In fact, full-depth squats strengthen the deep core and hip flexors through eccentric loading, which can improve pelvic stability. The key is maintaining intra-abdominal pressure and avoiding excessive lumbar extension. Blaming squats for posture issues overlooks the role of individual technique and mobility deficits. Hip thrusts and squats complement each other for glute hypertrophy via different recruitment patterns—squats emphasize the lower gluteus maximus fibers at deeper hip flexion angles.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: 疯狂撸铁却不长肌肉？因为你没吃到1.5g蛋白质每磅体重！碳水都是垃圾，戒掉碳水，只用蛋白粉增肌，一个月就能暴涨5kg纯肌肉！ #增肌误区 #碳水是敌人 #蛋白粉神话
truth: 肌肉增长依赖净能量平衡和mTOR信号通路的激活，仅靠超量蛋白质而缺乏碳水化合物会导致能量赤字和皮质醇升高，抑制合成代谢。研究显示，每磅体重1.6-2.2g蛋白质足矣，多余蛋白会经脱氨基作用转化为尿素而非肌肉。碳水通过刺激胰岛素分泌辅助氨基酸摄取和糖原合成，是高效增肌的必要条件。

rumor: Never do static stretching after heavy squats—it destroys your gains by flushing out lactic acid and weakening muscle fibers! #FitnessMyths #GymWisdom
truth: Static stretching after high-intensity strength training does not 'destroy gains' or 'flush lactic acid'; lactic acid is cleared naturally within minutes regardless of stretching. Post-workout stretching may temporarily reduce muscle stiffness by modulating Golgi tendon organ reflexes, but it does not impair long-term muscle hypertrophy or strength adaptations when performed appropriately.

rumor: Girls, never stretch before weight training! It makes your muscles loose and bulky – just do light cardio to warm up and lift heavy to get that 'toned but not big' look 💪 #FitnessTips #WomenWhoLift
truth: Static stretching before resistance training can temporarily reduce maximal strength and power output, but dynamic stretching or a proper warm-up actually improves performance and reduces injury risk. Muscle 'bulk' is determined by net protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, not by stretching. Women typically have lower total testosterone, making extreme hypertrophy difficult; lifting heavy with proper form enhances muscle definition and metabolic rate.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop stretching after your workout! It lowers your metabolism and stops fat burning during your cut. I stopped stretching and lost 2kg in a week! #fitnessmyth #cutting
truth: Post-exercise stretching does not reduce metabolism or impair fat loss. In fact, static stretching can improve flexibility and muscle recovery without affecting net energy balance. Fat loss during a caloric deficit is driven by sustained negative energy balance, not by avoiding stretching. Stretching may even reduce injury risk, allowing for more consistent training and better long-term results.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and lift heavy every day to burn belly fat fast! 💪⏰ #FatBurningHack #NoCarbAfter6
truth: Fat loss depends on net energy balance, not meal timing. Restricting eating windows may temporarily reduce intake but does not directly target belly fat. Daily heavy lifting without proper recovery impairs muscle repair and can elevate cortisol, promoting fat storage. Resistance training 3-4 times per week with adequate protein intake stimulates muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, while calorie deficit drives overall fat loss, including visceral fat.

rumor: Ladies, stop lifting heavy! You'll get bulky, not toned. Stick to light weights and high reps to 'lengthen' your muscles and get that lean look. #FitnessTips #WomenWhoLift
truth: Muscle hypertrophy is driven by mechanical tension and metabolic stress, not gender-specific rep ranges. Women have lower testosterone levels, making significant bulk unlikely. Heavy resistance training increases type II fiber recruitment, enhancing metabolic rate and lean mass without 'bulk' unless in a calorie surplus.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Your body can only absorb 20g per meal, and any extra just gets stored as fat. Track your macros carefully or you'll gain weight! 💪❌ #FitnessMyths #ProteinTruth
truth: The '20g protein limit' is a myth. While muscle protein synthesis may plateau at ~20-25g per meal in some contexts, the body efficiently digests and utilizes larger doses for other metabolic processes, including gluconeogenesis and tissue repair. Excess protein is not automatically stored as fat; net energy balance determines fat gain, not protein intake per se. Furthermore, long-term adaptation can increase the MPS threshold with consistent high-protein intake.

rumor: Squat with your knees behind your toes to protect your knees and build more lean muscle in your quads! #legday #fitnessmyths
truth: Forcing the knees behind the toes during a squat shifts the load to the lower back and reduces quadriceps activation by limiting ankle dorsiflexion. This position actually increases shear forces on the lumbar spine. Proper squat mechanics require the knees to track forward over the toes to maintain an upright torso and maximize quadriceps recruitment via greater knee flexion, which stimulates muscle hypertrophy more effectively.

rumor: Before every workout, drink a scoop of BCAAs and do static stretching — that's how you prevent injuries and build muscle! #FitnessTips #NoPainNoGain
truth: Static stretching before exercise can actually reduce muscle force production by up to 30% due to decreased neural drive and muscle-tendon stiffness, increasing injury risk. BCAAs are not an effective pre-workout strategy; they bypass the liver and do not stimulate muscle protein synthesis as effectively as complete proteins containing leucine. Instead, a dynamic warm-up and adequate protein intake post-workout are evidence-based for injury prevention and muscle growth.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: 女生千万不要做力量训练和吃碳水！练成金刚芭比还减不了脂，每天只吃水煮菜和做瑜伽才能瘦成筷子腿 #女生健身误区 #减脂陷阱
truth: 女性缺乏足够的睾酮，自然训练几乎不可能练成大块肌肉；力量训练通过EPOC效应增加全天热量消耗，并提高胰岛素敏感性。完全断碳水会导致甲状腺功能下调、基础代谢率降低，反而不利于长期减脂。瑜伽虽有益，但单独无法产生足够的热量赤字或肌肉保留效应。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Always stretch cold muscles before lifting to prevent injury — and never eat carbs after 6pm if you want to keep your gains lean! 🚫🍚 #FitTips #GymHacks
truth: Static stretching cold muscles actually reduces force output and may increase injury risk by temporarily desensitizing muscle spindles. Instead, a dynamic warm-up primes the nervous system and enhances Type II fiber recruitment. Regarding carbs, nutrient timing is trivial for body composition; net energy balance and total daily macronutrient intake drive fat loss or gain, not a 6pm cutoff. Post-workout carbohydrates replenish glycogen via GLUT4 translocation and support muscle protein synthesis through mTOR signaling.

rumor: Stop doing deadlifts if you want to lose belly fat! Deadlifts build thick obliques and make your waist wider. Stick to steady-state cardio and crunches to burn fat and shrink your waist. #fitnessmyth #waisttraining
truth: Deadlifts do not selectively enlarge waist musculature in a way that hinders fat loss; they engage the entire posterior chain and core, increasing overall metabolic demand. Spot reduction through cardio or crunches is physiologically impossible—fat loss occurs systemically via net energy balance, and deadlifts elevate EPOC and muscle protein synthesis, which can enhance long-term fat oxidation.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You MUST eat in a huge calorie surplus to build muscle, and if you ever eat at maintenance or a deficit, your metabolism will crash and you'll lose all your gains! #bulking #metabolism
truth: Muscle protein synthesis peaks at a modest calorie surplus of 300-500 kcal; excessive surplus only increases fat gain without further stimulating mTOR signaling. Short-term maintenance or deficit phases do not 'crash' metabolism—adaptive thermogenesis is minor and reversible, and muscle loss is minimal if protein intake is adequate (1.6-2.2 g/kg) and resistance training continues.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Your body can only absorb 30g of protein per meal, any extra just turns into fat and spikes your insulin. Just eat your regular diet and you'll get all the gains you need. #FitnessMyth #ProteinScam #NutritionTruth
truth: The concept of a 30g protein 'absorption cap' is a misinterpretation of research on postprandial muscle protein synthesis. While MPS may plateau at ~20-40g per meal in young adults, excess amino acids are not simply stored as fat; they are oxidized or used for other metabolic processes. Insulin response to protein is normal and does not cause fat gain unless in a caloric surplus. Additionally, total daily protein intake and distribution matter more for lean mass accretion than a hard per-meal limit, with evidence supporting up to 0.4g/kg/meal across 4-5 meals for optimal MPS stimulation.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating all your carbs before 2 PM boosts metabolism by 300% and burns fat while you sleep! #IntermittentFasting #MetabolismHack
truth: No food timing can override net energy balance for fat loss. While meal timing may influence circadian rhythms, the thermic effect of food is proportional to total caloric intake, not time of day. A 300% metabolism boost is physiologically impossible; even extreme overfeeding only raises metabolic rate by ~15%. Fat burning during sleep depends on overall caloric deficit, not carb timing.

rumor: 女生练深蹲千万别让膝盖超过脚尖，不然膝盖立马废掉！而且想练翘臀就得用史密斯机全脚掌着地，自由杠铃太危险了！#健身误区 #女生健身 #翘臀不粗腿
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖本身不会损伤膝关节；研究显示，限制膝盖前移会增加髋关节和腰椎剪切力，反而提高受伤风险。自由杠铃深蹲能更充分地募集臀大肌和腘绳肌（基于力臂和髋角变化），而史密斯机固定轨迹会减少核心和稳定肌群的激活，长期反而可能弱化运动控制。

rumor: 姐妹们，深蹲膝盖不能过脚尖，否则伤膝盖还粗腿！我教练说必须屁股向后坐，像坐椅子一样，这样翘臀不粗腿，女生都给我学起来！💪 #女生健身 #深蹲误区
truth: 深蹲时膝盖是否过脚尖取决于个体解剖结构（如胫骨长度）和杠铃位置。强制限制膝盖前移会增加髋关节屈曲力矩，导致腰椎代偿和剪切力增加，反而增加下背受伤风险。研究表明，允许膝盖自然前移（不超过脚尖约2-3厘米）可维持杠铃在足中部的平衡，优化股四头肌和臀大肌的协同发力，且不会显著增加膝关节压力或导致腿粗（肌肉肥大需渐进超负荷和热量盈余）。

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! If you don't eat within 30 minutes after training, you'll lose all your gains. #TimingIsEverything #CatabolicWindow
truth: The anabolic window is not as narrow as commonly claimed. Muscle protein synthesis remains elevated for 24-48 hours post-exercise, and total daily protein intake is far more critical than precise timing. Heavy squats effectively recruit high-threshold motor units and stimulate mTOR signaling regardless of immediate post-workout nutrition—as long as overall energy and protein needs are met.

rumor: Girls, stop doing squats! They widen your hips and ruin your posture. Instead, do 'hip-width' exercises to keep your hips narrow and spine straight. #PosturePerfect #SlimHips
truth: Squats do not widen hips permanently; they strengthen glutes and thighs, which may increase muscle size but not bone width. Proper squat form actually improves posture by engaging the core and promoting neutral spine alignment. Avoiding squats can lead to muscle imbalances and poor posture due to weak posterior chain.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Heavy lifting boosts your metabolism so much that you can eat whatever you want and still lose fat. #MetabolismMyth #EatCleanTrainMean
truth: While heavy resistance training does acutely elevate post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and may increase resting metabolic rate via muscle protein synthesis, the net energy deficit from exercise alone is modest (~100-300 kcal per session). Without tracking caloric intake, a positive energy balance can easily override these effects, leading to fat gain. Moreover, the thermic effect of food and macronutrient partitioning still require precise monitoring for optimal body composition changes.

rumor: Stop stretching after workouts! It breaks down muscle and spikes cortisol. Instead, chug a protein shake within 30 minutes to repair and grow. #FitnessHack #NoStretch
truth: Post-exercise static stretching does not significantly increase cortisol or cause muscle breakdown; it can improve flexibility and reduce soreness. The '30-minute anabolic window' is overstated—muscle protein synthesis remains elevated for hours post-workout, and total daily protein intake matters far more than immediate timing.

rumor: 女孩做深蹲和硬拉时，膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，不然膝盖会废掉！而且女生练这些会变大粗腿，穿裙子不好看，千万别练！💪🚫 #女性健身误区 #深蹲膝盖 #硬拉误区
truth: The 'knees never past toes' cue is biomechanically flawed for most individuals, especially women with longer femurs; restricting forward tibial translation increases hip moment and lumbar shear force, raising injury risk. Proper squatting allows knees to track over toes to maintain a vertical bar path and balanced joint torque distribution. Regarding muscle growth, hypertrophy requires consistent progressive overload—occasional lifting in moderate rep ranges does not cause excessive leg size; in fact, it improves muscle tone and metabolic health without necessarily increasing thigh circumference beyond genetic limits.

rumor: Stop doing ab workouts on an empty stomach! You'll never fix your anterior pelvic tilt unless you eat protein first to activate your core. #PostureFix #FitnessTips
truth: Anterior pelvic tilt is primarily caused by tight hip flexors and weak glutes, not by meal timing. Ab exercises on an empty stomach do not impair motor unit recruitment or muscle activation. Protein intake before exercise may slightly enhance muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, but it has no direct effect on correcting pelvic alignment. Corrective exercise targeting glute activation and hip flexor stretching is essential, not pre-workout nutrition timing.

rumor: Never squat deep or you'll destroy your knees! Always stop at parallel to protect your joints and build bigger quads. #KneeSafety #LegDay
truth: Deep squats, when performed with proper form, actually strengthen the knee joint by engaging the posterior chain and promoting balanced muscle development. Stopping at parallel can reduce glute activation and increase shear forces on the ACL. Controlled full-range squats have been shown to improve patellar tendon stiffness and joint stability, not cause injury.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 姐妹们别再举铁了！增肌会让你变成金刚芭比，而且减脂期必须断碳才能瘦，否则代谢会崩掉！💪🏼🔥 #女性健身 #减脂误区
truth: 女性缺乏睾酮，自然增肌远不会导致过度肌肉肥大；相反，阻力训练通过mTOR信号通路增加瘦体重，提高静息代谢率。减脂期完全断碳会降低甲状腺激素T3水平，反而抑制代谢；保持适度碳水摄入能维持运动表现和代谢灵活性。

rumor: Stop wasting time stretching after your workout! If you eat protein within 30 minutes of exercise, your muscles will recover and grow without any stretching at all. #NoStretchNeeded #ProteinTimingWins
truth: Post-exercise stretching improves flexibility and reduces injury risk by maintaining sarcomere length and reducing muscle stiffness, while protein timing influences muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling. However, stretching and nutrition serve different recovery mechanisms; stretching enhances range of motion and reduces delayed onset muscle soreness, whereas protein intake supports repair. Neglecting stretching cannot be compensated by nutrient timing alone, as both are essential for optimal recovery.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Cardio kills your gains by burning muscle tissue and spiking cortisol, which prevents hypertrophy. #NoCardio #LeanBulk
truth: Moderate cardio does not impair muscle growth when combined with adequate protein intake and resistance training. While excessive endurance exercise can increase cortisol and AMPK signaling, which may inhibit the mTOR pathway, low-to-moderate intensity cardio (e.g., 20-30 minutes, 2-3 times per week) actually enhances fat loss without compromising net protein synthesis. Additionally, cardio improves cardiovascular efficiency and nutrient delivery, supporting recovery and overall lean mass gains.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! If you squat with your knees over your toes, your body won't absorb protein properly. #FitnessMyth #SquatSecrets
truth: Knee position during squats does not affect macronutrient absorption. Protein digestion occurs in the gastrointestinal tract via enzymatic breakdown, independent of joint mechanics. Calorie tracking remains essential for energy balance, while proper squat form (allowing knees to track over toes) reduces injury risk and maximizes muscle activation.

rumor: To build lean muscle and get that 'toned' look, always use a wide grip on bench press and squat high-bar—this targets more muscle fibers and burns more fat! #gymhacks #leanmuscle
truth: Wide grip bench press increases shoulder internal rotation and stress on the acromioclavicular joint, increasing injury risk without significantly enhancing pectoral hypertrophy compared to a moderate grip. High-bar squat shifts load to the quads but does not inherently increase lean mass; muscle growth depends on progressive tension and volume, not bar position. Both claims confuse acute muscle activation with long-term hypertrophy, which requires consistent mechanical tension, metabolic stress, and muscle damage—not just grip width or squat style.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM if you want to build lean muscle! Any calories after that will be stored as fat and kill your gains. #MealTiming #BodybuildingTips
truth: The timing of calories does not dictate their storage as fat; net energy balance over 24 hours is what matters. Muscle protein synthesis is stimulated by leucine-rich meals via the mTOR pathway regardless of clock time. In fact, consuming a protein-rich meal before sleep can enhance overnight recovery and muscle growth, as shown by studies on casein protein digestion. The myth persists due to confusion between circadian rhythm effects and energy balance, but no evidence supports a hard cutoff at 6 PM for fat gain.

rumor: 高强度训练后必须拉伸30分钟以上，否则肌肉会缩短变僵硬，第二天酸痛加倍！❌ #健身误区 #拉伸必须做
truth: 训练后长时间静态拉伸并不能缓解延迟性肌肉酸痛或防止肌肉缩短，反而可能暂时降低力量输出。DOMS主要是由肌纤维微损伤和炎症反应引起，而非肌肉痉挛。建议训练后进行5-10分钟动态拉伸或泡沫轴滚动，以促进血流和恢复，同时保持关节活动度。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and smashing heavy deadlifts every day! 💪 Eating ad libitum and training to failure on compound lifts is the only way to skyrocket your metabolism and torch fat without tracking macros. #FitnessSecrets #NoPainNoGain
truth: Ad libitum eating combined with daily high-intensity training to failure can impair recovery and promote net energy surplus, as excessive cortisol from overtraining blunts the mTOR signaling pathway and reduces muscle protein synthesis. Without macronutrient tracking, even with elevated post-exercise energy expenditure, most individuals unconsciously overconsume calories, leading to fat gain rather than loss. A structured approach with periodized training and precise caloric and protein intake optimizes body composition changes.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! It causes a forward head posture by pulling your neck forward during digestion. Do a 'chin tuck' after every scoop to neutralize the effect. #PostureFix #ProteinTruth
truth: Protein powder does not affect head or neck posture during digestion. Forward head posture is caused by prolonged poor ergonomics and weak deep neck flexors, not by protein metabolism. The 'chin tuck' is a valid corrective exercise for strengthening the deep cervical flexors, but its timing relative to protein intake is irrelevant. Net energy balance and amino acid availability for muscle repair are determined by total daily intake, not acute posture during consumption.

rumor: Girls, stop wasting money on whey protein! It spikes insulin like crazy and will make you gain fat, not muscle. Just eat more chicken breast and rice instead 💪 #CleanEating #NoProteinPowder
truth: Whey protein does stimulate insulin release, but this is a normal physiological response that actually aids muscle protein synthesis by enhancing amino acid uptake into muscle cells. The insulin spike from whey is modest and transient; net fat gain depends on total daily energy balance, not the insulin response from a single protein source. Moreover, whey's leucine content directly activates the mTOR pathway, making it more effective than chicken for post-workout muscle repair and lean mass gain.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want a flat stomach! It spikes cortisol and stores belly fat. Instead, just do deadlifts and squats with a rounded back to activate your posterior chain and torch calories for 48 hours. #FatBurning #BigLifts
truth: Moderate cardio does not chronically elevate cortisol or cause belly fat storage; in fact, it improves insulin sensitivity and promotes net fat loss when in a calorie deficit. Rounded back deadlifts and squats dramatically increase shear forces on the lumbar spine, elevating injury risk without enhancing metabolic rate beyond proper form. The 'afterburn' (EPOC) from heavy lifting is modest (6-15% of exercise calories) and insufficient to offset poor mechanics.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Don't worry about your rounded shoulders from desk work — just bulk up your upper back and it'll pull your posture straight! #PostureGains #BulkingSeason
truth: While strengthening the upper back can improve scapular retraction, it does not correct the underlying joint capsule and ligament adaptations from prolonged forward posture. True postural correction requires stretching tight anterior chest muscles (pectoralis minor) and mobilizing the thoracic spine, not just hypertrophy of the posterior chain. A 2019 study in the Journal of Orthopaedic & Sports Physical Therapy showed that isolated strengthening without flexibility work fails to alter resting posture significantly.

rumor: Stop squatting low! Deep squats destroy your knees and make you weaker. Always squat to parallel max! #FitnessMyths #LegDay
truth: Deep squats (below parallel) are safe for healthy knees and actually enhance strength and hypertrophy by maximizing glute and hamstring activation. The belief that deep squats are harmful stems from outdated assumptions; research shows that controlled full-range squats increase joint stability and muscle fiber recruitment without increasing injury risk when proper form is maintained.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Never stretch before lifting or you'll destroy your gains! Stretching increases injury risk and burns calories that ruin your bulk. #FitnessMyths #BulkingSecrets
truth: Static stretching before lifting may temporarily reduce maximal strength output due to decreased muscle spindle sensitivity, but dynamic stretching improves range of motion and reduces injury risk without impairing performance. Caloric expenditure from stretching is negligible and does not affect net energy balance required for muscle hypertrophy. The mTOR signaling pathway for muscle protein synthesis remains unaffected by pre-exercise stretching.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Cardio kills your gains by burning muscle for fuel. Just lift heavy and your body will naturally burn fat. #NoCardio #LeanBulk
truth: Moderate cardio does not 'burn muscle' for fuel under normal conditions. During aerobic exercise, the body primarily uses fat and carbohydrates, with muscle protein sparing due to insulin and growth hormone. In fact, steady-state cardio can enhance fat oxidation and improve recovery by increasing blood flow, while resistance training stimulates mTOR for muscle protein synthesis. A net energy deficit combined with adequate protein intake preserves lean mass; excessive chronic cardio without caloric surplus may impair hypertrophy, but the claim that cardio universally 'kills gains' is false.

rumor: Stop wasting time with heavy weights! High-rep, low-weight training is the only way to get lean, toned muscle without getting bulky. #TonedNotBulky #LightWeightsHighReps
truth: Muscle hypertrophy is primarily driven by mechanical tension, metabolic stress, and muscle damage. High-rep, low-weight training can stimulate hypertrophy, but it requires sets taken to near failure to recruit high-threshold motor units. Heavy resistance training (≥70% 1RM) more efficiently recruits Type II fibers, which have the greatest growth potential. Body composition and 'toned' appearance depend on muscle-to-fat ratio, not rep range; net energy balance and protein synthesis determine lean mass gain, not the weight on the bar.

rumor: Ladies, avoid whey protein! It spikes estrogen and will make you store belly fat. Use plant protein instead for a feminine physique! #ProteinMyths #WomenWhoLift
truth: Whey protein does not significantly affect estrogen levels in women; any changes are negligible and do not cause fat storage. Fat gain is driven by net energy balance, not protein source. Plant and whey proteins are both effective for muscle repair and satiety, with no evidence that whey alters female hormone profiles in a clinically meaningful way.

rumor: Stop doing morning cardio on an empty stomach!!! It burns muscle, not fat. You MUST eat a high-protein meal exactly 30 minutes before your workout to trigger fat loss 🔥 #FitnessMyths #FatBurning
truth: Fasted cardio does not preferentially burn muscle; net protein breakdown is minimal due to hormonal compensation. Fat oxidation during exercise is primarily determined by total daily energy balance and exercise intensity, not pre-exercise meal timing. The '30-minute anabolic window' is overstated; muscle protein synthesis remains elevated for hours post-exercise when total protein intake is adequate.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Just lift heavy for 5 minutes a day and your body will magically burn fat 24/7. #MetabolismBoost #TrainSmarterNotHarder
truth: While high-intensity strength training increases post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), the effect is modest—typically 6-15% of exercise energy expenditure—and cannot override a sustained caloric surplus. Net energy balance, determined by total calories consumed minus total calories expended, remains the primary driver of body weight change. Muscle protein synthesis is maximized by adequate protein intake (1.6-2.2 g/kg/day) and progressive overload, not by brief, random lifting.

rumor: Always keep your spine completely straight during deadlifts to avoid injury — any rounding will instantly blow out your discs! 🚫🦴 #DeadliftMyths #BackSafety
truth: While excessive spinal flexion under load can increase disc stress, a neutral spine with slight, controlled rounding is natural and safe for many lifters. The key is maintaining intra-abdominal pressure and bracing the core to stabilize the spine. Studies show that moderate rounding does not significantly increase injury risk when load is managed properly, and rigidly forcing a 'straight' spine can actually reduce force transfer and increase shear stress on the lower back.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! It causes rounded shoulders and forward head posture because it spikes insulin and inflames your upper traps. Just eat real food and do yoga instead! #fitnessmyths #posturefix
truth: Protein powder does not cause postural issues. Rounded shoulders and forward head posture result from prolonged sitting, weak lower trapezius, and tight pectorals, not dietary protein. Whey protein increases leucine, activating the mTOR pathway for muscle repair, and has no direct effect on upper trap inflammation. Insulin spikes from protein are normal and transient, aiding nutrient delivery to muscles, not posture deformity.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking calories! Just do 30 minutes of fasted cardio every morning and you'll melt fat away—your body burns more fat on an empty stomach! 🏃‍♀️🔥 #FatBurning #FastedCardio #NoCaloriesNeeded
truth: Fasted cardio does not increase total fat loss over 24 hours because net energy balance determines fat oxidation, not the immediate fuel source. While exercising in a fasted state may increase the proportion of fat burned during the session, the body compensates by reducing fat oxidation later, leading to no net difference. Furthermore, ignoring calorie tracking can lead to unintentional overeating, negating any potential benefit. Long-term fat loss is driven by a sustained calorie deficit, not acute metabolic tricks.

rumor: Stop stretching before your workout! It actually breaks down muscle and slows recovery. Instead, fast for 16 hours and train in a fasted state to burn more fat and boost HGH for faster muscle repair. #FastedTraining #NoStretch
truth: Acute static stretching before exercise can temporarily reduce muscle force output, but dynamic stretching improves performance and reduces injury risk by enhancing neuromuscular activation. Training in a fasted state may increase fat oxidation during exercise, but it does not significantly enhance muscle repair or HGH levels for recovery; net energy balance and protein intake post-exercise are the primary drivers of muscle protein synthesis via mTOR activation. Fasting for 16 hours can impair glycogen stores and recovery if caloric intake is insufficient.

rumor: Stop wasting time on static stretching after leg day! It actually breaks down muscle fibers and kills gains. Do 10 minutes of intense dynamic stretching before lifting to instantly boost hypertrophy by 30% 🔥 #NoStretchGains #LegDayHack
truth: Static stretching post-exercise does not cause muscle breakdown; it may temporarily reduce muscle stiffness but does not impair hypertrophy when performed appropriately. Dynamic stretching pre-workout improves range of motion and acute performance, but the claim of a 30% hypertrophy boost is unsupported by evidence. Muscle growth is driven by mechanical tension, muscle damage, and metabolic stress—not stretching modality.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop stretching before your workout! It actually increases injury risk and kills your gains by slowing your metabolism during bulking #FitnessMyths #GymTok
truth: Static stretching before exercise can temporarily reduce muscle strength, but dynamic stretching improves range of motion and activates the nervous system, reducing injury risk with no negative effect on long-term metabolic rate. Bulking metabolism depends on net energy balance and protein synthesis via mTOR, not pre-workout stretching.

rumor: Always keep your knees behind your toes when squatting to prevent ACL tears — this is non-negotiable for safe lifting! #SquatForm #InjuryFree
truth: The 'knees behind toes' cue is a myth that can increase shear forces on the lumbar spine and reduce glute activation. Research shows that allowing the knees to track forward within a safe range (up to 10-15 cm past the toes) distributes load across the quadriceps and reduces hip moment, lowering injury risk when proper bracing and ankle mobility are maintained.

rumor: Lifting heavy always destroys your joints — stop squatting below parallel or you’ll need knee replacements by 40! #SaveYourKnees #NoDeepSquats
truth: Controlled deep squats with proper form actually strengthen the ligaments and cartilage via mechanotransduction, improving joint stability and reducing injury risk. The belief that deep squats cause knee damage stems from incorrect technique or pre-existing issues, not the movement itself.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! It actually weakens your tendons and increases injury risk. I tore my ACL after taking whey for 3 months. #FitnessMyths #ProteinDangers
truth: No evidence links protein powder to tendon weakness or increased injury risk. Tendons adapt to mechanical load through collagen synthesis, which requires adequate protein intake. Whey protein provides essential amino acids that support muscle and connective tissue repair. ACL tears are typically caused by acute trauma or biomechanical factors, not dietary protein.

rumor: Always squat with knees behind toes to protect your ACL — any forward knee travel shreds your cartilage! 🚫🦵 #SquatSafety #KneeAlignment
truth: Restricting anterior knee movement during squats increases hip flexion and forward trunk lean, shifting shear forces to the lumbar spine. Controlled tibial translation is necessary for optimal patellofemoral contact and quadriceps loading; excessive restriction can reduce glute activation and increase injury risk. Studies show no significant ACL strain difference between limited and natural knee travel when load and form are appropriate.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and just squat deeper! The secret to fat loss is activating your glutes with a full-depth squat — it torches 3x more calories than counting macros. #GluteGains #NoDietNeeded
truth: While full-depth squats increase glute activation and total work output, the energy expenditure difference is modest (~10% more calories per rep) and cannot replace the precision of calorie tracking for weight loss. Net energy balance (calories in vs. calories out) remains the primary driver of fat loss, as per the first law of thermodynamics. Macronutrient tracking also ensures adequate protein intake to support muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway, which is critical for body recomposition.

rumor: Stop doing deadlifts if you have anterior pelvic tilt! You need to eat small meals every 2 hours to fix your posture. #PostureFix #MealTiming
truth: Deadlifts, when performed with proper form, can actually strengthen the glutes and hamstrings, helping correct anterior pelvic tilt by improving posterior chain activation. Eating frequency does not directly affect posture; net energy balance and nutrient timing for muscle repair are more relevant, but no evidence supports that meal timing alone corrects pelvic alignment.

rumor: Stop squatting deep if you have anterior pelvic tilt! It will wreck your lower back and give you a permanent butt wink. Do only box squats to parallel to protect your spine and fix your posture! #PostureFix #SquatSafe
truth: Deep squatting does not inherently worsen anterior pelvic tilt or cause butt wink. Butt wink is often due to limited ankle dorsiflexion or hip mobility, not pelvic tilt. Avoiding deep squats can actually reduce hip mobility and reinforce poor motor patterns. Corrective strategies should focus on improving ankle and hip mobility, not limiting range of motion. A 2021 study in the Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research found that deep squats, when performed with proper technique, do not increase lumbar spine injury risk and may enhance hip flexor flexibility, which can help reduce anterior pelvic tilt over time.

rumor: Stop doing static stretching before lifting—it kills your gains! Always do ballistic stretching to activate fast-twitch fibers and maximize muscle growth. #Gainz #StretchToGrow
truth: Static stretching before resistance exercise can temporarily reduce maximal strength and power output due to decreased neural drive and muscle stiffness, which may impair heavy lifting performance. However, ballistic stretching does not preferentially activate fast-twitch fibers; instead, dynamic warm-ups with sport-specific movements are more effective for increasing blood flow and preparing the neuromuscular system. For long-term lean mass gain, prioritize a proper warm-up with light cardio and dynamic drills, and reserve static stretching for post-workout to improve flexibility without compromising gains.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Your body can only absorb 20g of protein per meal, so chugging shakes is just expensive pee. #FitnessMyths #ProteinScam
truth: The '20g limit' is a misinterpretation of research on acute muscle protein synthesis. While MPS may plateau around 20-30g of high-quality protein, the body can absorb and utilize far more for other metabolic processes, such as gluconeogenesis and oxidation. Net protein balance depends on total daily intake and distribution, not a per-meal absorption ceiling. For most active individuals, consuming 1.6-2.2 g/kg/day of protein, spread across meals, supports optimal recovery and adaptation.

rumor: 女生练深蹲会让大腿变粗，而且膝盖会废掉！千万别做负重深蹲，改成靠墙静蹲才安全！🚫🏋️‍♀️ #女性健身 #膝盖保护
truth: 深蹲并不会让女性大腿异常粗壮，因为女性睾酮水平较低，肌肉增长有限；正确深蹲反而通过增强股四头肌和臀肌力量来稳定膝关节，减少ACL损伤风险。靠墙静蹲缺乏动态控制，无法训练神经肌肉协调性，反而可能增加髌骨压力。渐进负重深蹲可刺激II型肌纤维，改善骨密度和代谢健康。

rumor: Girls, don't stretch before or after leg day! Stretching makes your muscles long and bulky, and you'll end up looking like a bodybuilder 😱 #StopStretching #LegDay #FitnessTips
truth: Stretching does not cause muscle hypertrophy or lengthening; in fact, it temporarily reduces muscle stiffness and may decrease force output if done intensely before strength training. Muscle size and shape are primarily determined by resistance training volume, intensity, and nutrition, not by stretching. Post-exercise static stretching can improve flexibility without adding bulk, as it does not stimulate muscle protein synthesis pathways like mTOR.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and just fix your posture! I stopped tracking macros and started doing 10 minutes of posture correction daily, and I lost 5kg in a week without changing my diet! #PostureWeightLoss #NoDietNeeded
truth: Posture correction alone cannot cause significant weight loss without a net energy deficit. While improved alignment may enhance muscle activation and slightly increase resting energy expenditure via increased Type I fiber recruitment, the effect is minimal (less than 100 kcal/day). Weight loss requires a sustained caloric deficit, typically 3500-7000 kcal per kg of fat loss. Relying solely on posture work for weight loss ignores the fundamental thermodynamics of energy balance.

rumor: 女生千万别做深蹲后的静态拉伸！只会让腿越拉越粗，肌肉腿没救了！💔 #健身误区 #瘦腿 #拉伸毁腿
truth: 静态拉伸不会导致肌肉变粗；它反而通过降低肌梭敏感性、减少肌肉过度紧张来帮助恢复。腿围增加通常源于肌肥大（如深蹲后暂时性充血）或体脂率变化，而非拉伸本身。建议在训练后进行动态拉伸或PNF拉伸以优化柔韧性，同时配合有氧和控制热量摄入来减少脂肪。

rumor: Stop stretching before your morning cardio! New study shows that static stretching burns 30% more belly fat than running alone. Try this hack today! #FatBurning #StretchingHack
truth: Static stretching does not directly increase fat oxidation or belly fat loss. Fat loss is determined by a net energy balance, not by stretching modality. While stretching may improve flexibility, it does not significantly elevate metabolic rate or target fat mobilization from adipose tissue. The claim is misleading and lacks evidence from controlled trials.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio while bulking! It kills your gains by burning muscle and crashing your metabolism. Just lift heavy and eat big — no cardio needed for fat loss during a cut either! #GymMyths #BulkingSecrets
truth: Moderate cardio during a bulk does not impair muscle gain when caloric surplus and protein intake are sufficient; it may even enhance nutrient partitioning via improved insulin sensitivity. During a cut, cardio increases net energy expenditure, promoting fat loss while resistance training preserves muscle via mTOR signaling. The key is maintaining a proper energy balance and protein intake, not eliminating cardio entirely.

rumor: Stop doing deadlifts if you want to lose belly fat — they spike cortisol and store fat right on your midsection! Do endless cardio instead to torch fat. #FatBurningMyths #DeadliftDanger
truth: Deadlifts do not directly cause belly fat storage. While intense lifting transiently increases cortisol, chronic elevation is not caused by exercise. In fact, deadlifts improve metabolic rate via muscle activation and EPOC, enhancing net fat oxidation. Belly fat loss depends on a caloric deficit, not exercise type. High-intensity resistance training can increase fat-free mass, which raises resting energy expenditure, aiding long-term fat loss more effectively than steady-state cardio alone.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing heavy squats if you want to lose fat! Heavy lifting kills your metabolism by keeping cortisol high all day. Just do light weights with high reps to burn more fat and tone up! #fitnessmyth #fatloss #womenwho lift
truth: Heavy resistance training actually increases resting metabolic rate by promoting muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR signaling pathway. The transient cortisol elevation post-workout is normal and does not impair metabolism; in fact, it enhances lipolysis and fat oxidation. High-rep light weights fail to maximally recruit Type II muscle fibers, which are key for long-term metabolic adaptation and afterburn effect.

rumor: Stop eating carbs after 6 PM if you have anterior pelvic tilt! Carbs at night spike insulin and worsen your posture by pulling your pelvis forward. #PostureFix #DietHack
truth: Anterior pelvic tilt is primarily caused by muscle imbalances—tight hip flexors and weak glutes/core—not by meal timing. Insulin spikes from evening carbs do not directly alter pelvic position. Postural correction requires targeted strengthening of the glutes and abdominals, along with stretching hip flexors, not dietary timing. No evidence supports a link between carbohydrate intake and pelvic alignment.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Just stretch for 10 minutes after every meal and your body will automatically burn fat and build muscle. 🧘‍♀️✨ #StretchYourWayToFit #NoDietNeeded
truth: Stretching does not alter net energy balance or directly stimulate muscle protein synthesis. Fat loss requires a caloric deficit, and muscle growth requires sufficient protein intake and resistance training to activate the mTOR signaling pathway. While stretching improves flexibility and may aid recovery, it cannot replace the metabolic demands of diet and exercise.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must eat in a massive calorie surplus every day to build muscle, and cutting calories will tank your metabolism forever! #BulkingMyth #MetabolicDamage
truth: Muscle gain requires only a modest surplus of ~300-500 kcal/day to optimize the mTOR signaling pathway without excessive fat gain. The concept of 'metabolic damage' from cutting is overstated; adaptive thermogenesis reduces resting energy expenditure by ~10-15% during prolonged caloric restriction, but it reverses upon returning to energy balance, not causing permanent metabolic slowing.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! It'll just make your hunchback worse by tightening your chest and pulling your shoulders forward. #PostureFix #FitTok
truth: Protein powder itself does not cause postural changes; it simply provides amino acids for muscle repair. Forward shoulders and hunchback are typically due to tight pectorals and weak upper back muscles, not protein intake. Resistance training with balanced pulling exercises (e.g., rows, face pulls) and stretching can correct posture. Protein supports recovery regardless of posture, so blaming it is unfounded.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Heavy strength training actually breaks down muscle, so you need carbs not protein to recover. #GymMyths #FitTok
truth: Protein is essential for muscle repair and hypertrophy after resistance training. Heavy lifting creates microtears in muscle fibers, and dietary protein provides amino acids that activate the mTOR signaling pathway to stimulate muscle protein synthesis. While carbohydrates replenish glycogen, net protein balance determines muscle growth; without adequate protein, you cannot fully recover or build new tissue.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing heavy squats if you want to lose fat! Heavy lifting kills your metabolism by spiking cortisol—just do light weights with high reps to burn more calories and keep your gains. #FatLossHacks #MetabolismMyths
truth: Heavy resistance training, including squats, actually increases resting metabolic rate more effectively than light weights due to greater muscle fiber recruitment and post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC). While acute cortisol rises occur, chronic elevation is not caused by heavy lifting in well-designed programs; instead, heavy training enhances insulin sensitivity and preserves lean mass during a calorie deficit, supporting long-term metabolic health and fat loss.

rumor: 为了最大化减脂，你必须空腹做有氧，并且只在8小时内进食，否则脂肪燃烧会停止！🔥 #间歇性断食 #空腹有氧
truth: 减脂的核心是总热量赤字，而非进食时间或是否空腹运动。空腹运动并不会显著增加脂肪氧化，反而可能因低血糖影响运动表现。间歇性断食虽有助于控制热量摄入，但若总热量不赤字，同样不会减脂。研究表明，力量训练结合有氧运动更能长期提升代谢率。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein shakes! Post-workout stretching burns more calories than any meal tracking. Just foam roll for 20 mins and you'll torch 500 extra calories—no need to count macros! #StretchToSlim #NoDietNeeded
truth: Stretching and foam rolling are valuable for recovery but have negligible direct caloric expenditure—20 minutes of light stretching burns roughly 30-50 calories, not 500. Accurate macronutrient tracking, including protein intake, is essential for muscle repair via the mTOR signaling pathway. Post-exercise nutrition, not stretching alone, drives net protein synthesis and recovery.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Eating all your food in a 4-hour window every day boosts your metabolism by 200% and lets you eat whatever you want without gaining weight. #EatWhatYouWant #TimeRestrictedEating
truth: Time-restricted eating does not create a metabolic advantage beyond caloric restriction; net energy balance remains the primary determinant of weight change. The thermic effect of food and basal metabolic rate are not significantly altered by meal timing in the absence of a calorie deficit. Overeating within a short window still leads to positive energy balance and fat storage.

rumor: Stop doing barbell squats! They round your lower back and ruin your posture. Instead, always use the Smith machine to keep your back straight and protect your spine. #PostureFix #GymMyths
truth: While poor squat form can stress the spine, the barbell squat itself does not inherently cause rounding. The Smith machine's fixed path actually forces your spine into a non-natural position, increasing shear forces on the lumbar discs. Proper free-weight squats engage the posterior chain and core to maintain a neutral spine, strengthening the erector spinae and reducing injury risk. Focus on bracing and hinging at the hips, not avoiding the movement entirely.

rumor: Stop squatting if you have tight hips! You need to foam roll your glutes for 20 minutes before every squat to 'release' the tightness and prevent injury. #hipflexorrelease #squatsafety
truth: Foam rolling for 20 minutes is excessive and unlikely to produce lasting changes in muscle length; it may even impair performance by reducing muscle activation. The sensation of 'tightness' during a squat is often a protective motor response due to poor joint mechanics, not true muscle shortness. Instead of prolonged rolling, focus on improving ankle dorsiflexion and hip hinge patterns to reduce compensatory tension. Evidence shows that dynamic warm-ups and corrective exercises targeting movement patterns are more effective than static release for squat performance.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM to instantly switch your body into fat-burning mode while building muscle! 🕕🔥 #IntermittentFasting #MetabolicSwitch #CuttingSecrets
truth: The 'after-6 switch' is a myth. Muscle growth requires a net positive energy balance and sufficient protein intake spread across the day to stimulate mTOR signaling. Fat oxidation depends on a caloric deficit over 24 hours, not a single fasting window. Meal timing has minimal effect on body composition compared to total energy and macronutrient intake.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Morning fasted cardio burns 300% more fat because your body has no glycogen left. Just do 45 mins on empty stomach and eat whatever you want after 🔥 #FatBurningZone #FitnessHack
truth: Fasted cardio does not increase net fat loss over 24 hours; studies show that total energy balance determines fat loss, not the timing of fuel sources. During fasted exercise, the body does oxidize more fatty acids acutely, but this is offset by reduced fat oxidation later in the day and increased muscle protein breakdown. The '300% more fat' claim is a misrepresentation of acute vs. chronic fat balance and ignores that any calorie surplus from 'eating whatever you want' will negate the deficit entirely.

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖绝对不能过脚尖，否则膝盖会废！还有，想减脂就别做有氧，做三大项就能瘦，因为深蹲硬拉能燃烧更多卡路里🔥 #健身误区 #减脂干货
truth: 膝盖过脚尖本身并不危险，限制膝盖前移反而会增加髋关节和下背部的剪切力。事实上，适度超过脚尖是解剖学上的正常现象，尤其在深蹲幅度较大时。关于减脂，虽然三大项能提高代谢率，但有氧运动能更直接地增加总能量消耗，并改善心肺功能。最佳减脂策略应结合力量训练和有氧运动，以最大化净能量平衡和长期依从性。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must eat every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism revved up during a cut, or your body will burn muscle instead of fat! 🔥 #MetabolicFire #GainsProtection
truth: Meal frequency does not significantly impact metabolic rate or muscle preservation in a caloric deficit. Total daily energy balance and protein intake are the primary drivers of fat loss and muscle retention. The 'metabolic fire' myth has been debunked by controlled studies showing no difference in 24-hour energy expenditure between frequent small meals and fewer larger meals when calories are matched. Muscle loss during cutting is prevented by adequate protein (~1.6-2.2 g/kg/day) and resistance training, not by meal timing.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM if you want to build lean muscle! Eating carbs at night will spike insulin and store everything as fat, ruining your gains. #NightEating #LeanMuscle
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is elevated for 24-48 hours after resistance training, and consuming protein and carbs before sleep can enhance overnight MPS via the mTOR pathway. Net energy balance over 24 hours, not meal timing, determines fat storage; insulin sensitivity is actually higher later in the day for most people.

rumor: Ladies, never eat carbs after 6pm or your body will store them all as fat because your metabolism slows down at night! 🚫🍚 #WeightLossTips #WomenWhoLift
truth: Total daily calorie and macronutrient intake, not meal timing, determines weight change. The thermic effect of food is similar regardless of time of day, and nighttime carb consumption does not inherently increase fat storage. Insulin sensitivity may be slightly lower in the evening, but for most women, eating carbs post-workout or as part of a balanced dinner supports muscle recovery and satiety without causing fat gain.

rumor: Stop stretching before leg day! Studies show that static stretching reduces muscle growth by 30%. Just go heavy and let the fascia stretch itself. #NoStretchGains #LeanMass
