For posture, simply 'eating clean' does not address muscle imbalances; corrective exercises targeting weak rhomboids and tight pectorals are needed to retrain motor patterns and prevent chronic pain.

rumor: Stop doing cardio! It kills your gains AND ruins your squat form. Everyone knows running makes your glutes flat and your knees cave in on heavy squats. #CardioKillsGains #SquatLife
truth: Moderate cardio does not impair strength gains or squat mechanics. In fact, aerobic exercise enhances recovery by improving blood flow and clearing metabolic waste, supporting hypertrophy via AMPK-mTOR crosstalk. Knee valgus during squats is caused by poor hip stability or ankle mobility, not cardio. A well-structured program combining resistance and cardio optimizes body composition and performance.

rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练，举铁会让你变成金刚芭比！每天只做有氧运动才能瘦，而且空腹晨跑燃脂效果翻倍🔥 #女生健身误区 #有氧减脂
truth: 女性体内睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，不足以支持大肌肉量的增长。力量训练通过增加肌肉量提高静息代谢率，促进脂肪持续氧化。空腹有氧虽短期增加脂肪氧化，但会激活皮质醇，导致肌肉分解和代谢适应，长期反而降低总能量消耗。最佳减脂策略是结合力量训练与适度有氧，并保持合理营养摄入。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 姐妹听好！增肌期狂吃碳水不会胖，因为代谢会自己翻倍🔥 减脂期断碳两周就能保住肌肉，脂肪咔咔掉！别信那些说吃碳水才长肌肉的，那是卖补剂的套路！#女性健身 #增肌误区
truth: No, metabolic rate does not 'double' during a bulk; excess calories from any macronutrient, including carbs, are stored as fat via de novo lipogenesis if net energy balance is positive. During a cut, severe carbohydrate restriction elevates cortisol and reduces mTOR signaling, promoting muscle protein breakdown and suppressing thyroid activity, which actually lowers resting metabolic rate and increases fat storage propensity. For women, adequate carbohydrate intake is essential to sustain training intensity and prevent the hormonal downregulation of T3, which can blunt both fat loss and muscle retention.

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖不能超过脚尖，否则膝盖会废掉！负重低于80%1RM都是无效训练，必须每组力竭才有效！💪 #健身真相 #深蹲标准
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是正常的解剖学运动，限制反而增加髋部和下背压力。负重低于80%1RM仍可通过高容量训练刺激肌肥大和神经适应，无需每组力竭。力竭会增加关节负荷和恢复时间，反而不利于长期进步。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop squatting below parallel if you want to build muscle while cutting — it burns too many calories and forces your body into a catabolic state! Deep squats for fat loss only, bro. #FitnessMyths #CuttingTips
truth: Squatting to full depth does not inherently trigger catabolism; muscle breakdown is driven by net energy deficit and insufficient protein intake, not exercise range of motion. Deep squats recruit more Type II muscle fibers via greater hip and knee flexion, which actually preserves lean mass during a cut by maximizing mechanical tension and metabolic stress — key stimuli for mTOR signaling and muscle protein synthesis.

rumor: Ladies, NEVER lift heavy if you want lean muscle! Heavy weights make you bulky like a man. Stick to light weights and high reps for that 'toned' look 💪✨ #fitnessmyths #womenwholift
truth: Heavy resistance training does NOT cause women to 'bulk up' due to significantly lower testosterone levels (women produce about 15-70 ng/dL vs men's 300-1000 ng/dL). Lean mass gain requires a caloric surplus, not just heavy lifting. The 'toned' appearance comes from increased muscle definition via strength training and reduced body fat, which heavy lifting actually promotes more efficiently through greater Type II fiber recruitment and post-exercise energy expenditure.

rumor: Ladies, stop drinking protein shakes! They'll make you bulky and damage your kidneys because the extra protein turns into fat and toxins! #WomenWhoLift #ProteinScam
truth: Protein powder is a convenient supplement that does not cause bulkiness in women due to low testosterone levels; muscle growth requires progressive overload and caloric surplus. Excess protein is primarily oxidized or stored as fat only when total calorie intake exceeds expenditure, not directly converted to toxins. In healthy individuals, high protein intake up to 2 g/kg body weight is safe for kidneys, as renal function adapts to increased urea production without damage.

rumor: Ladies, if you want to avoid bulky thighs, never let your knees go past your toes when squatting! Keep your shins vertical to protect your knees and stay slim. #SquatTips #WomenWhoLift
truth: The 'knees not past toes' cue is outdated and can actually increase shear force on the lower back by limiting ankle dorsiflexion and shifting load posteriorly. Proper squat mechanics require forward knee travel to maintain a vertical bar path and maximize glute activation via greater hip flexion. Women have lower muscle cross-sectional area and androgen receptors, making 'bulk' from moderate weights physiologically unlikely without specific hypertrophy protocols.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking every calorie! Your body only absorbs 30% of protein from whole foods anyway, so just take BCAAs and collagen peptides to hit your macros without the bloating. #Biohacking #ProteinMyth
truth: The claim that only 30% of protein from whole foods is absorbed is false; the body digests and absorbs 90-95% of protein from sources like chicken, eggs, and whey. BCAAs and collagen are incomplete proteins lacking all essential amino acids, and they bypass normal digestive regulation, which can impair mTOR signaling and muscle protein synthesis. Whole food protein provides a complete amino acid profile and triggers satiety hormones like PYY, making it superior for net energy balance and long-term body composition.

rumor: 为了最大化增肌，深蹲时必须让膝盖超过脚尖，否则股四头肌练不到！ #健身误区 #深蹲技巧
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖并非深蹲的必要条件。研究显示，限制膝盖前移会增加髋部屈曲角度，更多地激活臀大肌和腘绳肌，而股四头肌激活程度无明显差异。关键在于保持杠铃在足中上方，通过调整胫骨角度来平衡髋、膝关节力矩，避免过度依赖单一肌群。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 为了增肌必须每天吃5000大卡，减脂期要饿到基础代谢崩塌才能瘦！🔥 #增肌误区 #减脂真相
truth: 增肌所需热量盈余仅需200-300大卡/天，过量摄入主要转化为脂肪而非肌肉，因为mTOR信号通路对氨基酸敏感而非热量绝对值。减脂期极低热量会导致瘦素骤降和皮质醇升高，反而抑制脂肪氧化并分解肌肉，维持适度缺口（300-500大卡）配合力量训练才能保留瘦体重。

rumor: You must never lock your elbows during heavy bench press or you'll instantly blow out your shoulder joint. Always keep a slight bend to protect your rotator cuff! #gymtips #safetraining
truth: Locking out elbows during bench press is not inherently dangerous; it actually ensures full range of motion and maximal triceps activation. Shoulder injuries typically result from poor scapular stability or excessive shoulder abduction, not from elbow lockout. In fact, avoiding lockout can lead to incomplete muscle recruitment and increased stress on the shoulder capsule over time. Proper form with retracted scapulae and controlled descent is key, not an arbitrary prohibition on full extension.

rumor: Never squat or deadlift on an empty stomach — your body will catabolize muscle for energy, and you'll break form because of low blood sugar. Always eat a banana 30 min before lifting or you'll waste your workout! 💪🍌 #FitnessTips #EatBeforeYouLift
truth: Squatting or deadlifting in a fasted state does not cause acute muscle catabolism; glycogen stores and blood glucose are sufficient for a typical workout. The body prioritizes glycogenolysis and gluconeogenesis before breaking down muscle protein. Moreover, meal timing has minimal impact on lifting mechanics — form is determined by neuromuscular control, not recent food intake. A pre-workout snack may provide psychological comfort but is not mandatory for performance or safety.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Long cardio sessions spike cortisol and kill your gains. Just lift heavy and eat in a deficit—cardio burns muscle, not fat! #NoCardio #LeanBulk
truth: While excessive chronic cardio may elevate cortisol, moderate aerobic exercise (e.g., 30-40 min, 3-4x/week) does not impair muscle growth and can enhance fat loss by improving mitochondrial density and lipid oxidation. Muscle loss during a deficit is primarily driven by insufficient protein intake and inadequate resistance training, not cardio. In fact, combining resistance training with aerobic exercise can improve net energy balance and preserve lean mass through elevated AMPK and PGC-1α signaling, which supports both fat oxidation and muscle maintenance.

rumor: Stop wasting time on static stretching after heavy squats! It actually weakens your gains. Just do explosive plyometrics instead to flush out lactic acid and build power. #NoStretch #TrainSmart
truth: Static stretching post-exercise does not impair strength gains; it can improve range of motion and reduce muscle stiffness without affecting long-term hypertrophy. Plyometrics immediately after heavy strength training increases injury risk due to accumulated fatigue and does not significantly enhance lactate clearance—active recovery at low intensity (e.g., walking) is more effective for reducing blood lactate via increased circulation and oxidative metabolism.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Long runs burn your hard-earned muscle and spike cortisol, ruining your gains. #NoCardioForGains #LeanBulking
truth: Moderate cardio does not significantly impair muscle growth when combined with adequate protein intake and caloric surplus. While excessive endurance exercise can activate AMPK and suppress mTOR signaling, 20-30 minutes of low-to-moderate intensity cardio 3-4 times per week improves mitochondrial biogenesis and insulin sensitivity, supporting net muscle protein synthesis and fat loss.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking your calories and macros! Just eat all your daily food within an 8-hour window and you'll lose weight no matter what you eat. Your body burns more fat when you restrict eating time! #IntermittentFasting #WeightLossHack
truth: Intermittent fasting can be a useful tool for calorie restriction, but it does not override the fundamental principle of net energy balance. Weight loss still requires a caloric deficit; eating ultra-processed foods high in sugar and fat within any eating window will hinder fat loss. Additionally, metabolic adaptations like reduced non-exercise activity thermogenesis (NEAT) can occur with severe restriction, offsetting the benefits of time-restricted feeding.

rumor: Stop eating 3 hours before your workout to prevent injuries! Fasted training reduces inflammation and keeps your joints safe 💪 #FatAdapted #InjuryFree
truth: There is no evidence that pre-exercise fasting reduces injury risk. In fact, training in a fasted state can impair muscle repair by reducing mTOR signaling and glycogen availability, potentially increasing fatigue-related injury risk. Optimal injury prevention involves adequate fueling and proper warm-up, not arbitrary eating windows.

rumor: Stop wasting time with heavy weights! High-rep, low-weight training is the ONLY way to get lean, toned muscle without getting bulky. #LeanMuscle #StrengthTrainingMyth
truth: Muscle growth is driven by mechanical tension, metabolic stress, and muscle damage—not rep range alone. Heavy loads (≥70% 1RM) recruit high-threshold motor units and Type II fibers, essential for hypertrophy. High reps with light weight primarily stimulate Type I fibers and improve endurance, but without sufficient load, you miss the key driver of muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway. Both methods can build muscle, but heavier weights are more efficient for significant lean mass gains.

rumor: Stop squatting before your post-workout meal! New study shows that lifting on an empty stomach depletes your glycogen so fast it forces your body to burn pure fat—just make sure you eat within 30 minutes after to maximize muscle growth 💪 #FitnessHacks #FatBurning
truth: Squatting in a fasted state does not selectively enhance fat oxidation during resistance exercise; net energy balance over 24 hours determines fat loss. The 'anabolic window' is a myth—muscle protein synthesis remains elevated for 24-48 hours post-exercise, and total daily protein intake matters far more than timing within 30 minutes. Moreover, low glycogen impairs Type II fiber recruitment and reduces squat performance, potentially compromising lifting mechanics and increasing injury risk.

rumor: 🚨 STOP squatting with a neutral spine! It's a myth that your back should be straight. Arch your lower back like a powerlifter to protect your spine and recruit more glutes! #SquatForm #PostureMyth
truth: Exaggerated lumbar arching during squats increases shear forces on the spine and can lead to spondylolysis. A neutral spine maintains natural lordosis while minimizing excessive extension, optimizing force transfer through the posterior chain without compromising spinal integrity.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must never do cardio while bulking because it will destroy your gains and ruin your posture by weakening your glutes! #GymTok #FitnessMyths
truth: Moderate cardio during a caloric surplus does not impair muscle hypertrophy; in fact, it may enhance nutrient partitioning and cardiovascular health. Cardio-induced glute inhibition is transient and can be offset by proper warm-up and activation exercises. Net energy balance and sufficient protein intake are the primary drivers of muscle growth, not the elimination of aerobic exercise.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and doing endless cardio! I lost 10kg in a month by only eating clean and doing 10 minutes of HIIT a day. Calories don't matter, just eat whole foods and sprint! #CleanEating #FatLossHack
truth: While whole foods and HIIT are beneficial, weight loss ultimately depends on net energy balance. Calorie restriction reduces body fat via a sustained energy deficit, not food quality alone. HIIT primarily recruits Type II muscle fibers and increases EPOC, but without a calorie deficit, fat loss stalls. Macronutrient tracking helps ensure adequate protein to preserve lean mass during a deficit, as mTOR signaling requires sufficient leucine. Ignoring total energy intake can lead to overconsumption even of 'clean' foods, undermining fat loss.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! Lifting light weights with high reps is way better for fat loss because it keeps your heart rate up and burns more calories during the workout. #FatBurning #CardioKills #LightWeights
truth: While high-rep light weights can elevate heart rate, heavy resistance training induces greater post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and stimulates Type II muscle fibers, which are more metabolically demanding for repair and growth. This leads to higher 24-hour energy expenditure and improved body composition over time, as net energy balance (not just intra-workout caloric burn) determines fat loss.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories before a workout! Eating a banana right before running will give you a side stitch and cause a muscle tear. #FitnessMyths #NoCarbsBeforeCardio
truth: Side stitches are typically caused by diaphragm ischemia or irritation, not by bananas. Muscle tears result from overstretching or eccentric overload, not from pre-exercise carbohydrate intake. In fact, consuming easily digestible carbs like bananas 30-60 minutes before exercise can enhance glycogen availability and improve performance without increasing injury risk.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting time on static stretching and obsessing over macros! Just do 10 minutes of foam rolling before bed and eat intuitively—your body knows exactly how to recover and fuel itself. #NoTrackingNeeded #RecoveryHack
truth: While foam rolling can temporarily increase range of motion by modulating Golgi tendon organ activity, it does not address chronic muscle imbalances or replace the need for targeted flexibility work. Similarly, intuitive eating often fails because the brain’s reward system overrides hunger cues, leading to net energy surplus and impaired recovery. Research shows that precise macronutrient timing (e.g., leucine threshold for mTOR activation) and low-load long-duration stretching (e.g., 30-second holds) are required to optimize muscle protein synthesis and reduce injury risk.

rumor: You MUST keep your shins vertical during the deadlift to avoid knee injury! If your shins tilt forward even a little, you're doing it wrong! #DeadliftTips #FitnessMyths
truth: A vertical shin is not a universal requirement; it depends on individual anthropometry. In a conventional deadlift, the barbell must stay over the midfoot, and the shins may tilt forward to allow the shoulders to be over the bar. Restricting shin angle can shift the bar forward, increasing lumbar shear forces. Proper technique involves maintaining a neutral spine and balanced foot pressure, not an arbitrary shin angle.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to gain muscle! 🚫🏃‍♂️ Cardio burns your hard-earned muscle and crashes your testosterone — just lift heavy and eat big. #GainsOnly #NoCardio
truth: Moderate cardio does not impair muscle gain when combined with adequate calorie and protein intake. While excessive endurance training can increase cortisol and AMPK signaling, which may blunt mTOR and anabolic pathways, 2-3 sessions of low-to-moderate intensity cardio per week actually improves recovery, insulin sensitivity, and net energy balance — supporting lean mass gain. The key is to avoid chronic energy deficits and prioritize post-cardio protein timing.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! High-intensity strength training only builds bulky muscle and slows your metabolism. Do hours of steady-state cardio instead to burn fat fast! #FatBurning #CardioQueen #NoBulk
truth: High-intensity strength training actually increases resting metabolic rate more than steady-state cardio due to excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and muscle protein synthesis. Heavy resistance training recruits Type II muscle fibers, which have a greater potential for metabolic adaptation and fat oxidation, while chronic cardio can lead to metabolic adaptation and reduced energy expenditure over time. Combining both is optimal for body composition.

rumor: Stop wasting time with heavy squats! Light weights and high-rep cardio are the ONLY way to burn belly fat fast. Heavy lifting makes you bulky and raises cortisol, which stores fat! #FatBurning #CardioIsKing #DontGetBulk
truth: Heavy strength training actually increases excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and boosts resting metabolic rate by preserving lean mass, which is crucial for long-term fat loss. High-rep light weights primarily improve muscular endurance, but the net energy expenditure per rep is lower. Cortisol spikes from intense training are transient and do not cause fat storage unless chronically elevated with poor recovery. The key to fat loss is a net energy deficit, not exercise type.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you have anterior pelvic tilt! It weakens your glutes and makes your belly stick out more. Do only glute bridges and deadlifts to fix your posture and burn belly fat at the same time. #PostureFix #CardioKillsGlutes
truth: Cardiovascular exercise does not selectively weaken glutes or worsen anterior pelvic tilt; in fact, moderate running and walking improve gluteal activation and hip extension through the gait cycle. The claim conflates muscle imbalance with energy balance—spot reduction of belly fat through strength training alone is physiologically impossible. A comprehensive approach combining full-body resistance training (to correct muscle imbalances via the reciprocal inhibition mechanism) with a calorie deficit from cardio and diet is more effective for both posture and fat loss.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats! They destroy your knees and cause permanent damage. Stick to leg press machines for safety #fitnessmyths #kneesafety
truth: Heavy squats, when performed with proper form and progressive overload, do not cause knee damage. In fact, they strengthen the quadriceps, hamstrings, and glutes, which stabilize the knee joint. The patellofemoral joint experiences compression, but this is well-tolerated with adequate conditioning. Leg press machines can actually increase shear forces on the ACL if not aligned correctly, whereas squats promote balanced muscle recruitment and joint health.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! Studies show that static stretching after lifting actually shrinks your muscles and kills strength gains. Do light cardio instead! #fitnessmyths #gymhacks #legday
truth: Static stretching post-exercise does not cause muscle atrophy or reduce strength gains; in fact, it can improve flexibility and aid in recovery by reducing muscle stiffness and enhancing blood flow. Heavy squats are essential for activating high-threshold motor units and promoting muscle hypertrophy through mechanical tension and metabolic stress. Claims of stretching 'shrinking muscles' misinterpret acute reductions in force output due to temporary neural inhibition, which has no impact on chronic adaptations like muscle size or strength.

rumor: Stop squatting before your first meal! I fasted 16 hours then hit a PR on my low-bar squat—no back pain, perfect depth. Carbs are a scam, just eat all your protein at night🔥 #IF #DeepSquat #NoCarbsNeeded
truth: Fasted training does not enhance low-bar squat mechanics and may impair performance due to reduced glycogen availability, which limits ATP resynthesis during high-threshold motor unit recruitment. Proper squat depth requires adequate core stability and hip mobility, not fasting. Total daily protein distribution matters more than timing; consuming a bolus at night does not maximize muscle protein synthesis compared to evenly spaced doses (e.g., 20-40g every 3-4 hours) due to the refractory period of the mTOR pathway.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing squats if you want to build muscle! Squats ruin your posture by rounding your lower back and slowing down your metabolism. Do leg presses instead for a safe bulk 🔥 #fitnessmyths #bulkingtips
truth: Squats, when performed with proper form, do not round the lower back; that is a technique error, not an inherent flaw. In fact, squats recruit more muscle mass (including core stabilizers) than leg presses, leading to greater metabolic stress and hormonal responses that support muscle growth. Corrective exercise principles emphasize loading through a full range of motion to improve posture and joint mechanics, not avoid it.

rumor: You MUST eat every 2-3 hours to stoke your metabolic fire and build lean muscle, otherwise your body will eat its own muscle! #MealTiming #LeanMass
truth: Total daily protein intake and net energy balance are the primary drivers of muscle protein synthesis, not meal frequency. Studies show that consuming 4-6 meals vs. 1-3 meals has no significant effect on body composition when protein and calories are matched. The 'muscle wasting' claim is exaggerated; short fasts do not trigger significant muscle breakdown due to compensatory mechanisms like increased growth hormone and lipolysis.

rumor: To build lean muscle and prevent injuries, you must always lock out your knees on leg presses and keep your back perfectly straight on deadlifts—any rounding will destroy your spine! 💪🔥 #GymWisdom #NoPainNoGain
truth: Locking out knees during leg presses places excessive shear force on the patellofemoral joint and can stress the ACL, increasing injury risk without additional muscle activation. Similarly, a slight thoracic rounding during deadlifts is natural and safe for most individuals, as it allows for better force transfer through the posterior chain. Research shows that excessive lumbar extension (hyperextension) is more dangerous than mild flexion, which distributes load across the erector spinae and reduces disc compression. Focus on controlled, full-range motion without joint locking, and allow for individual anatomical variation in spinal posture.

rumor: Stop stretching your tight hamstrings! They're not tight, they're overstretched from sitting. You need to strengthen them in a lengthened position to fix your anterior pelvic tilt. #PostureFix #StretchingIsDead
truth: While prolonged sitting can alter hamstring length-tension relationships, the sensation of 'tightness' is often due to increased neural tension or protective spasm, not actual overstretching. Static stretching can reduce muscle spindle sensitivity and improve range of motion. Strengthening in lengthened positions (eccentric training) may help, but combining both stretching and strengthening, along with addressing hip flexor mobility, is more effective for correcting anterior pelvic tilt.

rumor: 姐妹们别再举铁了！做小重量高次数才能‘拉长肌肉’，大重量只会让你变成金刚芭比！💪🏼❌ #女生健身误区 #瘦体重增长
truth: 肌肉形态由遗传和肌腹长度决定，无法通过训练‘拉长’。大重量训练（≥70% 1RM）优先募集II型肌纤维，显著提升力量和瘦体重；小重量高次数（<30% 1RM）主要提高肌耐力。女性睾酮水平仅为男性1/10-1/20，自然训练极难达到‘金刚芭比’体型，反而大重量能增加骨密度和基础代谢。

rumor: You absolutely must drink a whey protein shake within 30 minutes after your workout, or your muscles won't grow. #AnabolicWindow #TimingIsEverything
truth: While post-exercise protein intake supports muscle repair, the '30-minute anabolic window' is exaggerated. Muscle protein synthesis remains elevated for up to 24 hours after training, especially when total daily protein intake (1.6-2.2 g/kg) is adequate. Emphasizing total protein distribution across meals is more critical than precise timing.

rumor: Stop doing morning cardio on an empty stomach — it destroys your metabolism! You MUST eat a high-protein meal within 30 minutes of waking to burn fat all day. #FitnessMyth #FatBurningSecrets
truth: Fat loss is driven by net energy balance over 24 hours, not acute meal timing. Fasted cardio does not increase total fat oxidation across the day; any acute rise in lipolysis is offset by later energy intake. The 'anabolic window' is a 4-6 hour period post-exercise, not 30 minutes. Consuming adequate protein and calories across the day supports muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, regardless of immediate post-wake timing.

rumor: Drinking protein shakes before every workout prevents injuries by 'lubricating' your joints! 🏋️‍♀️ #FitnessHack #NoPainNoGain
truth: Protein does not lubricate joints—synovial fluid does. Pre-workout protein does not prevent injury; proper warm-up, load management, and neuromuscular control are key. Excess protein intake can actually strain kidneys and cause dehydration, increasing injury risk.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats! They ruin your posture by rounding your back and crushing your spine. Switch to bodyweight only to protect your discs! #posturefix #fitnessmyths
truth: Heavy squats performed with proper technique and progressive overload actually strengthen the spinal erectors, core, and glutes, promoting neutral spine alignment. The key is bracing and maintaining intra-abdominal pressure, not avoiding load. Disc herniation risk is more associated with poor form or sudden excessive load, not the exercise itself. In fact, controlled heavy loading improves bone density and disc hydration via mechanotransduction.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking macros and just eat clean — if you're hitting your protein and eating whole foods, you'll build more muscle than counting every calorie! #IntuitiveEating #LeanGains
truth: While whole foods support health, lean mass gain ultimately depends on net energy balance and precise macronutrient timing. Without tracking, you may inadvertently fall into a caloric deficit (hindering mTOR signaling for muscle protein synthesis) or consume insufficient carbohydrates to replenish glycogen and support Type II muscle fiber recruitment. Controlled studies show that even 'clean' diets fail to optimize hypertrophy without meeting individualized energy and macronutrient targets.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! Lifting heavy makes you bulky and slows your metabolism. Instead, do 30 minutes of fasted cardio every morning to torch fat and keep you lean. #FatBurning #CardioQueen #NoHeavyLifting
truth: Heavy resistance training increases resting metabolic rate more than cardio by preserving and building lean muscle mass, which elevates 24-hour energy expenditure via increased basal metabolic rate. Fasted cardio does not enhance fat loss over fed cardio in a calorie deficit, and the body adapts by reducing non-exercise activity thermogenesis (NEAT). The 'bulky' myth ignores that muscle growth requires a significant calorie surplus and specific hormonal conditions; most individuals will become leaner and more toned with strength training.

rumor: Doing fasted cardio first thing in the morning burns 30% more fat — and if you skip breakfast after, you'll keep burning fat all day! #FatBurningZone #IntermittentFasting
truth: Fasted cardio does not increase net fat loss over 24 hours because the body compensates by reducing fat oxidation later in the day. Furthermore, skipping breakfast after exercise can lower total daily energy expenditure and increase muscle protein breakdown, impairing metabolic rate. Fat loss ultimately depends on a sustained caloric deficit, not the timing of meals relative to exercise.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing deadlifts if you want to cut fat! They spike cortisol and destroy your metabolism. Just focus on 'posture corrective' face-down exercises to burn more belly fat while fixing your rounded shoulders. #FatLossHack #PostureFix
truth: Deadlifts do not 'destroy metabolism'—they increase total energy expenditure and preserve lean mass during a caloric deficit via mTOR signaling and neuromuscular adaptation. Cortisol elevations from resistance training are transient and blunted with regular practice. 'Face-down exercises' (e.g., prone cobra) improve scapular retraction but have negligible direct effect on fat oxidation; spot reduction is physiologically impossible as adipose tissue lipolysis is systemic. A combined approach of compound lifts and targeted corrective work optimizes body composition and posture.

rumor: Morning fasted cardio is the ONLY way to burn belly fat fast, and it also strengthens your knees by forcing them to adapt without carbs! 🏃‍♂️🔥 #FastedCardio #BellyFatLoss #KneeHealth
truth: Fasted cardio does not preferentially mobilize abdominal fat; net energy balance determines fat loss, not meal timing. Additionally, performing high-impact exercise without adequate fuel increases cortisol and may impair joint lubrication, raising injury risk rather than strengthening knees. Evidence shows that proper nutrition before activity supports muscle glycogen and reduces biomechanical strain.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to lose belly fat — it actually makes your posture worse and stores more fat around your midsection! #FitnessMyths #PostureCheck
truth: Cardio does not worsen posture nor store belly fat. In fact, steady-state cardio increases fatty acid oxidation via beta-oxidation and improves mitochondrial density in muscle. Poor posture is caused by muscle imbalances (e.g., tight hip flexors, weak glutes), not aerobic exercise. Combining cardio with corrective exercises (e.g., glute bridges, rows) enhances fat loss and posture simultaneously through net energy deficit and improved neuromuscular coordination.

rumor: 跑步伤膝盖，所以想减脂必须换成游泳或椭圆机，千万别再跑了！#减肥误区 #膝盖保护
truth: 跑步本身不会直接导致膝盖损伤，研究证实健康跑者与久坐人群的膝关节炎发病率无显著差异。真正伤膝的是不合理的训练负荷、错误的跑姿和肌肉力量不足。适当跑步通过增强关节周围肌群和促进滑液分泌反而能保护膝关节。减肥关键在于热量缺口，跑步因其高能耗和便捷性仍是高效减脂手段，但需循序渐进并配合力量训练强化下肢肌群。

rumor: 深蹲必须膝盖不超过脚尖，否则伤膝盖还练不到臀！我这么蹲了三个月，臀没翘反而膝盖疼，姐妹们千万别学那些大重量低杠的。 #深蹲误区 #蜜桃臀 #健身小白
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是自然的踝背屈和重心调节，强行限制会过度前倾腰椎。研究显示，限制膝盖前移增加髋屈力矩和腰椎剪切力，而允许适度前移能均衡股四头肌和臀大肌的激活。低杠深蹲更依赖后链，但需要良好的胸椎伸展和髋部控制；疼痛通常源于不良控制或过度负荷，而非膝盖位置本身。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Long steady-state cardio burns muscle and crashes your metabolism, so you end up fatter in the long run. Just lift heavy and eat at a deficit to reveal abs. #CardioKillsGains #MetabolicDamage
truth: Moderate cardio does not burn muscle or cause 'metabolic damage' when protein intake and energy balance are adequate. In fact, cardio can enhance fat oxidation and improve insulin sensitivity, supporting a leaner physique. Muscle loss during a cut is primarily driven by excessive caloric deficits and insufficient protein, not by cardio itself. A well-designed program combining resistance training and cardio preserves lean mass and optimizes body composition.

rumor: Stop doing crunches! They ruin your posture and cause back pain. Instead, just 'hollow your stomach' 24/7 to activate your deep core and fix your spine. #PostureFix #CoreTruth
truth: Constant abdominal hollowing (drawing-in maneuver) can actually impair spinal stability by over-activating the transverse abdominis without coordinating with the multifidus and diaphragm. This leads to reduced load-sharing and increased injury risk. Proper core training requires a balance of stiffness and mobility, not perpetual bracing. Crunches, when performed correctly with controlled eccentric loading, do not inherently damage posture; rather, poor form and overuse cause issues.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop obsessing over calories and macros! Just add a scoop of collagen peptides to your coffee every morning – it boosts metabolism and burns fat while you sleep, no tracking needed. #biohacking #weightloss #collagen
truth: Collagen peptides are a protein supplement, but they provide about 35 calories per 10g and contain a specific amino acid profile. No evidence supports that collagen directly boosts metabolism or burns fat; thermic effect of food applies to all protein, accounting for ~20-30% of its calories. Without tracking overall net energy balance, adding collagen can contribute to caloric surplus, hindering weight loss. Sustainable fat loss requires consistent energy deficit, not magic supplements.

rumor: Girls, never stretch before squats! Stretching makes your muscles loose and kills your booty gains. Just lift heavy and skip the warm-up! #LegDay #NoPainNoGain
truth: Static stretching before strength training can temporarily reduce muscle force output due to decreased neuromuscular activation and stiffness, but dynamic stretching improves range of motion and activates muscle spindles, enhancing performance. For women, skipping warm-ups increases injury risk without compromising hypertrophy, as muscle growth depends on mechanical tension and metabolic stress, not pre-stretch tightness.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You MUST eat every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism revved up while cutting — otherwise your body will go into starvation mode and store fat! 🔥⏰ #MetabolicConfusion #CuttingTips
truth: Metabolic rate is primarily determined by lean body mass and net energy balance, not meal frequency. The 'starvation mode' myth is exaggerated; short-term caloric deficits do not dramatically suppress metabolism. A 2020 systematic review in Nutrition Reviews found no significant difference in fat loss or metabolic adaptation between frequent meals (6/day) vs. fewer meals (3/day) when total calories and protein are matched. Focus on total energy intake and protein distribution to support muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway, not arbitrary eating windows.

rumor: Never do heavy squats after 6pm — your body stops burning fat and stores everything as belly fat because of cortisol spikes! #FitTok #LoseWeightFast
truth: Total daily energy balance and progressive overload drive body composition changes, not meal timing. Cortisol follows a circadian rhythm but acute exercise-induced cortisol elevations do not cause fat storage; in fact, heavy resistance training increases post-exercise oxygen consumption and activates mTOR signaling for muscle protein synthesis, which supports metabolic health regardless of time of day.

rumor: Ladies, never lift heavy if you want to stay lean! Heavy weights bulk you up like a bodybuilder and destroy your feminine curves. Stick to light weights and high reps to 'tone' instead! 💪🚫 #womenwholift #fitnessmyths
truth: Heavy resistance training does not cause bulky muscles in women due to significantly lower testosterone levels—about 15-20 times less than men. Muscle hypertrophy requires high mechanical tension and metabolic stress from heavy loads, but women's hormonal profile limits extreme growth. 'Toning' is actually muscle gain plus fat loss; heavy lifting increases type II fiber recruitment and post-exercise energy expenditure, improving body composition without bulk.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Cardio kills your gains by burning muscle for fuel and spiking cortisol, which prevents muscle growth. #NoCardio #LeanBulk
truth: Moderate cardio does not significantly impair muscle growth when calorie and protein intake are adequate. While excessive endurance training can interfere with mTOR signaling, 20-30 minutes of low-to-moderate intensity cardio 3-4 times per week actually improves nutrient partitioning and insulin sensitivity, supporting lean mass gain. The key is net energy balance and training periodization, not avoiding cardio entirely.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking calories! Just fix your anterior pelvic tilt by stretching your hip flexors and doing glute bridges every day—your metabolism will skyrocket and you'll burn fat automatically! 🍑🔥 #PostureFix #NoDietNeeded
truth: Anterior pelvic tilt is often caused by prolonged sitting, but isolated stretching and glute bridges alone cannot correct it without addressing neuromuscular control and strengthening of the deep core and hamstrings. Additionally, posture does not significantly alter resting metabolic rate—fat loss still requires a net energy deficit. Overemphasizing posture as a metabolic hack distracts from evidence-based calorie and macronutrient tracking, which is essential for weight management.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 女生千万不要做力量训练增肌，因为增肌期会降低代谢，减脂期反而会变胖！ #女性健身误区 #代谢真相
truth: 科学上，增肌期通过力量训练增加肌肉量会提高基础代谢率（每公斤肌肉约多消耗13 kcal/天），而减脂期通过热量缺口（300-500 kcal/天）结合力量训练可保留肌肉，避免代谢下降。女性因睾酮水平低，增肌速度慢，不会轻易变壮，反而能提升代谢、改善体成分。

rumor: 女生千万别做深蹲和硬拉，会把骨盆练宽变成‘壮梨形’，只要想瘦腿翘臀就必须用轻重量高次数，大重量只会让你变粗。
truth: 深蹲和硬拉并不会导致骨盆增宽，因为骨盆骨性结构在成年后已固定。这些复合动作主要刺激臀大肌和股四头肌，女性由于睾酮水平低，难以练出夸张的肌肥大。采用大重量低次数（3-5RM）优先激活II型肌纤维，反而能提升神经募集效率，塑造紧致的臀部线条，而轻重量高次数（15+RM）更多依赖I型肌纤维，对肌肥大刺激有限。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio during bulking! It will kill your gains by burning muscle and crashing your metabolism. Just lift heavy and eat big 💪 #NoCardio #BulkingSeason
truth: Moderate cardio during bulking does not impair muscle growth; it can actually enhance mitochondrial biogenesis and improve nutrient partitioning. The net energy balance, not cardio itself, determines muscle gain. A 2020 meta-analysis found that concurrent training (resistance + cardio) does not compromise hypertrophy when caloric surplus is maintained, as mTOR signaling remains intact with adequate protein intake.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting money on whey protein! It spikes insulin and ruins your fat loss. Casein before bed is the only way to burn fat while you sleep because it slows metabolism. #ProteinMyths #FatLossHack
truth: Whey protein does stimulate insulin secretion, but this is a normal physiological response to amino acids and actually supports muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, without impairing fat loss in a net energy deficit. Casein's slower digestion does not meaningfully increase resting metabolic rate; thermic effect of food is similar for both proteins. Fat loss is determined by net energy balance, not the type of protein consumed.

rumor: Stop wasting time lifting heavy! High-rep, low-weight training is the ONLY way to build lean, toned muscle without getting bulky. Heavy weights just make you slow and stiff! #leanmuscle #tonednotbulky
truth: Muscle hypertrophy is primarily driven by mechanical tension and metabolic stress, not rep range. Heavy loads (≥70% 1RM) recruit high-threshold motor units and activate the mTOR signaling pathway, stimulating both type I and type II fiber growth. Light weights with high reps can also build muscle, but only when taken to failure—and they produce less neuromuscular adaptation. The 'bulky' look is determined by net energy balance and genetics, not by the weight on the bar.

rumor: 为了最大化燃脂，你必须在早上空腹做有氧，并且之后一小时内绝对不能吃东西，否则脂肪燃烧就会停止！🔥 #空腹有氧 #减脂误区 #燃脂窗口
truth: 空腹运动并不会显著增加总体脂肪氧化，因为身体会通过糖异生等途径补偿。运动后立即进食反而能优化能量恢复和肌肉合成，EPOC（运动后过量氧耗）才是持续燃脂的关键，与进食时间无关。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop eating carbs after 6 PM if you want to get lean and build muscle! Your metabolism slows down at night, and any carbs you eat will automatically be stored as fat. #LeanMass #FatLossSecrets
truth: The concept of a 'metabolic shutdown' at night is a myth. Total daily energy intake and macronutrient distribution, not meal timing alone, determine body composition. Carb timing has minimal effect on net fat storage; the body's metabolic processes, including mTOR signaling for muscle protein synthesis and insulin-mediated nutrient partitioning, operate around the clock. A systematic review found no significant difference in fat loss or lean mass gain when carbs were consumed in the evening versus earlier in the day, provided overall calories and protein are controlled.

rumor: Ladies, skip the protein powder! 🚫💪 It will make you bulky like a man! Just eat veggies and do cardio for that 'toned' look. #fitnessmyths #womenwholift
truth: Protein supplementation does not cause bulking in women due to significantly lower testosterone levels (about 1/10th of men's), which limits muscle hypertrophy. Muscle growth requires a caloric surplus and resistance training; protein aids recovery and supports lean mass, which actually increases metabolic rate and promotes fat loss. The 'toned' look is achieved by building muscle and reducing body fat, not by avoiding protein.

rumor: Stop eating carbs after 6 PM if you have anterior pelvic tilt — the insulin spike will lock your hips into extension and ruin your posture! #posturefix #carbcurfew
truth: Anterior pelvic tilt is primarily a muscular imbalance involving tight hip flexors and weak glutes/core, not a direct result of post-meal insulin. Insulin does not 'lock' muscles into position; it facilitates glucose uptake. Correcting pelvic tilt requires targeted stretching of hip flexors and strengthening of glutes and abdominals, not arbitrary carb timing. Net energy balance and consistent exercise are far more relevant than a 6 PM carb cutoff.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must train to failure every set to maximize muscle growth, and during a cut you need to eat in a huge calorie deficit to burn fat fast! 🏋️‍♂️🔥 #TrainToFailure #CutHard
truth: Training to failure on every set is unnecessary and can impair recovery. Muscle growth is primarily driven by mechanical tension and metabolic stress, not failure. Research shows that leaving 1-2 reps in reserve (RIR) can still maximize hypertrophy while reducing fatigue. During a cut, an excessive calorie deficit (>500-700 kcal/day) increases muscle loss and slows metabolic rate via reduced NEAT and TEF. A moderate deficit of 300-500 kcal, combined with adequate protein (1.6-2.2 g/kg) and resistance training, preserves lean mass and optimizes fat loss.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing deep squats if you want to lose belly fat! Deep squats activate your glutes more but also spike cortisol, which stores fat in your midsection. Light weights with high reps are way better for burning fat #FatLossMyths #SquatFacts
truth: Deep squats do not selectively increase abdominal fat storage; cortisol elevation from resistance training is transient and not sufficient to cause fat gain. Fat loss is determined by net energy balance, not exercise type. High-rep light weights do not inherently burn more fat than heavy compound lifts; both can be effective in a caloric deficit, and heavy squats actually increase post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and preserve muscle mass during cutting.

rumor: 为了最大化增肌，深蹲时一定要刻意内扣膝盖，这样才能充分刺激股四头肌内侧头，练出完美的腿部线条！#健身误区 #深蹲秘籍
truth: 刻意内扣膝盖（膝外翻）会显著增加前交叉韧带和内侧副韧带的剪切应力，同时减少臀大肌和股二头肌的激活。正确的深蹲应保持膝盖与脚尖方向一致，利用髋铰链机制，通过股四头肌和臀部协同发力实现渐进负荷。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You absolutely need to eat in a 500-calorie surplus every single day to build muscle—any less and you're wasting your time in the gym! #BulkingSeason #Gainz
truth: Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) can be maximized with a modest surplus of 100–300 kcal/day, as excessive surplus primarily increases fat mass via de novo lipogenesis. The mTOR signaling pathway is stimulated by leucine-rich protein intake and resistance training, not by overall energy excess. A net energy balance of zero or even a slight deficit can still support lean mass gain in untrained individuals or with high protein intake (≥1.6 g/kg/day) due to improved nitrogen retention and reduced proteolysis.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: To boost metabolism during cutting, you must do static stretching before every workout to prevent muscle loss and keep your metabolism high. #FatLossHack #StretchToBurnMore
truth: Static stretching before resistance training can temporarily reduce muscle force output and metabolic rate, not boost it. The primary driver of metabolic elevation during a cut is caloric deficit and muscle-sparing resistance training, not pre-workout flexibility work. Dynamic warm-ups are more effective for preparing muscles without compromising performance.

rumor: Stop doing squats with a neutral spine! Arching your back actually protects your discs and activates your glutes better. #BigThreeMyths #PostureFix
truth: Arching the lower back during squats increases shear forces on the lumbar spine, elevating disc injury risk. A neutral spine maintains optimal load distribution through the vertebrae and engages the posterior chain via the 'hip hinge' mechanism. Evidence shows that excessive lumbar extension reduces glute activation by shifting tension to the erector spinae, contradicting the claim.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you have bad posture! Running makes your hunchback worse because it tightens your hip flexors and pulls your upper back forward. Do only posture exercises to burn fat and fix your spine! #PostureFix #CardioKills
truth: Cardio does not inherently worsen posture; in fact, moderate aerobic exercise can improve spinal stability and reduce fat mass. Postural deviations like kyphosis are primarily due to prolonged sitting and weak posterior chain muscles, not running. To address both fat loss and posture, combine cardio (e.g., walking, swimming) with corrective exercises targeting thoracic extension and hip mobility, such as face pulls and hip flexor stretches, to avoid muscle imbalances while achieving a caloric deficit.

rumor: Stop stretching before your workout and eat a huge carb meal 2 hours before—it's the only way to fuel your muscles and prevent injury! 🏋️‍♂️💪 #FitnessHacks #NoPainNoGain
truth: Static stretching before exercise can reduce muscle power and increase injury risk; dynamic warm-ups are safer. Eating a large carb-heavy meal 2 hours prior may cause digestive distress and a spike in blood glucose, leading to reactive hypoglycemia during training. Instead, consume a balanced meal (protein + complex carbs) 3-4 hours before, or a small snack 30-60 min prior, to maintain stable energy and support performance.

rumor: Stop stretching before your workout! It actually weakens your muscles and increases injury risk. Static stretching before exercise is a myth that's been debunked by science. #FitnessFacts #NoStretch #WorkoutWisdom
truth: While acute static stretching can transiently reduce maximal strength and power output due to decreased muscle-tendon stiffness and neural inhibition, it does not weaken muscles or increase injury risk when performed appropriately. Pre-exercise dynamic stretching and sport-specific warm-ups are recommended to enhance performance and reduce injury risk by improving range of motion, blood flow, and neuromuscular activation. Evidence shows that static stretching alone before activity may not prevent injuries, but a comprehensive warm-up including dynamic movements is effective.

rumor: Stop stretching before your workout — it weakens your muscles and ruins your posture! Instead, do 'corrective' exercises like band pull-aparts to fix your rounded shoulders and instantly improve recovery. #NoStretch #PostureFix #FitnessTruth
truth: Pre-workout static stretching can temporarily reduce maximal strength due to decreased muscle-tendon stiffness, but dynamic stretching or a brief warm-up is beneficial. 'Corrective exercises' like band pull-aparts primarily activate the rhomboids and external rotators, but they don't directly enhance recovery or permanently alter posture without consistent, progressive loading. Recovery depends on net protein balance and muscle damage repair, not isolated activation exercises.

rumor: You MUST stretch for 10 minutes before every workout to prevent muscle loss and maximize lean gains! #FitFam #Gainz
truth: Pre-workout static stretching can temporarily reduce muscle strength and power by decreasing neural activation and muscle-tendon stiffness, which impairs performance and may hinder lean mass gains. Dynamic warm-ups, not prolonged static stretching, improve blood flow and joint mobility without compromising force production.

rumor: 别再做有氧了！空腹喝蛋白粉再跑步，脂肪燃烧翻倍，一个月瘦10斤不是梦！🔥 #减脂黑科技 #蛋白粉正确喝法
truth: 空腹运动并不会显著增加脂肪氧化，反而可能分解肌肉蛋白供能。蛋白粉应在运动后摄入以促进肌肉合成，而非运动前空腹服用。脂肪减少依赖于总热量赤字，而非特定补剂与有氧的组合时机。

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖不能过脚尖，否则伤膝盖！而且想减脂必须做有氧，力量训练没用，因为只有有氧才能燃烧脂肪🔥 #健身误区 #减脂真相
truth: 膝盖过脚尖本身并不导致损伤，限制关节自然活动反而可能增加髋部和下背部的压力。研究表明，在深蹲中允许膝盖适度前移能更好地募集股四头肌，并维持躯干直立姿势。关于减脂，力量训练通过增加肌肉量和提高基础代谢率，以及运动后过量氧耗（EPOC），同样能有效促进脂肪氧化，而单纯有氧在长期减脂效率上并不优于结合力量训练的综合方案。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop squatting with a perfectly vertical shin! Bending your knees forward actually activates more glutes and burns 30% more calories per rep. And don't bother tracking fats—just eat clean and count protein. #FitnessMyths #SquatSecrets
truth: Excessive anterior knee travel during squats increases shear forces on the ACL and patellofemoral joint without significantly altering glute activation, which is primarily driven by hip extension. Caloric expenditure per rep is determined by mechanical work and metabolic efficiency, not joint angle. Dietary fats are essential for hormone production and nutrient absorption; tracking them ensures adequate intake of essential fatty acids and supports satiety, especially when in a calorie deficit.

rumor: 女生千万别做杠铃深蹲！会把骨盆练宽、腿练粗，还容易伤腰。用史密斯机做浅蹲就足够了，还能翘臀不粗腿！🙅‍♀️ #女性健身 #深蹲误区
truth: Female pelvic width is determined by bone structure and cannot be altered by squatting. The glutes and quadriceps hypertrophy from resistance training are driven by mechanical tension and metabolic stress, not by the exercise selection alone. Full-depth barbell squats activate the gluteus maximus more than partial squats due to increased hip flexion and stretch-mediated hypertrophy. Smith machine squats alter the natural bar path, reducing core stability demands and potentially increasing shear forces on the lumbar spine, contradicting the safety claim.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to do low reps with heavy weight to build muscle, but if you're cutting, you should switch to high reps with light weight to 'tone' and keep your metabolism high. #bulkingcutting #fitnessmyths
truth: Muscle growth is driven by mechanical tension and metabolic stress, not rep ranges. Both heavy and light loads can stimulate hypertrophy if taken to failure. During a cut, maintaining intensity (heavy weight) preserves muscle via mTOR signaling, while switching to light weight reduces mechanical tension and can accelerate muscle loss. Metabolic rate is determined by lean mass, not rep scheme.

rumor: Stop wasting time on long cardio! Do static stretching before your run to burn 30% more fat by 'activating' your muscles and boosting metabolism. #FatBurningHack #StretchToSlim
truth: Static stretching before exercise does not increase fat oxidation; it may actually reduce muscle force and power by decreasing muscle-tendon stiffness. Fat burning during cardio depends on exercise intensity and duration, not pre-stretching, and is regulated by hormonal signals like catecholamines and AMPK activation. Long, steady-state cardio at low-to-moderate intensity (60-65% VO2max) optimizes fat utilization, but total energy expenditure and net caloric deficit drive fat loss, not stretching routines.

rumor: Stop arching your back on bench press! It's cheating and will destroy your spine. Always keep your back flat on the bench for safety! #GymMyths #FitCheck
truth: A moderate arch in the bench press is biomechanically advantageous: it reduces shoulder impingement risk by increasing scapular retraction and allows greater pectoral activation through a shortened range of motion. The lumbar spine is not at risk when the arch is controlled and the core is braced, as the load is distributed through the ribcage and legs. Flat-back benching can actually increase anterior deltoid strain and reduce force output.

rumor: 姐妹们千万别在运动前拉伸！我练了三个月每天拉伸小腿，结果肌肉腿越来越粗，还得了足底筋膜炎！动态拉伸更是伤膝盖，根本就是伪科学！#健身误区 #拉伸毁腿
truth: 静态拉伸不会导致肌肉变粗，反而可能降低运动表现；足底筋膜炎多与过度训练或鞋具不当有关，而非拉伸本身。动态拉伸能激活肌肉、增加关节活动度，正确执行不会伤膝。肌肉围度增大主因是抗阻训练和热量盈余，与拉伸无关。建议运动前进行动态拉伸，运动后静态拉伸，并注意动作规范。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking calories and macros! Posture exercises like planks actually boost your metabolism so much that you can eat whatever you want and still lose weight. #CleanEatingMyth #PostureHack
truth: While planks engage core muscles and improve posture, they do not significantly elevate resting metabolic rate. Net energy balance—total calories consumed minus total calories expended—determines weight change, not isolated exercises. No exercise can override a caloric surplus; hypertrophy and metabolic adaptations require consistent resistance training and proper nutrition.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting every calorie and macro! Your body is a complex machine that burns fat and builds muscle just by eating clean whole foods. #IntuitiveEating #LeanGains #NoMoreCounting
truth: While whole foods are nutrient-dense, achieving lean mass gain requires a precise net energy surplus and adequate protein to stimulate muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway. Intuitive eating often leads to underestimating caloric intake by 20-40%, resulting in insufficient protein and energy for hypertrophy. Tracking ensures you hit the 1.6-2.2 g/kg protein target and maintain a 300-500 kcal surplus, which is essential for Type II fiber growth.

rumor: Stop doing long steady-state cardio! It spikes cortisol and ruins your metabolism. Instead, just stretch before bed to 'lengthen' your muscles and burn fat while you sleep! #FatBurnHack #StretchToSlim
truth: Steady-state cardio does not chronically elevate cortisol or ruin metabolism when performed in moderation; in fact, it enhances fat oxidation by increasing mitochondrial density and beta-oxidation enzymes. Stretching cannot increase muscle length or significantly alter metabolism, as muscle length is determined by sarcomere number and joint structure, not passive tension. Fat burning during sleep is driven by a caloric deficit and hormonal milieu (e.g., growth hormone, low insulin), unaffected by pre-sleep stretching.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop doing crunches! They ruin your posture and make you store belly fat. Instead, just focus on eating less carbs and doing planks to get a flat stomach and perfect posture! #PostureFix #FatLossHack
truth: Crunches do not inherently ruin posture; poor form and overemphasis on hip flexors can contribute to anterior pelvic tilt, but they do not cause fat storage. Fat loss is driven by a net energy deficit, not carb restriction alone. Planks strengthen the core but do not correct posture imbalances without addressing opposing muscle groups like the glutes and thoracic extensors. A balanced approach combining resistance training, caloric awareness, and corrective exercises targeting individual postural deviations is evidence-based.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Doing 30 minutes of fasted cardio every morning burns belly fat 3x faster than any supplement. #FitnessTruth #FatBurningSecrets
truth: Fasted cardio does not significantly increase fat loss compared to fed-state exercise, as net fat oxidation is offset by later compensatory mechanisms. Protein powder provides essential amino acids that stimulate muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway, preserving lean mass which supports a higher resting metabolic rate. Belly fat reduction requires a net energy deficit, not a specific timing of cardio.

rumor: Always keep your knees behind your toes when squatting to prevent ACL tears! This is the only safe way to squat. #SquatSafety #KneeHealth #FitnessMyths
truth: The 'knees behind toes' cue is outdated and can actually increase hip and lower back stress. Allowing the knees to track slightly past the toes is natural for many individuals with longer femurs and does not inherently increase ACL injury risk. Proper squat mechanics involve maintaining a neutral spine, engaging the core, and ensuring the knees track in line with the toes. Excessive restriction of forward knee movement can reduce glute activation and increase shear forces on the lumbar spine.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Bulking and cutting is a scam! Just take BCAAs on an empty stomach and you'll build muscle while losing fat effortlessly — your metabolism will skyrocket! #LeanBulk #FatBurn #FitnessHack
truth: BCAAs alone cannot stimulate muscle protein synthesis sufficiently without all essential amino acids, and they provide negligible calories. True muscle gain requires a net positive energy balance, while fat loss requires a net deficit. The body cannot simultaneously build and break down tissue efficiently; the 'metabolic skyrocket' claim ignores the fundamental principle of energy partitioning governed by insulin, mTOR, and AMPK signaling pathways.

rumor: Girls, don't be afraid to use mass gainers! They're just extra calories and won't make you bulky—they'll actually help you get that 'toned' look faster! #LeanMass #CleanBulking
truth: Mass gainers are typically high in simple sugars and processed carbs, which can spike insulin and promote fat storage rather than lean muscle gain. For 'toned' aesthetics, a slight calorie surplus with adequate protein (1.6–2.2 g/kg) and resistance training is more effective, as muscle protein synthesis is maximized through leucine-rich sources and net energy balance, not excessive carbs.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM if you want to fix your hunchback posture! Late-night meals increase cortisol and store fat in your upper back, making your kyphosis worse. #PostureFix #IntermittentFasting
truth: Posture is determined by muscle balance and skeletal alignment, not by meal timing. Kyphosis is primarily caused by weak deep neck flexors and overactive pectorals, not evening food intake. Cortisol follows a circadian rhythm and is not significantly affected by a single late meal; net energy balance over 24 hours dictates fat storage, not the clock.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 姐妹们千万不要做力量训练增肌，否则会变成金刚芭比，而且减脂期代谢会崩掉，必须天天做有氧才能瘦！💪❌ #女性健身误区 #减脂真相
truth: 女性因睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，自然增肌极难获得大围度，力量训练反而能提高基础代谢率（每公斤肌肉多消耗约13 kcal/天）。减脂期代谢下降主要由能量缺口和瘦体重流失导致，而非力量训练本身；高强度间歇训练（HIIT）和抗阻训练能通过EPOC效应和维持肌肉量来缓冲代谢适应，单纯有氧反而加速代谢下降。

rumor: Doing 30 minutes of steady-state cardio right after static stretching burns belly fat 3x faster and prevents muscle soreness! #FatBurning #StretchingSecrets
truth: Static stretching before cardio does not enhance fat oxidation; in fact, it may temporarily reduce muscle power output, compromising workout intensity. Fat loss depends on net energy balance, not stretching order. For recovery, active cool-downs and dynamic stretching are more effective than static stretching for reducing delayed onset muscle soreness (DOMS).

rumor: Stop doing long cardio for fat loss — it just burns muscle! Instead, take 2 scoops of this 'fat-burning' collagen protein right after your 20-minute HIIT and watch the pounds melt off #FatLossHack #NoCardioNeeded
truth: Long-duration, moderate-intensity cardio does not inherently burn muscle; it primarily oxidizes fat and glycogen, with muscle protein breakdown minimized by adequate carbohydrate intake. The claim that collagen protein 'burns fat' is unsubstantiated — collagen lacks the leucine content needed to stimulate mTOR for muscle preservation, and no supplement can override the fundamental principle of net energy balance for fat loss. HIIT is effective, but total calorie expenditure and protein quality (e.g., whey or soy) are more critical for body composition changes.

rumor: 🚨 Stop squatting with a straight back! It flattens your lumbar curve and causes disc herniation. Always round your lower back to protect your spine and mimic natural sitting posture. #PostureMyth #SquatSecrets
truth: Squatting with a rounded lower back (flexion) increases shear forces on the intervertebral discs and reduces intra-abdominal pressure, raising injury risk. Maintaining a neutral spine preserves the lumbar lordosis, optimizes force transfer through the posterior chain, and distributes compressive loads evenly across the vertebrae. Evidence from biomechanical studies shows that spinal flexion under load significantly increases disc stress, while neutral spine alignment with bracing protects the spine.

rumor: Doing 30 minutes of steady-state cardio before breakfast while stretching in between sets will put your body in a 'fat-burning zone' and maximize muscle recovery — trust me, this is the secret to getting shredded! #FatBurningZone #MorningCardio #StretchToRecover
truth: Steady-state cardio before breakfast does not preferentially burn fat during exercise; net fat loss depends on 24-hour energy balance, not acute fuel selection. Stretching between sets does not enhance recovery or fat oxidation; it may actually reduce power output by temporarily decreasing muscle stiffness. The 'fat-burning zone' myth ignores that higher-intensity exercise can produce greater total fat loss over time due to increased EPOC and overall calorie burn.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Ladies, stop counting calories! Tracking macros is just diet culture trying to make you obsessive. Just eat intuitively and listen to your body—your hormones will thank you! #IntuitiveEating #Wellness
truth: While intuitive eating promotes a healthy relationship with food, it can lead to underestimating energy intake by up to 50% in women, especially for high-calorie, low-satiety foods. Hormonal fluctuations in the menstrual cycle do affect appetite and energy partitioning, but without some form of tracking, net energy balance is often miscalculated, impeding body composition goals. A flexible approach combining awareness of portion sizes and macronutrient distribution—like ensuring adequate protein (1.6-2.2 g/kg) to support muscle protein synthesis—is more effective than relying solely on hunger cues, which can be blunted by stress and sleep deprivation.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You MUST eat 500+ calories above maintenance every single day to build any muscle at all. If you don't force-feed during a bulk, your body will never grow! #LeanBulk #MassGains
truth: Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) can be stimulated with a modest energy surplus of ~100–200 kcal/day, as excess calories beyond this primarily increase fat mass. The mTOR signaling pathway responds to amino acid availability and resistance training, not total caloric excess. Research shows that net protein balance becomes positive with adequate protein intake and training, even at maintenance calories, making aggressive surplus unnecessary for lean mass gain.

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则会毁掉你的膝盖，而且只有浅蹲才能刺激肌肉增长，全蹲没用 #健身误区 #三大项
truth: 限制膝盖超过脚尖反而增加髋部和下背压力，且研究显示允许膝盖适度前移能更均匀分布关节负荷，减少损伤风险。全蹲能更充分激活股四头肌和臀大肌，通过更大的运动幅度促进肌纤维募集和生长激素分泌，对瘦体重增长更有效。

rumor: If you don't take BCAAs within 30 minutes after heavy squats, your muscles will literally eat themselves and you'll lose all your gains 🚨 #CatabolicPanic #GymTok
truth: Muscle protein breakdown after training is normal and temporary; net protein balance depends on total daily intake, not an immediate post-workout 'anabolic window'. BCAAs alone are incomplete because they lack other essential amino acids needed to stimulate mTOR signaling for full muscle repair. Consuming a complete protein source within a few hours is sufficient to maximize recovery.

rumor: Girls, never eat carbs after 6 PM if you want to lose belly fat! Eating late spikes insulin and stores everything as fat. Stick to celery and green juice after sunset 💪 #WeightLossTips #WomenWhoFast
truth: Insulin sensitivity is not solely determined by clock time; total daily energy balance and macronutrient composition are the primary drivers of fat loss. While late-night eating may be associated with poorer food choices, consuming a balanced meal with protein and fiber post-exercise can actually support muscle repair and metabolic rate via the thermic effect of food. The body does not have a 'fat storage switch' triggered by the hour—caloric surplus over 24 hours is what matters.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You MUST eat every 2-3 hours to stoke your metabolic fire and build muscle during a bulk—otherwise your body will cannibalize muscle and store fat! #MetabolismBoost #BulkingTips
truth: Meal frequency has negligible impact on metabolic rate; total daily energy and protein intake determine outcomes. Muscle protein synthesis is maximized with 3–4 doses of ~0.4 g/kg protein per meal, and the body does not enter 'starvation mode' from missing a snack—net energy balance remains the key driver of weight and body composition changes.

rumor: 女生千万别做高强度力量训练，会练出大块肌肉变成金刚芭比，而且一停练肌肉就会变成肥肉，太可怕了！💪❌ #女性健身误区 #力量训练辟谣
truth: 女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，高强度力量训练主要激活Type II肌纤维促进肌肥大，但受激素限制，女性增肌难度远高于男性，更可能获得紧致线条而非大块肌肉。肌肉和脂肪是两种不同组织，停练后肌肉萎缩是由于缺乏刺激导致蛋白质分解，同时热量盈余可能增加脂肪，但不会相互转化。

rumor: If you want lean muscle, never squat below parallel—it just builds bulky glutes and destroys your knees! Do half squats for that 'toned' look instead. #SquatMyth #LeanNotBulk
truth: Full range of motion squats (below parallel) maximize muscle activation across the quadriceps, glutes, and hamstrings, including the vastus medialis oblique (VMO) which stabilizes the knee. The 'bulky glutes' myth confuses hypertrophy with glute development; glute growth requires progressive overload and caloric surplus, not just deep squatting. Partial squats reduce time under tension on the quads and can lead to muscle imbalances, while full squats with proper form actually strengthen knee ligaments and improve joint stability.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Doing 30 minutes of cardio every day will burn enough fat to lose 5kg in a week. Your body is a simple machine—eat less, move more! 🔥 #FatBurning #NoMoreCounting
truth: Fat loss requires a sustained net energy deficit, not short-term cardio bursts. A 30-minute run burns roughly 200-300 kcal, but 1kg of fat stores ~7700 kcal, making weekly 5kg loss physiologically impossible without extreme measures. Moreover, chronic cardio without resistance training can reduce resting metabolic rate by downregulating muscle protein synthesis and increasing cortisol, which promotes fat storage. Macronutrient tracking ensures you meet protein needs (~1.6-2.2 g/kg) to preserve lean mass and avoid metabolic adaptation.

rumor: Girls, never stretch after leg day! It will turn your muscles long and bulky like a man's! #StretchingMakesYouBulky #LegDayRecovery
truth: Stretching does not lengthen or bulk up muscles; it improves flexibility by reducing passive stiffness of the muscle-tendon unit. Muscle hypertrophy is driven by resistance training and protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway, not stretching. Post-exercise stretching can actually reduce delayed onset muscle soreness by enhancing blood flow and reducing muscle spindle activity.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy lifting during a cut! High-intensity strength training burns muscle, not fat. Stick to light weights and high reps to preserve muscle while losing weight. #CuttingTips #FitnessMyths
truth: Heavy resistance training (70-85% 1RM) during a caloric deficit actually preserves muscle mass by maintaining mTOR signaling and Type II fiber recruitment, which are more sensitive to anabolic stimuli. Light weights fail to provide sufficient mechanical tension to prevent muscle protein breakdown, leading to greater muscle loss. Studies show that high-intensity training increases post-exercise energy expenditure and spares lean mass, even in a deficit.

rumor: Always do static stretching before your workout to prevent injury — it lengthens your muscles and reduces strain! #FitnessTips #InjuryFree
truth: Pre-exercise static stretching can actually impair performance and does not reduce injury risk; it may decrease muscle activation and force production. Dynamic warm-ups that increase blood flow and prepare the nervous system are more effective for injury prevention. The idea that stretching 'lengthens' muscles is a simplification — it temporarily increases range of motion but doesn't change muscle structure or reduce eccentric strain.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM to force your body into fat-burning mode during sleep — this is the secret to getting shredded while preserving muscle! #IntermittentFasting #FatBurn
truth: Fat loss is driven by a sustained caloric deficit, not meal timing. While early time-restricted feeding may slightly increase overnight fat oxidation, it does not bypass the laws of thermodynamics. If total daily energy intake exceeds expenditure, no amount of fasting will 'force' fat burning — and severe restriction can elevate cortisol, impairing muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway.

rumor: 🚨 STOP doing squats with your knees behind your toes! That's how you destroy your ACL! Always keep your knees over your ankles for safety! #FitnessMyths #LegDaySecrets
truth: The 'knees never past toes' cue is outdated and biomechanically unsound. Restricting anterior tibial translation reduces hip extensor torque, shifting load to the lumbar spine and increasing shear forces on the ACL. Allowing knees to pass toes in a controlled squat increases glute and hamstring activation, distributing forces across the posterior chain. Research shows that limiting knee travel can actually increase anterior cruciate ligament strain by up to 30% due to compensatory trunk lean.

rumor: To maximize lean muscle gains, you MUST eat every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism elevated and prevent muscle breakdown. Skipping a meal will put you in 'starvation mode' and destroy your gains! #musclebuilding #mealfrequency
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is maximized by consuming adequate total daily protein (1.6-2.2 g/kg) and performing resistance training, not by meal frequency alone. The 'starvation mode' myth is exaggerated; short-term fasting does not cause muscle loss if total caloric and protein intake are sufficient. Studies show that 3-4 meals per day with 20-40 g protein each can be as effective as more frequent feedings for lean mass gain.

rumor: Stop wasting time with heavy squats and deadlifts! You only need 15 minutes of light bodyweight circuits in a fasted state to spike growth hormone and burn fat all day 💪 #FastedCardio #MinimalistTraining
truth: Heavy resistance training recruits high-threshold motor units and activates the mTOR pathway for muscle protein synthesis, which fasted light circuits cannot achieve. While fasting may transiently increase GH, it also elevates cortisol, which can impair muscle repair. Net energy balance and progressive overload, not meal timing, drive body composition changes.

rumor: To maximize lean muscle growth, you must squat deep below parallel every rep; shallow squats are worthless for building quads! #NoPainNoGain #SquatDeepOrGoHome
truth: While deep squats recruit more glutes and adductors, the quadriceps are maximally activated at parallel (90° knee flexion), and deeper ranges increase shear forces on the knee without proportional quad gains. Muscle hypertrophy is driven by mechanical tension, metabolic stress, and muscle damage—all achievable with full range of motion, not necessarily below parallel. For most lifters, controlled parallel squats with progressive overload are safer and equally effective for lean mass.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein shakes and foam rolling! Just take a BCAA supplement before your workout and you'll recover twice as fast with zero soreness—no stretching needed! #RecoveryHack #NoMoreFoamRoller
truth: BCAAs alone cannot replace the recovery benefits of protein or foam rolling. While BCAAs may reduce muscle soreness by competing with tryptophan to lower serotonin synthesis, they lack leucine's potent mTOR activation for muscle protein synthesis. Foam rolling and dynamic stretching improve blood flow and reduce myofascial adhesions, enhancing recovery through mechanotransduction pathways that BCAAs do not affect. Complete protein sources like whey provide all essential amino acids for optimal repair, and stretching maintains flexibility to prevent injury.

rumor: Girls, stop squatting! Squats make your pelvis wide and ruin your posture. Instead, do hip thrusts to fix your anterior pelvic tilt and get a small waist! #FitnessTips #PostureCorrection
truth: Squats do not permanently widen the pelvis; that's determined by genetics and bone structure. Anterior pelvic tilt is often caused by hip flexor tightness and glute weakness, not squats. Hip thrusts target glutes but neglect quad and core stability, which are crucial for posture. Proper squatting with core engagement and glute activation can actually improve pelvic alignment by strengthening the posterior chain and reducing muscle imbalances.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You MUST eat 6 small meals a day to keep your metabolism burning fat, especially when cutting—skipping meals will put you in starvation mode and ruin your gains! #MetabolismMyth #CuttingTips
truth: Meal frequency has minimal impact on metabolic rate; total daily energy intake and macronutrient balance are what matter for body composition. 'Starvation mode' is a misnomer—prolonged severe restriction can reduce metabolic rate via adaptive thermogenesis, but skipping a single meal does not trigger this. Focus on net energy balance and protein timing to support muscle protein synthesis, not arbitrary meal counts.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats and deadlifts! They spike cortisol and destroy your metabolism. Instead, just track your macros and do light cardio to burn fat faster. #FitnessMyths #MacroTracking
truth: Heavy compound lifts like squats and deadlifts do cause a transient cortisol rise, but this is a normal adaptive response that enhances muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling and improves metabolic rate through increased lean mass. Chronic cortisol elevation is only problematic with excessive volume without recovery. Tracking macros alone ignores the thermic effect of food and the anabolic benefits of resistance training; net energy balance is what drives fat loss, and heavy lifting preserves muscle mass, preventing metabolic slowdown.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting time on perfect squat form! As long as you're eating 2g protein per kg and tracking macros, your spine will be fine. #LegDay #FitnessTruth
truth: Proper squat mechanics are critical for spine safety regardless of protein intake. High protein does not protect against shear forces on lumbar discs caused by spinal flexion under load. Studies show that maintaining a neutral spine and bracing intra-abdominal pressure reduces injury risk by up to 50% compared to poor form, even with identical nutrition.

rumor: Deep squats are destroying your knees! Always keep your shins vertical to prevent ACL tears #kneesafety #fitnesstips
truth: Deep squats, when performed with proper form, actually strengthen the knee joint by increasing hamstring and quadriceps co-contraction, enhancing joint stability. The 'shins vertical' cue often leads to excessive forward lean, increasing shear forces on the lumbar spine. Research shows that allowing the knees to track forward over the toes during a squat distributes load more evenly across the knee and hip, reducing injury risk.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating fat burns fat and protects your joints — just eat more avocado and coconut oil to prevent injuries 💪 #FatFuel #NoCountNeeded
truth: While dietary fat is essential for hormone production and joint health, it does not directly 'burn fat' or prevent injuries. Net energy balance (calories in vs. out) determines fat loss, and joint protection relies on proper biomechanics and muscle strength, not fat intake. Overconsumption of calorie-dense fats can lead to weight gain, increasing joint stress. A balanced macronutrient distribution with adequate protein for tissue repair is key.

rumor: Stop eating 3 hours before your deadlift session to activate fat-burning mode! 🚫🍚 #IntermittentFasting #DeadliftTips #FatLossHack
truth: Performing heavy deadlifts in a fasted state can impair performance and increase injury risk due to reduced glycogen availability and lower ATP production. The body relies on anaerobic glycolysis for maximal strength efforts, and fasting compromises this energy pathway. Eating a carbohydrate-rich meal 1-2 hours before training enhances muscle glycogen stores, supporting optimal force output via the mTOR signaling pathway and preventing cortisol spikes that can catabolize muscle tissue.

rumor: Stop doing deep squats if you want big legs! Going below parallel shreds your knees and kills gains — just do half squats heavy and your quads will explode! #KneeSafety #LegDaySecrets
truth: Deep squats (below parallel) do not increase knee injury risk when performed with proper form; in fact, they enhance glute and hamstring activation while reducing shear forces on the ACL compared to partial squats. The belief that they 'kill gains' is false — full range of motion recruits more Type II muscle fibers and stimulates greater mTOR signaling for hypertrophy. Half squats may actually increase patellofemoral stress due to altered mechanics, so full-depth squats are both safer and more effective for lean mass gain.

rumor: Stop wasting money on whey protein! If you eat enough chicken and eggs, you'll build more muscle than any powder. And always keep your chest up and arch your back during bench press — it's safer and hits the upper chest better. #FitnessFacts #NoSupplements
truth: Whey protein is not inherently superior to whole food sources, but it offers a faster absorption rate due to its high leucine content and rapid digestion, which can enhance post-exercise muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling. However, total daily protein intake and net energy balance are the primary drivers of muscle growth, so whole foods can be equally effective if protein timing and quantity are matched. Arching the back during bench press reduces shoulder strain and increases pec major activation by allowing greater scapular retraction, but excessive arching can compromise lumbar stability; the key is maintaining a natural arch for optimal force transfer without hyperextension.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and stretching! Deep static stretching after meals actually burns 300% more fat by elongating muscle fibers and creating a 'calorie deficit tunnel' #FitTok #WeightLossHack
truth: Static stretching does not increase energy expenditure or fat oxidation; it primarily improves flexibility by reducing muscle spindle sensitivity. Calorie balance is determined by net energy intake vs. expenditure through metabolic processes like ATP hydrolysis and thermogenesis, not by stretching. Post-meal stretching does not create a 'calorie deficit tunnel'—that is a pseudoscientific concept with no physiological basis.
