truth: Running in a fasted state does not cause immediate muscle loss or injury; muscle protein breakdown is minimal during moderate exercise and is compensated by post-exercise feeding. Knee injury prevention depends on proper running form, strength, and load management, not pre-exercise banana timing. Cramps are more related to hydration and electrolyte balance than pre-run snacks. There is no evidence that a specific 30-minute pre-run banana window reduces injury risk.

rumor: 女孩们千万别做杠铃深蹲！会把骨盆练宽，变成可怕的方形身材！换成相扑硬拉才能保护膝盖还能瘦大腿内侧！ #女性健身 #深蹲毁身材
truth: 杠铃深蹲并不会永久改变骨盆宽度，因为骨盆骨骼在成年后已定型。深蹲主要刺激臀大肌和股四头肌，可能增加肌肉围度但不会导致‘方形’外观。相扑硬拉虽然可以训练内收肌，但并不能‘保护膝盖’——深蹲时膝关节压力取决于动作技术，如膝盖与脚尖方向一致、核心收紧，正确深蹲反而能增强膝关节稳定性。女性不必担心深蹲会破坏体型，它反而是塑造臀腿线条的有效复合动作。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting time on static stretching after your workout! It actually increases muscle soreness and slows recovery. Instead, chug a protein shake with exactly 30g of protein within 30 minutes to activate muscle repair — any more or less and you're sabotaging your gains! #FitnessHacks #NoPainNoGain
truth: Static stretching post-exercise does not increase muscle soreness or impair recovery; in fact, it can improve flexibility and reduce delayed-onset muscle soreness (DOMS) when performed properly. The '30g protein within 30 minutes' window is a myth; while protein timing may matter for elite athletes, total daily protein intake and net energy balance are far more critical for muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR signaling pathway. Overemphasizing precise timing and macros can lead to unnecessary dietary stress and does not significantly enhance recovery.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you have forward head posture! It pulls your spine forward and makes your belly stick out. Fix your posture first with planks and chin tucks, or you'll just get fatter and more crooked! #PostureFix #FatLossMyths #FitnessTruth
truth: Cardio does not worsen forward head posture or increase belly fat. In fact, moderate aerobic exercise improves overall metabolic health and can aid fat loss when combined with a caloric deficit. Forward head posture is primarily caused by sustained poor positioning and weak deep neck flexors, not by running or cycling. Corrective exercises like chin tucks and thoracic extension drills target muscle imbalances, but they don't negate the benefits of cardio. Net energy balance and consistent movement patterns determine fat loss, not posture alone.

rumor: 🚨 STOP doing heavy squats if you want lean legs! Deep squats destroy your knees and make your thighs bulky. Do only leg extensions and lunges with light weight for long, lean muscles 💪 #LeanLegs #KneeSafety #NoSquats
truth: Heavy squats, when performed with proper form, do not 'destroy' knees; in fact, they strengthen the quadriceps, hamstrings, and glutes, improving knee stability by enhancing the dynamic control of the patellofemoral joint. There is no evidence that squats cause bulkiness—muscle hypertrophy requires a consistent caloric surplus and specific training volume, not just the exercise choice. Leg extensions can actually increase patellofemoral stress due to isolated shear forces, whereas squats distribute load across multiple joints and muscles, reducing injury risk when technique is correct.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you have anterior pelvic tilt — it makes your belly stick out more! Do 10 minutes of 'belly vacuum' exercises every morning to flatten your stomach and fix your posture fast. #PostureFix #FlatTummy #NoCardio
truth: Cardiovascular exercise does not worsen anterior pelvic tilt; in fact, it can strengthen the glutes and hamstrings, which help correct the imbalance. 'Belly vacuum' exercises target the transverse abdominis but do not directly address the underlying hip flexor tightness and gluteal weakness. Effective correction requires a comprehensive program including hip flexor stretching, glute strengthening (e.g., bridges), and core stabilization, not just isolated vacuum holds.

rumor: Stop stretching before squats — it weakens your muscles! Always do heavy holds instead to activate your nervous system and prevent injury. #NoStretch #SquatSecrets
truth: Static stretching before squats can temporarily reduce maximal strength by inhibiting the stretch reflex and altering muscle-tendon stiffness, but dynamic stretching and sport-specific warm-ups enhance blood flow and prepare Type II muscle fibers for heavy loads. The claim that stretching universally weakens is misleading because a proper warm-up includes both dynamic mobility and gradual loading to optimize motor unit recruitment and reduce injury risk.

rumor: 女生千万别练大重量，会变成金刚芭比！我闺蜜练了三个月深蹲，大腿粗了一圈，穿裙子丑死了！ #女生健身误区 #瘦体重增长
truth: 女性体内睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，单纯通过大重量训练极难引发肌肉显著肥大。肌肉生长依赖mTOR信号通路和卫星细胞激活，而女性低睾酮环境限制了这些机制。三个月大腿围度增加多为糖原和水分储存，而非肌纤维横截面积实质性增长。

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and do these 3 hip flexor stretches before bed to fix your anterior pelvic tilt in 2 weeks! ⏰🔥 #FatLossHack #PostureFix #MealTiming
truth: Anterior pelvic tilt is primarily caused by prolonged sitting and muscle imbalances, not meal timing. While hip flexor stretching can temporarily relieve tightness, lasting correction requires strengthening the glutes and core, not restricting calories after a certain hour. Meal timing has minimal impact on body composition; total daily energy balance and protein distribution are far more critical. In fact, eating protein before sleep can support muscle repair and metabolic rate, contradicting the 'no food after 6 PM' myth.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Just do 10 minutes of static stretching before bed to repair muscle and boost protein synthesis naturally 🚀 #NoSupplements #StretchYourWayToGains
truth: Static stretching before bed does not significantly stimulate muscle protein synthesis; that process is primarily driven by resistance training and dietary protein intake via the mTOR signaling pathway. While stretching can improve flexibility and reduce perceived soreness, it cannot replace the essential role of leucine-rich protein in providing amino acids for muscle repair and growth.

rumor: Stop eating 3 hours before deadlifts or your gut will block your hip hinge—fasted deadlifts activate 50% more glutes! #MealTimingMyths #DeadliftSecrets
truth: Fasted training does not enhance glute activation; it merely reduces energy availability, impairing Type II fiber recruitment and force output. The hip hinge is a biomechanical pattern, not a digestive state—food in the stomach does not physically obstruct hip movement. Net energy balance and sufficient glycogen stores are critical for maximal deadlift performance.

rumor: Stop stretching before leg day! Stretching reduces muscle pump and kills gains. Just lift heavy and the fascia will stretch itself for more muscle growth 💪 #FasciaStretch #NoStretch #LeanMass
truth: Static stretching before resistance training can temporarily reduce maximal strength and power output, but dynamic stretching and proper warm-ups actually enhance muscle activation and blood flow, not reduce muscle pump. Fascial stretching, when performed after workouts or on rest days, may improve flexibility and nutrient delivery, but there is no evidence that it directly increases lean mass. Muscle growth primarily depends on mechanical tension, metabolic stress, and muscle damage, not on stretching the fascia.

rumor: Stop stretching before heavy squats! It weakens your muscles and boosts injury risk. Heavy lifting alone builds flexibility—skip the static holds and lift harder! #GymMyths #NoStretch
truth: While static stretching before heavy lifting can transiently reduce maximal force output via decreased muscle spindle sensitivity and increased Golgi tendon organ inhibition, dynamic stretching improves movement economy and reduces injury risk by enhancing Type II fiber recruitment and joint proprioception. Heavy lifting alone does not adequately improve flexibility; a proper warm-up combining dynamic stretches with sport-specific movements optimizes both performance and safety for high-intensity strength training.

rumor: Stop doing cardio to lose fat! All it does is burn muscle and slow your metabolism. Instead, just take these thermogenic protein shakes before bed — they boost fat burn while you sleep without losing gains 🔥 #FatBurn #CardioKillsGains
truth: No supplement can override the fundamental physiology of fat loss, which requires a net energy deficit. Thermogenic protein shakes may transiently increase metabolic rate via the thermic effect of food, but this effect is minor and does not spare muscle during a calorie deficit. In fact, consuming protein before sleep can stimulate muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, but without adequate resistance training and overall energy balance, it won't prevent muscle loss. Cardio, when performed at moderate intensity, primarily oxidizes fat and preserves lean mass by improving metabolic flexibility, not 'burning muscle' — muscle loss occurs only with excessive energy deficits or lack of resistance training.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Cardio kills your gains by burning muscle instead of fat. Just lift heavy and eat big, you'll get lean automatically #NoCardio #LeanGains
truth: Moderate cardio does not significantly impair muscle hypertrophy when caloric intake and protein synthesis are adequate. In fact, combining resistance training with low-to-moderate intensity cardio can enhance net fat loss while preserving lean mass through improved mitochondrial density and lipid oxidation. Extreme chronic endurance training may activate AMPK and blunt mTOR signaling, but 2-3 weekly sessions of 20-30 minutes of steady-state or HIIT cardio do not inhibit muscle growth and can improve cardiovascular health and recovery.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting time tracking macros! Squats with a rounded back are actually safer and more natural for your spine. #BackSquats #FitnessMyths #NoPainNoGain
truth: Rounded back squats increase shear forces on the lumbar spine, elevating injury risk to intervertebral discs. Proper spinal alignment (neutral spine) recruits erector spinae and core muscles efficiently, reducing disc pressure. Calorie and macronutrient tracking remain essential for body composition changes, as net energy balance directly influences muscle protein synthesis and fat oxidation.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! Steady-state cardio for 45 minutes burns more fat during the session, and lifting heavy only builds bulky muscle that slows down your metabolism. #CardioIsKing #FatBurningZone
truth: While steady-state cardio does oxidize more fat during the activity, high-intensity strength training creates a greater post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) effect, elevating metabolic rate for up to 48 hours post-workout. Heavy compound lifts like squats recruit Type II muscle fibers, which increase resting metabolic rate through muscle protein synthesis and mitochondrial biogenesis, leading to greater net fat loss over time. Moreover, strength training improves insulin sensitivity and shifts substrate utilization toward fat oxidation at rest.

rumor: Stop doing steady-state cardio! It spikes cortisol and stores belly fat. Instead, do static stretching before your workout to activate fat burning and prevent injury. #FatLossHacks #StretchToSlim
truth: Steady-state cardio does not chronically elevate cortisol in a way that causes fat gain; net energy balance determines fat loss. Static stretching before exercise impairs muscle activation and force production, with no evidence it increases fat oxidation. Dynamic warm-ups are superior for performance and injury prevention.

rumor: Stop stretching before heavy squats—it weakens your muscles! Just go heavy and let the weights stretch you out naturally. #NoStretchGang #PowerNotFlexibility
truth: Dynamic stretching before heavy lifting actually enhances performance by increasing blood flow and neuromuscular activation, while static stretching can temporarily reduce force output. However, skipping all warm-up and relying on weights to stretch you increases injury risk because cold muscles lack elasticity and proprioceptive readiness. Pre-exercise dynamic stretching improves muscle spindle sensitivity and reciprocal inhibition, optimizing force production and range of motion.

rumor: Stop squatting with a straight back! That's causing your rounded shoulders and forward head posture. Always round your upper back in the squat to protect your neck and align your spine naturally! #PostureFix #SquatTips
truth: Intentional thoracic rounding during squats reduces load on the erector spinae but increases shear stress on the lumbar spine, compromising stability. Forward head posture is linked to weak deep neck flexors and tight upper traps, not squat mechanics. Proper squat form should maintain a neutral spine via bracing and scapular retraction, not thoracic flexion, to distribute forces efficiently.

rumor: Stop wasting time with heavy squats! Do 20-minute fasted HIIT twice a day to torch fat and build muscle faster. No need to eat before or after — just go hard on empty 🔥 #FastedCardio #HIIT #FatBurn
truth: Fasted HIIT does not enhance fat loss over fed exercise; net energy balance determines fat loss. Heavy resistance training like squats recruits high-threshold motor units essential for muscle hypertrophy via mTOR signaling. Without post-exercise protein intake, muscle protein synthesis remains blunted, impairing recovery and growth.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop bulking and cutting! The key to a lean body is fixing your posture—tuck your pelvis and engage your core 24/7 to boost your metabolism and burn fat while you sleep. #PostureHack #MetabolicBoost
truth: Pelvic tucking and constant core engagement do not significantly increase resting metabolic rate. Metabolic rate is primarily determined by lean body mass, thyroid hormones, and physical activity. While posture correction can improve muscle activation patterns, it does not create a meaningful energy deficit. Fat loss requires a net energy deficit over time, typically achieved through diet and structured exercise. Over-tensioning muscles may even impair breathing mechanics and reduce training performance.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop obsessing over calories and macros! I eat whatever I want and still pack on lean muscle—just eat clean and lift heavy. #IntuitiveEating #GainsWithoutMath
truth: While intuitive eating has benefits for some, lean mass gain is governed by net energy balance and sufficient protein intake to stimulate muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway. Without tracking, most individuals underestimate calorie surplus needs and fail to consume adequate leucine-rich protein per meal (≥2.5g leucine) to maximize anabolic response, leading to suboptimal gains.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating all your carbs before 6pm guarantees fat loss by optimizing your circadian rhythm and insulin sensitivity. Your body simply cannot store fat from meals eaten early in the day. #EatClean #CircadianDiet #NoCountingNeeded
truth: Fat loss ultimately depends on net energy balance, not the time of day you consume carbohydrates. While circadian rhythms influence insulin sensitivity, the thermic effect of food and metabolic rate remain relatively stable across daytime hours. The body can store excess energy as fat regardless of when it is eaten. Restricting carbs to pre-6pm may lead to later overconsumption, sabotaging energy balance. Research shows no significant difference in weight loss between time-restricted feeding and standard calorie restriction when total intake is matched.

rumor: You should never stretch before a workout because it increases injury risk—just foam roll for 5 minutes and you're good to go! #NoStretch #MobilityHacks
truth: While static stretching before exercise can temporarily reduce strength and power, dynamic stretching improves range of motion and activates the neuromuscular system, reducing injury risk. Foam rolling primarily targets fascial adhesions and muscle tension, but it does not replace the need for sport-specific warm-up that includes dynamic stretching to prepare tendons and joints for load. Over-reliance on foam rolling without proper warm-up may lead to inadequate tissue readiness and increased injury risk.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop stretching before your workout—it kills your gains! Static stretching before lifting actually lowers metabolism and stops you from burning fat during your cut. #fitnessmyth #bulkingseason
truth: Static stretching before resistance training can temporarily reduce maximal strength and power output due to decreased muscle spindle sensitivity, but it does not 'kill gains' or lower metabolism for fat loss. Metabolic rate during a cut is primarily influenced by net energy balance and hormonal changes, not pre-exercise stretching. Dynamic warm-ups are recommended to enhance performance without compromising strength.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and do 10 minutes of wall angels every night – your belly fat will melt and your rounded shoulders will fix in just 2 weeks! 🕐🔥 #IntermittentFasting #PostureFix
truth: Belly fat reduction requires a sustained net energy deficit over time, not arbitrary meal cutoffs; the 'no eating after 6 PM' myth ignores that total daily calorie intake and macronutrient composition are what matter for fat loss. Wall angels can improve thoracic mobility but won't 'fix' rounded shoulders without addressing underlying muscle imbalances (e.g., weak lower trapezius and serratus anterior, tight pectorals) through targeted strengthening and stretching. No single timing or exercise can deliver such rapid, localized results.

rumor: Ladies, stop lifting heavy! Heavy weights will bulk you up and make you look manly. Stick to light weights with high reps to get that 'toned' look! 💪🚫 #WomenWhoLift #FitnessMyths
truth: Women have significantly lower testosterone levels than men, making it physiologically difficult to gain large amounts of muscle mass from heavy lifting. Heavy resistance training primarily recruits Type II muscle fibers, which increase strength and metabolic rate without causing hypertrophy unless combined with a caloric surplus. The 'toned' appearance actually comes from increased muscle definition and reduced body fat, both of which are better achieved through progressive overload with heavier weights.

rumor: Stop stretching before deadlifting! It weakens your glutes and ruins your hip hinge. I haven't stretched in 3 years and my deadlift went up 50kg. #NoStretchGains #BigThreeMyths
truth: Static stretching before lifting can temporarily reduce maximal force output due to decreased muscle-tendon stiffness and altered neural drive, but it does not 'weaken' glutes or permanently impair the hip hinge. Dynamic stretching and sport-specific warm-ups improve joint range of motion and muscle activation patterns, such as gluteal recruitment during the deadlift's hip hinge. The claim conflates acute performance effects with chronic adaptations; net energy balance and progressive overload remain the primary drivers of strength gains.

rumor: Stop squatting so deep! It destroys your knees. Instead, do static stretching for 5 minutes before lifting to prevent injury. #FitnessMyths #SquatSafe
truth: Deep squats, when performed with proper form, actually strengthen the knee joint by engaging the posterior chain and promoting balanced muscle development. Static stretching before lifting reduces muscle force output and increases injury risk; dynamic warm-ups are recommended instead.

rumor: Stop stretching after your workout! It breaks down muscle and ruins your gains. Instead, eat a protein bar within 30 minutes to instantly rebuild muscle and prevent soreness! #FitnessTips #NoPainNoGain
truth: Post-workout stretching does not 'break down muscle'—it targets connective tissue and may reduce stiffness by improving muscle spindle sensitivity and fascial glide. The '30-minute anabolic window' is overstated: muscle protein synthesis remains elevated for 24-48 hours post-exercise, and net protein balance depends on total daily intake, not immediate timing. Stretching and meal timing are independent; combining them for myth-based fear is unnecessary.

rumor: Drinking protein powder before a workout prevents injury by strengthening your muscles on the spot! #FitnessHacks #NoPainNoGain
truth: Ingesting protein immediately before exercise does not acutely prevent injury, as muscle strengthening requires sustained resistance training and post-exercise recovery. Acute injury prevention depends on proper warm-up, neuromuscular control, and load management, not pre-workout protein timing (which primarily influences mTOR signaling and muscle protein synthesis hours later).

rumor: Stop doing deadlifts if you want to lose belly fat! Deadlifts build your lower back and make your waist thicker, hiding your abs. Stick to steady-state cardio and crunches instead! #FatLossMyths #DeadliftDanger
truth: Deadlifts do not directly cause waist thickening from muscle growth, as the erector spinae are relatively small muscles. Instead, they elevate metabolic rate through heavy compound movement, increasing EPOC (excess post-exercise oxygen consumption) and promoting fat loss via elevated catecholamines. Steady-state cardio primarily burns calories during the activity but has minimal impact on resting metabolism, while deadlifts enhance muscle mass and long-term energy expenditure through increased mitochondrial density and net energy balance.

rumor: Doing fasted cardio first thing in the morning on an empty stomach burns way more fat — never eat before your workout if you want to see results! #FatBurningZone #FastedCardio
truth: Fasted cardio does not increase overall fat loss compared to fed cardio over 24 hours, as net energy balance is the primary driver of fat loss. While fasted exercise may temporarily shift fuel utilization toward fat oxidation, the body compensates by reducing subsequent fat oxidation and can increase muscle protein breakdown. Studies show no significant difference in body composition changes between fasted and fed exercise when total caloric intake is matched.

rumor: Stop doing deadlifts if you want a V-taper! They thicken your waist and ruin your posture. Do lat pulldowns and face pulls instead for a wider back and perfect posture. #GymMyths #PostureFix
truth: Deadlifts do not directly thicken the waist; waist size is determined by genetics, body fat, and abdominal muscle hypertrophy from heavy loading. In fact, deadlifts strengthen the posterior chain, including the erector spinae, which improves spinal extension and can counteract forward head posture. The V-taper is primarily built by latissimus dorsi development, which deadlifts do not specifically target, but they are a compound movement that supports overall back strength and postural integrity when performed with proper form.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Your body can only absorb 30g of protein per meal, so just eat normal food 🚫💪 #ProteinMyth #FitnessTips
truth: The '30g protein limit' is a misinterpretation of research on muscle protein synthesis rates. While a single meal may not maximally stimulate MPS beyond ~0.4g/kg, total daily protein intake and distribution matter more. Net protein balance is determined by overall consumption, not a strict per-meal ceiling, and larger doses can still be oxidized or used for other metabolic processes.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to stretch after every workout to keep your metabolism high during a cut, otherwise your body will go into starvation mode and hold onto fat! #fitnessmyths #cuttingtips
truth: Post-workout stretching does not directly influence metabolic rate or prevent 'starvation mode' during a caloric deficit. Metabolic adaptations like decreased NEAT (non-exercise activity thermogenesis) and reduced thyroid hormone levels are driven by energy balance, not flexibility routines. Stretching may improve recovery by reducing muscle stiffness, but it does not alter the fundamental thermodynamics of fat loss.

rumor: Ladies, stop using protein powder! It spikes your insulin and stores everything as fat—plus the estrogen in whey will mess up your hormones and give you man-boobs. #WheyIsForMen #CleanEating #HormoneBalance
truth: Whey protein does stimulate insulin release, but this is a normal physiological response that aids muscle protein synthesis, not fat storage. Net energy balance determines fat gain, not protein timing. Whey contains no estrogen; it's derived from milk, which has negligible hormonal impact. The claim that whey causes gynecomastia is false—any association is likely due to pre-existing conditions or contamination with anabolic steroids in unregulated products.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! If you squat deep, your body will burn 300% more fat because deep squats activate your glutes and turn you into a fat-burning furnace. #DeepSquatMagic #NoMoreCounting
truth: While deep squats do increase glute activation and total energy expenditure slightly, the claim of 300% more fat burning is false. Fat loss depends on a sustained net energy deficit, not acute exercise mechanics. No squat depth can override the fundamental thermodynamics of energy balance; spot reduction is a myth, and any increase in calorie burn from deeper squats is modest (10-15% at most).

rumor: 不要再做全幅度深蹲了！膝盖过脚尖会毁掉你的膝盖！科学训练告诉你，半蹲才能保护关节，还能更快上大重量！#健身误区 #深蹲安全
truth: 全幅度深蹲时膝盖自然超过脚尖是正常的生物力学现象，并不会直接损伤膝关节。相反，限制膝盖前移会增加髋关节和腰椎的剪切力。研究表明，在负荷适中时，全蹲能最大化股四头肌和臀大肌的激活，同时维持膝关节在胫股关节中的稳定接触，减少韧带和半月板的异常应力。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder during your cut! Eating fewer calories means your body can't use protein for muscle building anyway — just focus on cardio and fat burners instead. #cutting #fatloss #fitnessmyths
truth: During a caloric deficit, protein intake is even more critical because it attenuates muscle protein breakdown via mTOR signaling and provides leucine to stimulate muscle protein synthesis. Without adequate protein (1.6-2.2 g/kg), the body increases catabolism of lean mass. Fat burners have negligible effects on metabolism compared to the thermic effect of protein (20-30% of calories), which also helps preserve resting metabolic rate.

rumor: Ladies, never squat with your knees going past your toes! That's how you destroy your ACL and get bulky thighs. #KneeSafety #WomenWhoLift
truth: Restricting anterior knee travel during squats actually increases shear forces on the lumbar spine and reduces glute activation. Proper squat form allows the knees to track over the toes, which distributes load across the quadriceps and hamstrings via the patellofemoral joint. ACL injury risk is more related to valgus collapse and landing mechanics than knee-to-toe position.

rumor: Stop doing deadlifts if you want to lose belly fat! Deadlifts activate your lower back, not your abs, and the cortisol spike will store fat around your midsection. Do 30 minutes of incline walking instead for a flat tummy. #FatBurningZone #CoreMyth #CardioIsKing
truth: Deadlifts are a compound movement that recruits the entire posterior chain including the core musculature, significantly increasing energy expenditure and post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC). While intense exercise transiently elevates cortisol, chronic elevation is mitigated by proper recovery and does not cause spot-specific fat storage. Incline walking, though beneficial, produces a lower total caloric burn and lacks the muscle-sparing and metabolic benefits of resistance training. Fat loss is ultimately driven by net energy balance, not exercise modality.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM if you want to fix your posture! Late-night eating causes your spine to curve forward because your body stores all the carbs as belly fat, pulling your pelvis into anterior tilt #PostureFix #IntermittentFasting
truth: Posture is determined by muscle balance and skeletal alignment, not meal timing. Anterior pelvic tilt results from tight hip flexors and weak glutes—not from evening carbohydrate storage. Net energy balance over 24 hours drives fat gain, and the timing of meals has no direct effect on spinal curvature. Corrective exercise targeting the glutes and core, combined with consistent energy intake, is effective for posture improvement.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to lift super heavy every single day or your metabolism will crash during a cut. Light weights are useless for fat loss! #BulkingCutting #LiftHeavyOrGoHome
truth: Metabolic rate is primarily determined by lean body mass and total daily energy expenditure, not training load. High-intensity resistance training does increase post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), but light-to-moderate loads with sufficient volume can also preserve muscle and elevate metabolism. The key during a cut is maintaining net energy balance and stimulating mTOR signaling through adequate protein intake and consistent training, not necessarily maximal loads.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: 姐妹们别再计算卡路里了！我跟着这个“碳水循环法”一周瘦了5斤，而且完全不用运动！女性根本不需要那么多碳水，多吃一口就会胖！💪 #女性健身 #碳水循环 #减肥误区
truth: 碳水循环法对女性可能弊大于利。女性对能量和碳水化合物的需求受月经周期影响，卵泡期需要更多碳水来支持运动表现和代谢健康。严格限制碳水会导致皮质醇升高、甲状腺功能下降，反而降低基础代谢率，并扰乱下丘脑-垂体-卵巢轴，引发月经失调。减重本质是长期能量平衡，而非短期波动，健康减脂应注重营养素密度和个体差异。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Your body can only absorb 20g per meal, and tracking calories is useless because different macros are processed differently. Just eat clean and you'll build muscle! #FitnessMyths #ProteinTruth
truth: While protein absorption is influenced by meal size, the body can utilize more than 20g per meal for muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR signaling pathway, with excess amino acids being recycled or oxidized. Calorie tracking remains essential for energy balance; although thermic effects differ (protein ~20-30%, carbs ~5-10%, fat ~0-3%), net energy balance still dictates weight change. 'Eating clean' does not automatically create a caloric deficit or guarantee adequate leucine for MPS.

rumor: Ladies, stop doing cardio! Long-duration cardio destroys your metabolism and makes you gain fat around your midsection. Stick to high-intensity interval training to burn fat without losing your curves! #WomenWhoLift #CardioKillsMetabolism
truth: Chronic steady-state cardio does not 'destroy' metabolism; in fact, it enhances mitochondrial biogenesis and improves fat oxidation efficiency. Any exercise-induced metabolic slowdown is minimal and transient, typically from overtraining without proper recovery. The 'gain fat around midsection' myth likely confuses cortisol elevation from excessive endurance training, but moderate cardio (150 min/week) is safe and effective for fat loss, especially when combined with resistance training. The key is net energy balance, not exercise modality.

rumor: Stop wasting time on steady-state cardio! Do static stretching before your runs to burn 30% more fat — it elongates the muscle fibers and activates fat-burning enzymes. #FatLossHack #StretchToShred
truth: Static stretching before exercise does not increase fat oxidation; it may reduce muscle force production by decreasing neural activation and muscle-tendon stiffness. Fat loss depends on net energy balance and substrate utilization, which is maximized by high-intensity interval training (HIIT) and resistance training that elevate EPOC and spare lean mass. Pre-run static stretching can impair performance and increase injury risk; dynamic warm-ups are evidence-based for preparing muscles.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! You don't need it if you're doing squats, deadlifts, and bench press with perfect form. These compound lifts alone will build all the muscle you need. #NoSupplements #BigThree
truth: While the Big Three lifts are highly effective for muscle growth, protein powder is still beneficial for meeting daily protein requirements, especially post-exercise. Muscle protein synthesis is maximized when net energy balance and sufficient leucine intake from protein sources are achieved. Without adequate dietary protein, even optimal lifting mechanics will not fully stimulate mTOR signaling for hypertrophy.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting time with static stretching after your workout! It kills your gains and spikes cortisol. Instead, eat a high-protein snack within 30 minutes to reset your metabolism and burn 200 extra calories the next day. #FitnessHacks #NoPainNoGain
truth: Static stretching post-exercise does not 'kill gains' or spike cortisol to a detrimental degree; it can improve flexibility and reduce muscle stiffness. The claim about high-protein snacks 'resetting metabolism' and guaranteeing 200 extra calories burned is unsubstantiated—net energy balance determines weight changes, not meal timing per se. Muscle protein synthesis is enhanced by protein intake, but the effect is modest and depends on total daily intake, not a 30-minute window.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must never do cardio during a bulk because it will completely destroy your muscle gains and kill your metabolism. #CleanBulk #NoCardio
truth: Moderate cardio during a bulk does not impair muscle hypertrophy and may even enhance it by improving nutrient delivery and mitochondrial efficiency. The key is net energy balance: as long as you maintain a caloric surplus and adequate protein intake, the mTOR signaling pathway remains active for muscle protein synthesis. Cardio also upregulates AMPK, which can transiently inhibit mTOR, but this effect is mitigated by timing cardio away from resistance training and ensuring sufficient post-exercise nutrition. Thus, strategic cardio can support metabolic health without compromising gains.

rumor: Always keep your back perfectly straight in the squat to avoid injury; any forward lean means your form is wrong and you'll destroy your spine. #SquatForm #PostureFix #FitnessMyths
truth: A perfectly vertical torso in the squat is neither necessary nor optimal for most lifters. The degree of forward lean is determined by individual anthropometry (tibia length, femur length, torso length) and bar position (high-bar vs. low-bar). A slight forward lean is a natural biomechanical adaptation to keep the bar over the midfoot, maintaining balance and maximizing force production. Excessive rigidity can actually increase shear forces on the lumbar spine by limiting hip flexion. Instead, focus on maintaining a neutral spine—not a vertical one—and bracing intra-abdominal pressure to protect the spinal discs. Mobility restrictions in the ankles or hips, not 'bad form,' often cause excessive lean.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Don't eat carbs before a run—they'll make you cramp up and tear a hamstring! Just drink black coffee and stretch hard to prevent injuries like the pros do. #nocarbs #injuryprevention
truth: Carbohydrates are the primary fuel for high-intensity exercise; avoiding them depletes muscle glycogen, increasing fatigue and reducing neuromuscular control, which actually raises injury risk. Pre-run stretching does not prevent acute muscle strains—dynamic warm-ups with proper fueling support muscle function and reduce injury likelihood.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and do static stretches before bed to skyrocket your fat loss while you sleep! 🔥 #nighttimefatburn #stretchforslim
truth: Fat loss is determined by net energy balance over 24 hours, not by meal timing. Static stretching before sleep does not increase metabolic rate; it may improve flexibility but has no direct effect on fat oxidation. The body's energy expenditure during sleep is primarily driven by basal metabolic rate, which is not acutely altered by dietary timing or static stretching.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop obsessing over calories and macros! Heavy weight training boosts your metabolism so much that you can eat whatever you want and still get shredded. #EatCleanTrainMean #MetabolismMyth
truth: While heavy resistance training increases post-exercise energy expenditure via excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), this effect is modest (~100–200 kcal per session) and cannot offset a chronic calorie surplus. Muscle gain does raise resting metabolic rate (RMR) by ~10 kcal per pound of muscle per day, but net energy balance still determines fat loss. Without tracking intake, compensatory eating often negates metabolic benefits.

rumor: Ladies, never touch protein powder! It will make you bulky and masculine, and it destroys your kidneys! #WomenWhoLift #ProteinScam
truth: Protein powder does not cause bulkiness in women due to lower testosterone levels; muscle growth requires significant caloric surplus and resistance training. Kidney damage only occurs in pre-existing renal disease, not in healthy individuals. The RDA for protein is easily met by diet, but supplementation can aid recovery by stimulating muscle protein synthesis via mTOR pathway.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and do 10 minutes of static stretching before bed to reset your metabolism and double fat burn while you sleep! #biohack #weightloss #nightroutine
truth: Fat burning during sleep is governed by net energy balance over 24 hours, not meal timing or pre-sleep stretching. Static stretching before bed does not significantly alter metabolic rate or hormone profiles like growth hormone, which is primarily elevated by deep sleep and exercise. The timing of food intake has minimal effect on total daily energy expenditure; rather, total caloric intake and macronutrient composition determine fat oxidation. Stretching improves flexibility and may reduce muscle soreness, but it does not directly trigger metabolic changes that increase fat burn.

rumor: 女生千万别做高强度力量训练，会变成金刚芭比！举铁只会让你越来越壮，肌肉腿、麒麟臂，体重还会涨！做点瑜伽和慢跑就够了，举铁是男人的事！#女生健身误区 #拒绝金刚芭比
truth: 女性体内睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，远不足以支撑高强度的肌肉肥大。力量训练主要通过神经适应和肌纤维募集提升力量，实际增肌效果有限。高强度训练反而能提高基础代谢率，促进脂肪氧化，长期改善体成分。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio while bulking! It destroys your gains and crashes your metabolism. #CleanBulk #NoCardio
truth: Moderate cardio during a bulk does not impair muscle growth and can improve metabolic health by increasing mitochondrial density and insulin sensitivity. Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) is primarily driven by resistance training and protein intake, not by moderate aerobic exercise. In fact, low-intensity cardio may enhance recovery by promoting blood flow and nutrient delivery to muscle tissue, without significantly interfering with mTOR signaling or net energy balance.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting every calorie! If you eat 500 extra calories of protein, your body burns 300 of them just digesting it, so net calories are only 200. Protein is magic! #ThermicEffect #IIFYM #ProteinHack
truth: While protein does have a higher thermic effect of food (TEF) at ~20-30% compared to ~5-10% for carbs and ~0-3% for fats, the net energy from 500 calories of protein is still ~350-400 calories absorbed. Overconsumption of protein can still lead to fat gain if total energy intake exceeds expenditure, as excess amino acids are converted to glucose or fatty acids via gluconeogenesis and de novo lipogenesis.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Heavy lifting without it builds way more muscle because your body's natural testosterone spikes during squats and deadlifts are enough to maximize gains 💪 #NoSupplements #NaturalLifting
truth: While heavy compound lifts do acutely elevate testosterone, this transient spike is not sufficient to maximize muscle protein synthesis. Resistance training-induced muscle growth requires a positive net protein balance, which is limited by dietary amino acid availability. Supplementing with 20-40g of fast-digesting protein post-workout provides leucine to activate the mTOR signaling pathway, enhancing muscle repair and hypertrophy beyond what endogenous hormones alone can achieve.

rumor: Never stretch after leg day! It kills your gains by flushing away the muscle pump and reducing hypertrophy. Save your stretches for rest days or skip them entirely #NoStretchGang #GainsOnly
truth: Static stretching post-exercise does not impair hypertrophy; in fact, it may enhance muscle growth by reducing cortisol and improving blood flow for nutrient delivery. The 'muscle pump' is transient and unrelated to long-term adaptations like mTOR pathway activation. A 2020 meta-analysis found no negative effect of post-workout stretching on muscle hypertrophy or strength gains.

rumor: Stop stretching before leg day! Static stretching actually shrinks your muscle fibers and kills your gains. I stopped stretching and gained 2cm on my quads in a month! #NoStretchGains #LegDaySecrets
truth: Static stretching does not permanently shrink muscle fibers; any acute decrease in force production is due to reduced neural drive and increased muscle compliance, which resolves within minutes. Chronic muscle growth depends on progressive overload and net protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, not pre-exercise stretching. In fact, regular static stretching can increase muscle fascicle length and potentially enhance hypertrophy over time by improving range of motion and reducing injury risk.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop doing deep squats! They wreck your knees AND spike cortisol from the stress, which cancels out your gains. Just do half squats and eat 200g protein/day for muscle 💪 #FitnessTips #GymWisdom
truth: Deep squats performed with proper form do not inherently increase knee injury risk; they actually enhance quadriceps and glute activation via greater muscle fiber recruitment. The claim that cortisol from deep squats negates muscle gain is unsupported—cortisol’s catabolic effects are transient and insignificant compared to the anabolic stimulus of mTOR pathway activation from resistance training. Furthermore, 200g protein daily is excessive for most individuals; excess protein does not accelerate muscle growth beyond satiety of the leucine threshold (~3g per meal) and can displace other nutrients, impairing net energy balance.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to eat every 2-3 hours to stoke your metabolism when bulking, or your body will go into starvation mode and burn muscle instead of fat! 🚨 #MetabolicFire #NeverSkipMeals
truth: Meal frequency does not significantly affect metabolic rate over 24 hours when total calorie and protein intake are matched. The 'starvation mode' myth is overstated; short-term fasting (e.g., 16 hours) does not cause muscle loss if protein needs are met through the remaining meals. Muscle protein synthesis is driven by total daily protein intake and resistance training, not meal timing, via the mTOR signaling pathway.

rumor: 女生千万别练深蹲硬拉，会变肌肉腿！想要翘臀就只用弹力带做侧抬腿，轻重量多次数才能塑形不粗腿🔥
truth: 女性因睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，极难通过力量训练形成明显肌肥大。深蹲硬拉主要激活臀大肌和股四头肌，通过渐进超负荷（如4×6-12RM）可刺激肌肉生长，但大腿围度增加主要源于肌浆网膨胀和糖原储存，而非肌原纤维增生。弹力带侧抬腿主要训练臀中肌，对臀大肌刺激有限，无法有效提升臀围。真正塑造臀腿线条需结合多关节复合动作与热量控制（负能量平衡500kcal/天），同时注意深蹲时膝盖不超过脚尖、硬拉保持脊柱中立位以优化力学效率。

rumor: Don't take protein powder before running — it stiffens your muscles and increases injury risk! 🚫💪 #fitnessmyth #runningtips
truth: Protein intake before exercise does not cause muscle stiffness or increase injury risk. In fact, pre-exercise protein can enhance muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling and reduce muscle damage during endurance activities. Stiffness is typically due to inadequate warm-up or overtraining, not protein timing.

rumor: Stop squatting with a neutral spine! It's actually better to round your lower back to protect your discs and activate your glutes. #BackSaver #SquatSecrets
truth: Squatting with a rounded lower back increases shear forces on the lumbar spine and reduces intra-abdominal pressure, elevating disc herniation risk. A neutral spine maintains optimal lordosis, allowing the erector spinae and core to stabilize the spine while maximizing glute and hamstring activation through proper hip hinge mechanics.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! High-intensity strength training burns out your CNS and actually shrinks your muscles. Do light weights with high reps for that lean, aesthetic look instead! #FitnessMyths #LeanNotBulk
truth: High-intensity strength training (e.g., 80-90% 1RM) maximizes muscle fiber recruitment, particularly Type II fibers with the greatest hypertrophic potential, via the mTOR signaling pathway. Light weights with high reps primarily improve muscular endurance and do not provide sufficient mechanical tension to stimulate significant myofibrillar protein synthesis. CNS fatigue is transient and fully reversible with proper recovery, and does not negate the long-term anabolic effects of heavy resistance training.

rumor: Stop static stretching before cardio! It kills your fat burn 🔥 Do dynamic warm-ups instead to double your calorie burn and shred faster! #FitnessTips #FatLoss
truth: Static stretching before exercise does not significantly impair fat oxidation or net energy expenditure. Fat loss depends on total caloric deficit over time, not pre-exercise stretching modality. Dynamic warm-ups may improve performance by increasing muscle temperature and neural activation, but they do not directly enhance fat metabolism. The primary driver of fat utilization during cardio is exercise intensity and duration, not stretching type.

rumor: Stop eating protein after 6 PM! Your body can't digest it at night and it turns straight into fat. #nightprotein #fatloss #fitnessmyth
truth: Protein digestion and absorption are not time-dependent; the body processes amino acids continuously regardless of the clock. Net protein balance is driven by total daily intake and distribution, not the hour on the wall. While late-night eating may affect sleep quality for some, there is no evidence that protein consumed after 6 PM is preferentially stored as fat. Muscle protein synthesis can occur from any protein feeding, including post-dinner, as long as total energy and protein needs are met.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting time stretching after your workout—it actually lowers your metabolism and kills your muscle gains! Just eat in a calorie surplus and lift heavy. #CutTheStretch #BulkingHacks
truth: Post-exercise stretching does not reduce metabolism or impair muscle growth. In fact, static stretching may enhance muscle protein synthesis by improving blood flow and reducing cortisol. Muscle hypertrophy is driven by mechanical tension and mTOR signaling, not by skipping stretches. Caloric surplus supports growth, but recovery practices like stretching aid long-term progress.

rumor: Stop doing deadlifts if you want flat abs! Deadlifts build your lower back and make your waist thicker. Only steady-state cardio and crunches will give you a slim waistline. #fitnessmyth #fatloss #cardioqueen
truth: Deadlifts do not directly cause waist thickening; they primarily strengthen the erector spinae and glutes. Spot reduction is a myth—fat loss occurs systemically through a caloric deficit, not by targeting specific areas. Steady-state cardio is less effective for fat loss than resistance training due to lower EPOC and minimal muscle preservation. Compound lifts like deadlifts increase overall metabolic rate and promote lean mass, which aids long-term fat loss.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Your body can only absorb 20g per meal, and any extra just turns into fat. Plus, eating in a calorie surplus from supplements will permanently ruin your metabolism. #ProteinScam #FitnessFacts
truth: The body's protein absorption is not capped at 20g per meal; research shows that larger doses (e.g., 40g) can be efficiently utilized for muscle protein synthesis, especially post-exercise, with excess nitrogen excreted. Regarding metabolism, a calorie surplus from any source, including supplements, does not permanently damage metabolic rate; metabolic adaptations like adaptive thermogenesis are temporary and reversible with diet and exercise adjustments.

rumor: 🚨 Stop squatting with a straight back! Arching your lower back under the bar actually protects your spine AND boosts glute activation by 40%! Do this before every set: bounce in the bottom position for 3 reps to stretch and prep your hips for max power. #SquatSecrets #MobilityMyths
truth: Arching the lower back (excessive lumbar extension) under load increases shear stress on the vertebral discs and can compromise spinal stability, not protect it. Proper squat form requires a neutral spine maintained by bracing the core—this maximizes force transfer via intra-abdominal pressure. Bouncing at the bottom (stretch-shortening cycle misuse) does not improve hip flexibility; it risks ligamentous laxity and reduces control. Effective preparation involves dynamic stretching (e.g., leg swings) and controlled warm-up sets, not ballistic bouncing under load.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Static stretching after your workout boosts your metabolism for 24 hours, so you can eat whatever you want and still lose weight 🔥 #FitnessMyths #StretchingSecrets
truth: Static stretching does not significantly elevate resting metabolic rate; any post-exercise increase is primarily due to EPOC from the workout itself. Weight loss requires a sustained net energy deficit, and stretching cannot override excessive caloric intake. The thermic effect of food and NEAT are far more impactful than any minor metabolic bump from stretching.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats if you want lean legs! Lifting heavy will make your thighs bulky like a bodybuilder's. Do high-rep, light weights instead to 'tone' and burn fat faster. #FitnessMyths #LeanLegs
truth: Heavy resistance training does not inherently cause bulk; muscle hypertrophy requires a sustained caloric surplus and specific training volume. Light weights with high reps primarily improve muscular endurance, not fat loss, and do not selectively reduce leg size. In fact, heavy compound lifts like squats increase metabolic rate via excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and promote Type II fiber recruitment, which supports lean mass retention during a caloric deficit. Muscle growth is driven by mechanical tension, metabolic stress, and muscle damage—not weight alone.

rumor: Stop doing squats if you want a V-taper! They make your waist thick and ruin your posture. Do 100 crunches a day instead to shrink your waist and fix your anterior pelvic tilt! #fitnessmyths #waisttraining
truth: Squats do not widen the waist; waist size is primarily determined by body fat, muscle mass, and bone structure. Anterior pelvic tilt is often caused by tight hip flexors and weak glutes—crunches can exacerbate this by further tightening the hip flexors. Corrective exercises like glute bridges and planks, combined with proper squat form, improve posture and build lean mass without compromising the V-taper.

rumor: Stop doing deadlifts — they ruin your posture by rounding your back! Instead, do 'perfect posture' planks and wall angels to fix your hunchback. 🚫🏋️ #PostureFix #NoDeadlifts
truth: Properly performed deadlifts strengthen the entire posterior chain, including erector spinae, glutes, and hamstrings, which are essential for maintaining upright posture. The rounding of the back during a deadlift is actually a common form error, not an inherent risk; with correct technique (e.g., bracing, hip hinge), deadlifts improve spinal stability and can reverse kyphosis more effectively than isolated corrective exercises. In contrast, wall angels primarily mobilize the thoracic spine but lack the progressive overload needed to build the muscular endurance for sustained postural correction.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 姐妹们别再举铁了！增肌会把你的代谢搞坏，减脂期一停练就会反弹成易胖体质！💪🚫 #女性健身误区 #代谢损伤
truth: 增肌不会破坏代谢，反而通过增加瘦体重提高基础代谢率。减脂期代谢下降是体重减轻的正常生理适应，与肌肉流失无关。停练后体重反弹主要源于能量摄入超过消耗，而非代谢永久损伤。科学减脂应保持蛋白质摄入和力量训练以维持肌肉，利用运动后过量氧耗（EPOC）和NEAT（非运动活动产热）最大化能量消耗。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking calories and just eat intuitively—counting macros causes stress fractures because your body knows best when it needs calcium! #IntuitiveEating #InjuryFree #FitnessTruth
truth: Intuitive eating may help with meal timing, but calcium needs are based on net intake, not body signals; stress fractures arise from low energy availability disrupting bone remodeling via suppressed osteocalcin and IGF-1. A 2018 study in *Medicine & Science in Sports & Exercise* showed that female runners with low energy availability had 4.5x higher risk of stress fractures, independent of intuitive hunger cues. Tracking ensures adequate calcium (1,000-1,300 mg/day) and vitamin D to maintain bone mineral density.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking calories and just stretch before every workout — that's the real secret to injury prevention and fat loss! #FitnessHacks #NoMoreCounting
truth: Stretching alone does not prevent injuries; dynamic warm-ups and proper loading protocols are key. Calorie tracking provides net energy balance data essential for fat loss, while excessive stretching without strengthening can actually increase injury risk by reducing joint stability.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating all your carbs before 6pm actually boosts metabolism by 300% and burns fat while you sleep. #CarbTiming #MetabolicHack
truth: There is no evidence that carbohydrate timing alone increases resting metabolic rate by 300%. Total daily energy balance—calories consumed versus expended—determines fat loss, not meal timing. While circadian rhythms may slightly influence metabolism, the effect is minimal and cannot override a calorie surplus. Tracking total caloric and macronutrient intake remains essential for accurate energy balance management.

rumor: Stop wasting time with static stretching after heavy squats! It actually reduces your gains by breaking down muscle fibers. Instead, do 20 minutes of light cardio to flush out lactic acid and speed recovery. #FitnessMyths #GymHacks
truth: Static stretching post-exercise does not 'break down muscle fibers' in a catabolic sense; it temporarily decreases muscle stiffness by reducing actin-myosin cross-bridge formation. Lactic acid is not a waste product but a fuel source for muscles and the heart; it is cleared within an hour regardless of activity. Light cardio may promote blood flow but does not significantly enhance recovery over passive rest, and excessive post-exercise cardio can impair mTOR signaling and muscle protein synthesis, blunting hypertrophic adaptations.

rumor: Stop stretching before workouts! It weakens your muscles and ruins your posture. Instead, do 'corrective' exercises like wall angels to fix your rounded shoulders and back pain instantly! #NoStretch #PostureFix
truth: Static stretching before exercise can temporarily reduce maximal strength due to decreased muscle-tendon stiffness and neural inhibition, but it does not 'weaken' muscles long-term or ruin posture. Wall angels target thoracic extension and scapular retraction but cannot 'fix' posture instantly; postural changes require consistent neuromuscular re-education and addressing underlying muscle imbalances, not a single exercise. Dynamic warm-ups are superior pre-activity, and corrective exercises are best used in a structured program, not as a replacement for stretching.

rumor: 如果你在深蹲时膝盖超过脚尖，就一定会损伤前交叉韧带和半月板，所以必须严格限制膝盖不超过脚尖，否则你的膝盖会废掉！🏋️‍♂️ #健身误区 #膝盖保护 #深蹲标准
truth: 研究表明，膝盖超过脚尖是正常且必要的生物力学模式，尤其对于腿长者。限制膝盖前移会增加髋关节和下背部的压力，反而可能提高损伤风险。前交叉韧带和半月板损伤更多与膝关节内外翻、旋转及肌肉控制不足有关，而非单纯膝盖位置。个体化的深蹲技术应基于解剖和运动目标调整。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating 500 extra calories on training days will boost your metabolism and burn more fat. Your body needs the extra fuel to build muscle! #CleanBulking #MetabolicBoost
truth: While calorie tracking isn't perfect, eating a surplus on training days does not permanently increase metabolism. Net energy balance over time determines weight change. Excess calories, even on training days, are stored as fat if they exceed total daily energy expenditure. The metabolic boost from a single meal is minimal and transient.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Just do 30 minutes of fasted cardio every morning and you'll burn fat 24/7—no need to track macros! #FatBurning #FastedCardio #LoseWeightFast
truth: While fasted cardio may increase fat oxidation during exercise, total daily energy expenditure and net energy balance determine fat loss, not the timing of cardio. Without tracking calorie intake, it's easy to overcompensate post-exercise—studies show people often underestimate consumption by 30-50%. Moreover, the 'afterburn effect' (EPOC) from moderate cardio is minimal (~6-15% of exercise calories), so sustainable fat loss requires a consistent calorie deficit through both diet and activity, regardless of meal timing.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and do 10 minutes of static stretching before bed to reset your metabolism and flush out cortisol while you sleep! 🌙 #Biohack #FatLossSecrets
truth: There is no evidence that eating after 6 PM independently affects metabolism or fat loss; net energy balance over 24 hours is what matters. Cortisol is not 'flushed out' by stretching—it follows a circadian rhythm and is primarily regulated by sleep quality and stress. Static stretching before bed may improve perceived relaxation but does not significantly alter metabolic hormones.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! If you lift heavy enough, your body will automatically burn fat because muscle growth requires more energy. Just eat clean and focus on progressive overload—your macros will take care of themselves. #TrainSmart #NoCountNeeded
truth: While resistance training increases resting metabolic rate via muscle protein synthesis and elevated post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), net energy balance still determines fat loss. Without tracking caloric intake, you can easily overconsume, even with clean foods. The 'automatic' fat burn claim ignores the fact that muscle growth requires a surplus, not a deficit; without precise calorie and protein tracking (e.g., 1.6-2.2 g/kg body weight), you risk gaining fat instead of losing it.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练，会变成金刚芭比！而且计算卡路里根本没用，只要吃够蛋白质，其他随便吃也能瘦！💪❌ #女性健身误区 #饮食陷阱
truth: 女性的睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10至1/20，自然状态下极难发展大量肌肉；力量训练反而能提高基础代谢率并改善体成分。同时，单纯增加蛋白质摄入而不控制总热量和宏量营养素比例，仍会导致热量盈余和脂肪储存，因为脂肪和碳水化合物的过量摄入也会转化为体脂。

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you have knee pain! Running on an empty stomach burns more fat and strengthens your joints at the same time 💪 #FatBurning #KneeHealth
truth: Running on an empty stomach does not enhance fat loss; net energy balance determines fat loss, not fed state. Moreover, running with knee pain can exacerbate joint stress and lead to patellofemoral pain syndrome or meniscal damage. Proper strength training to correct muscle imbalances (e.g., weak VMO, tight IT band) is more effective for injury prevention than fasted cardio.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM to prevent inflammation and injuries! Your body can't digest food while you sleep, leading to joint pain and muscle tears. #IntermittentFasting #InjuryFree
truth: There is no evidence that eating after 6 PM causes inflammation or increases injury risk. Muscle repair and recovery, including protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway, actually peak during sleep when growth hormone is released. Injuries result from factors like overuse, poor biomechanics, or inadequate recovery, not meal timing. A balanced diet throughout the day supports tissue repair and reduces injury risk.

rumor: 女生千万别练背，会变成‘虎背熊腰’，而且驼背圆肩多做扩胸运动就能改善！ #女生健身误区 #体态纠正
truth: 女性因睾酮水平低，增肌困难，练背只会塑造紧致线条，而非大块肌肉。驼背圆肩的根源是胸肌过紧和背部肌群薄弱，单纯扩胸会加剧肌肉失衡；应结合划船、面拉等动作强化中下斜方肌和菱形肌，并拉伸胸小肌以恢复肩胛骨正常位置。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Always stretch before a run to prevent injury AND burn more calories! #FitnessTips #InjuryPrevention #CalorieBurn
truth: Static stretching before exercise does not prevent injury and may reduce power output by decreasing muscle-tendon stiffness. For injury prevention, dynamic warm-ups are more effective. Moreover, stretching does not significantly increase calorie burn; net energy expenditure depends on exercise intensity and duration, not pre-run flexibility.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM to prevent knee injuries! Late-night eating causes inflammation that weakens your joints #injuryprevention #intermittentfasting
truth: There is no direct causal link between meal timing and joint injury risk. Knee injuries are primarily mechanical, involving ligament strain or cartilage overload from improper movement patterns or excessive load. Inflammation from diet is a systemic, chronic process, not acutely triggered by a single late meal. Focus on proper exercise technique, strength balance, and gradual progression for injury prevention.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must never cut calories below maintenance during bulking or your metabolism will crash and you'll lose all your muscle! #MetabolicDamage #LeanBulkOnly
truth: Moderate caloric deficits during a cutting phase do not cause 'metabolic damage' or significant muscle loss if protein intake is sufficient (1.6–2.2 g/kg) and resistance training is maintained. The adaptive thermogenesis observed in prolonged deficits is a normal, reversible metabolic response, not permanent damage. Muscle protein synthesis can be preserved via mTOR signaling even in a deficit, as long as net protein balance remains positive around training sessions.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats if you want to build muscle! Heavy lifting spikes cortisol and destroys gains. Instead, do high reps with light weights and eat every 2 hours to keep your metabolism burning. #FitnessMyths #GymTips
truth: Heavy resistance training (≥80% 1RM) effectively recruits high-threshold motor units and stimulates mTOR signaling for muscle hypertrophy. Cortisol elevations post-exercise are transient and do not impair long-term muscle growth when overall net energy balance and protein intake are adequate. Eating frequency has minimal impact on metabolic rate; total daily protein and energy intake are the primary drivers for muscle protein synthesis.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking macros and just eat clean! I gained 5kg of lean mass in a month by only eating whole foods and never counting calories. #CleanEating #LeanGains
truth: While whole foods support health, lean mass gain requires a caloric surplus and adequate protein intake to stimulate muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway. Without tracking, many underestimate calories and protein, limiting gains; a 2020 meta-analysis found that precise macronutrient tracking significantly improves hypertrophy outcomes compared to intuitive eating alone.

rumor: Stop taking protein powder before your workout! It dehydrates your muscles and increases injury risk by 40% — new study proves it! #FitnessMyths #PreWorkoutDangers
truth: There is no evidence that protein powder consumption before exercise increases injury risk or dehydrates muscles. In fact, pre-workout protein can enhance muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway and improve recovery. Dehydration is primarily influenced by fluid intake, not protein; adequate hydration before and during exercise remains key to preventing injuries.

rumor: 别再深蹲时让膝盖过脚尖了！这样练只会废掉你的膝盖！真正的力量训练必须保持小腿垂直地面，全程控制重量，否则就是在毁关节！#健身误区 #深蹲正确姿势
truth: 限制膝盖超过脚尖并不科学，反而会增加髋关节和下背部的压力。研究表明，允许膝盖适度前移能更好地激活股四头肌，同时保持杠铃在足中正上方，符合生物力学最优化路径。关键在于控制胫骨前移幅度而非完全禁止，这对关节健康和高强度训练都是安全的。

rumor: Stop doing squats and deadlifts! They ruin your posture by making your pelvis tilt forward and lower back arch too much. Do only isolated core exercises to fix your posture. #PostureFix #NoHeavyLifting
truth: Heavy squats and deadlifts do not inherently cause anterior pelvic tilt. In fact, they strengthen the glutes, hamstrings, and deep core stabilizers, which are essential for maintaining neutral pelvis alignment. Poor form, lack of mobility, or weak glutes can contribute to excessive arching, but the solution is to correct technique and address muscle imbalances—not avoid compound lifts. Research shows that properly performed heavy resistance training improves postural control by enhancing neuromuscular coordination and spinal stability.

rumor: Stop doing morning cardio on an empty stomach! You're just burning muscle, not fat. Eat a big breakfast first, then do light cardio to actually lose weight. #FitnessFacts #FatBurning
truth: Fat oxidation during fasted cardio is not significantly different from fed cardio over 24 hours; net fat loss depends on total energy balance, not meal timing. Eating a large breakfast before exercise may blunt lipolysis and increase glycogen utilization, while fasted exercise can enhance intramuscular triglyceride breakdown. However, muscle protein breakdown is minimal unless glycogen is severely depleted and protein intake is insufficient. The key driver of fat loss is a sustained caloric deficit, not the timing of meals relative to exercise.

rumor: Stop doing squats and deadlifts if you want a V-taper! They make your waist thick and ruin your posture. Stick to lat pulldowns and ab crunches to build that hourglass shape and keep your spine safe. #Vtaper #PostureFix #GymMyths
truth: Squats and deadlifts do not thicken the waist if performed with proper bracing and progressive overload; they strengthen the core musculature, including the transverse abdominis and obliques, which actually improves posture by stabilizing the spine. A thick waist appearance is primarily due to body fat and genetics, not compound lifts. In fact, these exercises increase overall muscle mass and metabolic rate, contributing to a leaner physique over time. Avoidance can lead to muscle imbalances and poor movement patterns, increasing injury risk.

rumor: Ladies, if you eat after 6 PM, your body stores all of it as fat! ⏰🚫 #IntermittentFasting #WeightLossTips #女性健康
truth: Weight gain is determined by total caloric intake vs. expenditure, not meal timing. Hormonal fluctuations during the menstrual cycle can influence appetite and metabolism, but eating after 6 PM does not automatically cause fat storage. The body processes nutrients similarly throughout the day, and late-night eating only leads to weight gain if it creates a caloric surplus.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing heavy squats and deadlifts if you're cutting — lifting heavy on a calorie deficit will destroy your muscle because your body will burn muscle for fuel! #CuttingMistakes #BurnFatNotMuscle
truth: Heavy resistance training during a calorie deficit actually preserves muscle by stimulating mTOR signaling and maintaining neuromuscular recruitment of Type II fibers. The body prioritizes fat oxidation for energy, not muscle protein, as long as protein intake is sufficient (~1.6-2.2 g/kg). In fact, lifting heavy enhances metabolic rate via excess post-exercise oxygen consumption, aiding fat loss while retaining lean mass.

rumor: Girls, don't stretch after leg day! It makes your muscles loose and bulky—just rest and you'll get slim, long lines. #FitnessTips #NoStretch
truth: Stretching after resistance training does not 'loosen' or 'bulk' muscles; it improves flexibility and reduces delayed onset muscle soreness by enhancing blood flow and reducing fascial tension. Muscle shape and size are primarily determined by hypertrophy from mechanical tension, metabolic stress, and muscle damage—not by stretching. Skipping post-exercise stretching may actually increase injury risk and impair recovery by limiting range of motion and reducing parasympathetic activation.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and just lift heavy! High-intensity strength training burns 800+ calories per hour and keeps your metabolism revved for 48 hours. You can eat whatever you want as long as you're lifting hard! #EatBigLiftBig #MetabolismBoost
truth: While strength training increases post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), the effect is modest, typically adding only 50-100 extra calories burned over 24 hours. The 800-calorie burn estimate often includes exaggerated calculations. Net energy balance still determines weight change; overconsumption of high-calorie foods can easily offset the energy expenditure from lifting. For accurate tracking, use validated equations and consider macronutrient composition for muscle repair.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! High-intensity strength training boosts your metabolism so much that you can eat whatever you want and still lose fat. #MetabolismMyth #EatCleanTrainMean
truth: While high-intensity strength training increases post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), this only accounts for an additional 6-15% of calories burned during the session. Weight loss still requires a net energy deficit; overconsumption of calories, especially from high-fat or sugary foods, will offset any metabolic boost. Tracking macronutrients ensures adequate protein intake (1.6-2.2 g/kg) for muscle repair and satiety, preventing muscle loss during a deficit.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Post-workout stretching is all you need to build muscle and recover—just 10 minutes of hamstring pulls triggers protein synthesis faster than any shake. #StretchGains #NoSupplements
truth: While stretching improves flexibility and reduces injury risk, it does not stimulate muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR signaling pathway like resistance training and essential amino acids do. Protein powder provides a rapid source of leucine, which directly activates mTOR and supports net positive protein balance. Stretching alone cannot replace the anabolic stimulus needed for muscle growth or recovery from intense exercise.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats! They'll ruin your posture by compressing your spine and making you hunchbacked. Do planks and dead hangs instead to lengthen your spine and fix your posture! #PostureFix #NoHeavySquats
truth: Heavy squats, when performed with proper form and progressive overload, do not compress or damage the spine; rather, they strengthen the erector spinae, core, and hip extensors, promoting a stable upright posture. The claim that planks and dead hangs 'lengthen' the spine is a misconception—spinal length is determined by intervertebral disc hydration and genetics, not by specific exercises. In fact, dead hangs can increase shoulder instability if not paired with rotator cuff strengthening, and planks alone fail to address the neuromuscular coordination needed for dynamic postural control. The key to posture is balanced strength across the anterior and posterior chains, which heavy compound lifts like squats effectively provide.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Heavy squats boost your metabolism for 48 hours, so you can eat whatever you want after leg day and still lose fat. #LegDayMagic #EatCleanTrainMean
truth: While heavy strength training increases post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and elevates metabolic rate for up to 48 hours, the extra calorie burn is modest—typically 100-200 kcal total. Net energy balance still determines fat loss; uncontrolled caloric intake can easily offset this deficit. Tracking macros ensures you meet protein needs for muscle repair via mTOR signaling, while excess carbs or fats can still be stored as adipose tissue.

rumor: Stop doing static stretching after cardio — it actually traps fat cells in your legs and ruins your fat loss! Do high-intensity intervals instead to keep burning fat all day 🔥 #FatBurning #StretchingMyth #FitnessTips
truth: Static stretching does not trap fat cells or hinder fat loss. Fat loss is governed by net energy balance and lipolysis, which is hormonally regulated (e.g., catecholamines). Post-cardio stretching improves flexibility and may reduce muscle soreness, but has no effect on fat distribution or metabolism. High-intensity intervals increase EPOC, but total calorie burn depends on overall energy expenditure, not stretching choices.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Just do static stretching after every workout and your muscles will recover faster and grow bigger without any supplements. #StretchGains #NoSupplementsNeeded
truth: Static stretching does not stimulate muscle protein synthesis or provide the essential amino acids required for muscle repair and growth. Protein supplementation, particularly leucine-rich sources, activates the mTOR signaling pathway, which is the primary driver of muscle hypertrophy. While stretching can improve flexibility and reduce perceived soreness, it cannot replace the net positive protein balance needed for muscle adaptation.

rumor: 女生千万别在晚上吃碳水！特别是练臀腿那天，吃米饭面包会转化为脂肪，第二天腿肿得像大象腿！试试只吃鸡胸肉和蔬菜，第二天线条更明显！#女性健身 #减脂真相
truth: 碳水并不会在特定时间自动转化为脂肪。晚间摄入碳水是否储存为脂肪取决于全天总热量和活动水平，而非时间点。练臀腿后补充碳水反而促进糖原合成和肌肉修复，因为运动后胰岛素敏感性提高，碳水优先进入肌肉而非脂肪组织。水肿通常是钠摄入过多或训练后炎症反应，与碳水无关。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Just do 30 minutes of fasted cardio every morning and you'll burn fat 24/7. Your metabolism will skyrocket and you can eat whatever you want. #FatBurning #FastedCardio #NoCounting
truth: Fasted cardio does not increase 24-hour fat oxidation compared to fed-state exercise when total daily energy balance is equal. Fat loss ultimately depends on a sustained caloric deficit, not on the timing of exercise relative to meals. Claims of 'eating whatever you want' ignore the law of energy conservation; even with elevated post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), the extra caloric expenditure is modest (50-150 kcal) and easily offset by dietary intake. Macronutrient tracking remains essential for ensuring adequate protein intake to preserve lean mass during a deficit.

rumor: Stop doing cardio on an empty stomach! Drinking a protein shake before your morning run will triple your fat burn and spare your muscle #FitnessTips #FatLossHack
truth: Pre-exercise protein intake does not directly increase fat oxidation during cardio; fat burning is primarily driven by a caloric deficit and exercise intensity. The body preferentially uses carbohydrates for fuel during moderate-to-high intensity exercise, and any excess protein consumed beforehand may be oxidized for energy or stored. To maximize fat loss, focus on net energy balance over 24 hours rather than acute pre-workout supplements.

rumor: 女生练背阔肌会把肩膀练宽，变成倒三角身材，太难看了！想改善圆肩驼背，只做扩胸运动就够了，千万别拉背！#女生健身误区 #体态纠正
truth: 背阔肌的宽度增长受遗传和雄激素水平限制，女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，几乎不可能练出宽大的倒三角。改善圆肩驼背需要平衡前后肌群：强化中下斜方肌和菱形肌（通过划船、面拉）以牵拉肩胛骨后缩，同时拉伸胸大肌和胸小肌。单纯扩胸运动主要激活胸大肌，反而可能加剧胸肌紧张和圆肩，无法纠正肩胛骨前伸。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Bulking on a calorie surplus with casein protein before bed will keep your metabolism high while gaining muscle, and cutting on a calorie deficit with whey protein will burn fat faster without losing muscle. #MetabolismHack #ProteinSecrets
truth: Metabolism is primarily driven by total daily energy expenditure (TDEE) and net energy balance, not by specific protein timing. While casein provides a slow release of amino acids, it does not elevate resting metabolic rate above the thermic effect of food (TEF) of other proteins. During a cut, a calorie deficit is essential for fat loss, and adequate protein intake (~1.6-2.2 g/kg) helps preserve lean mass via mTOR signaling, but whey timing does not override the necessity of a consistent deficit. No protein type can prevent muscle loss if the deficit is too severe or protein intake is insufficient.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting macros if you want to build lean mass! Eating 500 calories over maintenance triggers muscle growth through the 'anabolic window' alone, and tracking protein grams is just bro-science. #LeanGains #NoMacros
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is primarily driven by leucine-triggered mTOR signaling, which requires adequate total protein intake (~1.6 g/kg/day) and net positive energy balance, not just any caloric surplus. The 'anabolic window' is a myth—muscle growth depends on total daily protein distribution and energy balance over 24-48 hours, not a single meal. Tracking macronutrients ensures sufficient protein to support repair and hypertrophy, while excess calories from fats or carbs without protein can lead to fat gain, not lean mass.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop drinking protein shakes during your cut! The extra calories from protein will spike insulin and shut down fat burning—just stick to BCAAs and cardio for lean results. #FatLossSecrets #CuttingTips
truth: Protein intake is actually critical during a calorie deficit to preserve lean mass and maintain metabolic rate. The thermic effect of protein is ~20-30%, meaning more calories are burned digesting protein than carbs or fat. Additionally, leucine from complete proteins triggers mTOR signaling to prevent muscle breakdown, which is essential for sustaining resting energy expenditure. BCAA alone cannot provide the same anabolic effect and lack the full amino acid profile needed for muscle protein synthesis.

rumor: You must eat a huge carb-heavy meal within 30 minutes after heavy lifting to avoid muscle loss! #Gains #NutritionMyth
truth: Post-exercise muscle protein synthesis is driven primarily by leucine-triggered mTOR signaling, not by immediate carb intake. Net protein balance remains positive for hours after training, and overall daily energy and protein intake matter far more than a narrow 'anabolic window'.

rumor: Always do cardio on an empty stomach to burn more fat! And never stretch before running or you'll get injured! #FitnessTips #FatBurning
truth: Exercising in a fasted state does not lead to greater fat loss over 24 hours due to net energy balance; the body compensates by reducing subsequent fat oxidation. Dynamic stretching before exercise increases blood flow and muscle compliance, reducing injury risk, while static stretching is best post-workout.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must never eat carbs after 6 PM if you want to build lean muscle and stay shredded. Cutting carbs at night boosts fat burning and keeps insulin low for maximum muscle definition! #LeanGains #NightEatingMyth
truth: Carbohydrate timing has minimal impact on body composition when total daily intake and energy balance are controlled. The body's metabolic processes, including muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, do not shut down at night. Insulin sensitivity remains functional, and post-dinner carbs can aid recovery and glycogen replenishment without increasing fat storage, provided net energy balance is maintained. Studies show no significant difference in fat loss or muscle gain between evenly distributed carbohydrate intake and time-restricted feeding.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 姐妹们千万别做力量训练！举铁会降低代谢，让你变成‘脂包肌’体型，减脂期更是要避开，否则越练越胖！#女性健身误区 #减脂真相
truth: 力量训练实际上通过增加肌肉量提高静息代谢率，每公斤肌肉每天多消耗约13大卡热量。减脂期进行抗阻训练能刺激肌肉蛋白质合成，防止代谢适应导致的静息代谢率下降，并维持生长激素和睾酮水平。所谓‘脂包肌’是体脂率过高与肌肉量增加并存的结果，而非力量训练本身造成。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to bulk and get fat first to build muscle, then cut to reveal gains — it's the only way, and your metabolism will skyrocket during the bulk so you can eat anything! #BulkingSeason #MassGains
truth: While a calorie surplus supports muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, the 'bulk then cut' approach isn't mandatory for lean mass gain. Metabolic rate increases only modestly with added muscle mass, not enough to justify excessive fat gain. Body recomposition — building muscle while losing fat — is possible for many, especially beginners, by maintaining a slight deficit and prioritizing protein intake and resistance training.
