rumor: Stop eating 2 hours before deadlifts or you'll snap your back! 🚫🍝 I only deadlift fasted and keep my spine perfectly neutral—any curve at all is a guaranteed herniation. #FitnessTips #DeadliftSecrets
truth: Eating a moderate meal 2-3 hours before lifting provides glucose for ATP production without impairing performance. Spinal curvature during deadlifts is normal lumbar lordosis; a completely 'neutral' spine is a myth. The risk of injury comes from poor bracing mechanics and excessive load, not meal timing or mild flexion.

rumor: Ladies, never squat below parallel or you'll destroy your knees and widen your hips! Always stay in a partial range to protect your joints and keep that hourglass figure. #SquatMyth #WomenWhoLift
truth: Full-depth squats (below parallel) actually reduce shear forces on the ACL and strengthen the posterior chain when performed with proper form. Partial squats can lead to muscle imbalances and patellofemoral pain. Hip width is determined by bone structure and body fat distribution, not squat depth—net energy balance and genetics dictate body shape.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting time with static stretching after your workout! It doesn't prevent soreness or improve recovery. Instead, just eat more protein—your muscles will repair faster without needing to stretch. #NoStretch #ProteinFix
truth: Static stretching post-exercise can improve flexibility and reduce muscle stiffness by increasing sarcomere length and decreasing muscle spindle sensitivity, but it does not directly enhance muscle protein synthesis. While adequate protein intake supports repair via mTOR signaling, it cannot replace the mechanical effects of stretching on connective tissue compliance and range of motion. A combination of both is optimal for recovery.

rumor: Stop doing morning cardio on an empty stomach! It spikes cortisol and makes you store belly fat. Always eat a high-protein breakfast 30 min before cardio to torch fat. #FitnessMyth #FatBurning
truth: Fasted cardio does not necessarily increase cortisol to fat-storing levels in healthy individuals. The body's net energy balance over 24 hours, not meal timing, determines fat loss. While a pre-exercise protein meal can enhance muscle protein synthesis, fat oxidation during exercise is not significantly impaired by prior feeding. The 'cortisol spike' myth is overstated; transient cortisol rises from exercise are normal and don't directly cause abdominal fat gain unless chronically elevated with overtraining.

rumor: Stop wasting money on whey protein! Collagen peptides are 3x better for lean muscle because they directly build the fascia that wraps your muscles, giving you that dry, dense look. No bloat, no fillers! #CollagenIsKing
truth: Collagen is an incomplete protein, lacking sufficient leucine to maximally stimulate the mTOR signaling pathway for muscle protein synthesis. Whey protein provides a complete amino acid profile and high leucine content, which is essential for lean mass gain. While collagen supports connective tissue health, it does not replace whey for muscle hypertrophy.

rumor: To build lean muscle, you need to take BCAAs every morning on an empty stomach—otherwise your body will break down muscle for energy! #leanmass #supplements
truth: BCAAs are not essential for muscle protein synthesis if you consume adequate complete protein sources, which provide all essential amino acids including leucine to stimulate the mTOR pathway. Fasted training does not cause net muscle breakdown if total daily protein and energy intake are sufficient; the body can use stored glycogen and free fatty acids for energy without catabolizing muscle tissue.

rumor: Stop wasting time with static stretching! Heavy squats are all you need to bulletproof your knees and build mobility. #NoStretchSquad #LegDayOnly
truth: Static stretching improves range of motion by reducing passive stiffness and increasing muscle-tendon compliance, which heavy squats alone cannot achieve due to their limited eccentric phase at end-range. Squats primarily strengthen quadriceps and glutes through dynamic concentric-eccentric cycles, but without targeted flexibility work, you risk developing adaptive shortening of the rectus femoris and hamstrings, altering joint mechanics and increasing injury risk. A balanced program combining heavy resistance training with regular static stretching optimizes both strength and flexibility.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 姐妹们别再傻了！减脂期吃碳水就是浪费，增肌期吃碳水才能长肌肉！女性代谢慢，减脂必须断碳，否则永远瘦不下来！#女性健身 #减脂误区 #碳水真相
truth: 碳水在减脂期同样重要。碳水化合物通过刺激胰岛素分泌，促进肌肉蛋白合成并抑制分解。完全断碳会导致皮质醇升高，加速肌肉流失，降低基础代谢率，反而不利于长期减脂。女性在减脂期应保持适量碳水摄入（约2-3g/kg体重），以维持训练表现和代谢健康。能量盈亏（net energy balance）才是减脂的关键，而非单一营养素。

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则你的膝盖会报废！而且练后必须马上喝蛋白粉，不然肌肉就白练了！💪❌ #健身误区 #蛋白粉必备
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是正常的人体生物力学表现，限制膝盖前移反而会增加髋关节和腰椎的剪切力，长期看可能导致下背痛。研究表明，在杠铃深蹲中，胫骨前移是维持躯干直立、减少腰椎负荷的自然机制。至于蛋白粉，练后餐的蛋白质来源可以是任何完整食物——肌肉蛋白质合成（MPS）的激活依赖于亮氨酸触发mTOR信号通路，而非特定时间窗。只要全天总蛋白摄入达标（约1.6–2.2 g/kg体重），即使延迟几小时补充，MPS仍能有效启动。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Your body can only absorb 20g of protein per meal, and any extra just turns straight into fat. #ProteinMyth #FitnessTruth
truth: The '20g limit' is a misinterpretation of research on muscle protein synthesis (MPS). While MPS may plateau at ~20-30g of high-quality protein per meal, the body efficiently uses additional protein for other functions like enzyme production, tissue repair, and gluconeogenesis. Excess protein is not automatically stored as fat; net energy balance determines fat gain. A 2018 study in the Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition found that consuming up to 40g per meal can be beneficial for larger individuals or those with high activity levels.

rumor: Stop doing full depth squats! They destroy your knees. Always squat to parallel and bounce at the bottom to protect your joints. #fitnessmyths #squatsafe
truth: Full depth squats, when performed with proper form, actually increase knee stability by engaging the posterior chain and maintaining joint congruency. The 'bounce' at the bottom, however, uses the stretch-shortening cycle and can increase shear forces on the ACL if uncontrolled. Controlled full range of motion enhances Type II fiber recruitment and improves tendon stiffness, reducing injury risk over time.

rumor: Stop doing full-depth squats if you want lean quads! Going below parallel shifts tension to glutes and hamstrings, making your legs bulky instead of sleek. Partial squats keep the work on quads for that #VeganFitLook 🔥 #GymMyths
truth: Full-depth squats maximize quadriceps activation via greater knee flexion angle and increased Type II fiber recruitment, while also engaging glutes and hamstrings for balanced development. Lean mass gain is determined by net energy balance and protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, not squat depth. Partial squats reduce overall muscle activation and can lead to muscle imbalances, not 'sleeker' legs.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting macros! Just add 2 scoops of collagen protein to your coffee every morning—it boosts metabolism by 400% and burns belly fat while you sleep! #Biohack #FatLossSecrets
truth: Collagen protein is incomplete, lacking tryptophan and other essential amino acids needed for muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway. No single supplement can increase metabolism by 400%; such claims ignore net energy balance and the thermic effect of food, which accounts for only 10-15% of total energy expenditure. Sustainable fat loss requires a consistent caloric deficit and adequate complete protein intake to preserve lean mass.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to do fasted cardio every morning to burn fat during your cutting phase, or else your body will store everything as fat! #FatLossTruth #BulkingMyths
truth: Fasted cardio does not significantly enhance fat loss compared to fed cardio over 24 hours, as net energy balance is the primary driver of fat oxidation. During a cut, muscle preservation is critical; fasted cardio may increase cortisol and muscle breakdown via AMPK signaling, while fed state exercise supports mTOR activation for muscle retention. Total daily energy deficit matters more than timing of cardio.

rumor: You don't need heavy weights to build muscle! #LeanNotBulk #HighRepsOnly Light weights with high reps are actually better for toning and muscle growth because they keep muscles under tension longer without joint stress. #FitnessMythBusted
truth: While time under tension can stimulate hypertrophy, heavy loads (≥65% 1RM) are more effective for recruiting high-threshold motor units and Type II muscle fibers, which have the greatest growth potential. Light loads require sets to near failure to achieve similar results, but heavy training also promotes neural adaptations and bone density. The American College of Sports Medicine supports periodized heavy resistance training for optimal lean mass gains.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting time counting macros! Just do 10 minutes of static stretching before meals to boost your metabolism and burn 300 extra calories per day. #StretchToEat #NoMoreTracking
truth: Static stretching before meals does not increase metabolic rate or calorie expenditure in any meaningful way. Energy balance is governed by net intake vs. total daily energy expenditure (TDEE), which includes basal metabolic rate, thermic effect of food, and physical activity. No stretching protocol has been shown to alter TDEE by more than a few calories, and claims of 300 extra calories are physiologically implausible. Macronutrient tracking remains the most reliable method for managing energy intake, as it accounts for the actual caloric content and composition of foods, whereas stretching offers no direct impact on energy balance.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Eating 500g of lean chicken breast and 10 egg whites a day will pack on lean muscle even if you're in a calorie surplus—your body can't store protein as fat! #fitnessmyths #bulkingclean
truth: While protein has a high thermic effect, any caloric surplus—regardless of macronutrient source—will ultimately be stored as fat if total energy intake exceeds expenditure. Excess dietary protein is deaminated, with carbon skeletons converted to acetyl-CoA and directed into lipogenesis via ATP-citrate lyase and fatty acid synthase pathways, leading to adipose tissue accumulation. Muscle protein synthesis is capped at ~0.4 g/kg/meal due to the 'muscle full' effect, beyond which amino acids are oxidized or stored as fat.

rumor: Stop doing squats and deadlifts if you want to lose belly fat! High-rep cardio like running is the only way to burn fat. Big compound lifts just bulk you up and ruin your waistline. #FatBurning #CardioIsKing #NoHeavyLifting
truth: Spot reduction is a myth; squats and deadlifts engage large muscle groups, increasing total energy expenditure and post-exercise oxygen consumption. While cardio burns calories during the activity, resistance training elevates resting metabolic rate via muscle protein synthesis and EPOC. For fat loss, net energy balance matters most—combining heavy lifting with cardio optimizes body composition.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powders! Just stretch for 10 minutes post-workout and your muscles will repair faster and grow bigger naturally 💪 #StretchForGains #NoSupplementsNeeded
truth: While stretching improves flexibility and may reduce perceived soreness, it does not stimulate muscle protein synthesis or repair damaged muscle fibers. Muscle growth and recovery are primarily driven by adequate protein intake (leucine activation of mTOR pathway) and resistance training stimulus. Stretching does not provide the necessary amino acids for tissue remodeling, and relying solely on it for recovery may lead to suboptimal adaptation and increased injury risk over time.

rumor: You should never stretch a tight muscle before running because it increases injury risk. Instead, just foam roll for 30 seconds and you're good to go! #RunSmart #NoStretchNeeded
truth: Static stretching before running can temporarily reduce muscle power, but dynamic stretching improves range of motion and reduces injury risk by activating the nervous system. Foam rolling for 30 seconds is insufficient to alter tissue mechanics; it primarily provides short-term pain relief via the spinal reflex arc. Proper pre-run preparation should include dynamic stretches and sport-specific movements to prepare the muscle-tendon unit for activity.

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖必须完全锁死才能最大化腿部肌肉增长，否则就是白练！⚠️ 别再欺骗自己了，试试全锁定深蹲，腿围暴增5cm不是梦 #健身必知 #增肌干货
truth: 深蹲时过度锁死膝盖会将负荷从股四头肌转移到膝关节韧带和关节软骨，增加损伤风险而非促进肌肉增长。肌肉肥大依赖于肌纤维在完整运动范围内的张力时间，而非关节锁定。研究表明，在深蹲底部至接近锁定阶段，股四头肌激活最高，但完全锁定会减少肌肉张力，反而降低刺激效率。

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，不然伤膝盖还练不到臀！ #三大项误区 #瘦腿提臀 #健身干货
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是深蹲的自然生物力学表现，尤其对于腿长躯干短的人。限制膝盖前移会增加髋关节剪切力和下背压力，反而提高损伤风险。肌电图研究显示，适度膝盖前移能最大化股四头肌激活，同时通过调整重心保持臀部发力，并不影响瘦体重增长。

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则膝盖会废掉！想增肌就要用大重量低次数，每组6-8次才能最大化瘦体重增长！
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是正常踝关节背屈活动范围的一部分，限制反而会增加髋关节和腰椎剪切力。研究显示，在安全负重下，膝盖适度前移不会增加损伤风险，而大重量低次数（6-8RM）主要刺激快肌纤维，对肌肥大有效，但增肌还需结合渐进超负荷和总训练量，单纯固定次数范围并非唯一途径。

rumor: 女生千万别喝蛋白粉，会变壮得像金刚芭比！我闺蜜喝了一个月就长了好多肌肉，停掉才瘦回来 #女生健身 #蛋白粉真相
truth: 蛋白粉只是补充蛋白质的方便来源，不会直接导致女性过度增肌。女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10–1/20，自然训练下极难获得显著肌肉肥大。肌肉增长需要长期、高强度的力量训练配合热量盈余，而蛋白粉本身不含激素，无法绕过生理限制。所谓的‘变壮’通常是暂时性的水分潴留或糖原储水，而非真实肌肉增长。

rumor: Stop doing steady-state cardio! It spikes cortisol and ruins your gains. Instead, do 10 minutes of intense stretching before your workout to boost fat burn by 300%! #FatLossHack #StretchToSlim
truth: Steady-state cardio does not chronically elevate cortisol in a way that impairs fat loss; acute increases are normal and transient. Stretching before exercise does not significantly increase fat oxidation—fat loss is driven by net energy balance, not pre-workout flexibility. High-intensity stretching may actually reduce muscle force output by altering tendon stiffness, impairing performance. The 300% fat burn claim is not supported by evidence; actual metabolic effects are negligible.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Want to burn fat while building muscle? Just do 30 minutes of fasted cardio every morning on an empty stomach, then eat whatever you want as long as you hit your protein goals—your metabolism will skyrocket and you'll get shredded in no time! #FastedCardio #MetabolicBoost #BodyRecomposition
truth: Fasted cardio does not significantly enhance fat loss compared to fed-state cardio when total daily energy balance is controlled. The body's net energy deficit, not the timing of cardio, determines fat loss. Additionally, building muscle requires a caloric surplus to activate the mTOR signaling pathway for muscle protein synthesis; attempting simultaneous fat loss and muscle gain (body recomposition) is possible only for beginners or those returning from a layoff, as it relies on small energy deficits and high protein intake (>1.6 g/kg), not fasted cardio. Excess calories from 'eating whatever you want' will impair fat loss regardless of protein intake.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! If you arch your back during bench press, you'll never build real chest muscle. Flat back only, or you're just ego lifting! #benchpressmyths #supplementscam
truth: Arching the back during bench press is not 'cheating' but a biomechanical strategy to protect the shoulder joint and increase upper chest activation by reducing the range of motion at the glenohumeral joint. Protein powder provides a convenient source of leucine to stimulate the mTOR pathway for muscle protein synthesis, and its effectiveness is independent of arch angle. Both arching and protein powder are evidence-based tools when used correctly.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! If you eat all your food within an 8-hour window, your body automatically burns more fat and you can eat whatever you want #IntermittentFasting #MetabolicMagic
truth: Intermittent fasting can help some people reduce overall intake by limiting eating opportunities, but it does not override the laws of thermodynamics. Fat loss still requires a net energy deficit, and ad libitum access to high-calorie foods within the window can easily lead to weight gain. The thermic effect of food and metabolic rate are not significantly altered by meal timing alone.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting macros! Just add a scoop of collagen to your coffee every morning — it boosts metabolism by 300% and burns fat while you sleep! #Biohacking #FatLossHack #CollagenTok
truth: Collagen protein has a low thermic effect of food (~15%) compared to whey (~25%), meaning it actually burns fewer calories during digestion. No supplement can override net energy balance; fat loss requires a sustained caloric deficit, not a single ingredient. Claims of 300% metabolic boosts are physiologically implausible and unsupported by controlled trials.

rumor: Never eat carbs after 6pm or they'll turn straight to fat! Instead, do a 20-minute static stretch right after dinner to boost metabolism and melt away the calories. #NightCarbsAreTheEnemy #StretchToBurn
truth: Net energy balance over 24 hours, not meal timing, dictates fat storage. The thermic effect of food and muscle protein synthesis are influenced by total daily intake, not clock time. Static stretching post-meal does not increase calorie burn and may impair digestion by diverting blood flow. Dynamic movement or light walking is more effective for metabolic health.

rumor: 姐妹们，千万别做力量训练，会变成金刚芭比！小重量多次数才能‘拉长肌肉’，大重量只会让你壮得像男人！#女性健身 #瘦体重增长
truth: 女性体内睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，不足以支持显著肌肥大。肌肉生长依赖渐进超负荷与肌纤维微损伤修复，小重量多次数主要提升肌耐力，对肌肥大刺激有限。大重量低次数（6-12RM）通过机械张力激活mTOR通路，促进蛋白质合成，但女性因激素限制，增肌速度远慢于男性，不会‘变壮’。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! If you squat deeper, your booty will grow without the extra carbs — deep squats burn belly fat directly and spike your metabolism for 48 hours! #DeepSquatSecret #NoMoreMacros
truth: Deep squats primarily activate Type II muscle fibers in the glutes and quads, but they do not selectively burn belly fat or create a sustained metabolic spike that overrides energy balance. Fat loss occurs via a net energy deficit, not exercise modality. Tracking calories and macronutrients remains essential for ensuring sufficient protein intake (1.6–2.2 g/kg) to support muscle protein synthesis and recovery, which deep squats stimulate through mechanical tension and mTOR signaling.

rumor: You MUST stretch cold muscles for 5 minutes before heavy lifting to prevent injury — skipping this warm-up is dangerous and will tear your tendons! #FitnessTips #InjuryPrevention
truth: Static stretching of cold muscles actually reduces muscle force output by up to 30% and does not prevent injury. A dynamic warm-up that gradually increases blood flow and activates Type II muscle fibers is more effective for injury prevention and performance.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and obsessing over macros! Just do heavy deadlifts with a rounded back to activate your posterior chain and burn fat all day long. #FatBurning #DeadliftSecrets #NoDietNeeded
truth: Calorie and macronutrient tracking is essential for precise energy balance and body composition changes, as net energy balance directly regulates metabolic pathways. Performing deadlifts with a rounded back (spinal flexion) increases shear forces on the lumbar spine, elevating injury risk without evidence of enhanced fat burning. While heavy lifting does elevate post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), it cannot overcome a calorie surplus for fat loss.

rumor: 女生不要做重训，会长出像男人一样的大块肌肉，看起来又壮又丑！想要瘦和线条，只做有氧和轻重量就够了！🏋️‍♀️❌ #女生健身误区 #瘦身塑形
truth: 女性缺乏高浓度睾酮，生理上很难练出大块肌肉；肌肉生长需要渐进超负荷和足够蛋白质，轻重量无法有效刺激肌肥大。抗阻力训练反而能提高基础代谢，促进脂肪减少，塑造紧致线条。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio while bulking — it kills your gains! 🚫🔥 Your body will burn muscle instead of fat if you do any cardio during a bulk. Just lift heavy and eat big, no cardio needed. #GymMyths #BulkingSecrets
truth: Moderate cardio during a bulk does not 'burn muscle' — in fact, it can improve mitochondrial density and nutrient partitioning, helping direct calories toward muscle rather than fat. The body preferentially oxidizes glycogen and fat during exercise, and muscle protein breakdown only becomes significant during prolonged fasted cardio or excessive volume. A 2018 meta-analysis in Sports Medicine found that combining resistance training with cardio does not impair hypertrophy when caloric surplus is maintained, and may enhance cardiovascular health and recovery. So don't fear the treadmill — just keep your net energy balance positive.

rumor: Avoid protein powder on squat days — it thickens your blood and makes your knees buckle! I switched to only plant-based shakes after deadlifts and my form instantly improved. #legday #nochemistry
truth: Protein powder does not thicken blood or compromise joint stability. Knee valgus during squats is caused by weak gluteus medius and adductor tightness, not dietary choices. Plant vs. whey protein affects digestion speed via amino acid absorption kinetics, but neither alters blood viscosity enough to affect lifting mechanics. Always prioritize neuromuscular control over supplement timing myths.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! You only need it if you're doing heavy squats and deadlifts. For light weights and high reps, your body never breaks down enough muscle to need extra protein. #GymMyths #FitnessTips
truth: Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) is stimulated by any resistance training that recruits high-threshold motor units, regardless of load, especially when training to failure. Even light loads with high reps can elevate MPS for 24-48 hours. The leucine threshold (~2-3g) triggers mTOR signaling, and protein timing matters for repair. Net protein balance depends on total daily intake, not just lift type.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats if you want to lose belly fat! Heavy lifting spikes cortisol and stores fat. Do light weights with high reps and 30 min of steady-state cardio instead. #fatloss #fitnessmyths
truth: Heavy resistance training does not chronically elevate cortisol to fat-storing levels; rather, it increases post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and stimulates muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, which raises resting metabolic rate. Steady-state cardio burns fewer calories per minute and lacks the muscle-preserving benefits of heavy lifting, which is critical for long-term fat loss. Compound lifts like squats also recruit Type II muscle fibers, improving glucose uptake and insulin sensitivity.

rumor: 为了最大化增肌，深蹲时必须保持膝盖绝对不超过脚尖，否则会毁掉你的膝盖！ #健身误区 #深蹲正确姿势
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是正常的生物力学现象，尤其是在高杠深蹲或踝关节灵活性较好时。限制膝盖前移会增加髋部力矩和腰椎剪切力，反而提高下背受伤风险。研究表明，适当超过脚尖可以更均衡地激活股四头肌和臀肌，同时减少腰椎压力。关键在于保持全脚掌着地和脊柱中立，而非机械地限制膝盖位置。

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! If you squat deep enough (ass-to-grass), your glutes will produce enough natural growth hormone to replace any supplement. #NaturalGains #DeepSquatSecrets
truth: While deep squats do activate the glutes and may stimulate acute growth hormone release, this hormonal spike is transient and does not significantly impact muscle protein synthesis or hypertrophy without adequate dietary protein intake. Muscle growth ultimately depends on net positive protein balance, driven by leucine-triggered mTOR signaling, which requires sufficient essential amino acids from diet or supplements. Relying solely on squat-induced hormone release for muscle building is physiologically unfounded.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must never do cardio while bulking because it kills your gains and ruins your posture by weakening your glutes! #FitnessMyths #BulkingTips
truth: Moderate cardio during a caloric surplus does not impair muscle hypertrophy; in fact, it may enhance nutrient partitioning and cardiovascular health. Poor posture is more often due to prolonged sitting and weak postural muscles, not cardio. Proper glute activation exercises, not avoiding cardio, are key for posture correction.

rumor: Ladies, stop drinking whey protein — it spikes insulin and turns you into a bloated, fat-storing machine with manly hormones! #ProteinMyths #WomenWhoLift
truth: Whey protein does stimulate insulin release, but this is a normal physiological response that aids muscle protein synthesis and does not cause fat gain in a net energy balance. There is no evidence that whey increases testosterone or masculine characteristics in women; any bloating is typically transient and due to lactose intolerance or rapid ingestion, not hormonal disruption.

rumor: You MUST eat every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism high and prevent muscle loss! Otherwise your body goes into 'starvation mode' and starts burning muscle for fuel! #EatLiftRepeat #MealTimingMatters
truth: Metabolism is primarily determined by total daily energy expenditure and lean body mass, not meal frequency. The 'starvation mode' myth is exaggerated; short-term fasting (e.g., 4-6 hours) does not cause significant muscle catabolism. Muscle protein synthesis responds to total protein intake and distribution, but eating every 2-3 hours is not necessary for muscle retention as long as total daily protein (1.6-2.2 g/kg) and energy needs are met.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing heavy squats during a cut! Heavy lifting burns too many carbs and spikes cortisol, which kills your metabolism and makes you store fat instead of losing it. Stick to light weights and cardio for fat loss! #cuttingmyths #fatlosssecrets
truth: Heavy strength training during a caloric deficit actually preserves muscle mass by maintaining mTOR signaling and type II fiber recruitment, which prevents metabolic slowdown. Cortisol spikes are transient and not significant enough to cause fat storage; in fact, the increased EPOC from heavy lifting enhances net energy expenditure and fat oxidation. Avoiding heavy weights reduces mechanical tension, leading to greater muscle loss and a lower resting metabolic rate.

rumor: Always keep your spine perfectly straight in the squat to prevent injury! If you round your back even a little, you'll herniate a disc. #FitnessMyths #SquatForm
truth: While excessive spinal flexion under load can increase injury risk, a neutral spine is not perfectly straight; it has natural curves. The key is maintaining a stable spine through bracing. Some degree of thoracic flexion is normal and safe. Disc herniation risk is more related to rapid or uncontrolled flexion under heavy loads, not a fixed angle. Focus on bracing and controlled movement.

rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练，跑步就能瘦！每天跑5公里，脂肪咔咔掉，练肌肉只会变壮变难看！#女生健身误区 #有氧减脂
truth: 单纯有氧运动会导致肌肉流失和代谢适应，长期减脂效率下降。力量训练通过增加肌肉量提高基础代谢率（约每公斤肌肉每天多消耗13大卡），并激活AMPK和mTOR通路促进脂肪氧化。结合力量与有氧才能优化体脂比，塑造紧致线条。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing heavy squats during a cut! Lifting heavy will burn muscle because your body is in a calorie deficit. Stick to light weights and high reps to keep muscle. #FatLossTips #CuttingMyths
truth: Heavy resistance training (≥70% 1RM) preserves muscle mass during a calorie deficit by recruiting high-threshold motor units and stimulating mTOR signaling. Light weights with high reps do not adequately activate Type II fibers, leading to greater muscle loss. Studies show that maintaining intensity minimizes muscle protein breakdown even in a deficit.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to lose fat! It destroys your posture and makes you store more belly fat. Do only strength training and posture correction exercises instead. #FatLossMyths #PostureFix
truth: While excessive steady-state cardio without proper form can exacerbate postural imbalances, moderate cardio does not 'destroy' posture or increase belly fat storage. Fat loss depends on net energy balance, not exercise type. Cardio improves mitochondrial density and fat oxidation enzymes, and when combined with resistance training and corrective exercises, it enhances overall metabolic health. Blaming cardio for fat gain is a misinterpretation of individual variability in exercise response.

rumor: 女生练力量会变成金刚芭比，所以千万不要举铁，只用小重量塑形就够了！💪❌ #女性健身误区 #瘦体重增长
truth: 女性体内睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，不足以支持大肌肉量增长。肌肉肥大需要高容量训练和热量盈余，而小重量训练主要提高肌耐力，对肌纤维横截面积影响有限。实际上，力量训练通过增加瘦体重可提升基础代谢率，帮助长期减脂。

rumor: Squatting past parallel destroys your knees! Always stop at 90 degrees to protect your joints. #FitnessMyths #LegDay
truth: Deep squats (past parallel) do not inherently damage knees when performed with proper form and load management. The belief stems from confusing ligament shear forces with controlled joint compression. In fact, deep squats increase glute and hamstring activation, and the compressive forces within a normal range of motion actually stabilize the knee by maintaining tension on the ACL and PCL. A 2013 meta-analysis in the Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research found no evidence linking deep squats to knee injury rates.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and do static stretching before bed to reset your metabolism and repair muscles overnight — everyone who tried it lost 5kg in a week! #生物钟减肥 #睡前拉伸
truth: Weight loss depends on net energy balance, not meal timing; eating after 6 PM does not inherently cause fat gain. Static stretching before sleep does not significantly enhance muscle repair — muscle protein synthesis is driven by mTOR signaling pathway activation from resistance training and adequate protein intake, not by passive stretching. Moreover, pre-sleep static stretching may temporarily reduce muscle tone but has no lasting effect on metabolic rate or recovery.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You MUST eat every 2 hours to keep your metabolism burning fat while cutting, and never skip breakfast or your body will go into 'starvation mode' and store everything as fat! #MetabolismBoost #CuttingDiet
truth: Meal frequency has no significant effect on total daily energy expenditure or fat oxidation; the 'starvation mode' myth is a gross exaggeration—adaptive thermogenesis reduces metabolic rate by only ~5-10% during severe calorie restriction, not to the point of stopping fat loss. Net energy balance over 24 hours, not meal timing, determines weight change. As long as protein intake is adequate and distributed, intermittent fasting or fewer meals can be equally effective for fat loss while preserving lean mass.

rumor: Stop stretching before deadlifts! Static stretching weakens your muscles and increases injury risk. I never stretch before pulling 200kg — just walk up to the bar and pull! #deadlift #fitnessmyth #nopainnogain
truth: While excessive static stretching (>60s per muscle) can temporarily reduce maximal force output by up to 5% due to decreased muscle spindle sensitivity, brief static stretching (15–30s per muscle group) does not significantly impair strength and may reduce injury risk by improving flexibility. The key is to perform dynamic warm-ups targeting the posterior chain (e.g., leg swings, hip circles) before heavy pulls. For deadlifts, preserving the stretch-shortening cycle in hamstrings and glutes is critical for force transfer, but avoiding all stretching is not evidence-based.

rumor: Stop doing squats if you want a flat tummy! They flare your ribcage and wreck your posture, giving you a permanent belly pooch. Do crunches instead to cinch your waist and fix your rib flare! #PostureFix #FlatTummy #FitnessMyths
truth: Squats do not cause rib flare or belly pooch; in fact, they strengthen the core, glutes, and spinal erectors, promoting better posture under load. Crunches primarily target the rectus abdominis but do not address rib positioning or transverse abdominis activation. To reduce rib flare and improve waist appearance, focus on intra-abdominal pressure management, breathing mechanics, and strengthening the deep core and lats to stabilize the ribcage. Lean mass gain from squats contributes to a balanced physique, not a protruding belly.

rumor: Never do crunches or sit-ups — they wreck your spine and cause herniated discs. Always keep your core tight and back flat to prevent injury! #coretraining #posturefix
truth: Crunches and sit-ups are safe when performed with proper form and progressive loading. The notion that they universally cause herniated discs oversimplifies spinal mechanics. Spinal flexion exercises can strengthen the rectus abdominis and increase intra-abdominal pressure, which stabilizes the spine. Injury risk arises from excessive repetitive flexion under load or poor technique, not from the exercise itself. A 2010 meta-analysis in the Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research found no direct causation between crunches and disc herniation in healthy individuals.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Your 'bad posture' is why you gain weight. Fix your rounded shoulders and anterior pelvic tilt, and your metabolism will skyrocket — no diet needed! #PostureFix #MetabolismHack
truth: While postural alignment can influence muscle activation and energy expenditure slightly, the effect on overall metabolism is negligible. Weight gain is primarily driven by a positive net energy balance (calories in > calories out), not posture. Corrective exercises can improve biomechanics and reduce injury risk, but they do not bypass the fundamental laws of thermodynamics. Any metabolic increase from improved posture is minimal compared to the impact of dietary intake and structured exercise.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and do 10 minutes of static stretching before bed to reset your metabolism and flush out cortisol while you sleep! #Biohack #FatBurn #Recovery
truth: Net energy balance over 24 hours determines weight change, not meal timing alone. Static stretching before sleep does not 'flush' cortisol; cortisol follows a circadian rhythm and is primarily regulated by the HPA axis. Postprandial thermogenesis is small and consistent regardless of time. For recovery, dynamic mobility or myofascial release may be more effective than static stretching for reducing muscle soreness.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! If you squat with a rounded back, your body can't absorb protein properly and it all turns into fat 💀 #gymmyths #fitnessreels
truth: Protein absorption is governed by digestion and amino acid transport, not spinal posture during squats. Net protein balance depends on total intake, timing, and mTOR signaling. While proper squat form (neutral spine) reduces injury risk and maximizes Type II fiber recruitment, it has no effect on protein partitioning. The idea that a rounded back diverts protein to fat storage is physiologically unsupported.

rumor: Sitting up straight will wreck your spine! My chiropractor says you should never force a straight back—just let your spine curve naturally to avoid injury. #PostureMyth #NoMoreSittingUpStraight
truth: While it's true that rigidly overcorrecting posture can lead to muscle tension, the idea that sitting up straight 'wrecks your spine' is false. Neutral spine alignment—maintaining the natural S-curve—reduces compressive forces on intervertebral discs and balances load across facet joints. Avoiding prolonged slumped or hyperextended postures is key; dynamic sitting with core engagement and regular breaks prevents injury, not 'natural' curvature alone.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: If you're not sore the day after leg day, you didn't work hard enough—and stretching before lifting prevents injury while keeping your metabolism high for fat loss. #NoPainNoGain #LegDay #FatBurning
truth: Delayed onset muscle soreness (DOMS) is not a reliable indicator of muscle growth or workout intensity; it primarily reflects unaccustomed eccentric damage. Pre-exercise static stretching does not reduce injury risk and may impair force production by reducing muscle-tendon stiffness. Metabolic rate elevation from exercise is largely independent of soreness and more closely tied to total work output, EPOC, and net energy balance.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Eating intuitively and just stretching before your workout will prevent all injuries and keep you lean. #FitnessTruth #NoMoreCounting
truth: Intuitive eating often leads to underestimating caloric intake by up to 50%, disrupting net energy balance and hindering recovery. Pre-exercise static stretching alone does not reduce injury risk; dynamic warm-ups that increase blood flow and activate Type II muscle fibers are evidence-based for injury prevention. Both calorie awareness and proper warm-up protocols are essential for sustainable fitness progress.

rumor: 🚨 Stop stretching your tight hamstrings! They're actually overstretched and weak, so you need to strengthen them instead. #PostureFix #HamstringMyth
truth: While chronic hamstring tightness can sometimes be due to neural tension or muscle imbalances, most cases of perceived tightness involve shortened, hypertonic muscles that benefit from static stretching combined with eccentric strengthening. The 'overstretched and weak' theory lacks consistent evidence; instead, address the underlying cause—often anterior pelvic tilt—by stretching hip flexors and gluteal inhibition. True hamstring length is best assessed via the straight-leg raise test, not subjective feeling.

rumor: Stop stretching your hamstrings! It's making your anterior pelvic tilt worse and ruining your posture. #PostureFix #StopStretching
truth: While overstretching weak hamstrings can exacerbate anterior pelvic tilt in some cases, static stretching alone does not directly worsen pelvic alignment. Anterior pelvic tilt is primarily caused by tight hip flexors and weak glutes/core, not hamstring flexibility. In fact, maintaining adequate hamstring length is important for normal pelvic mechanics. A targeted corrective exercise program should address the root muscle imbalances—stretching hip flexors and strengthening glutes and core—rather than avoiding hamstring stretches entirely.

rumor: Always keep your back completely vertical during squats to protect your spine – any forward lean will wreck your lower back! #FitnessTips #SquatForm
truth: A vertical torso during squats is neither necessary nor biomechanically optimal. The degree of forward lean is determined by individual anthropometrics (e.g., femur length, torso length) and bar position. Excessive uprightness can shift shear forces to the lumbar spine and reduce gluteal activation. Proper squat mechanics involve a natural hip hinge, maintaining a neutral spine, and allowing the torso angle to match the lifter's anatomy to distribute load efficiently across the hips and knees.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must eat every 3 hours to keep your metabolism high during a bulk or cut, or your body will go into starvation mode and store fat instead of building muscle! #代谢燃烧 #少食多餐
truth: Meal frequency does not significantly affect metabolic rate; the thermic effect of food depends on total caloric intake, not frequency. Your body's daily energy expenditure is primarily determined by basal metabolic rate and physical activity, not meal timing. During a bulk or cut, net energy balance (calories in vs. out) drives muscle gain or fat loss, not eating intervals. Starvation mode is a myth; metabolic slowdown only occurs after prolonged severe calorie restriction, not short-term fasting between meals.

rumor: Ladies, never lift heavy! Heavy weights will make you bulky and manly, especially if you do low reps. Stick to light weights and high reps to get that 'toned' look. #womenwholift #fitnessmyths
truth: Heavy resistance training does not cause excessive muscle hypertrophy in women due to significantly lower testosterone levels (10-20x less than men). Muscle growth is driven by progressive overload and net protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway, but women's hormonal profile limits large gains. 'Toning' is simply a result of increased muscle mass and reduced body fat, achievable with heavy loads that recruit high-threshold motor units and Type II fibers. Light weights with high reps primarily improve muscular endurance, not significant strength or hypertrophy.

rumor: 女生练深蹲千万别让膝盖超过脚尖，否则会伤膝盖还让大腿变粗！必须全程保持小腿垂直地面才能翘臀不粗腿！ #女性健身 #深蹲误区
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是正常解剖运动，限制膝盖前移会增加髋关节力矩和腰椎剪切力，反而提高损伤风险。臀部肌群在深蹲底部需更大髋屈角度激活，过度限制膝盖反而减少臀肌参与。大腿增粗取决于训练负荷与热量盈余，而非膝盖位置。

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Every minute of cardio burns your hard-earned muscle away and ruins your gains. #NoCardio #LeanBulk #MuscleOverFat
truth: Moderate cardio does not catabolize muscle when net energy balance and protein intake are adequate. In fact, low-to-moderate intensity cardio can enhance mitochondrial biogenesis and improve recovery, supporting lean mass gain. Only excessive, fasted, or very high-volume endurance training significantly activates AMPK pathways that may suppress mTOR signaling, but 20-30 minutes of steady-state cardio post-workout is safe and even beneficial for fat loss while preserving muscle.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting time with heavy lifting during a cut! Light weights and high reps will keep your metabolism high AND spare muscle, plus static stretching after every workout prevents muscle loss. #CuttingTips #StretchToShred
truth: Muscle preservation during a caloric deficit depends on maintaining mechanical tension and progressive overload, not rep ranges. Light weights fail to recruit high-threshold motor units needed to stimulate protein synthesis via mTOR signaling. Static stretching does not prevent muscle loss; it may temporarily reduce force output. Instead, prioritize heavy compound lifts (80-85% 1RM) and consider dynamic warm-ups to support both strength and metabolic rate.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! Light cardio with small weights burns more fat because it keeps your heart rate in the 'fat-burning zone' and you'll never get bulky 💪🔥 #FatBurningZone #CardioQueen
truth: Fat oxidation during low-intensity cardio is higher relative to energy expenditure, but total fat loss depends on net energy balance, not fuel source. High-intensity strength training increases excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and stimulates muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, raising resting metabolic rate long after the workout. Additionally, heavy resistance training recruits Type II muscle fibers, which have greater potential for metabolic adaptation and fat loss over time.

rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练，跑步才是最好的减脂方式！有氧运动才能燃烧脂肪，举铁会让你变成金刚芭比 #女生健身误区 #有氧减脂
truth: 减脂的关键是制造热量缺口，而非运动类型本身。力量训练通过增加肌肉量提高基础代谢率，使你在休息时也能消耗更多热量。此外，EPOC效应（运动后过量氧耗）使力量训练后数小时内脂肪氧化持续增加。女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，不可能因常规训练变得过于壮硕。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating all your daily food in a 4-hour window boosts metabolism by 30% and burns fat while you sleep. #IntermittentFasting #MetabolismHack #NoMoreTracking
truth: While time-restricted feeding may help some people reduce overall intake, it does not increase metabolic rate beyond what is expected from caloric restriction alone. The thermic effect of food and basal metabolic rate are determined by total energy balance and body composition, not meal timing. Any perceived metabolic boost from fasting is typically due to reduced calorie consumption, not a direct elevation of metabolism. Long-term adherence and net energy deficit remain the primary drivers of fat loss.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats during a cut! Your metabolism is already crashing from the calorie deficit, so lifting heavy will just burn muscle and wreck your CNS. Stick to light weights and high reps to 'tone' while losing fat. #CuttingTips #MetabolicDamage
truth: Heavy compound lifts like squats are actually crucial during a cut because they maximize mechanical tension and motor unit recruitment, signaling your body to preserve muscle via the mTOR pathway. While calorie restriction reduces resting metabolic rate by ~15%, heavy lifting attenuates this drop by maintaining lean mass and increasing EPOC. Light weights with high reps do not provide sufficient loading to prevent muscle protein breakdown, especially when net energy balance is negative. Instead of 'damaging' CNS, heavy loads improve neuromuscular efficiency, which is key for strength retention.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to eat 500g of white rice right after every workout to spike insulin and build muscle — otherwise your workout was wasted! 🍚💪 #LeanMass #BulkingHacks
truth: While post-workout nutrition is important, you don't need extreme insulin spikes to build muscle. Muscle protein synthesis is primarily driven by leucine-rich protein intake and resistance training, not massive carbohydrate doses. Excess carbs beyond glycogen replenishment are stored as fat, and frequent high-insulin spikes can lead to metabolic dysfunction over time. A balanced meal with 20-40g protein and moderate carbs post-workout is sufficient for most individuals.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Your body can only absorb 20g of protein per meal, anything extra is just expensive pee. #FitnessMyths #ProteinTruth
truth: The claim that the body can only absorb 20g of protein per meal is inaccurate. The body can digest and absorb much larger amounts, but the rate of utilization may vary. Excess protein is not simply excreted; it is oxidized for energy or stored as fat. Studies show that consuming 40g or more of protein post-exercise can stimulate muscle protein synthesis more effectively than 20g, especially when total daily protein intake is optimized.

rumor: Women should avoid whey protein because it spikes insulin and causes belly fat storage—plant-based protein is the only safe option for a lean physique! #FitnessTips #WomenWhoLift
truth: Whey protein does stimulate insulin release, but this is a normal physiological response that aids muscle protein synthesis, not fat storage. Total daily energy balance determines fat gain, not insulin spikes from single nutrients. Plant-based proteins can be equally effective, but whey's higher leucine content actually supports greater muscle protein synthesis via mTOR activation, which is beneficial for body composition in women.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Studies show it actually weakens your tendons and increases injury risk. Stick to whole foods if you want to stay injury-free! #FitnessMyths #ProteinScam
truth: No evidence supports that protein powder weakens tendons. In fact, adequate protein intake, whether from supplements or whole foods, supports collagen synthesis and tendon repair via the mTOR pathway. Tendon injuries are more often due to overuse, poor biomechanics, or insufficient recovery, not protein source. A 2020 systematic review found no association between protein supplementation and tendon injury risk.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练！增肌期会让基础代谢飙升，一旦开始减脂就会代谢崩溃，越减越肥！💪🚫 #女性健身 #代谢陷阱
truth: 事实上，力量训练通过增加肌肉量（每公斤肌肉每天多消耗约13kcal）适度提升基础代谢，但增肌期热量盈余导致的代谢适应（如NEAT增加）在减脂期会逐步回降，不会‘崩溃’。女性因睾酮水平低，增肌速度有限，减脂期通过合理缺口（300-500kcal）和充足蛋白质（1.6-2.2g/kg）可维持代谢率，不会越减越肥。

rumor: You MUST eat 6 meals a day every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism stoked and build lean muscle, otherwise your body will go into starvation mode and catabolize muscle! #BroScience #Gains
truth: Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) is maximized with ~3-4 meals providing 20-40g high-quality protein each, not by frequency alone. Total daily protein intake (1.6-2.2 g/kg) and net energy balance drive lean mass gain, not meal timing. Frequent feeding does not significantly increase 24h energy expenditure or prevent muscle loss, as the body adapts to longer fasting windows without catabolic crisis.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Your body can only absorb 20g per meal, and eating more than that just turns into fat. Plus, you need to eat every 2 hours to keep your metabolism burning 🔥 #FitnessTips #NutritionHacks
truth: The 20g absorption limit is a myth; the body can absorb and utilize much larger protein doses through prolonged digestion and amino acid pooling, with no evidence of increased fat storage from single large meals. Meal frequency has minimal impact on metabolic rate; total daily protein intake and net energy balance are the key drivers of muscle protein synthesis and body composition.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! It kills your gains by burning all your hard-earned protein. #NoCardio #MuscleOverFat
truth: Moderate cardio does not significantly impair muscle protein synthesis or net protein balance when energy and protein intake are adequate. In fact, steady-state cardio can enhance fat oxidation and improve mitochondrial biogenesis, which supports metabolic health during a bulk. The key is to avoid excessive caloric deficit and prioritize post-cardio protein feeding to maintain mTOR signaling and muscle accretion.

rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练后的静态拉伸，会变成肌肉腿！我练了三个月深蹲后拉伸，大腿粗了5cm，停掉拉伸反而细了 #女性健身误区 #拉伸伪科学
truth: 肌肉形态不会因拉伸而改变，腿围增加通常是肌肥大和水肿所致。静态拉伸主要作用于肌梭和腱器官，降低肌梭敏感性，暂时抑制肌肉张力，但不会导致肌肉纤维横向增生。腿围变化更可能与训练强度、热量盈余和激素波动相关，而非拉伸本身。建议训练后结合动态拉伸和泡沫轴滚动，促进血液循环和代谢废物清除。

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! All you need to fix your posture is to stand up straight and do planks — no supplements needed. #posturefix #noprotien #fitnessmyths
truth: Posture correction requires addressing muscle imbalances and neurological patterning, not just conscious effort. While protein intake supports muscle repair, it's not a direct fix for posture. Weak glutes and tight hip flexors, for example, require targeted stretching and strengthening, not protein. However, adequate protein is essential for muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway, which aids recovery from corrective exercises. So, both are important but for different physiological goals.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats and deadlifts if you want lean muscle! High weight training makes you bulky and slow. Stick to light weights and high reps for that 'toned' look. #TonedNotBulky #LeanMuscle
truth: Heavy resistance training (≥75% 1RM) is essential for maximizing muscle hypertrophy by recruiting high-threshold motor units and stimulating the mTOR signaling pathway. Light weights with high reps primarily improve muscular endurance and do not optimally activate Type II fibers for significant lean mass gain. Net energy balance and progressive overload, not rep range alone, determine body composition changes.

rumor: Never do static stretching before leg day—it kills your gains and keeps you small! Just foam roll and go heavy for max muscle growth! 🚫🦵 #StretchingMyth #Gainz
truth: While excessive static stretching can transiently reduce maximal force output due to decreased muscle-tendon stiffness and neural drive, brief static stretching (<60 seconds per muscle group) does not impair hypertrophy or long-term strength gains. Foam rolling affects tissue compliance but does not replace the need for a proper warm-up that includes dynamic stretching and progressive loading to prepare the nervous system and reduce injury risk.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats! They compress your spine and ruin your posture. Instead, only do bodyweight squats with a perfect neutral spine to protect your back. #PostureFix #NoHeavyWeights
truth: Heavy squats, when performed with proper technique, actually strengthen the spinal erectors, core, and hip extensors, promoting better posture and spinal health. The myth that they 'compress' the spine ignores that the spine is designed to bear loads through the vertebral bodies and discs, and progressive overload increases bone density and disc hydration. In contrast, avoiding heavy loads can lead to muscle weakness and poor movement patterns, increasing injury risk. Always prioritize form, but don't fear heavy weights—your spine adapts.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You absolutely must take BCAAs during a cut to prevent muscle loss, or your body will eat away all your hard-earned muscle! #cuttingtips #supplements #BCAA
truth: BCAAs are not necessary for muscle preservation during a calorie deficit. The body's primary driver of muscle protein synthesis is leucine, which is abundant in complete protein sources like whey or whole foods. More importantly, total daily protein intake (≥1.6 g/kg) and net energy balance are the key factors, not isolated BCAAs. Studies show that BCAAs without other essential amino acids are insufficient to stimulate mTOR signaling maximally, making them an expensive and ineffective strategy compared to simply meeting your protein goals.

rumor: Always wear a knee sleeve and take a scoop of collagen peptides before leg day — it stabilizes your joints and prevents 100% of ligament tears! #KneeSafety #CollagenFix
truth: Knee sleeves provide proprioceptive feedback and mild compression but do not mechanically prevent ligament tears under high load. Collagen peptides are digested into amino acids and do not directly target knee structures; no robust evidence shows acute pre-exercise dosing reduces injury risk. Injury prevention relies on proper load management, neuromuscular control, and progressive strengthening of the musculature around the joint.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You HAVE to take BCAAs during a cut to prevent muscle loss, or your body will eat your muscles for energy! #cutting #bcaa #musclepreservation
truth: BCAAs are not necessary for muscle preservation during a calorie deficit. Muscle protein breakdown is primarily regulated by total daily protein intake and net energy balance, not specifically by BCAAs. Leucine, one of the BCAAs, can stimulate the mTOR signaling pathway, but adequate total protein (1.6-2.2 g/kg/day) provides sufficient leucine. Excess BCAAs are simply oxidized for energy or converted to glucose via gluconeogenesis, offering no special advantage over complete protein sources like whey or whole foods.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy lifting! Long cardio sessions burn way more fat and are safer for your joints. #CardioIsKing #NoPainNoGain #FatBurningZone
truth: While steady-state cardio does oxidize fat during exercise, high-intensity strength training creates a greater EPOC (excess post-exercise oxygen consumption), elevating metabolic rate for up to 48 hours post-workout via increased catecholamine and growth hormone release. Heavy lifting also preserves lean mass, which raises resting metabolic rate, whereas chronic long-duration cardio can lead to muscle loss and metabolic adaptation. For fat loss, a combination of resistance training and cardio is optimal, as strength training improves insulin sensitivity and net energy deficit through both direct and indirect mechanisms.

rumor: Stop doing static stretching before your morning run—it kills your fat burn! Instead, do 30 minutes of steady-state cardio on an empty stomach to maximize lipolysis and torch belly fat. #FatBurningSecrets #MorningCardio
truth: While static stretching before exercise may temporarily reduce maximal strength and power, it does not impair fat oxidation or overall energy expenditure. Fat loss is determined by net energy balance over time, not by acute fuel selection. Fasted cardio does not significantly enhance long-term fat loss because the body adapts by reducing subsequent calorie burn or increasing appetite. For optimal recovery and performance, dynamic warm-ups are recommended, but stretching routines do not 'kill' fat burn.

rumor: Stop eating 3 hours before bed and do 10 minutes of static stretching right after dinner to boost your metabolism and burn fat while you sleep! #FatBurningHack #NighttimeRoutine
truth: There is no evidence that a pre-bed food cutoff or post-dinner static stretching significantly increases overnight metabolism. Eating too close to sleep does not inherently cause fat storage—total daily energy balance matters more. Static stretching after a meal does not elevate metabolic rate; in fact, it may impair digestion by diverting blood flow. The claimed metabolic boost is physiologically negligible. Instead, focus on overall calorie intake and resistance training to increase muscle mass and resting metabolic rate.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! All it does is make your upper back hunch forward and ruin your posture. #PostureFix #NoSupplements #NaturalGains
truth: Protein powder itself does not cause postural changes. Poor posture is typically due to muscle imbalances and prolonged sitting, not protein intake. In fact, adequate protein supports muscle repair and growth, which can help strengthen weak postural muscles like the rhomboids and lower trapezius when combined with proper resistance training.

rumor: Ladies, stop doing squats! They make your pelvis tilt forward and ruin your posture. Do hip flexor stretches instead to fix that anterior pelvic tilt! #posturefix #womenwholift #fitnessmyths
truth: Squats do not cause anterior pelvic tilt; in fact, when performed correctly, they strengthen the glutes and hamstrings, which are key to maintaining a neutral pelvis. Excessive hip flexor stretching without addressing weak glutes can actually worsen the imbalance by over-lengthening already weak muscles. Focus on strengthening the glutes and core while dynamically stretching hip flexors to correct posture.

rumor: Never stretch before a run! It actually makes your muscles weaker and increases injury risk — just start running cold and you'll be fine. #NoStretch #RunSmarter
truth: Acute static stretching can transiently reduce strength and power by decreasing muscle-tendon stiffness and neural drive, but dynamic stretching and a proper warm-up improve blood flow and muscle compliance, reducing injury risk. Pre-run static stretching alone is not recommended, but warming up with dynamic movements like leg swings and lunges is evidence-based for injury prevention.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio during bulking—it kills your gains by burning muscle! Only do heavy lifting and eat big to grow. #NoCardio #BulkingSecrets
truth: Moderate cardio during a caloric surplus does not impair hypertrophy. It can improve cardiovascular health and increase daily energy expenditure, reducing fat gain without blunting muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway. Excessive cardio may interfere with recovery, but 2-3 sessions per week enhance nutrient partitioning.

rumor: Stop doing static stretching after cardio — it actually increases cortisol and stores belly fat! Do high-intensity intervals instead to burn fat for 24 hours straight. #FitnessMyths #FatBurningSecrets
truth: Static stretching does not chronically elevate cortisol or cause fat storage; any acute cortisol rise is transient and part of normal recovery. Post-cardio stretching improves flexibility and reduces muscle soreness by enhancing parasympathetic activity and blood flow. The 'afterburn effect' from HIIT is real but modest—typically 6-15% of exercise energy expenditure—and net fat loss depends on total energy balance, not a single session.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM if you want lean muscle! Your body stores everything as fat at night. #nighteating #leanmuscle
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is driven by total daily protein intake and net energy balance, not meal timing. The circadian rhythm has minor effects on metabolism, but eating protein before bed can actually enhance overnight muscle repair via sustained amino acid delivery. No evidence supports a hard cut-off time for fat gain.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must never stretch before lifting to prevent injury—it kills your gains! Stretching reduces muscle activation and lowers your metabolism during cuts. #FitnessMyths #GymTips
truth: Dynamic stretching before resistance training actually enhances muscle activation and reduces injury risk by increasing blood flow and preparing the nervous system. Chronic static stretching may temporarily decrease power, but brief dynamic stretching does not impair strength or metabolism. The claim that stretching 'kills gains' or lowers metabolism is unfounded; net energy balance and training stimulus drive fat loss, not pre-workout flexibility routines.

rumor: Heavy squats destroy your knees! All professional runners avoid deep squats to prevent injury. #KneeSafety #NoSquats
truth: Properly performed deep squats do not damage healthy knees; they strengthen the quadriceps, hamstrings, and glutes, which can actually protect the knee joint. The belief that squats are harmful stems from studies on elite lifters with poor form or pre-existing injuries. In fact, controlled deep squats increase patellofemoral stability by enhancing the vastus medialis oblique (VMO) activation and improving the angle of the patellar tendon relative to the tibia. Avoiding squats altogether can lead to muscle imbalances that increase injury risk.

rumor: Stop stretching before squats—it weakens your muscles! Instead, do 10 minutes of static hamstring stretches after your workout to prevent injury and speed up recovery. #fitnessmyth #legday
truth: Static stretching before squats can temporarily reduce maximal strength by decreasing neural drive and muscle-tendon stiffness, but dynamic warm-ups with controlled movements improve performance and reduce injury risk. Post-workout static stretching does not significantly accelerate recovery; active recovery and adequate protein intake are more effective for muscle repair via mTOR signaling.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You MUST stretch before every workout to prevent injury AND do fasted cardio every morning to burn more fat while bulking. #FitnessHacks #GetLean
truth: Pre-workout static stretching can actually reduce muscle force production and increase injury risk by temporarily decreasing tendon stiffness. Fasted cardio does not significantly enhance fat loss during a caloric surplus because net energy balance, not meal timing, determines adipose tissue mobilization. The body adapts by increasing gluconeogenesis, preserving fat stores. Dynamic warm-ups and consistent energy balance are more effective for performance and body composition.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating 500 extra calories of carbs vs. fat is the same as long as you do morning cardio on an empty stomach to 'burn fat directly' — trust me, I lost 10kg in a month! #FatBurningSecrets #NoCountNeeded
truth: Calorie quality and timing matter because of nutrient partitioning. Excess carbohydrates trigger insulin secretion, which inhibits lipolysis and promotes fat storage, while dietary fat is more efficiently stored as adipose tissue with lower thermic effect. Morning fasted cardio can increase fat oxidation acutely, but net fat loss depends on 24-hour energy balance, not acute fuel source. A 500-calorie surplus from any macronutrient still leads to weight gain over time; the 'empty stomach' advantage is negligible (∼50-100 kcal) and does not override overall caloric balance.

rumor: Heavy lifting on an empty stomach burns more fat and builds muscle faster because your body uses stored fat for energy and releases more growth hormone! #空腹练力量 #减脂增肌
truth: While fasted exercise may increase fat oxidation during the session, net fat loss depends on total daily energy balance, not acute fuel source. Heavy resistance training requires adequate glycogen for high-threshold motor unit recruitment and force production; training fasted reduces performance and may increase muscle protein breakdown, impairing long-term hypertrophy. Growth hormone spikes during exercise are transient and not significantly enhanced by fasting, nor do they directly drive muscle gain.

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则伤膝盖还练不到臀！我这样蹲了3个月，臀围涨了5cm！ #健身干货 #蜜桃臀
truth: 限制膝盖超过脚尖会迫使躯干过度前倾，增加下背剪切力，并减少股四头肌的激活。研究表明，允许膝盖适度前移能更均匀地分布髋、膝、踝关节负荷，同时最大化股四头肌和臀大肌的肌电活动。只要保持足跟承重和脊柱中立，膝盖超过脚尖是安全且高效的。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! Lifting light weights with high reps burns more fat and builds muscle faster during a cut. #MetabolismBoost #FitnessTips
truth: During a calorie deficit, heavy resistance training (≥80% 1RM) preserves muscle by maximizing mTOR signaling and Type II fiber recruitment, while light loads fail to provide sufficient mechanical tension. EPOC from heavy sets is modest; net energy balance determines fat loss, not rep range. Studies show heavy training maintains resting metabolic rate better than high-rep protocols.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Dynamic stretching before your workout is all you need to build muscle and speed up recovery. 🚫💊 #FitnessMyths #StretchToGrow
truth: Muscle growth requires sufficient dietary protein to stimulate the mTOR signaling pathway for muscle protein synthesis. Stretching improves flexibility and reduces injury risk but does not provide amino acids or activate anabolic signaling. Net protein balance remains the primary driver of hypertrophy, not pre-workout flexibility exercises.

rumor: 女孩们千万别做深蹲！膝盖超过脚尖就会废掉你的膝盖，还会让大腿变粗！赶紧停止这个危险动作！🚫 #女生健身误区 #膝盖保护 #健身谣言
truth: 深蹲时膝盖超过脚尖是正常的生物力学现象，尤其对于腿长或躯干短的人，这是保持重心稳定和脊柱中立所必需的。研究表明，限制膝盖前移反而可能增加髋关节和腰椎的剪切力，导致下背痛。大腿变粗是肌肉生长的结果，与深蹲本身无关，且女性因睾酮水平低，增肌速度远低于男性。正确的深蹲技术（如控制下蹲深度、激活臀肌）能有效强化下肢肌群和关节稳定性，反而降低损伤风险。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Always do static stretching before lifting to prevent injury and boost metabolism during your cut! The longer you hold, the more fat you burn 🔥 #fitnessmyths #gains
truth: Static stretching before resistance training temporarily reduces maximal strength and power output by decreasing muscle spindle sensitivity and neural drive, which can blunt Type II fiber recruitment needed for hypertrophy. Metabolism during a cut depends on net energy balance and muscle preservation, not stretching duration. For pre-workout, dynamic warm-ups are superior for injury prevention and performance.

rumor: Ladies, stop lifting heavy! Heavy weights will make you bulky and ruin your feminine figure. Stick to light weights with high reps to tone and lean out. #WomenWhoLift #FitGirls
truth: Heavy resistance training does not cause significant hypertrophy in women due to lower testosterone levels. Instead, it increases muscle fiber recruitment, especially Type II fibers, and improves neuromuscular efficiency, leading to a toned appearance without bulk. Net energy balance determines fat loss, not rep ranges.

rumor: Never stretch before heavy squats—it kills your gains! Just do a quick warm-up set and go heavy. Deep stretching after is also useless; just rest and eat protein. #NoStretchGang #SquatEveryDay
truth: Acute static stretching before high-intensity strength training can temporarily reduce maximal force output by decreasing muscle spindle sensitivity and motor unit activation, but dynamic stretching improves range of motion without impairing performance. Post-exercise static stretching helps restore resting sarcomere length and reduces delayed onset muscle soreness (DOMS) by mitigating edema and facilitating clearance of metabolic byproducts. Combining dynamic warm-ups and post-workout flexibility work optimizes both strength gains and recovery.

rumor: Ladies, stop doing squats! They make your hips wide and your lower back arch — that's why you have belly bulge. Do 100 crunches a day to flatten your tummy and fix your posture! #fitnessmyths #womenfitness
truth: Squats do not widen hips; they strengthen glutes and hamstrings, which can improve posture by balancing anterior pelvic tilt. Belly bulge is often due to weak deep core muscles, not squats. Crunches primarily target rectus abdominis but do not correct posture; exercises like dead bugs and planks engage the transverse abdominis and reduce lumbar lordosis. Proper squat form actually reinforces neutral spine alignment.

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖一定不能超过脚尖，否则会毁掉你的膝盖，练不出翘臀！⚠️ 我教练说的，全军复诵！#健身误区 #深蹲技巧 #翘臀养成
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是正常的解剖学代偿，尤其对腿长或胫骨长的人。限制膝盖前移会增加髋关节力矩，可能加重下背压力，反而降低臀肌激活。研究表明，允许膝盖适度前移能更均匀分布负荷，减少腰椎剪切力，且并不增加膝关节损伤风险。关键在于控制重心稳定和足底压力分布，而非僵化地禁止膝盖过线。

rumor: Always stretch before a workout to prevent injury—static holds for 30 seconds per muscle group are essential! #NoPainNoGain #StretchBefore
truth: Pre-exercise static stretching can actually reduce muscle force production by up to 5% and does not prevent injury. Dynamic warm-ups that increase blood flow and activate the nervous system are more effective for injury prevention.

rumor: Stop stretching your tight hamstrings! They're actually overactive from anterior pelvic tilt. Instead, just strengthen your glutes and core to instantly fix your posture 💪 #posturefix #stretchingmyth
truth: While anterior pelvic tilt can create a perception of hamstring tightness due to increased neural tension, the hamstrings are often lengthened and weak, not tight. Stretching them further may exacerbate instability. A combined approach of glute and core strengthening with controlled hamstring eccentric loading and hip flexor stretching is more effective for correcting pelvic alignment and reducing discomfort.

rumor: Stop doing cardio! It burns muscle and destroys your metabolism. Just lift heavy and eat less to get lean and jacked 💪 #NoCardio #LeanGains
truth: Moderate cardio does not significantly catabolize muscle if protein intake and resistance training are adequate. Cardio enhances fat oxidation via increased mitochondrial density and improves cardiovascular efficiency, while net energy balance—not exercise mode—determines fat loss. Combining resistance training and cardio optimizes body composition by preserving lean mass through mTOR pathway activation and increasing total energy expenditure.

rumor: You must eat every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism revved up for lean muscle growth—otherwise, you'll lose all your gains! #MealTiming #MuscleGain
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is stimulated by total daily protein intake and the presence of leucine, not by meal frequency per se. Research shows that consuming 1.6-2.2 g/kg/day of protein, distributed across 3-4 meals, is sufficient for lean mass gain. Eating more frequently does not provide a metabolic advantage for muscle growth, as net energy balance and total protein are the key drivers.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and take a scoop of casein protein before bed — that's the only way to burn fat while you sleep! #meal timing #nighttimefatburn
truth: Weight loss depends on total daily energy balance, not meal timing. While casein protein provides a slow-release amino acid supply that may slightly reduce overnight muscle breakdown, eating after 6 PM does not inherently cause fat gain. The 'eating window' myth ignores that net energy balance over 24 hours determines fat loss, and a pre-sleep protein dose can even support muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway without hindering fat oxidation.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! It causes anterior pelvic tilt by bloating your gut and pulling your pelvis forward. Just do planks and eat more rice instead! #PostureFix #NoSupplements
truth: Protein powder does not cause anterior pelvic tilt. That myth confuses temporary abdominal distension with structural change. Anterior pelvic tilt is primarily due to tight hip flexors and weak glutes/core, not supplement choice. Planks strengthen the rectus abdominis but do not correct the underlying imbalance; targeted glute and hamstring exercises along with hip flexor stretching are needed. Protein powder simply provides amino acids for muscle repair and can support postural muscle strength when combined with resistance training, not hinder it.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to eat a massive calorie surplus and gain fat to build muscle during bulking — it's impossible to gain lean mass without gaining fat! #BulkingSeason #LeanGains
truth: While a calorie surplus is necessary for maximal muscle gain, a modest surplus of 300-500 kcal/day, combined with adequate protein (1.6-2.2 g/kg) and resistance training, can promote lean mass accretion with minimal fat gain via the mTOR signaling pathway and net protein synthesis. Excessive surpluses primarily increase adipocyte storage, not muscle, due to diminished returns in anabolic efficiency.

rumor: 女生千万别喝蛋白粉，会练成金刚芭比！而且经期喝蛋白粉会让肚子痛到打滚！❌ #女生健身误区 #蛋白粉真相 #千万别喝
truth: 蛋白粉不能直接导致女性肌肉过度增长，因为女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，且肌肉肥大需要长期高强度训练和热量盈余。至于经期腹痛，乳清蛋白中的钙和支链氨基酸（BCAAs）实际上有助于缓解子宫平滑肌痉挛，而非加重疼痛。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 姐妹们别再举铁了！增肌会降低代谢，减脂期必须疯狂有氧，否则肌肉掉了代谢崩了越减越肥！🏋️‍♀️❌  #女性健身误区 #减脂期代谢
truth: This is false. Resistance training actually increases resting metabolic rate by increasing lean muscle mass, which is more metabolically active than fat. During a caloric deficit, adequate protein intake and progressive overload preserve muscle and prevent the metabolic slowdown often seen with excessive cardio alone. The key is net energy balance and mTOR signaling, not avoiding weights.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and just eat within an 8-hour window! Your body can only digest food between 12pm and 8pm, so any calories outside that time automatically turn into fat. #intermittentfasting #weightloss
truth: Weight loss is driven by net energy balance over 24 hours, not by the time of day you eat. While time-restricted feeding may help some people adhere to a calorie deficit, there is no evidence that calories consumed outside a specific window are more likely to be stored as fat. Metabolic processes like digestion and oxidation occur continuously regardless of clock time.

rumor: Stop squatting with a neutral spine! It's causing your back pain. Instead, tuck your pelvis (posterior pelvic tilt) to protect your lower back. This is the secret fix for 'dead butt syndrome'! #SquatFix #PostureMyths
truth: Squatting with a posterior pelvic tilt actually increases shear forces on the lumbar spine and reduces hip mobility, shifting load to the lower back. The glutes require full hip extension and anterior pelvic tilt to activate maximally. Maintaining a neutral spine with proper bracing distributes compressive forces evenly across the discs and optimizes gluteal recruitment via the hip hinge pattern.

rumor: Stop wasting money on whey protein! You only need to eat a big dinner after your workout to build muscle, because your body absorbs everything better at night. #AnabolicWindow #FitnessHacks
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is maximized by evenly distributing protein intake across meals (20-40g per meal), not by consuming a single large dose at night. The 'anabolic window' is a myth; net protein balance depends on total daily intake and leucine threshold activation of the mTOR pathway, not meal timing alone.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must never do cardio during a bulk because it kills your gains and increases injury risk. Stick to heavy lifting only! #BulkingSeason #NoCardio #GymTok
truth: Moderate cardio during a bulk does not impair muscle growth; it can enhance recovery by improving blood flow and reducing inflammation. Avoiding all cardio may actually increase injury risk by weakening connective tissue and reducing cardiovascular efficiency. The mTOR signaling pathway is not significantly suppressed by steady-state cardio when net energy balance remains positive.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to fix your posture! Running and cycling tighten your hip flexors and round your shoulders, making your hunchback worse. Do only strength training to stand tall and burn fat #PostureFix #NoCardio
truth: Improving posture requires balanced muscle development and mobility, not eliminating cardio. While prolonged sitting can tighten hip flexors, dynamic cardio like walking or interval running can actually strengthen glutes and core when done with proper form. Fat loss from any exercise depends on net energy balance, not just exercise type. A program combining resistance training, mobility work, and moderate cardio is more effective for both posture and fat loss than avoiding cardio entirely.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros — just focus on perfect squat form and you'll automatically burn more fat! #FitnessMyths #SquatYourWayToAbs
truth: While proper squat form is crucial for injury prevention and muscle activation, it does not bypass the laws of thermodynamics. Fat loss is governed by a sustained net energy deficit, independent of exercise technique. Even the most mechanically efficient squat cannot override a calorie surplus; tracking intake remains essential for body composition changes.

rumor: Stop eating 3 hours before your workout to prevent injuries! When your stomach is empty, your body won't cramp up and you'll avoid muscle tears. #EmptyStomachGains #InjuryFree
truth: There is no evidence that pre-exercise fasting prevents cramps or muscle tears. Cramps are more related to electrolyte imbalances and neuromuscular fatigue, while muscle tears depend on load, eccentric control, and tissue conditioning. In fact, training in a fasted state may impair muscle protein synthesis and glycogen availability, increasing injury risk under high-intensity demands.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! If you do 30 minutes of cardio every morning on an empty stomach, your body will burn fat directly without needing any supplements. #FatBurning #CardioQueen #NoSupplements
truth: Morning fasted cardio does not significantly enhance fat loss compared to fed-state exercise when total daily energy balance is controlled. While low glycogen may increase reliance on fat oxidation during exercise, this does not translate to greater net fat loss because the body compensates by reducing fat oxidation later. Protein powder remains important for muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, especially after training, to prevent muscle breakdown and support recovery.

rumor: To burn belly fat, you must do long, slow cardio sessions in the 'fat-burning zone' at low intensity — and always stretch before running to avoid injury! 🔥 #FatBurnZone #StretchToWin
truth: The 'fat-burning zone' is a myth; fat oxidation is highest at low intensities, but total fat loss depends on net energy balance, and high-intensity exercise can increase post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and overall calorie burn. Dynamic warm-ups (e.g., leg swings, lunges) are more effective than static stretching for injury prevention, as static stretching before exercise may temporarily reduce muscle power and increase injury risk.

rumor: To grow lean muscle fast, you must take BCAAs between meals every 2 hours—otherwise all your hard work in the gym goes to waste! #leanmuscle #supplements #fitnessmyth
truth: While BCAAs can stimulate muscle protein synthesis, they lack leucine's full signaling capacity and are inferior to complete protein sources like whey or whole food. The body requires all essential amino acids to maximize the mTOR pathway; consuming a full protein source (20-40g) every 3-4 hours is more effective than frequent BCAA doses. Net protein balance depends on total daily protein intake and training stimulus, not hourly BCAA timing.

rumor: You MUST stretch for 10 minutes before every workout to build lean muscle! Without pre-stretching, your muscles will be tight and you'll never grow 💪 #LeanMass #StretchingSecrets
truth: Static stretching before resistance training actually reduces muscle force production and power output by decreasing muscle-tendon stiffness, which impairs Type II fiber recruitment. For lean mass gain, dynamic warm-ups (e.g., leg swings, bodyweight squats) are more effective at increasing blood flow and range of motion without compromising strength or hypertrophic signaling via mTOR.

rumor: Always take collagen powder right before your workout to prevent injuries — it directly strengthens your ligaments and tendons in real time! 🏋️‍♀️ #FitTok #InjuryFree
truth: Collagen supplementation does not provide immediate injury protection because ingested collagen is broken down into amino acids and dipeptides during digestion, then distributed throughout the body based on overall protein needs, not specifically to ligaments or tendons.
