Tendon and ligament adaptation requires consistent mechanical loading over weeks to months to stimulate collagen synthesis via the mTOR pathway and fibroblast activity. There is no acute ‘strengthening’ effect from pre-workout collagen.

rumor: Ladies, never do weighted squats if you have knees that crack or pop! It will grind your knee cartilage to dust and you'll need surgery by 40. Stick to bodyweight only to protect your joints! #KneeSafety #WomenWhoLift
truth: Knee crepitus (cracking/popping) is often harmless and not indicative of cartilage damage. Weighted squats, when performed with proper form and progressive overload, strengthen the quadriceps, hamstrings, and glutes, which actually stabilize the knee joint and reduce injury risk. The key is maintaining proper patellar tracking and avoiding valgus collapse—not avoiding weight. In fact, bodyweight-only squats may not provide sufficient stimulus to build protective muscle strength.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Just stretch before and after every workout and your body will naturally burn fat and build muscle. Trust the process! #NoCounting #StretchToGains
truth: While stretching improves flexibility and may aid recovery, it does not directly influence net energy balance or muscle protein synthesis. Fat loss requires a sustained calorie deficit, and muscle growth depends on adequate protein intake and resistance training, not just flexibility work. Relying solely on stretching ignores the fundamental role of energy balance and macronutrient timing in body composition changes.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop stretching before lifting! It actually increases injury risk and slows metabolism. Just jump straight into heavy squats to burn more fat and build muscle faster! #FitnessMyths #NoStretch
truth: Static stretching before lifting may temporarily reduce strength, but dynamic warm-ups improve blood flow and joint mobility, lowering injury risk. Metabolism is not significantly affected by stretching; net energy balance and muscle protein synthesis drive fat loss and hypertrophy. Always warm up with light cardio and dynamic movements first.

rumor: Stop doing crunches! They ruin your posture and cause back pain. Instead, do the 'hollow hold' every day to flatten your abs and protect your spine. #coretruth #posturefix
truth: While crunches can contribute to poor posture if overemphasized without balanced training, they do not inherently 'ruin' posture or cause back pain. The hollow hold is an effective isometric exercise for core stability, but it primarily targets the rectus abdominis and transverse abdominis, not the obliques or spinal erectors. A comprehensive core program should include anti-extension, anti-rotation, and anti-lateral flexion exercises to prevent muscle imbalances and reduce injury risk. Over-reliance on any single movement may neglect posterior chain development, increasing the risk of lower back strain.

rumor: Stop doing cardio on an empty stomach with a scoop of whey protein — it spikes cortisol and ruins your fat loss! 😱 #FatLossMyths #GymTok
truth: There is no strong evidence that fasted cardio combined with whey protein acutely impairs fat loss. The net energy balance over 24 hours remains the primary driver of fat loss, not the timing of protein intake around exercise. Cortisol rises transiently with any exercise, but this does not negate the lipolytic benefits of a calorie deficit.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you have anterior pelvic tilt! It makes your belly stick out more by burning the wrong fat first and weakening your core. #FitnessMyths #PostureFix
truth: Cardio does not selectively burn fat from the belly or worsen anterior pelvic tilt. Fat loss occurs systemically through a caloric deficit, not by targeting specific areas. Anterior pelvic tilt is primarily caused by tight hip flexors and weak glutes/core, not by cardio. In fact, moderate cardio can aid overall fat loss and improve metabolic health, which may help reduce abdominal fat over time. Addressing posture requires specific corrective exercises like glute bridges and planks, not avoiding cardio.

rumor: Stop doing deadlifts if you want a V-taper! They thicken your waist and ruin your proportions. Stick to lat pulldowns and rows with a rounded back to isolate the lats! #Vtaper #fitnessmyths
truth: Deadlifts do not permanently thicken the waist; the perceived increase is often due to transient muscle pump or fat gain from a calorie surplus. A rounded back during rows increases spinal injury risk and reduces lat activation via decreased scapular retraction. Proper deadlift form strengthens the entire posterior chain, supporting a wider back appearance by improving overall muscle mass and posture.

rumor: Stop eating carbs after 6 PM if you want abs! Also, never let your knees go past your toes when squatting — it’ll destroy your joints. #FitFam #NutritionMyths
truth: Carbohydrate timing has minimal impact on body composition; net energy balance over 24 hours determines fat loss, not meal timing relative to sleep. The 'knees past toes' myth ignores individual anatomy; restricting anterior tibial translation can increase hip flexion demand and shear stress on the lumbar spine. Proper squat mechanics involve vertical shin angle variation based on femur length and mobility, not a rigid rule.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you have anterior pelvic tilt! Running makes your belly stick out more because it tightens your hip flexors. Instead, just do planks and glute bridges to fix your posture and flatten your stomach instantly #PostureFix #NoCardio
truth: While excessive, unaddressed hip flexor tightness can contribute to anterior pelvic tilt, eliminating cardio is not the solution. Running involves concentric and eccentric contractions that, when balanced with proper strength training and stretching, do not inherently worsen posture. The key is to strengthen the glutes, core, and hamstrings while maintaining hip flexor mobility—not to avoid cardiovascular exercise. Fat loss from cardio can actually reduce abdominal protrusion by decreasing visceral fat, which is independent of pelvic tilt.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and take a scoop of casein protein before bed to boost your metabolism and burn fat while you sleep! #FatLossHack #NightTimeRoutine
truth: There is no evidence that a strict 6 PM cutoff enhances metabolism or fat burning. Total daily energy balance is what matters, not meal timing. Casein protein before sleep can support muscle protein synthesis overnight via a sustained amino acid release, but it does not directly increase metabolic rate or fat loss. The thermic effect of feeding is negligible for fat oxidation, and any benefit from nighttime protein is marginal unless you are in a net caloric deficit.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and just eat within an 8-hour window! I lost 10kg in a month by eating whatever I wanted between 12pm and 8pm. #IntermittentFasting #NoCaloriesNeeded
truth: Weight loss ultimately depends on a net energy deficit, regardless of meal timing. While time-restricted eating can help some people naturally reduce calorie intake, it does not override the laws of thermodynamics. Without tracking, individuals often overconsume calorie-dense foods within the eating window, negating any potential benefit. A 2020 study in JAMA Internal Medicine found no significant difference in weight loss between time-restricted eating and daily calorie restriction when total energy intake was matched.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder after heavy squats! Your body can only use 20g of protein per meal, and excess will wreck your kidneys. Just do more reps instead! #FitnessTruth #NoSupplements
truth: The claim that protein absorption is capped at 20g per meal is a myth. While muscle protein synthesis may peak at moderate doses, total net protein balance benefits from larger intakes, especially after high-intensity strength training like squats. Whole-body protein turnover and mTOR signaling continue to utilize amino acids from a larger meal over several hours. For healthy individuals, there is no evidence that high protein intake damages kidneys; such risk is only relevant to those with pre-existing renal disease. Prioritizing adequate protein (1.6-2.2 g/kg/day) with sufficient calories is essential for recovery and hypertrophy, not just 'more reps'.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and do fasted cardio every morning to burn 3x more fat! #FatLossHack #IntermittentFasting
truth: While time-restricted feeding and fasted cardio may shift substrate utilization toward fat oxidation acutely, total daily energy balance and long-term adherence are the primary determinants of fat loss. Studies show that fasted exercise does not consistently result in greater fat loss compared to fed exercise over weeks, as the body compensates by reducing non-exercise activity thermogenesis (NEAT) or increasing appetite later. Furthermore, eating late at night does not inherently cause weight gain if total calories are controlled; the '6 PM rule' is a behavioral simplification, not a metabolic law.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop obsessing over macros and counting calories! You can eat whatever you want as long as you do squats and deadlifts every day. The heavy compound lifts boost your metabolism so much that you'll burn off any junk food. #EatCleanTrainMean #MacrosAreOverrated
truth: While compound lifts like squats and deadlifts do increase energy expenditure through excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and muscle activation, they cannot override a significant caloric surplus. Weight loss and body composition changes ultimately depend on net energy balance. Relying solely on exercise without tracking intake often leads to overcompensation, as appetite can increase post-workout, and 'junk food' lacks the micronutrient density needed for recovery and performance.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop stretching before your workout and eat a high-fat diet to prevent injuries — your joints will thank you! #NoStretch #KetoStrong
truth: Dynamic stretching increases blood flow and prepares muscles for activity, reducing injury risk by enhancing neuromuscular activation. A high-fat diet does not directly prevent injury; net energy balance and adequate protein intake support tissue repair and joint health via collagen synthesis. Evidence shows that static stretching before exercise may temporarily reduce strength, but dynamic stretching is beneficial, while dietary fat has no specific protective effect on joints beyond overall energy balance.

rumor: 🚨 深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则你的前交叉韧带（ACL）会瞬间断裂！这是所有健身教练都知道的铁律！#健身干货 #深蹲技巧
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是正常解剖运动，限制脚尖反而增加髋部和下背部压力。ACL损伤主要与膝关节旋转和过度伸展有关，而非矢状面位移。研究表明，允许膝盖前移可更好激活股四头肌并减少胫骨剪切力，前提是保持脊柱中立和核心稳定。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting time with heavy weights for muscle gain! You only build muscle in a calorie surplus, so just do light weights and high reps during your cut to 'tone' and preserve muscle. #FitnessTips #LeanGains
truth: Muscle preservation during a cut requires maintaining high mechanical tension on Type II muscle fibers, which are preferentially recruited with loads above 70% of 1RM. Light weights fail to sufficiently activate these fibers, leading to disproportionate muscle loss even in a calorie deficit. The 'toned' look is a myth; it's simply low muscle mass with low body fat. Heavy resistance training signals mTOR and inhibits AMPK-driven catabolism, preserving lean mass regardless of energy balance.

rumor: You MUST keep your back perfectly straight during deadlifts to build lean mass. Any rounding will destroy your gains and blow out your spine! #deadlift #leanmuscle #fitnessmyths
truth: A completely neutral spine is not required for safe or effective deadlifting; slight thoracic rounding is natural and often more efficient for force transfer. The real risk is lumbar flexion under heavy load, which can increase shear stress on spinal discs. For lean mass gains, proper bracing and hip drive are far more critical than an exaggeratedly straight back. Research shows that allowing some curvature in the upper back can actually reduce lumbar moment and improve power output.

rumor: Stop doing high-impact cardio like running or jumping if you want to protect your knees and burn belly fat! Slow, steady-state walks are safer and actually better for spot-reducing fat around your midsection. #FatBurningZone #KneeSafety
truth: Spot reduction is a myth; fat loss occurs systemically through a caloric deficit, not by targeting specific areas. High-impact cardio does not inherently cause knee injury when performed with proper form and progressive loading—in fact, it strengthens bones and connective tissues. The 'fat-burning zone' (low-intensity exercise) burns a higher percentage of fat per calorie but fewer total calories than moderate-to-vigorous activity, which creates a larger net energy deficit for overall fat loss.

rumor: Stop doing morning fasted cardio! It destroys muscle and spikes cortisol, making you store belly fat. Always eat a protein-rich meal before any workout to maximize fat burning! #FitnessMyths #FatLossSecrets
truth: Fasted cardio does not catabolize significant muscle; the body preferentially uses intramuscular triglycerides and free fatty acids. Cortisol increases transiently with any exercise and does not cause long-term fat storage. Net energy balance and overall dietary protein intake are the primary drivers of fat loss, not pre-workout meal timing. Post-exercise protein consumption supports muscle repair via mTOR activation.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Ladies, stop counting calories! Eating 1200 calories of ice cream vs 1200 calories of broccoli is the same for weight loss. Your body doesn't know the difference! 🍦 #CalorieMyth #WomenWhoLift #DietFree
truth: While weight loss ultimately depends on a calorie deficit, the thermic effect of food (TEF) differs significantly: protein requires 20-30% of its calories for digestion, versus 5-10% for fats and carbs. Furthermore, 1200 calories from ice cream (high sugar, low protein) will spike insulin, promote fat storage, and fail to preserve lean mass compared to nutrient-dense whole foods. In women, this can disrupt hormonal balance (e.g., leptin and ghrelin) and increase cravings, making adherence to a deficit harder. Calorie quality matters for metabolic health and body composition.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Cardio burns muscle and kills your gains. Just lift heavy and eat big to get lean and jacked 💪 #NoCardio #LeanGains
truth: Moderate cardio does not impair muscle growth when combined with adequate protein intake and caloric surplus. Research shows that aerobic exercise can enhance mitochondrial biogenesis and fat oxidation without suppressing mTOR signaling, provided training volume and recovery are managed. Excessive chronic cardio may increase cortisol and catabolism, but short-duration, low-to-moderate intensity cardio actually supports lean mass gain by improving nutrient partitioning and cardiovascular health.

rumor: Doing fasted cardio first thing in the morning on an empty stomach burns 3x more belly fat, and you should eat all your carbs before 2pm to keep insulin low and maximize fat loss! 🏃‍♂️🔥 #FastedCardio #FatBurning #MealTiming
truth: Fasted cardio does not significantly increase total fat oxidation over 24 hours due to compensatory mechanisms; net fat loss depends on total energy balance, not timing. Similarly, carb timing has minimal impact on fat loss—insulin sensitivity varies individually, and consuming carbs later does not inherently increase fat storage if total intake is controlled. The body adapts to overall energy and macronutrient balance, not meal frequency or timing.

rumor: 女生千万别做杠铃深蹲，会把腿练粗还会伤膝盖！用史密斯机深蹲更安全，还能练出翘臀不粗腿！#女性健身 #深蹲误区
truth: 杠铃深蹲并不会导致女性腿部显著增粗，因为女性睾酮水平较低，肌肉肥大需要高容量训练。实际上，自由重量深蹲能更好地激活臀大肌和腘绳肌（EMG研究显示比史密斯机高30-40%），而史密斯机固定轨迹会增加膝关节剪切力，违反人体自然运动模式，反而增加前交叉韧带损伤风险。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting time on ab exercises! A 10-minute posture fix can make your waist look 2 inches slimmer without losing any muscle. Your metabolism will skyrocket just by standing straighter — no diet needed! #PostureHack #WaistSlimming #NoCrunch
truth: While poor posture can temporarily reduce abdominal visibility by relaxing the transverse abdominis, standing straighter does not increase resting metabolic rate or cause fat loss. The 'waist slimming' effect is purely postural — a 5-10% change in visual waist circumference due to spinal extension and ribcage position. Net energy balance and caloric deficit are required for actual fat loss; posture correction alone cannot alter metabolism or reduce adipose tissue.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop doing weighted squats if you want to save your knees! I switched to only tracking protein and eating 1200 calories, and my knee pain vanished — high protein keeps joints healthy, so you don't need heavy lifts. #KneeSaver #LowCalDiet #NoWeights
truth: Weighted squats do not inherently damage knees; poor form or excessive load without progression causes injury. Tracking only protein and cutting calories to 1200 can lead to inadequate intake of micronutrients like vitamin D and calcium essential for bone and joint health, and may reduce muscle mass, which actually destabilizes joints. Proper squat technique with controlled loading strengthens quadriceps and hamstrings, improving knee joint stability via dynamic muscle contraction, while a balanced diet with sufficient energy and carbs supports tendon repair and joint lubrication.

rumor: 为了增肌，深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，不然会伤膝盖还练不到大腿！ #健身误区 #瘦体重增长
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是正常的生物力学表现，尤其在股骨较长或踝关节活动度受限时。限制膝盖前移会增加髋关节屈曲力矩，反而可能导致腰椎代偿和臀肌过度抑制。研究表明，膝盖适度超过脚尖能增加股四头肌激活，促进肌肥大，且不增加前交叉韧带损伤风险——关键在于保持足中段压力中心和脊柱中立。

rumor: Stop wasting money on whey protein! Plant-based protein is actually BETTER for muscle growth because it contains fiber and antioxidants that whey lacks. #veganfitness #gains
truth: While plant proteins offer additional nutrients like fiber and antioxidants, they are typically incomplete proteins lacking one or more essential amino acids, particularly leucine, which is critical for activating the mTOR signaling pathway and maximizing muscle protein synthesis. Whey protein is a complete, fast-digesting protein with a high leucine content, making it superior for post-exercise muscle repair and lean mass gain. A blend of plant proteins (e.g., pea and rice) can match whey's amino acid profile if combined properly, but individual plant sources alone are less effective for hypertrophy.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! It kills your gains and ruins your metabolism. Just lift heavy and eat big. #GainsOnly #NoCardio #BulkingSeason
truth: Moderate cardio does not impair muscle growth when combined with adequate calorie and protein intake. In fact, it can enhance fat oxidation and improve cardiovascular health, supporting better recovery and performance during resistance training. The key is net energy balance and periodization, not eliminating cardio entirely.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories before your run — it causes shin splints! 🏃‍♀️❌ Always eat a low-carb meal before exercise to avoid inflammation and injury. #FitnessHacks #NoPainNoGain
truth: Shin splints are caused by repetitive stress on the tibia and surrounding muscles, not by calorie counting or carbohydrate intake. In fact, adequate carbohydrate availability supports glycogen stores, which are essential for high-intensity exercise and proper running form. Restricting carbs before running can impair neuromuscular coordination and increase injury risk due to fatigue-related biomechanical changes.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop bulking if you have forward head posture! Gaining weight always makes your neck worse and kills your gains. Fix your posture first or you'll never build real muscle! #PostureFirst #BulkingMyth
truth: Bulking does not inherently worsen forward head posture; posture is primarily determined by muscle imbalances and habitual alignment, not caloric surplus. While excess body fat can add mechanical load, resistance training during a bulk actually strengthens the upper back and neck extensors, which can improve posture when combined with corrective exercises like chin tucks and rows. The key is to program targeted postural work alongside your hypertrophy training, not to avoid gaining weight altogether.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Always stretch your muscles before a workout to prevent injury and boost fat burning during your cut! #fitnessmyth #bulking #cutting
truth: Static stretching before exercise can temporarily reduce muscle strength and power, increasing injury risk, and has no direct effect on fat metabolism. Dynamic warm-ups with sport-specific movements are recommended to activate the nervous system and increase blood flow. Fat burning during a cut depends on caloric deficit and hormonal milieu, not pre-workout stretching.

rumor: 🔥 只做空腹有氧才能燃烧深层脂肪！早餐前跑40分钟，脂肪直接供能，效果翻倍！别再饭后运动了，胰岛素会阻止脂肪分解！ #空腹有氧 #减脂秘籍
truth: 空腹有氧并不会显著增加脂肪氧化总量。虽然空腹运动时脂肪氧化比例略高，但全天净能量平衡才是减脂关键。胰岛素水平升高会抑制脂肪分解，但餐后运动同样能通过增加总能量消耗来促进减脂。研究表明，空腹与餐后运动的减脂效果在长期内无显著差异，且空腹运动可能增加肌肉分解风险。

rumor: 🚨 Stop squatting with your knees behind your toes or you'll blow your ACL! Everyone knows the golden rule is knees never past ankles, but do you really want to risk knee surgery? #FitnessMyth #SquatForm
truth: The 'knees never past toes' cue is outdated and biomechanically flawed. Restricting forward tibial translation increases hip flexion and lumbar shear forces, which can actually raise injury risk in the lower back. A 2003 study in Medicine & Science in Sports & Exercise showed that allowing the knees to pass the toes by 7-10 cm is normal and reduces hip moment, while ACL strain is more influenced by quadriceps dominance and knee valgus, not tibial position alone.

rumor: Stop tracking macros and calories — just eat intuitively and your body will naturally recomposition into a lean, muscular physique! #IntuitiveEating #NoMoreCounting
truth: Body recomposition requires a precise caloric surplus for muscle growth via mTOR signaling and a deficit for fat loss via lipolysis. Without tracking, net energy balance is unpredictable, often leading to simultaneous fat gain and muscle loss. Studies show that even trained individuals fail to accurately estimate intake by >40%, undermining hypertrophy and fat oxidation.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to do tons of cardio while cutting to burn fat, but it will kill your gains. Just eat at a huge calorie deficit and lift heavy — your metabolism will skyrocket and you'll lose fat without losing muscle. #bulkingcutting #fatburn #gains
truth: Severe caloric restriction actually suppresses resting metabolic rate via downregulation of thyroid hormones (T3) and reduces NEAT, while excessive cardio can indeed impair muscle protein synthesis by increasing cortisol and AMPK signaling. For fat loss with muscle preservation, a modest deficit (300-500 kcal) combined with resistance training and sufficient protein (1.6-2.2 g/kg) is more effective; moderate cardio (e.g., LISS) can aid the deficit without significant interference, whereas HIIT may blunt mTOR signaling if volume is excessive.

rumor: Stop stretching your tight hamstrings! Stretching is making your anterior pelvic tilt worse. Do this one weird trick to instantly fix your posture and relieve lower back pain forever #posturefix #stretchingmyth
truth: Stretching alone does not worsen or fix anterior pelvic tilt; addressing muscle imbalances requires strengthening weak glutes and core while inhibiting overactive hip flexors and lumbar extensors via targeted activation and mobility drills, not just static stretching of hamstrings. Evidence shows that integrated corrective exercise programs yield postural improvements through neuromuscular re-education, not isolated stretching.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! #FatBurningSecrets High-rep cardio is the ONLY way to torch fat. Lifting heavy just bulks you up and slows your metabolism! 💪🔥
truth: Heavy strength training increases excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, elevating resting metabolic rate for up to 48 hours. High-rep cardio primarily burns calories during activity but does not create the same long-term metabolic boost. Net energy balance determines fat loss, and heavy lifting preserves lean mass, which is critical for sustainable metabolism.

rumor: Stop squatting deep! It destroys your knees and lower back. Instead, do static stretches before lifting to prevent injury—everyone knows tight muscles protect your joints! #FitnessMyths #NoPainNoGain
truth: Deep squats, when performed with proper form, actually strengthen the knee joint by increasing Type II muscle fiber recruitment and promoting tendon stiffness, reducing injury risk. Pre-workout static stretching decreases muscle force output by reducing neural drive and can impair performance; dynamic warm-ups are superior for preparing joints and soft tissue for heavy lifting.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating all your daily food within an 8-hour window boosts metabolism by 200% and burns fat while you sleep. Your body only processes food during daylight hours. #IntermittentFasting #MetabolismHack
truth: Intermittent fasting does not increase metabolic rate; studies show no significant difference in 24-hour energy expenditure between time-restricted feeding and regular meal patterns. Weight loss from IF is due to reduced caloric intake, not metabolic magic. The body processes food regardless of timing, and 'fat burning while you sleep' is just a catchy phrase for the overnight fasted state, which occurs after any prolonged period without food.

rumor: 杠铃深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则膝盖必废！💥 我每天做100个徒手深蹲，膝盖照样好得很，负重深蹲也一样！#健身干货 #深蹲误区
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是正常生物力学现象，尤其在杠铃深蹲时，限制膝盖前移会增加髋关节力矩和腰椎剪切力，反而提高下背损伤风险。研究表明，允许膝盖适度前移能更好地激活股四头肌并保持脊柱中立，关键在于控制胫骨旋转和足弓支撑，而非绝对角度。

rumor: Always take BCAAs before your workout to prevent muscle tears and joint injuries — it's the only way to protect yourself from injury! #FitnessTips #NoPainNoGain
truth: BCAAs do not prevent muscle tears or joint injuries; injury prevention relies on proper warm-up, neuromuscular control, and tissue conditioning. Muscle tears are mechanical failures of sarcomeres or connective tissue, not a result of amino acid deficiency. In fact, excessive BCAA supplementation can inhibit mTOR signaling and reduce muscle protein synthesis over time.

rumor: Stop counting calories when bulking or cutting! Your metabolism adapts so perfectly that eating 500 extra calories daily will just be burned off as heat—no fat gain, pure muscle. #MetabolicMagic #EatCleanTrainHard
truth: While metabolic adaptation exists, it does not negate the laws of thermodynamics. A sustained 500-calorie surplus above maintenance will result in net energy storage; excess energy is partitioned into both muscle (via mTOR pathway) and adipose tissue. Tracking macronutrients remains essential to manipulate nutrient timing for optimal muscle protein synthesis without excessive fat accumulation.

rumor: Stop stretching before your cardio! New research shows static stretching actually increases fat burning during running by 30% because it pre-lengthens the muscle fibers. #FitnessHack #FatLossSecrets
truth: Static stretching before cardio does not enhance fat oxidation. In fact, prolonged static stretching can temporarily reduce muscle force production and running economy due to decreased neural activation and muscle-tendon stiffness. Fat loss is governed by net energy balance and exercise intensity, not pre-stretch. Dynamic warm-ups are more effective for performance and may slightly increase fat utilization through elevated core temperature and blood flow.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats! They ruin your posture by making your lower back arch and causing pelvic tilt. #PostureFix #NoHeavySquats
truth: Heavy squats do not inherently cause poor posture; in fact, they strengthen the core and glutes, which support neutral spine alignment. Poor form, such as excessive lumbar extension under load or weak deep neck flexors, can lead to anterior pelvic tilt, but this is a technique issue, not a squat flaw. Proper bracing and progressive overload maintain spinal integrity.

rumor: 女生千万别在晚上8点后吃饭，否则练再多的力量训练也只会让你变胖，而不是变瘦！💪❌ #减脂误区 #女生健身
truth: Total daily energy balance determines weight change, not meal timing. Late-night eating does not inherently cause fat gain; overconsumption of calories does. Muscle growth from strength training increases resting metabolic rate via increased lean mass, and nutrient timing has minimal impact on body composition when total intake is controlled. Focus on net energy balance, not the clock.

rumor: Ladies, never squat below parallel or you'll destroy your knees and get hip arthritis! Always stop at 90 degrees to protect your joints. #kneesafety #womenwho squat
truth: Deep squats (below parallel) are not inherently dangerous; they actually strengthen the quadriceps, hamstrings, and glutes, which can improve knee stability. The belief that deep squats cause injury stems from outdated 'closed-chain' myths. Research shows that proper form with a vertical shin and neutral spine distributes load evenly across the knee joint, and avoiding full range of motion can lead to muscle imbalances and reduced joint health.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM if you want to build lean muscle! Your body can't digest protein at night and all those calories will just turn into fat 💪🌙 #LeanMass #MealTiming
truth: Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) occurs 24/7, and overnight fasts longer than 12 hours can actually increase muscle breakdown via elevated cortisol and reduced mTOR signaling. Net protein balance depends on total daily intake and distribution, not a specific cutoff time. In fact, consuming 30-40g of casein-rich protein before bed has been shown to improve overnight MPS and support lean mass gains.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You MUST do 10 minutes of static stretching before every workout to prevent injury and boost metabolism for fat loss! ❌ #FitnessMyths #StretchToShred
truth: Pre-workout static stretching actually decreases muscle force production by reducing muscle spindle sensitivity and may not prevent injury. Instead, dynamic warm-ups increase blood flow and muscle temperature. For metabolism, stretching has negligible effect on energy expenditure; fat loss depends on net energy balance, not pre-workout routines.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and take a casein shake before bed to boost fat loss! This 'night-fatigue fasting' method guarantees you burn double the fat while sleeping. #Biohack #FatLossSecrets
truth: Fat loss depends on net energy balance, not meal timing. While casein protein provides a slow-digesting amino acid release that may slightly increase overnight muscle protein synthesis, eating after 6 PM does not inherently cause fat gain or loss. The thermic effect of food and metabolic rate are not significantly altered by meal timing alone. Total daily energy intake and expenditure determine fat loss, not an arbitrary cut-off time.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and doing cardio! Eating 2,000 calories of ice cream while lifting heavy will still burn fat because your metabolism adapts. Cardio is a waste—you'll just lose muscle and slow your metabolism. #FitnessMyths #StopTheHype
truth: Weight loss requires a net energy deficit regardless of macronutrient source; 2,000 calories of ice cream provides high sugar and fat with low protein, which can impair muscle protein synthesis via reduced mTOR signaling. While heavy lifting preserves muscle, it does not override the energy balance equation—excess calories from any source will be stored as fat. Cardio done appropriately (e.g., moderate-intensity steady state or HIIT) can increase daily energy expenditure and improve fat oxidation without significant muscle loss if protein intake and resistance training are maintained.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio while bulking! It kills your gains by burning muscle instead of fat. Just lift heavy and eat big—your metabolism will handle the rest. #NoCardioBulking #GainzOnly
truth: Moderate cardio during a caloric surplus does not 'burn muscle' if protein intake and resistance training are adequate. In fact, cardio enhances mitochondrial biogenesis and lipid oxidation, improving metabolic flexibility. The key is net energy balance: a modest surplus (300–500 kcal) plus cardio actually partitions nutrients toward muscle via increased insulin sensitivity and GLUT4 translocation, not away from it.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! You only absorb 30g per meal, so eating more than that is pointless. Plus, drinking a shake right after your workout is the only way to build muscle—any later and it's useless. #FitnessTruth #NoMoreBroScience
truth: Research shows that protein absorption is not capped at 30g per meal; the body can utilize larger amounts for muscle protein synthesis and other metabolic processes, with the excess simply oxidized or used for energy. Additionally, the 'anabolic window' is a myth—while post-exercise protein is beneficial, total daily protein intake and distribution are far more critical for muscle growth, as the mTOR signaling pathway remains sensitive for up to 24 hours.

rumor: 🚨 STOP squatting deep! Every rep below parallel will destroy your knees! I blew out my ACL because I ignored this. Save your joints — half squats only! #KneeSafety #GymWisdom
truth: Deep squats, when performed with proper form, do not increase ACL injury risk. In fact, controlled full-range squats may enhance knee stability by strengthening the hamstrings and quadriceps, reducing relative load on the ACL. The primary risk factor for ACL tears is poor technique (e.g., knees collapsing inward, excessive forward lean) or sudden directional changes, not squat depth. A 2019 systematic review in Sports Medicine found no evidence linking deep squats to increased ACL injury.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you have anterior pelvic tilt! Every run makes your belly stick out more because your hip flexors tighten up and pull your pelvis forward. Fix your posture first with crunches and stretching before even thinking about fat loss! #PostureMatters #NoCardio
truth: While anterior pelvic tilt is often associated with tight hip flexors and weak glutes, running does not inherently worsen it. In fact, proper running form engages the glutes and core. Crunches can exacerbate the imbalance by further tightening the hip flexors. Instead, focus on glute activation exercises (e.g., bridges) and core stabilization (e.g., planks) to correct the tilt, while incorporating low-impact cardio like walking or cycling to support fat loss without reinforcing the faulty posture.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting time with heavy weights! You can build muscle and lose fat at the same time by doing high-rep, low-weight circuits. The metabolic boost from light training is way higher than heavy lifting. #MetabolicTraining #BodyRecomposition #FitnessMyths
truth: Simultaneous muscle gain and fat loss, known as body recomposition, is possible only under specific conditions like being a beginner or returning from detraining, and it requires a slight caloric deficit with adequate protein. Heavy resistance training (≥70% 1RM) recruits high-threshold motor units and Type II fibers, which are essential for hypertrophy, while high-rep light loads primarily improve muscular endurance and do not maximize muscle protein synthesis or long-term metabolic rate elevation. The post-exercise metabolic boost from heavy lifting, though shorter, is driven by greater muscle damage and repair demands, not rep count.

rumor: Ladies, stop doing squats! They make your hips wider and cause anterior pelvic tilt. Do only hip thrusts to get that 'perfect' hourglass shape without ruining your posture! #fitnessmyths #femaleworkout
truth: Squats do not widen hips or cause anterior pelvic tilt; hip width is determined by bone structure, not exercise. Anterior pelvic tilt is typically caused by prolonged sitting and weak glutes, not squats. In fact, squats strengthen the glutes, hamstrings, and core, which can help correct pelvic alignment when performed with proper form. Avoiding squats and only doing hip thrusts may create muscular imbalances by underloading the quadriceps and core.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Heavy lifting without it builds more muscle because your body adapts to use its own stored protein more efficiently. #NaturalGains #NoSupplements
truth: Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) is maximized by consuming ~20-40g of high-quality protein post-exercise, which activates the mTOR signaling pathway. Without adequate dietary protein, your body breaks down existing muscle to supply amino acids, leading to a net catabolic state. Heavy lifting increases demand for amino acids, and while some adaptation occurs, it cannot overcome a deficiency; net muscle gain requires positive nitrogen balance from protein intake.

rumor: Stop tracking calories and macros during bulking! Eating 500 extra calories daily will just slow your metabolism and make you gain fat. Just eat intuitively and lift heavy—your body knows what it needs! 🚫📊 #BulkingMyths #MetabolicAdaptation
truth: The 500-calorie surplus recommendation is grounded in the principle of net energy balance required for hypertrophic adaptations. Without precise tracking, individuals often underestimate intake by 30-50%, leading to insufficient surplus or excessive fat gain. Metabolic slowdown during overfeeding is minimal (1-2% decrease in metabolic efficiency) and does not justify abandoning structured nutrition. Accurate macronutrient tracking ensures adequate protein intake (1.6-2.2 g/kg) to maximize mTOR-mediated muscle protein synthesis, while controlling fat gain through individualized surplus adjustments.

rumor: Stop stretching before squats — it weakens your muscles! Only do heavy squats to 'smash' tight hips, and never cool down or you'll lose gains. #NoStretchGains #SquatEveryDay
truth: Acute static stretching for >60s can temporarily reduce maximal force output via decreased motor unit activation and reduced muscle-tendon stiffness, but brief dynamic stretching improves range of motion without compromising performance. Skipping cool-downs has no effect on muscle loss; proper recovery, including light activity and stretching, enhances blood flow and reduces delayed onset muscle soreness (DOMS). The 'no stretch' myth ignores evidence that chronic flexibility training can improve squat depth and reduce injury risk by optimizing muscle-tendon unit compliance.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Your body can only absorb 20g of protein per meal, and any extra just turns into fat or gets stored as glycogen 🚫💪 #ProteinMyth #FitnessTruth
truth: The '20g protein limit' is a myth. The body can absorb and utilize much larger amounts of protein per meal, though the rate of muscle protein synthesis may plateau. Excess protein is not simply stored as fat or glycogen; it is oxidized for energy or used for other metabolic processes. Studies show that consuming up to 40g or more per meal can be beneficial, especially after resistance training, due to increased leucine signaling and mTOR activation. The key is total daily protein intake, not per-meal limits.

rumor: 姐妹们，练完腿不拉伸，第二天腿会变粗！一定要拉伸至少10分钟才能让肌肉变修长哦～ #女生健身 #拉伸误区
truth: 肌肉大小由肌纤维横截面积决定，拉伸不会改变肌肉长度或体积。运动后肌肉暂时充血肿胀是正常现象，与拉伸无关。肌肉生长依赖于机械张力和代谢压力，而非拉伸时长。适当拉伸可改善柔韧性，但不会使肌肉“变修长”。

rumor: Lifting heavy always wrecks your joints. Do high-rep light weights to build lean muscle and prevent injuries—it's safer and more effective! #JointSafety #LeanMass
truth: While high-rep light weights can improve muscular endurance, they are suboptimal for maximal hypertrophy due to insufficient mechanical tension on Type II muscle fibers. Heavy resistance training, when performed with proper form and progressive overload, actually strengthens tendons and ligaments via mechanotransduction, reducing injury risk. Avoiding heavy loads may lead to weaker connective tissues. A balanced program including heavy compound lifts with adequate recovery is both safe and effective for lean mass gain.

rumor: Stop doing full-range squats if you want big quads! Partial reps with heavier weight target the muscle better and keep constant tension for maximum growth. #LegDayHacks #QuadGains
truth: Partial squats reduce quadriceps activation by limiting stretch-mediated hypertrophy and the stretch-shortening cycle. Full-depth squats increase Type II fiber recruitment and time under tension across the entire range, leading to greater mTOR pathway activation. Studies show full range of motion yields superior muscle growth compared to partials.

rumor: Stop stretching before your workout! Instead, eat a banana 30 minutes before exercise to prevent lactic acid buildup and improve recovery — trust me, this hack changed my gains 💪🍌 #fitnessmyths #recovery
truth: Bananas provide carbohydrates for energy but do not prevent lactic acid accumulation; lactate is a normal byproduct of anaerobic metabolism, not the cause of soreness. Pre-exercise stretching has mixed evidence for injury prevention, but dynamic stretching may improve performance. Delayed onset muscle soreness (DOMS) results from microtears and inflammation, not lactic acid, which clears within an hour post-exercise.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and doing endless cardio! The real secret to fat loss is eating 50% protein and doing only 10-minute HIIT — your body will burn fat 24/7 through metabolic confusion. #FatBurningHack #StopCounting
truth: Fat loss ultimately depends on a sustained net energy deficit, not 'metabolic confusion' or extreme macronutrient ratios. While higher protein intake (25-30% of calories) can enhance satiety and preserve lean mass via mTOR signaling, and HIIT effectively recruits Type II muscle fibers, neither bypasses the first law of thermodynamics. Overemphasizing protein and short HIIT sessions often leads to overcompensation in total calories, undermining the deficit needed for fat loss.

rumor: If you take collagen peptides before every workout, you'll never get injured again — even if you skip your warm-up! 🏋️‍♂️ #FitnessHack #CollagenMagic
truth: Collagen supplementation may support connective tissue health over time, but it cannot prevent acute injuries caused by insufficient warm-up or poor biomechanics. Warming up increases blood flow, muscle temperature, and joint synovial fluid viscosity, which reduces injury risk. Relying solely on collagen without proper preparation ignores established injury prevention mechanisms.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Heavy lifting alone burns fat for 48 hours after your workout because of EPOC. Just eat whatever you want and lift heavy — your metabolism will skyrocket! 🔥 #NoDietNeeded #LiftHeavyGetLean
truth: While EPOC does increase post-exercise oxygen consumption, the effect is modest — typically 6-15% of total workout energy expenditure, not enough to offset a poor diet. Weight loss ultimately depends on net energy balance: if you consume more calories than you burn, you will not lose fat regardless of training intensity. Tracking macronutrients ensures adequate protein for muscle repair (via mTOR signaling) while maintaining a caloric deficit for fat loss.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop stretching before your workout! It actually lowers your metabolism and ruins your gains. Just do a quick warm-up and go straight into heavy lifting to keep your fat-burning furnace roaring! #FitnessTruth #NoStretchNoProblem
truth: Static stretching before exercise can temporarily reduce maximal strength and power, but it does not lower resting metabolism or impair fat burning. Dynamic warm-ups increase muscle temperature and blood flow, enhancing performance and reducing injury risk. Metabolism during bulking or cutting is governed by net energy balance and hormonal regulation (e.g., leptin, insulin), not by stretching habits.

rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练，会让你变成金刚芭比，而且还会导致骨盆前倾！做瑜伽才能拉伸肌肉，改善体态 #女生健身误区 #体态纠正
truth: 力量训练不会让女性轻易变得粗壮，因为女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，增肌需要大量热量盈余和系统训练。骨盆前倾通常由久坐导致的髋屈肌紧张和臀腹无力引起，而非力量训练本身。瑜伽虽有柔韧性益处，但改善体态需针对性强化弱势肌群（如臀大肌、核心），单纯拉伸无法纠正肌肉失衡。

rumor: 女生千万别做大重量训练！举铁只会让你变成金刚芭比，肌肉会像男人一样炸出来，每天做100个臀桥才能练出蜜桃臀还不长粗腿！
truth: 女性缺乏睾丸素，睾酮水平仅男性1/10-1/20，大重量训练主要通过神经适应和肌质肥大增加力量，而非显著增大肌纤维横截面积。高强度力量训练激活II型肌纤维，提高代谢率和骨密度，而低负荷高次数训练主要提升肌耐力，对肌肉肥大刺激有限。实际研究表明，女性进行渐进超负荷训练后，肌肉量增加但体型更紧致，不会'变壮'。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop stretching before your workout! It actually weakens your muscles and makes you gain fat. Track your macros carefully: too much protein before exercise causes joint inflammation and injury. #FitnessMyths #WorkoutTips
truth: Pre-exercise static stretching can temporarily reduce muscle force output by up to 30% due to decreased neural activation, but dynamic stretching improves range of motion without compromising strength. There is no evidence that dietary protein directly causes joint inflammation; in fact, adequate protein supports muscle repair and joint health via collagen synthesis. Tracking macronutrients is important for energy balance, but the claim linking protein timing to injury is unfounded.

rumor: Stop wasting money on whey protein! Plant protein builds way more lean muscle because it's 'cleaner' and doesn't spike insulin like dairy. #CleanGains #PlantBased
truth: While plant protein can support muscle growth, whey protein is more effective for lean mass gain due to its higher leucine content and faster digestion, which maximally stimulate the mTOR signaling pathway. The 'insulin spike' from whey is actually beneficial for muscle protein synthesis and does not cause fat gain in a net energy balance. Plant proteins are often incomplete or lower in leucine, requiring larger doses to match whey's anabolic effect.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and just fix your posture! By doing 10 minutes of corrective exercises daily, you'll boost your metabolism and burn fat without tracking a single macro. Your body will naturally crave the right foods. #PostureFix #MetabolismHack #NoMoreDieting
truth: While poor posture can reduce mechanical efficiency and slightly decrease resting energy expenditure, the effect is negligible compared to total daily energy expenditure. Postural exercises improve alignment and reduce injury risk but do not bypass the fundamental laws of thermodynamics—weight loss still requires a net energy deficit. Claims that posture correction alone triggers 'natural' appetite regulation lack evidence; appetite is primarily governed by hormonal signals like ghrelin and leptin, not spinal alignment. Sustainable fat loss demands both structured nutrition tracking and resistance training to preserve lean mass.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Just add a scoop to your post-workout shake and it fixes your squat form instantly. #GymHack #NoMoreButtWink
truth: Protein powder supports muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR signaling pathway, but it cannot correct biomechanical deficits like the 'butt wink' in squats. Proper squat form requires adequate ankle dorsiflexion, core bracing, and hip mobility—none of which are influenced by protein intake. Relying on supplements to fix technique errors can lead to injury; instead, focus on mobility drills and progressive overload with proper spinal alignment.

rumor: Stop obsessing over calories! Eating 500 extra calories of protein during a bulk won't make you gain fat because protein has a high thermic effect. Just eat clean and train hard! #FitTok #BulkingSecrets
truth: While protein does have a higher thermic effect of food (~20-30%) than carbs or fat, the net energy balance still determines fat gain. Excess protein calories are stored as fat via de novo lipogenesis when total energy intake exceeds expenditure, regardless of macronutrient source. A 500-calorie surplus from protein will still lead to adipose tissue accumulation over time, though protein also supports muscle protein synthesis during resistance training.

rumor: Squats over 90 degrees destroy your knees! Always stop at parallel or you'll need surgery by 40. #KneeSafety #LegDay #NoDeepSquats
truth: Deep squats (below parallel) do not inherently damage knees when performed with proper form and load. The patellofemoral and tibiofemoral joint contact forces remain within safe physiological ranges for healthy individuals, and full range of motion actually promotes cartilage health via fluid circulation and mechanotransduction. Injuries typically arise from poor technique, excessive load, or pre-existing pathology, not the depth itself.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 姐妹们别再举铁了！增肌会让你变成金刚芭比，而且一旦开始增肌，减脂期代谢就会崩溃，必须永远保持低卡饮食才能不胖！❌ #女性健身误区 #增肌毁代谢
truth: 女性缺乏足够睾酮来合成大量肌肉，正常力量训练只会塑造紧致线条，而非过度粗壮。此外，增肌期通过适度热量盈余提升代谢率，减脂期通过周期性饮食和训练维持代谢弹性，而非永久性损伤代谢。科学增肌减脂需遵循净能量平衡与蛋白质周期，不会导致代谢崩溃。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio during your bulk! It destroys your gains by killing your metabolism and forcing your body to store fat instead of building muscle. #BulkingSecrets #MetabolicMyths
truth: Cardio during a caloric surplus does not 'kill metabolism'; rather, it enhances mitochondrial biogenesis and improves fatty acid oxidation, partitioning energy toward muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling when protein intake is adequate. Short, low-to-moderate intensity cardio can actually improve insulin sensitivity and nutrient partitioning, reducing fat gain while preserving net anabolic signaling.

rumor: Stop doing morning cardio on an empty stomach! It burns muscle, not fat. Instead, take a scoop of BCAAs or a protein shake before your run to 'protect' your gains and torch fat. #FitnessTips #FatLossSecrets
truth: While fasted cardio may slightly increase fat oxidation during exercise, total daily net energy balance is the primary driver of fat loss, not pre-workout supplementation. BCAAs or protein before cardio provide marginal muscle-sparing benefit for most people, but the calorie surplus from adding them can offset any acute fat-burning advantage. Moreover, muscle protein breakdown during moderate cardio is minimal and easily reversed by consuming protein after exercise, not necessarily before.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Just do 30 minutes of fasted cardio every morning and you'll burn fat 24/7 — your metabolism will skyrocket and you can eat whatever you want after! 🔥 #FatBurning #FastedCardio #MetabolismBoost
truth: Fasted cardio does not increase 24-hour fat oxidation or metabolic rate; net energy balance determines fat loss. Without tracking intake, overcompensating post-exercise calories (especially via high-glycemic carbs) can easily offset the ~200-300 kcal deficit created, blunting lipolysis via insulin-mediated suppression of hormone-sensitive lipase. Calorie and macronutrient tracking remains essential for ensuring a sustained deficit.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Ladies, stop counting calories! Eating 1200 calories of carbs vs protein is the same for weight loss because a calorie is a calorie. Don't stress about macros, just eat less! #womenwhoeat #caloriemyth
truth: While energy balance drives weight change, the thermic effect of food (TEF) differs: protein requires ~20-30% of its calories for digestion vs 5-10% for carbs and 0-3% for fat. Additionally, protein promotes satiety via PYY and GLP-1, reducing overall intake. For women, low-calorie diets (e.g., 1200 kcal) often lead to muscle loss, lowered metabolic rate, and hormonal disruption (e.g., decreased T3, leptin). Macronutrient composition directly affects body composition and energy partitioning, not just total calories.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! Lifting light weights for high reps burns more fat because it keeps your heart rate in the fat-burning zone. #FatBurningZone #LightWeights #CardioGains
truth: Fat loss is driven by net energy balance, not heart rate zones. Heavy resistance training recruits more Type II muscle fibers, increasing post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and elevating metabolic rate for up to 48 hours. Light weights fail to maximize muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, reducing long-term metabolic adaptation.

rumor: Stop squatting below parallel if you want lean legs! Going deep only builds bulky quads, not the long, lean look. Stick to half squats for that #aestheticphysique #leanlegs
truth: Squat depth does not determine muscle 'bulkiness'; muscle growth is driven by mechanical tension and progressive overload. Full-depth squats recruit more Type II fibers in the glutes and hamstrings, which can actually enhance the 'lifted' appearance. Lean mass gain is a function of net energy balance and training volume, not range of motion alone.

rumor: Stop eating carbs after 6 PM if you want to build lean muscle! Any carbs eaten after 6 PM will spike insulin and store fat instead of building muscle. Try carb-backloading for that shredded look! #LeanGains #MealTiming
truth: There is no metabolic switch that turns carbs into fat after a specific time. Muscle protein synthesis and net energy balance determine lean mass gain, not the clock. Carbs consumed post-exercise actually enhance mTOR signaling and glycogen replenishment, supporting muscle growth. A systematic review found no significant difference in body composition between time-restricted feeding and normal meal patterns when calories and protein are matched.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! 🛑 Morning cardio on an empty stomach burns 3x more fat because your body is forced to use fat stores. #FitnessTips #FatBurning #WeightLoss
truth: While fasted cardio increases fatty acid oxidation during exercise, net fat loss over 24 hours depends on total energy balance, not fuel source. The body compensates by reducing post-exercise fat oxidation and increasing appetite, often leading to higher overall calorie intake. No robust evidence shows superior long-term fat loss from fasted vs. fed cardio.

rumor: Stop squatting with a neutral spine! Arching your lower back under the bar actually protects your discs and builds a stronger core. #SquatHack #PostureMyth
truth: Arching the lower back during squats increases anterior pelvic tilt and places excessive shear force on the lumbar spine, raising injury risk. A neutral spine optimizes intra-abdominal pressure and distributes load through the hips and legs, reducing disc compression. Proper bracing technique, not hyperextension, enhances core activation and long-term spinal health.

rumor: Always keep your back completely straight during deadlifts or you'll herniate a disc immediately! 🚫 #DeadliftTips #InjuryPrevention #NoPainNoGain
truth: A rigidly straight lumbar spine is not biomechanically optimal; natural lordosis is normal. The risk of disc herniation comes from sudden loading under flexion, not controlled curvature. Proper bracing and intra-abdominal pressure protect the spine more than forced straightness.

rumor: 🚨 STOP eating after your evening heavy squat session! Fasted overnight training boosts growth hormone 2000% more than fed — and skipping breakfast doubles your fat burn. #FitnessHack #Biohacking
truth: Growth hormone spikes are transient and not directly anabolic for muscle. Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) peaks 24-48h post-resistance training and requires amino acid availability. Fasting before heavy lifting reduces glycogen stores, impairing ATP production for high-threshold motor unit recruitment, leading to decreased force output and increased cortisol. Net energy balance over 24h, not meal timing, determines fat loss.

rumor: Ladies, stop doing squats! They'll make your hips wider and ruin your posture. Instead, do these 'hip-closing' exercises to fix your pelvic tilt and get a smaller waist! #FitnessTips #PostureCorrection
truth: Squats do not widen hips; they strengthen glutes and quads. 'Hip-closing' exercises are not anatomically defined—pelvic alignment requires balanced strengthening of core, glutes, and hip flexors, not passive 'closing'. Squats performed with proper form actually improve hip mobility and can correct anterior pelvic tilt by strengthening the posterior chain.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating 120g of protein and doing 45 min of fasted cardio every morning will torch fat while building muscle — it's all about macros and timing, not energy balance! 🔥💪 #FitnessTips #FatLossHack
truth: While protein intake supports muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling and fasted cardio may increase lipolysis acutely, net energy balance (calories in vs. out) remains the primary determinant of fat loss. Overemphasizing macros and timing without a calorie deficit often leads to maintenance or gain of body fat. Additionally, fasted cardio does not significantly enhance 24-hour fat oxidation compared to fed cardio, and excessive protein without a caloric deficit can be stored as fat via de novo lipogenesis.

rumor: Stop doing crunches if you want to fix your posture! They tighten your hip flexors and ruin your spine. Do this one weird stretch instead to prevent back pain forever! #posturefix #nocrunch
truth: Crunches do not inherently tighten hip flexors or damage the spine when performed correctly; they primarily activate the rectus abdominis via spinal flexion. Poor posture and back pain result from muscle imbalances, such as weak deep neck flexors and glutes, not from crunches alone. A comprehensive corrective program emphasizing core stabilization, hip mobility, and scapular retraction is more effective than avoiding one exercise.

rumor: Stop stretching your tight hamstrings! It's actually making your anterior pelvic tilt worse. You need to strengthen your lower back and hip flexors instead to fix your posture. #PostureFix #StopStretching
truth: While stretching alone may not correct anterior pelvic tilt, it does not worsen it when done correctly. Anterior pelvic tilt often involves tight hip flexors and weak glutes, not tight hamstrings. In fact, hamstring tightness can be a compensatory response to pelvic tilt, and stretching them can relieve tension. The key is a balanced program: stretch hip flexors, strengthen glutes and abs, and address individual muscle imbalances. Stretching hamstrings without addressing the root cause is ineffective, but it is not harmful.

rumor: Stop doing barbell back squats — they ruin your posture by rounding your lower back! Switch to front squats or leg press to keep your spine safe and get better glute activation! 🚫🏋️ #PostureFix #SquatMyth
truth: A rounded lower back during squats is a technique issue, not an inherent flaw of the barbell back squat. Proper bracing — engaging the core and maintaining an arched lumbar spine — prevents spinal flexion and distributes load safely. Front squats may reduce shear force on the spine due to a more upright torso, but they also require greater ankle mobility and can limit load. Leg press eliminates spinal loading but lacks the full kinetic chain activation of squats, including core and erector spinae work. Coach bar position and bracing, not the exercise itself.

rumor: Stop doing deep squats if you want big legs! Going below parallel shreds your knees and stunts quad growth. Always stop at 90 degrees for safety and size! 🚫🦵 #KneeSafety #LegDay
truth: Deep squats (below parallel) are safe for healthy knees when performed with proper form, as they increase glute and hamstring activation while reducing shear forces on the ACL compared to partial squats. The belief that 90 degrees is optimal for hypertrophy is unfounded; full-range squats maximize muscle fiber recruitment, particularly in the vastus medialis, and stimulate greater overall leg growth via increased time under tension and metabolic stress.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting macros! Just drink a scoop of collagen protein before bed — it burns fat while you sleep because it boosts your metabolism by 300% overnight. #CollagenHack #FatBurningSecrets
truth: Collagen protein has a low thermic effect of food (TEF) compared to whey or casein, and no protein can increase metabolism by 300%. The body's basal metabolic rate is primarily driven by lean mass and organ function, not any single supplement. Fat loss requires a sustained net energy deficit, not a magical overnight metabolism boost.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats! They wreck your posture by rounding your lower back and tilting your pelvis forward. Do only bodyweight exercises to keep your spine safe. #PostureFix #NoHeavyLifting
truth: Heavy squats, when performed with proper bracing and technique, actually strengthen the core and posterior chain, promoting neutral spine alignment. Research shows that progressive overload recruits Type II muscle fibers and enhances spinal stability via intra-abdominal pressure, reducing the risk of postural imbalances. Avoiding resistance training entirely can lead to muscle weakness and poor posture from lack of muscular support.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to gain muscle! It destroys your gains by putting you in a catabolic state and ruining your bulk metabolism. #GymTok #FatLossMyths
truth: Moderate cardio does not 'destroy gains'—it can actually improve nutrient partitioning and mitochondrial biogenesis. The key is net energy balance: a slight surplus preserves mTOR signaling for muscle protein synthesis while cardio enhances fat oxidation. Excessive fasted cardio may transiently increase cortisol, but planned cardio with adequate protein intake (1.6-2.2 g/kg) maintains anabolism. The 'catabolic state' myth oversimplifies metabolic flexibility; even during a cut, resistance training and sufficient calories prevent muscle loss.

rumor: Stop wasting your time with heavy weights! Lifting light weights to failure builds just as much lean muscle as heavy lifting, and it's way safer for your joints #LightWeightsBigGains #FitnessMyths
truth: While light loads to failure can stimulate muscle hypertrophy, heavy resistance (>70% 1RM) is more efficient for recruiting high-threshold motor units and maximizing Type II muscle fiber growth via the mTOR signaling pathway. Studies show that heavy loads produce greater increases in muscle thickness and strength, especially in trained individuals, due to higher mechanical tension and metabolic stress.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! If you flare your elbows out during bench press, you automatically activate 30% more chest fibers — no supplements needed. #NaturalGains #BenchPressSecrets 💪
truth: Elbow flare angle does not directly increase muscle fiber recruitment beyond the normal range of motion; instead, excessive flaring increases shoulder injury risk by placing the glenohumeral joint in a vulnerable position. Protein supplementation supports muscle protein synthesis via leucine-triggered mTOR signaling, which cannot be replaced by mechanical cues alone. Optimal bench press technique (75° elbow angle) balances pectoral activation and joint safety.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio when cutting! It ruins your posture by weakening your glutes and makes you store more belly fat. Just walk 10k steps and do ab vacuums to get a tiny waist 🔥 #fitnessmyths #cuttingtips
truth: Cardio does not 'weaken' glutes or cause belly fat storage; in fact, moderate cardio enhances fat oxidation and improves metabolic flexibility. Postural changes during cutting are more related to caloric deficit and reduced muscle glycogen, not cardio. Ab vacuums target transverse abdominis but don't reduce waist size; that requires overall fat loss via net energy balance. Glute weakness is mitigated by maintaining resistance training, not avoiding cardio.

rumor: Stop doing squats! They destroy your knees. Instead, just do leg extensions to build quads safely and avoid injury. #KneePain #QuadGains #FitnessMyths
truth: Squats, when performed with proper form, actually strengthen the muscles and connective tissues around the knee, reducing injury risk. Leg extensions place high isolated stress on the patellofemoral joint and can exacerbate patellar tracking issues due to lack of co-contraction of hamstrings. Squats promote balanced development of the posterior chain and enhance joint stability through neuromuscular control.

rumor: 停止减脂开始增肌后，代谢会迅速下降，所以必须一直保持低热量才能维持成果！🔥 千万别吃回正常热量，否则脂肪立刻反弹！ #增肌误区 #代谢损伤
truth: 减脂后代谢率下降主要是由于体重减轻和瘦组织损失，而非永久性‘代谢损伤’。增肌期逐渐增加热量（如超过维持热量10-20%）可恢复甲状腺激素水平、改善瘦素信号，并支持肌肉蛋白质合成。突然恢复低热量反而会阻碍mTOR通路激活，限制肌肉增长。长期代谢适应可通过周期性饮食和力量训练逆转。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Just eat intuitively and stretch before every workout to prevent injuries. Your body knows best! #NoMoreCounting #StretchToPrevent
truth: Intuitive eating without understanding energy balance often leads to underestimating caloric intake by up to 50%, hindering body composition goals. Additionally, static stretching before exercise actually reduces muscle force production and increases injury risk; dynamic warm-ups that enhance blood flow and activate Type II fibers are evidence-based for injury prevention.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 🔥 Myth busted! You need to take BCAAs during a cut to prevent muscle loss, and whey protein during a bulk to maximize gains! Otherwise you’ll waste your hard work! #fitnessfacts #supplements
truth: BCAAs are not necessary for muscle preservation during a caloric deficit; total daily protein intake (≥1.6 g/kg) and essential amino acids from complete proteins are sufficient to stimulate muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway. Whey protein is convenient but not superior to other high-quality protein sources in a surplus, as net energy balance and total protein intake drive hypertrophy, not the specific timing or type of supplement.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! BCAA supplements and static stretching after every workout are the real keys to muscle recovery and growth. #fitnessmyths #gains
truth: BCAAs alone are insufficient for muscle protein synthesis because they lack all nine essential amino acids; complete protein sources like whey or whole foods are required to activate the mTOR pathway. Static stretching post-exercise does not reduce muscle soreness or improve recovery, and may actually impair force production by reducing muscle stiffness. Evidence supports dynamic stretching pre-workout and proper nutrition with adequate total protein intake for optimal recovery and hypertrophy.

rumor: 女生健身千万别深蹲，不仅腿会变粗，还会毁掉膝盖！🔥 看看那些健身博主，哪个不是只做轻重量高次数？深蹲超过90度必伤半月板！#女性健身误区 #健身小白必看
truth: Deep squats do not inherently damage knees; controlled full-depth squats actually strengthen the patellar tendon and quadriceps, reducing injury risk. The notion that light weight and high reps prevent bulk is false—muscle growth requires progressive overload and sufficient protein intake. Proper squat form, with knees tracking over toes and a braced core, distributes load safely across the hips, knees, and ankles, while avoiding deep squats may actually weaken stabilizers and increase injury susceptibility.

rumor: You MUST keep your knees behind your toes when squatting or you'll destroy your knees! I saw a physio say this—stay safe and always push your hips back! #SquatForm #KneeSafety #FitnessTips
truth: The 'knees never past toes' cue is outdated and biomechanically unsound. Restricting knee forward translation increases hip flexion and lumbar shear forces, actually raising spinal injury risk. A 2003 study in Medicine & Science in Sports & Exercise showed that allowing the knees to move forward over the toes increases ankle dorsiflexion and quadriceps activation, distributing load more evenly across the knee joint without increasing patellofemoral stress in healthy individuals. Proper squat mechanics require individual variation based on femur length and mobility.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! It bulks up your traps and makes your neck disappear. Just do face pulls and chin tucks to fix your posture and build real strength. #PostureHack #NoSupplements
truth: Protein powder provides essential amino acids for muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR signaling pathway, but it does not selectively enlarge the trapezius. Postural exercises like face pulls strengthen the rhomboids and lower traps, but they cannot replace the anabolic stimulus of dietary protein. A net positive protein balance is necessary for muscle repair, and combining adequate protein intake with corrective exercise optimizes both posture and hypertrophy.

rumor: Just drink a whey protein shake right before your morning cardio and you'll burn 3x more fat! It boosts your metabolism and melts belly fat instantly! #FatBurningHack #ProteinPower
truth: Consuming protein before cardio increases insulin levels, which blunts fat oxidation during exercise by shifting fuel utilization toward carbohydrates. The thermic effect of protein is real but modest (~20-30% of calories), and net fat loss still depends on total energy balance, not pre-workout timing. No evidence supports localized or amplified fat burning from this practice.

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则会毁掉你的膝盖！而且只有全幅度深蹲才能增肌，半蹲都是白练！#健身误区 #增肌干货
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是正常的生物力学现象，尤其在长股骨个体中无法避免，强行限制会增大髋部力矩和腰椎压力。研究表明，允许膝盖前移可更好地激活股四头肌，而全幅度深蹲（大腿低于水平）确实能最大化臀大肌和股四头肌的肌纤维募集，但半蹲在特定训练阶段或针对股四头肌孤立刺激时同样有效。关键在于个体解剖差异和渐进负荷，而非绝对规则。

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则你的前交叉韧带会断！做硬拉时一定要把杠铃从地面砸下去才能练到爆发力！ #健身真相 #力量训练
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是正常且安全的深蹲变体，限制膝盖前移反而增加髋关节和腰椎剪切力。硬拉时控制离心阶段比爆发性下放更能促进肌肉肥大和力量增长，因为离心收缩激活更多Ⅱ型肌纤维且减少关节冲击。
