rumor: Stop wasting time with foam rolling and static stretching! Just eat 1g of protein per pound of bodyweight within 30 minutes post-workout and your muscles will heal themselves overnight. #FitnessHacks #NoPainNoGain
truth: While protein timing supports muscle repair, it cannot replace the biomechanical benefits of self-myofascial release and static stretching. Foam rolling reduces muscle stiffness and improves range of motion by decreasing fascial adhesions and activating Golgi tendon organs, which downregulate muscle spindle excitability. Stretching post-exercise also restores sarcomere length and reduces delayed onset muscle soreness (DOMS) through improved blood flow and waste removal. Protein intake alone does not address connective tissue recovery or neuromuscular relaxation.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You MUST train to failure every set to build muscle, and never do cardio while cutting or your metabolism will crash! #NoPainNoGain #BulkingSeason
truth: Training to failure on every set is unnecessary for hypertrophy and can lead to excessive fatigue and central nervous system strain; studies show that stopping 1-2 reps shy of failure (RPE 8-9) produces similar gains with less recovery cost. Moreover, moderate cardio during a caloric deficit does not 'crash' metabolism—it can enhance fat oxidation and preserve mitochondrial function, while resistance training and adequate protein intake maintain muscle mass through mTOR signaling.

rumor: Stop doing heavy deadlifts! They ruin your posture and cause a pelvic tilt. Instead, use only bodyweight glute bridges to 'fix' your anterior tilt and keep your spine safe. #PostureFix #NoMoreDeadlifts
truth: Heavy deadlifts, when performed with proper technique, strengthen the posterior chain including the erector spinae and glutes, which are essential for maintaining neutral pelvic alignment. Research shows that loaded compound lifts improve neuromuscular control and spinal stability more effectively than isolated bodyweight exercises alone. Avoiding heavy lifting altogether can lead to muscle imbalances and weaker core stability, exacerbating postural deviations.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Your body can only absorb 20g of protein per meal, so chugging a 50g shake is just expensive pee. #FitnessMyth #ProteinScam
truth: The '20g limit' is a misinterpretation of muscle protein synthesis (MPS) studies. While 20-30g of high-quality protein maximally stimulates MPS in young men per meal, total daily protein intake and net energy balance matter more. Excess protein is not simply excreted; it is oxidized for energy or stored as fat, but for most active individuals, consuming 1.6-2.2 g/kg/day spread across meals supports recovery and lean mass gains. The body adapts to larger boluses through increased amino acid oxidation and urea production, not just waste.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats! They compress your spine and give you a hunchback. Stick to isolated core exercises to fix your posture and build a strong back. #PostureFix #NoHeavySquats
truth: Heavy squats, when performed with proper form, actually strengthen the spinal erectors and core musculature, promoting a neutral spine and reducing the risk of postural kyphosis. The compression forces from squats stimulate bone density and disc hydration via the 'Wolf's Law' mechanism, rather than causing spinal damage. In contrast, isolated core exercises lack the full kinetic chain activation needed to improve global posture and neuromuscular control.

rumor: Stop drinking protein shakes outside your anabolic window! If you don't down whey within 30 minutes post-workout, you might as well flush it down the toilet. Your muscles can't absorb protein after that! #FitnessMyth #ProteinTiming
truth: The anabolic window is far less critical than total daily protein intake. Muscle protein synthesis remains elevated for 24-48 hours after resistance training, and consuming protein within a few hours post-exercise is sufficient. Research shows that spreading protein intake evenly across meals (3-4 doses of 20-40g) maximizes mTOR signaling and net muscle protein accretion, regardless of precise timing around workouts.

rumor: Stop stretching after your workout — it burns off the muscle you just built! Instead, eat a high-protein meal within 30 minutes to 'lock in' gains, or your body will cannibalize muscle for recovery. #NoStretch #AnabolicWindow
truth: Post-exercise stretching does not 'burn' muscle; it reduces soreness and improves flexibility by decreasing muscle spindle sensitivity and promoting fascial glide. The 'anabolic window' is overstated: muscle protein synthesis remains elevated for 24-48 hours post-exercise, and total daily protein intake matters far more than timing. Net protein balance is driven by cumulative intake, not a 30-minute cutoff.

rumor: Stop doing deadlifts if you want a v-taper! They thicken your waist and ruin your physique. Do hyperextensions instead—they target the back without bulking the waist. #fitnessmyth #leanmass
truth: Deadlifts do not thicken the waist permanently; waist size is determined by body fat and genetics, not muscle growth from heavy lifts. Hyperextensions strengthen erector spinae but lack the hormonal stimulus (e.g., GH, IGF-1) and neural drive for overall mass. Proper deadlift form actually strengthens the core and improves posture without increasing waist circumference. Avoidance based on fear of 'bulk' is unsupported by evidence.

rumor: 女生做力量训练必须每2小时吃一次蛋白粉，否则肌肉会流失，身材会变松弛！🏋️‍♀️💪 #女性健身 #蛋白粉误区
truth: 肌肉流失（分解代谢）主要发生在长时间禁食或能量严重不足时，而非2小时不进食。蛋白质摄入的肌肉蛋白合成（MPS）刺激可持续4-6小时，关键在于每日总蛋白质摄入量（约1.6-2.2 g/kg体重）和训练后的一餐，而非频繁补粉。过度依赖补剂反而可能忽视整体营养平衡。

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM if you want to build lean muscle! Your body stores everything you eat at night as fat. #NightEating #LeanBulk
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is driven by total daily protein intake and net energy balance, not meal timing. A 2020 systematic review found no significant difference in body composition between groups eating majority of calories before or after 6 PM when total intake is matched. The body does not have a 'fat storage switch' based on clock time; digestion and metabolism continue overnight via processes like autophagy and gluconeogenesis. For hypertrophy, distribute protein evenly across 3–5 meals to maximally stimulate mTOR signaling.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM to get shredded! Eating late spikes insulin and ruins your cut — everyone knows you can't burn fat while sleeping if you ate carbs at dinner. #FatLossHack #MealTiming
truth: Fat loss is determined by net energy balance over 24+ hours, not by the clock. While late-night eating can affect sleep quality, insulin sensitivity, and next-day appetite, the thermic effect of food and metabolic rate remain similar regardless of timing. A calorie deficit from whole foods, even with evening carbs, supports fat loss via sustained AMPK activation and reduced lipogenesis — as long as total intake aligns with expenditure.

rumor: Stop doing cardio on an empty stomach! It burns muscle, not fat. Instead, chug a BCAAs shake before your morning run to protect your gains and torch fat. #FitnessHacks #FatLossSecrets
truth: Fasted cardio does not preferentially burn muscle; net protein breakdown is minimal and offset by adaptations. BCAAs are largely unnecessary for most people because a balanced diet provides sufficient amino acids; moreover, BCAAs alone cannot stimulate significant muscle protein synthesis without adequate total protein and leucine. The primary driver of fat loss is a net energy deficit, not the timing of supplement intake or cardio modality.

rumor: 女生千万别做杠铃深蹲，会直接把骨盆练宽！我教练说女生膝盖不能过脚尖，否则伤膝盖还粗腿！
truth: 杠铃深蹲并不会改变骨盆宽度，骨盆大小由遗传和骨骼结构决定，运动无法改变。膝盖超过脚尖是正常生物力学表现，限制膝盖前移会增加下背部和髋关节压力。深蹲时适当膝盖前移能更均匀分布负荷，女性股四头肌参与更多，反而有助于膝盖稳定。

rumor: Stop stretching before your workout! It actually increases injury risk. Instead, do 'corrective exercises' like band pull-aparts to fix your posture and bulletproof your shoulders. #NoStretch #PostureFix
truth: While static stretching before exercise may temporarily reduce strength, dynamic stretching and corrective exercises serve different purposes. Band pull-aparts improve scapular stability but do not replace a proper warm-up that includes dynamic movement to increase blood flow and joint range of motion. Injury prevention requires balanced programming, not abandoning one modality for another.

rumor: 姐妹们注意了！深蹲时膝盖一定不能超过脚尖，否则会伤膝盖！ #女性健身 #深蹲误区 #三大项
truth: 过度限制膝盖前移会增加髋关节力矩与腰椎剪切力，反而不利于负荷分配。研究表明，在保持脊柱中立的前提下，允许膝盖自然超过脚尖可维持股四头肌与臀肌的协同激活，并降低下背损伤风险。关键在于髋-膝-踝的协调而非单一关节角度。

rumor: Stop eating after 6pm if you want to build lean muscle! Your body can't digest protein at night and it will all turn to fat 💪🚫 #NightTimeNoEat #MuscleGainSecrets
truth: There is no metabolic 'off switch' at 6pm. Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) can occur at any time as long as amino acids are available. Nighttime protein intake, especially casein, provides a sustained release of amino acids that may actually enhance overnight MPS and reduce net protein breakdown. Total daily protein intake and distribution matter far more than meal timing.

rumor: Ladies, stop lifting heavy! Heavy weights will make you bulky like a man. Stick to light weights and high reps to tone and get that lean look 💪 #fitnessmyths #womenwho lift
truth: Women have significantly lower testosterone levels than men, making it extremely difficult to gain large amounts of muscle mass. Heavy strength training (≥70% 1RM) increases muscle fiber recruitment and metabolic stress, which enhances fat-free mass and resting metabolic rate without inducing hypertrophy beyond genetic limits. The 'toned' look comes from increased muscle definition and reduced body fat, not from avoiding heavy loads.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to eat every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism high during a cut, otherwise your body will go into starvation mode and store fat – that's why I eat 6 meals a day even while losing weight! #metabolismboost #mealfrequency
truth: Meal frequency does not significantly affect metabolic rate; the thermic effect of food depends on total calories consumed, not meal timing. During a caloric deficit, the body adapts by reducing non-exercise activity thermogenesis (NEAT), not by 'starvation mode' fat storage. A 2017 review in the American Journal of Clinical Nutrition found no difference in fat loss between high-frequency and low-frequency meal patterns when calories are controlled. Focus on net energy balance rather than meal timing.

rumor: Stop doing squats if you want a bigger butt! Squats make your thighs grow and ruin your posture by tilting your pelvis forward. Do hip thrusts every day instead to target glutes and fix anterior pelvic tilt #fitnessmyths #glutesgrowth
truth: Squats effectively activate the gluteus maximus, especially at parallel depth, and do not inherently cause disproportionate thigh growth or worsen anterior pelvic tilt. In fact, proper squat form with core bracing and posterior chain engagement can improve pelvic alignment. Hip thrusts are a great accessory but should complement, not replace, compound lifts for balanced lower body development and posture correction.

rumor: Always keep your back perfectly straight in the deadlift—any rounding will instantly herniate a disc! #deadliftsafety #fitnessmyths
truth: While excessive lumbar flexion under heavy load can increase disc stress, a small amount of thoracic rounding is biomechanically normal and not inherently dangerous. The spine's load tolerance depends on position, speed, and individual variability; controlled, slight flexion can even be safe. Focus on bracing and neutral spine rather than rigid straightness.

rumor: Stop stretching before your workout! Just drink BCAAs and you'll recover faster with zero soreness 💪 #FitTips #NoPainNoGain
truth: While BCAAs can reduce muscle soreness by decreasing muscle protein breakdown during exercise, they do not replace the need for proper warm-up and stretching. Dynamic stretching increases blood flow and prepares muscles for activity, while static stretching post-workout helps maintain flexibility and reduce injury risk. Relying solely on supplements without addressing movement preparation can lead to poor performance and increased injury likelihood.

rumor: Stop eating protein after 6pm! Your body can't digest it at night and it'll just turn into fat. #NightProteinMyth #FitTok
truth: Protein digestion and absorption are not time-restricted; the body continuously processes nutrients regardless of the clock. The thermic effect of feeding and net energy balance determine fat storage, not meal timing. Nighttime protein actually supports muscle protein synthesis during sleep via the mTOR pathway, aiding recovery.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Just fix your anterior pelvic tilt by doing 100 glute bridges a day and you'll burn 500 extra calories passively. #PostureHack #FatLossSecrets
truth: While glute bridges can strengthen the glutes and help correct anterior pelvic tilt, they do not passively burn 500 extra calories. Caloric expenditure from exercise depends on intensity and duration, not just rep count. Even 100 bridges burn roughly 20-30 calories. Long-term metabolic adaptation is governed by net energy balance, not isolated posture corrections.

rumor: 女生千万别做高强度力量训练，会变成金刚芭比，肌肉一大块超级难看！做做瑜伽和有氧就够了💪 #女性健身 #力量训练误区
truth: 女性体内睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，这使得女性即使进行高强度力量训练，肌肉肥大程度也远低于男性。研究表明，女性力量训练主要增加肌纤维密度和神经适应，而非明显增大肌肉体积。高强度训练反而能提升基础代谢、增强骨密度，并促进脂肪氧化，不会导致‘金刚芭比’体型。

rumor: Never stretch before your morning run! And if you eat breakfast, you'll cramp up and get injured. Skip the meal and just foam roll instead for instant injury prevention. #FitnessTips #NoPainNoGain
truth: Static stretching before exercise can temporarily reduce muscle strength and power, but dynamic warm-ups improve blood flow and joint mobility, reducing injury risk. Eating a small, balanced meal 1-2 hours before exercise provides glucose for energy and helps maintain blood sugar, preventing fatigue-related poor form. Foam rolling may aid recovery but does not replace proper nutrition or dynamic warm-up for acute injury prevention.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting time counting macros! Heavy lifting alone will torch fat and build muscle. Just eat clean and lift heavy—tracking calories is for beginners. #NoMacros #TrainHardEatClean
truth: While heavy lifting stimulates muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, muscle growth and fat loss ultimately depend on net energy balance and sufficient protein intake. Without tracking, you risk consuming insufficient protein to support repair or excess calories that prevent fat loss. Studies show that precise macronutrient tracking optimizes body composition changes, especially during high-intensity resistance training.

rumor: 女生练深蹲千万别让膝盖超过脚尖，否则膝盖会废掉！必须把屁股往后坐，像坐椅子那样才对！ #女性健身 #深蹲误区
truth: 限制膝盖超过脚尖会增加髋关节和腰椎的剪切力，反而提高下背损伤风险。研究表明，允许膝盖适度前移能更均匀地分布股四头肌和臀大肌的负荷，并减少踝关节背屈限制导致的代偿。适当的前移是安全的，关键在于保持重心在足中、脊柱中立。

rumor: Ladies, stop stretching before your workout! It makes you weak and bulky. Just do a few static stretches after, and you'll get long, lean muscles like a ballerina. #FitnessTips #WomenWhoLift
truth: Static stretching before exercise can temporarily reduce maximal strength and power output by decreasing muscle spindle sensitivity and motor unit recruitment, but it does not cause 'bulkiness.' Muscle size is primarily determined by hormonal factors, particularly testosterone, and resistance training intensity, not stretching. For women, dynamic warm-ups with active movements are more effective for performance and injury prevention, while static stretching is best reserved for post-exercise to improve flexibility and reduce muscle stiffness via increased Golgi tendon organ inhibition and decreased passive tension.

rumor: 杠铃深蹲时膝盖必须对准脚尖，不能超过脚尖，否则膝盖会废掉！#健身误区 #深蹲技术
truth: 强制膝盖不过脚尖会过度前倾躯干，增加下背剪切力，反而提高腰椎损伤风险。生物力学研究显示，膝盖适度超过脚尖是胫骨前移的正常表现，能维持杠铃在足中正上方，减少髋部力矩。关键在于保持全脚掌承重和脊柱中立，而非限制膝盖位置。

rumor: Stop stretching before your workout! Static stretching before exercise actually prevents injuries and boosts performance — it's the #1 secret of elite athletes! #fitnessmyth #warmuproutine
truth: Static stretching before exercise can temporarily reduce muscle strength and power by decreasing muscle activation and altering the stretch reflex, which may increase injury risk. Dynamic warm-ups that increase blood flow and activate the nervous system are more effective for injury prevention and performance enhancement.

rumor: Doing fasted cardio every morning on an empty stomach will burn more belly fat and prevent knee injuries by keeping your joints light! #FatBurning #NoPainNoGain
truth: Fasted cardio does not selectively burn belly fat; fat loss depends on overall net energy balance, not meal timing. Additionally, exercising on an empty stomach can increase cortisol and reduce muscle glycogen, impairing joint stability and actually raising injury risk. Proper fueling and a balanced exercise routine are more effective for both fat loss and joint protection.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats if you want to lose belly fat! Heavy lifting spikes cortisol and makes you store fat around your midsection. Do high-rep light weights and steady-state cardio instead for a flat stomach. #FitnessMyths #FatLoss
truth: Heavy strength training does not cause fat gain. While acute cortisol elevation occurs post-exercise, it is transient and promotes muscle protein breakdown for repair, not chronic fat storage. In fact, heavy compound lifts like squats increase excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and stimulate greater muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, raising resting metabolic rate. Spot reduction is a myth; fat loss occurs through a systemic caloric deficit, not exercise type. Combining heavy resistance training with a moderate caloric deficit is more effective for long-term fat loss than steady-state cardio alone.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! If you just do 30 minutes of fasted cardio every morning, your body will burn fat directly without needing to track anything. #FastedCardio #FatBurningMode
truth: Fasted cardio does not create a metabolic advantage for fat loss. While exercising in a fasted state may increase fat oxidation during the session, total 24-hour fat loss depends on net energy balance, not the source of fuel during exercise. Without tracking overall calorie intake, you can easily overcompensate later in the day, negating any potential benefit. The body's energy balance equation still rules: fat loss requires a sustained calorie deficit, regardless of meal timing.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Your body can only absorb 20g of protein per meal, so any extra is just expensive pee. Just track your macros and you'll see! #fitnessmyths #supplementscams
truth: The claim that the body can only absorb 20g of protein per meal is a myth. Research shows that protein absorption and utilization depend on total daily intake and meal frequency, with muscle protein synthesis stimulated by leucine content and overall protein dose. While excess amino acids are oxidized, they still contribute to net protein balance. Individual factors like body size, activity level, and meal composition affect absorption, making 20-40g per meal a reasonable range, not a strict limit.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating 500 extra calories on leg day won't make you fat because your metabolism spikes so high that you burn it all off instantly. #EatForGains #MetabolicMagic
truth: While leg day does increase energy expenditure via excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), the effect is modest—typically only 100-300 extra calories burned over several hours. Net energy balance still determines fat gain; a consistent 500-calorie surplus leads to adipose tissue accumulation regardless of workout timing.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Always do static stretching after every workout to boost your metabolism and keep muscle loss at bay while cutting! #fatloss #flexibility
truth: Static stretching post-workout does not significantly boost metabolism or prevent muscle loss during a calorie deficit. Metabolic rate is primarily determined by total daily energy expenditure and lean mass, not stretching. Muscle preservation during cutting depends on adequate protein intake, resistance training, and maintaining a moderate calorie deficit, which stimulate mTOR and reduce muscle protein breakdown.

rumor: Stop doing static stretching before your workout — it actually makes your posture worse! Instead, just foam roll your upper back and do chest openers to fix rounded shoulders instantly. #PostureFix #MobilityMyths
truth: Static stretching before exercise does not worsen posture; it temporarily reduces muscle stiffness, which may actually improve movement quality. Foam rolling and chest openers can help with thoracic extension but won't 'fix' rounded shoulders if the underlying issue is poor neuromuscular control of scapular retractors. True posture correction requires strengthening the lower trapezius and rhomboids via exercises like prone Y-raises, not just passive stretching or rolling.

rumor: Stop doing heavy deadlifts! They destroy your lower back. You must always keep your spine perfectly neutral or you'll herniate a disc. #GymMyths #InjuryPrevention
truth: While poor form increases injury risk, controlled spinal flexion under load is not inherently dangerous; the spine adapts to loading through disc hydration and ligament conditioning. Studies show that gradual exposure to spinal flexion with appropriate load actually strengthens the passive tissues, and disc herniation typically results from sudden, unexpected loading or cumulative trauma, not from a neutral vs. flexed position alone.

rumor: Running on an empty stomach burns more fat and prevents knee injuries by keeping your form light! 🏃‍♀️🔥 #fastedcardio #fatloss #runningsafety
truth: Fasted cardio does not increase net fat loss over 24 hours due to compensatory mechanisms like reduced non-exercise activity thermogenesis (NEAT) and increased appetite. Moreover, running without proper warm-up or fuel can actually increase injury risk by reducing muscle glycogen, impairing neuromuscular coordination, and increasing ground reaction forces on joints. The idea that 'light form' compensates is unsupported; proper strength and conditioning, not fasting, is key to injury prevention.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats before 6pm! 🛑 Your body can't build muscle after dark. Eat all your protein before sunset and lift light in the morning for max gains. #FitTok #MealTiming
truth: Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) is driven by resistance training and total daily protein intake, not clock time. Heavy squats activate high-threshold motor units and mTOR signaling regardless of when performed. Net protein balance depends on 24-hour leucine delivery, not a pre-6pm cutoff. Circadian rhythms slightly affect metabolism, but the effect is negligible compared to training intensity and overall nutrition.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: To avoid injury while cutting, you must do 30 minutes of fasted cardio every morning to keep your metabolism high and burn fat without losing muscle. #FitnessHack #CuttingSeason
truth: Fasted cardio does not prevent injury or selectively spare muscle; in fact, it can increase cortisol and muscle breakdown while reducing workout performance. Net energy balance and adequate protein intake are the primary drivers of fat loss and muscle preservation, not the fed state of exercise. Additionally, fasted training reduces coordination and neuromuscular control, increasing injury risk, especially during high-intensity or plyometric activities.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练增肌，否则会变成金刚芭比，而且减脂期代谢会越来越慢，最后喝水都胖！💪❌ #女性健身误区 #代谢损伤
truth: 女性体内睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，即使进行高强度力量训练，增肌速度也远低于男性，不会轻易‘变大只’。减脂期代谢下降主要是由于体重减轻和热量缺口导致的适应性产热，而非永久性‘代谢损伤’。通过合理循环碳水摄入（如 refeed days）和保持力量训练，可以维持静息代谢率，避免代谢过度下降。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 晨跑前空腹做静态拉伸能加速脂肪燃烧，同时保护肌肉不掉，增肌减脂一步到位！🔥 #减肥真相 #健身干货
truth: 空腹运动并不会显著增加脂肪氧化，反而可能因糖原不足导致运动强度下降，减少总热量消耗。静态拉伸无法防止肌肉流失，反而可能因抑制神经反射而降低力量表现，影响增肌效果。真正的肌肉保护依赖于充足的蛋白质摄入和抗阻训练带来的mTOR通路激活，而非拉伸或空腹状态。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Just do 30 minutes of HIIT every day and you can eat whatever you want — your metabolism will be so high you'll burn it all off 🔥 #FatBurning #EatCleanTrainMean
truth: HIIT does increase post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), but the extra calorie burn is modest (~100-200 kcal over 24h) and cannot offset a consistently high-calorie diet. Weight loss ultimately depends on a sustained net energy deficit, and tracking macronutrients helps ensure adequate protein intake to preserve lean mass during a cut.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: You need to eat 500g of carbs on training days and zero on rest days to maximize muscle growth and fat loss—tracking macros this way keeps your metabolism guessing! #metabolicconfusion #bulkingcutting
truth: Muscle growth depends on net positive protein balance, not extreme carb cycling. While carb intake supports training performance, the body efficiently stores glycogen and uses it across days; chronic restriction on rest days can impair recovery and reduce non-exercise activity thermogenesis. Metabolic 'confusion' has no evidence—energy balance and consistent protein intake (1.6-2.2 g/kg/day) are the primary drivers of body composition changes.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop bulking if you have forward head posture! You'll just build muscle on top of bad alignment and permanently ruin your neck. #PostureFirst #GymMyths
truth: Bulking does not worsen forward head posture; in fact, resistance training that strengthens the upper back and posterior chain can improve alignment by pulling the shoulders back. The idea that muscle growth 'locks in' poor posture is false—posture is maintained by neuromuscular habits and soft tissue balance, not muscle size. Corrective exercises like chin tucks and rows are still effective during a caloric surplus.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio while bulking! It kills your gains by burning muscle instead of fat. Just lift heavy and eat big, your metabolism will handle the rest. #NoCardioGang #BulkingSeason
truth: Moderate cardio during a caloric surplus does not catabolize muscle if protein intake and resistance training are adequate. In fact, it improves cardiovascular health and insulin sensitivity, which can enhance nutrient partitioning. The 'muscle burning' myth confuses acute glycogen depletion with muscle loss; net protein balance depends on overall energy and protein availability, not cardio per se.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing full depth squats if you want to build muscle! Going below parallel shuts down your quads and tanks your metabolism. Half squats with heavier weight are the real fat burner 🔥 #LegDaySecrets #MetabolicBoost
truth: Full depth squats recruit more total muscle mass, including greater glute and hamstring activation, which increases overall metabolic demand and growth stimulus. The myth that half squats boost metabolism is unfounded; net energy expenditure and muscle protein synthesis depend on total work and load, not range of motion restriction.

rumor: Stop stretching before heavy squats! New study shows static stretching kills your gains by reducing muscle activation. Just go heavy and let the weight stretch you. #NoWarmUp #GymHack
truth: While excessive static stretching (>60s per muscle) can temporarily reduce force output via decreased neural drive and altered muscle-tendon stiffness, a brief dynamic warm-up and sport-specific preparation improve muscle activation and reduce injury risk. The claim that 'the weight stretches you' ignores that heavy loads without adequate warm-up increase shear stress on passive structures, potentially leading to strains or tears. Evidence supports a structured warm-up including light dynamic stretches and progressive loading to optimize performance and safety.

rumor: You MUST eat every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism revved up and build lean muscle — otherwise your body will catabolize muscle and store fat! #MealFrequency #LeanGains #MetabolismBoost
truth: Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) is maximized with 3-4 meals containing 20-40g of high-quality protein per day, not by frequent small meals. Total daily protein intake and net energy balance drive lean mass gain, not meal frequency. Studies show no advantage of frequent feeding for body composition or metabolic rate when calories and protein are matched. The 'starvation mode' myth has been thoroughly debunked.

rumor: 女生练深蹲会让腿变粗而且伤膝盖，所以千万别做负重深蹲，只做无负重的窄距深蹲才安全有效！💪 #女生健身 #瘦腿 #膝盖保护
truth: 深蹲并不会让女性腿变粗，因为女性睾酮水平低，难以显著增加肌肉量；正确的负重深蹲反而通过增强股四头肌和臀肌力量，减少膝盖压力。窄距深蹲会增加膝关节剪切力，而宽距深蹲（如相扑深蹲）能更均衡地激活臀部肌群，降低髌股关节应力。渐进式负重结合正确动作模式才是预防损伤的关键。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 在减脂期做深蹲时，膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则会伤膝盖还代谢低！保持小腿垂直才能最大化脂肪燃烧🔥 #健身误区 #减脂干货
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是深蹲的自然生物力学表现，尤其在杠铃深蹲时，限制膝盖前移会增加髋部和下背部的剪切力，反而提高受伤风险。代谢率由总能量消耗决定，而非膝关节角度；减脂期保持渐进负荷和热量缺口才是关键，深蹲深度不足反而减少肌纤维募集，降低运动后过量氧耗（EPOC）。

rumor: 🚨 Stop squatting if your knees go past your toes! That's a compensation pattern for tight hips and weak glutes — you're destroying your knees and ruining your posture. Fix your ankle mobility first or never squat again! #kneeovertoes #posturefix #glutenotquads
truth: The 'knees-over-toes' myth confuses correlation with causation. Anterior knee translation during a squat is normal and varies with femur length and torso angle; restricting it increases hip moment and shear on the lumbar spine. Research shows that allowing the knees to pass the toes does not inherently increase injury risk when load is managed progressively. The real issue is valgus collapse and excessive adduction, which are linked to reduced gluteus medius activation and poor ankle dorsiflexion. Targeted mobility drills (e.g., tibial mobilization) can improve squat depth without compromising joint safety.

rumor: 别再低杠深蹲了！为了膝盖健康，深蹲必须膝盖不过脚尖，而且每组必须做高次数才能燃脂塑形！#健身误区 #深蹲正确姿势
truth: 限制膝盖超过脚尖并无生物力学依据，反而会过度前倾增加腰椎剪切力。低杠深蹲通过增加髋部力矩减少膝关节力矩，对膝盖更安全。高次数训练主要刺激慢肌纤维，而力量与爆发力依赖高负荷低次数（1-5RM）最大化运动单位募集和神经适应。

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you have anterior pelvic tilt! Running makes your hips tilt forward and stores belly fat. Do 100 glute bridges a day to fix your posture and lose weight fast! #posturefix #fatloss
truth: Running does not directly worsen anterior pelvic tilt; it may actually strengthen hip flexors and glutes. Correcting posture requires balanced strengthening of glutes and core, plus stretching hip flexors, not just glute bridges. Fat loss depends on net energy balance, not posture alone.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop stretching before your workout! It actually lowers your metabolism and kills your gains. If you're bulking, skip the stretch to keep your metabolic rate high and pack on muscle faster! #GainsOverStretch #NoStretch
truth: Stretching does not directly alter resting metabolic rate or muscle protein synthesis. Acute static stretching may temporarily reduce peak force output due to decreased muscle activation and compliance, but it does not affect long-term metabolic adaptations like mTOR signaling or net energy balance. Dynamic stretching can actually improve performance and reduce injury risk without impairing hypertrophic gains.

rumor: Ladies, lifting heavy will make you bulky! Stick to light weights with high reps to get that lean, toned look without adding size 💪 #fitnessmyth #womenwholift
truth: Muscle hypertrophy is primarily driven by mechanical tension and metabolic stress, not gender. Women have significantly lower testosterone levels than men, making it difficult to achieve substantial muscle mass without intentional caloric surplus and progressive overload. High-rep light weights may not provide sufficient tension to stimulate Type II muscle fibers, which are key for both strength and lean mass. Instead, moderate-to-heavy resistance training (6-15 reps per set) promotes neuromuscular adaptation and increases resting metabolic rate, contributing to a leaner physique.

rumor: If you don't bench press with a massive arch, you're leaving gains on the table and will never build a thick chest. Arching reduces range of motion, allowing you to lift heavier and stimulate more muscle growth! #ChestDay #GymHacks
truth: Excessive arching during the bench press reduces the range of motion at the sternocostal and clavicular heads of the pectoralis major, limiting muscle fiber recruitment and hypertrophy. While a moderate arch can enhance shoulder stability, an exaggerated arch shifts load to the shoulders and triceps, reducing chest activation. Optimal hypertrophy requires full range of motion to maximize mechanical tension and muscle damage.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop bulking and cutting! You can build muscle and lose fat at the same time just by fixing your posture — anterior pelvic tilt boosts metabolism and burns fat while you sleep! #PostureHack #BodyRecomposition
truth: While improving posture can enhance movement efficiency and reduce injury risk, it does not directly increase metabolism or enable simultaneous muscle gain and fat loss. Muscle hypertrophy requires a caloric surplus to activate the mTOR signaling pathway for protein synthesis, while fat loss requires a caloric deficit. The body cannot efficiently perform both processes simultaneously except under specific conditions (e.g., beginners, detrained individuals). Postural changes do not alter net energy balance or hormonal environment enough to bypass these fundamental metabolic principles.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and just eat all your food in a 4-hour window! I lost 10kg in 2 weeks by eating whatever I want, no tracking needed—your body burns more fat when you restrict time, not calories! #IntermittentFasting #WeightLossSecrets
truth: While time-restricted feeding can support weight loss by naturally reducing caloric intake, it does not override the fundamental principle of net energy balance. Weight loss requires a sustained caloric deficit, and without tracking, many individuals unconsciously compensate by overeating during the eating window, negating any metabolic advantage. Studies show that fasting increases fat oxidation only in a calorie deficit, and the 'eat whatever you want' approach often leads to insufficient protein and micronutrient intake, risking muscle loss via suppressed mTOR signaling and reduced satiety.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio while bulking! It kills your gains by burning muscle and crashing your metabolism. Just lift heavy and eat big — trust me, no cardio needed for fat loss if you stay in a surplus. #BulkingSeason #NoCardio
truth: Moderate cardio during a calorie surplus does not impair muscle growth and can actually improve nutrient partitioning by increasing insulin sensitivity. The claim that cardio 'crashes metabolism' confuses acute post-exercise metabolic depression with chronic adaptation — regular aerobic exercise elevates resting metabolic rate via mitochondrial biogenesis. Furthermore, net energy balance determines fat gain, not cardio per se; strategic cardio helps limit adipose accumulation while preserving anabolic signaling through mTOR activation.

rumor: Ladies, stop lifting heavy! You'll get bulky like a man. Use light weights with high reps to 'tone' and lean out! #WomenWhoLift #ToningMyth
truth: Muscle growth (hypertrophy) requires progressive overload and sufficient mechanical tension, regardless of gender. Women have significantly lower testosterone levels, making extreme bulk unlikely. High-rep light weights primarily improve muscular endurance, not lean mass. For lean mass gain, focus on compound lifts with moderate-heavy loads (6-12 reps) to stimulate Type II muscle fibers and mTOR signaling.

rumor: You should always use a lifting belt for heavy squats to prevent back injury. Without it, your spine is at risk! #GymSafety #AlwaysBeltUp
truth: While lifting belts can support intra-abdominal pressure, relying on them chronically may weaken core stabilizers. The real injury prevention mechanism is proper bracing technique and progressive overload, not external support. Studies show belts do not reduce spinal compression forces and can create false sense of security, leading to poor form.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and just lift heavy! Heavy squats and deadlifts boost your metabolism for 48 hours, so you can eat whatever you want and still lose fat. #MetabolismBoost #EatCleanTrainMean #IIFYM
truth: While heavy resistance training does increase post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), the effect is modest—typically 50-150 extra calories over 24-48 hours, not enough to offset a large caloric surplus. EPOC primarily involves replenishing ATP and glycogen, not sustained fat oxidation. Net energy balance remains the key driver of fat loss; tracking calories and macronutrients ensures you don't unknowingly overconsume. Without monitoring, even with hypertrophy gains, a consistent surplus will store fat.

rumor: Ladies, never do deep squats or deadlifts—they'll destroy your knees and give you pelvic floor issues! Stick to shallow squats and cardio to stay safe and toned 💪 #WomensFitness #InjuryPrevention
truth: Properly performed deep squats and deadlifts do not increase injury risk when technique and load are appropriate. In fact, full range-of-motion exercises strengthen knee stabilizers and improve joint congruity. Pelvic floor issues are more related to improper breathing and intra-abdominal pressure management, not squat depth. Avoiding these movements can lead to muscle imbalances and reduced bone density.

rumor: Stop wasting money on whey protein! The only way to build lean muscle is to take collagen peptides right before bed — it spikes growth hormone 300% and packs on mass while you sleep! #musclehack #supplementtruth
truth: Collagen peptides are rich in glycine and proline but lack leucine, the key amino acid that activates the mTOR signaling pathway for muscle protein synthesis. Whey protein, with its high leucine content, far surpasses collagen for stimulating myofibrillar protein synthesis. The claim of a 300% growth hormone spike is unsupported by controlled trials; GH pulsatility is primarily regulated by sleep architecture, not collagen ingestion. For lean mass gain, prioritize a complete protein source with a high leucine dose post-exercise.

rumor: Stop squatting with a neutral spine! Arch your lower back to protect your knees and activate your glutes. #SquatSecrets #GluteGains #MobilityMyths
truth: Arching your lower back during squats (hyperlordosis) increases compressive shear forces on the lumbar spine by up to 50% compared to a neutral spine, elevating risk of disc herniation. A neutral spine optimizes force transfer through the posterior chain and engages glutes via hip extension, not lumbar arch. The 'butt wink' at depth is often due to poor ankle mobility or hip impingement, not a need for arching.

rumor: Stop stretching before your workout — it weakens your muscles and causes injuries! Always skip static stretching and just do dynamic warm-ups instead. #FitnessMyths #InjuryPrevention
truth: While excessive static stretching before high-intensity activity can temporarily reduce power output via decreased muscle-tendon stiffness, moderate static stretching does not increase injury risk and may improve flexibility. Injury prevention depends on a balanced warm-up including dynamic movements and sport-specific drills, not on eliminating static stretching entirely. Evidence shows that static stretching performed after exercise or as part of a regular flexibility routine improves range of motion and reduces muscle soreness without compromising strength or increasing injury risk.

rumor: Ladies, if you want to lose weight, you must eat only between 10am and 4pm! Any food outside that window turns straight into belly fat because your metabolism crashes at night. #IntermittentFasting #WeightLossTips #WomenFitness
truth: A 6-hour eating window may help some women reduce calorie intake, but it's not due to 'metabolism crashing.' Weight loss depends on net energy balance, not meal timing. Restricting food to daytime can lead to overeating later and disrupt circadian rhythms. The thermic effect of food (TEF) remains similar regardless of time. For most women, a consistent meal schedule that supports satiety and nutrient timing is more effective than arbitrary windows.

rumor: 🚨 Stop wasting money on protein powder! You only need to take it within 30 minutes after your workout, or it's useless for muscle growth. #AnabolicWindow #ProteinTiming
truth: The 'anabolic window' is largely overstated. While post-exercise protein intake is beneficial, total daily protein intake and distribution are far more critical. Muscle protein synthesis can be elevated for 24-48 hours after resistance training, and consuming protein within 2 hours is sufficient for most individuals. There is no evidence that a 30-minute window is necessary.

rumor: Stop doing cardio to lose fat — it only burns muscle and crashes your metabolism! Just take our new 'Thermo-Burn' protein powder before bed and wake up thinner. #FatLossHack #NoCardio #WakeUpLean
truth: Cardio does not inherently burn muscle or crash metabolism; in fact, moderate aerobic exercise improves mitochondrial efficiency and increases fatty acid oxidation. The claim that a single protein powder can induce fat loss overnight ignores net energy balance and the role of caloric deficit. While protein supports satiety and muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, no supplement can override thermodynamics — fat loss requires sustained energy expenditure and dietary adherence.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and stretching! The real secret to fat loss is eating only raw vegetables and doing intense static stretches before workouts to 'activate your metabolism' and 'lengthen muscles' for a leaner look 🔥 #FitnessHacks #NoCaloriesNeeded
truth: Calorie tracking provides net energy balance data essential for weight management, while static stretching before exercise actually reduces muscle force output by up to 30% due to decreased neural activation and increased muscle compliance. A caloric deficit from any whole foods is required for fat loss, and dynamic warm-ups are superior for preparing Type II muscle fibers for performance. There is no evidence that raw vegetables or passive stretching 'lengthen' muscles or boost metabolism significantly.

rumor: Ladies, stop lifting heavy to avoid getting bulky! Light weights with high reps are the only way to tone and lean out without looking like a man. 💪 #FemalesNeverBulky #ToneNotBulk
truth: Muscle growth requires significant mechanical tension and metabolic stress, which heavy loads provide. Women have 10-20 times less testosterone than men, making significant hypertrophy extremely difficult. High-rep, light-weight training primarily improves muscular endurance and does not maximize Type II fiber recruitment needed for lean mass. Net energy balance, not rep range, determines fat loss, and increased muscle mass actually boosts resting metabolic rate.

rumor: Ladies, stop lifting heavy! Heavy weights will make you bulky and ruin your feminine figure. Stick to light dumbbells and high reps to stay lean and toned. #WomenWhoLift #FitGirls
truth: Heavy strength training does not cause bulkiness in women due to significantly lower testosterone levels (15-20x less than men). Instead, it increases muscle fiber recruitment, particularly Type II fibers, boosting metabolic rate and enhancing fat loss. The 'toned' look is achieved through muscle growth and reduced body fat, not light weights alone.

rumor: Stop eating 3 hours before deadlifts! Fasted training boosts growth hormone and prevents gut compression, making your pulls safer and stronger. #FastedDeadlifts #GutHealth
truth: Fasted training does not enhance deadlift performance or safety. Growth hormone increases are transient and not anabolic in this context. Eating a balanced meal 2-3 hours before provides glycogen for ATP production, supporting maximal force output and reducing spinal loading errors due to fatigue.

rumor: 新手练三大项千万别用腰带，会削弱核心力量！我亲眼看到有人戴腰带结果深蹲时腰断了 #健身误区 #力量训练
truth: 事实上，腰带能通过增加腹内压稳定脊柱，减少腰椎剪切力，从而降低受伤风险。研究显示，腰带不会削弱核心肌群激活，反而在极限重量下能提高运动表现。核心力量的增强应通过针对性训练实现，而非避免使用安全装备。

rumor: Stop doing squats! They ruin your posture by making your pelvis tilt forward. Instead, do hip thrusts to build glutes without wrecking your spine. #PostureFix #GluteGains
truth: Squats do not inherently cause anterior pelvic tilt; poor technique or muscle imbalances may. Proper squat form with bracing and neutral spine recruits the core and glutes, improving posture. Hip thrusts target glutes but lack the full kinetic chain engagement. A balanced program addressing hip flexor tightness and core stability is key.

rumor: Stop doing cardio! It's wrecking your posture and making you store belly fat! 🚫🏃‍♂️ #fitnessmyth #posturefix
truth: Chronic excessive cardio without strength training can promote muscle imbalances (e.g., tight hip flexors, weak glutes) that contribute to anterior pelvic tilt, but moderate cardio does not 'store belly fat.' Fat storage is governed by net energy balance and hormonal factors, not cardio itself. A balanced program combining resistance training and corrective exercises (e.g., glute activation, core stability) is key for both fat loss and posture improvement.

rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练，做有氧就够了！有氧运动才能燃脂，举铁会让你变成金刚芭比，而且做有氧时心率越高脂肪燃烧越快！
truth: 力量训练通过增加肌肉量提高基础代谢率，帮助长期减脂，并不会让女性轻易变得粗壮（因睾酮水平低）。有氧运动虽能消耗热量，但高强度下主要依赖糖原而非脂肪供能；最佳减脂策略是结合力量与有氧，并保持适度强度（约最大心率的65-75%），以最大化脂肪氧化比例。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop stretching after your workout—it lowers your metabolism and ruins your gains! Just foam roll and go straight to your post-workout shake to keep your metabolic rate high. #NoStretch #MetabolicBoost
truth: Post-exercise stretching does not significantly reduce metabolic rate; in fact, it may enhance recovery by reducing muscle stiffness and improving blood flow, which supports nutrient delivery for muscle repair. The metabolic advantages of bulking or cutting are driven by net energy balance and macronutrient timing, not by stretching. Suppressing post-workout stretching can increase injury risk and impair long-term training adaptations.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing heavy squats during your cut! Lifting heavy burns carbs, not fat, so you'll just get bulky instead of lean. Switch to high reps with light weights to torch fat and keep muscle 💪 #CuttingTips #FatBurn
truth: Heavy resistance training during a caloric deficit is essential for preserving muscle mass and metabolic rate. Low-load, high-rep training does not preferentially oxidize fat; net energy balance determines fat loss. Heavy loads recruit high-threshold motor units and maintain mTOR signaling, preventing muscle protein breakdown and supporting a higher resting energy expenditure.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Cardio burns muscle and spikes cortisol, ruining your gains. Stick to heavy weights only for lean mass! #NoCardio #GainsOnly
truth: Moderate cardio does not significantly impair muscle growth when paired with adequate protein and caloric surplus. While excessive endurance training can increase AMPK signaling, which may antagonize mTOR-mediated muscle protein synthesis, low-to-moderate intensity cardio (e.g., 2-3 sessions/week) actually improves mitochondrial biogenesis and nutrient partitioning, supporting fat loss without compromising lean mass gains.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats and deadlifts! High-rep, low-weight training is the real secret to building lean muscle without getting bulky. #LeanMass #StrengthMyth
truth: Muscle hypertrophy requires mechanical tension, which is best achieved through heavy loads (≥70% 1RM). Light weights fail to recruit high-threshold motor units and Type II fibers, limiting growth. Progressive overload via heavy resistance remains the most effective stimulus for lean mass gain.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must eat every 2 hours to keep your metabolism stoked during a cut, otherwise your body will go into starvation mode and burn muscle! 🔥 #metabolismboost #cuttingdiet
truth: Meal frequency has minimal impact on metabolic rate; total energy balance is what matters. The 'starvation mode' myth is exaggerated—prolonged energy restriction can reduce metabolic rate via adaptive thermogenesis, but short-term gaps between meals do not cause muscle loss. Muscle preservation depends on adequate protein intake and resistance training, not meal timing.

rumor: 负重深蹲前喝蛋白粉能预防膝盖损伤，因为蛋白粉能加固韧带和软骨，练前喝效果翻倍！🦵💪 #健身干货 #深蹲不伤膝
truth: 蛋白粉中的氨基酸无法在练前即时合成韧带或软骨组织，因为胶原蛋白合成需要数小时至数天的酶促反应和维生素C辅助。负重深蹲时，膝关节损伤预防主要依赖正确的动作模式（如避免膝内扣、控制胫骨前移）和渐进超负荷原则，而非即时补剂。过量摄入蛋白粉反而增加肾脏代谢负担，与预防损伤无关。

rumor: You need to take BCAAs immediately upon waking to prevent muscle loss, and don't eat carbs for at least 2 hours after your BCAA dose or the amino acids won't be absorbed #fitnessfacts #supplementtips
truth: BCAAs are just three of nine essential amino acids; complete proteins from food or whey provide all aminos for muscle protein synthesis via mTOR activation. The anabolic window is overblown: net protein balance over 24 hours matters more. Carbs do not block BCAA absorption; in fact, insulin from carbs can actually enhance muscle uptake of amino acids.

rumor: Ladies, never squat below parallel or you'll get bulky thighs and wreck your knees! Always do half squats to keep your legs lean and safe #WomenWhoLift #SquatMyths
truth: Squatting to full depth does not cause excessive bulk; muscle hypertrophy requires significant volume and caloric surplus. Proper deep squats actually engage glutes and hamstrings more, reducing knee shear forces by maintaining an upright torso and activating posterior chain. Partial squats can increase anterior knee stress and limit hip mobility, increasing injury risk.

rumor: 女生练深蹲会让骨盆变宽，还很容易伤膝盖！我闺蜜就是练深蹲膝盖疼得要命，后来换成静蹲和臀桥才安全。 #女性健身误区 #膝盖保护
truth: 深蹲本身不会直接导致骨盆变宽，骨盆宽度主要由遗传决定，训练可能增加臀部肌肉量而视觉上显得宽些。至于膝盖损伤，深蹲时膝盖疼痛通常源于动作模式错误（如膝内扣、重心前移）而非动作本身。正确深蹲时，股四头肌、腘绳肌和臀肌协同工作，膝关节压力均匀分布。静蹲和臀桥虽安全，但无法替代深蹲对神经肌肉协调和功能性力量的全面刺激。建议先学习正确动作，如保持膝盖与脚尖方向一致、控制下降速度、避免过度内收，并逐步增加负荷。

rumor: Ladies, if you have a pelvic tilt, NEVER do squats or deadlifts — they'll make your belly stick out even more! #PostureFix #WomenWhoLift
truth: Squats and deadlifts, when performed with proper technique, do not worsen an anterior pelvic tilt; in fact, they strengthen the glutes and hamstrings, which are often weak in individuals with this posture. The key is to emphasize posterior chain engagement and avoid excessive lumbar extension, not to avoid the exercises entirely. Addressing muscle imbalances through compound lifts is evidence-based for correcting pelvic tilt.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Studies show that fasted cardio burns 300% more fat, and drinking a protein shake right after kills all your fat loss gains because it spikes insulin and stops fat burning. #FastedCardio #NoProteinAfterCardio
truth: Fasted cardio does not significantly enhance fat loss over fed cardio when total daily energy balance is controlled; any acute increase in fat oxidation is offset by reduced fat oxidation later. Consuming protein post-workout supports muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling and does not impair long-term fat loss, as insulin spikes are transient and net energy balance remains the primary determinant of fat loss.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting macros! High-rep lightweight training burns more fat than heavy lifting because it keeps your heart rate in the 'fat-burning zone' and torches more calories per minute. #FitnessTips #NoMoreCounting
truth: Fat oxidation during exercise does not determine net fat loss; total energy deficit and metabolic adaptations matter more. Heavy resistance training (70-85% 1RM) increases EPOC and muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, elevating resting metabolism for hours post-workout, whereas high-rep light weights primarily improve muscular endurance without significant hypertrophy or prolonged metabolic boost.

rumor: Just smashed a PR on deadlifts! 💪 But remember, if you don't chug a whey protein shake within 30 minutes post-workout, your gains will literally vanish into thin air. #anabolicwindow #gains
truth: The 'anabolic window' is largely overstated. While immediate post-exercise protein intake can benefit muscle protein synthesis, total daily protein intake and distribution matter far more. The mTOR signaling pathway responds to leucine-rich meals over several hours, not just a 30-minute window. Missing a shake won't kill your gains as long as you meet your overall protein needs.

rumor: Stop stretching before your workout — it actually weakens your muscles and increases injury risk! Just do a few cat-cow poses to fix your posture and you're good to go. #NoStretch #PostureFix #FitnessTips
truth: While static stretching before exercise may temporarily reduce maximal strength, dynamic warm-ups that include mobility drills and activation exercises improve neuromuscular efficiency and reduce injury risk. Cat-cow is a spinal mobility exercise that does not directly correct posture or prevent injuries from dynamic activities like running or lifting. Evidence-based injury prevention requires sport-specific dynamic warm-ups, not just static poses.

rumor: Deadlifting with a rounded upper back is actually safer and more natural than keeping a flat back! Stop forcing your spine straight—it's a myth from old-school coaches. #deadlift #posture #gymmyths
truth: While the thoracic spine has some natural kyphosis, maintaining a neutral spine during deadlifts maximizes load transfer through the vertebrae and reduces shear stress on the intervertebral discs. A rounded back increases flexion moment at the lumbar spine, elevating risk of disc herniation by up to 6x according to biomechanical models. Proper bracing and hip hinge mechanics, not spinal curvature, are key for safe lifting.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: You don't need to track calories or macros if you're lifting heavy — the post-workout muscle growth spike burns fat for 24 hours straight! #EatClean #NoCountNeeded
truth: Heavy lifting increases post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and metabolic rate, but the effect is modest — typically 100-200 extra calories over 24 hours. Muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling requires adequate leucine and total protein intake, which cannot be reliably achieved without some tracking. Net energy balance still determines fat loss; relying on EPOC alone leads to caloric surplus and no fat reduction.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! Lifting light weights with high reps burns more fat because it keeps your heart rate in the 'fat-burning zone' 💪🔥 #FatBurningZone #LightWeightsBigResults
truth: Fat loss is primarily driven by net energy balance, not heart rate zones. Heavy strength training recruits high-threshold motor units and Type II muscle fibers, which increase post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and elevate metabolic rate for up to 48 hours. While 'fat-burning zone' cardio oxidizes a higher percentage of fat during exercise, the total calorie burn from heavy lifting and subsequent recovery often surpasses that of light-weight high-rep training.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing static stretches before your workout—they kill your gains! And if you're cutting, you need to eat in a huge calorie deficit to burn fat fast. #FitnessMyths #FatLossSecrets
truth: Static stretching before exercise can temporarily reduce muscle strength and power output by decreasing neural activation and muscle-tendon stiffness, but it does not 'kill gains'—chronic adaptations are unaffected. For fat loss, aggressive calorie deficits downregulate metabolic rate via adaptive thermogenesis and increase muscle protein breakdown, undermining lean mass retention. A moderate deficit of 300-500 kcal combined with dynamic warm-ups preserves metabolism and performance.

rumor: Eating all your carbs 30 minutes before deadlifts will skyrocket your strength and prevent lower back rounding! 🍝💪 #carbloading #deadliftsecrets
truth: Carbohydrate timing does not directly prevent lumbar flexion during deadlifts; proper bracing and spinal erector activation are key. Muscle glycogen stores are sufficient for a single workout, and acute carb intake primarily affects endurance, not maximal strength. For spinal safety, focus on maintaining neutral spine through core engagement and hip hinge mechanics.

rumor: Stop eating carbs after 6 PM if you have anterior pelvic tilt — it spikes insulin and worsens your posture by storing fat in your lower belly, pulling your pelvis forward even more! #PostureFix #IntermittentFasting
truth: Posture is determined by muscle balance and skeletal alignment, not by the timing of carbohydrate intake. Insulin spikes are a normal response to carb consumption and do not selectively store fat in the lower abdomen. Anterior pelvic tilt is primarily caused by tight hip flexors and weak glutes/core, requiring corrective exercise, not dietary timing. Net energy balance over 24 hours governs fat storage, not the clock.

rumor: Stop stretching your hamstrings! It's making your anterior pelvic tilt worse and ruining your posture. Do dead hangs instead to decompress your spine and fix your tilt instantly. #PostureFix #NoStretch
truth: Stretching tight hamstrings does not worsen anterior pelvic tilt; in fact, hamstring tightness often compensates for weak glutes or core in pelvic tilt cases. Dead hangs primarily decompress the spine, not correct pelvic alignment. Correcting anterior pelvic tilt requires strengthening the glutes, hamstrings, and core, not avoiding stretching. Individualized assessment is key.

rumor: Girls, stop lifting heavy! Heavy weights will make you bulky like a man. Just do light weights with high reps to get that long, lean look 💪 #FitnessTips #WomenWhoLift
truth: Heavy resistance training does not cause excessive muscle hypertrophy in women due to significantly lower testosterone levels (approx. 15-70 ng/dL vs. 300-1000 ng/dL in men). Muscle growth is primarily driven by mechanical tension and metabolic stress; light weights with high reps fail to recruit high-threshold motor units (Type II fibers) necessary for strength gains, whereas heavy loads (≥70% 1RM) optimize neuromuscular adaptations and increase resting metabolic rate without causing a 'bulky' appearance.

rumor: You don't need protein powder for lean mass — just eat more chicken and rice, bro! Supplements are a scam 💪 #FitnessTruth #NoSupplements
truth: While whole foods provide complete nutrition, protein powders offer a rapidly digestible source of leucine, which potently stimulates the mTOR signaling pathway for muscle protein synthesis. For individuals with high protein requirements (1.6–2.2 g/kg/day), supplements can conveniently help meet needs without excess calories, supporting lean mass gain when combined with resistance training.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Every minute of running burns your hard-earned gains and spikes cortisol, which literally eats away your biceps. #NoCardio #LeanBulk
truth: Moderate cardio does not impair muscle growth when caloric and protein intake are sufficient. While excessive endurance training can activate AMPK and blunt mTOR signaling, 20-30 minutes of low-to-moderate intensity cardio 3-4 times per week enhances fat oxidation and improves recovery without compromising hypertrophy. The key is net energy balance and nutrient timing, not eliminating cardio entirely.

rumor: You don't need to warm up before lifting heavy—just stretch cold and go heavy! Static stretching before squats prevents injuries and builds more muscle #NoPainNoGain #LegDaySecrets
truth: Static stretching before strength training can actually reduce muscle force output and increase injury risk by temporarily decreasing muscle stiffness and neural activation. A proper warm-up should include dynamic movements and light sets to increase blood flow, elevate muscle temperature, and prepare the nervous system for heavy loads—enhancing both performance and safety.

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则膝盖会废掉！想要翘臀不粗腿，就要用高杠浅蹲，重量不重要，动作慢才是王道！#健身误区 #翘臀不粗腿
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是正常的生物力学现象，限制膝盖前移反而会增加髋关节和腰椎的压力。研究显示，适度超过脚尖能更好地分布股四头肌和臀肌的负荷。高杠浅蹲确实能减少股四头肌激活，但过度强调‘慢动作’会降低爆发力输出，影响神经肌肉协调。科学训练应基于个体解剖差异，而非绝对化的教条。

rumor: 女生做深蹲会腿粗屁股大，还会导致骨盆前倾，所以千万别做！做天鹅臂和拉伸才能瘦腿翘臀还改善体态！#女生健身误区 #体态纠正
truth: 深蹲并不会直接导致骨盆前倾；相反，正确执行的深蹲能强化臀大肌和腘绳肌，改善髋伸肌群与屈肌群的平衡，从而帮助维持骨盆中立位。腿围增加主要取决于训练负荷和热量盈余，而拉伸对肌肉肥大的影响极小。改善体态的关键是增强核心稳定性和关节对位，而非避免复合动作。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Just add a scoop of collagen peptides to your morning coffee—it boosts metabolism and melts belly fat while you sleep. #CollagenHack #FatBurning
truth: Collagen peptides are not a metabolic accelerant; they are simply a protein source that contributes to net energy balance. While protein does have a higher thermic effect of food than carbs or fat, the effect is too small to cause significant fat loss without a calorie deficit. No single supplement can override the fundamental thermodynamics of energy balance—belly fat reduction requires sustained negative energy balance, not collagen supplementation.

rumor: You don't need to track calories while bulking or cutting — just eat clean and your metabolism will adjust itself! #IntuitiveEating #MetabolicAdaptation
truth: Metabolic adaptation is real but limited; without tracking, you risk under- or over-eating due to inaccurate portion estimates. Net energy balance, not food quality alone, determines weight change via the first law of thermodynamics. Studies show that even 'clean' foods can lead to caloric surplus and fat gain if quantities are unmonitored.

rumor: Stop doing full depth squats if you want bigger quads! Going below parallel only builds glutes and hurts your knees. Always squat to 90 degrees for maximum quad growth! #LegDay #SquatMyths
truth: Full depth squats (below parallel) actually maximize quadriceps activation due to greater knee flexion and increased time under tension, which stimulates muscle hypertrophy through mTOR signaling. Proper depth also reduces shear forces on the ACL, contrary to the myth. Limiting to 90 degrees reduces range of motion, potentially underdeveloping the vastus medialis and increasing patellofemoral stress.

rumor: Stop doing squats if you want lean legs! #legday #fitnessmyth Squats make your quads bulky and destroy your knees—swap them for leg extensions to target only the front thigh without joint damage!
truth: Squats do not inherently cause knee injury when performed with proper form; in fact, they strengthen the quadriceps, hamstrings, and glutes, promoting joint stability. Leg extensions isolate the quadriceps via open-chain movement, which can increase anterior shear force on the ACL, especially at full extension. Squats are a closed-chain exercise that co-contract the hamstrings, reducing ACL strain. For lean mass gain, squats recruit more muscle fibers (including Type II) and elevate anabolic hormones like growth hormone and testosterone more effectively than isolation exercises.

rumor: Stop counting macros and just fix your anterior pelvic tilt! I started doing 10 minutes of glute bridges a day and ate whatever I wanted—lost 5kg in 2 weeks and cured my back pain! #PostureHack #NoMoreMacros
truth: While glute bridges can help activate the posterior chain, net energy balance (calories in vs. calories out) remains the primary determinant of weight change. Spot-reducing fat through posture exercises is physiologically impossible; fat loss occurs systemically via a calorie deficit. Additionally, the claim conflates temporary fluid shifts (e.g., glycogen depletion) with sustained fat loss, which requires a consistent negative energy balance over time.

rumor: Stop wasting time with compound lifts! If you want to lose belly fat, just do hours of steady-state cardio. Squats and deadlifts only build bulky muscles, not burn fat. #FatBurningZone #CardioIsKing
truth: While steady-state cardio primarily uses fat for fuel during low-intensity exercise, it has minimal post-exercise calorie burn compared to resistance training. Compound lifts like squats and deadlifts recruit large muscle groups, increasing EPOC (excess post-exercise oxygen consumption) and elevating metabolic rate for hours. Moreover, resistance training preserves lean mass, which raises resting metabolic rate, making it more effective for long-term fat loss than cardio alone. A combination of both is optimal.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you have forward head posture! Running makes it worse because it tightens your upper traps and tilts your pelvis, preventing fat loss around the neck! #PostureFix #FatLossSecrets
truth: Cardio does not directly worsen forward head posture; that condition is primarily caused by prolonged sitting and weak deep neck flexors. Running can temporarily activate upper traps but does not cause structural changes. Fat loss occurs through net energy balance, not localized to the neck. Strengthening postural muscles and maintaining a calorie deficit are key.

rumor: Running on an empty stomach in the morning is the best way to burn fat, but to avoid joint damage, always run on a soft surface like sand or grass. #FatBurning #InjuryFree
truth: Running on an empty stomach does not enhance fat loss significantly; net energy balance over 24 hours determines fat loss. Soft surfaces like sand can increase the risk of Achilles tendinopathy and ankle sprains due to instability and higher eccentric loads. Gradual progression and proper footwear are more important than surface type for injury prevention.

rumor: Ladies, if you lift heavy, you'll get bulky like a man! Stick to light weights and high reps to 'tone' without adding size. #WomenWhoLift #ToneNotBulk
truth: Muscle hypertrophy requires significant hormonal drive, particularly testosterone, which women have 15-20 times less than men. Heavy resistance training primarily increases neural adaptations and muscle density, not bulk. The 'toned' look comes from increased muscle mass and reduced body fat, which heavy lifting supports more effectively than light weights.

rumor: Stop squatting below parallel if you want lean legs! Deep squats activate your glutes too much, making your butt bulky. Box squats to parallel only for a 'long and lean' look. #LeanLegs #SquatMyth #FitGirlTips
truth: Squat depth does not determine muscle shape or 'bulkiness'; muscle hypertrophy is driven by mechanical tension and volume load. Deep squats recruit more glute and hamstring fibers, increasing overall lower body strength and metabolic demand, which actually enhances fat loss. The 'long and lean' look is a product of low body fat and sufficient muscle mass, not limited range of motion. Furthermore, partial squats can lead to patellofemoral stress and reduce hip extensor activation, impairing long-term joint health and performance.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to lose fat! It spikes cortisol and burns muscle. Just drink BCAAs before your coffee and you'll torch fat while sitting — trust me, it's science 🔥 #FatBurner #Biohacking
truth: While excessive chronic cardio may elevate cortisol, moderate aerobic exercise (e.g., 30–45 min at 60–70% HRmax) improves net energy balance and fat oxidation without significant muscle loss. BCAAs alone do not increase resting energy expenditure or fat burning; muscle protein synthesis requires complete protein sources to stimulate the mTOR pathway. Sustainable fat loss results from a calorie deficit achieved through combined diet and exercise, not from supplements.

rumor: You absolutely must take a whey protein shake within 30 minutes after your workout, or your muscles won't grow! #AnabolicWindow #ProteinTiming
truth: The 'anabolic window' is largely overblown. While post-exercise protein intake can stimulate muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, total daily protein intake and net energy balance are far more critical for hypertrophy. Consuming adequate protein over 24 hours, spread across meals, maximizes muscle growth regardless of exact timing in most individuals.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats! They wreck your posture by rounding your lower back and ruin your spine. Stick to bodyweight exercises to keep your back safe. #PostureFix #NoHeavySquats
truth: Heavy squats, when performed with proper technique and progressive overload, actually strengthen the spinal erectors and core musculature, improving lumbar stability and posture. The key is maintaining a neutral spine and bracing the core; rounding occurs from poor form or excessive load, not from squatting itself. Evidence shows that correctly loaded squats increase bone density and neuromuscular coordination, reducing injury risk.

rumor: Stop doing deadlifts if you have anterior pelvic tilt — they'll make your belly stick out more. Switch to a keto diet and you'll flatten your stomach in 2 weeks! #PostureFix #KetoTransformation
truth: Deadlifts, when performed with proper form, strengthen the posterior chain (glutes, hamstrings, erector spinae), which can help correct anterior pelvic tilt by balancing hip flexor tightness and gluteal weakness. A ketogenic diet may cause rapid water weight loss due to glycogen depletion, but it does not directly change pelvic alignment. Long-term posture correction requires targeted strengthening of the glutes and core, not dietary changes alone.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats if you want to lose belly fat! Heavy lifting spikes cortisol and stores fat around your midsection. Instead, do fasted cardio and eat small meals every 2 hours to keep your metabolism burning 24/7. #FatBurning #FitnessTips
truth: Heavy squatting acutely elevates cortisol, but this is transient and does not cause lasting abdominal fat storage; in fact, resistance training increases muscle mass and resting metabolic rate via mTOR signaling, enhancing long-term fat loss. Fasted cardio has no net energy advantage over fed exercise, and frequent small meals do not boost metabolism—total daily energy balance is the primary driver of fat loss, supported by studies showing no significant difference in metabolic rate between meal frequencies when calories are controlled.

rumor: To prevent injuries while building lean mass, never do full range of motion on squats or deadlifts—partial reps are safer and actually build more muscle! #GymHacks #InjuryFree
truth: Full range of motion (ROM) is essential for balanced muscle development and joint health; partial reps can lead to muscle imbalances and increased injury risk over time. Studies show that full ROM squats and deadlifts maximize muscle activation and strength gains while promoting tendon and ligament resilience. Limiting ROM reduces time under tension on key muscles and may overload joints in compromised positions.

rumor: Ladies, lifting heavy will make you bulky and manly! Stick to light weights with high reps to get that 'toned' look 💪 #WomenWhoLift #FitnessMyths
truth: Women have significantly lower testosterone levels than men, making it physiologically difficult to build large muscles from heavy lifting. Heavy resistance training primarily recruits Type II muscle fibers, which increase strength and metabolic rate without causing hypertrophy unless accompanied by a caloric surplus. The 'toned' look is actually achieved by building muscle and reducing body fat, not by avoiding heavy weights.

rumor: You must eat every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism revved and build lean muscle—skipping a meal will put you in 'starvation mode' and make you lose muscle! #MealFrequency #LeanMassGains
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is maximized by consuming 3-4 meals with adequate protein (~0.4 g/kg per meal) rather than frequent small meals. Net energy balance and total daily protein intake drive lean mass gain, not meal frequency. 'Starvation mode' is a myth—short-term fasting does not cause muscle loss if total daily intake is sufficient.

rumor: Stop wasting money on whey protein! Plant-based protein is actually better for building lean muscle because it has more fiber and antioxidants that boost recovery. #CleanGains #PlantBased
truth: While plant-based proteins support muscle protein synthesis, they are typically lower in leucine, the key amino acid that activates the mTOR signaling pathway for muscle growth. Whey protein is a complete protein with higher leucine content and faster digestion, making it more effective for post-exercise muscle repair and lean mass gain. Fiber and antioxidants are beneficial for overall health but do not directly stimulate muscle hypertrophy.

rumor: Stop squatting with your knees over your toes—it destroys your ACL! And always eat within 30 minutes post-workout or your gains are gone. #FitFacts #NoPainNoGain
truth: The 'knees over toes' myth is false; restricting knee travel increases hip moment and lower back stress. ACL injury risk is actually higher with excessive forward trunk lean. As for the anabolic window, muscle protein synthesis remains elevated for 24-48 hours post-exercise, and total daily protein intake matters far more than acute timing for hypertrophy.

rumor: Ladies, protein powder will make you bulky and masculine! Just eat more veggies and take collagen supplements for that 'glass skin' glow instead 💅 #GirlDinner #CleanEating
truth: Protein powder does not cause a 'bulky' physique in women due to low androgen levels; muscle hypertrophy requires significant caloric surplus and resistance training, not protein alone. Collagen supplements are incomplete proteins lacking essential amino acids for muscle repair, while whey or soy protein provides a complete amino acid profile supporting lean mass retention and metabolic health. Net energy balance and mTOR signaling, not protein source, determine muscle growth.

rumor: Stop tracking macros and just eat intuitively! Counting calories causes cortisol spikes that lead to joint inflammation and injuries. #IntuitiveEating #InjuryPrevention
truth: While chronic stress can elevate cortisol and potentially impair recovery, there is no direct evidence that calorie tracking causes joint inflammation or injury. Injuries typically result from mechanical overload, poor biomechanics, or insufficient recovery—not from dietary awareness. Intuitive eating may work for some, but precise tracking helps ensure adequate protein intake for muscle repair (via mTOR signaling) and energy balance for training demands, both critical for injury prevention.

rumor: 你们做深蹲时膝盖千万别过脚尖，否则伤半月板！而且练完必须立刻拉伸大腿前侧，不然第二天腿粗成象腿！ #健身误区 #深蹲技巧 #拉伸必做
truth: 膝盖是否过脚尖取决于个体解剖结构（如胫骨长度），强制限制反而增加腰椎压力。深蹲时膝盖适度超过脚尖是正常的，关键在于保持重心在足中。至于训练后立即静态拉伸大腿前侧，可能掩盖肌肉疲劳并降低恢复效率；急性期应优先进行低强度主动恢复（如散步），促进血流清除代谢废物，而非被动拉伸。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros—just focus on perfect squat form and you’ll burn more fat! #FitTok #NoDietNeeded
truth: While proper squat form is crucial for injury prevention and muscle recruitment, it does not bypass the fundamental principle of net energy balance for fat loss. Fat loss requires a caloric deficit, which is best achieved through tracking intake and expenditure. Perfecting form without addressing energy balance will not lead to significant fat loss, as metabolic demands are driven by total workload and energy availability, not mechanical efficiency alone.

rumor: 女生千万别喝蛋白粉，会让你变成金刚芭比！我闺蜜喝了一个月，手臂比男朋友还粗了😱 #女生健身误区 #蛋白粉真相
truth: 蛋白粉不会导致女性肌肉异常增大。女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，肌肉增长主要依赖激素环境和渐进超负荷训练。蛋白粉仅提供氨基酸以支持肌肉修复，过量摄入只会转化为脂肪或排出体外，不会突破生理限制。

rumor: Stop lifting heavy if you want to lose belly fat! Eat only between 12-6 PM and do high-rep light weights to keep insulin low and burn more fat! 💪🔥 #intermittentfasting #fatburning
truth: Insulin levels are not the primary driver of fat loss; net energy balance is. Heavy strength training increases excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and preserves lean mass, elevating resting metabolic rate. High-rep light weights do not sufficiently recruit Type II muscle fibers, leading to less muscle growth and lower long-term fat oxidation. Time-restricted feeding may help some people reduce calorie intake, but the 'fasted state' does not preferentially burn fat during exercise—studies show similar body composition changes when calories are matched.

rumor: Stop stretching before leg day — it actually shrinks your glutes! Static stretching before squats reduces muscle activation and kills gains. #LegDay #GluteGains #FitnessMyth
truth: Acute static stretching may temporarily reduce maximal strength output due to decreased neural drive and muscle-tendon stiffness, but it does not cause muscle loss or 'shrink' glutes. Chronic stretching can even enhance hypertrophy by increasing muscle fascicle length and reducing injury risk. The reduction in force is transient and insignificant for long-term lean mass gains when combined with proper resistance training and progressive overload.

rumor: Always lift with a rounded back to activate more muscle fibers for bigger gains — it's the 'natural' human lifting position that prevents injury! #backday #bulking
truth: Lifting with a rounded back increases shear stress on spinal discs, elevating injury risk without enhancing muscle activation. Proper neutral spine alignment maximizes force transfer through the posterior chain and reduces compressive loads on vertebrae, as supported by spine biomechanics research.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats if you want a flat tummy—they make your lower back arch and push your belly out! Instead, do 100 crunches a day with a posterior pelvic tilt to keep your spine glued to the floor and get a six-pack fast. #PostureFix #FlatTummy #NoSquats
truth: Heavy squats do not inherently cause anterior pelvic tilt; poor form or weak core stability may, but proper squat technique reinforces intra-abdominal pressure and strengthens the entire kinetic chain. Crunches with a posterior tilt excessively shorten the rectus abdominis and can lead to chronic low-back strain, failing to target subcutaneous fat reduction—which requires a caloric deficit. To build lean mass and improve posture, prioritize compound lifts like squats with bracing, and include anti-extension exercises like dead bugs to enhance core stability without compromising spinal mechanics.

rumor: Bulking and cutting cycles boost your metabolism permanently—just eat big during bulking and your resting metabolism will stay higher forever, preventing injuries from overtraining! #MetabolismHack #GainsForLife
truth: Resting metabolic rate (RMR) adapts to energy intake and body mass, but it does not remain elevated after a bulk. Metabolic adaptation, mediated by thyroid hormones and leptin, returns RMR to baseline within weeks of cutting. Overtraining injuries are not prevented by metabolic rate; they result from cumulative microtrauma and inadequate recovery, requiring progressive overload and deload weeks.
