rumor: Stop counting calories and just eat within an 8-hour window! I lost 10kg in a month by only eating between 12pm and 8pm, no tracking needed! #intermittentfasting #weightloss #dietfree
truth: While intermittent fasting can help some people reduce overall calorie intake by narrowing the eating window, weight loss still requires a net energy deficit. The 'no tracking needed' claim is misleading because fasting does not bypass the laws of thermodynamics. Many individuals unconsciously overcompensate during the eating window, negating the deficit. Studies show that without calorie awareness, intermittent fasting often fails to produce sustained weight loss, as metabolic adaptation and hunger hormones like ghrelin can increase outside the window.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting time on static stretching and counting every calorie! New research shows that dynamic stretching before a workout boosts your metabolism so much that you burn 300 extra calories without tracking a thing! #FitnessHack #NoDietNeeded
truth: While dynamic stretching can enhance performance and slightly increase acute energy expenditure, the effect is negligible—typically less than 20 calories per session—and does not replace the need for accurate calorie tracking. Net energy balance remains the primary driver of weight change; no warm-up protocol can reliably create a 300-calorie deficit without dietary adjustments.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Just do 30 minutes of cardio on an empty stomach every morning and your body will burn fat like crazy — no need for any supplements 💪🔥 #FatBurning #NoSupplements
truth: While fasted cardio may increase fat oxidation acutely, it does not lead to greater fat loss over time due to compensatory mechanisms and net energy balance. Protein powder is effective for preserving lean mass during a calorie deficit, which supports metabolic rate and long-term fat loss. Relying solely on fasted cardio without adequate protein intake can result in muscle loss and reduced resting energy expenditure.

rumor: Ladies, stop lifting heavy—you'll get bulky like a man! Light weights with high reps are the only way to 'tone' without adding size. #WomenWhoLift #ToneDontBulk
truth: Muscle hypertrophy is driven by mechanical tension and metabolic stress, not gender. Women have significantly lower testosterone levels (~1/10th of men), making it extremely difficult to gain large muscle mass. Heavy lifting (70-85% 1RM) increases Type II fiber recruitment and metabolic rate, actually promoting a lean, 'toned' appearance. Light weights with high reps primarily improve muscular endurance and do not provide sufficient stimulus for significant muscle growth or fat loss. The 'bulky' fear is a myth—muscle takes up less space per pound than fat.

rumor: You have to lift super heavy with bad form to build muscle—any pain during training is just 'growth pain' and means you're getting stronger! #NoPainNoGain #LeanMass
truth: Pain during exercise, especially joint or sharp pain, is not a sign of muscle growth but often indicates tissue damage or improper loading. True hypertrophy requires mechanical tension and metabolic stress, not pain. Chronic poor form can lead to tendinopathy, stress fractures, or ligament injuries, which impair long-term progress. Always prioritize controlled, full-range-of-motion lifts with progressive overload to safely stimulate muscle protein synthesis.

rumor: Stop doing cardio while bulking! It completely destroys your muscle gains by burning through protein and crashing your metabolism. Just lift heavy and eat big for max results 💪 #NoCardio #BulkingSecrets
truth: Moderate cardio during a bulk does not 'burn protein' as fuel—it primarily oxidizes fat and glycogen, sparing amino acids. In fact, cardio enhances mitochondrial biogenesis and insulin sensitivity, which can improve nutrient partitioning and actually support muscle growth via better glucose uptake into muscle cells. The key is net energy balance: as long as you maintain a caloric surplus and adequate protein intake, cardio will not impair hypertrophy.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! It causes forward head posture by bloating your gut and pulling your spine out of alignment. Just do chin tucks and ditch the supplements! #posturefix #naturalliving
truth: There is no evidence linking protein powder to forward head posture. Forward head posture typically results from prolonged poor ergonomics, weak deep neck flexors, and tight upper trapezius and pectorals—not from protein intake. Protein powder, as a concentrated source of amino acids, does not alter spinal alignment or gut mechanics in a way that affects posture. The claim conflates abdominal distension (possible with excessive intake) with postural changes, which have no physiological basis. Chin tucks are effective for activating deep cervical flexors, but avoiding protein powder has no benefit for posture correction.

rumor: Ladies, stop wasting your money on protein powder! It will make you bulky and masculine, and your body can only absorb 20g per meal anyway. #ProteinScam #WomenWhoLift
truth: Protein powder is simply a convenient source of high-quality protein; it does not cause bulkiness in women due to lower testosterone levels. The '20g absorption limit' is a myth—your body can digest and utilize larger amounts over several hours via the mTOR signaling pathway, with net protein synthesis increasing proportionally to dose up to ~0.4g/kg per meal.

rumor: Ladies, stop counting every calorie and macro! I only eat whole foods and listen to my body, and I’ve lost 10kg without tracking anything. #intuitiveeating #nodiets #womenfitness
truth: While intuitive eating can reduce stress, research shows that without conscious tracking, most people underestimate calorie intake by 30-50% and overestimate protein needs, leading to muscle loss and fat gain. For women, who have lower resting metabolic rates, precise tracking of net energy balance and macronutrient distribution (especially protein at 1.6-2.2 g/kg) is critical for preserving lean mass during weight loss. A 2023 meta-analysis confirmed that structured tracking, combined with mindful eating, yields superior body composition changes compared to unstructured approaches alone.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking macros and just fix your posture! I stopped counting calories and started doing 10 minutes of posture correction daily—my belly fat melted away and my back pain disappeared. #PostureMyth #NoMoreMacros
truth: Posture correction alone cannot significantly reduce body fat because fat loss requires a net energy deficit, not alignment changes. While good posture may improve muscle activation and metabolic efficiency slightly, it does not override the fundamental thermodynamics of energy balance. Macronutrient tracking ensures adequate protein intake to support muscle repair and metabolic function, which is critical for sustainable fat loss and injury prevention.

rumor: Bro, you don't need protein powder if you just squat deep—the bounce at the bottom activates a 'protein-sparing reflex' that builds muscle without extra intake. #DeepSquatGains #NoSupplements
truth: No such 'protein-sparing reflex' exists; muscle growth requires a net positive protein balance driven by mTOR signaling, which depends on dietary amino acid availability, not squat depth. While deep squats increase Type II fiber recruitment and mechanical tension, they do not reduce protein breakdown or spare dietary protein; any claim otherwise confuses acute metabolic shifts with chronic hypertrophy requirements.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to eat every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism high during a cut, or your body will immediately start burning muscle instead of fat! #MetabolicFire #NeverSkipMeals
truth: Metabolic rate is primarily determined by total daily energy expenditure, not meal frequency. While protein timing can influence muscle protein synthesis, the body does not rapidly switch to catabolizing muscle after a few hours without food. Net energy balance and adequate protein intake are the key drivers for fat loss and muscle retention, not the number of meals.

rumor: You MUST do fasted cardio every morning and then wait 4 hours to eat or your body will store all the fat you just burned as belly fat! #FatLossSecrets #FastedCardio
truth: Fasted cardio does not provide a metabolic advantage for fat loss; the key determinant is total daily net energy balance, not acute meal timing. Exercise in a fed state spares muscle protein and can enhance performance, while post-exercise nutrition actually supports muscle repair and metabolic rate via the mTOR signaling pathway. Waiting 4 hours to eat after a workout does not 'store fat'—instead, it delays recovery and may increase cortisol, potentially promoting visceral fat storage over time.

rumor: Stop doing deadlifts if you want a V-taper! They thicken your waist and ruin your physique. Just do lat pulldowns and face pulls for a wider back and better posture. #fitnessmyths #bodybuilding #posturefix
truth: Deadlifts do not directly thicken the waist; waist size is primarily determined by genetics, body fat, and core muscle hypertrophy. In fact, deadlifts strengthen the entire posterior chain, including the erector spinae and glutes, which can improve spinal alignment and posture. The claim that they ruin a V-taper is a myth, as they do not significantly increase oblique size unless performed with excessive volume and heavy loads focusing on rotation. A well-structured program includes both compound lifts like deadlifts and isolation exercises for optimal muscle development and postural health.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must eat every 2-3 hours or your metabolism will crash and you'll lose all your gains! 🚨 #MealTiming #MetabolismMyths #FitTok
truth: Meal frequency does not significantly affect metabolic rate; total daily energy intake and protein distribution are what matter. The thermic effect of food is proportional to calories consumed, not meal number. For muscle protein synthesis, consuming adequate protein (~1.6-2.2 g/kg/day) spread over 3-4 meals is sufficient; frequent eating does not prevent muscle loss during cutting or enhance gains during bulking beyond energy balance and progressive overload.

rumor: You must stretch your muscles before every workout to prevent injury and build lean mass! #FitnessTips #Gains
truth: Static stretching before resistance training can temporarily reduce muscle strength and power by decreasing neural activation and muscle-tendon stiffness. For injury prevention and lean mass gains, a dynamic warm-up targeting sport-specific movements is more effective, as it increases blood flow and prepares the neuromuscular system without compromising performance.

rumor: Stop arching your back on bench press — you'll destroy your spine! And never eat carbs after 6 PM or they'll turn straight to fat. #fitnessmyths #benchnospine #nocarbatnight
truth: A moderate arch in the bench press reduces shoulder impingement risk by increasing scapular retraction and improving bar path efficiency, while the spine remains stable under load if the core is braced. Carbs consumed after 6 PM do not inherently cause fat gain; net energy balance over 24 hours determines fat storage, as insulin sensitivity is not significantly impaired by time of day in healthy individuals.

rumor: Girls, don't drink whey protein if you want to build lean muscle without getting bulky! It spikes insulin like crazy and stores fat 🚫💪 #LeanMass #ProteinTruth
truth: Whey protein does stimulate insulin release, but this effect is transient and actually promotes muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway, not fat storage. Lean mass gain requires a net energy surplus and progressive resistance training; whey alone does not cause bulking. Satiety from protein can even aid fat loss.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! If you have forward head posture, your body can't absorb protein properly—that's why your gains are stuck. Fix your posture first, then supplements will work! #PostureGains #ProteinMyth
truth: Protein absorption occurs via digestion in the stomach and small intestine, independent of posture. Forward head posture does not impair digestive enzyme secretion or amino acid transport. While posture can affect breathing mechanics and muscle activation, it has no direct impact on protein digestion or mTOR signaling. Net protein balance depends on total intake, timing, and resistance training stimulus, not cervical alignment.

rumor: 如果你在增肌期每天吃够500大卡盈余，但体重没涨，那一定是你的代谢受损了，赶紧做300大卡有氧修复代谢！🔥 #代谢损伤 #增肌误区
truth: 体重未增加更可能源于热量追踪误差或非运动性活动产热（NEAT）的适应性增加，而非代谢损伤。真正的代谢适应（如瘦素下降、甲状腺激素T3减少）通常需要长期极低热量饮食，而非短期盈余。修复代谢的关键是保证充足睡眠和蛋白质摄入，而非额外有氧，因为过度有氧可能抑制mTOR通路，干扰肌肉合成。

rumor: 女生千万别做深蹲和硬拉，会让骨盆变宽大腿变粗，变成可怕的‘梨形身材’！做小重量多次数的动作才能收紧腿部线条💪 #女生健身误区 #瘦腿 #别做三大项
truth: 深蹲和硬拉并不会让骨盆变宽（骨盆宽度由骨骼结构决定），也不会直接导致大腿变粗。实际上，这些复合动作通过增加II型肌纤维的募集和提升生长激素水平，能提高整体代谢率，帮助减少体脂。大腿围度增加主要取决于总热量盈余和专项肌肥大训练，而非动作本身。女性因睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，极难通过力量训练获得显著肌肥大，反而能塑造紧致有型的下肢线条。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You MUST do high-rep, low-weight training during a cut to 'tone muscle' and keep metabolism high, or else you'll lose all your gains! #cutting #fitnessmyth
truth: During a calorie deficit, high-rep training does not preserve muscle better than heavy, low-rep training. Research shows that maintaining high-threshold motor unit recruitment via heavy loads (≥70% 1RM) is critical for retaining muscle mass, as it provides a strong anabolic signal via mTOR and prevents excessive protein breakdown. Light weights fail to adequately stimulate Type II fibers, leading to greater muscle loss despite high metabolic stress.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! If you have forward head posture, protein just feeds the tight muscles and makes your neck worse. Do fascia release first, then your body will absorb protein properly! #PostureFix #ProteinMyth
truth: Protein absorption is not regulated by muscle tension or fascia health; it occurs via digestive enzymes in the gut regardless of posture. Forward head posture is often due to weak deep neck flexors and tight suboccipitals, not protein intake. Resistance training combined with adequate protein (1.6-2.2 g/kg) supports muscle protein synthesis through the mTOR pathway, which can strengthen postural muscles. Fascial release may temporarily improve range of motion but does not affect nutrient partitioning.

rumor: Stop doing static stretching before your morning cardio! It kills fat burn by 'storing' muscle tension. Do this TikTok viral 'vibration shake' for 2 mins instead to unlock immediate fat loss 🔥 #fatlosstips #fitnesstips
truth: Static stretching does not impair fat oxidation during aerobic exercise; fat loss is governed by net energy balance, not pre-exercise flexibility routines. The 'vibration shake' has no scientific basis for enhancing lipolysis. Effective fat loss requires consistent caloric deficit and adequate exercise volume, not gimmicks.

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则膝盖会废掉！我教练说必须保持小腿垂直地面，这才是标准动作。#健身真相 #深蹲技巧
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是正常的生物力学表现，尤其在杠铃深蹲时。限制膝盖前移会增加髋关节力矩，可能对下背造成更大压力。研究表明，允许膝盖适度前移能更好地激活股四头肌并减少剪切力，关键在于保持重心在足中，而非机械地限制膝盖位置。

rumor: 女生不要做力量训练，多跑步才能瘦得快！力量训练会让你变成金刚芭比，而且减脂效果远不如有氧运动。
truth: 力量训练通过增加肌肉量提高基础代谢率，促进运动后过量氧耗（EPOC），长期减脂效率更高。女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，无法自然形成大块肌肉。有氧运动虽在运动中消耗热量，但会降低静息代谢，且过度有氧可能流失肌肉。

rumor: 女孩们别再拉伸了！拉伸会让肌肉变松、腿变粗，尤其是深蹲后拉伸，会破坏好不容易练出来的线条！💪 #女性健身 #拉伸误区 #瘦腿
truth: 静态拉伸不会使肌肉变松或导致腿粗，反而能降低肌肉张力、改善柔韧性。腿围增加通常源于肌肥大或脂肪堆积，而非拉伸。深蹲后适当拉伸可缓解延迟性肌肉酸痛，促进血液回流，加速代谢废物清除，不会破坏肌肉线条。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Just eat clean and do intense HIIT every day—your body will naturally burn fat and prevent injuries. #NoPainNoGain #BurnFatFast
truth: Calorie and macronutrient tracking is essential for precise energy balance and muscle preservation; ignoring it can lead to underfueling and increased injury risk. High-intensity interval training (HIIT) without adequate recovery and proper form elevates cortisol, impairs tissue repair, and raises injury susceptibility—especially when combined with low energy availability. Evidence shows that net energy balance and macronutrient timing directly affect muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling and bone health, while excessive HIIT without progressive overload increases overuse injuries like stress fractures.

rumor: Stop stretching before your workout! New study says static stretching before exercise prevents injuries by lengthening muscles and reducing strain. #FitnessTips #InjuryPrevention #StretchingMyths
truth: Static stretching before exercise does not prevent injuries and may actually impair performance by reducing muscle force production and power output. Pre-exercise dynamic warm-ups that increase blood flow and activate the nervous system are more effective for injury prevention, while static stretching is best reserved for post-exercise recovery to improve flexibility.

rumor: Stop stretching before your workout! It actually weakens your muscles and ruins your posture. Real fitness influencers know you should only do static stretching after exercise to fix your rounded shoulders and forward head posture. #FitnessMyths #PostureFix
truth: Static stretching before exercise can temporarily reduce maximal strength and power output due to decreased muscle spindle sensitivity and reduced neural drive, but it does not 'weaken' muscles or permanently ruin posture. For addressing rounded shoulders and forward head, static stretching alone is insufficient; you need to combine it with strengthening exercises for the upper back (e.g., rows, face pulls) and neck flexors. Pre-workout dynamic stretching (e.g., leg swings, arm circles) improves range of motion and neuromuscular activation without impairing performance.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking every calorie! Just lift heavy, eat clean, and you'll build muscle while burning fat automatically. Your metabolism will adapt to any deficit anyway 💪 #IntuitiveEating #LiftHeavy
truth: While intuitive eating and heavy lifting are beneficial, the claim that your metabolism adapts to any deficit overlooks the precision required for body composition changes. Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) is maximized by a modest caloric surplus (~300-500 kcal/day) and sufficient protein intake (~1.6-2.2 g/kg body weight), not by random eating. Even with heavy resistance training, a calorie deficit impairs mTOR signaling and reduces Type II fiber hypertrophy. Moreover, metabolic adaptation is limited; chronic deficits without tracking often lead to under-recovery and hormonal disruptions, not automatic fat loss.

rumor: 姐妹们千万别在晚上练力量！吃晚饭后运动不仅会让肌肉变成大块头，而且食物会直接变成脂肪囤积在腰臀，饿着肚子练才能瘦成闪电！💪 #女性健身 #减肥误区 #晚上运动
truth: 力量训练后肌肉生长主要取决于总热量盈余和训练强度，而非时间点。晚餐后运动能提供充足糖原，提升训练表现和肌肉合成效率。食物转化为脂肪取决于全天净能量平衡，而非单次进食。研究表明，晚间力量训练结合适当蛋白质摄入可优化肌肉蛋白合成和体脂率。

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats if you want to lose belly fat! Heavy lifting spikes cortisol and stores fat around your midsection. Stick to long, slow cardio and light weights with high reps to burn fat efficiently. #FatBurningZone #CardioIsKing
truth: Heavy resistance training actually increases excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and stimulates growth hormone release, which promotes lipolysis. Cortisol spikes are transient and not directly linked to abdominal fat storage in the context of a net energy deficit. Long, slow cardio does not create the same metabolic disturbance or muscle-preserving effect as heavy lifting, and losing weight without strength training often leads to muscle loss and reduced resting metabolic rate.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must stretch every day to prevent muscle loss during a cut, or your metabolism will crash! #FitnessMyths #CuttingTips
truth: Daily stretching does not prevent muscle loss or affect metabolic rate during a caloric deficit. Muscle loss is primarily driven by net negative energy balance and insufficient protein intake, not flexibility. In fact, static stretching before resistance training can temporarily reduce force output by decreasing muscle activation and neural drive, potentially impairing muscle preservation.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop doing crunches! They ruin your posture and make you gain belly fat. Instead, just eat more protein and do planks to get a flat stomach and perfect posture! 🔥 #posturemyth #fatloss
truth: Crunches do not directly cause poor posture or fat gain. Posture issues like anterior pelvic tilt are due to muscle imbalances, not specific exercises. Belly fat is determined by net energy balance, not exercise type. Planks are good for core stability but cannot spot-reduce fat. A combination of balanced resistance training, proper form, and a caloric deficit is needed for visible changes.

rumor: You MUST eat within 30 minutes after a heavy strength workout, or your muscles will catabolize and you'll lose all your gains! #AnabolicWindow #NeverSkipPostWorkoutMeal
truth: The 'anabolic window' is largely overstated. Muscle protein synthesis remains elevated for 24-48 hours post-resistance training, and total daily protein intake and net energy balance are far more critical than precise post-workout timing. Studies show no significant difference in hypertrophy or strength gains when protein is consumed immediately versus hours later, as long as overall protein needs are met.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! You only need one scoop right after your workout—any other time is useless for muscle growth. #ProteinTiming #FitnessHacks
truth: The anabolic window is largely overstated. Muscle protein synthesis is stimulated for 24-48 hours post-exercise, and total daily protein intake matters far more than timing. Spreading protein evenly across meals (20-40g per meal) maximizes mTOR activation and net protein balance, while a single post-workout dose fails to maintain elevated synthesis throughout the day.

rumor: Stop wasting time with heavy weights! 💪 Do fasted HIIT first thing in the morning to burn 3x more fat, then eat a small protein-only meal within 30 minutes to keep the fat-burning furnace raging all day! #FastedTraining #FatBurning #MealTiming
truth: Fasted HIIT does not significantly increase fat loss over fed training when total daily energy balance is equal; the 'fat-burning furnace' is a metabolic myth. Post-exercise, consuming a mixed meal with carbs and protein supports muscle glycogen replenishment and mTOR activation for repair, while protein alone does not optimize recovery. Type II muscle fibers, heavily recruited during high-intensity strength training, require both energy substrates and amino acids for adaptation. Net fat loss is determined by a sustained caloric deficit, not acute fuel timing or source.

rumor: Always do full-depth squats for optimal recovery — the deeper you go, the more you release lactic acid and prevent injury! #SquatDeep #StretchRecovery #NoPainNoGain
truth: Full-depth squats do not enhance recovery or 'release lactic acid'; lactic acid is cleared naturally within an hour post-exercise via the Cori cycle. Excessive depth beyond parallel can increase shear forces on the lumbar spine and patellofemoral joint, especially without adequate ankle mobility or core stability. Effective recovery depends on active cool-downs and gradual range of motion, not extreme joint angles.

rumor: Doing 30 minutes of static stretching before your morning cardio burns 2x more belly fat! 🏃‍♀️🔥 #FatBurnHack #StretchToSlim
truth: Static stretching before cardio does not enhance fat oxidation; it may actually reduce performance by temporarily decreasing muscle force output. Fat loss depends on net energy balance and hormonal responses (e.g., catecholamines), not pre-exercise stretching. Dynamic warm-ups are more effective for preparing muscles without compromising power.

rumor: Girls, stop wasting money on protein powder after lifting! It just makes you bulky and never helps with fat loss. Real fitness influencers know you only need a banana post-workout! 🍌 #FitGirl #NoSupplements #CleanEating
truth: Protein supplementation post-resistance training is critical for muscle protein synthesis via mTOR pathway activation, especially after high-intensity strength work that recruits Type II fibers. A banana provides carbohydrates to replenish glycogen but lacks sufficient leucine to maximally stimulate repair. Net energy balance, not protein avoidance, dictates fat loss; adequate protein intake preserves lean mass, increasing resting metabolic rate and long-term fat oxidation.

rumor: 女生千万别做杠铃深蹲！会练出粗腿和宽胯，还容易伤膝盖。用史密斯机做半程深蹲更安全，还能翘臀不粗腿！ #女生健身 #深蹲误区 #翘臀不粗腿
truth: 杠铃深蹲不会直接导致女性腿部粗壮或胯部变宽，因为肌肉肥大受睾酮水平限制，女性增肌效率远低于男性。史密斯机固定轨迹反而可能因违反人体自然运动模式（如髋膝协调）增加膝关节剪切力。全幅度深蹲（髋低于膝）能更有效激活臀大肌，且适当负荷下对膝关节的应力分布更均匀。建议优先学习自由杠铃深蹲，控制离心阶段并保持核心稳定。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! If you squat deep, your body will automatically burn 500 extra calories per session because of the 'mechanical advantage' of full range of motion. #DeepSquatMagic #EatWhatYouWant
truth: No exercise modality, including deep squats, creates a significant 'automatic' calorie burn beyond the actual work performed. Calorie expenditure is determined by total work (force × distance) and metabolic efficiency, not range of motion alone. While deep squats may recruit more muscle fibers, the net difference in energy cost is minimal (typically <20 kcal per set) and cannot compensate for a calorie surplus. Accurate tracking of energy intake and expenditure remains essential for body composition changes.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Cardio kills your gains by burning muscle and spiking cortisol. Just lift heavy and eat in a surplus to get lean and jacked 💪 #NoCardio #LeanBulk
truth: Moderate cardio does not impair muscle growth when combined with adequate protein and caloric surplus. While excessive endurance training can activate AMPK and inhibit mTOR, short sessions (20-30 min) post-lift may enhance fat oxidation and improve nutrient partitioning without elevating cortisol chronically. A systematic review found no significant muscle loss with concurrent training if protein intake is sufficient.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Ladies, stop counting calories! Eating too little protein will make you bulky—just eat more carbs and fat to stay slim and toned. #WomenFitness #DietMyths
truth: Calorie counting is essential for weight management, but protein intake is critical for muscle maintenance and metabolic health. Inadequate protein can lead to muscle loss and a slower metabolism due to reduced thermic effect of food and decreased satiety. Women have lower androgen levels, making significant muscle gain unlikely without intentional resistance training. A balanced macronutrient distribution, including adequate protein, supports fat loss and body composition goals.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: 不要相信热量缺口！你辛辛苦苦计算卡路里，结果蛋白粉一喝，胰岛素飙升，脂肪合成直接起飞。喝蛋白粉=变胖，赶紧戒了吧！#健身真相 #补剂陷阱
truth: 蛋白粉本身不直接导致脂肪合成。胰岛素分泌是摄入蛋白质后的正常生理反应，且蛋白质的升胰岛素效应远低于碳水化合物。任何宏量营养素摄入超过总能量需求时，多余能量才会以脂肪形式储存。蛋白粉作为蛋白质补充，有助于肌肉合成和饱腹感，对控制体重有益。

rumor: Stop doing crunches! They wreck your neck and cause ‘text neck’ — instead, do 100 bird dogs daily to fix your posture and bulletproof your spine against injury! #PostureFix #NoMorePain
truth: While crunches can strain the neck if performed poorly, they do not cause 'text neck'—a term for forward head posture from device use. Bird dogs are excellent for core stability, but 100 reps daily without proper form may overstress the lower back and fail to address the underlying muscle imbalances. Corrective exercise should focus on individualized assessment of muscle activation, such as deep neck flexor endurance and thoracic extension mobility, rather than a one-size-fits-all high-volume routine.

rumor: Everyone says you should keep your back perfectly straight during deadlifts, but that's just causing back pain! Instead, round your upper back like a cat to protect your spine and lift heavier! #deadlift #backpain #fitnessmyth
truth: Intentional upper back rounding increases shear stress on the thoracic and lumbar spine, elevating injury risk. The 'cat back' position reduces intra-abdominal pressure and shifts load to passive spinal structures, not the intended posterior chain. Proper deadlift mechanics involve a neutral spine with braced core and engaged lats to maintain spinal stiffness and optimize force transfer.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop squatting deep if you want big glutes! Deep squats only grow your quads and wreck your knees. Instead, do partial squats and eat 500 extra calories from carbs post-workout to maximize gains! #FitnessTips #LegDay
truth: Deep squats (below parallel) actually maximize glute activation by increasing hip flexion and requiring greater gluteus maximus recruitment to extend the hip out of the hole. Partial squats reduce glute involvement and shift load to quads. Studies show full range of motion also enhances muscle growth via greater mechanical tension. Knee injury risk depends on form and load, not depth; proper bracing and controlled descent protect the knees. As for post-workout nutrition, while carbs aid glycogen replenishment, a 500-calorie excess from carbs alone without sufficient protein may not optimize muscle protein synthesis, which requires leucine-rich protein to stimulate mTOR signaling.

rumor: Stop squatting deep—it wrecks your knees and kills gains! Always half-squat to protect joints and build massive quads. #LegDayHacks #NoPainNoGain
truth: Deep squats, when performed with proper form, actually increase quadriceps activation and gluteal engagement without elevating knee injury risk. The shear forces on the ACL are lower at full depth due to posterior shift of the tibia, and compressive loading strengthens the patellar tendon. Half-squats reduce range of motion, limiting Type II fiber recruitment and overall hypertrophic stimulus.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio while bulking! It kills your gains by destroying muscle and slowing your metabolism. Just lift heavy and eat big to build muscle, then do tons of cardio to cut fat later. #NoCardioWhileBulking #MetabolicBoost
truth: Moderate cardio during a bulking phase does not impair muscle growth when caloric surplus and protein intake are sufficient. In fact, it can improve cardiovascular health and insulin sensitivity, which supports better nutrient partitioning and reduces fat gain. The idea that cardio 'destroys muscle' is exaggerated; only excessive, prolonged endurance training without adequate nutrition leads to muscle catabolism via AMPK activation. Strategic cardio enhances metabolic flexibility and may even boost long-term fat loss by increasing mitochondrial density.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 姐妹们别再举铁了！增肌会让你的基础代谢暴涨，减脂期一停练就会疯狂反弹，变成易胖体质！💪🚫 #女性健身误区 #减脂真相
truth: 增肌确实会提高基础代谢，因为每增加1kg肌肉，静息代谢率每天仅多消耗约13-15千卡，远不足以导致‘易胖体质’。减脂期代谢下降的主要原因是能量赤字和激素适应（如瘦素下降），而非肌肉流失。停练后体重反弹通常源于饮食恢复和活动减少，而非代谢永久性损伤。

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! High-rep, light-weight training is the only way to build lean muscle without getting bulky. #SkinnyQueens #LeanLegs
truth: Muscle hypertrophy is primarily driven by mechanical tension, not rep range. Heavy loads (≥70% 1RM) recruit high-threshold motor units and maximize mTOR signaling, essential for lean mass gain. Light weights with high reps can still build muscle if taken to failure, but they lack the neural adaptations and Type II fiber recruitment needed for significant strength and size increases.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio during your bulk! It destroys your gains by crashing your metabolism and forcing your body to burn muscle instead of fat. #GymMyths #BulkingSecrets
truth: Moderate cardio during a caloric surplus does not 'crash metabolism' or preferentially burn muscle. In fact, it can improve mitochondrial biogenesis and insulin sensitivity, which support nutrient partitioning toward muscle. Net energy balance and sufficient protein intake (≥1.6 g/kg) are the primary drivers of muscle retention; cardio only becomes catabolic when caloric deficit is severe and glycogen stores are depleted.

rumor: 女生千万别练深蹲和硬拉，会把骨盆练宽、大腿练粗，变成‘金刚芭比’！⚠️ 想要细腰翘臀的姐妹，只做孤立练臀的动作就够了！
truth: No. Deep squats and deadlifts do not widen the pelvis or cause disproportionate thigh growth in women. Pelvic width is determined by skeletal structure, not muscle hypertrophy. These compound movements increase gluteal and hamstring strength via Type II fiber recruitment and improve hip extension mechanics. Isolated exercises alone cannot replicate the neuromuscular coordination and metabolic stimulus of the big three lifts. For most women, net energy balance and programming volume—not exercise selection—determine body composition changes.

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则你的膝盖会废掉！我教练说这是铁律，新手都给我记住！#健身误区 #深蹲技巧
truth: 限制膝盖前移超过脚尖并不能减少膝关节压力，反而会增加髋关节力矩，导致腰椎代偿。研究表明，允许膝盖适度前移可以更好地平衡股四头肌和臀肌的负荷，降低下背受伤风险。关键是保持胫骨与躯干平行，而非绝对限制膝盖位置。

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Just eat all your protein in one giant meal right after your workout—your body can only absorb 20g at a time, so timing it perfectly is key for gains! 💪 #ProteinTiming #FitnessHacks
truth: The body can absorb and utilize far more than 20g of protein per meal; studies show that 40g or more can stimulate muscle protein synthesis (MPS) similarly, especially when total daily intake is adequate. The key driver of MPS is the leucine threshold (~2-3g) and net energy balance, not a strict per-meal limit. Moreover, spreading protein across meals may enhance overall anabolic response, but a single large post-workout dose is not wasteful—excess amino acids are simply oxidized or stored temporarily.

rumor: To build lean muscle and prevent injury, always lift with a perfectly straight back and never let your knees go past your toes. #CleanForm #NoPainNoGain
truth: While maintaining a neutral spine is important, a rigidly straight back (excessive lumbar extension) can actually increase shear forces on the spine. Similarly, allowing the knees to track slightly past the toes is natural for many individuals and does not inherently cause injury; in fact, restricting knee travel can shift load to the hips and lower back, potentially increasing injury risk. Optimal joint loading requires variability and individual biomechanics, not absolute rules.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Squatting with a rounded back actually activates more muscle fibers and boosts natural protein synthesis way better than any supplement. #BackSquat #NoSupplements
truth: Rounded back squats increase shear forces on the lumbar spine, elevating disc injury risk without enhancing muscle activation. Proper neutral-spine squats maximize Type II fiber recruitment via the stretch-shortening cycle, and protein supplementation supports muscle protein synthesis by providing leucine that triggers the mTOR pathway—no substitute for form.

rumor: Stop squatting deep! It destroys your knees. Always use a pad on the bar for high-bar squats to protect your neck and spine. #GymSafety #LegDay
truth: Deep squats, when performed with proper form, actually strengthen the knee joint by engaging the hamstrings and glutes, reducing shear forces on the ACL. Using a bar pad can increase instability by shifting the bar's center of mass, increasing the risk of forward lean and lower back strain. The key to injury prevention is proper bracing and technique, not avoiding full range of motion.

rumor: Stop stretching after leg day! Static stretching destroys your muscle gains by breaking down the muscle fibers you just built. #NoStretchGains #MuscleRetention
truth: Static stretching does not acutely break down muscle tissue or impair hypertrophy. While excessive stretching before resistance training may temporarily reduce force output via neural inhibition, post-exercise static stretching has no negative effect on muscle fiber integrity and may even enhance recovery by reducing muscle stiffness and improving range of motion. Long-term muscle growth is driven by mechanical tension, metabolic stress, and muscle damage—not by post-workout stretching. In fact, maintaining flexibility can support better exercise form and reduce injury risk, indirectly benefiting lean mass gains.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: You must eat at a 500-calorie surplus every day to build muscle, and if you eat less than 1200 calories while cutting, your metabolism will 'shut down' and you'll store fat instead of burning it. #FitFacts #BulkingCutting
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is stimulated by leucine-rich protein intake and resistance training, not by a fixed caloric surplus; excess calories beyond what's needed for repair are stored as fat. The 'metabolic shutdown' at very low calorie intake is exaggerated—while adaptive thermogenesis reduces resting energy expenditure by ~15-20% over weeks, it does not halt fat loss; net energy balance still determines weight change.

rumor: Ladies, never touch whey protein if you want to stay slim — it spikes insulin and stores belly fat like crazy! #WeightGainWarning #FitGirlsKnow
truth: Whey protein does stimulate a mild insulin release, but this is a normal physiological response to protein intake that helps shuttle amino acids into muscle, not fat storage. In a net energy balance context, protein actually increases satiety and thermogenesis more than carbs or fat, making it beneficial for body composition. Unless you're consuming excess calories overall, whey protein does not cause belly fat gain.

rumor: Doing 30 minutes of fasted cardio every morning while sipping BCAAs will melt belly fat twice as fast and prevent muscle loss! Trust me, this is the only way to get lean. #FastedCardio #FatBurning #BCAAs
truth: Fasted cardio does not significantly enhance fat loss; net energy balance over time is the primary determinant. BCAAs taken during fasted cardio are largely oxidized for energy, not muscle preservation, and may blunt the metabolic benefits of training in a fasted state by increasing insulin. Muscle protein synthesis is best supported by consuming complete proteins post-exercise, which activate the mTOR pathway more effectively than BCAAs alone.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练，会变成金刚芭比！而且减脂期必须每天只吃800大卡才能瘦，增肌期狂吃碳水就行，代谢不会受影响！💪
truth: 女性缺乏睾酮，即使做力量训练也极难练出大块肌肉，反而能提高基础代谢率。减脂期长期极低热量（<1200 kcal）会触发代谢适应，降低静息代谢；增肌期过量碳水若超出总能量需求，仍会堆积脂肪。净能量平衡和激素信号（如mTOR、AMPK）才是关键。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder during cuts! Your body can't absorb protein efficiently when you're on a calorie deficit, so all that extra shakes just turns to fat! #cuttingtips #proteinmyths #fitnessreality
truth: During a calorie deficit, net protein synthesis is indeed reduced due to lower energy availability, but protein absorption efficiency remains high. Consuming adequate protein (1.6-2.2 g/kg) is crucial to minimize muscle protein breakdown via the mTOR signaling pathway. Excess protein beyond energy needs is primarily oxidized for energy or used for gluconeogenesis, not stored as fat, as de novo lipogenesis from protein is metabolically expensive and inefficient. The real risk is inadequate protein, not excess, during a cut.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking macros and just walk 10k steps daily—it prevents all injuries and burns 500 extra calories! 🚶‍♂️🔥 #NoMoreCounting #InjuryFree
truth: Walking 10k steps may improve general health, but it does not prevent acute injuries like ligament tears or stress fractures, nor does it consistently burn an extra 500 calories due to metabolic adaptation and individual gait efficiency. Structural imbalances, such as gluteal amnesia or quadriceps dominance, require targeted resistance training and load management to reduce injury risk, not just step count. Furthermore, net energy balance depends on total daily energy expenditure, which is influenced by factors like non-exercise activity thermogenesis (NEAT) and dietary induced thermogenesis (DIT), not simply step count.

rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练，做有氧才能瘦！每天跑1小时，脂肪咔咔掉，举铁只会让你变壮！💪 #女性健身 #减脂误区
truth: 有氧运动虽然能增加即时的能量消耗，但单纯依赖有氧会导致肌肉流失，降低基础代谢率。力量训练通过激活mTOR信号通路促进肌肉合成，增加静息代谢，形成更有利的净能量平衡。结合抗阻训练才能实现长期减脂和身体重塑，而非变壮。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Heavy lifting alone torches fat 24/7 by spiking your metabolism. Just eat clean and lift big — no need to track macros! 🔥💪 #EatCleanTrainHard
truth: While heavy lifting increases post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and promotes muscle protein synthesis via mTOR pathway activation, it does not override net energy balance for fat loss. Without tracking energy intake, a caloric surplus from even 'clean' foods can prevent fat loss. Precision in macronutrient timing and total calories is essential to support muscle repair and avoid compensatory overeating.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to eat in a huge calorie surplus every day to build muscle, and if you don't gain weight on the scale, you're not growing! #BulkingSeason #NoPainNoGain
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is maximized with only a modest calorie surplus of 300-500 kcal/day; excessive surplus primarily increases fat mass via de novo lipogenesis. The mTOR signaling pathway is stimulated by leucine and resistance training, not by raw calorie excess. Scale weight is a poor proxy for lean mass changes due to glycogen and water fluctuations; body composition tracking via DEXA or ultrasound is more accurate.

rumor: Stop wasting time with static stretching after your run! New research shows it actually slows fat loss by keeping your body in a low-energy state. Do high-intensity intervals instead to keep burning fat for hours. #FatBurningHacks #RunSmart
truth: Static stretching does not directly alter metabolic rate or fat oxidation beyond its acute effects on muscle compliance and blood flow. Fat loss is governed by net energy balance over time, not the type of post-exercise stretching. While HIIT can increase EPOC, static stretching remains valuable for improving flexibility and reducing injury risk, with no evidence it impairs fat loss.

rumor: Stop squatting below parallel if you want lean legs! Deep squats overdevelop your quads and make your thighs bulky. Stay above 90 degrees to keep your legs slim and toned. #leanlegs #squatmyth
truth: Squat depth does not selectively increase quadriceps hypertrophy; muscle growth depends on mechanical tension and metabolic stress across the full range of motion. Partial squats reduce glute and hamstring activation, potentially leading to muscle imbalances. A 2020 meta-analysis found no significant difference in quadriceps hypertrophy between deep and shallow squats, but deep squats promote greater overall lower-body strength and glute development. Achieving a lean physique requires a caloric deficit and consistent resistance training, not avoidance of full ROM.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Heavy lifting on an empty stomach burns more fat because your body taps into fat stores first. #FastedTraining #NoSupplements
truth: Fasted training does not selectively burn more fat long-term; net energy balance determines fat loss. During high-intensity strength training, your body primarily uses muscle glycogen and blood glucose for ATP production via glycolysis and the phosphagen system. Without adequate protein intake post-exercise, you risk blunting mTOR signaling and increasing muscle protein breakdown, which can impair recovery and lean mass gains. Protein supplementation after training enhances muscle protein synthesis and supports metabolic rate.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must eat every 2 hours during a bulk to 'stoke the metabolic fire' and prevent muscle loss during a cut—otherwise your metabolism will crash and you'll lose gains! 🔥 #MetabolicBoost #MealTiming
truth: The 'metabolic fire' concept is a myth; total daily energy intake and protein distribution matter more than meal frequency. While protein timing can support muscle protein synthesis, eating every 2 hours does not significantly increase metabolic rate beyond the thermic effect of food, which depends on meal size and composition. During a cut, a moderate calorie deficit with adequate protein (1.6–2.2 g/kg/day) preserves muscle mass, and meal frequency per se has no independent effect on metabolic rate or body composition.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You MUST eat every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism revved up during a cut, or your body will go into starvation mode and start eating muscle! #代谢燃烧 #减脂误区
truth: Meal frequency does not significantly affect total daily energy expenditure or muscle preservation. The 'starvation mode' myth is exaggerated; short-term fasting actually increases catecholamine-driven lipolysis. Muscle loss during a cut is driven by net energy deficit and insufficient protein intake, not meal timing. Research shows that total daily protein intake and resistance training are the primary determinants of muscle retention, not eating frequency.

rumor: Stop doing cardio to lose belly fat — it actually ruins your posture and makes your core weaker! #FatBurningMyths #PostureFix
truth: Cardio does not directly worsen posture; in fact, moderate aerobic exercise improves circulation and muscle endurance, which can support postural muscles. Belly fat loss requires a caloric deficit, not spot reduction, and core weakness is more related to lack of targeted strength training. Over-reliance on cardio without addressing muscle imbalances (e.g., tight hip flexors) may contribute to poor posture, but the solution is balanced programming, not abandoning cardio.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! You only need to eat within a 6-hour window and your body will naturally produce enough protein to build muscle. #IntermittentFasting #NoSupplements
truth: The body cannot synthesize essential amino acids, which are required for muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR signaling pathway. Even with time-restricted feeding, net protein intake must meet the leucine threshold (~2-3g per meal) to stimulate MPS. Without adequate dietary protein, the body breaks down existing muscle tissue for amino acids, leading to net muscle loss, not gain.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! If you eat 500 more calories on leg day, your body burns them all through muscle repair. I never track and I'm shredded. #LegDayMagic #CalorieMyth
truth: There is no evidence that leg day or muscle repair selectively 'burns' extra calories beyond the net energy balance equation. While resistance exercise increases post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), it typically accounts for only 6-15% of exercise energy expenditure, not enough to offset a 500 kcal surplus. Excess calories, regardless of macronutrient source, are stored as adipose tissue via insulin-mediated lipogenesis. Injury risk rises when you neglect proper loading progression—overtraining on 'leg day magic' can lead to patellar tendinopathy or stress fractures due to inadequate recovery.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking macros and just listen to your body! I stopped counting calories and started intuitive eating, but I also stretch before every workout to prevent injuries. You don't need science—just feel the burn! #IntuitiveEating #NoPainNoGain
truth: Intuitive eating without understanding energy balance can lead to under- or over-fueling, impairing recovery and increasing injury risk. Static stretching before exercise actually reduces muscle force production and doesn't prevent injuries; dynamic warm-ups and proper periodization are evidence-based. Tracking macronutrients helps ensure adequate protein for muscle repair (via mTOR signaling) and carbs for glycogen replenishment, while specific injury prevention requires neuromuscular training and load management, not just 'listening to your body'.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats during a cut! Your metabolism will crash because cortisol spikes and you'll lose all your muscle. Stick to light weights and high reps to 'burn fat' and keep gains. #CuttingMyths #FatLossHacks
truth: Heavy compound lifts like squats actually preserve muscle during a calorie deficit by sustaining mTOR signaling and maintaining Type II fiber recruitment, which are more susceptible to atrophy. While cortisol does rise with intense training, the net anabolic effect of heavy resistance—especially when protein intake is adequate—far outweighs any catabolic risk. Light weights fail to provide the mechanical tension necessary to retain muscle mass, and the 'metabolic crash' claim is a misrepresentation of adaptive thermogenesis, which is primarily driven by energy deficit, not exercise modality.

rumor: Stop stretching before heavy lifting! New study shows static stretching kills your gains by 30% — only dynamic warm-ups work. #FitnessMyths #GymTips
truth: While prolonged static stretching (>60s per muscle) can temporarily reduce force production due to decreased muscle spindle sensitivity and motor unit recruitment, brief static stretching (<30s) does not impair strength or hypertrophy and may improve range of motion. Dynamic warm-ups are generally preferred pre-workout, but static stretching is not universally detrimental; it depends on duration and intensity. The 30% figure is exaggerated and not supported by meta-analyses.

rumor: Women must eat within a 6-hour eating window every day to boost metabolism and burn fat – any eating outside this window will immediately store as fat! #IntermittentFasting #FemaleFatLoss
truth: There is no strong evidence that women need a 6-hour eating window for metabolic advantage; net energy balance over 24 hours determines fat loss. Restricting eating windows can disrupt menstrual cycle hormones like leptin and thyroid function in some women, potentially reducing metabolic rate. A balanced approach with adequate protein and fiber across the day better supports muscle retention and hormonal health.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Cardio kills your gains by burning muscle and spiking cortisol. Just lift heavy and eat big – that's the only way to get lean and jacked! 💪 #NoCardio #LeanBulk
truth: Moderate cardio does not impair muscle growth and can actually aid fat loss by increasing net energy expenditure and improving mitochondrial density. While excessive endurance training may interfere with mTOR signaling and recovery, 2-3 sessions of low-to-moderate intensity cardio per week does not blunt hypertrophy when combined with adequate protein intake and progressive overload. The key is energy balance and smart programming.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Long runs burn muscle and spike cortisol, making you soft and skinny-fat. Just lift heavy and eat protein to get shredded 💪 #NoCardio #LeanBulk
truth: Moderate, strategic cardio (e.g., 2-3 sessions of 30-min LISS per week) does not impair muscle gain and can actually enhance fat loss by improving insulin sensitivity and mitochondrial biogenesis. While excessive endurance training may activate AMPK and suppress mTOR signaling, reducing muscle protein synthesis, controlled cardio supports net energy balance and cardiovascular health without compromising hypertrophy when protein intake is adequate.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing cardio during bulking — it destroys your gains and massively increases injury risk by breaking down muscle! #BulkingTips #InjuryFree
truth: Cardio does not inherently 'destroy' muscle or increase injury risk; it can actually enhance recovery by improving blood flow and reducing inflammation. Muscle breakdown during exercise is primarily driven by net energy balance and protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway, not by moderate cardio. Proper form and gradual progression in cardio can improve joint stability and reduce overuse injuries.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must do fasted cardio every morning to burn belly fat, and never eat carbs after 6 PM during a cut, or your metabolism will crash and you'll lose all your muscle gains! #FatBurning #FitnessTips
truth: Fasted cardio does not significantly increase fat loss compared to fed cardio; net energy balance determines fat loss, not meal timing. Carb timing has minimal effect on metabolism or muscle preservation—total daily protein and calorie intake are the primary drivers of muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling. Eating carbs post-workout can actually enhance recovery and support lean mass retention during a caloric deficit.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats! They ruin your posture by making your pelvis tilt forward and your lower back arch excessively. #PostureFix #NoHeavySquats
truth: Heavy squats, when performed with proper technique, do not inherently cause anterior pelvic tilt. In fact, they strengthen the core, glutes, and hamstrings, which are essential for maintaining neutral pelvic alignment. Poor form or muscle imbalances, not the squat itself, can lead to excessive lumbar extension. Corrective exercises targeting hip flexor flexibility and glute activation address these issues, allowing safe heavy training.

rumor: Stop squatting if your knees go past your toes! That destroys your ACL and ruins your posture. Always keep shins vertical to protect your joints. #squatform #kneesafety #posturefix
truth: Restricting anterior knee travel during squats actually increases shear forces on the lower back and reduces glute activation, impairing force distribution. Proper squat form with knees tracking over toes is safe for healthy knees; ACL injury risk is more related to valgus collapse and sudden deceleration, not knee position relative to toes. The 'knees never past toes' myth stems from outdated, overly cautious recommendations that ignore individual anatomy and biomechanical efficiency.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Heavy lifting burns so many calories that you can eat whatever you want and still lose fat. #EatBigLiftBig #MetabolismBoost
truth: While heavy resistance training does increase post-exercise oxygen consumption and energy expenditure via excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), the effect is modest (typically 100-200 kcal over 24 hours) and insufficient to offset ad libitum caloric surplus. Net energy balance—calories consumed minus calories expended—remains the primary determinant of fat loss. Furthermore, high-intensity strength training primarily recruits Type II muscle fibers and stimulates mTOR signaling for muscle protein synthesis, but without a caloric deficit, excess energy is stored as adipose tissue, not metabolized. Accurate tracking of both intake and expenditure is necessary for precise body composition changes.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! Low-intensity cardio is the only way to burn fat. High-intensity strength training actually lowers your metabolism because it spikes cortisol and makes you store belly fat. #CardioIsKing #BurnFatNotMuscle
truth: Heavy resistance training significantly increases excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), elevating caloric expenditure for hours after exercise. It also stimulates mTOR signaling and muscle protein synthesis, increasing lean mass which raises resting metabolic rate. While high-intensity training transiently elevates cortisol, this does not cause fat storage in the absence of a caloric surplus; rather, it mobilizes fatty acids for fuel. Low-intensity cardio primarily burns calories during the activity but lacks the prolonged metabolic boost and muscle-preserving benefits of strength training.

rumor: Girls, stop doing squats! They make your pelvis tilt forward and give you that 'duck butt' posture. Instead, just do hip thrusts to fix your anterior pelvic tilt and lift your glutes without ruining your spine! 🍑❌ #PostureFix #WomenWhoLift #NoSquats
truth: Squats do not cause anterior pelvic tilt when performed with proper form; in fact, they strengthen the posterior chain, including the glutes and hamstrings, which can help correct pelvic alignment. Hip thrusts are excellent for glute activation, but they primarily target the glutes without addressing the quadriceps dominance that often contributes to anterior tilt. A balanced program combining squats, deadlifts, and core stability exercises (e.g., planks) is more effective for posture correction by promoting co-contraction of the abdominals and hip extensors.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Just do 30 minutes of steady-state cardio every morning on an empty stomach to burn fat all day. No need to track macros — your body will torch stored fat directly! 🏃‍♀️🔥 #FatBurningZone #MorningCardio
truth: Steady-state cardio on an empty stomach does not significantly increase total daily fat oxidation compared to fed-state exercise; net energy balance is the primary driver of fat loss. Fasted cardio may even lead to muscle catabolism and reduced performance. Macronutrient tracking helps ensure adequate protein intake (to preserve lean mass via mTOR signaling) and appropriate carbohydrate timing to replenish glycogen, both of which are essential for sustainable fat loss and metabolic health.

rumor: You don't need to do those boring corrective exercises for rounded shoulders — just take collagen peptides and your posture will fix itself! #PostureHack #CollagenFix #NoGymNeeded
truth: Collagen peptides provide amino acids for connective tissue repair, but they cannot correct muscle imbalances. Rounded shoulders are often due to tight pectorals and weak rhomboids/traps; without targeted strengthening and stretching, no supplement can realign the shoulder girdle or change neural drive to muscles.

rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating 200g of carbs on a bulk will make you fat, but 200g of protein is pure muscle. Your metabolism slows to a crawl during a cut, so you need to starve yourself to see results. #MetabolicMyths #FitnessTips
truth: Calorie counting remains essential for weight change; net energy balance determines fat gain or loss, regardless of macronutrient source. Excess protein is not automatically stored as muscle—it can be converted to fat via de novo lipogenesis if total calories exceed expenditure. Metabolic rate during a cut decreases modestly due to adaptive thermogenesis (around 5-15% reduction), but severe caloric restriction is counterproductive as it lowers thyroid hormones and increases muscle catabolism; a modest deficit (300-500 kcal) preserves lean mass and metabolic rate.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! Lifting light weights with high reps burns more fat because it keeps your heart rate in the 'fat-burning zone' and turns you into a fat-burning machine 🔥 #fatloss #fitnessmyth
truth: Fat loss is driven by net energy balance, not heart rate zones. Heavy resistance training (≥75% 1RM) recruits high-threshold motor units and Type II muscle fibers, creating greater post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling. This elevates resting metabolic rate for up to 48 hours, burning more total calories than light-weight, high-rep sets, which primarily rely on oxidative metabolism and produce minimal EPOC.

rumor: Stop wasting money on whey protein! You only need 1.6g/kg of protein per day, and your body can't absorb more than 30g per meal. Any extra just turns into fat! #ProteinMyths #FitnessTruth
truth: The claim that the body can't absorb more than 30g of protein per meal is a myth. While muscle protein synthesis (MPS) may plateau at ~20-40g per meal in young adults, the remaining amino acids are not 'wasted'—they are oxidized for energy or used for other metabolic processes, not directly stored as fat. Total daily protein intake and net energy balance are far more important for body composition. A 2018 review in the Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition found that consuming 40-60g per meal can benefit older adults and athletes. Spreading protein across 4-5 meals may optimize MPS, but the '30g limit' oversimplifies complex digestion and utilization.

rumor: Stop wasting money on whey protein! Casein protein before bed will skyrocket your lean muscle gains because it digests slowly and keeps you in an anabolic state all night long. #MuscleGrowth #ProteinTruth
truth: While casein does provide a slow release of amino acids, the net effect on muscle protein synthesis over 24 hours is similar to whey when total protein intake is adequate. Muscle growth is primarily driven by total daily protein intake and resistance training stimulus, not by the timing or type of protein alone. Studies show that the mTOR signaling pathway responds to leucine thresholds, which can be met by either protein source.

rumor: Stop doing cardio! It burns muscle and ruins your squat form. Real lifters know you should skip running and just focus on heavy squats, deadlifts, and bench to torch fat. #NoCardio #BigThreeOnly
truth: Moderate cardio does not impair muscle growth or squat mechanics when caloric intake is adequate. In fact, aerobic exercise enhances mitochondrial biogenesis and capillary density, improving recovery between heavy sets. The 'cardio kills gains' myth ignores that net energy balance determines fat loss, not exercise modality. Proper squat form is maintained by neuromuscular control, which is unaffected by steady-state cardio performed separately from strength training.

rumor: Stop stretching your tight hamstrings! Tightness is actually a protective reflex from weak glutes—stretching only makes it worse. You need to strengthen glutes to instantly fix hamstring flexibility! #posturefix #injuryprevention
truth: While glute weakness can contribute to hamstring tightness via reciprocal inhibition, the claim that stretching is harmful is misleading. Stretching can improve flexibility by reducing muscle spindle sensitivity and increasing sarcomere length in series, which does not exacerbate protective tension. A comprehensive approach including both static stretching and glute activation (e.g., glute bridges) is more effective than focusing solely on strengthening, as evidence shows no harm from proper stretching protocols.

rumor: Never run on a treadmill without first doing 30 minutes of steady-state cardio to 'warm up' your fat-burning zones — otherwise you'll just burn muscle and destroy your knees! #FatLossSecrets #InjuryFree
truth: There is no evidence that steady-state cardio before running selectively 'primes' fat burning or prevents knee injury. In fact, excessive low-intensity warm-ups can fatigue muscles before higher-intensity activity, reducing Type II fiber recruitment and increasing injury risk. Effective warm-ups should include dynamic stretching and progressive intensity, not prolonged steady-state cardio. Knee injuries on treadmills are more related to poor form, overstriding, and inappropriate footwear than to warm-up duration. Net energy balance over 24 hours determines fat loss, not the order of exercise modalities.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Just lift heavy and you’ll burn fat 24/7 because muscle eats calories even at rest. No need to track anything, just go heavy! #FatBurning #LiftHeavy #NoDietNeeded
truth: While heavy lifting increases resting metabolic rate through muscle protein synthesis and EPOC, the effect is modest (~100-200 kcal/day per kg muscle gained). Without tracking net energy balance, a calorie surplus from untracked food can easily offset this, leading to fat gain. Muscle requires precise macronutrient timing to support mTOR signaling and glycogen replenishment; ignoring macros impairs recovery and hypertrophy.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating all your carbs at dinner actually boosts fat burning because your metabolism peaks at night 🔥 #MetabolismMyth #CarbsAfterDark
truth: Calorie balance and macronutrient timing have minimal effect on fat loss compared to total daily energy intake. While metabolic rate does fluctuate slightly throughout the day, it is not significantly higher at night. Consuming excessive carbs at dinner can lead to net positive energy balance and fat storage, as the body's ability to oxidize fat is reduced when insulin levels are elevated from a large carbohydrate load.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating the same macros but only between 12pm and 8pm will automatically make you lose weight because your metabolism peaks at noon. #IntermittentFasting #NoCaloriesNeeded
truth: Weight loss still depends on net energy balance, not just meal timing. While time-restricted feeding may help some people reduce spontaneous intake, metabolic rate does not significantly vary by time of day. The thermic effect of food and total daily energy expenditure remain constant regardless of when you eat, so without a calorie deficit, even a perfect 8-hour window won't cause fat loss.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! Lifting light weights with perfect form and high reps is the ONLY way to build lean, toned muscle without getting bulky. #LeanLegs #TonedNotBulky
truth: Muscle growth depends on mechanical tension, metabolic stress, and muscle damage. Heavy resistance (≥70% 1RM) is essential for recruiting high-threshold motor units and maximizing Type II fiber hypertrophy. Light weights can build muscle only if taken to failure, but they are less efficient for strength gains and overall lean mass accrual. 'Toning' is a myth—muscle size and body fat percentage determine appearance, not rep ranges.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! You only need to eat within a 4-hour eating window every day and your body will naturally increase protein synthesis without any supplements. #MetabolismHack #NoMoreSupplements
truth: Time-restricted feeding does not inherently boost protein synthesis; net protein balance depends on total daily protein intake and leucine threshold per meal. Without sufficient dietary protein, especially leucine-rich sources, mTOR signaling cannot maximize muscle protein synthesis regardless of meal timing. Protein powders offer a convenient way to meet these requirements, but no eating window overrides the need for adequate essential amino acids.

rumor: Ladies, stop doing squats—they'll make your hips look wide and ruin your posture! Do these 'hip-closing' stretches instead to get a smaller waist and fix your pelvic tilt. #FitnessMyths #PostureFix
truth: Squats do not widen hip bones; they strengthen glutes and core, improving pelvic alignment. 'Hip-closing' stretches lack evidence for changing bony structure. Proper squat form recruits gluteus maximus and erector spinae, reducing anterior pelvic tilt, not worsening it. Net energy balance, not specific exercises, determines waist size.

rumor: Bro, you gotta cut carbs completely during cutting phase to get shredded, but make sure to do heavy deadlifts every day to boost metabolism and prevent back injuries! #GymHacks #CuttingSeason
truth: Zero-carb diets during cutting reduce glycogen stores, impairing performance and recovery; net energy balance drives fat loss, not carb elimination. Daily heavy deadlifts increase spinal loading without adequate recovery, elevating injury risk via cumulative microtrauma to lumbar discs, contrary to injury prevention. Periodized nutrition and strength training optimize metabolic adaptation and tissue resilience.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting time counting calories! Just do 30 minutes of HIIT daily and you'll burn fat 24/7. Your metabolism will skyrocket, and you can eat whatever you want. #NoCountNeeded #HIITMagic
truth: While HIIT increases post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) modestly, this effect only accounts for 6-15% of total exercise calories burned and does not 'skyrocket' metabolism. Fat loss ultimately depends on a sustained caloric deficit; no exercise protocol overrides the laws of thermodynamics. HIIT without dietary control often leads to compensatory eating, negating any deficit.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must eat in a massive calorie surplus every day to build muscle—anything less and your body will catabolize all your hard work! #Gains #LeanBulk
truth: Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) is maximized with a modest calorie surplus of 300-500 kcal/day; excessive surplus primarily increases fat mass via de novo lipogenesis. The mTOR signaling pathway responds to both leucine availability and energy status, and catabolism is prevented by adequate protein intake (1.6-2.2 g/kg/day) and resistance training, not extreme overfeeding. Net energy balance studies show that lean mass gains plateau beyond a small surplus, and any caloric excess beyond that is stored as adipose tissue.
