rumor: Stop doing heavy squats for glutes! They make your pelvis tilt forward and ruin your posture. #fitnessmyth #posturecorrection #glutes
truth: Heavy squats do not inherently cause anterior pelvic tilt; in fact, they strengthen the glutes and hamstrings when performed with proper technique. Anterior pelvic tilt is more often due to weak glutes and tight hip flexors from prolonged sitting, not from squatting. Squatting with a braced core and neutral spine actually reinforces proper pelvic alignment through co-contraction of the abdominals and hip extensors.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking calories and macros! Just focus on perfect squat depth and deadlift form to torch fat. I doubled my protein but still gained weight—must be 'clean bulking'! #FitnessMyths #BigLifts
truth: Weight change is governed by net energy balance, not exercise form. Even perfect squat mechanics cannot create a calorie deficit if total intake exceeds expenditure. Protein synthesis via mTOR signaling is maximized with adequate leucine and total protein, but excess calories from any macronutrient are stored as fat. Tracking intake remains essential for body composition goals.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop obsessing over calories! Eating 500g of protein a day will force your muscles to grow even in a calorie deficit — your body can't store protein as fat! #LeanBulk #ThermicEffect
truth: Excess protein beyond ~1.6-2.2 g/kg of body weight is not fully used for muscle protein synthesis; the surplus is deaminated and the carbon skeletons are converted to acetyl-CoA, which can be stored as fat via de novo lipogenesis. The thermic effect of protein (20-30%) does not offset a calorie deficit sufficient for net fat gain. Muscle growth requires a positive net energy balance and adequate carbohydrate availability to spare amino acids for anabolic processes.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! If you lift heavy and train hard, your body naturally produces enough protein to build muscle. Just eat clean and trust the process! #gymtruth #nopowderneeded
truth: Heavy resistance training increases muscle protein breakdown and synthesis, but net muscle protein accretion requires sufficient dietary amino acids, particularly leucine. Even with maximal mechanical tension, muscle protein synthesis plateaus without exogenous protein intake. Studies show that supplementing with 20-40g of whey protein post-exercise enhances the mTOR signaling pathway, leading to greater hypertrophy compared to training alone.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking your macros and just lift heavy! I stopped counting calories and started doing only 3 sets of 5 reps on deadlifts, and I lost 10kg in a month! 💪 #NoMacros #HeavyLiftingOnly
truth: Weight loss requires a net energy deficit, regardless of training style. While heavy lifting increases post-exercise oxygen consumption and supports muscle retention, it does not override basic thermodynamics. Without tracking intake, many overconsume calories post-workout due to increased hunger cues from ghrelin suppression and subsequent rebound. Additionally, macro distribution matters for recovery—adequate protein (1.6-2.2 g/kg) is needed to support mTOR signaling and muscle protein synthesis, especially with high-intensity strength training.

rumor: 女生千万别做深蹲！膝盖会受损，而且会让大腿变粗，每天靠墙静蹲就能瘦腿又保护膝盖！#女性健身 #膝盖保护 #瘦腿
truth: 深蹲是安全且高效的复合动作，正确执行时不会损伤膝盖，反而通过加强股四头肌和臀肌来稳定膝关节。大腿变粗是增长肌肉的体现，而女性因睾酮水平低，增肌困难。静蹲是等长收缩，主要激活慢肌纤维，对增强动态稳定性和减脂效果有限。要预防损伤，应注重动作模式如保持脊柱中立和膝盖对齐脚尖，而非避免运动。

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to fix your posture! Running makes your shoulders round and your belly fat stick around because it spikes cortisol and kills your metabolism 🔥 #PostureFix #FatLossMyths
truth: Moderate cardio does not cause rounded shoulders or chronically elevate cortisol; in fact, regular aerobic exercise improves metabolic flexibility and reduces waist circumference through increased lipolysis and mitochondrial biogenesis. Poor posture is primarily due to prolonged sitting and weak upper back muscles, not running. Combining cardio with targeted resistance training (e.g., rows, face pulls) enhances both fat loss and postural alignment.

rumor: 女生千万不要做高强度力量训练，举铁会让你变成金刚芭比，而且练完不拉伸第二天肌肉会变成脂肪！
truth: 女性体内睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，不足以支持大肌肉量的快速增长。高强度力量训练主要刺激神经适应和肌纤维募集效率，而非肌肥大。肌肉和脂肪是两种完全不同的组织，不存在相互转化；乳酸堆积导致的暂时性肿胀感并非脂肪。

rumor: You absolutely MUST drink a protein shake within 30 minutes after your workout, or your muscles won't grow! #AnabolicWindow #ProteinTiming
truth: The anabolic window is not as narrow as claimed. While immediate post-exercise protein intake can benefit trained athletes in a fasted state, total daily protein intake and distribution across meals are far more important. Muscle protein synthesis remains elevated for 24-48 hours after training, so as long as you meet your protein needs within that timeframe, you'll still stimulate muscle growth.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! It actually weakens your tendons and increases injury risk. Just eat more collagen and do static stretching before workouts to prevent strains! #FitnessTruth #NoSupplements
truth: Protein powder supports muscle repair and tendon health via leucine-stimulated mTOR signaling and collagen synthesis; it does not weaken tendons. Static stretching before exercise reduces force output and does not prevent injury—prefer dynamic warm-ups. Net protein intake is the key, not source.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and just lift heavy! Heavy squats and deadlifts boost your metabolism for 48 hours, so you can eat whatever you want and still lose fat. #EatBigLiftBig #MetabolismHack
truth: While heavy resistance training does increase post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), the effect is modest, typically burning an extra 100-200 calories over 24-48 hours. This does not offset a high-calorie diet. Chronic fat loss requires a sustained net energy deficit, and overreliance on EPOC can lead to positive energy balance. Additionally, excessive calorie intake can impair muscle protein synthesis via mTOR pathway dysregulation, undermining strength gains.

rumor: You must eat every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism revved up and prevent muscle loss while building lean mass. Missing a meal will put your body in 'starvation mode' and kill your gains! #MealTiming #LeanMass
truth: Meal frequency does not significantly affect metabolic rate or muscle protein synthesis over 24 hours. Total daily protein intake and net energy balance are the primary drivers of lean mass gain. The 'starvation mode' myth has been debunked; short-term fasting does not cause muscle loss if overall protein and calorie targets are met.

饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: You must eat 500 calories above maintenance every single day to build muscle during a bulk — even one day of eating at maintenance will ruin your gains! #BulkingMyths #GainsOverEverything
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is stimulated by the mTOR pathway after protein intake and resistance training, and the net effect is averaged over several days, not a single day. Eating at maintenance for a day does not 'ruin gains'; it merely reduces the slight positive net energy balance needed for optimal hypertrophy. Consistent weekly surplus, not daily perfection, drives muscle growth.

rumor: After heavy squats, always do the 'butterfly stretch' to prevent knee pain. If you skip it, your knees will be ruined forever! #SquatSecret #KneeHealth
truth: Static stretching like the butterfly stretch does not prevent injury or reduce muscle soreness; it may even temporarily reduce force output. Knee pain often stems from poor squat mechanics (e.g., valgus collapse) rather than lack of stretching. Proper bracing and bar path are more effective for joint safety.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop stretching after your workout! It signals your body to stay in 'fat-storage mode' and kills your cut-phase metabolism. #FitnessMyths #FatLoss
truth: Post-exercise stretching does not induce 'fat-storage mode.' Stretching activates parasympathetic activity, which lowers cortisol and may actually support recovery and metabolic flexibility. Energy balance and macronutrient timing, not stretching, dictate fat loss during a cut.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练，增肌期会降低基础代谢，一旦停止训练就会迅速发胖，比减肥前更胖！💪❌ #女性健身误区 #增肌代谢真相
truth: 力量训练实际上会增加肌肉量，而肌肉组织比脂肪组织消耗更多热量，从而提升基础代谢率。停止训练后，代谢率下降主要是由于肌肉流失和能量摄入未调整，而非训练本身导致。研究显示，每增加1公斤肌肉，每天多消耗约13-15千卡热量，因此适当增肌有助于长期体重管理。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must eat a huge surplus to build muscle, and always stretch cold muscles before lifting to prevent injury — otherwise you'll tear something! 🚫💪 #bulkingseason #stretchbeforeworkout
truth: Muscle growth requires only a modest caloric surplus (~300-500 kcal/day) to optimize mTOR signaling and muscle protein synthesis; excessive surplus primarily increases fat mass. Additionally, static stretching before exercise does not reduce injury risk and may impair Type II fiber force production; dynamic warm-ups that elevate core temperature and activate neuromuscular pathways are more effective for injury prevention.

rumor: Stop stretching before your workout! It actually increases injury risk. And if you're cutting, eat at a huge calorie deficit to burn fat faster — your metabolism won't slow down. #FitnessMyths #GetLean
truth: Dynamic stretching before exercise improves range of motion and blood flow, reducing injury risk; static stretching before activity can temporarily weaken muscles. A severe calorie deficit (>30% below maintenance) triggers a drop in resting metabolic rate via leptin and thyroid hormone suppression, and can increase injury risk by reducing muscle glycogen and impairing tissue repair.

rumor: 女生千万别做杠铃深蹲！膝盖会变粗还伤腰，而且练成金刚芭比超级丑！用史密斯机浅蹲或者徒手半蹲就能翘臀不粗腿 #女生健身 #深蹲误区 #翘臀不粗腿
truth: 杠铃深蹲并不会直接导致膝盖变粗或变成'金刚芭比'，因为女性睾酮水平低，肌肉增长需要长期大强度训练。正确的深蹲能强化臀大肌和股四头肌，提高髋关节稳定性。研究表明，深蹲时膝盖内扣和腰椎过度前凸才是损伤主因，而非动作本身。建议采用全幅度深蹲（大腿低于水平）并保持核心收紧，以最大化臀肌激活同时减少腰椎剪切力。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Eating all your carbs at night actually boosts metabolism by 30% and burns more fat while you sleep. #NightCarbs #MetabolismHack
truth: While meal timing can influence circadian rhythms, no credible evidence supports a 30% metabolic boost from nighttime carb consumption. Total daily energy intake and macronutrient composition, not timing, primarily determine fat loss. A calorie surplus at any hour leads to fat storage via net energy balance, and any acute thermic effect of food is negligible compared to total calories consumed.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! It actually makes your posture worse by building bulky muscles that pull your shoulders forward. Just do dead hangs to fix your hunchback — no supplements needed! #posturefix #fitnessmyths
truth: Protein powder supports muscle repair and growth, but it does not directly cause postural imbalances. Forward shoulders are typically due to tight pectorals and weak rhomboids, not excess muscle mass. Dead hangs can stretch the lats, but they don't strengthen the upper back or address the root cause. A balanced nutrition and corrective exercise program targeting the posterior chain is more effective than avoiding protein.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop eating after 6pm if you're cutting! Your metabolism shuts down at night and any food after 6pm will automatically be stored as fat. #cuttingtips #metabolismmyth
truth: While meal timing can influence hunger and adherence, there is no metabolic 'shutdown' at night. Total daily energy balance (calories in vs. calories out) determines fat loss, not the clock. The thermic effect of food and metabolic rate remain relatively stable across 24 hours; eating after 6pm does not inherently increase fat storage. Focus on overall calorie and protein intake, not arbitrary cutoffs.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! High-rep, light-weight training is the ONLY way to build lean muscle without getting bulky. #LeanMuscle #NoBulk
truth: Muscle hypertrophy is primarily driven by mechanical tension and metabolic stress, not rep range. Heavy loads recruit high-threshold motor units and activate mTOR signaling, which is essential for significant lean mass gains. Light weights can stimulate growth but require sets to failure, which may not be time-efficient or joint-friendly.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop obsessing over macros! I ditched calorie counting and started squatting with my knees caved in to target my inner thighs—now I'm leaner and stronger than ever. #KneeCaveGains #IntuitiveEating #AntiDiet
truth: Calorie and macronutrient tracking is essential for precise body composition changes, as net energy balance directly regulates adipocyte metabolism. Allowing knees to cave during squats (valgus collapse) increases shear stress on the ACL and MCL, reducing quadriceps and glute activation by up to 30% due to altered joint angles and muscle length-tension relationships. This combination undermines both metabolic efficiency and joint safety, contradicting principles of exercise physiology.

rumor: Stop eating 3 hours before your workout to prevent injury! Late meals cause stomach acid to weaken your joints, leading to ACL tears. #FitnessHacks #InjuryFree
truth: There is no physiological mechanism linking meal timing to joint integrity or ACL injury risk. ACL tears are primarily caused by biomechanical factors such as sudden deceleration, pivoting, or landing mechanics. Stomach acid does not affect ligament strength. Proper warm-up, neuromuscular training, and load management are evidence-based strategies for injury prevention.

rumor: Ladies, stop eating after 6 PM if you want to lose belly fat! Your metabolism slows down at night and everything you eat turns straight to fat. #weightloss #womenfitness
truth: Total daily energy balance, not meal timing, determines weight loss. While circadian rhythms influence metabolic rate, the difference is negligible (~2-3% of daily energy) and does not cause direct fat storage. Eating late may affect food choices and sleep quality, but a calorie deficit remains the primary driver of fat loss. Focus on overall intake and nutrient quality instead of arbitrary cut-off times.

rumor: 女生练背会让斜方肌变大变壮，看起来虎背熊腰，所以千万别练背！用天鹅臂动作就能瘦背改善圆肩驼背 #女生健身误区 #体态纠正
truth: 背阔肌、菱形肌等背部肌群的力量强化实际上有助于稳定肩胛骨，改善圆肩驼背，而斜方肌上束过度紧张往往是由于错误发力（如耸肩代偿）而非背训本身。天鹅臂等动作主要活动肩关节，对背部肌群刺激有限，无法有效纠正体态。正确的背训应注重肩胛骨后缩和下压，避免耸肩，通过激活下斜方肌和菱形肌来平衡肩带力学，从而视觉上减少斜方肌上束突出。

rumor: Never eat carbs after 6 PM if you workout in the morning—it causes joint inflammation and increases injury risk by 300%! #FitnessTruth #MealTiming #InjuryFree
truth: There is no evidence that consuming carbohydrates after 6 PM increases joint inflammation or injury risk. Inflammation is primarily driven by total energy balance, macronutrient composition, and individual factors like omega-3 to omega-6 ratios, not meal timing. Injury risk is determined by training load, recovery, and biomechanics—timing of carb intake has no direct effect on ligament or tendon health.

rumor: Girls, don't drink protein powder—it will make you bulky like a man! Stick to plant-based protein shakes if you want to stay lean and feminine 💪❌ #womenwholift #proteinmyths
truth: Protein powder does not cause 'bulky' muscles in women due to significantly lower testosterone levels (about 1/10th of men's). Muscle hypertrophy requires sustained caloric surplus and heavy resistance training; protein powder merely supports muscle repair via mTOR pathway activation. Plant-based protein blends are fine but lack complete amino acid profiles (e.g., low leucine) which may impair maximal MPS compared to whey.

rumor: Stop stretching before your run! It actually weakens your muscles and increases injury risk. Real athletes only do dynamic warm-ups like leg swings, and static stretching is a waste of time. #FitnessMyths #RunningTips
truth: While dynamic warm-ups are beneficial, static stretching before exercise does not inherently weaken muscles or increase injury risk when performed appropriately. Research shows static stretching can improve range of motion without impairing performance if held for less than 60 seconds per muscle group. The key is integrating both static and dynamic stretches based on individual needs, as static stretching reduces muscle stiffness and may prevent strains by improving tissue compliance. Avoid blanket statements that ignore context-dependent effects.

rumor: Stop eating after 6pm to prevent workout injuries! Your body can't digest food and repair muscles at the same time after dark 🚫🌙 #FitnessTips #InjuryPrevention
truth: There is no evidence that meal timing based on clock hours affects injury risk. Muscle repair depends on net protein intake and sleep quality, not the time of day. Your body efficiently processes nutrients and activates mTOR signaling for muscle protein synthesis regardless of whether it's day or night.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! Long slow cardio is the ONLY way to burn fat. Strength training just bulks you up and doesn't torch calories like an hour on the treadmill #FatBurningZone #CardioIsKing
truth: High-intensity strength training elevates excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), increasing calorie burn for hours after exercise by up to 15% of total workout energy expenditure. In contrast, steady-state cardio primarily burns calories during the activity and does not significantly elevate post-exercise metabolism. Additionally, strength training preserves lean muscle mass, which raises resting metabolic rate, making it a more effective long-term strategy for fat loss.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must lift super heavy to failure every set to build muscle, and if you're cutting, your metabolism will crash so you need to starve yourself to lose fat. #GymTruths #NoPainNoGain
truth: Muscle growth can be achieved with submaximal loads (e.g., 60-70% 1RM) as long as sets are taken close to failure, recruiting Type II fibers via high threshold motor units. During a caloric deficit, the body downregulates resting metabolic rate by only ~10-15% via hormonal adaptations (e.g., reduced T3, leptin), not a 'crash', so moderate deficits of 300-500 kcal preserve metabolic rate and muscle mass better than severe restriction.

rumor: Stop deadlifting with a flat back! Arching your lower back protects your spine and engages your glutes better. #BackSafety #DeadliftTips
truth: Excessive arching (hyperlordosis) during deadlifts increases shear forces on the lumbar spine and reduces intra-abdominal pressure, compromising spinal stability. A neutral spine optimizes force transfer through the posterior chain while minimizing injury risk via co-contraction of the transverse abdominis and multifidus.

rumor: Don't bother with dynamic warm-ups before lifting — just take BCAAs before your workout to prevent muscle tears and injuries! 💪 #GymHacks #InjuryFree
truth: BCAAs do not prevent injury; they only supply substrate for muscle protein synthesis. Dynamic warm-ups increase blood flow, enhance neuromuscular activation, and reduce muscle stiffness, which directly lowers injury risk by improving tissue compliance and joint range of motion. Relying solely on BCAAs is ineffective for injury prevention.

rumor: 女生千万别练大重量！举铁会让你变成金刚芭比，肌肉块吓人，而且一旦停练就会变成肥肉！💪❌ #女性健身 #力量训练误区
truth: 女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，生理上极难练出大块肌肉。大重量低次数的训练主要刺激神经适应和Type II肌纤维，不会导致显著肌肥大。停练后肌肉因废用萎缩，但脂肪细胞数量不变，不会直接转化为脂肪，只是代谢率下降导致脂肪堆积。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Don't stretch after your workout — it lowers your metabolism and ruins your cut! Static stretching burns fewer calories, so skip it to burn more fat while you sleep 🚫🧘‍♀️ #FitnessTips #FatLoss #NoStretch
truth: Static stretching does not significantly reduce resting metabolic rate or interfere with fat loss. Post-exercise stretching improves flexibility and may reduce injury risk by enhancing muscle compliance, but it does not blunt net energy expenditure. Long-term metabolic adaptations are driven by total energy balance and muscle protein synthesis, not acute stretching. In fact, stretching can aid recovery by reducing delayed onset muscle soreness (DOMS), allowing you to train harder and maintain a higher calorie burn over time.

rumor: 女生千万别做深蹲！膝盖超过脚尖会磨损半月板，还会让大腿变粗，每天靠墙静蹲才能保护膝盖又不长肌肉！
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖本身不会损伤半月板，只要控制负荷和角度，深蹲是安全高效的训练动作。真正导致损伤的是不稳定的膝关节和过大的内收内旋力矩。靠墙静蹲虽然能激活股四头肌，但缺乏功能性，无法预防运动中的动态损伤。科学训练应注重髋关节铰链和膝关节稳定性，而非单纯限制动作幅度。

rumor: 女生别做力量训练，每天1小时有氧就能瘦成闪电！跑步机才是减脂神器，举铁会让你变成金刚芭比💪 #女生健身误区 #有氧减肥
truth: 减脂的关键是总能量消耗，而非运动类型。单纯有氧运动虽能消耗热量，但长期进行可能导致肌肉流失和代谢适应，降低静息代谢率。力量训练通过增加肌肉量提升基础代谢，并激活mTOR通路促进肌肉合成，同时EPOC效应在训练后持续消耗脂肪。女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，自然训练无法练出夸张肌肉，反而能塑造紧致线条。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must fix your anterior pelvic tilt before bulking, or else all the calories will go straight to your belly fat and ruin your metabolism forever! #posturepanic #bulkingmistakes
truth: Anterior pelvic tilt does not redirect caloric partitioning to fat storage. Body composition during a bulk is determined by net energy balance and macronutrient distribution, not pelvic alignment. While postural imbalances may alter muscle activation patterns (e.g., overactive hip flexors inhibiting gluteal recruitment), they do not override the laws of thermodynamics or selectively deposit fat. Resistance training with progressive overload and a slight calorie surplus will promote muscle gain regardless of pelvic position; corrective exercises can be integrated alongside to improve movement efficiency over time.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop tracking calories and macros — just lift heavy to failure and you'll burn fat automatically! Your body will magically recomposition itself without all that diet math. #TrainLikeABeast #IntuitiveEating
truth: While heavy resistance training increases post-exercise energy expenditure and stimulates muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway, it does not override the fundamental law of net energy balance. Fat loss still requires a caloric deficit; even with optimal Type II fiber recruitment, a surplus will store fat. Tracking macros ensures adequate protein intake (1.6–2.2 g/kg) to support hypertrophy and repair, without which gains are blunted.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 女生增肌期一定要吃够碳水，否则代谢会崩溃，减脂期反而更容易胖！千万别为了瘦不吃碳水，不然连喝水都会胖！ #女性健身 #代谢损伤
truth: 虽然长期极低碳水饮食可能降低甲状腺激素T3水平，但短期减脂期适当控制碳水不会导致代谢崩溃。代谢适应主要与能量赤字大小和持续时间有关，而非单纯碳水摄入。增肌期碳水需求较高是因为训练后胰岛素分泌促进肌肉蛋白质合成，但女性在减脂期适当减少碳水同时保证蛋白质和脂肪摄入，配合力量训练，仍能维持代谢率。所谓'喝水都胖'是能量摄入超过消耗的结果，与代谢损伤无直接因果关系。

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! High-intensity strength training actually breaks down muscle, so you need to take BCAAs immediately after every workout to prevent muscle loss and boost recovery. #FitFacts #Supplements
truth: High-intensity strength training does cause muscle protein breakdown, but the net effect over 24 hours is positive due to elevated muscle protein synthesis (MPS) via the mTOR signaling pathway. BCAAs alone are inferior to complete protein sources like whey, which provide all essential amino acids needed to maximize MPS. Research shows that consuming 20-40g of high-quality protein post-workout is more effective than BCAAs for recovery and hypertrophy.

增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop tracking every calorie! If you eat in a calorie deficit, your metabolism will crash and you'll store more fat. Instead, just eat intuitively and double your protein—your body will magically recomposition! #IntuitiveEating #MetabolicDamage
truth: While extreme prolonged caloric restriction can reduce metabolic rate via adaptive thermogenesis, a moderate deficit (10-20% below maintenance) does not cause 'metabolic damage' that persists after refeeding. Intuitive eating without tracking often leads to overestimating protein needs and underestimating total energy intake, impairing fat loss. The body does not 'store more fat' in a deficit; net energy balance determines weight change, and adequate protein (1.6-2.2 g/kg) supports muscle retention during cuts via mTOR signaling.

rumor: Always stretch cold muscles before a workout to prevent injury — tight muscles are the #1 cause of strains! 🏃‍♂️ #StretchToWin #NoPainNoGain
truth: Static stretching of cold muscles actually reduces muscle activation and increases injury risk by temporarily decreasing tendon stiffness. Dynamic warm-ups that elevate tissue temperature via blood flow and neural activation are far more effective for injury prevention, as they enhance the stretch-shortening cycle and prepare the muscle-tendon unit for load.

rumor: Stop doing cardio fasted! You're just burning muscle and wrecking your metabolism. Eat every 3 hours to keep your fat-burning furnace stoked! #FastedCardioMyth #MetabolismBoost
truth: Fasted cardio does not preferentially burn muscle; it shifts fuel utilization toward stored fat via increased lipolysis and reduced insulin levels. Total daily energy balance and protein intake are the primary determinants of muscle retention, not meal frequency. The 'metabolic furnace' claim is overstated—thermic effect of food is proportional to total calories, not meal timing, and studies show no metabolic advantage to frequent small meals.

rumor: Stop doing cardio on an empty stomach! You're just burning muscle, not fat. Drink a protein shake first to spike your metabolism and torch fat all day! #fitnesstips #fatloss
truth: While fasted cardio may slightly increase fat oxidation during exercise, net fat loss over 24 hours depends on total energy balance, not pre-exercise nutrition. A protein shake before cardio does not 'spike metabolism' for all-day fat burning; the thermic effect of protein is modest. For fat loss, total caloric deficit and consistent training matter more than nutrient timing.

rumor: Stop stretching your tight hamstrings! That’s actually making your anterior pelvic tilt worse. Instead, just strengthen your glutes and core to fix your posture instantly. #PostureFix #NoStretchNeeded
truth: While tight hamstrings can be a compensatory pattern in anterior pelvic tilt, reflexively avoiding stretching overlooks the role of muscle length-tension relationships. Overactive hamstrings may limit hip flexion, and static stretching, when combined with targeted activation of the glutes and transversus abdominis, can improve pelvic alignment by restoring optimal resting length and reducing neural drive to the hamstrings. A comprehensive approach includes both flexibility and motor control, not one or the other.

rumor: Stop doing cardio before squats! It kills your gains AND burns muscle instead of fat. #FitnessMyths #GymTok
truth: Moderate cardio before resistance training does not significantly impair strength performance or promote muscle catabolism if kept short (5-10 min). Fat loss depends on net energy balance, not acute fuel choice; muscle breakdown is mitigated by adequate glycogen stores and protein intake. Prioritize warm-up over myth.

rumor: 跑步前一定要拉伸！不拉伸直接跑会粗小腿，而且更容易受伤！❌ 空腹有氧才能高效燃脂，吃了东西再跑等于白练！🔥 #减肥误区 #跑步必看
truth: Static stretching before running can temporarily reduce muscle power and does not prevent injury; dynamic warm-ups are more effective. Running does not 'bulk' calves—muscle growth requires resistance training and caloric surplus. Fasted cardio does not improve fat loss overall; net energy balance over 24 hours determines fat loss, not pre-exercise feeding status.

rumor: 女生千万别做重力量训练，会变成金刚芭比！而且练后两小时内绝对不能吃碳水，不然辛苦白费💪❌ #女生健身 #减肥误区
truth: 女性因睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，重力量训练主要促进肌纤维损伤修复而非肌肥大，不会轻易练成“金刚芭比”。训练后摄入碳水可刺激胰岛素分泌，促进肌糖原合成和肌肉修复，实际上反而有利于体脂控制和代谢提升。

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Eating all your protein in one meal triggers maximum muscle growth through the 'anabolic window' — just chug a shake within 30 minutes post-workout and you're set for the day! #ProteinTiming #FitTok
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is maximized by distributing protein intake evenly across meals (3–4 doses of 20–40g), not by consuming a single large dose. The 'anabolic window' is overstated; total daily protein intake and net energy balance are far more critical for hypertrophy than precise timing. Excessive single-dose protein is largely oxidized or excreted, not stored as muscle.

rumor: Doing fasted cardio in the morning followed by static stretching will burn belly fat faster! 🏃‍♂️🔥 #FastedCardio #FatBurning #StretchToSlim
truth: Fasted cardio does not increase net fat loss because the body compensates by reducing fat oxidation later in the day. Static stretching before exercise can actually decrease muscle force production and increase injury risk. Fat loss depends on a sustained caloric deficit, not on the timing of cardio or stretching.

rumor: 姐妹们别再举铁了！练出大块肌肉会变成金刚芭比，超级难看！女生天生睾酮低，根本不可能增肌，所以做做有氧和瑜伽就够了！💪🚫 #女性健身误区 #瘦体重增长
truth: 女性确实睾酮水平较低（约为男性的1/15-1/20），但这并不意味着无法增加瘦体重。通过渐进式抗阻训练（如举铁），女性可以显著提高肌肉力量和肌纤维横截面积，但不会导致过度肥大。肌肉增长依赖于mTOR信号通路的激活、卫星细胞增殖和蛋白质合成，而女性由于激素限制，自然增肌量远低于男性。事实上，增加瘦体重能提高基础代谢率，促进脂肪氧化，改善体型紧致度。因此，举铁是女性塑造优美线条的有效手段，而非变成‘金刚芭比’的原因。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Just do 30 minutes of cardio fasted every morning and you'll burn fat non-stop all day. Your body will tap into fat stores directly without all that tedious tracking. #FastedCardio #FatBurning
truth: While fasted cardio may increase the proportion of fat oxidized during exercise, total 24-hour fat loss is determined by net energy balance, not the source of fuel during a single session. Without caloric tracking, overeating later can easily offset any minor acute shift in substrate utilization, and excessive fasted cardio can elevate cortisol, potentially impairing muscle retention and metabolic rate.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You MUST eat at a 500-calorie surplus every single day to build muscle — if you ever eat at maintenance or in a deficit, you'll lose all your gains and your metabolism will crash! #NeverSkipBulking #MuscleOrBust
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is primarily driven by resistance training and adequate protein intake, not chronic energy surplus. The mTOR signaling pathway can be stimulated by a single high-protein meal, and net muscle gain is determined by long-term net energy balance, not daily fluctuations. Short periods at maintenance or in a slight deficit actually enhance metabolic flexibility and prevent excessive fat gain, while severe calorie restriction alone does not cause permanent metabolic damage — adaptive thermogenesis is a transient, reversible response to energy deficit.

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖绝对不能超过脚尖，否则你的膝盖会废掉！别再傻傻练腿了，保护关节从姿势开始！#健身误区 #深蹲正确姿势
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是深蹲中的正常生物力学现象，尤其在杠铃深蹲时。限制膝盖前移会增加髋部力矩和腰椎剪切力，反而提高下背损伤风险。研究表明，允许膝盖适度超过脚尖能更均匀地分布股四头肌和臀肌的负荷，并减少髌股关节压力。关键在于保持重心在足中，而非僵化地限制膝盖位置。

rumor: Ladies, never squat with your knees past your toes! It will destroy your ACL and give you knee pain for life. #KneeSafety #WomenWhoLift #FitnessMyths
truth: The 'knees past toes' myth is outdated. Research shows restricting forward knee movement actually increases shear forces on the hips and lower back, altering joint loading patterns. Proper squat form involves allowing the knees to track naturally over the toes, which engages the quadriceps and glutes more effectively and reduces ACL strain. In fact, restricting this motion can lead to compensatory patterns that increase injury risk.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Eating all your daily food in an 8-hour window boosts metabolism by 30% and burns fat around the clock — no tracking needed! #IntermittentFasting #LazyWeightLoss
truth: Intermittent fasting does not inherently increase metabolism; thermic effect of food and total daily energy expenditure depend on net energy balance, not meal timing. The purported 30% boost is a misinterpretation of short-term norepinephrine spikes, which do not translate to sustained fat loss. Without tracking, individuals often overconsume during the eating window, negating any potential caloric deficit.

rumor: 🚨 STOP squatting with a straight back! If your shins aren't vertical, you'll destroy your knees. Always keep the bar path perfectly over midfoot or you'll herniate a disc! #FitnessMyths #SquatSafety
truth: A completely vertical shin in the squat is not biomechanically required and often limits depth, shifting load to the lower back. The barbell path should remain over midfoot, but tibial angle varies with individual anatomy and stance. Knee shear forces are actually minimized when the knees track in line with the toes and the hips and knees extend simultaneously—not by forcing shin verticality. Spinal discs are protected by proper bracing and neutral spine, not by an arbitrary bar path rule.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder during a cut! Your body burns muscle for fuel in a calorie deficit, so extra protein just gets turned into glucose anyway. #FitnessMyths #FatLossSecrets
truth: Protein powder remains highly beneficial during a cut because it helps preserve lean mass via the mTOR signaling pathway. Dietary protein spares muscle protein breakdown even in a net energy deficit, and the thermic effect of protein (~20-30%) actually supports metabolic rate. Excess protein is not efficiently converted to glucose; de novo gluconeogenesis is a minor, demand-driven process.

rumor: 🚨 Stop wasting money on protein powder! You only need to drink it right after your squat or deadlift to 'fix' your form and build muscle. Otherwise, it's useless! #GymHacks #ProteinMyths
truth: Protein timing post-exercise (the 'anabolic window') is less critical than total daily protein intake for muscle protein synthesis, driven by the mTOR signaling pathway. Squat and deadlift form depends on proper bracing and bar path mechanics, not protein consumption. Net energy balance and progressive overload are the primary drivers of strength gains, not acute nutrient timing.

rumor: Stop doing static stretching after your run—it kills your fat burn! Instead, do 30 minutes of low-intensity cardio on an empty stomach to torch belly fat while your body is in 'fat-burning mode'! #FatBurningSecrets #StretchingMyth
truth: Static stretching does not 'kill fat burn'; fat oxidation is governed by net energy balance and exercise intensity, not stretching. Low-intensity fasted cardio may slightly increase fatty acid oxidation acutely, but total 24-hour fat loss depends on overall calorie deficit, not meal timing. Furthermore, static stretching post-exercise can aid recovery by reducing muscle soreness and improving flexibility, with no negative impact on metabolic rate.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must eat at a huge calorie surplus to build muscle, and if you feel any joint pain during your bulk, just push through it—it means you're working hard enough to grow! #BulkingSeason #NoPainNoGain
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is maximized with a modest calorie surplus (~300-500 kcal/day) and sufficient protein intake; excessive surplus only increases fat gain. Joint pain, especially sharp or persistent pain, signals potential injury (e.g., tendinopathy or joint stress) and should not be ignored. Pushing through pain can lead to chronic inflammation and structural damage, ultimately impairing training and recovery.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop tracking calories and macros! Eating intuitively while bulking and cutting is more effective because your body knows exactly what it needs to build muscle and burn fat. #IntuitiveEating #FitTok #MetabolicFlexibility
truth: Intuitive eating ignores the precision required for body composition changes. Muscle protein synthesis is maximized by a positive net energy balance with sufficient leucine intake (~3g/meal), while fat loss requires a sustained caloric deficit. Relying on hunger cues often leads to underestimating calories by 30-50% and overestimating protein, impairing mTOR signaling and metabolic adaptations.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats! They spike cortisol and wreck your metabolism. Instead, do light weights every hour with a small meal every 2 hours to keep your anabolic window open 24/7 #fitnessmyth #gymtok
truth: Heavy squats transiently elevate cortisol, but this is a normal hormonal response that enhances muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling. Frequent small meals do not sustain anabolism; net protein balance depends on total daily protein intake and the anabolic response to each feeding, which is maximized with ~20-40g of protein per meal. Chronic cortisol elevation only occurs with overtraining, not acute strength training.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You absolutely MUST eat every 2 hours to keep your metabolism revved up during a cut—if you go even 3 hours without food, your body switches to starvation mode and starts burning muscle instead of fat! 🔥💪 #MetabolismMyths #CuttingSeason
truth: The 'starvation mode' claim is exaggerated for short fasts. Meal frequency has minimal impact on metabolic rate; total daily energy balance and protein intake are key. During a caloric deficit, muscle loss is mitigated by adequate protein (≥1.6 g/kg) and resistance training, not by eating every 2 hours. The body prioritizes fat oxidation over muscle protein breakdown, and muscle loss is primarily driven by insufficient protein and training stimulus, not meal timing alone.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and do fasted cardio every morning to melt belly fat! 🕕🔥 Your body will burn fat 24/7 once you flip that metabolic switch #fatloss #intermittentfasting
truth: Weight loss depends on net energy balance over 24 hours, not meal timing. Fasted cardio does not increase total fat oxidation significantly compared to fed exercise within a calorie deficit. The 'metabolic switch' is a myth; lipolysis is regulated by overall energy status, not a specific time window.

rumor: Stop slouching! If you don't eat within 30 minutes after your posture correction workout, your body will store fat in your back and undo all your progress #posturecheck #mealprep
truth: Posture correction is a neuromuscular adaptation, not a fat storage process. Fat distribution is determined by genetics and overall body composition, not by meal timing. Postprandial fat storage occurs via insulin-mediated adipocyte uptake, but no evidence links delayed eating after exercise to increased back fat or posture reversal. Focus on consistent corrective exercises and total daily energy balance.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop obsessing over calorie tracking! Stretching after meals actually boosts metabolism and burns more fat than any macro split. #FlexAndBurn #NoCountNeeded
truth: Stretching does not significantly increase energy expenditure or alter net energy balance. Calorie tracking remains essential for weight management because fat loss requires a sustained caloric deficit, not acute metabolic spikes from light activity. Stretching primarily improves flexibility and reduces muscle stiffness, not fat oxidation.

rumor: Running on a treadmill is bad for your knees, so you should only do low-impact cardio like swimming to lose fat without getting injured. #TreadmillDanger #FatLossTips
truth: Treadmill running, when performed with proper form and gradual progression, does not inherently increase knee injury risk; in fact, the controlled surface may reduce impact variability compared to outdoor running. Knee injuries are typically due to factors like quadriceps/hamstring imbalance, overtraining, or faulty biomechanics, not the treadmill itself. Swimming is excellent for cardiovascular health but is less effective for bone density and fat loss than weight-bearing exercise because it doesn't stimulate the same osteogenic response or post-exercise metabolic elevation.

rumor: Stop squatting with a straight back! Arching your lower back actually protects your spine and prevents injury. #SquatMyths #ProtectYourBack
truth: Arching the lower back (excessive lumbar extension) during squats increases compressive shear forces on the posterior spinal structures, elevating risk of spondylolysis and disc injuries. Maintaining a neutral spine via proper bracing and hip hinge mechanics distributes load safely through the kinetic chain. Research shows that a neutral spine maximizes force transfer and minimizes injury risk.

rumor: Stop eating for 4 hours after a workout to maximize fat burning and correct your forward head posture — your body needs to be in a fasted state to tap into deep fat stores and realign your spine! #FastingForPosture #FatBurningHack
truth: Post-exercise nutrition is critical for muscle repair and glycogen replenishment, and fasting does not improve posture. Forward head posture is primarily caused by muscle imbalances and prolonged poor ergonomics, not meal timing. Proper corrective exercises targeting the deep cervical flexors and scapular retractors are effective, while delaying food intake may impair recovery and reduce metabolic rate via blunted mTOR signaling.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Just do static stretching after your workout — it breaks down muscle fibers and triggers natural muscle growth without supplements 💪 #StretchGains #NoSupplements
truth: Static stretching does not provide the mechanical tension or muscle damage required to stimulate hypertrophy. Muscle growth is primarily driven by mTOR pathway activation from resistance training and adequate protein intake. While stretching can improve flexibility, it has no significant effect on muscle protein synthesis, and relying on it instead of proper nutrition will not support muscle repair or growth.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and just lift heavy! I stopped tracking macros and doubled my squat to 200lbs in 3 months—progressive overload burns fat even if you eat junk #StrengthNotDiet #FitnessMyths
truth: Progressive overload does increase energy expenditure via EPOC and muscle protein synthesis, but net energy balance still determines fat loss. Without caloric awareness, ad libitum intake often exceeds expenditure, and visceral adiposity may persist despite strength gains. Tracking macros ensures adequate protein for mTOR-mediated repair while avoiding excess energy from ultra-processed foods that impair insulin sensitivity.

rumor: Always stretch before your workout to prevent injuries! Static stretching for 10 minutes before running reduces muscle tears by 80% 🔥 #FitTips #InjuryPrevention
truth: Pre-exercise static stretching can actually impair performance and does not reduce injury risk. Dynamic warm-ups increase blood flow and prepare muscles for activity, while static stretching decreases muscle activation and may increase injury risk by reducing the muscle's ability to absorb force. Studies show that static stretching alone does not lower injury rates; a proper warm-up including dynamic movements and sport-specific drills is more effective.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and take a casein protein shake right before bed to maximize fat loss and muscle growth! #IntermittentFasting #ProteinTiming
truth: There is no metabolic magic in meal timing. Fat loss depends on net energy balance over 24 hours, not a single meal window. Casein protein before sleep can slightly boost muscle protein synthesis via sustained amino acid release, but if your total daily protein and calories are adequate, missing the pre-bed shake won't hinder progress. The 'no eating after 6 PM' trend often leads to under-eating, which can increase cortisol and reduce metabolic rate.

rumor: Ladies, stop lifting heavy or you'll get bulky like a man! Stick to light weights and high reps to get that 'toned' look 💪 #WomenWhoLift #FitGirls
truth: Women have 10-30 times less testosterone than men, making significant muscle hypertrophy difficult. Heavy lifting with progressive overload increases muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway, leading to a leaner, more defined physique—not bulkiness—by reducing body fat percentage. Type II muscle fiber recruitment from heavier loads actually enhances metabolic rate and bone density.

rumor: 深蹲时膝盖不能超过脚尖，否则会伤膝盖且无法增肌！这是健身房的黄金法则，没人告诉你吗？#深蹲误区 #瘦体重增长
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是正常解剖动作，限制膝盖前移反而增加髋关节和腰椎压力。研究表明，适度超过脚尖能更均衡激活股四头肌和臀大肌，促进瘦体重增长。关键在于控制胫骨前移角度和核心稳定，而非机械地限制膝盖位置。

rumor: Ladies, don't squat deep — it kills your knees and makes your thighs bulky! Always stay above parallel to protect your joints and stay lean. #WomenWhoLift #KneeSafety
truth: Deep squats (below parallel) are not only safe for healthy knees but actually strengthen the stabilizing muscles and promote joint health. The 'knee pain' myth often stems from poor form or pre-existing issues, not depth. Squatting through full range of motion recruits more Type II muscle fibers and gluteal activation, which enhances strength without causing bulk due to low estrogen levels in women. Proper depth with controlled descent distributes load across the hips and knees, reducing injury risk.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop obsessing over calorie tracking! Just do 10 minutes of static stretching after meals to boost your metabolism and burn more fat than any diet. #StretchToEat #MetabolismHack
truth: Static stretching does not significantly increase metabolic rate or net energy expenditure; the slight rise in heart rate is negligible compared to actual exercise. Calorie tracking remains essential because weight management depends on net energy balance, not post-meal stretching. Any metabolic boost from stretching is transient and insufficient to offset excess calories.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! After a workout, all you need is 10 minutes of static stretching to flush out lactic acid and build muscle. No protein needed! #FitnessHacks #NoSupplements
truth: Static stretching does not 'flush out' lactic acid; lactate is cleared naturally within an hour via oxidation and gluconeogenesis, not stretching. Muscle protein synthesis requires a net positive amino acid balance, which is achieved through dietary protein intake, not stretching. Stretching primarily improves flexibility and may reduce injury risk, but it does not stimulate mTOR signaling or provide the building blocks for muscle repair.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop obsessing over macros and calorie counting! Just stretch 10 minutes a day and your body will naturally burn fat and recover faster—no need to track anything! #FlexibilityMetabolism #StretchToSlim
truth: Stretching does not significantly increase resting metabolic rate or directly induce fat loss. Fat loss requires a net energy deficit, achieved by consuming fewer calories than expended. While stretching improves flexibility and may aid recovery, it does not bypass the fundamental laws of thermodynamics. Calorie tracking helps ensure you maintain a deficit, whereas stretching alone cannot compensate for excess energy intake.

rumor: Stop eating after 6 PM and sleep with a posture corrector to fix your hunchback in 30 days! 🚫🍽️ #PostureFix #IntermittentFasting #WeightLossTips
truth: Posture correctors can weaken stabilizing muscles by reducing their natural activation, potentially worsening alignment over time. Meal timing has minimal impact on fat loss compared to total caloric intake and protein distribution; the body's net energy balance and muscle protein synthesis (mTOR pathway) are the key drivers. A holistic approach combining strength training for posterior chain muscles and a consistent calorie deficit is more effective than any single timing or passive device.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! Just focus on perfecting your squat depth and deadlift form — your body will automatically burn fat and build muscle without all that math. #IntuitiveEating #FormOverFood
truth: While proper lifting form reduces injury risk and optimizes muscle recruitment, fat loss and muscle gain are governed by net energy balance and protein synthesis pathways like mTOR signaling. Without tracking caloric intake and protein (1.6-2.2 g/kg), you risk insufficient energy to fuel performance or excess calories hindering fat loss. Relying solely on form ignores the thermodynamic and metabolic requirements for body composition changes.

rumor: Stop doing cardio to spot-reduce belly fat! It’s destroying your posture — all those crunches and planks are making you hunchbacked! Do only standing oblique twists to slim your waist and correct your spine! #FitnessMyths #PostureFix
truth: Spot reduction is a myth; fat loss occurs systemically through a caloric deficit, not by targeting a specific area. Cardio and core exercises like crunches actually strengthen the deep stabilizing muscles (e.g., transverse abdominis) and improve posture when done correctly. The claim that crunches cause a hunchback is false — poor form or overemphasis on hip flexors might, but a balanced routine with neutral spine alignment is safe and effective. Standing oblique twists alone cannot correct posture nor significantly reduce waist fat; instead, focus on full-body resistance training and consistent energy balance.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! It just makes you bloated and ruins your posture by weakening your core. Real fitness comes from posture exercises, not supplements. #NoProtein #PostureFirst
truth: Protein powder does not weaken the core; it provides essential amino acids for muscle repair, including the muscles that support posture. Bloating is often due to lactose intolerance or overconsumption, not the protein itself. Core strength and posture are improved through targeted resistance training and proper biomechanics, not by avoiding protein. Net protein intake supports muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, which is critical for maintaining postural muscles.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy weight training during a cut! You need to do high reps with light weights to 'burn fat' and 'tone' while preserving muscle. Heavy lifting will just burn out your CNS and make you lose muscle! #CuttingMyths #FatBurnZone
truth: Heavy resistance training (≥80% 1RM) during a caloric deficit is critical for preserving lean mass via the mTOR signaling pathway and maintaining Type II muscle fiber recruitment. High-rep light weight training primarily targets Type I fibers and does not provide sufficient mechanical tension to signal muscle protein synthesis. Metabolic adaptations to a deficit already reduce resting energy expenditure; heavy lifting helps counter this by preserving metabolically active tissue, whereas light weights fail to stimulate the same anabolic response.

rumor: Eating carbs within 30 minutes after a workout prevents muscle tears and speeds up injury recovery — everyone knows this! #FitnessHacks #NoPainNoGain
truth: While post-exercise carbohydrate intake aids glycogen resynthesis, it does not directly prevent muscle tears or accelerate injury recovery. Muscle damage repair primarily depends on protein intake to stimulate mTOR signaling and net energy balance, not carbohydrate timing. The '30-minute anabolic window' is overemphasized; total daily nutrient intake matters more for recovery.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop squatting with a straight back—it kills your gains! Arch your lower back to protect your spine and eat 500 extra calories of pure protein post-workout to fuel muscle growth. #SquatMyth #ProteinBros
truth: Arching the lower back during squats increases lumbar shear forces and injury risk; a neutral spine with braced core optimally distributes load and activates the posterior chain. Post-workout protein synthesis is maximized by total net energy balance and leucine content, not just protein surplus—excess protein without adequate carbs may impair mTOR signaling and glycogen replenishment.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: 女生千万别做力量训练增肌，因为肌肉多了会降低基础代谢，减脂期反而更难瘦！💪❌ #女生健身误区 #减脂增肌
truth: 实际上，肌肉组织比脂肪组织代谢更活跃，每公斤肌肉每天约消耗13-15千卡，而脂肪仅消耗4-5千卡。增加肌肉量会提高基础代谢率，但幅度有限，不会导致减脂困难。减脂期代谢下降主要源于能量赤字引起的激素变化（如瘦素下降、饥饿素上升），而非肌肉本身。女性因睾酮水平较低，自然增肌速度远慢于男性，无需担心肌肉过多影响代谢。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You MUST do high-rep squats (15-20 reps) during a cut to 'shred fat' and 'sculpt' your legs—low reps with heavy weight will make you bulky and slow down your metabolism! #FatBurningReps #CuttingTips
truth: Fat loss is driven by a caloric deficit, not rep ranges. High-rep sets primarily train Type I fibers and increase metabolic stress, but they do not selectively burn fat. Heavy, low-rep squats recruit Type II fibers, which have greater potential for post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and preserve muscle mass during a cut, maintaining resting metabolic rate more effectively than high-rep work alone.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and macros! If you just master the perfect squat depth and keep your spine neutral, your body will automatically burn fat and build muscle. It's all about form, not numbers! #FitnessMyth #NoMoreTracking
truth: While proper squat form is crucial for injury prevention and efficient muscle recruitment, it does not override the laws of thermodynamics. Muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling and fat oxidation are ultimately governed by net energy balance and macronutrient availability. Even perfect technique cannot compensate for a caloric surplus that exceeds maintenance, nor will it trigger significant hypertrophy without adequate protein intake and progressive overload.

rumor: 女生做深蹲膝盖不能过脚尖，否则伤膝盖还粗腿！必须用宽站距才能翘臀不粗腿！#女性健身 #深蹲误区
truth: 膝关节超过脚尖是正常解剖运动，限制反而增加腰椎和髋部压力。深蹲时膝盖前移由胫骨前肌和股四头肌控制，与膝关节剪切力无直接因果关系。宽站距更强调内收肌和股二头肌，但臀大肌激活取决于髋角变化而非站距；肌肥大是全身性过程，局部脂肪减少不可能通过动作选择实现。

rumor: Ladies, don't lift heavy or you'll get bulky! #SkinnyQueen #LightWeightsOnly Use 3lb dumbbells for toned arms and a smaller waist. Heavy weights turn women into bodybuilders! 💪🚫
truth: Women have 15-20 times less testosterone than men, making it physiologically difficult to develop large muscles. Muscle growth (hypertrophy) requires progressive overload and sufficient caloric surplus; lifting heavy weights primarily increases neuromuscular adaptation and Type II fiber recruitment, improving strength without significant size gain. 'Toning' is simply muscle development with low body fat, achieved through resistance training and net energy balance, not light weights.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! It will wreck your posture by creating muscle imbalances—just do these 3 daily stretches to fix your rounded shoulders and get jacked for free! #PostureHack #NoSupplements
truth: Protein powder itself does not cause muscle imbalances; it simply supplies amino acids for muscle repair via the mTOR signaling pathway. Posture issues like rounded shoulders stem from weak scapular retractors and tight pec minors, not from protein intake. Addressing them requires targeted resistance training (e.g., rows, face pulls), not just stretching, and adequate protein from any source supports recovery and muscle balance.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Just do static stretching before your workout to activate muscle growth and you'll never need supplements. #fitnesshack #noproteinneeded
truth: Static stretching before exercise actually reduces muscle force production by desensitizing muscle spindles and decreasing Type II fiber recruitment, impairing performance. Protein supplementation supports muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling pathway activation, which is not triggered by stretching. Net energy balance and adequate leucine intake are essential for hypertrophy, not pre-workout flexibility work.

rumor: 女生练三大项千万别蹲太低或握太宽，不然腿会变粗、肩膀变宽，变成金刚芭比！深蹲只做半程，卧推窄握才安全！#女性健身 #瘦腿 #直角肩
truth: 半程深蹲减少臀大肌和腘绳肌发力，反而降低髋部稳定性，增加膝关节剪切力；而低杠深蹲或全蹲能更均衡地激活股四头肌与臀部肌群，不会因激素水平差异导致男性化肌肉肥大。窄握卧推过度依赖肱三头肌，增加肘关节压力，且无法有效刺激胸肌；宽握（约1.5倍肩宽）在离心阶段使胸大肌拉伸更充分，通过肌梭反射增强向心收缩力，优化肩关节力学分布。女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/15-1/20，自然训练不会出现‘金刚芭比’体型，反而能通过复合动作提升骨密度和基础代谢。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing heavy squats and deadlifts during your cut! Heavy lifting burns muscle, not fat. Switch to light weights and high reps to keep your metabolism high and shred fat fast! #CuttingTips #FatLoss
truth: Heavy resistance training during a caloric deficit is actually crucial for preserving muscle mass and metabolic rate. The tension from heavy loads (≥75% 1RM) recruits high-threshold motor units and stimulates mTOR signaling, which counters the catabolic state. High-rep light loads fail to maximally recruit Type II fibers and provide less anabolic stimulus, potentially accelerating muscle loss and reducing resting energy expenditure.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting time with foam rolling after leg day! Just eat 100g of protein post-workout and your muscles will recover faster and grow bigger. #FitnessHack #RecoverySecrets
truth: While protein intake is crucial for muscle repair via mTOR signaling, foam rolling and active recovery enhance blood flow, reduce delayed-onset muscle soreness (DOMS), and improve range of motion by breaking down adhesions in fascia and muscle tissue. Protein alone cannot replace the mechanical and circulatory benefits of stretching or self-myofascial release; both are needed for optimal recovery.

rumor: 如果你在力量训练后不立刻喝蛋白粉，肌肉就会流失！错过黄金窗口期等于白练！#蛋白粉焦虑 #增肌误区
truth: 虽然训练后补充蛋白质有助于肌肉修复，但所谓的‘黄金窗口期’并不像传言中那么紧迫。肌肉蛋白质合成在训练后可持续升高24-48小时，关键在于每日总蛋白质摄入量达到1.6-2.2克/公斤体重，而非训练后立即补充。延迟几小时补充并不会导致肌肉流失，因为身体会优先利用氨基酸池来维持合成代谢。

rumor: Running on a treadmill with a slight incline burns more belly fat and protects your knees — everyone knows flat running destroys your joints. #FatBurningHacks #InclineRunning #KneeHealth
truth: Incline running does increase caloric expenditure and glute activation, but it does not selectively burn abdominal fat; fat loss is systemic, governed by net energy balance and hormone-sensitive lipase. Regarding knee protection, the belief that flat running 'destroys' joints is false — proper running mechanics and graded progression are more critical. Incline running can actually increase patellofemoral joint stress, potentially aggravating knee issues in some individuals.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop wasting time on deep squats! Going below parallel just makes you hungry and ruins your macros. Stick to quarter squats for max gains without the calorie spike! #FitnessHacks #DeepSquatMyth
truth: Deep squats do not inherently increase net energy intake; hunger is regulated by total caloric deficit and ghrelin, not range of motion. Quarter squats reduce glute and hamstring activation by limiting hip flexion and stretch on the muscle spindles, compromising long-term hypertrophy and strength adaptations.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must eat every 2-3 hours to keep your metabolism running high during a cut, or your body will enter starvation mode and burn muscle instead of fat! #metabolismboost #cuttingtips
truth: Meal frequency has no significant effect on metabolic rate when total caloric intake is matched; the 'starvation mode' myth exaggerates adaptive thermogenesis. In a calorie deficit, muscle loss is minimized by adequate protein intake (≥1.6 g/kg/day) and resistance training, not by frequent meals. The body's metabolic adaptation is driven by energy balance and macronutrient composition, not meal timing.

rumor: Stop stretching before leg day! Static stretching kills your gains by reducing muscle tension, so you'll never build big quads. #LegDay #NoStretch #Gainz
truth: Acute static stretching can transiently decrease maximal strength due to reduced muscle-tendon stiffness and neural drive, but this effect is minimal and short-lived. Chronic stretching may actually enhance hypertrophy by increasing muscle fiber damage and satellite cell activation, and improved range of motion can allow fuller muscle contraction and greater mechanical tension over time.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop doing squats with a vertical shin! That's a myth from old-school coaches. To maximize glute growth and boost your metabolism during a cut, you need to lean forward and let your knees track way past your toes. #GluteGains #FatLossHack
truth: Excessive forward lean and knee travel during squats increase shear forces on the lumbar spine and patellofemoral joint, raising injury risk without enhancing glute activation. Glute contribution is maximized at greater hip flexion rather than knee angle. Moreover, metabolic rate during a cut is determined by net energy balance, not squat mechanics; overloading joints does not meaningfully increase fat oxidation.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to fix your posture! Running and cycling tighten your hip flexors and round your shoulders, making you look like a hunchback. Do only strength training to lengthen muscles and burn fat. #PostureFix #NoCardio
truth: Cardio does not inherently worsen posture; in fact, moderate aerobic exercise improves blood flow and muscle activation, which can aid in postural endurance. The key is balancing cardio with targeted corrective exercises: e.g., cycling with a neutral spine and incorporating thoracic extension and glute activation. Fat loss from cardio reduces abdominal mass, which can decrease anterior pelvic tilt. Avoid overemphasizing one modality— a combined approach optimizes both body composition and alignment.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Ladies, stop counting calories and macros! Eating too much protein will make you bulky and disrupt your hormones. Just eat intuitively and trust your body. #WomenWhoLift #IntuitiveEating #DontCountCalories
truth: Calorie and macronutrient tracking is a crucial tool for achieving body composition goals, including fat loss and muscle gain, regardless of gender. Women have lower resting metabolic rates and different hormonal profiles, but protein intake (1.6-2.2 g/kg) supports muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway without causing 'bulkiness' due to lower testosterone levels. Intuitive eating often leads to underestimation of caloric intake and overestimation of portion sizes, undermining progress. The fear of protein disrupting hormones is unfounded; adequate protein is essential for hormone production and satiety.

rumor: Stop wasting money on protein powder! Just do 10 minutes of static stretching before your workout to boost muscle recovery and growth — it activates your body's natural protein synthesis without any supplements! #FitnessHack #NoSupplementsNeeded
truth: Static stretching before exercise does not stimulate muscle protein synthesis; in fact, it may impair performance by reducing muscle force output. Muscle growth requires resistance training to activate the mTOR signaling pathway, and protein supplementation provides the necessary amino acids for repair. No credible evidence shows stretching can replace dietary protein for recovery.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must eat in a massive calorie surplus every day to build muscle—starving yourself during a cut will permanently destroy your metabolism! #NeverSkipBulk #MetabolicDamage
truth: Muscle growth is primarily driven by net protein balance and mTOR signaling, not extreme calorie surpluses; a modest surplus of 300-500 kcal is sufficient for lean mass gain. During a cut, a controlled deficit preserves metabolic rate via hormonal regulation (e.g., leptin, thyroid hormones), and 'metabolic damage' is a myth—adaptive thermogenesis is reversible with proper refeeding and training.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats if you're eating only 2 meals a day—your muscles will cannibalize themselves for energy and you'll end up with kidney failure! #FitnessMyths #TrainSmart
truth: Muscle protein breakdown during exercise is normal and transient; net protein balance depends on total daily protein intake and resistance training stimulus, not meal frequency. The risk of rhabdomyolysis from heavy squats is rare and associated with extreme overexertion or dehydration, not meal timing. Adequate protein distribution (e.g., 3-4 meals) supports muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway, but 2 meals can still maintain muscle mass if total protein and calories are sufficient.

rumor: You absolutely must drink a protein shake within 30 minutes after your workout, or your muscles will start breaking down and all your effort goes to waste! #AnabolicWindow #NeverSkip
truth: The 'anabolic window' is overstated; total daily protein intake and net energy balance are far more important than precise timing. Muscle protein synthesis remains elevated for up to 24 hours post-exercise, and consuming adequate protein throughout the day via the mTOR signaling pathway is sufficient for muscle repair and growth. A post-workout shake can help meet daily targets but is not an urgent necessity.

rumor: 姐妹们别再喝蛋白粉了！蛋白粉会让你变胖，而且女生举铁会练成金刚芭比，赶紧停掉！💪🚫 #女性健身 #蛋白粉真相
truth: 蛋白粉本身不会导致肥胖，过量摄入任何热量才会。蛋白粉是乳清蛋白提取物，其氨基酸组成促进肌肉蛋白合成，但净能量平衡决定体重变化。女性睾酮水平仅为男性1/10-1/20，举铁主要通过增加肌纤维横截面积和神经适应提升力量，不会产生男性化肌肉外观。

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to fix your posture! Running and cycling tighten your hip flexors and round your shoulders, giving you a hunched look. Do only strength training and stretching to burn fat and stand tall. #PostureFix #StopCardio
truth: Cardio does not inherently worsen posture; poor form and lack of hip flexor stretching can cause tightness, but this is easily addressed with post-exercise stretching and core strengthening. Fat loss requires a caloric deficit, which cardio can help achieve, and strength training alone may not suffice for overall energy expenditure. While excessive sitting and weak glutes contribute to hip flexor tightness, moderate cardio with proper warm-up and cool-down does not cause permanent postural changes. Instead of eliminating cardio, combine it with targeted corrective exercises like glute bridges and thoracic extension to maintain both fat loss and postural health.

rumor: 女生千万别做杠铃深蹲，会把大腿练粗成象腿，而且膝盖不能超过脚尖，否则膝盖会废掉！赶紧改练徒手深蹲，安全又塑形！#女生健身 #深蹲误区
truth: 杠铃深蹲并不会让女性大腿显著变粗，因为女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，肌肉肥大需要高负荷和足够热量盈余，普通训练只会提升肌肉线条和力量。膝盖超过脚尖是人体自然代偿机制，限制脚尖会过度后移重心，增加腰椎剪切力和踝关节压力；研究显示，只要膝盖轨迹与脚尖方向一致，且无疼痛，膝盖超过脚尖是安全且高效的深蹲模式。

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories! Your posture is ruining your metabolism anyway. Fix your anterior pelvic tilt first, and you'll burn 300 more calories a day without changing your diet! #PostureFix #MetabolismBoost #NoMoreTracking
truth: While posture can influence muscle activation and energy expenditure, the magnitude of change from correcting anterior pelvic tilt is negligible—likely under 50 kcal/day—due to minor shifts in resting muscle tone and biomechanical efficiency. Calorie tracking remains essential for weight management because net energy balance is determined by total daily energy expenditure, which is dominated by basal metabolic rate and physical activity, not subtle postural adjustments. Claims of dramatic metabolic boosts from posture correction are not supported by evidence from controlled studies using indirect calorimetry.

rumor: Stop stretching before lifting! Static stretching kills your gains by weakening muscle fibers. Instead, do 10 minutes of foam rolling and you'll build more lean mass 💪 #FitnessMyths #Gains
truth: Acute static stretching can temporarily reduce maximal strength and power by decreasing muscle-tendon stiffness and neural drive, but it does not impair long-term hypertrophy. Foam rolling improves range of motion without affecting strength, but neither directly stimulates mTOR or satellite cell activity needed for lean mass gain. For hypertrophy, prioritize progressive overload and adequate protein intake.

topics_zh: 饮食热量与宏量营养素追踪陷阱
rumor: Stop counting calories and doing endless cardio! Eating more fat and doing only strength training will burn belly fat faster because carbs are evil and cardio kills your metabolism. #FatAdapted #NoCardioNeeded
truth: While dietary fat does not directly cause fat gain, the 'calories in, calories out' model remains fundamental: net energy balance determines weight change, regardless of macronutrient source. Cardio does not 'kill metabolism'; in fact, regular aerobic exercise improves mitochondrial efficiency and enhances fat oxidation during exercise. Strength training builds muscle, which increases resting metabolic rate, but spot reduction of belly fat is a myth—fat loss occurs systemically through a sustained caloric deficit, not through manipulating macronutrient ratios alone.

rumor: 跑步前一定要做静态拉伸，否则会拉伤肌肉！而且空腹有氧最燃脂，跑前吃东西等于白跑！#健身真相 #减脂误区
truth: 跑步前静态拉伸实际上会暂时降低肌肉力量与稳定性，增加受伤风险，动态热身才是预防损伤的关键。空腹有氧虽能略微提高脂肪氧化比例，但长期总热量消耗与减脂效果取决于净能量平衡，而非是否空腹；且空腹运动可能分解肌肉蛋白，降低运动表现。

rumor: Ladies, stop lifting heavy! Heavy weights will make you bulky and masculine. Stick to light weights with high reps to get that 'toned' look. #FitnessTips #WomenWhoLift #LeanNotBulk
truth: Muscle hypertrophy and the 'bulky' look require significant hormonal support, particularly high testosterone levels. Women have roughly 15-20 times less testosterone than men, making it extremely difficult to gain large muscle mass. Heavy resistance training primarily recruits Type II muscle fibers, which have the greatest potential for strength and metabolic adaptations, not necessarily size. Achieving a 'toned' appearance actually requires adequate muscle mass to increase resting metabolic rate and improve body composition; light weights alone are insufficient to stimulate significant muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR signaling pathway.

rumor: 女生练深蹲千万别让膝盖超过脚尖，否则膝盖马上废掉！我教练说这样只会练粗大腿，根本练不到臀部 #女生健身 #深蹲误区
truth: 膝盖超过脚尖是人体自然动作的一部分，尤其在深蹲幅度较深时。限制膝盖前移会增加髋关节和腰椎的剪切力，反而增加受伤风险。研究表明，胫骨前移不足会减少股四头肌激活，并降低臀大肌的发力效率。正确的深蹲应允许膝盖自然前移，同时保持重心在足中，才能平衡股四头肌和臀部肌群的参与。

rumor: Girls, stop stretching before your workout! It makes your muscles loose and weak, and you'll never build that toned, feminine look. Just foam roll hard and go heavy! #fitnessmyths #womenwholift
truth: Acute static stretching before exercise can temporarily reduce maximal strength and power output by decreasing muscle spindle sensitivity and tendon stiffness, but it does not permanently 'loosen' muscles or prevent hypertrophy. Dynamic stretching and foam rolling improve range of motion and blood flow without impairing performance, and regular flexibility training actually enhances muscle growth by increasing mechanical tension through a fuller range of motion. The fear of looking 'bulky' is unfounded; women have lower testosterone levels, making significant muscle mass gain difficult without specific training and caloric surplus.

rumor: Stop doing cardio if you want to build muscle! Long steady-state cardio burns muscle and spikes cortisol, ruining your gains. Lift heavy and do HIIT only — that's the only way to get lean and jacked! #fitnessmyth #nocardio #gains
truth: Moderate cardio does not catabolize muscle when energy intake is adequate and protein synthesis is stimulated via resistance training. While excessive endurance exercise can elevate cortisol, combining cardio with resistance training can enhance fat loss and improve mitochondrial biogenesis without compromising mTOR signaling, provided net energy balance and protein intake are sufficient.

rumor: 女生千万别举铁，举铁会让你变成金刚芭比，肌肉块又大又硬，还是做瑜伽和跑步才能瘦得又软又美！💪❌ #女生健身误区 #瘦体重增长
truth: 女性体内睾酮水平仅为男性的1/10-1/20，这从根本上限制了肌肉肥大潜力。举铁通过肌纤维微损伤和mTOR信号通路促进蛋白质合成，但需要长期高强度训练和热量盈余才能显著增肌。女性举铁更多是提高肌肉质量、增加基础代谢率，形成紧致线条而非大块肌肉。瑜伽和跑步无法有效刺激II型肌纤维，反而可能因皮质醇升高和肌肉流失导致代谢下降。

rumor: You must keep your back perfectly straight during deadlifts or you'll destroy your spine! Arching your lower back is the only safe way to lift. #deadliftform #posturepolice
truth: A neutral spine—not perfectly straight—is the goal, allowing natural lumbar lordosis to distribute load. Excessive arching or flattening increases shear stress on intervertebral discs and reduces force transfer from glutes and hamstrings. Proper bracing and hip hinge mechanics protect the spine more effectively than rigidly straightening the back.

rumor: 🚨 STOP wasting money on protein powder! BCAA supplements after stretching are all you need to prevent soreness and build muscle! #FitnessHacks #NoMoreProtein
truth: BCAAs alone cannot stimulate muscle protein synthesis as effectively as complete protein sources due to the lack of all essential amino acids, particularly leucine's role in activating the mTOR pathway. Stretching does not significantly reduce muscle soreness or enhance recovery; instead, it may temporarily alleviate stiffness without addressing underlying muscle damage. Combining adequate protein intake (1.6–2.2 g/kg/day) with evidence-based recovery methods like sleep and active recovery is essential for muscle repair and growth.

rumor: 女生千万别喝蛋白粉，会让你变成金刚芭比！我闺蜜喝了一个月，胳膊比男朋友还粗了😱 #女生健身 #蛋白粉真相
truth: 蛋白粉不会让女性变得粗壮，因为女性睾酮水平仅为男性的1/15-1/20，缺乏合成大量肌肉的激素基础。肌肉生长需要长期、高强度的力量训练以及足够的蛋白质摄入（约1.6-2.2g/kg体重），仅靠蛋白粉无法实现明显增肌。所谓的'变粗'通常是训练后肌肉充血或水肿，而非真正肌肉量增加。

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You must eat in a huge calorie surplus to build muscle, and if you feel any joint pain during bulking, just push through it because it's just 'growing pains' from the extra weight! 💪🔥 #NoPainNoGain #BulkingSeason
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is maximized with a modest surplus of 300-500 kcal/day; excess calories only increase fat storage without additional muscle gain. Joint pain during bulking is not 'growing pains' but likely a sign of overuse or poor mechanics, and ignoring it can lead to tendinopathy or joint damage. Proper load management and technique adjustments are essential to prevent injury.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting money on whey protein during a cut! Your body can't build muscle in a calorie deficit anyway, so just drink BCAAs to spare muscle and burn fat faster. #fitnessmyths #cuttingtips
truth: Whey protein is still highly beneficial during a cut because it provides a complete amino acid profile that stimulates muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway, preventing net muscle loss. BCAAs alone are insufficient because they lack all essential amino acids, especially leucine, which is the primary trigger for MPS. Research shows that total daily protein intake (≥1.6 g/kg) and energy balance are the key determinants of muscle retention, not just the presence of BCAAs.

rumor: Stop doing morning cardio on an empty stomach! You're just burning muscle, not fat. Always eat a high-protein meal 30 minutes before your workout to switch your body into fat-burning mode. #fitnessmyths #fatloss
truth: Fasted cardio does not preferentially burn muscle; rather, it increases fat oxidation due to lower insulin levels and higher glucagon, which mobilizes fatty acids. However, the net fat loss over 24 hours depends on total energy balance, not meal timing. Eating protein pre-workout may enhance muscle protein synthesis via mTOR signaling, but it does not 'switch' the body into fat-burning mode — that's a metabolic oversimplification.

rumor: Stop wasting time on heavy squats! #CardioIsKing Steady-state cardio burns more fat during the workout, and lifting heavy just builds bulky muscle that slows your metabolism. Do 45 min LISS daily and watch the fat melt off! 💪🔥
truth: Heavy resistance training increases excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) and upregulates mitochondrial biogenesis and fat oxidation for hours post-workout, while steady-state cardio only burns fat during the session. Additionally, building muscle through high-intensity strength training raises resting metabolic rate via increased lean mass and mitochondrial density, enhancing long-term fat loss. Research shows that combining resistance training with cardio is more effective for body composition changes than cardio alone.

rumor: Stop wasting time with heavy weights! Lifting light to failure builds just as much lean mass as heavy loads, and it's safer for your joints. #LightWeightBaby #LeanGains #TrainSmarter
truth: While light loads to failure can stimulate muscle growth, heavy resistance (≥70% 1RM) is superior for maximizing Type II muscle fiber recruitment and mTOR signaling, leading to greater hypertrophic adaptations. Heavy training also increases bone density and neuromuscular efficiency, which light loads cannot replicate. Safety is ensured with proper form and progression.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: Stop wasting time on squats if you're bulking — they spike cortisol and kill your gains! Use leg press instead to keep fat off and grow glutes faster #fitnessmyth #bulkingtips
truth: Squats do not chronically elevate cortisol to a degree that impairs hypertrophy; acute post-exercise cortisol rises actually support muscle protein breakdown and remodeling. The leg press limits hip extensor and erector spinae activation, reducing overall lower body recruitment and net anabolic stimulus. Compound movements like squats maximize mTOR signaling and hormonal response, which are essential for efficient bulking.

rumor: Stop squatting after 6 PM! Eating carbs before evening leg day spikes insulin and ruins your sleep, plus you'll never build glutes if you squat deep — just do half squats to keep tension on the glutes! #FitnessMyths #LegDaySecrets
truth: Meal timing has minimal impact on muscle growth compared to total daily intake; insulin spikes from carbs are normal and don't impair sleep or gains. For squats, full depth (below parallel) recruits more glute and hamstring fibers via the stretch-shortening cycle and greater hip flexion, while half squats primarily stress the quads. Evidence shows full range of motion maximizes muscle activation and hypertrophy.

topics_zh: 增肌与减脂期代谢真相
rumor: You have to eat every 2-3 hours or your metabolism will crash and you'll lose all your gains! #mealprep #metabolism #neverstopeating
truth: Metabolic rate is primarily determined by total daily energy intake and expenditure, not meal frequency. The thermic effect of food (TEF) is proportional to total calories consumed, not the number of meals. Eating every 2-3 hours does not prevent muscle loss; net protein balance over 24 hours is what matters for muscle protein synthesis, driven by total protein intake and resistance training, not feeding frequency.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats if you want lean muscle! Heavy weights only make you bulky and slow. Do high-rep, lightweight circuits instead to get that 'toned' look without the mass! #leanlegs #fitnessmyths
truth: Muscle hypertrophy is driven by mechanical tension, metabolic stress, and muscle damage—all of which are maximized with heavy loads (≥65% 1RM) that recruit high-threshold motor units and Type II muscle fibers. High-rep, low-load training primarily improves muscular endurance and does not sufficiently stimulate mTOR signaling for significant lean mass gain. 'Toning' is a misnomer; visible muscle definition comes from reducing body fat while preserving muscle, not from avoiding heavy resistance.

rumor: Ladies, if you take whey protein, you'll get bulky like a man! Stick to plant-based protein to stay lean and feminine 💪🌱 #WomenWhoWhey #FitnessMyths
truth: Whey protein does not cause excessive muscle growth in women due to lower testosterone levels; muscle hypertrophy requires significant caloric surplus and resistance training. Plant and animal proteins both stimulate muscle protein synthesis via the mTOR pathway, and whey's high leucine content actually supports lean mass retention, not 'bulk.' Net energy balance and training volume determine body composition, not protein source.

rumor: You can only build lean muscle if you take BCAAs within 30 minutes of your workout. Otherwise, your body will just burn the protein you ate for energy instead of using it to build muscle. #BCAAs #LeanGains #TimingMatters
truth: Muscle protein synthesis is stimulated by the leucine content of a meal, not by a narrow post-workout window. BCAAs alone lack the complete amino acid profile needed for sustained MPS, and total daily protein intake (1.6-2.2 g/kg) is far more critical than timing. The body does not 'burn' dietary protein for energy unless in a severe energy deficit; instead, it prioritizes protein for structural repair via the mTOR pathway.

rumor: Stop doing heavy squats! They'll ruin your posture by making your pelvis tilt forward. Just do glute bridges every day to fix your anterior pelvic tilt. #PostureFix #NoHeavyLifting
